The only complaint is that it is a bit too spicy. Wish there was a way to reduce the amount of spiciness. We tried all the ways to cut it by adding other ingredients, but they either don't help and/or they change the flavor. I'd give this 4.5 stars for the convenience + flavor if the ingredient which makes it spicy were in a separate packet which you could adjust.Maybe we are wimps. Try it for yourself. It goes well with Basmati rice, but any fresh rice will do. Enjoy!
shipping and items are both satisfactory. curry is a little bit salty but with adding plentiful stuff (apple, onion, carrots, squash,potatoes besides chicken) it's not a big deal.
This is delicious! It's very easy to make and there is hardly anything in it that is bad for you. Naan is necessary

Delicious!  My wife and I love this curry!  It is a little bit on the spicy side, so our daughter will only eat a little of it, but that is great, because it leaves more for us.  She prefers the chick pee curry!

Received it this week, made a package tonight with one large cut up chicken breast, perfect meal for me, I will keep this on hand always. I will subscribe to the item, may quicken the pace a bit more, I see eating it more than I originally thought I would.

This is for the butter chicken curry.  Made some of this for my mom, then the next day went to a local Indian place.  The homemade from this pouch was every bit as good as the restaurant.  There is no hint of "too much salt" like some claim.  I will order this, and others from them, again.  I also works well with pork or steak, although I prefer the chicken or pork with this spice mix though.  I also have tried adding coconut milk and it tastes awesome this way.

Ive never made curry before but I've tasted it and this comes very close to it. It taste very authentic to what I know. It is very easy to prepare. You can just add meat or you can add meat with fresh onion, bell pepper and minced garlic. This product is paste form. It makes it very easy to prepare your curry with no mess and no fuss. Very simple and hard to screw it up. My kids absolutely love this when I cook it. We even buy the Naan bread from our Walmart to go with this. It's very simple and easy to make. The taste is very delicious. You do not even need to add anymore spice to this if you don't want. I would definitely be buying this again once my 6 packs is gone. I can't afford to take my big family out to an authentic Indian restaraunt so this is the next best thing to it. Awesome job to Amazon for carrying this product and awesome job to Kitchens of India for making this. I am your new loyal fan. Now I wonder how the other flavors taste. I will have to try them too.
I am very satisfied this curry!!.actually i don't like spicy,but this curry just okay!i'll gonna buy again!this curry is perfect ever!!!!

Normally I make a lot of sauces myself, but this Butter Chicken Curry paste is great as is and, at this price, a staple in my cupboard. All you need is the rice, chicken, and butter and you've got dinner. I also recommend the Curry Chicken paste by Kitchens of India - it has much more of a kick to it if you're in the mood for spice.

I can make this myself and have in the past, but this is just so convenient if I don't have all the spices or sauce in the house.  I don't think it's too spicy so I add a little hot curry spice to the sauce. I also fry a large white onion in a little olive oil first then add the sauce and chicken. I don't usually add the butter as I don't think it makes much difference.  This is great and will be a staple in my house.

The Butter Chicken Curry is easy to prepare and tastes great. Once the chicken is cut up, it's just under 30 minutes to the table. Mix butter, chicken, water and the paste together and let it simmer. This is a popular brand in Indian groceries, and I see why. We love it.

I have tried many different brands of Butter chicken masalas from Indian stores. This is the Best Tasting Butter chicken I have ever tried. And the best part is, my 9 yr old son loves it. I highly recommend this to anyone who wants to try ready to eat masala. While using this brand, I reduce the recommended Butter quantity to half. You may need to adjust to your taste.
cheap! it was like $1.2 for each; I usually buy one pack for $2 in local grocery store; taste great!

This spice packet is awesome. It creates the best butter chicken. I do add some tomato sauce or tomato paste to the mix to give it a nice sauce. When I have guests over I use extra butter and I top it off with a dollop of sour cream to turn it into a restaurant style dish.

I have been using these for a while. I not only use them for a variety of curries, but also for Biryanis as well.I have a bunch of KOI curry pastes, and I mix and match quite often. The result is usually delicious because most of the KOI curry pastes taste good.This particular curry paste is not too thick or thin. It has a tangy taste to it, more so than it should be. I usually get rid of the excess tangy taste by adding a different curry paste packet to it.

Kitchens of India Paste for Butter Chicken is wonderful!!!!!!!!!!!!!  I am a person who enjoys a variety of dishes, especially those with a hint of spice and a Caribbean taste.  So that is how I landed on this wonderful packet.  I have used this paste on New York Strips and with rice and my next adventure will be to blend the paste with yam.  And by the way my significant other just loves, (HE LOVES) this wonderful paste.  If he could have it his way he would eat, the rice that I cook for him and the New York Strip with the paste everyday of the week.  And matter fact I just bought Kitchens of India Paste for Butter Chicken today!!!!!!!!!!!!!  If your reading this post, GO AND GET THIS GREATNESS!!!!!! YOU WILL NOT BE SORRY!!!!!!!!!!

I love this product.  I am a vegatarian and some of my friends are vegan an this product works well for me.  I split it in half and also split a can of cocounut milk in half and simmer veggies with one half and chicken with the other.  It makes a ton for my family of 4.  I cook the chicken mostly thorugh before I add the milk and paste and let it simmer for another 20 minutes.  The veggie side, I mostly use whatever I have, but frozen cauliflower and veggie mix bags work well as well as fresh stuff.  Simmer for 20 minutes to let the sauce thicken and the paste to fully incorporate.

i've used this product before and prefer it to other quick butter chicken packages i've tried. it requires less cooking skill than making Hamburger Helper and it makes for a great introduction to Indian foods. you pretty much just add a bit of butter or oil, stir in this paste, add some cooked chicken and you're good to go. this also has no heat to it, so if you like spicier food, you're going to have to add your own heat to it.

I'm not a big fan of curry but my girlfriend loves the stuff.  I found this on a good deal so I decided to try it because of the reviews. Glad I did! It is delicious and had just the right amount of spice -not too strong like other curries where it overpowers everything else in the dish that have turned me off to the spice.  No sketchy ingredients either, a huge plus!Other reviewers have said they used cooked or semi cooked chicken- there is no need for this, as the recipie is designed to cook raw chicken.  I usedthigh pieces and it came out perfectly cooked and tender. Instead of the 3T butter called for by the recipie, I used 1T of butter and 2T of Smart Balance(Light) to cut down a bit on the fat.  The extra butter probably would have made it that much better but is not needed for great taste. I served it overrice, and despite the claim on the box of 4 servings, it really is only 3 assuming it is the centerpiece of your meal. Buy it!

column9: Definitely a HIT in our kitchen!
column10: Even though it seemed to have mostly great reviews, I didn't have super high expectations for this packet mix...but it ended up knocking my socks off! It had a really nice taste with just enough hint of heat to be tasty but not overpowering. I do have a cooking suggestion, however--I followed the directions to the T (I always do the first time I make something like this) and I ended up having a hard time mixing the paste in quick enough because it really is a thick paste and it took more time that I thought for it to break down and my water was boiling away. Or something like that--I made it a few days ago and my memory isn't that great, but I just remember thinking that the next time, I'd pre-mix the water and paste outside of the pan first to make sure it's all reconstituted nicely with no lumps. I don't think there is any way you could get all the lumps out if you put the chicken in at the same time as the paste packet. ANYWAY, we had it with coconut rice and it was delish. I can't wait to make it again!

I simply followed the recipe is on the package, and now I can make chicken curry!! It's tasty and more importantly, I don't have to go the restaurant and pay for this dish any more.This is a really awesome deal.

This is the best tasting Curry I've found outside of very few authentic Indian restaurants.  It's flavor is unmatched. Perfect blend of spices! I used to buy this Curry Paste at a local store. After they stopped carrying it I searched for quite awhile to find it.  Luckily I tried Amazon and they had it! My husband and I were so pleasantly surprised to finally find it we put it on Autoship.  If you like butter curry this is a must try.
Makes a nice meal with sauteed onions and frozen peas. Unfortunately, I'm allergic to chili peppers, so if you have a similar allergy, this product might not be for you.

This was excellent! A bit spicy for me, but I'm a spice wuss. I think I'll add another 1/2-1 lb chicken next time as I had quite a bit of sauce left over. Imagine it would also be good with shrimp. I put this over rice and added broccoli. I have to say that I never thought I could get such an excellent meal from a packaged paste. HIGHLY recommend.

column9: Now, Any one can cook Indian Chicken Curry
column10: Good item for those who want to cook chicken the Indian Way.make sure you start your cooking after you have enough Fried Onions,(Fried to golden brown)....

I have made butter chicken from the Kitchens of India paste five times now (including for dinner last night). Each time, it has tasted a little different, but each time, it's been delicious! It is not too spicy, it just has a rich, delicious flavor. The recipe is easy to follow, too. I usually eat mine with jasmine rice and a piece of naan bread, and everything goes beautifully together.

My entire extended family gets this curry paste because it is the best we can find. I make it about once every two weeks. With rice and chicken, I easily get three large meals. Which works out to less than $2 per meal. I never add the butter as called for in the directions because it is absolutely flavorful enough without it. With subscription, it is cheaper than buying it in the grocery store.I would give it more than five stars if I could.

This is a fast, easy, tasty curry fix.  It's may be a little spicy for some people.  I'd rate it 2.5 stars on a four star hotness scale.I like it best made with boneless chicken thighs, but chicken breasts/tenders are OK (if a bit more dry.)  Cut the chicken into 1-2 inch pieces and throw it in the pot with the curry mixture.  You'll have 3-4 tasty meals in about twenty minutes.  I like to serve it over rice, but naan is fine.  Leftovers are good too.Personally, I'd rate it 4-1/2 stars, but that wasn't an option.  I eat this 3-4 times a month.Their other dishes are nice too, but this is my favorite.

This stuff is good. People who have never tasted curry love it. People who've had curry loved it. It's simple to make and a cheap way to have something "exotic".My husband, who eats like a bird and doesn't like most kinds of curry, will stuff himself into oblivion with this. He can actually eat more of this stuff than I can, and I am usually the one who can eat more in one sitting...Recommend it. Totally and completely worth the money. You will not regret this deliciousness! :D

Although I didn't buy this from Amazon, I'm writing this review because it is perfect tasting for my tongue.The reason I first tried this product was because I was sick of those fake derived instant japanese/korean curry and wanted try something more of real curry.This curry paste let me have an amazing chicken(breast or thigh) curry within 30 minutes.The instruction is so easy and no other ingredients are needed other than water and chicken!

This is a total must buy if you like indian food! It was recommended to me by an Indian who frequently purchases this curry paste for her own family. It is very easy to make and tastes better than the indian restaurant down the street! Love it!
This makes some of the best curry I've ever eaten! We've bought it several times and will continue to do so. I would highly recommend this product to anyone who is a fan of Indian food.
Kitchens of India makes a wonderful product that is extremely easy to use. If you are in a hurry, but want good Indian food, this is the best.

A friend recommended this to me one day when I mentioned I was craving butter chicken. I used to get it from the local grocery stores, but now it's very hard to find it. Now I get it by subscription and never have to worry about finding it again.It's a mildly spicy sauce and it's very good as leftovers(the flavor soaks more into the chicken after a day or two).
Excellent product.  I love indian food but I do not have any places nearby that sell it.  This is truly authentic in taste.  You really don't need to add anything exxcept what's on the package.
Probably my favorite of the Kitchens of India line, the Butter Chicken Curry paste, is super easy to make and is delicious!Just add water, add chicken (I used firm tofu), cook, stir and DONE!  :)

This is a wonderful way to easily make a tasty chicken dish. It is a one pan meal and I found delicious. I wife found it a little spicy(hot) but enjoyed the flavor. Eat with more rice to turn down the heat.

This product must be Kitchens of India's flagship product.  It is hands down by far the tastiest of all of their products by a wide margin.  I recommend this item first over on top of any of their other products because it will become your "gateway drug" to Kitchens of India products.  Medium spice, superb flavor.  Cooking this with an additional sliced onion makes it even better.

The flavor is really good and it seems very authentic. I know there are some complains about sodium. When I cook my chicken, I had to add a bit more salt to enhance the flavor and that made it perfect. Other than that, there are no complaint.
Has an excellent flavor.One hint when preparing get the paste and water,butter mixed with a whisk before adding chicken as it's very thick.

column4: camomile reviewer "*would like to try out the...
column9: Surprising good butter chicken curry from a pouch!
column10: I purchased this on sale after seeing all of the great reviews on Amazon not really expecting much. Although there are many great Indian restaurants in New York sometimes I neither have the time or inclination to go out nor do I have many good indian restaurants locally that deliver.With that in mind I took the plunge on KOIs Butter Chicken Curry. Preparation was simple, so simple that I was even more suspect than when I originally purchased. Based on recommendation of some of the reviewers I added additional liquid (1 cup of water and 1 cup of 1% milk) and sauteed my soy curls ahead of time. I found that adding the additional liquid help dissipate some of the saltyness of the pouch. I also added some fresh garlic in the beginning and garnished with cilantro at the end.The taste was as good as many of the restaurants on 6th street (indian row) in New York, very easy to prepare, and at a fraction of the cost of eating out. Grab some frozen naan from trader joes and whip up some jasmin or basmati rice and you have yourself a quick and tasty indian meal.One star off for the salt content but otherwise this is now a household staple.

I don't usually have to cook for myself because my wife does the job. i bought this to keep at home as a standby and it came in handy when my wife went away for a trip during the weekend and i had to cook for myself. Even as an inexperience cook, this is no challenge to make. The instructions are clear and was prepared quickly. I am Indian and have to admit that the taste is not too authentic but still, it has got great flavor in it and is pretty good for people who can eat spicy food.

column9: Use double the water to reduce salt
column10: These pastes are so good and so easy. I bought the butter chicken paste only because it had the lowest sodium count of all their pastes, but I have yet to actually make it with chicken! I also use two cups of water instead of one and it doesn't taste watered down at all (I don't add butter either). Last night I cut a large yam into 1-1/2" cubes, sliced a kielbasa into coin-size pieces and cooked as directed (but with the 2 cups of water). Served it over rice. May not be traditional but it was tasty and couldn't be easier. The yams thicken up the sauce nicely too (regular potatoes would probably do so too).

Firstly, I'm an American and have never been to India.  I do work with a lot of Indians however, and go to local Indian restaurants for lunch with them or to places they recommend.One of my favorites at the Indian restaurants has always been the Butter Chicken (all varieties).  I wasn't expecting much, but based on the reviews and the fact that the price was right, I decided to give this product a chance.  I have to say I am very pleasantly surprised.  This comes very close to what I've had at Indian restaurants.  Not only was it easy to prepare, it was very tasty.  I served it over white rice.  Even my extremely children liked it.  Definitely a keeper.  The best part is that I have 5 more packages left!  For $8ish for the 6-pack of curry paste, you can't go wrong.

I love this stuff.  It is spicy but not too bad..  I love spicy and sometimes add a bit of pirates bite to it..  I have been serving with a bag of steamed veggies or 2 boxes.  Potatos,green beans  the healthy weight blend all work great!  This is my once per week go to meal

What can I say? It was my first real introduction to Indian 'prepared foods/mixes'...and it was GREAT!! Butter Chicken Curry ROCKS! Highly recommend the 'Kitchens of India' multi-packs (as side-dishes)...as I had (as well as 'Cauliflower ala Ramesh' *steamed cauliflower w/ coconut cream sauce, and lighty topped with crushed cashews*)!! All those flavors just 'mesh' together very well for a highly enjoyable meal experience. Try some TODAY!

I had seen this product in the store, but wasn't sure about how it would taste. I am SO grateful for all the reviewers here on Amazon because I took a chance based on the reviews. This was simply delicious! I love that it was fast and easy and had a great likeness to the Indian restaurant that we frequent. I liked that it was spicier than the restaurant version, but not overly so. Next time I think I will throw in a few cubed potatoes and some veggies. Basmati rice is a must :) Thank you so much Kitchens of India!! And many thanks to Amazon to carrying it for an extremely competitive price. A *must* buy!!

column9: good gandhi good curry let's eat in a hurry!
column10: hi, i've never attempted curry.  at the simplest add water, butter, and chicken.i must say i was happy with my first attempt.  i added frozen veggies/onions and frozen chicken strips from costco.  i was impressed.  i'm not picky when it comes to food but i thought it was delicious.  a lady friend thought the same thing.  we ate it over white rice.my second attempt wasn't as goo.  i tried it with potatoes, onions, and vietnamese pressed pork (given to me by my priest).  i think the sweetness of the onions and the blandness of the pork subdued some of the flavor and kick.  nonetheless, i still liked it.my next attempt i will try using milk instead of water. does anyone know what i can add to make it a lil more spicy?  any help is appreciated.  i got a pack of 6 for ~$5.  definitely worth trying out.

column9: Great product but now way too expensive
column10: This is an excellent product that is easy to make, great flavor and one of the few items in the line that is not too hot for kids.We were buying it regularly and then it quadrupled in price because a third party rather than Amazon is selling it.If you can find it at regular prices it's well worth the money.

column9: Needs A Bit of Tweking for My Taste
column10: I do believe that this is the best store bought Indian Food product that I have up until today tried. I did find it a bit too spicy for my liking and my kids couldn't eat it all even with added yogurt. I think I will use less butter next time and add milk instead of water. I would like to try potatoes or maybe chickpeas along with the chicken and saute some onions or shallots.I have tried the Kitchens Of India Vegetable Biryani Paste and it was so hot as to be inedible for me. This was not nearly that spicy and I could taste the flavors. I think the salt was overboard too, but that isn't a huge concern for me.Another favorite of mine is Tasty Bite Madras Lentils Entree, Heat & Eat, 10-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6). It has a nice flavor with only a hint of after-burn. Once again my kids couldn't eat it, but it's especially good with a little shredded cheddar and a dollop of sour cream as a dip.

column9: ALMOST AS GOOD AS MY FAVORITE INDIAN RESTAURANT!!
column10: This has no meat in it--it is a curry paste/simmer sauce for your meat of choice. We had boneless pork chops on hand, so we diced the pork and used it instead of chicken. No biggie! You could use any meat in this, or frozen peas, potatoes and mushrooms for a vegetarian meal. We do like creamy curries here in Cincinnati, so at the very end of cooking, we added some heavy whipping cream (you could also use half and half or evaporated/canned milk.) Awesomely good, spicy but not too hot, and great depth of flavor! I am ordering more.

...Kitchens of India Butter Chicken Curry Paste!!!I ordered this curry for two main reasons: I've been thinking about trying to cook an Indian dish and it would get here in three days, thanks to free TwoDay Shipping as a student on Amazon. I did the research, read all 83 reviews, and went ahead and decided to purchase. It got here yesterday and it is simply amazing.I altered the recipe a little bit due to some reviewer's noting that it salty and spicy. Seems like the kind of thing you can do your own thing with. I'm a college kid cooking for myself and so I need each pack to make a stew that will last longer than just that night's dinner. With that in mind, I did the following  ~ love onions so I dumped about half a small white onion and the 3tablespoons butter in and let that cook for a little while  ~ next added chicken because africans don't just toss raw chicken into sauce. I let it brown pretty well on both sides (5mins approx). and it was 1 and a half whole chicken breast cut up into fairly big pieces.  ~ substituted '1 cup water' for a little less than half a pint of Shamrock Heavy Cream (let that sit for 10mins or so) and by this time the heat is way low as to not curdle the milk, and because I wanted the chicken to be more than 1/2 way done. also tossed in lots of peas and carrots in tiny bitesized pieces.  ~ now the paste and two whole basil leaves!  ~ I added about 3/4 teaspons of flour to thicken it slightly, and water as I saw fit. Simmered for 15mins after the addition of paste.The end result was a curry that is slightly sweet, a little creamy, and very much what the Kitchens of India served up! I don't know what anyone's 'hot meter' is comparable to mine but Africans like it hot and Southwest food is pretty hot! This was tame in comparison - maybe a 4 out of 10 - but I liked it that way. I have a subscription but it looks like one pack is enough to last me at least 4 days! I would certainly recommend this to anyone with a hankering for curry. It was really quite delicious.Pros - slightly sweet thick curry, easy to make, directions were clear (even if i altered them), quick prep time for the chicken and everything else I put in.Cons - none! I'm not tempted to try it with just water to get the full effect of spice or salt. But I'm sure I'd like it too!

I love this curry paste!  It is very flavorful, quick and easy to make.  Since it is a paste, you can add whatever you like.  I usually make two packets at a time with half chicken and half chickpeas or white beans.  I also like to add sauteed onions and extra curry powder.  It is very tasty.
I have used lentils, chickpeas, or potatoes in place of the chicken. If it's too spicy for your liking you can use milk instead of water to make the sauce--it really cut down on the bite.
I can not believe the quality of this paste. It is truly delicious. If you love good Indian food you will not be disappointed. Incredible for the price.

I rarely write reviews but this was so amazing i had to!!  I have had a lot of authentic Indian food so I was nervous that this would be a poor substitute for the real thing, I'm so glad I ordered this - Everyone I have served this to loves it!!! My husbands most requested dinner! It is a little spicy but with a yogurt sauce on the side not too bad! I added a can of chickpeas - wow, I also brown the chicken a little before adding the sauce & I always use 2 packets at a time (double the recipe) because its amazing the next day (the chickpeas absorb the flavor of the sauce much more on the 2nd day).

The grocery store that I shop at stopped carrying this item.  I am so glad that I found it here on Amazon!  It is one of my favorite dishes to make.  I eat it over brown rice and a little quinoa.  LOVE IT!!

This gets 4 stars because of the high taste:convenience ratio. It is missing the "kick" that Indian food usually has. I feel as though you need 2 packets to enhance the flavor, but then the sodium content would be extremely high.

I made this for my husband using bite-size pieces of lean pork, and the meat came out unbelievably tender. It took a little less time to cook than the chicken, probably about 15 min. In the morning, I put some brown rice in the rice cooker, used vegetable broth instead of water, and set the timer for 6:00 pm. While the meat was cooking, I threw some frozen spinach in the microwave. I put the rice and spinach on a plate and topped it with the wonderful curry. So we had a great meal prepared in less than 20 min.

This has become a staple around our house and a standing order.  It's that good!  It tastes like our favorite Indian restaurant at a fraction of the price.  We love it with Basmati rice, but any rice would be good with it.  It's quite easy to make, as well.

I bought a pack of 6 of the Butter Chicken because it was cheap and I figured it was worth giving it a shot, but I frankly wasn't expecting it to be much different than the usual jars and pastes I can find in various stores.But I have to say I was very pleasantly surprised, it's extremely easy to make, doesn't require you to have anything unusual in your fridge/pantry, and it tastes great! My family all liked it. Definitely better than whatever else I have been buying in stores over the years.I don't know Indian food, so I have no clue whether it is authentic or sub-standard compared to home made, but for me it is great. And I immediately ordered another pack of 6.

This is so very easy to make and so very delicious! It is only a bit spicy, and the heat does not last long. We use boneless chicken thighs to make it, and it is so very good! Put on top of some rice and instant yum! We love it so much we ended up getting a subscription for autodelivery!

Prior to discovering this product, I was making a very generic type chicken curry, really just chicken stew with curry powder added....... I ordered this when it was on special, and  didn't really know what to expect.  Now that I've used it, I must say it's very good, spicy but not too hot.  I usually use two packages and a whole cut up chicken that I lightly brown, and then add one medium sliced onion.  It's quick, easy and so delicious.

column9: Easy, Quick, Flavorful Dinner in 20 Minutes!
column10: We cook dinner most nights and found ourselves stuck in a rut on weeknights because of time-frame and kids' schedules.  This item came up in my Gold Box Lightning Deals choices,and, with the excellent reviews, I decided to try it.This is very easy to make - 3 tablespoons of butter, 1 cup of water, cubed chicken & the spice packet.  20 minutes.  Easy.  I've made it different ways - like the directions, but have also added onions & other vegetables & put the mixture over rice & pasta.  I'm lucky in that my kids eat just about everything (vegetables, spicy food, etc.), so this meal is always gobbled down no matter what I add to the mixture.I'm very happy with this purchase & will buy again.

column9: now I can cook Indian food at home
column10: I saw good reviews on this item and decided to give it a try. Wow~ it smell and tastes really good. Now we can have good Indian curry dish at home without paying a lot for restaurant takeouts.

column9: Why eat out ?!?  This stuff is GREAT !!
column10: I spent a year living in New Delhi, and developed quite a fondness for Indian food.  This is as close as I have *ever* come to recreating the restaurant fare at home.  Easy to use, reasonable price, and the quality and taste are VERY VERY GOOD.Highly recommend.

I had purchased this product at a closeout store, and really liked it, but unable to find in the local grocery, so was happy to find it on Amazon.  The flavor is spicy, but not overwhelming, and an easy way to make a quick dinner. The consistency is just right for serving over rice.

I followed the instructions precisely, with the only change being (at the suggestion of my 19 year-old nephew) to add raisins about 5 minutes before serving.  Everyone loved this dish - especially my 14 year-old niece. She saved the leftovers and ate them later in the evening.This dish has just the right amount of 'bite' to it, and we enjoyed it with rice and some steamed vegetables.  Contrary to its name, it is not greasy, oily or high fat.  Just v-e-r-y good!

I found this product locally at our Albertson's several years ago.  They stopped carrying it.  I was so glad to find it here.  I use the microwave directions and it comes out perfect.  Serve with some Jasmine rice and a simple veggie.  The flavor is yummy and leftovers are great warmed up in the sauce.  Now I've got plenty in my pantry.
Both my daughter and I found this very tasty, and it"s so easy to make.  Tastes authentic, highly recommended!

column9: Super tasty - and the 4 year old liked it too!
column10: Tried this recently based on the ++ reviews.  We enjoyed it with chicken over rice. The seasonings were very complex - with a medium heat (by our tastes).  My 4 year old son, who can be a picky eater ate 2 helpings and has asked when we'll have it again.  I had the leftovers for lunch the next day and the chicken was even more tender.

I had never tried this particular product before. I rely heavily on your customers reviews, and I must say I have never seen a food item get this much positive feedback. Anyway, I thought I would give it a try....and boy am I glad I did. It was an instant hit with the whole family! We'll definitely be ordering it again.

These spice packets are pretty much perfect.I recommend starting with a whole chicken or skin-on pieces, grill quickly over high heat to char the skin somewhat and give the chicken a smoky flavor. If using whole chicken, cut it up into large-ish pieces and throw into a crock pot along with butter, tomatoes, potatoes, diced onion, and some other veggies.The smokiness of the chicken and the awesome spices make a perfect match. You can take the skin off prior to serving, but leaving it on during cooking makes the sauce taste just that much better.Like pretty much everyone else said - this is 'shortcut' Nirvana.Enjoy, my Amazononian friends!
I liked this product enough that I will order it again. It isn't too spicy, which is a bit of a downside for me.

This is easy, tastes great, and anyone else will think you did a lot of prep. And I cook a lot of Indian from scratch.The paste contains all the spices, just add chicken, butter, and water.  It's a bit salty so it tastes best when made with unsalted butter. Try it.

I bought this didn't really know what to expect but since Amazon sell this as today's deal. I might try it as well. And it turn to be the best curry I have ever tasted!Definitely will buy more when I run out stock.

column9: Fantastic! Simple and easy yet very tasty!
column10: This is one of the best Butter Chicken sauces I have ever tried.  It is slightly spicier than I prefer so I actually add an extra 1/2 cup of coconut cream to it. Great product at a fantastic price!  It satisfies my Butter Chicken cravings and I think it's healthier than than getting take-out.  I highly recommend this product.

column9: Delicious BASE, a little spicy, great w Rice
column10: This was so easy to prepare!  The only thing that made the meal preparation take a while is thawing the chicken x_x  One bag's worth of stew, with chicken added, WITH RICE was a satisfying meal for two. I made a side salad too and that really sealed the deal.  Very delicious! But probably not the healthiest.Also since the stew was quite spicy, I added extra water to tone it down a little (was still excellent after!) yet still, both time I prepared it I wished I had made extra rice.I will definitely try other kitchen of india curries now :-)

column9: Quick Fix for Indian ... Even better than going out!
column10: We purchased the Butter Chicken Curry packs when Amazon had a great sale and were skeptical on the taste.  Low and behold, the taste way exceeded our expectations! We are not meat eaters, so we added tofu and cauliflower (instead of chicken) and were impressed with how authentic the taste was compared to restaurants we've been to.  Nothing beats fresh but this unassuming packet of goodness could rival some of the indian restaurants we frequent! Perfect meal in taste and price!!!

I loved this dish.  My husband won't eat Indian food, so I don't have anyone to go out to eat with.  I tried this at home and loved it.  So did he!  Be sure to add the cream at the end, it makes the whole dish just heavenly.  Found some Naan bread at my local Walmart.  Perfect dinner.
I didn't think a packaged meal would be as good as this was. I made it like Appleonius did and I think it was as good as a restaurant dish.

column9: Makes a very good chicken makhani (butter chicken)
column10: Butter chicken is one of my favorite Indian dishes. This little spice pouch greatly exceeded my expectations by making it easy to make a very flavorful rendition of it using only one pot.1 cup of water, 3 tablespoons butter (I used Smart Balance and it came out great), a pound of chicken (the bagged frozen Tyson grilled chicken strips work great) and 20 minutes and you have a dish that closely approximates the restaurant version. I added some slices of Vidalia onion at the very end so they'd stay crunchy.Great product, great value. [...]

column9: Very close to the real thing
column10: First let me start of that i am an indian residing in the US. I miss authentic indian food and dont get to eat good indian food in the restaraunts in my city.These are very vlose to the real thing and taste just yummy. For people who dont eat too much spice the butter chicken wood be an excellent choice. Now i do cook the real butter chicken(not the best cook) i think this tastes better and is very easy to prepare. I didnt have to add any additional ingredients and the chicken came out great. Even entertained a few american guests and they were all over it !

Did you ever just need a fast, easy and quick remedy to solo cooking?  Have a yen for Indian food that just won't go away?  This product is GREAT--just add chicken (it says chicken breast, but chicken thighs also worked well), heat through and dinner is served.  A very tasty dinner it is, too!

I didn't think that this Butter Chicken Curry paste would hold up to a traditional, home cooked Indian meal...but I was gratefully wrong. My mom is a fantastic cook and this paste does a great job emulating that authentic, home made taste. At roughly $2 (or less on sale), this is far cheaper than going out to eat at an Indian restaurant.My girlfriend and I make this but we first cook down some sweet onion and brown the chicken a bit before adding the curry paste and water. The instructions tell you to add raw chicken but that sounds a little odd to us. We also like to add some extra heat via red chili powder. If you brown the chicken first, cut it into large enough pieces so that they don't dry out during cooking. We've also used this paste to make butter shrimp & it's a great alternative. All of our friends (Indian + non-Indian) LOVE this stuff. Indian approved!

The best butter chicken you ever had!Start with a medium SWEET (very important) onion and 2 - 3 cloves of garlic minced. Sautee in butter, very slowly while cutting chicken into 1" to 2" cubes (small because it cooks faster). Add the chicken to the onion/garlic sautee and add 2 tsp turmeric (or to taste) and 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper (more or less to taste).Start cooking your rice at this time.Cook over medium heat (don't burn the garlic) until chicken is done (5 to 10 minutes). Pre-mix the Kitchens of India Butter Chicken paste in a small bowl using hot water until smooth and add the mixture to the pan. Cook down to desired consistency.Optional: add tomato paste, plain yogurt or cream cheese (separately or in any combination). Or add a fresh mango cut into small pieces for "Mango Chicken".This makes a truly restaurant-class Indian dish and takes just 30 - 40 minutes from concept to meal. Serve with a small salad, fresh veggies and nan for a complete meal that is a real treat! Serves four (or two really hungry people). Double the recipe for 4 or more - the leftovers are just as good as the dinner and probably won't last until morning.

I wasn't sure what to expect when I purchased this.  And I hesitated and hesitated...  But, I'm glad I finally got this!  This tastes delicious and it was so easy.You get 6 individually packaged boxes and each package has the directions. The packages contain one foil packet of the paste.  I first melted the butter with the water and then mixed the paste in. Then I added the chicken and cooked until ready.  That's it!  It was really all I did and it came out great.  The smell in the house while this is cooking was heavenly.I used a little less butter than the recipe asked for and it still turned out delicious.  We served this over rice and we really enjoyed it.There is also a Microwave Oven recipe for those folks that don't have a stove or would rather use the Microwave.The expiration dates on these were all well out into late next year, so I have plenty of time to use these.  But, there is no way they are going to last that long.  I'm sure I'll use these all up in the next month or so.Because of the great success with this item, I ordered some of the other items from this line.  I'm eager to test them out and see if they are as wonderful as this one.I have always wanted to make a tasty Indian dish at home and just didn't know how to go about it.  I'm so glad I found these.  Big taste.  And big money saver versus going to my local Indian restaurant.

With a significant population of recent immigrants from India in the Silicon Valley came a welcome increase in the number of authentic Indian restaurants. San Franciscan's have always enjoyed a diverse bounty of culinary experiences and it's always a challenge to replicate the great recipes at home. I was hoping this product would accomplish that. while quite flavorful, the overall taste is burdened with way too much salt (not authentic proportion) so, like the other 3 star reviewer, I added one half can of coconut milk. The result was an improvement (if not anymore authentic) and tasted more like Thai Curry which I enjoy also. It's a shame that the saltiness dominates what could be a much better product. I even used unsalted butter and still found the saltiness overwhelming.
Wife uses potatoes and chickpeas with this.  Very very close to restaurant quality Indian food.

I live in suburban Detroit and love Indian food. Unfortunately, the nearest Indian restaurant is probably 25 miles away from my home, which isn't real convenient. So when this Kitchens of India product was offered as a Lightning Deal from Amazon, I decided to take a chance on it. I was, however, very skeptical. How could something so simple produce great tasting Indian food at home? Well, I am skeptical no longer. I made this for the first time last night and was amazed at how easy it was. All you do is put your raw chicken pieces in a pot with some water, butter, and this product. Then you cook it for about 25 minutes. That's it. One pot and less than a half hour of cooking time. And let me tell you: While the taste of the finished product might not be exactly the same as that found in an authentic Indian restaurant, it's darn close. So close, in fact, that I'd be willing to bet that a lot of people couldn't tell the difference. I can't recommend this product any more highly. It will definitely satisfy my cravings for Indian food going forward! And you can bet that I'll be trying other Kitchens of India products soon! (Edit: One cooking suggestion that at least one other reviewer mentioned and I just recently tried... Add some chopped onions to the mixture for the last five minutes of cooking time. The onions make a great dish even better!)
When you love Indian food, but don't have the time to cook it, Kitchens of India is a really great alternative. I have yet to be disappointed in one of their dishes and this one is no exception.

This is great butter chicken curry.  I usually marinate the chicken in a package (maybe add some yogurt) for an hour or two and then just add the water as it calls for.  It is also good as is.  I used chicken breasts, cooking it a little less then it called for and it turns out wonderful.  Serve with jasmine rice and you have a great quick dinner.

This Butter Chicken is awesome!  It reminds me so much of my favorite Indian restaurant that I went to at least once a week before I moved to a different city.  This was one of the biggest things I missed with the move.  Now, I can have it again right here from my home.  I highly recommend this. A++++

column9: Wow! Best Boxed Curry I Have Ever Had
column10: This is the best boxed curry that I have ever tasted, without a doubt. We enjoyed the Kitchens Of India Ready To Eat Palak Paneer for lunch and immediately went on Amazon and ordered more. Now after eating this curry mixed in with chicken breast & rice, I am logging in to buy more of this too. Wow!Kitchens of India Butter Curry Paste will negatively impact my local Indian Food restaurant because I can now get my curry fix at home without compromising quality; this is that good.

I fancy myself as a bit of a curry snob.  Nothing out of a package has ever come close to meeting my expectations.  This was absolutely amazing.  I challenge you to find anything better in the finest Indian restaurants.
what more can we ask for? easy to cook, natural (as stated on the pack), great taste (really authentic indian curry taste) and very reasonably priced. Seriously, this is my best amazon review!
Now only if I could get the Saag Paneer and Naan to go with it...

I can't say that I know what the original Indian version of this tastes like, but I can say that this makes a very tasty curried chicken dish and one that is very easy to prepare. It is spicy but not very, I actually would have preferred it had been a little hotter. I added some onion slices about 5 minutes before it was done cooking, tasted great.

This is SOOOO GOOOOOD.  Really.I used boneless thigh meat, and the meat came out fork-tender - absolutely fabulous.  I also used homemade chicken stock instead of water, but that probably didn't make too much difference in the flavor. Which is, without a doubt, heavenly.  I love curry, and I found the heat level to be just right.The one thing that I wasn't too crazy about, and I didn't see this noted in other reviews, is there was (to me) a bit too much grease on top of the sauce at the end of the simmer.  However, I just blotted it off with a paper towel.  This IS after all, made with 3 tablespoons of butter, and sunflower oil is listed in the ingredients.  (If you don't want grease, don't buy something with the word "butter" in the name - it's that simple. Duh.)  I didn't find the grease enough of a problem to downgrade the rating. Other people might not find it objectionable at all.I served this on top of plain jasmine rice, and it went together well.  The amount of sauce was generous, so it easily could be extended to at least one more serving with the addition of more chicken. I think that this would also be great with potatoes or tofu, as other reviewers mentioned.If I had ordered this dish in a restaurant, I would have been completely happy with it. I will definitely buy this again.  It's a winner!

We ordered this when it was a deal of the day and are coming back to stock up for the 50% off sale. This is a super easy to make and very, very flavorful dish. Even my one year old was making "mmmm!" sounds for the whole meal. It's earned a place on our weekly meal rotation, and is fast enough to make during a busy weeknight. The only alteration I made was to toss in some onion and peas while it was cooking. It's a bit spicier than I was expecting, but still edible for a total spice wimp like me. I love this paste and can't recommend it enough. It makes Indian food easy enough to enjoy whenever you want without spending the money to go out.

column9: Made my first stab at Indian cooking a BIG success.
column10: I just made Butter Chicken Curry and it was sooooooo YUMMY!!! I strongly recommend this product. It is so much better than other currys out there on the market. It was easy to make. My house smelled like an Indian restaurant, in a good way .  I'm sold!!

We love Indian food, but as an American, it's beyond me how to make a good curry blend.  I like to buy spice packets and pastes from the Indian store, but I have to go out of my way to get them.  So I bought these.  They tasted okay, but it wasn't very hot, spice-wise.  Some people might like that, but I was hoping for something with a little more kick.

column9: Good flavored and a little spicy!
column10: This curry is pretty spicy. But those who love spicy food will not think it is spicy. I honestly can't taste the buttery part of it. It really just taste like curry. Although it tastes good, I could see myself getting tired of it if I ate it too often. It has a very strong taste. I usually eat less rice than the meat on my plate... but with this curry, I eat way more rice to compensate for the strong tatse of the curry.
not fantastic, but not bad!  :)  I added veggies, and a bit of sugar as it is slightly bitter.  I also added some coconut milk at the end.

Wow, this is better than I expected.  I think I did good for the first time using this curry paste.  Having said that, I didn't follow the instruction completely.  Instead of water, I substituted with coconut milk.  I added powder red pepper and a pinch of salt to kick it up a notch. Threw down some vegetables in there.  It turned out great!  The taste and the curry odor are just like butter chicken curry I had at restaurant.  I will certainly make this dish again in a couple of weeks.

column9: For someone who has little exposure to Indian food, I found this very yummy!
column10: I found this very interesting and unique, being someone who doesn't get a lot of exposure to food from other cultures.  Often the best exposure I get is when I visit a larger city. I ordered this seeing that it had a great review and was an amazon today's deal and after having made it with chicken and serving over rice, I found it a great interesting food! I'm not one to like spicy food, and this does have a little kick to it (hits kind of far back in the mouth/throat) but I was able to manage just fine with chicken and over rice plus a beverage.While many of the reviews say how close this is to authentic, my review is to say even for someone who has little to no exposure to Indian food, I found this unique, different, and very satisfying!

column9: Joining Everyone Else - This Stuff Is Great!
column10: I just made my first batch of Butter Chicken Curry. It's terrific!It's extremely easy to prepare - just mix the paste with 1 cup water, 3 Tbs butter, 1 lb chicken pieces, and simmer for 20 minutes with a 5 minute high burner finish. That's it. And it tastes wonderful!There is a great Indian restaurant in town where I live and this easily is as good as the chicken curry that they make. Now all I need to do is learn how to make naan bread and some of the other sides and I'll be in heaven.

Great directions. Easy to use. Good taste with this butter curry chicken paste!I used precut, boneless chicken which made the entire process painless, fast and easy.Only ingredients, this curry paste, a wee bit of butter and a pound of chicken. Simple.I've tried cooking in a pan, and cooking in a microwave. Both work well. I prefer the pan cooked... I think I overcooked a wee bit in the microwave. :(Great taste over rice, with pasta or with potatoes and veggies.  You won't regret trying this curry paste.Kitchens of India Paste for Butter Chicken Curry, 3.5-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)

I followed the direction and got a very oily sauce sauce. If this is the way it should be I will consider a different product nest time. However the flavor was excellent and just the right amount of heat. I added frozen peas to this dish and despite its oily appearance came out delicious. If the company is reading this I would recommend either creating a recipe with less fat or a product with less fat. In the meantime I think I'll stick to tikki masala and kashmiri curry sauces.

I guess I'm no cooking pro and I loved this dish but I removed a star for two reasons. One, I expected this to be much more buttery then spicy and mine was definitely a pretty strong spice. The second reason being is at the end you have to cook it uncovered on high heat which will result in a mess all over the stove. Next time I would like to try adding some vegetables and using a bit more butter.One package makes enough for 2 maybe 3 people. Price is excellent here on amazon I bought it on a deal and will likely continue to buy this every year.Now if I could only make homemade naan bread....

column9: Good taste, but not restaurant level
column10: This was definitely saltier than I expected, but it does taste pretty good for a box paste. Will be buying more in the future.
I liked it. But after eating it for one week, I'm tired of it. I'll probably wait for 2 monthes before trying it again.
It's actually quite spicy. I can't really handle spicy food, but this was really good and I couldn't stop eating it even though it burned.

I ordered this on sale just to see what the hype was all about - now I know. It is very good curry paste. I prepared it according to the reviews; using milk instead of water, using less butter (1 T), browning the chicken before adding liquid, and adding lots of delicious vegetables. Obviously, this is not as good as preparing the spices from scratch, but it is a good substitute for a delicious and reasonably priced Indian curry dinner. It is spicy and has a kick to it (yum!). I recommend it.
I substituted the lemon curd with plain yogurt and it still tasted great. The little spice packet that comes with it really adds a lot of flavor to the final product so don't forget about it!

column9: Delicious, But Not What I'm Used To
column10: I've had butter chicken at Indian restaurants several times, and love it.  Before ordering, I noticed this is butter chicken "curry."  So, I wasn't anticipating it would be the style of butter chicken I'm used to.This paste is relatively spicy and the cooked dish tastes more like curry than butter chicken.  Actually, it didn't taste like butter chicken at all.  (Of course, the restaurants where I've eaten may have Americanized the dish.)  The chicken was delicious & so easy and fast to make!  I served it with Jasmine rice.
good stuff. nothing like butter chicken you would get at an east indian restaurant, but very tasty. and very easy to make, which is definitely a plus

column9: Good but not what I expected
column10: I'm not Indian, but I've been to India and eat Indian food often enough, and this "butter chicken curry" tastes like no butter chicken I've ever tasted. That aside, the curry is pretty good and flavorful (too much, perhaps), just don't listen to the directions and double the portions, otherwise it will turn out too strong (i.e one packet for two pounds of chicken). Also, note that if you don't add cream or yogurt, the paste won't come out creamy at all.

My wife's favorite Indian dish is Butter Chicken Curry, so I ordered this.  The flavor was good and it didn't take very long.  The sauce was too thick, though.  I probably did something wrong, but I would have preferred it to be thinner.  And the directions said to cook at high heat for several minutes after simmering.  This burned the curry to the bottom of the pan and was hard to clean.

column9: Flavor may be good but MUCH hotter than description would imply...
column10: I understand that when describing or talking about food that "spicy" and "hot" may be synonymous to some but not others. I bought this based upon an incredible chicken butter cream curry dish I had many years ago in Australia that was flavorful with almost a bit of sweetness but not spicy/hot... I used one of these packets and found it to be WAY too hot for me and for many people who I was planning on serving it to. Spices and "spicy" can be great--but this was "hot," and even after adding 1/2 can of undiluted, full-strength coconut milk it was still very "warm" even served 50/50 with basmati rice. Flavor DID seem quite authentic and good but the heat can take away those pluses for the unsuspecting.This seems like a high-quality item but the description just wasn't clear about the heat level. Many Indian and East Asian dishes (and even Mexican) will have a heat meter graphically or in words on the package, which would have helped in this case. Authentic, good flavor--yes... but be prepared for more than mild heat.

column9: If you don't like ginger, don't get this product.
column10: There is a substantial amount of ginger flavor to this curry. It made the curry unpalatable for me.

column9: Hot, Hot, Hot, and more Hot!!!
column10: When they describe this as a "mildly spiced gravy" - DON'T BELIEVE IT! This is the hottest thing I have eaten in a long time. In fact, I could only take one bite. I couldn't eat any more of it because it was so spicy. Felt like I was chewing up an actual hot pepper! I followed the directions exactly, and even added vegetables to it, and served it over brown rice. I am not a hot spice fan, and I was very misled by the description given for this product. I did give this 2 stars because it did have decent flavor if it wasn't for the heat of it. Without the heat, it would have been delicious. Now I have 5 more packages of this and they will probably go in the garbage. I doubt even a soup kitchen could serve this stuff.
This soup is too harsh, too strong for the smell.My husband likes curry but this curry couldn't eat anymore.

These products were terrible tasting. My husband is Indian and said the taste was terrible. I agreed. When I went to return the unopened packages I could not so so. They have a no return policy. Now I will have to toss out $40 worth of unused product. Amazon is always so very good about returns but evententaly some of their vendors are not.
I've used this as directed, with chicken, and loved it.I tried it with extra firm tofu and like it even better. Yummy!

column9: Great stuff in a packet! I'm addicted.
column10: I love Indian food. Most of my friends have no stomach for it and therefore I rarely get to indulge myself. This is closest to a restaurant version that I have ever had. It must also be well liked by the general population, because my local supermarkets are always out of it. (And I live in white food county.) When they restock, I grab the entire quality they have. Believe it or not, I will drive to three or four supermarkets to find it in stock.I am also on a low carb, original Dr. Atkins Lifestyle. This stuff is perfect. It gives me the flavor that I desire in chicken with very few sugar carbs per serving (unlike many barbecue sauces and marinades).It is a bit salty. FYI so use unsalted butter.

column9: How do they say "heaven" in India?
column10: I was at my daughter's last evening, busy I was on the barbecue grill when she walks out with a small dish she called an appetizer.  One bite and my taste buds screamed "I'm in Heaven".  Okay, kidding aside, but I thought she had brought me leftovers from some 5-star Indian Restaurant.  This curry paste done with tender chicken is heaven.  I am ordering it today.

column9: Excellent prepared curry paste for Butter Chicken
column10: This Kitchens of India Butter Chicken curry paste is a real find, tasty and well-priced. The preparation is so easy - just add butter, water, and cut-up chicken to the paste and stir. Well, you do have to turn on the stove.I used two boneless breasts and cut them into fairly large chunks as breast meat tends to dry out easily. I would think boneless thighs would work just as well. The whole dish was cooked in less than 30 minutes. Jasmine rice is the perfect accompaniment. The dish was a big hit with everyone.

I thought I would give this stuff a try after seeing it as the deal of the day.  My husband said that he didn't want any because he doesn't like Indian food but after I had cooked some up and was "mmmmm"ing like crazy he decided to try some.  5 min later he got up and went for 2nds.. then 3rds...Needless to say, we both LOVED this dish and it has earned a home on our weekly menu.  I would also like to add that to both of our surprise, it digested easily and no problems the next day.  ;-)

I just tried this for the first time today.  It was wonderful!!!  I don't know a lot about Indian food but I know what I like and I loved this!  It had just the right amount of spice and flavor.  I cut up a few chicken breasts, added the packet & butter and put it all over rice.  I highly recommend getting this for a quick and tasty meal!

Ordered these on sale and was pleasantly surprised.Other reviewers have mentioned the saltiness - I'm fairly sensitive to salt and I didn't find it to be too bad.  Initially I used about 9/10 of the package, but ended up using the whole package in later meals and it was fine.You can also add a lot more chicken than they say on the box and it still comes out quite flavorful.It's a little pricey at the list price, but on sale it's a heck of a deal!

I have tried many Indian curry recipes in hopes of finding one that would taste as good as when I eat at an Indian restaurant, but they have all fallen short.  On a whim I tried this Butter Chicken Curry (I usually stay away from packaged foods)and couldn't believe how amazing it tasted--the perfect spiciness with fantastic flavor.  Also, there are no preservatives or crazy chemicals added to this product.  I am so excited to find such a great tasting curry; I can now have great Indian food that is so easy and quick.  I can't wait to try all of the different 'Kitchens of India' flavors!
I didn't know whether to believe others who rated the Butter Chicken, but BELIEVE THE HYPE - it's good stuff!  Very delicious, I made this for my boyfriend's family and they loved it!
What can I say - DELICIOUS!!! I use boneless chicken breasts and sometimes add mixed veggies, chickpeas or black beans. I saute the chicken in onions, then follow the instructions on the box.

This was a very easy curry paste to use and it came out very close to what you get at restaurants.  All I added was butter, chicken and water.  I made 3 servings with one packet of paste but I think if I had more chicken, I could have made 4 servings.
Wow, very good and easy. Very flavorful and the spice factor was just right. Not too spicy, but you can still taste it. Quick to make and very easy! Yum!

My dad and I just tried this the other night and were AMAZED at how delicious it was! My kids thought it a little on the spicy side, but they loved it anyway and wanted more. Incredibly yummy and easy to make. If I could give it 10 stars, I would!

column9: Surprisingly good for a box mix
column10: I love to shop at ethnic grocery stores including those specializing in Indian foods.  That is where I first saw this product.  I noticed several Indian women of a certain age tossing these in their carts.  I thought, "well, if it's good enough for them..."  I bought a few boxes and later started getting it from Amazon.  I asked some friends of mine who grew up in Dehli (where this dish originated and is called Murgh Makhani) for some tips.  Here is how they told me to make it:First I cut up the chicken (I prefer boneless thighs but also use breasts) into bite-sized pieces and marinate them overnight in a plain yogurt, garam masala, minced ginger and garlic mixture.The next day I rinse off the chicken, pat the pieces dry and saute them over high heat in ghee (clarified butter) until browned.  I set the chicken aside and make the gravy separately and according to directions on the box.  Once it thickens up I add a little heavy cream (I've also used coconut milk for something very different), fenugreek, freshly chopped red chili peppers, and a little more garam masala.I add the chicken and then turn down the heat to very low and simmer the dish for about a half an hour to 45 minutes.  I garnish with sliced fresh curry leaves (when I can get them) and a pat of butter and then serve with Basmati rice and naan bread.This is a very popular dish in parts of India and this mix is sold in almost every Indian grocery store that I have ever visited.  This mix is a staple in my pantry.

My family loves Indian food.  This is a quick and easy way to serve good Indian food at home and it smells heavenly.  I omit the butter and use a can of lite coconut milk.The last time I prepared it I used cubed chicken breast and chunks of peeled potato.  At the last moment I added two big handfuls of raw spinach and let it wilt before serving.  Delicious!  You do not have to add meat; this make a delightful vegetarian dish.  Use about any assortment of fresh vegetables. This is also a good way to clean out the frig using up leftover meat and vegetables.  Just add it to the sauce and serve over basmati or jasmine rice.  Very economical.  We like this so much I am on auto-delivery.

This isn't areal review - just a quick note - I buy the butter chicken curry whenever it goes on sale at Amazon - and my wife an I have it once a week or so.  It's very good for the price - I would definately recommend trying it once if you haven't.
This is a great product for someone that wants something different and does not know how to cook Indian food.

column9: Delicious Indian Curry, Fast and Easy...
column10: The Kitchens of India (KoI) Curry paste exceed my expectations.  This little 3.5oz packet contains a paste that instantly turns your boring chicken into a delicious spicy curry in under 30 minutes.  The recipe is incredibly simple and uses just a single pot/pan.  Just add approximately 1 lb of boneless chicken pieces into the pot/pan.  Add 2-3 tbsp's of butter.  Add your packet of curry paste + 1 cup of water and mix until the paste has been dissolved into the water.  At this point just let the cooking process take over, and in about 25 minutes you have delicious Butter Chicken Curry!  I usually have mine over some riceSimple, fast and the quality of the curry is excellent!  The curry itself is a bit creamy thanks to the added butter, and also has some kick to it.  It isn't overpowering but the added spices in the paste really come alive once you heat the curry up.  What I love about this flavor curry is the spices and mixture of ingredients.  They are balanced just right and leaves a slight spicy aftertaste that really makes you want to go back for a second helping.  The quality is outstanding on this KoI Curry, and while not as good as restaurant quality it comes pretty close.The only real downside is the sodium(salt) factor.  While the product is all natural, it preserves with SALT and thus the product has a higher than average salt content per serving (480mg).OVERALL I highly recommend this KoI Curry product.  The Butter Chicken Curry paste is delicious and even leaving off the "Butter" factor still results in delicious curry, though not as creamy. 5 stars!!!** Nutritional Information ** (Entire packet)Each packet is 3.5oz (100g) and contains  FOUR(4) Servings. column9: Excellent; has me revisiting the brand!
column10: I was a little skeptical about trying this, as I was somewhat disappointed in the Kitchens Of India Curry Paste For Lamb Curry, 3.5-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6).  Given that I found that one not quite as spicy as I like, I expected this to be too mild.  I was very pleasantly surprised!  The spice is just about right.  It is aromatic and flavorful (the degree of heat becoming less of an issue), made a nice thick curry: not at all what I had expected.I am adding this review primarily because I'd expressed disappointment in the lamb curry paste and directed people towards another brand.  This one not only made me reconsider but revisit the brand to see what i had missed.My preparation deviated from the direction a bit.  I prepared it as if I were starting from scratch, sauteing the spices in the butter for a few minutes, and then adding the chicken to coat, and then the water.  I cooked it longer than recommended (but only because I was waiting for my family to get home), and it was really excellent!When I saw how thick the sauce was (and it smelled divine) , I did not want it to go to waste, and so added some new potatos and cauliflower.  I think I am going to double my subscription to this one, and try playing around with some variations.I do not know how much of an impact my preparation had as I have only made it the one time.  It ois meant to be easy to prepare, literally less than 5 minutes (that said, what I did added only 3 minutes to the prep time).A really excellent product, which has me back here looking for more :)

This product makes a great butter chicken.  Suggestions: We brown the chicken first and we also use half milk/half water (it's a little creamier and less spicy).  We also add pieces of cooked, cubed potatoes and(small) pieces of cooked cauliflower.  With rice and a little nan brad from Trader Joes, it's one of our family's favorite meals.

column9: The Best Item In My Long List of Amazon Subscribe And Save Items
column10: I got this item because of its Amazon.Com rating. I crave Indian Foods but my wife and I haven't dared to cook it at home. I decided to try this product to get a quick Indian taste fix. OMG! This is totally awesome. Our kids (8 and 9) not only finished their chicken servings but they also used the naan to clean their plates clean. After dinner, they even asked us if we could bring a few packages with us on our August trip. Absolutely crazy!

column9: Packs just the right amount of spiciness!
column10: I had read great reviews about the "Kitchen of India" curry pastes and decided to try one out. The butter chicken curry came out great on my first try and I was truly amazed at how well it turned out as I'm more of a cook-from-scratch type of cook and have been disappointed by other curry pastes. This is definitely a reliable curry paste when one is short on time but would still like to cook at home.Anyway, I tweaked the recipe a little and the results were pretty good - I sauteed a medium shallot [sliced] in the butter [used smart balance as a substitute] on medium heat before adding the chicken pieces [I used organic chicken breast pieces cut into cubes] and the curry paste. Finally, during the last 5 minutes of cooking on high heat, I added two dollops of plain yoghurt to tone down the strong spice flavor and add a creamy texture to the dish. It turned out really well, and is great served with fresh steamed rice and/or naan or paratha. Also, stir-fry spinach goes great with this dish or even a cucumber salad. Highly recommended!

I LOVE Indian food, and I've struggled to re-create my favorite restaurant dishes at home.  I love to cook, and it's not terribly difficult, but it always seems that the best dishes require dozens of ingredients, mostly spices, that have to be pre-blended in a specific order.  So I had pretty much relegated myself to getting my Indian food fix with occasional visits to my favorite Indian restaurants.Then I discovered the Kitchens of India products.  Oh. My. Goodness.  This stuff is incredible!  Butter Chicken is one of my all-time favorite dishes, and my favorite Indian restaurant (Saffron in Seattle) does an amazing version of it.  The Kitchens of India Curry Paste for Butter Chicken comes *very* close to the quality of that restaurant dish.The ingredients in the paste are all-natural -- no preservatives, nothing with unpronounceable names.  Just tomato paste and spices (mostly).  You just add butter (natch), chicken, and water, and let it simmer for 20 minutes.I've used chicken breasts cut into large pieces, and chicken thighs, too.  I prefer the flavor of thighs (skinless/boneless), but they're both good.  I usually serve it with Pulao -- Basmati rice spiced with cinnamon stick, cardamom pods, cumin seed, bay, cloves, sultanas, and slivered almonds.  Yum!Amazon's price is good, too, considering that you get 3 servings or so from each 3.5-oz package.I can't wait to try more of the Kitchens of India products -- so far, I've had this one and the lamb curry, and both have been exceptional.
It makes a good meal with only chicken and butter. You can get a better dish if you add vegetables and some coconut milk.

I've spent a small fortune buying all kinds of Indian sauces and mixes from Trader Joe's and other places in my search for restaurant-quality Indian food (or anything even close to that) to make at home. Always I am bitterly disappointed in my search. I decided to give this paste a try because of the very high reviews and the low price with subscribe & save. I am amazed and so pleased with this product. It's truly delicious and a monkey (or my husband) could make it. I didn't follow the directions exactly -- I cooked the chicken until there wasn't any pink and then added the water, sauce and butter and let it simmer (just wanted to be sure the chicken was done). We served it over brown rice. This is SO fast and SO easy and SO good and SO affordable -- you cannot go wrong. I would recommend this a hundred times over and look forward to trying their other varieties.

If you like indian food, this is definitely a great base to start with.We have made have made it with chicken, but I have been told that it tastes really good with other types of meat and vegan options.I called this a great base as we have added some spices, milk, coconut milk and/or different configurations and surprisingly enoughthey have all been been very tasty. My wife is learning to like spicy foods and she really liked it. She did think it was a little spicy. I grew upeating very spicy items and I thought it was perfect and delicious!I recommend giving it a try. It is relatively cheap for what your get. I recommend getting some garlic naam or pita bread to go with it.Hope this was helpful!

column9: New to curry, here's my take on it
column10: I was introduced to a Prima-brand curry paste a few weeks ago, not Indian, but a Singapore curry: Prima Taste Rendang Curry Sauce Kit, 12.7-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4) - unfortunately the price was too high for me, so I came across the Kitchens of India Paste for Butter Chicken Curry.While this is good, I prefer the Rendang Curry (with beef). Of course I used chicken with the KOI curry paste, and beef for the rendang.  The KOI has too much of a clove flavor for my taste, so I ended up adding 1/2 cup of light sour cream to it, and it was pretty good when served over rice.I'll try this with beef the next time, who's to say it has to be used with chicken?ETA - April 1, 2012:  Just tried this and used a lb. of beef stew meat instead of chicken. I thought it was better using the beef than chicken.

If it's curry, chances are pretty great that I'll love it!I've never had butter curry chicken before, so don't have anything to compare this to. But the price on this pack of curry paste, is beyond reasonable so you can't go wrong!I think the chicken I used had water in it, because the pan was very watery after I uncovered it. I made another batch of it using 4 T. of butter instead of three, and cut the water down to 3/4 c. instead of one cup, and it was much better. I also used 1 1/2 lbs of chicken instead of 1 lb. per the box, so you can still get a nice amount of sauce with that much chicken if you want.Initially the curry sauce was a little spicy, and with a pronounced 'clove' taste that had me on the fence whether I liked it or not. But the taste grew on me as I finished the bowl. I made this a third time and subbed in 1 cup of coconut milk instead of the water, and that *really* tamed down the heat. It was creamy and mild.For the price, I am happy with my purchase, and how versatile the curry paste is. I think this would taste better with beef or lamb instead of chicken, though.This product does have flour and sugar in it, for those who keep track.

I've never had Butter Chicken before -- this makes me want to try it at an authentic Indian restaurant.  I brined 4 lbs of chicken thighs in a salt solution for 24 hrs and then put them in a crock pot -- I was a little concerned about using just one package of the paste but it worked.  I mixed about 2 tablespoons of tomato paste and added about 2 tablespoons of curry powder to the mixture and poured on top of the thighs -- then cut up 3 tablespoons of butter and scattered on top of that.  Cooked about 3 hrs on high, then reduced to low.  Once it was done, I shredded the chicken and put some on a plate with long grain rice. (Jasmine rice would be better...) I took a cup of the sauce out and mixed some sour cream in it -- made it nice and creamy.  The creamy sauce on top of the chicken and rice was very good.  My husband and 17 year-old son liked it.  I'll be making this again!Update -- 2nd time making this -- this time I put a 3# package of chicken thighs (didn't brine, etc) into a pressure cooker and browned in a little oil until nice and golden.  I mixed two packages of the spice, extra ground curry powder, a little tomato paste and used 3 cups of water + 1 stick of salted butter.  It took about 35 minutes total at 15 psi and was really good.  I did like the extra sauce by using the two packets with that much chicken.  Served over Jasmine rice and a nice dollop of sour cream -- I'm in gastro-heaven!

column9: Amazing flavor, but too spicy for me.
column10: I love Indian food, but I prefer it non-spicy. The flavor of this is EXCELLENT. As good as our favorite Indian restaurant. So good, I couldn't stop eating it, despite my discomfort! My husband thinks it wasn't that spicy. He also raved about the flavor. I definitely recommend, but if you are wimpy about spice, be careful! :)

Seriously the best food product ever made. I buy three of the six-packs at a time, because I am addicted and make this stuff at least once a week. It requires simple ingredients (butter, water, meat product, curry package), minimal attention (put on stove, set timer, wander away), minimal prep (combine things in a pot), and makes the most epic left-overs (I eat mine over drained ramen noodles because I'm lazy and it is so easy/tasty). It is somewhat spicy though, and my sister hated it for that reason. So if you don't like spicy, maybe eat something that isn't curry. But if you DO like spicy, and you DO like curry... try it, and you can't go wrong. Nom nom nom...
Easy to prepare and tastes good.  Definitely to much salt but not unexpected.Recently went to purchase more and the cost tripled for whatever reason.  Will not purchase again at the new price.

This is a delicious product that is easy to use and helps me in preparing Indian cuisine in my home...at least, it used to!I bought a 6 pack about one month ago and made several enjoyable meals.Since my family was so excited about the product, I returned to purchase a much larger quantity.  Imagine my surprise to find a price increase of over three times what I'd paid a month ago.  What gives?Sorry to say, I won't be purchasing any more of this product until it returns to its more reasonable price of $10/6 pack.

column9: For 83 cents/pack, I have nothing to complain about!
column10: Pro: Easy & Quick, Flavorful and it's Kosher.Con: a little on the salty side and not spicy enough for my taste.I cooked with this tonight and it was pretty good.  First I browned four chicken thighs then I added 2 Tablespoon of unsalted butter, a cup of coconut milk and mixed them really well.  Precooked red potato and sweet peas was added at the last few min of cooking.  I was cooking for two and have enough leftover for us to pack lunch for tomorrow.  For 83 cents/pack, I have nothing to complain about!

I am a HUGE fan of Indian food, and have been testing out Indian convenience products for years.  This is BY FAR the best and most authentic!  As a nutritionist, I am pleased that the ingredients are compromised of "whole foods" - no nasty preservatives.It is good prepared "plain", but I have experimented with putting in diced bell peppers or frozen spinach with a bit of red pepper - delicious!The directions can be a little vague - bring the ingredients to a boil and then cover for 25 minutes.  I then put the lid on askew to let moisture out (but the mess in) over high heat for 5 minutes or more - this is crucial to the thickening of the sauce.I especially love that the 30 minutes it takes to cook is conveniently the same amount of time it takes to book Basmati rice :)I love this so much that I put it on my auto-order subscriptions on Amazon!  We make this at least every other week for a quick, delicious, healthy dinner.

I was a bit apprehensive about buying this since I've had somewhat poor experiences in the past with packaged Indian spices for curries. But, based on the positive reviews, I gave it a shot during the recent sale.Simply outstanding! Excellent blend of spices - great flavor, nicely spiced, and simple to prepare. I'd put the heat level at mild side of medium - some spiciness, but not overpowering. Personally, I like it more spicy, but others in the household don't care for hot food so this is just the right level to keep everyone happy.I scale back the amount of butter the recipe calls for (it says to use 3 tablespoons, and I use 1), and use stock instead of water.
