A tablespoon over ice makes a wonderful tonic. The vinegar comes with a small cookbook which contains the recipe for Lucianno Pavarotti's "Piccatina", a truly delightful veal dish. This is not salad dressing vinegar. This is a jewel of wonderfully subtle sweet flavors.

column9: My Dog Gives These Five Woofs!
column10: Sarah, just loves these treats, they are her very favorite, and I love seeing her so happy.  She is a rescue, thrown from a passing car, and I feel nothing is too good for her!  I plan on never being without them and I plan on watching her enjoy these terrific Bone Treats until we are both too old to chew!

Just kidding about the bees knees thing. If they were bees knees, I would need several thousand packages to satisfy my two labs. My dogs really liked them but then they would eat the hub caps off a moving car. I found them to be just a little too chewy and I had to fight off the dogs to get mine to eat. Actually, the price was very good compared to what I had to pay at the local pet food store. They also came quickly in the mail. Good service.

These are the BEST!!! Linzer Cookies I've ever had!...so delicious that Scotts Cakes has a lifetime customer here!........so fresh and tasty that I could not stop eating them...fresh ingredients and excellent price and the Super Fast Shipping makes them a Winner!.......5 Stars definitely.

This has been my favorite candy bar since it had it's short release in the US back in the 80's. I thought it was gone forever until I discovered it was sold in Europe in 1990. Since then it has been my quest to find ways to get my Wispa fix. I am so happy I can now easily order them on Amazon and get them shipped right to my door in no time. All is now right in my candy world
The flavor & texture of these raw organic pistachios are great!  These taste much better than roasted/salted alternatives.  Quick shipping and great value.

I accidently ran into this product. They where by the cashiers check out stand for $1.99 at TJ Maxx. I really wanted some chocolate but was watching what I ate at the time so to compromised I got the Organic Hard Candies in the Cherry flavor. However, I did not open them until about a week later. But when I did...wow. They were great. I had eaten two and was about to pop a third one in when I actually looked down at the candy and realized that it wasn't red. Which blew my mind since I thought I was tasting red. It was amber colored.I know that sounds weird. So I grabbed the bag and read the ingredients and saw that it was an all natural candy with only 4 ingredients. You cant beat that. And it tasted really good with out being overly sweet. I just went back to TJ Maxx and bought all the other flavors...I have 5 bags now. And I will savor them slowly. I don't mind paying $1.99 a bag...but $3.99 is a little my budget. But when I run out....I might just have to cave in. So I'm happy that Amazon has them.

I've tried the Cherry and Pomegranate flavors.  Both are delicious.  They have a real, "normal" hard candy flavor only better (no weird sweetener flavors etc.).  I will point out that they have a very, very slight barley sugar quality, which if you ever had real old-fashioned hard candy, will make these taste real and authentic to you.  If you haven't had old-style hard candies, I think you will still like them and find it a much more pleasant taste than the stark, harsh sugar-bomb effect of most modern hard candies.They are of a good size, a good shape, last a long time, and while definitely hard candy, they aren't horribly sweet.  The real, fresh, tangy and tart fruit flavors come through loud and clear.  I think they have a wonderful flavor balance.When I lived in Los Angeles and had a horrible commute twice daily through dusty, polluted, desert-dry and hot conditions, I found these to be a necessary item to keep my throat comfortable (you don't want to be drinking a lot of water or coffee when stuck in commuting traffic!).  In that regard, they also serve very well as cough drops when you're sick.  I tried many different products and these were the ones I settled on as the best for both purposes.  Of note re using them when you're sick, these won't make any hot tea etc. you are simultaneously drinking taste weird, like many cough drops do.  These candies do not burn the roof of your mouth like some hard candies do, nor do they dissolve into sharp shard like pieces that feel like they would cut your mouth.Each candy is twist wrapped in a little piece of waxy paper.  They hold up surprisingly well to humidity etc. but they occasionally may eventually start to become a little stuck to the papers.  I didn't notice anything like this except for occasionally with ones I'd had in the car for months.  I never had one so stuck that it tore the paper or I couldn't get the paper off.  It really isn't a problem.I really liked the cherry flavor; as well as the pomegranate, and I've read many favorable reviews of the other flavors as well.

i just received this tea in the mail today. the only bad part about the tea is that it is really really really small.. i cant stress that enogh. but the ingredients are awesome and it also says that this tea is good for singers.

The fastest shipping ever. I placed my order early evening on a Tuesday and received my order the following afternoon. That never happens. I was so pleased.Good price, good packaging and even included promo code for future orders. Will definetly buy again and will recommend to friends!

Very deceiving photo looks like a large bag of chips. My wife did not read product info so its mostly her fault, however overcharge fro both shipping and product. Look around product should cost 89 cents and shipping should be around $1.50. They charged $4.33 to ship a 1 ounce product. Buyer beware this is a scam and a good one at that. Read whole page before purchasing.

I love to barbecue and I was a big bulls eye fan and loved their sauces.  One day I bought the kansas city sauce from Cattleman's and I was really blown away. It was spicy, tangy and had a great texture.  I've tried it on meats and poultry and it is amazing.  My ribs are now the talk of everyone after using a dry rub and putting this on to finish them off.It has a great consistency; not too thick; and is easy to spread onto items with a brush.If you want a consistent and quality barbecue sauce that you can count on to be great with any food, this is the sauce.  Kansas City is my favorite but the Mississippi and Memphis is really good too with just the right amount of sweetness.For the mustard crowd there is Carolina which has a hint of cayenne and mustard and it's very tangy and delicious.I go out of my way to get Cattleman's sauces.  It may be hard to find at times in stores, but many of the chain grocery stores carry it.

I don't claim to be an aficionado of barbecue sauce. I know some people are, and they have much more of a claim than me to say that Cattleman's is the best.But I have over the decades sampled a lot of different sauces, everything from the very generic to the much pricier. I had never tried this brand before because my local stores don't carry it. I came across it on Amazon entirely by accident when it was being sold at $10 for six bottles. That's pretty inexpensive for ANY barbecue sauce. I got some. What could I possibly lose?Cattleman's stands head and shoulders above anything else I have tried. As the description says, it has a sweet and tangy taste. However, the sweetness isn't the cloying taste you might get from corn fructose syrup. It tastes more like molasses. There is also a hint of smokey hickory taste. The base doesn't have a tomato-y taste. It's more in a class all of its own. While there are spices that help to give the sauce a sharply tart sense to it, this is in no way a hot sauce or something thst anyone would find too spicey.The overall effect is very, very pleasing. You can use this on pretty much anything from meat to omelets, hash browns, French fries, you name it.If you buy this, though, avoid the overpriced Amazon Marketplace vendors. Wait for Amazon to restock, lower the price, and sell it through its Prime plan. You'll be a much happier customer if you purchase it this way.

column9: I love this BBQ sauce. Perfect for stocking stuffers. Thanks Amazon!!
column10: Great tasting sauce..Appeals to most taste buds!! I too used Cattlemen's, buying it @ Walmart until they stopped carrying it. Finally found it on Amazon and wanted to order a larger bottle but at the time just the 18 oz was available. Bought several six packs and then got the idea to add one to my gift stockings for friends & family. 18 oz plastic bottle is a perfect fit. My six packs arrived safe and sound. Thank, Amazon. sacee
I am pleased with the flavor, as a matter of fact it is fantastic.  However I still miss C's Smokehouse, too bad it's not available anymore...

The Cattlemens Kansas City Classic BBQ Sauce is phenomenial. Were impressed with the distinct flavor of just enough sweet & tangy combined that leaves you with that savory salivating mood when you think of this BBQ sauce. They dont sell this in grocery stores in Hawaii but thankful Amazon does free shipping over $25 when quaified to keep the cost down and give me that piece of the South I miss so much, you wont be dissappointed with this pick and neither will your guests, enjoy!

Cattlemen's is the best all around BBQ sauce there is. It is getting hard to find in local grocery stores. I am so glad to find that I can order it from Amazon. Super service every time I have ordered. Keep up the good work.

I've tried tons of different BBQ sauces and short of making it yourself, this is the best option.  Many of the others on the market seem to be disgustingly sweet or really runny.  This BBQ sauce is nice and thick.  I slather it on frozen chicken quarters, pop it in the oven at 325 degrees for 1.5 hours and voila!  Dinner!

BBQ sauce is the best hands down next to Watkins BBQ concentrate which isn't available anymore. This was available in Walmart recently in 18 & 64 oz bottles, but they have been changing their inventory a lot recently and going more store brand. Fairly priced, but the 6 bottles are in a tightly fitting box inside a sealed plastic bag. The corners of the bottle near the neck touch each other bottle and due to the shipping they can press against each other and 2 of my bottles cracked. There was BBQ everywhere. Amazon did refund my purchase after I submitted photo feedback. I wish the process was a little more streamlined.

column9: Good BBQ Sauce, watch the "best by" date
column10: Bought this at the beginning of July of this year when it was on super sale direct from Amazon. Just noticed now that they all have a "best by" date of October 2012. Who would realistically go through 6 things of bbq sauce in 4 months?

I grew up with Cattlemen's then I moved to the other side of the USA.  I later discovered Cattlemen's BBQ Sauce at Walmart and started using it, then Walmart discontinued it my area and I could not get it anywhere in this state, so I went to Amazon. I ordered 2 cases of 6 Plastic bottles. I just got my shippment from Amazon and 2 of the bottle are damaged ( meaning there is BBQ sauce inside the box )there wasn't any packaging inside the box, the bottles were wrapped in bundles of 6 and the bundles were loose in the box.From what I read about returns on products like this one, you cann't return them. Would I order a product like this from AMAZON again,NO. Don't get me wrong I still love Cattlemen's BQQ Sauce, I'll try getting it from some one else.

I had always given rawhide chews and didn't really have any problems with them. I picked these up by mistake thinking they were dingo's but when I gave them to my dogs, they were trying to take each other's from them, that's how much they liked them. There have been no stomach problems. I noticed with rawhide, they would cough a lot as if it was stuck in their throat. I quit giving them pig ears for the very same reason. These do not make them cough at all.

column9: My dogs dream of these bones!
column10: I have been giving these bones to my dogs for over two years now and they LOVE them!  Every night just before bed time they each get a bone and they go crazy when they see my take them out.  The mini size is good for small dogs, my female dog is 9 pounds and does not have all her teeth (they never fully came in)but has no problems with eating this treat.  I like that these bones do not leave any residue on the couch or bed and that they don't get slimey like raw hides.  This is a great treat and unlike the 1 star poster, I don't care that they come from China.  It is hard to find chews that will not make my dogs choke, are a small size, do not leave residue, and that they love to eat.  I have found all of that with these chews and highly recommend them!

My dogs love these but are hard to find.  This is a very good price for them as well. They always arrive very fresh.  Will never buy any other brand for my dogs.  I love the idea that there is no raw hide in them.  Fast shipping.

Chester Mateo my 3 month old mix lab LOVES them.... I even love them... they smell soooo Good... I get this urge to take a bite! jajajaja... haven't done that... but It smells very good... clean even... :) once my pup got a whiff of them he went CRAZY... he chewed it up very quickly which bumbs me out b/c i wish it would entertain him a little longer... No issues with digestion...I will deff continue buying these for him!!!:)

Both of my dogs really enjoyed this rawhide alternative bone. My dogs have been eating real rawhide for several years, with seemingly no issues. Recently, one of my dogs had a terrifying near-death experience; choking on a rawhide. After doing some research, I learned that this isn't an uncommon situation, and that rawhides are a known choking hazard. After the incident, I quickly researched different rawhide alternative bones, and theses ones were one of the first we have tried. They have more of a leathery texture, softer and more flexible than a rawhide. However, they are not soft treats that can be chewed up quickly, it still took my dogs some time to eat them, and enjoying them for about 10 minutes. One thing that I really liked about these bones is that they don't get stringy, slimy, and sticky like rawhides do. They get softer with chewing, and then brake off into smaller pieces, unlike rawhides that won't brake off, making the dream bones less of a choking hazard. They only reason I gave them a 4 star rating and not a 5 star rating is because the first ingredient (the most prevalent) is corn. Corn isn't the greatest thing for pets to consume because its not easy to digest. I avoid corn in pet food at all costs, but because this is a treat- and not a main food staple, I think it is okay. I do recommend these- especially over regular rawhides. I would recommend the dental version more as those ones smell really good and contain parsley and chlorophyl and other good smelling ingredients that aren't present in the chicken flavor.

Our dog is a 12 year-old poodle.  She was having a lot of issues with rawhide chews and other treats--like throwing up all the time.  She absolutely loves these chews, and they don't bother her stomach.  Every evening she whines to let us know that it is time for her treat-it's a regular ritual with her.  She gets so excited and  will go through all of her tricks for just half of one of these mini chews.  We have been giving her these chews for more than a year and are really glad we found this product on Amazon.

Great product so far! We've only been using these for about a month, but I can tell you this - our 11 year old dog who has never handled rawhide well and who can no longer chew most other dental chews loves these.  Furthermore, they are a great chew for our 9 week old Lab. Both dogs are handling them without any digestive issues. One last thing - while you should absolutely be cautious of what your pet eats, giving these a poor rating based solely on where they are from seems uninformed and a bit prejudicial to me (unless there are some facts out there that haven't been shared yet).  If things change and I find these to cause any issues with my pups, be sure that I will update this post.  Until then, if you see no updates, all is well!!

I've been giving these bones to my 3 dogs for well over 1 year and had never had any problems. It surprised me to see that the other review had such negative comments about this product but never really stated anything about actually giving it to the dogs and seeing the results. Anyhow, I love these. One of my chihuahuas kept throwing up with other bones and these are literally the only ones I can give her without having accidents all over my house. They do have a different texture to them but again, I've never had any incidents with them so I will keep buying it. Too bad they do not have these in the Amazon recurring subscriptions :-(
These dog bones must really taste wonderful - I have 2 dogs that love these bones.  If we ever run out one of the dogs stands and cries  at treat time until we get more.

I have no issue with the product but a few days after opening it, I see it expired mid June.  These products typically have a long shelf life, so sending out expired product is inexcusable.  This is one product I won't buy from Amazon again.

column9: Made in china!  Do not buy these!
column10: Another treat I purchased at the store for my dogs and did not check where they were made. They are made in china.  I check everything I buy for my dogs now because most products are made in china.  Yes my dogs like them but I am not putting their health at risk.  And they are a really strange rubbery texture.  Does not look like something they should be ingesting. Anyway, I will never buy these again. Zero stars!

I have a 4 year old 18 lb Shorkie and a 6 year old 35 lb Cockerpoo.  Both of them seem to really love these treats.  They are small enough that they love to catch them in their mouths! I can't speak for the taste since I don't eat them :-) but my 2 dogs seem to look forward to these little treats.  We have to watch their weight and these are the perfect size and don't seem to be adding the pounds.  As long as they get some little something they are happy.  We have to watch what we give our cockerpoo as she has a sensitive stomach but so far these don't seem to be upsetting her.
I have a cocker spaniel who loves treat and though that this nugget help me with his oral care but he spitted it every time I tried, probably does not like the flavor.
I've  been using this spice for forty years. First found it at Hudson's (no more) and love it in almost everything, especially in dips. Difficult to find.

I also love this seasoning and have been using for years.  However, I think that this vendor is over-charging in a major way.  I just bought two 3.5 oz bottles of Beau Monde from my local Von's/Safeway store at $4.19 each.  Then I came back to this entry to see if the bottles were perhaps larger than 3.5 oz but they are not.  So, I have to ask, "Why is this so expensive at this one online store?

Beau Monde is the most wonderful spice.  I use it in several dips and will start to experiment with it in other recipies.  It's hard to find if you don't have a lot of grocery stores -- which I don't, however, Amazon.com came through, as usual.

These are the BEST!!! Linzer Cookies I've ever had!...so delicious that Scotts Cakes has a lifetime customer here!........so fresh and tasty that I could not stop eating them...fresh ingredients and excellent price and the Super Fast Shipping makes them a Winner!.......5 Stars definitely.

It is acceptable but in my opinion it is too heavy on the clove.  If I had been able to see a list of the ingredients before purchasing it would have helped.  In very small amounts in making teriyaki tofu it does add a nice flavor.

I like it very much, it really adds taste to my meats and veggies..I would like it better if it was not ground or maybe came in whole spices and I could grind myself...it seems to be missing something from my original purchase where I grinded the 5 spices myself...but overall it is still very yummy...would buy again if I decided to go all organic...price is kind of high compared to non organic..but you know what they say, you get what you pay for...thanks...quick shipping too...

I have no idea why Amazon is selling these so cheaply but I am thrilled. This particular one happens to be my toddler's favorite flavor.These pouches are great for the car for a sudden snack attack or as part of a meal. They are even great for a snack for a pregnant mom or anyone else!Once opened each individual pouch should be consumed within 24 hours and ideally refrigerated if not finished in one setting. Toddlers like this because they get to do things "Mine Self!" and parents can like them too because you could conceivably squeeze out a portion.

I got 3 boxes with a total of 12 pouches.  Makes me question ordering from amazon.  I was sent an email on special sales, saying this was slashed in price from $70 to $15.87 a savings of 77%, for a pack of 12.  I ordered the apple mashers once when they were on a special, so I thought this was the same special.  Who would order 3 boxes for $15.89 when they could get 4 boxes for less.  Before, a a pack of 12 was 12 boxes with 4 mashers in each.  Other product from revolution listed as pack of 12 are also 12 boxes with 4 in each boxRevolution Foods Organic Mashups, Tropical, 3.17-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 12).  Why would this one be any different?  Of course, these are nonreturnable.  I am going to assume that since they sold out, that there are many others who were duped and are going to be just as stumped when they get 3 packs, not 12.  I would like to complain to amazon, but looked everywhere and can't even find a contact us.  If the original price had been $70, they would have been around $23 a box, almost $6 a tube.  They are definitely lacking in specifics in the description area.

When I originally ordered these, it was described as 4- count packages (Pack of 12). I interpreted that to mean 48 total, a fantastic deal. Instead it's 12 total, which is over a dollar each and a huge rip off. My daughter loves them but I can't afford to feed her like that.

column9: Now we're getting into some top-of-the-line sardines!
column10: Wow! A can of these cost me over five dollars at the store, but I had to try them out.  What you get here is a can of sardines that are so slim that it takes two layers of them to fill the can.  I suppose that means a greater skin-to-meat ratio and even more flavor since the flavor of a sardine tends to be in the skin.Are two layers better than one?  Maybe slightly.  You get most of the small sardine in olive oil flavor with the one layer variety, but it you want to reach for that next level in sardine delicacy and flavor, here they are!

This offer is impossible to pass up. Dollar for dollar it is the one to act on.  As for Season's sardines; not all sardine brands are created equal.  Overall, the Season brand brislings are better in just about every respect.  They have a higher consistency of quality and taste good.  If you are new to sardines it can be daunting to find the right ones.  Generally, you will only want to focus on the "Brislings" because of their smaller size and subsequent better taste.Verdict: eat thisPS.  Alton Brown does a splendid job of explaining the sardine and gives some ideas on preparation in this vid...[...]

Both my wife and my self fine that this band it better than crown prince brisling sardines in olive oil.This Season brand is not as dry,but we also think that crown prince crosspacked in olive oil is a little  better the size of the sardines are smaller.

Its hard to say any product is the 'best' without valid comparison.Apples are apples - and brisling sardines are the best ! no question.Seasons 2-layer packed in olive oil are in my top 3 sardines. I eatone can ever single day - and no I never tire of them. I see a lot of chatterabout sardines in olive oil vs. water. To me, olive oil is the way to go. The onesin water are great - but remember these little guys have all the good fats so thecalorie savings over water and oil (assuming you pour off oil and feed the cat/dog) isminimal. Oil packed taste better but have I also like the water types.My top 3 (all brisling) ...- Seasons 2 layer in olive oil- King Oscar Tiny tots in olive oil- Crown Prince 2 layer in olive oilI have tried them all - the spring water brislings are great, as are the mustard ones.You can always add your favorite condiment - mustard, hot sauce, vinegar, lemon.The olive oil 2 layer ones are the best tasting, most versatile I have had.I do not want to pan the single layer brisling varieties - they are just a bit bigger butstill very tasty. In general - smaller is better ... and more expensive.On the cost side amazon holds its own. In most major markets in the US - they don't carry thebrisling sardines, and if they do they are $3 plus a can. My Walmart here in cali sometimes has2 of my 3 favorites (not seasons variety). When available - walmart charges about $2.60 a can.If you can get any of these varieties at 2.5 - 3.0 bucks a can stock up. They are not alwaysavailable.Enjoy - I love sardines and they have replaced my old reliable tuna. Let the tuna stock come back !Sardines are ...1. cheap2. healthy3. tasty4. sustainableeat well - and look to the future

If you hate fishy tasting fish like I do, but want to try sardines for the health benefits, try these. I had tried but given up on sardines before due to the heavy, fishy taste. Then I read the recommendations on amazon for these and decided to try them. Well, these are indeed very mild, and, with the right seasonings, are even tasty. If you're a sardines newbie who isn't fond of really fishy tasting fish, try these.
i thought i was buying "tiny" sardines, but they are the larger variety.they are excellent, but next time i wouid prefer the "tiny" .many thanks

I recently started eating sardines, as they are good for me. I was unimpressed with some brands, as the sardines were dry or gummy or just plain unpalatable. But these sardines are just nummy. I will order only them from now on.
I eat sardines at least three times a week and these are some of the best I have ever had!
If you think you don't like sardines, you just haven't tried Season tiny bristling sardines.  They are mild and delicious.
Love these...tried to order some more but none available at this time.  Too baf!

column9: Not the same as last year
column10: I purchased several boxes of this product last year. They were from Norway and excellent. Perfectly smoked and texture was just right. This time the label said "prodcut of Poland" so not sure if I ordered the wrong item or if it was substituted; but these were definitely not the same quality. Sardines were muushy and had a metallic taste to them.
try lightly fried in a bit of olive oil and with onion....on a club cracker!

I was looking for Norway brisling sardines and got these by mistake.  These are from Scotland.  They are not anywhere near the old King Oscar two pack level of quality.  They are lean and dry.  Way too expensive for this quality....

column9: Among the best if not the best!
column10: The high quality of these sardines has remained through the years.  I've tried sardinesin other sauces and olive oil remains my favorite.  Excellent on toast with lettuce andtomatoes.  Use as much or as little of the olive oil as you wish.  I prefer drainingthem before eating.

These are the best sardines I have ever had. I have had many different brands and sauces and these are far and away the best. They are quite small and should be low on the food chain which means less accumulated mercury if you are worried about that sort of thing. Worth a try if you are into eating for health.

This is indeed in the top tier of sardines.  Very tasty, nicely packed, and go down sooooo smooth.  Well worth getting if you are looking for a very good product.  I wouldn't mind having these every day of the week.

Not too bad, very cute.  I got these for 6 at an anime convention recently.  The jelly ones are similar to the fruit chewy sugar coated candies in the USA and the breaded ones are similar to Twinkies.  The overall sweetness is about the same as mochi or marshmallows.

I've been giving these bones to my 3 dogs for well over 1 year and had never had any problems. It surprised me to see that the other review had such negative comments about this product but never really stated anything about actually giving it to the dogs and seeing the results. Anyhow, I love these. One of my chihuahuas kept throwing up with other bones and these are literally the only ones I can give her without having accidents all over my house. They do have a different texture to them but again, I've never had any incidents with them so I will keep buying it. Too bad they do not have these in the Amazon recurring subscriptions :-(

We've used these with two dogs (an 11 year old and a 9 week old) and have had absolutely no issues so far. In fact, these are the first dental chews that our 11 year old has ever been able to handle without issue. No digestive issues and no ill health effect; only happy pups whose eyes light up when we open the package.  They are also the perfect size for our pups to finish in one sitting; a little tasty distraction without having an all day chewing event.Now, I had no intention on posting a review for this product. However, after I saw such a poor rating on these chews that we had been using for our pups, I was quite concerned.  When I saw that the poor rating came from someone who had used the product only once (that I can tell) and negated it based not on fact or ill effects to their animals but solely on where the product was manufactured, I decided to post a counter review from someone who had actually used - and is still currently using - the product. Rest assured that if these PROVE to be a detriment to our pups (based on either factual evidence or research that I find), I will post an update.  If you don't see any updates, then all is still going great on this end, and I am a very satisfied customer.

We rescued a dog in May and have been trying to find a treat for her that she will eat and enjoy (and that is not a health hazaard).  She doesn't really like the rawhide chews, which is good as they are not really good for dogs, especially if they have digestive issues.  Our dog just loves these and we have not had any issues at all.  No choking or throwing up like with the rawhide chews.  When I start to open the package she just comes running and is so excited!!  I am not overly thrilled that the first ingredient is corn, but since it is just a treat, and our little girl loves them, then I am giving this a 5 star rating!  And for the reviewer complaing that they are made in China .... now-a-days: what isn't?  Sure, I'd love to be able to purchase this awesome product knowing it was made here in the good ole USA, but since noone here in the good ole USA is making a treat my dog can eat without throwing up or choking ... DREAMBONE it is!!!!

My puppy had rejected so may things and then fell in love with this  -  -TO THE PERSON RE MADE IN CHINA issue- you are not well informed- it is not All products- do your homework- this product is fine  NO rawhide AT all and she loves them!! - I can finally stop looking and experimenting and spending a lot doing it LOL

Both of my dogs really enjoyed this rawhide alternative bone. My dogs have been eating real rawhide for several years, with seemingly no issues. Recently, one of my dogs had a terrifying near-death experience; choking on a rawhide. After doing some research, I learned that this isn't an uncommon situation, and that rawhides are a known choking hazard. After the incident, I quickly researched different rawhide alternative bones, and theses ones were one of the first we have tried. They have more of a leathery texture, softer and more flexible than a rawhide. However, they are not soft treats that can be chewed up quickly, it still took my dogs some time to eat them, and enjoying them for about 10 minutes. One thing that I really liked about these bones is that they don't get stringy, slimy, and sticky like rawhides do. They get softer with chewing, and then brake off into smaller pieces, unlike rawhides that won't brake off, making the dream bones less of a choking hazard. They only reason I gave them a 4 star rating and not a 5 star rating is because the first ingredient (the most prevalent) is corn. Corn isn't the greatest thing for pets to consume because its not easy to digest. I avoid corn in pet food at all costs, but because this is a treat- and not a main food staple, I think it is okay. I do recommend these- especially over regular rawhides. I would recommend the dental version more as those ones smell really good and contain parsley and chlorophyl and other good smelling ingredients that aren't present in the chicken flavor.

column9: DO NOT BUY! Made in china!!!!!
column10: Another treat I purchased at the store for my dogs and did not check where they were made. They are made in china. I check everything I buy for my dogs now because most products are made in china. Yes my dogs like them but I am not putting their health at risk. And they are a really strange rubbery texture. Does not look like something they should be ingesting. Anyway, I will never buy these again. Zero stars!

I have purchased these cookies twice now (I'm backlogged, but I was afraid that Amazon wouldn't stock them again) and I'm slowly eating my way through them.Many people have attempted to describe the taste and I agree with most of the previous descriptions - they are not hyper sweet or milk chocolate-y, but rather almost like a darker chocolate taste.  Don't take me calling it dark chocolate to mean they're bitter, because they're not, but imagine the taste of a normal Hershey's bar if you removed half the sugar.  You'd still get the nice taste of chocolate, but just in a more subdued fashion.  If you have a chocolate craving, and not a sugar craving, you'll love these cookies.  If you have just a simple sweet tooth and a craving for sugar, well these may not be quite what you're looking for.One thing to keep in mind is that these are what I would classify as "very hard" cookies.  Most of the cookies you find on the grocery stores now days contain quite a few fatty ingredients that make the cookie yield in your mouth instead of crunching.  These suckers crunch.  A lot.  I would even go far as to say that if you have dental issues, milk would be a requirement to eat these.  The texture is very similar to eating Nature's Valley granola bars (not the chewy ones).

column9: I love the cookies, but my order were about to expire and were stale
column10: I love, love, love the Cinnamon Graham Alphabet Cookies.  They are hard to find in the stores, and the one place I always could find them is no longer carrying them.  So, I bought a Pack of 12.  Unfortunately, they were just about to expire, and they were stale.  My husband and son ate them anyway, but I was disappointed.  I would be nervous about ordering them again.  Pity, because when they are fresh, they are 5-star cookies.
I recommend these cookies to any chocolate lover - the cookies have a deep, rich cocoa flavor....they're low fat, yet quite tasty -- a delicious and nearly guilt-free snack!

column9: Delicious, but be careful of amazon's expiration dates...
column10: The cookies are very yummy, and have a good amount of chocolate taste to them, and just the right amount of crunch :)  I would definitely buy these again, but probably not from amazon.  I bought the 12 pack of cookies mid-August, and ALL of them expire in the beginning of November 07.  I know you CAN eat things past the expiration date, but if I'd known the expiration date was 3 months later, I wouldn't have bought a 12 pack of them!If they taste this good, so close to their expiration date, I imagine the fresher ones are even better!

These are a great snack to have on hand and carry in the diaper bag.  They are a wonderful treat for my two-year-old son who is allergic to milk and eggs.  Plus, it doesn't hurt to have the extra exposure to the ABCs, huh?

column9: Don't let the organic & healthy image scare you
column10: Though resembling nothing like the common graham crackers found in most grocer's cookie aisle, these small squares are quite delectable and relatively guilt-free.

I have ordered these twice now, they taste so good! I also tried the chocolate wheat-free ones, they were awful, I would not order them again, but have been waiting several weeks for the grahams to be stocked!

Newman's Own Organics Alphabet cookies are very chocolatey and very crunchy. The first time I tried them I was hooked! My two children also think they are fantastic. If you are have not tried organic cookies before, these cookies are a good starting point.

column9: Very Good, But Rock Hard Texture
column10: I've had a great experience with the Newman's Own Organics Newman-O'S Ginger-O'S, and was very pleased.  So I decided to try Cinnamon Graham Alphabet cookies.These cookies are not as sweet as the Newman's Own sandwich cookies, which is a big plus.  These are quite tasty with a good balance of natural sweeteners and the right amount of cinnamon.  While I prefer a strong cinnamon flavor, these cookies did not disappoint me.  It makes for a nice treat.  They barely pass my all-important "dunkability" test, or how they taste when dunked in milk.  While they dunk very well and absorb milk quickly and awaken the flavor of the sweetener and cinnamon, the cookies are so small that you'll be dunking fingers along with cookies.There are a few minuses; but given the quality of the cookies, they're minor:1) The cookies are smaller than I thought, so be careful giving them to small children.  But I'm sure they'll love them.2) Because of their size, it makes them very easy to overeat them.  Despite their all-natural organic ingredients, they're still cookies: They're not very nutritious, they're very sweet and are high in calories.  Self-control is essential.3) These cookies are amazingly hard to chew; they are very crunchy.  Eating them helps me to appreciate how hard dogs work to chew dog biscuits.  Your molars will get some work chewing these down.As with all groceries sold by Amazon, I suggest buying a pack at a supermarket and trying it before buying the case.  But I'm confident you will not be disappointed.

After googling these and seeing that some people are obsessed with the arrowroot variety, I thought I would give them a try. They taste basically like graham crackers or maybe animal crackers with strong taste of honey. It's great that they have no trans fats, minimal chemical ingredients, are mostly organic, and "non-profit"; but they're nothing to get excited about. The hard texture is a pro/con in that it forces you to eat carefully, and limits your desire to gorge. These are good non-lethal commercial cookies, but like all commerical cookies are lacking in nutrition and taste.

column9: I need to know what "natural flavoring" specifically means... can't have MSG or any similar chemicals slipped into some foods.
column10: MY FAVORITE COOKIES! I love Oreos without the cream and these are perfect. They taste just like the ice-box cake cookies sold in the larger flat cookies, too.... BUT.....I need to know exactly what "natural flavoring" is because I react horribly to MSG and similar glutamate heavy "altered 'natural' foods" that are allowed by the FDA. I am trying to eliminate even small amounts from my diet to prevent future effects that build up with the trace amounts you get in each item.  The FDA allows many flavor enhancing trace chemicals that have the same effects as glutamates on people.... but they don't have to specifically list them and it leaves me in a tough spot for enjoying packaged foods :(I can't wait to start chomping these again!!  :)

These are a great lunch box snack. Just enough sweetness and no high fructose corn syrup or hydrogenated oils which is great if you care what  you are eating as well. Too bad they have reduced the package size and increased the price like every other food company out there.

column9: an Oreo cookie without the filling
column10: This cookie is the same chocolate cookie that is in their Newman O's. If you like chocolate cookies these are the best. I use them for a chocolate crust in my cheesecakes.Great cookie, profits go to charity and organic so they are as pesticide free as possible and grown by sustainable methods.

column9: Excellent snack! Crunchy, not too sweet,  just right!
column10: This is an excellent cookie for kids or adults. I would have given it 5 stars if it had been made with 100% whole wheat flour.

I have fallen in love with these cookies!They taste almost the same as Newman's sandwich cookies, just without the filling. Crunchy, chocolaty, and just the perfect size. And at 120 calories for a serving, they aren't too waist enhancing.The main reason I am in love with them is the fact that they don't have any corn in them (I'm allergic to corn). This is something that not too many cookie makers consider when making their products.Yet another Newman's Own product to add to our ever growing pantry of products.Pros:Chocolaty enough to satisfy chocoholics.Crunchy and have a good texture.Cons:Far too many Qs and not enough vowels, it's like playing Scrabble! :P

i love these cookies because they are a natural product, taste good enough to satisfy my chocolate cravings without wasting a huge amount of calories, easy to transport, and not messy (ok, there are a couple of little residual crumbs on your fingers). I eat them almost everyday so i have them on a repeat order!

I'm not afraid to admit that these alphabet crackers are my favorite "cookies".  They are not too hard, not too soft.  They have a great flavor and they are actually pretty nutritious.  The bag has a re-sealable sticker.  They make an excellent snack.

column9: Tasty, fun, sticks to the teeth
column10: Tasty and the kids were excited to play alphabet games with them.They were difficult to brush out of the kids' teeth.  I'm still trying to figure that feature out.

These cookies are GREAT. I've recently developed some food allergies and these cookies are one of the few treats I can have! They are the perfect way to satisfy that craving for a little something sweet! The fact that they have protein in them is a bonus too!I would have liked to have known about the expiration date prior to buying. I purchased them in October and they expired in November. I had 1 month to eat 12 bags of cookies (which wasn't a problem) but I would have liked to have known that ahead of time. Otherwise, the transaction was great!

Back for another case after just one month...yep, we ate them all! These are not the sicky-sweet kind of cookies you buy in the junk aisle at the grocery store; they are more cocoa-y than sugary, and this former sugar fiend prefers them now. I also like the crunch (it's really not too hard). And they're better for you than those "elf-made" snacks. My one problem with these is that I can't stop eating them once I start! There's just something about them that makes me go to town on the bag, and I'm not a craver/compulsive-type eater by any means. Then there's the organic ingredients, and the responsible business practices and charitable contributions of the company - what's not to like? For me these are 10 stars **********
These Newman graham cookies are wonderful.  I'm on my third case because they are so handy to take along for a snack.  They taste great, you won't be disappointed.
These are great cookies! Small, crunchy, low in calories for a serving size, and just a wonderful not too sweet cookie.
I love these cookie crackers. I share them with my infant son. They are a tasty snack I enjoy during all periods of the day.
These are by far thee best organic cookies out there!!!  And not too high calorie for 10 of them per serving!!
I wasnt impressed with these and neither were my kids.  I ended up giving them away. Not bad, realy, just not particularly good or worth wasting the calories on...

column9: Does not come with perforated cap to moderate speed of pouring but tastes good
column10: if you don't accidentally spill too much out due to the lack of perforated cap, it is good stuff.  plus, it's hard to find organic cinnamon sugar.
Not much to say here I've been ordering these for a while now. Simple, good fruit, great taste, no sugar packed syrup and no extra calories.

Pacific Natural is a great brand and Light Sodium Organic Creamy Tomato Soup is a winning product. It is a rich, flavorful, smooth soup. A bowl of this is a tasty and convenient way to have one of the five daily recommended servings of fruits and vegetables.I take off one star because I have recently begun counting my sodium intake and this soup often puts my daily total over. I'm just trying to not exceed the normal, recommended amounts of sodium, nothing drastic. I wish Pacific Natural Foods would sell a version of their soups with no added salt, at all. We could carefully add our own salt, or not. Actually, it would be perfect if they made a "super light sodium" version with 50% less salt than this, the "50% less salt" version. I could have it every day.This has 380 mg per 1 cup serving. This is a lower amount than the regular Organic Creamy Tomato by Pacific Natural Food, which has a whopping 750 mg per cup. For those who aren't watching their sodium, both of these soups will be good. But, I bought the "Low Sodium" version because of an interest in keeping daily sodium intake within recommended healthy levels. Comparing it to frozen "healthy" entrees, this has more sodium than some "main dishes". As a side dish, this has a significant amount of added salt.For watching calories and nutrients (like sodium) there's a great, free website at "everydayhealth.com". Users can list every thing eaten and it calculates the fat, protein, sugar carbohydrates and sodium for each day. I find this a tremendously helpful resource. It has an expanded nutritional content view that allows easy scanning and comparison of foods. Things with with higher salt, fat or sugar are easy to spot. This soup comes up on the higher-sodium side of things I eat. It has been a revelation how much salt is in most prepared foods. Even "healthy" brands like Weight Watchers, Eating Right, Lean Cuisine, Amy's, O Organics, Morningstar Farms, etc. have enough sodium to make hitting targets difficult. For salt-watching fans of this soup, you may not be doing as well as you thought. I'll still buy this, but will eat it less often/in smaller portions. Looks like cooking from scratch is best to insure not overdoing the salt. Too bad, easy to prepare, healthy meals are a great convenience and there is a place for them in this busy world. Enjoy the soup, but count the milligrams!

column9: Best Soup That You Didn't Make Yourself
column10: Some soups are forgettable cups of nutrition, others are memorable only for their imbalance - too salty, too tart, too concentrated, too bland....  Certainly packaged soups are the worst offenders.  Behold Pacific Foods Light Sodium Organic Creamy Tomato.  At long last, perfect balance in a packaged soup.  The tomato flavor, the core issue here, is not only warm and tangy, it's got that little hint of sweetness that only appears in a fresh tomato.  I can't imagine how Pacific Foods does it - you'd swear it was pulled from the vine on a summer's day and magically transported into your mug.  The creaminess is a velvety blanket of affection that surrounds you, yet never overwhelms the tomato flavor.  And while my homemade soups can not stand without the support of chicken stock or beef broth, somehow Pacific Foods has worked even more magic by making this soup completely vegetarian, yet full-dimensional and rich.Now if only Amazon could figure out how to pack the shipment a bit better....  cleaning off 11 cartons because the 12th got bashed in transit - no fun.  Ah well, at least I can console myself with another mug of perfection.

This delicious, lower sodium tomato soup is convenient to take with you and satisfying either warm or right from the carton cold. Stir in favorites for a more hearty meal.  Also a good base for tossing with pasta and veggies for a light summer fare.

As a child Campbell's tomato soup was a staple at my house, but the high sodium content held me back from feeding it to my own kids. I happened upon this at the grocery store one day and myself and my kids LOVED it. This is the only soup (of any flavor) that I can get my picky daughter to eat. Although this 'low sodium' version still has a considerable amount of sodium in it (most any prepackaged soup does), I figure since she doesn't eat it every day and our diet is generally low sodium anyway, it won't hurt anything...not to mention the health benefits of tomatoes which my daughter will not eat regularly.This soup is very creamy and pairs well with a sandwich, crackers, or even grilled chicken. I often pack some in a thermos for my daughter's lunch. I would compare it to La Madeleine's creamy tomato basil soup but with a smoother texture and far less calories.

I love this soup so much that I have added it to the subscribe and save service.  It is wonderful by itself and is gluten free.  Even my wheat loving husband loves this soup.  I also use it to cook with and have found it works great.  Just substitute it for any recipe that calls for tomato soup.  I use it in a halupki casserole and it is delicious.

column9: scary, not sure what happened, manufacturing problem maybe
column10: I have used Pacific Natural soup products before, and bought a case of these to try the organic creamy tomato. I had these in my cabinet for one month after receiving them in good condition from Amazon, and one of them exploded in the case!  They had been stored at room temperature, and it's not that hot in SF. I was a bit disturbed by what type of conditions in the box would have caused such an explosion (out of the top of the box, and it got all over everything), so i threw the entire 10 unused boxes away.  the one box i had consumed, was very mild tasting, but good (thus the 2 stars).  i don't think i'll be puchasing these again, since ive never had a commercially packaged product contaminated w bacteria (most likely) before. i can a lot of foods, so i'm always careful about processing -at a minimm, there may be a quality control problem, since the shipping and packaging appeared solid. Yikes!

column9: awesome flavor and low calorie way to add pizazz to food
column10: was not particularly fond of balsamic vinegar until i tried mazetti.  it has a wonderful complex flavor.  it's sweet, but not too sweet.  it's mild but has punch without being overpowering.  brings out the natural flavor of whatever you put it on.  highly recommend.

These candy bars where wonderful, just like I used to have as a child growing up in California. I have been in Georgia for 32 years now and I have looked everywhere for them but no one carries them. They came fresh as can be and it didn't take long to get here. I WILL order them again.

Along with the Kit Kat, this is the best american chocolate, try it, I'm sure you'll love it too. I'm a true chocoholic and really like the consistency in the marshallow, it combines perfectly with a thin layer of chocolate and nuts.

column9: The Dog just EATS IT UP!!
column10: I usually mix a little of this with my dog's hard food. I noticed I can put a spoonful on her hard food and she eats it up just the same. I guess this will last her for a pretty long time...I will definitely come back when she runs out!

column9: high quality and my dog loves it
column10: I purchased this food because I wanted a high quality dog food. I was not disappointed. When I opened the can, the food had a pleasant aroma and the food looked like people beef stew. Chunks of meat and plenty of vegetables. My dog loves it. It is a little pricey but you get what you pay for and my dog is worth it.
Always great service.  Have been a customer for 3 years now! My dog just loves this stuff!!!  Very convenient.  I love Amazon for all my online purchases!

The one star is for Nuticity's advertisement of a product that apparently does not exist.  Knotts Berry Farm used to produce the best strawberry preserves at a reasonable price.  However at least a couple years ago it was bought out by Smuckers, and I have not been able to find Knotts Berry Farm products on any shelves.  I was surprised at Nutricity's Knotts Berry Farm Preserve Strawberry being "In Stock," and although the offer was pricey, I ordered the pack of 12 on May 26th. The order was delayed and delayed. I wrote to Nutricity through Amazon on 6/8 and was assured that this was just a processing delay.  Nutricity cancelled the order today 6/21.  (My credit card was never charged.)  What is surprising is that they are allowed to keep it showing as "In stock" on the Amazon page.  That would appear not to be correct.Coyote

column9: Banana pancakes, a Saturday morning tradition
column10: My family loves Bisquick pancakes.  Most Saturday mornings I take one of these mixes, add an 8 oz bottle of water, mash and add a couple of ripe bananas and make the best pancakes you have ever tasted.The ripeness of the bananas directly effects the taste of the pancakes, they must be ripe.  We take ripe bananas, peel them, bag them and freeze them so that they will be ready for pancake day.  If there is banana juice in the bag be sure to pour it into the mix too.Try it, you'll probably love it.This mix makes enough pancakes for about three adults, maybe a little more.

not sure where the problems occured that other customers experienced, but I was almost totally satisfied with this product...easy to mix, the pancakes came out great (if not slightly bland tasting)...my only criticism is that leftover batter tends to thicken when refrigerated...don't add extra water or the batter will be too thin...take the batter out of the fridge and let warm to room temp before using.

I like buying my pancakes in bulk like this from Amazon. I am wheelchair bound and it keeps me from having to buy only one or two of the bulky boxes of stuff. The pancakes are good and easy to make. Each one of the containers will easily make 8 good sized pancakes.
This is a great product that helps you save LOTS of time and LOTS of the mess when making pancakes!!  Tastes great too!

column9: Quick and Easy; great to have on hand
column10: For decades, I would always make pancake mix from scratch (and to be honest, it's really not that difficult to do so.)  But now that I have less time and perhaps out of laziness, I've switched to this product.  It's REALLY EASY.  Literally all you do is add water to the fill line (on side of jar), put lid back on and shake vigorously to mix.  It's not always that easy to get the mix at the bottom to mix with the water and their suggestion of tapping the bottom doesn't work.  But the mix turns out just fine.  It doesn't make the nice fluff, airy pancakes that you can get from homemade mixes but it makes perfectly fine, tasty regular pancakes.  And you can't beat the convenience.  They're great to have on hand even as back ups.  This particular size (10.6oz) I found too large for just my son and I but the smaller size is perfect.  And it's easy to make pancakes for him whenever he wants.

Every Sunday is pancake day and this product produces consistent, delicious, and quick results.  I know, you can make them from scratch, from a bag, and also from a box.  This product ensures that pancakes taste good all the time.  And how many things do you know you can count on week to week?

I forgot how ggod the bisqick pancake tasted, I haven't had them for years. I'm please, I was able to find this shake & pour mix on amazon the price is good, the amount is a lot. the taste is good the pancake is light. also quick and easy to prepare.

I use the "thinner" ratio on the bottle and the resulting product is more like a crepe-pancake than a pancake.  And it's DELICIOUS.  Definitely my favorite way to have pancakes.  I use butter in the pan and don't find these to be bland at all.  In my opinion you don't need to add anything (like bananas or chocolate chips, etc) unless you want to, and you don't even need syrup.  The resulting pancake is a buttery slightly-salty wonder.I can imagine needing to add syrup, etc if you use the "thicker" ratio, because then the pancakes would be thicker, cakier, and more dry.  But if you make the thin version, you don't get bogged down in a thicky cakey middle.I love this.  I honestly think these pancakes are better than anything I'd make myself "from scratch" or that I've had in a restaurant, etc.  And that's not surprising.  Bisquick's whole business is essentially pancakes.  You'd think they'd get it right.  And they have!  Nothing to be ashamed of to really love their mix.  Just because they're commercial doesn't mean it's not a great pancake.(again, try the thinner version!)
These are great for camping.  Just add water and you're ready for pancakes.  The mix has a great Bisquick taste.

Have tried the product from the grocery store and loved it. We had a hard time finding this product in the stores. Since we do grocery shopping once a month we were looking for 6 to 8 and could only find 2 or 3. We looked on line and found a company to purchase from for a reasonable price except they wanted $10 per bottle for shipping, $60 for six bottles, really? We did not know that Amazon also dealt with food products but we search anyway. Not only did we find the product, we found it slightly lower than the store price and FREE SHIPPING! We bought 2 cases and plan to purchase a case a month especially in the summer time when we camp. This is an excellent product which can be altered to your liking. For instance we add Hershey's chocolate syrup into the bottle and make chocolate pancakes.

column9: Shaking the "cakes" for our family reunion
column10: Over the last weekend in June, my committee and I put on a 135th family reunion for over 160 people. That in itself can be a feat but let's just add that this three day event was held in a field with porto potties, no running water and a generator for some lights at night. One of the main features of this gathering is the Sunday pancake breakfast. My husband built a 6 ft x 2 ft propane griddle that could cook 36 pancakes at once but the thought of mixing eggs, milk and pancake mix into batter without proper clean up facilities really presented a problem. Then, I thought about the Bisquick Shake N'Pour mixes that I use when we go camping during the summer and "Googled" them to check cost. Amazon had cases of 10.6 oz bottles...I bought 5 cases..just add water and shake and pour on the griddle and the pancakes were great. Without the cost of milk and eggs I believe we actually saved money. We did not end up with lots of unused, mixed batter, smaller batches were easier to control. Clean up involved tossing the plastic containers in the recycling. Couldn't be more thrilled. We also have a lot of converts who had not tried the product before but after having tried it will be buying it in the future. Great with blueberries and chocolate chips tossed in as well.

column9: This is the only way I'll make waffles
column10: Until I found out about this product, I wouldn't bother making pancakes or waffles.  When cooking for one person, it's just not worth the cleanup time.This product is fantastic... no cleanup at all, and it makes excellent waffles.Just make sure, as per the instructions, that you put the top on loosely when storing leftover product.  Pressure builds inside the bottle, and if you put the cap on tightly it will spray batter everywhere when you open the bottle.Highly recommended!

The product conveniently makes very good pancakes. Be careful of Amazon's pricing. I have been ordering it through Amazon's Grocery Department for less than $18 per case. With no explanation as to why, Amazon offered it for over $38 per case. That plus shipping brought the price per bottle  to over $5.00 a bottle, which is approximately $2.50 per bottle more than the local grocery stores.

I Like these at $14.18 for 8 bottles.The only drawback on "Subscribe and Save" is that they adjust the price with out letting me know!!But as long as you monitor what it costs there are some pretty good deals :)

I didn't like these at all!  The pancakes came out too thin and had a terrible taste.  In fact I just threw out a bottle I had in the refrigerator. I'll stick to the powder in the box type. I don't reccomend this product.

My 18 month old son is allergic to dairy and egg and legumes, so we have a hard time finding foods that have the nutrition he needs. I gave him this vegan mac and "chreese" tonight and he LOVED it. And, as a vegan, I thought it was good too. It is not super flavorful, but satisfying none-the-less. I am very pleased with this product and will continue to buy it.

column9: It's okay for boxed mac & cheese
column10: This is an okay version of dairy-free mac & cheese.  I looked at the advice of other reviewers and added 3/4 cup (instead of 1/2 cup) of hemp milk and a tablespoon of vegan Earth Balance buttery spread to the powdered cheese mix.  This seemed like the right balance to have a cheese sauce that wasn't too liquidy or to powdery/lumpy.  The pasta, as others have said, is very good.  The cheese flavor could use a little more flavor but it's okay for a standard dairy-free mac & cheese.  I added some Dunya cheese to it which melted and that helped slightly.  I recently became vegan so this helped me get through a mac & cheese craving but I probably won't make/buy again.

column9: Closest to Mac n Cheese As A Vegan Can Get
column10: In short, this stuff is pretty fantastic! I've been vegan for 5 years for reference. No, it's not anything like your Kraft Mac n' Cheese, but it has a great, savory flavor nonetheless. Do NOT buy this if you're expecting something that mimics cheddar. You'll especially like the flavor if you cook with nutritional yeast, go for it!The pasta cooks nicely, its whole wheat macaroni that takes a little longer to cook than white pasta would, but the consistency is as good as any other pasta if you cook it right and drain.I made my sauce with Rice Dream rice milk. Like any powdered sauce mix, I wouldn't suggest pouring the entire thing in the pot at once! Put your desired milk product in the pot, then slowly stir in the powder to make sure you work any lumps that develop from the powder. I've found this is easier to do while its on low heat. Then you can add the pasta and kick up the heat a little bit as you mix it. The sauce gets nice and creamy! So glad I got this! Good job, Road's End! YUMMY!

This is a great product. Let me start by saying I'm a vegan and have not consumed cheese in 4 years. But from what I remember of the cheese flavor and texture this is really close. No this does not taste like Kraft mac and cheese, I feel like the taste is more like something you would get at a deli.Contrary to what other reviewers stated, I find the pasta to be my least favorite part of this product. I do have a few tips on making the sauce:1. when mixing it with the milk product really do get all the clumps to dissolve2. when you drain the noodles, leave the burner on the side ON so when you do put the sauce with noodles back on the burner to stir it instantly starts to thicken the sauce3. also I recommend to follow the suggestion on the box to add a tablespoon of butter or a butter substitute to enhance the flavor. I add this as I'm stirring the noodles and cheese sauce together for the first timeI really do enjoy this product especially the easiness(if I speed make it. I can cook it in 15 min). Maybe for the average dairy consumer this just doesn't cut the cake, but at least for those who do not consume dairy, for whatever reason, this is an awesome replacement.

We love this stuff in my house! If you've ever made your own vegan mac and "cheese" from nutritional yeast, flour, etc, then you'll love this too. If you're expecting it to mirror real cheese, then you'll be let down. But that's the general rule for vegan cheese products, in my opinion. The mix makes a really smooth bechamel-style "cheese" sauce with a nice stretchy quality. I love to serve it with bbq tofu and greens - the absolute vegan comfort meal.

column9: Would be much better without the wheat pasta
column10: As much as I love this vegan mac and cheese knockoff, I prefer the shells over this one. There's so much wheat in the macaroni one that it actually scratches my throat.

Pros:*The pasta is really good - nice and sturdy, not floppy or mushy*Per 320 calorie serving there are only 2 g of fat and whopping 9 grams of fiber, 20% DRI of Iron, 40% DRI of B12, and 30% DRI of Folate!*The texture of the cheese sauce is very good.*At around $2/box, it is very resonibly priced.Cons:*The directions need a little adjustment. I needed to cook the pasta around 12 minutes (it says 6-10. You are also supposed to add 1/2 cup soymilk, but I have found that it needs an entire cup.*With 400 mg of sodium per 320 calorie serving, it's a little high in sodium (but not very high)*The flavor of the sauce should be bolder. The texture is very good and creamy, but the flavor is somewhat bland. I think if they added 25% more spices they would be spot on.Overall, I would recommend this product. Nutritionally it is rather healthy, the price is good, and the flavor is also good.

column4: ChibiNeko "Sooo many books, so little time!"
column9: Does NOT taste remotely similar to cheese
column10: I'm allergic to dairy & due to recent events I've had to give up the little bit of dairy that I was able to eat previously. I ended up buying this mac & chreese in the hopes of finding something similar to the old favorite that I loved so much. Note that I said *similar* & not identical. While I've tasted some vegan cheeses that were pretty close to the real thing, I wasn't expecting a miracle from a powder.Oh boy... where do I start... Well, first I'll start with the good. The pasta isn't bad. It cooks up nice & firm, just like I would want it to. The pasta is probably the one thing about this that I'd probably try again, if it came in a package by itself.But the bad part is the sauce. Not only does it NOT taste remotely like cheese, but it's this icky sloppy mess that reminds me more of garlic than cheese. My first attempt with this sauce might have had too much water, as it was a little too soupy, but my second attempt (I was willing to try it again to see if I'd prepared it wrong) wasn't much better. The taste didn't improve with either attempt.As far as mac & vegan cheese goes, I think I'll go back to the old fashioned way of making it (noodles & melting vegan cheese) instead of the instant route. I wasn't expecting a miracle with this, but I was hoping that the sauce would at least attempt to taste like cheese or be tasty in some regards. This just wasn't for me.If you try this, just remember that it isn't going to taste like anything remotely cheesy. Just go to the store & get one box of this stuff before buying it in bulk here on amazon.

While this product offered a convenient vegan alternative to other commercial products, it was sort of sad looking on the plate, with a minimal amount of sauce that dried up quickly.  I added 1/2c of MimicCreme and 1 tbls of EarthBalance.  Blech. Back to making "cheesy" nutritional yeast sauce from scratch.

I don't like Roads End's cheese sauce.  It needed at least twice as much liquid as they say to add.  Even then the sauce was gloppy and didn't taste particularly cheesy.  I really wanted to love this as the price is so much better than Namaste Foods mac & cheese.  Namaste Foods product is far superior.  I also tried Edward & Sons cheese flavored mashed potatoes which contains Roads End cheese sauce and it wasn't very good either.  The other varieties of Edward & Sons potatoes were really delicious so the problem is Roads End's cheese sauce mix.  So disappointing.The pasta cooked up well though.  I wish it were wheat free though.

We love this easy tasty vegan mac & cheese. If you want a fat free meal all you add is soy milk. If you want a richer pasta sauce you can add a dab of earth balance margarine. We like to add peas & carrots to ours for a full meal. Products like this make it easy to stay vegan and healthy.

I totally love this stuff! It the best of the Road's End bunch.Some tasty options: If you truly have a craving for a more cow-cheesey flavor, mix in a bit of yellow mustard (maybe a teaspoon or two). Somehow it works. Or just for fun, try a dash of curry, crushed red pepper flakes, garlic powder, dried or sauteed onions, diced fresh tomatoes, chopped steamed broccoli/cauliflower, green peas, fresh or dried herbs or even...ketchup. Yes! I love ketchup on my Mac! The sodium and fat content in the boxed package as is, is low enough that you could, frankly, crank it up a ton with stuff and still be eating healthy. I wonder if they did that on purpose? Either way, I love it as is, but I also love it a million different "homemade" ways. Have fun with your Mac & Chreese!Peace to you.Enjoy!=)

column9: pasta ok, sauce not so good
column10: great to find gluten/dairy free pasta choices, but... their included sauces (I've tried several flavors) leave a terrible after taste. the pasta (without the sauce) is ok...  I'd buy their pasta again if it were made available without the sauce.

I would say this rates around standard for your non-dairy mac n cheese. It's alright, edible, and filling but not amazing and something you would be craving to have again. I like that it's organic and whole wheat at a decent price. Not sure I would buy it again as I expected something a little more cheesy like. I rather get some noodles and pasta sauce over this.

The Road's End Mac and Chreese is such a great convenience food for vegans or anyone avoiding dairy.  The sauce is made with nutritional yeast, so it tastes somewhat cheesey but definitely not like conventional mac and cheeses.  Make sure you follow the directions on the box and re-warm the sauce and pasta to thicken it.  The first time I made it, I didn't do this and it wasn't nearly as good.The mac and chreese is also really easy to bulk up to make a complete meal.  You can add in veggies or even veggie burgers (Sunshine burgers go really well with this.)Also, this is a great price.  It's almost half the price per box as it costs to buy in the grocery store.

This is good stuff! When I went vegan the thing I missed most was cheese. I've gotten over it, but this "chreese" really brings back a flavor memory. Good texture, very smooth and creamy, and no nasty dairy. Excellent replacement for Mac-n-cheese. I doubt that your family would even know the difference. I'm sure it's more healthy too, not that it matters to me.

I cooked the mac the required time.  I made the sauce with milk and added a bit of butter.  Cardboard.  inedible.  I don't remember where I bought this, I would certainly return it if i recalled.  Terrible texture.

I was very disappointed with this dairy free mac and cheese -- I did it like I would make other mac and cheese  -- I always melt the butter and add the mix - then the milk  --  ( I tried both soy and regular-- )  mix them in sauce pan  -- I was upset because first of price and then it tasted terrible --  I have done other mac and cheese mixes and there is something wrong with calling them mac and cheese --  They are elbows and whatever the sauce is -- It tastes like card board-- I have used lots of different soy cheeses - and other non dairy mixes -- this is awful  --  I wouldn't waste your money on it  --

noodles are finecheese sauce is disgustingit does not taste anything like cheese ...i see why they call it chreese instead of cheese.i can not find anything redeeming to say about the sauce.the good news is the noodles are edible.they are a little stiff but work well for baked style macaroni

awesome sugar sticks! not all busted up, good quality sugar! melted nicely in my morning cup of Java!! very pleased with product!! will order again! easy to order, quick delivery great shipping price!!! very pleased!!

column9: Just what I wanted.  but NOT individually packed
column10: Exactly as pictured EXCEPT each stick is NOT individually wrapped - they are unwrapped although packed well (paper separating each layer of sticks).  I found no breakage at all.  Just had my daughter re-pack in a plastic air-tight (and hopefully insect-proof!) container.  That's the only reason I gave a 4 out of 5 on the review.  But the price certainly is right - least expensive I've seen on Amazon.  So - if you are a major home-coffee drinker, or going to have a special party - I think these are a good deal.  And fun to eat.
I've tried many types of coffee and always come back to Pilon. I've been drinking it by far and it has a wonderful flavor without that bitter bite some coffees have. WONDERFUL!

column9: This is the only coffee I buy now.
column10: Wonderful coffee, not at all bitter, works magnificently with my AeroPress creating smooth coffee with a lovely foam. Highly recommend this little treasure. Great price, too.

I've been drinking this coffee ever since my best friend's mom introduced it to me in HS. This is by far the best tasting store bought coffee, Maxwell House and Folgers can't compare. I like strong coffee and its still strong even after I add cream and sugar. Its also great iced.

I love Pilon cuban coffee! I'm from Miami, FL and just moved to rural Mississippi recently and can't find it here anywhere! Please do something about that. LOL. In the meantime I'll order form Amazon.com so I can have it in the morning before work and at lunchtime and after dinner. There's some things a Miami girl can't live without, and Pilon is definitely one of them. It's the best coffee in the whole world, hands down.Lula

A wonderfully tasting coffee but I offered a package to a friend and she said, "I don't like espresso coffee". Well, it seems to me that the actual use of the word is used to describe the grind of the coffee which is as fine as dust. I don't use this coffee in an espresso machine but just put it in my Mr Coffee with the paper filter. Works great and with the fine grind, one gets much more "mileage" out of a given amount of coffee. The finer grind makes much more surface area of the coffee available as opposed to a regular grind with big chunks of bean which needs much more product to produce a similiar cup of coffee.I found this coffee in a Florida Publix and enjoyed it very much. Upon returning home, the only source for it was on Amazon and even with shipping, its a great bargain. Enjoy.

column9: Roasted in USA vs Imported from Italy Saves BIG BUCKS.
column10: I was ordering cans of the fancy Italian import, but decided to buy from an American roaster and also save some cash.  For less than one can of the import,  I can get four bricks that are comparable in quality. The roaster (Rowlands -javacabana dot com) has a wide variety of blends for everything from true espresso machines to stove top pots.  One note: I believe some of the other blends may use some cheaper "robusta" beans, and therefore may have a bit more caffeine kick. But this one is 100% arabica.Espresso snobs will turn up their noses at pre-ground, but don't let them fool you.  You will need to get a $[...] burr grinder to grind you own beans fine enough to match Pilon.  Blade grinders and cheap $[...] Chinese burr grinders with boutique names  sold in big box stores simply won't cut it.  Even my $[...] grinder is not good enough.  Enjoy!

Smooth, rich coffee.  I'm very selective when it comes to coffee.  I use Pilon to make expresso, capuccino, cuban  and in my drip coffee maker.  Everyone I've served it to has remarked on it's rich smooth flavor without aftertaste or bitterness.

My favorite is Estrella espresso, but my former e-merchant chose the low road.  So be it.  Pilón (and Bustelo) is a strong favorite, and I've used it for at least 10-12 years ... still do.  It gives me great crema, has strong but not bitter taste, and I prefer strong espresso over the fruitier styles made by other companies.  Can't go wrong with Pilón.
This is an arabica blend.  This coffee leaves a lot to be desired.  Typical waiting room quality coffeeGreat for the breakroom at work, but I would not chose to drink this.
I know PILON coffee since my early childhood in Cuba. It's a good espresso type coffee with one of the best price tags in the market.
Pilon Espresso 100 % Arabica Coffee, 10-Ounce Bricks (Pack of 4)Personally, I prefer the whole-bean version. Good quality, Cuban-style espresso, less expensive than Bustelo, but just as good.

My husband originally purchased this coffee in Florida. He grew up drinking Cuban coffee, and likes very strong regular coffee. He brews it in our French press using standard coffee measurements.  Buying it from Amazon is a great value if you're used to drinking other gourmet coffees.  It's vaccuum sealed, so it makes sense to buy enough to qualify for free shipping!
I use this in my Cafe Frappe by Mr. Coffee and it works great.  The perfect grind.

I usually buy fresh dark roast beans and grind them just before brewing. A friend served Pilon and I liked it. Don't be turned off by the "Expresso" designation. It is a very good dark, rich coffee at a bargain price.

column4: S. P. Delorenzo "S. P. DeLorenzo Coffee Maven"
column9: Cafe Pilon : The Cuban Espresso That Delivers!!!
column10: Cafe Pilon is a robust espresso that satisfies the enthusiast's taste buds every sip. Reasonably priced and never disappointing. Full bodied with a lingering full coffee taste. Brew it any time of day or evening for aaaaah satisfying respite.

Pros: this is not bitter has a nice aroma and makes strong coffee.Cons: this is a little on the burnt side and not as good as Bustelo.I normally drink Cafe Bustelo Cafe Bustelo Coffee Espresso, 10-Ounce Bricks (Pack of 4) but I decided to try this. I think Bustelo is much better. Pilon is still better compared to other coffee at this price.

column4: Eric R. Kirk "Thanks for reading, Eric."
column10: This coffee is just outstanding. I don't even know where to start. Umm lets start with the amount of pure Arabica (not cheaper Robusta beens) coffee you get for just 10-12 bucks. 2.5 lbs that's just crazy cheap, but the flavor is anything but cheap. This coffee is probably the best I have tasted. It's very dark and rich, full body, and no bitterness. I use an aerobie coffee maker 2 scoops of this coffee and it makes some darn good espresso. I normally make a American style coffee, buy filling the mug up with hot water. Just the best cup of coffee and the price is so low it's almost a joke. Most things in life you get what you pay for. Well with this coffee you get way more then you paid for and that's nice now a days. I would also like to add that I have also recently bought (Lavazza Qualita Rossa) that was three times the price of Pilon Espresso. It was just horrible. Bad aroma, very bitter, and 2nd rate beans (Robusta). Again for the price you can't beat this coffee. As far as a drip coffee maker, I don't have one. So it might turn out differently for you. I do recommended get a aerobie coffee maker and this coffee.
