Now the oil did help to soften my skin and moisturize the places that were really dry, but I just wondered about it since it had absolutely no scent what-so-ever. Also I found that Walmart sales coconut oil that smells like coconut oil and works just as well. So from here on out especially since it is cheaper - it is walmart for me.

Just because the item's description is 360t bucket doesn't guarantee a bucket anymore!  You'll receive 360 pieces of dubble bubble in a shipping box.  So if you where hoping to store them in the bucket, buy something else.

column9: America's Original Is As Good As Ever
column10: The gum was in a nice red, white and blue bucket that contained 380 pieces, not just 360. A good value, and the flavor is just as you remember it from when you were a kid. Very highly recommended for us grown up bubble gum lovers.
I use this to give out to kids of a sunday school class I teach.  The kids love it and look forward to getting a piece every week.

Make sure to check your order upon receipt.  I ordered a tub of original bubble gum and instead received a tub of 5 fruit flavors.I guess  I can give it out a Halloween, but really needed regular bubble gum.

Dubble Bubble in this container is the first time you will taste the gum in it's freshest condition, and 385 pieces of gum will give the entire office a change to sample a true chewing gum experience.  I am still giving out gum after a month later, and people are asking where I got such a unique gift.  I recommend this for everyone who needs to make a large number of people happy.

column9: Great product and great company to buy from!
column10: This company is one of the best to buy from! They go beyond and above to make sure the customer is happy! Definately buy from this company!

column9: Very good, but shop around for a lower price
column10: These crackers are great. If you're missing cheese-its these will fit the bill! I highly recommend them.  Please note, that you can probably find these locally for much less. For anyone in my area ~ Heinens in Avon, Ohio has them for around $5.50 per 12 oz. box.  Definitely shop around. Prices on this particular product on here seem way too high!

column9: Grainless Baker cheddar snackers are a yummy snack
column10: The Grainless Baker has some amazing products and their Cheddar Snackers are another successful product in my opinion. The crackers are buttery, flaky and crunch and remind me of non- gluten free crackers. The only downside to these crackers are the price (I paid around $8 for a box) and they are very high in calories (17 crackers for 150 calories, yikes). If you are looking for a savory gluten free snack, Cheddar Snackers are a great option.

My son used to love cheez-its before going gluten free. I bought these in hopes that they would replace the cheez-its, but my son did not like them. They are not bad at first, but have a bad after taste. My youngest son, who will eat anything,  also didn't care for these. At $10 a box, I was hoping for better results.

column9: Best Honey Buns I've Had, But Price Is Terrible.
column10: These honey buns are delicious, definitely better than Little Debbie's version. Warm or room temperature their tasty, and soft. Amazon's pricing is too high, when you can get the same amount from Sam's for less than $5.
this is probibly my favorite honey bun, but it's not on the amazon prime free shipping,which  is the reason i might not order again..i know i know ,i'm cheap...lol
best deal in all the snacks ... shipping was fast and what a deal !! sent 2 cases to my son and what a surprise it was ... everyone loves these tasty treats !!

I loved eating this doughnuts when I was a freshman in high school. I cannot really find them anywhere except if I go to Sam's Club. However, I do not have a membership card to buy anything there. I want to get these doughnuts but if I have to spend over $20 for the item, forget it.
This is the absolute best, your life isn't complete until u have had a box of these...delicious, tasty, moist...just wow...

column9: i ordered them over the internet
column10: i did not have to microwave these because they were just delicious the way they came. they were very fresh and to my liking. for me these were very very good at room temperature or cold. the texture was very pleasing and i enjoyed eating them. they were packaged properly for the shipping. i would love to see a lot more fresh products like this on the website that we can order and get delivered right to our home. it helps some of us who can't get out and drive right now to the stores. thank you.

Vegan. Organic. Kosher. Yummy rice & beans. Heat 'n serve. Flavorful, not very spicy. 420 kcal, 14g protein, 350mg sodium per can. Six star company. This review is out there for those for whom this makes a difference. See all of my reviews for more great choices. Check out "Vegan Grocery Favorites" and "Vegan Grocery Top Ten" in Listmania. Your "helpful" votes count and will be greatly appreciated to benefit the search of others. Thank you.

column9: nice convience food for gluten free or anything else
column10: a slight heat but not a mouth burner, just right. Flavorings are nice, and combine with anything. Some of these products have a distinctive taste that limits options. This one is good as a side dish, use it in making soup or chili, good filler and extender for leftovers. It is not overly salty. If you have not tried Lundberg's beans and rice, this is a good one for a first try
I've been using this product for a couple of years, & really like it, the seasoning is just right. I like ordering through Amazon the service has been great.

BPA free can a BIG plus if you eat/store canned foods. Rice has good texture, beans firm. Overall this version of Eden Organic Rice and Beans is VERY bland. Some doctoring with preferred herbs/spices is needed. I much prefer the Mexican version for "out of the can" good taste. Free shipping brings the price about in line with what I would pay locally. Good product.

column9: Love the taste, and the fact the cans are BPA-free
column10: When I am too tired to cook I heat up a can of rice & beans, and top with diced tomatoes, corn or other vegetable.  Great, filling meal.  And, for me, the spices are just right -- not too little, not too much.

I bought this through Amazon, and am tasting it for the first time.  Service through Amazon was fabulous.  But the taste of this canned food leaves much to be desired -- it is very bland and mushy.  I had to add lots of my own spices just to make it taste alright.  It's relatively healthy though, and the can doesn't have BPA which gets it the additional star.  I'll try some of the other Eden brands, hoping they are better tasting. But if you are looking for a quick relatively healthy meal, and have your own spices to add, then this can be a good pick.

column9: Not the best can of rice and beans, but certainly the least toxic.
column10: It is kind of spicy, which is nice, because otherwise it would be very bland.  I got the Eden black beans as well, and they are a lot worse without the Caribbean Rice.  Of course, the best feature of these products is the bean cans do not have BPA toxicity, as well as no toxic ingredients or sweeteners.  No salt even!  If you want the rawest, natural, bare beans and rice.  Here it is.  Hopefully you can season and flavor foods if there's not enough oomph in them, or you know someone that can.

column9: Wholesome product, taste not too great.
column10: I bought these Eden Organic Carribean Rice and Beans, because they come in BPA free cans. First of all, I would like to thank the company for producing a quality product in a safe container. It is honestly hard to find BPA free cans, even in these "organic focused" days. Now for the taste, I am not picky about food, but ... these were just O.K. The flavoring was not up my alley. I was expecting something a little more spicy. This rice and beans had a very mild seasoning. Once I added spices to these the taste improved greatly. However, if you like the more mild seasonings this might be perfect for you. I know you can't expect too much from canned food. I give this three stars for safe packaging, and decent texture/taste.

column9: Not Bad if you like Cumin
column10: I bought this for quick organic rice & bean dishes or things like burritos. There is a strong cumin taste and it is spicy right out of the can, so you should taste it before adding anymore spices. I found I liked it better toned down by adding more cooked rice or a lot of cheese or sour cream on burritos. We have all had beans from a can, but I wondered what canned rice would be like and it's pretty good, but not five star good.

When I first got this I was disapointed that it it had so much rice.  I know it says Rice and Beans but I was hoping for more beans.  But it has really grown on me and I'm about to order another case.  I love it as a base for tostadas, better than beans alone and the slighly spicy flavor adds alot (I put cheese, salsa, fresh tomato and lettuce and sometime meat on my tostadas).  I use about a can week and it is a nice product to have for emergencies, you could, if you have to, eat it straight from the can and it would taste better and be more filling than a lot of emergency foods.  Beans and rice form a complete protien which makes for a hunger statisfing meal.

i love that not only are these organic, but the lining is also bpa-free.  they taste great on their own, in dishes or on top of chips as nachos.  i keep them on hand in my pantry for a go to item when i need to feed my family something fast & can still feel good about what i'm feeding them.  love these!

First time ever that I buy beans and rice, fully prepared, in a can. After reading the glowing reviews for Eden Foods we purchased Eden Organic Rice & Beans, Caribbean Black Bean, Lundberg Brown Rice, 15-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12), among two other Eden Organic choices for a total of 36. The first time we tasted this one product I added a little virgin olive oil to a pan and used two cans. They were not kidding when they said low salt. I will admit that on my portion I did play a little with herbs and even salt and pepper. Just a little. But in the end it went to the plate accompanied with a tasty broiled garlic chicken and the results are in: A Winner, Good Edibles. Brown rice, which is basically the only kind of rice I can attempt to eat these days and the black beans. Uh Wee Loui!, I could have eaten an extra can but since I am attempting to set a good example on moderation at the dinner table and have also eyes on me checking for any sign of faltering or deceive (harsh critics all around me!) I realized I was and everyone around me too, content with dinner. Can't wait to dive in the garbanzos and green lentil, probably tonight, but one can tell the reviewers were on the money. Why not 5 Stars? I guess I do not want to honk the horn too loud until I try them for all they are worth! For now 4 Stars but very promising stars!PS Now is 11-4-09 and I feel I must update this review. Healthy but not tasty! Certainly not a 4 Star (believe it or not I do care for my fellow Amazonian consumers and reviewers) so here is my latest take on the same product after having had to eat it (will not throw food away) for quite some time. Here it goes:From what I gathered from the nutrition label this is a healthy form of food. From what I gather every time I eat one of the 12 cans of Rice & Caribbean Black Beans, Organic 15 oz Can I regret every byte of it. Some type of condiments, perhaps attributed to the Caribbean way of eating but I doubt it, makes this selection below par. I have tried to fix it with herbs, spices, dry it in the oven, make soup but it still barely acceptable to my highly developed culinary instinctual taste.First I must say that this is the first time ever I have purchased a can that included both items, in this case beans and rice. The overall taste of this particular product leaves much to be desired. I still have about 7 more cans to consume but not very happy at all with the taste. Thought I bring it up, Healthy but Not Tasty! What a distinctive, off the wall flavor, Caribbean or not it's getting increasingly harder to finish! No disrespect intended to Eden Organic for they do deserve their accolades but not with this little bundle of joy!
This product wasn't what I expected it wasn't spicy at all and didn't have a smokey flavor either it had a super light regular store paprika flavor.

None of my local stores carry organic smoked paprika, so I was happy to find it on Amazon. I was able to choose the amount that I wanted, it arrived very quickly and it was exactly as it was described.  If you can't find organic smoked paprika locally, I would recommend ordering it from Amazon.

column9: Looks great when it first is finished
column10: I used this on a wedding cake for a friend and it looked perfect after it was applied.  My only issue was that I was working in a shared kitchen where I think someone must have put something hot into the walk-in cooler.  The fondant ended up sweating really bad and looked almost like ganache.  It dripped all over the white table cloth as I was setting up the tiered cake and made for a sticky mess to cut.  I'm not sure if it was someone who put something hot in the cooler or if the fondant just doesn't sit well in a fridge overnight...  Either way, I don't think I'll use this again, just in case.

I bought this fondant to make a reinder cake for my daughter's birthday. It was easy to use, the color was perfect and it was not overly sweet. The taste was much better than what I expected for that kind of products. It was the 1st time I bought and used something like that as usually I make my own icing. If I need to cover a big cake I will bought this product again.

I bought these nuts for tailgaiting but have eaten two of the four cans before football season. The nuts are very good and fresh. My wife says she will refill the cans for our tailgate parties. I think they will be a real hit and am thinking of buying more so everyone gets some. I like the design of the label and it is a clever idea. Wish I had thought of it first. My only words of wisdom are to buy enough. I'm not sure if they make them with other contents or not but the butter Toffee is really good.

When they say "Whatever" rub they mean it. I have put this on many things. Great on burgers and french fries. First sampled this at the Texas State Fair and the girl told me to try it on green beans. I was skeptical but it was awesome!

Our greyhound absolutely loves these bones! Even though it's designed to clean her teeth, I think she plans her day around the opportunity to chew on this luscious bone. She knows she gets the bone after she finishes her dinner. I think she would eat sawdust to get to this bone! Like the original Coke recipe, does it have Cocaine in it? Our dog is a loving, docile pet, but regularly growls if we try to take it away from her...we give her 1/3 of a bone after each dinner meal. Too much of this product seems to effect the stool negatively. If you want  your dog to place you on a pedestal, buy this product!
Nice size and quality for the price.  My dogs chew this things 24/7. Fast shipping.  No problems.

column9: DO NOT BUY THIS BONE, IT WILL MAKE YOUR DOG SICK.
column10: I bought this bone for our 8 month old schnoodle. He loved it, and ate all of the inside 'meat' within two days. True, he shouldn't have been left to eat it so quickly but he also shouldn't have gotten sick. The day after he started eating this bone, he developed diarrhea with some blood for a couple of days. After a week, he is still having loose stool and yesterday he vomited twice. Otherwise, he has been eating his food and drinking water as usual and is playing like he always does so we have been trying to wait for his system to clear up on its own. Another couple of days of these symptoms and we'll be taking him to the vet. Btw, I did a google search on the Dingo brand for any cases of puppies/dogs getting sick and I found multiple hits where people were talking about their dog having the same reaction as ours did. I also found out that there was a recall on another type of Dingo treat 1 year ago. Please look for another brand of bones for your pet, better to be safe then sorry.
My Chauncy is spoiled. He gets raw marrow bones so he did not have an interest in this. May be good for a dog that hasn't had the taste of a real bone.

My American Bulldog, Chaos, loves Dingo Dental Bone. Sadly, the bone is gone within a day because of his teeth! But it's ok because what matters is that he's entertained when he chews on it and does not chew on things that he's not supposed to :-).

I would call this "fudge" rather than brownies. My husband didn't like it, my son ate a small piece but wasn't too impressed, I thought they tasted OK but whatever ingredient is in it, it gave me awful cramps and bathroom issues, the same problem I get with sugar free candy so I guess I should have known. Sugar free "fudge" is a great concept but I guess there's no real way to be slim and still eat brownies because this is not the answer, atleast not for our family, unfortunately.

Something like popcorn seasoning is sure to be subjective, which is why we see the "love it or leave it" 1 or 5 star rating from previous reviers.Personally...I like it. It enhances the popcorn flavor. Just don't use too much. But again, how much is too much? That is beyond the scope of this review. Do you trust my taste in popcorn seasoning? If so, buy this now. If not, just buy it anyway. You need seasoning. You know this or you wouldn't be reading this review. Your life is empty without popcorn seasoning. Spice up your life!

This product was great when we first got it, but before we could use the first jar it did something weird and the taste changed into something nasty and chemical flavored. It was stored in a pantry out of the sunlight, but something happened to make it go bad before I could use even 1/2 the jar.

Movie Theater Style is an accurate description.This products captures the taste you get from a movie theater or popcorn cart style popcorn maker. Rather salty and the butter flavor is not exactly butter flavored.That said, I LOVE that flavor, and it's delicious on the home popped popcorn without nearly as much grease as the movie theater machines need to add.

Wabash Valley Farms Popcorn salt is wonderful. It is very fine grainedand won't just glide across your popcorn and fall to thebottom of the bowl. This season sticks to popcorn andmakes is taste amazing. I ordered Wabash Valley Farm popcorn seasons to go along with Paragon's Coconut oil bars. Unfortunatley Amazon did not send me the Paragon Coconut oil bars I ordered but substituted with Lou Ann coconut oil bars. Which taste pretty good, just not what I ordered.The combination of cooking popcorn in the coconut oil and then topping itoff with this Wabash popcorn salt is a grand finish. You will get popcornthat tastes like theater popcorn.  I ordered this combo after reading reviewshere at Amazon. Glad I read the reviews. Because we are popcorn lovers and thiscombination of Wabash popcorn salt and the coconut oil bars gave us popcornperfection. You don't need much of this salt , a little goes a long way.It has a slight buttery flavor to it.I recommend Wabash Valley Farms Popcorn salt .Plus get some coconut popcorn oil to cook your popcorn in.We use the Whirly pop popcorn maker to cook popcorn in. It makes the fluffiestlightest popcorn of any popcorn maker I have ever used.

column9: Found what I been looking for
column10: I have found what I was looking for in a popcorn seasoning. I have been looking for at least three years. I plan to order more soon.

I purchased this at a local Home Outfitters and was really excited to try it out. Unfortunately, it was extremely salty, and did not really impart any butter flavor. I tried to just use it sparingly as other users have suggested on Amazon, but it didn't seem to help -- it was just... mildly salted popcorn now, rather than that buttery/salty flavor that you're hoping for in 'movie style' popcorn.I didn't mind the yellow color of the product but couldn't get over the fact that it really just tasted like regular salt. I really like Wabash's Zesty Cheddar Cheese seasoning, which is quite salty as well, but has a great cheesy taste - try that one out!
Makes your popcorn taste just like your local theater's popcorn. With this seasoning less is more. You do not need much to add a ton of flavor to your popcorn.

This is the best movie theater butter seasoninig I have found, but it is still too salty for my taste.  I used it with popcorn popped in coconut oil and personally felt that it could use more of the buttery flavor and a lot less salt.

I thought this was the salt that Wabash puts in their popcorn packs that you can use in the Whirley-Pop. This salt you are advised to use only as a topping and it doesn't taste as good as the salt flavoring in the popcorn/oil/salt packs. So I used it as directed. I didn't really go crazy for the flavor. I have another salt I like better and it's the ACT II-Buttery Popcorn Salt, 3 lb. 4 oz. jug which when added to butter really tastes like the movies. Won't be buying this again.

The old product finally got rancid from age.  Folks used to rave about my popcorn, and the secret was the seasoning.  I tried some thing I bought at the local grocery and it is not good at all so I examined the container of the "old" stuff and found an web place and placed an order.  Seems like this new batch is not quite the same.  We will still use it and is far better than the POOR product I bought locally.  I'll try it out on company and see if anyone gets excited.In a few words . . .what were my expectations?  More butter flavor.  Lots of product to use here, and not super cheep so not sure I want to experiment.

column9: Tastes good but it doesn't stay powdery
column10: I really like the way this seasoning tastes but it wasn't very long until the seasoning began to combine together so it wasn't like fine salt but more like big clumps of seasoning so it doesn't sprinkle well.

The butter flavor of this topping is decent. But the salt is beyond reason. I shook a minimal amount on our first batch of popcorn and none of us could continue to eating past the first few bites. Now, I sprinkle maybe 3 shakes over an entire large bowl and then I end up with several really salty bites and a bunch of popcorn with no topping flavor at all on it. I might consider a low-salt version of this, but with the amount I have left of these bottles, it will probably take me 3 years to get through it. I'll probably end up throwing them away.

I love the taste of butter on popcorn, corn on the cob, vegetables, etc, but don't like to slather on the butter. This butter flavored salt gives a nice buttery flavor with some salt with no after taste or artificial taste.

We were gifted a jar of Whirly-Pop Theater Popcorn Spice in 2004 and became fans immediately. When we tried to replace it we were unable to find it anywhere in Washington State and proceeded to search the net for our favorite spice. We visited a store in Everett, Washington that carried the Wabash Valley Farms seasoning but they did not have Theater Spice. We finally found it at Amazon.com in a three-pack and have shared it with family and friends who are now converts. This is a great product, it reminds me of my weekend trips to the movie theater back in the 50's and 60's because it tastes the same. Word of Caution: DO NOT USE TO MUCH a little goes a long way. Hey... Its popcorn night tonight!

I love this seasoning!  I do not pop microwave popcorn.  Instead, I pop it myself on the stove top.  It lacks the buttery flavor that you get with movie theater popcorn.  This product adds that taste to my home made popcorn.  I just sprinkle it on when I am finished popping.  I also use their butter flavored oil.  Together my popcorn tastes fabulous.  When I get low, I simply order more. I have used Wasbash Valley Farms products for some time, and they have all been good, high quality popcorn products.
far too salty.  Save your money.  You might as well get a salt shaker and pour salt over your corn.
We highly recommend this product.  It is a great addition to freshly popped popcorn.

I looove walkerswood jerk sauce. I personally, love the heat of the hotter jar but bought this one for my family as they tender of tongue. It is less than the hot version but not enough to be called mild I dont think. Family agrees but the flavor is excellent. I buy this stuff in six packs.

column9: THIS IS SOME WEIRD LOOKING--YET...TASTY STUFF!!!
column10: APPEARANCE...WEIRD.  Honestly, it kinda puts you in the mind of 'regurgitated' food from an EXTREMELY large PELICAN!  I alllllmost didn't use it cause I thought it went bad or somethin'.SALTY AS HECK. GEESH. YOU COULD CURE A CORPSE IN THIS STUFF.  (SORRY but seriously)--However, I advise you to just take my word at this and JUST USE IT. DON'T taste it--- because you might change your mind and decide to throw it out because it taste like "salty regurgitated food from...yep you got it".If you're a 'sodium warden'...Immo be honest...just pass it by.And yes...like everyone probably knows on here....a little--goes a lonnnnnnng way.  If you use too much, well...don't say I didn't warn you.TASTE!!!  Delicious. Crackin' delicious.  There was no salty taste in the end product.  I marinated chicken for 2 days.  I got worried because I actually forgot about the chicken and we alllll know the last thing you wanna smell is "bad chicken".  Now that I think about it, the excess salt probably prevented that.Unfortunately, I burnt some of the chicken while grilling. Definitely grill--it gets the BEST taste, smoke + jerk..well it just belongs together.  The parts I could eat though---"FAN-BLESSING-TASTIC". Seriously. No salty taste what-so-ever.  And if you don't really like chicken thighs (I don't either)---jerking is what a chicken has thighs for.It's takes that funny, 'chicken thigh-ee', dark meat---errrr...taste out of it.I don't know how to explain it but chicken thigh meat taste...well...funny to me.  But hey--jerked thighs = jerked juicy tastiness.  NOW, that's C.H.I.C.K.E.N thighs...not REAL PEOPLE THIGHS people!  Yeeees, it may yield more meat but ughh...yeah...that's demented and you can go to jail for that.I will DEFINITELY THOUGH...get me some more and not burn it this time.  Tha' bomb!

I used Walkerswood Jamaican Mild Jerk seasoning to prepare jerk chicken wings for a party and it was a huge hit. I have tried to use other jerk seasoning but it was too hot.  I loved the flavor of this seasoning and it was spicy but not too spicy.  It was delicious.  I would recommend Walkerswood Jamaican Mild Jerk seasoning to anyone who does not want their chicken too spicy.

This Walkerswood Jamaican Jerk Seasoning was purchased as a favor for a bridal shower, to give out to guests as they were leaving.  It was a huge success!!  People were delighted to receive it, and the jar even looked quite pretty decorated with a green bow and set out in a straw basket.  Thank you Amazon and Walkerswood!!BTW, the Amazon suppliers were much more reliable than the actual store that had promised to send us some but sent them very late and after much complaining by us.  Amazon Rocks and Walkerswood Rules!!!

Amazing product! Nice, sutle, and aromatic blend of spices. You can also add small amounts of your "secret spices" without interrupting the natural jerk flavor. Best if marinated overnight, but not necessary.
What are you waiting for? It is a great seasoning and if you are reading this you are trying to find a good mild jerk seasoning. Just buy it already.

column9: Shipped wrong kind of grapefruit juice
column10: When I ordered this item, the caption clearly said Bluebird PINK Grapefruit Juice, which is what I wanted.  However, you shipped regular Bluebird Grapefruit Juice.Now I see that the caption for this item on Amazon.com has changed accordingly, so others will not be fooled.But, I should have been advised that you were going to do that, in which case I would have cancelled the order.

We have ordered the green papaya and it is very good.  I was leary about ordering a fruit item online, but it was delivered quickly and the packaging was great.  Follow the recommendations amazon suggests as far as shredding and soaking in salt water, then storing.  Ours lasted quite a long time by doing this.  Will definitely be ordering from here again when we are in the mood for Som Tom!

column9: Fresh fruit through Amazon? This is fantastic.
column10: I was skeptical about ordering a papaya through the mail, but both the packaging and quality were great. We'll be ordering again. Thanks.

column9: Sell the Fennel & Salt with Organic Fennel Pollen Separately
column10: Casina Rossa products are really excellent. Amazon needs to sell the products individually as well as in packs. The fennel salt that Amazon is selling separately is actually different than the one in this two pack. The one in the two pack is the bomb! I bought it separately at another store. The other fennel salt is very good too, but it's not a blend. Besides fennel, this one has black pepper, oregano, white pepper, laurel, grass pepper, curry, fennel pollen, thyme, juniper, pimento and mustard. It's amazing.paula

These are great and economical for convenience food.  While you won't mistake this for fare from a fine Indian restaurant this makes a nice change from cold cuts and instant soup.  This comes out of the microwave just fine and isn't overly complicated like some microwave meals.  It's also more filling than it looks.

I ordered what I wanted in the picture, a bamboo plant in the shape of a heart. Instead, I got a different bamboo plant. I settled for the plant because it was still a gift for someone else and I didn't want to go thru the extremities of packing it all back up and returning another perfectly good plant.

I used this cup for crab salad for a Ball.  They worked great.  They stayed crunchy and fresh tasting.  The shipping box was very impressive.  It had a little tube on it to show if the box had been mishandled.  We get that alot from the Post Office in Scottsville, KY.  I will purchase these cups again!
These would be absolutely fantastic if they weren't coated in huge chunks of sugar (ie the granulated stuff). Otherwise they're fine, even if they aren't as "super" sour as they claim.
I love these gummies! I can't eat anything that contains tapioca or corn products and these are the only gummies I've found that don't have either. The best part is that they taste really good!

These don't taste very good. I haven't found a person yet that likes them. They just taste bad, like old fruit. And the packaging is not frustration free! Often the glue runs and the bag is stuck within the box.

While this organic gummy bear isn't perfect, it isn't far off. For a once in a while snack, this is the one to choose. The gummy bears are minimally sour and more sugary than anything because of their coating. Their texture is very much like a traditional gummy bear but it is easy to tell that it tastes slightly different.

column9: Not super sour, but definitely super tasty
column10: Organic candy can be hit-or-miss, but these are a hit.  They're not as sour as some of the non-organic sour candy, but they've got a nice tartness to them.  And the texture is really good - a bit softer than your traditional Gummi Bear, but with a very crisp and fruity flavor.  My husband and I are grownups and we love them.

What a great product! I love my share of candy and I was a little timid trying this product but what a find. The little individual packs are a great snack for kids or adults. They taste so fresh you would think they were made yesterday. Another great way to get away from all the artificial grabage that is out there!!!!!

column9: Organic is good, but only for the kids!
column10: My son and his classmates love them!!!  We, however, think they are AWFUL!!!

column9: Definitely not like regular gummy bears
column10: The flavors are good, but the consistency is nothing like regular gummi bears.Overall I like them.

These greens are delish. And they are low calorie and chocked full of cancer fighting vitamins. I have had bad experiences with canned greens being bland and metallic tasting. But when I saw that it was an "Allen's" product ( I love their Italian Green Beans.) I decided to give it a try. Perfect easy side dish to baked chicken. Add a few tomato slices and viola, dinner is served.
This is as good canned kale as I have had.  Just the right touch of seasoning.  Sprinkled with a bit of parmesan and it is a perfect no meat lunch.

I made 3 lbs of this so far. I made both jerky strips and jerky sticks using my Nesco jerky gun kit. I have been making all different kinds of jerky so far and this is an instant favorite! I couldn't really tell the sweet part of it, but it does have a nice spicy hint to it. This is a very tasty jerky, very hard to stop eating too.

I have tried a few of the High Mountain jerky seasonings and this was one of my least favorites.  It didn't taste sweet and spicy.  For some reason it just didn't have enough taste.  I followed the instructions on the amount of seasoning and cure to add for lbs of ground beef.  I may have to add more of the seasonings than what the instructions stated, but I'll just stick with High Mountain's original as that is the best.

column9: To Dill or not to Dill?
column10: I recommend you Dill. This product is strong and has good favor. I highly recommend on fish, when making tartar sauce or when making a Dill dip for vegetables.Very good product.

My husband loves this stuff!  It is hard to find, so I turned to Amazon and there it was!!  Although the latest shipment of 6 jars came with 2 that had broken open and made a huge mess---yuck!!  So, we only got four useable jars.  :(
This sauce/spread is one of (if not THE) best spicy brands out there.  I first discovered it in a Vietnamese restaurant.  Just plain awesome.

I'm on a low sodium diet so I add this to everything I eat.  Huy Fong makes a similar sauce without the garlic and it's a lot hotter and less flavorful.  Before you buy this pack of 6, go to an Asian store and buy one jar and try it out.  Then order the 6 pack.-------------------------Three years later and I'm ordering my third multi-pack.  My brother cooks for us and some of our neighbors and he adds this stuff to much of his cooking.  He said he uses a tablespoonful a day.  If someone does a really good job for us, we reward them with a jar of this sauce.But I caution to compare prices here at Amazon.  I'm ordering a 12 pack today for $3 a jar.
Great for chili, pizza, Chinese food, etc. The flavor is bold and much better than vinegary/watery hot sauces like Tabasco.

column9: Chili Garlic Sauce goes with Everything!
column10: This product is consistently delicious.  It is not for the faint of heart--probably one of the hottest condiments that is not technically a hot sauce.  It really is a great accompaniment for pizza, eggs, toss with veggies for a spicy influence, mix with marinades etc. It is a very versatile product.
I use this in marinades that I prepare for the BBQ.  I like the heat in that allows you to taste your food and enjoy the spiciness of some heat.

column9: Great Flavor and Heat - Highly Recommended
column10: Huy Fong "Sriracha Hot Chili Sauce" is offered in just about every Chinese and Vietnamese restaurant in my area, and with good reason! Unlike at lot of hot sauces, this has a great chili pepper and garlic flavor that compliments most of the dishes I like (particularly good on Pork Lo-Mein) and also provides a good amount of spicy heat. This is not the hottest of the hot sauces but it is on the borderline for several of my friend.This is really good stuff and we almost always keep a bottle of it on hand to liven up or cooking or when take-out doesn't have enough "zing". It is also great to spread on chicken when grilling but watch the smoke when opening the grill lid, it is like OC spray if it gets into your eyes.Highly Recommended!CFH
This sauce is awesome on everything I've tried it with -- pizza, pasta, soup, rice, bread, etc. This is the fastest I've ever gone through a jar of hot sauce, and I'll be ordering this frequently.
2 of the chilli bottles broke in the packaging box and spilled everywhere.  I cannot even use these since the seals are broken on both.  Can I get a refund or at least 2 new chilli bottles?

First off--best hot sauce ever.  Almost every food I eat now has this sauce on it.But don't buy it here.  I know this six pack looks tempting but...the local oriental market has 18 ounce bottles for 3.39...adding up to around 20 bucks for a 6 pack.  If you don't have any sort of local oriental market and none of the grocery stores carry it, it's still totally worth paying almost twice as much as it's retail value just to experience the stuff.

column9: Great kick without swamping the other flavors
column10: I just ordered my third 6-pack. Found this item a few years ago at the local Vietnamese food store. I enjoy spicy food but do not want to kill the flavor of the underlying dish. This is a great add to meatloaf, rice, sandwiches and many other foods. Adding it to some soy sauce makes it terrific for pork fried rice or for a topping to salmon. There are many creative uses. It can pack a punch if used too heavily. I find it much more interesting and flavorful than the basic Sriracha Sauce produced by Huy Fong.Buy a small bottle and give it a try. You will be back for more..

Salada Asian Plum White tea is a light tasting tea with just a hint of plum flavoring in each sip. Some people, like Dr. Oz, claim that white tea has more beneficial qualities than the more popular green tea. Try it. I think you'll like it.

Heinz makes the best mustard time and time again. Golden or spicy, it makes no difference. These packets were received on time and with great anticipation. We were not let down. And, by the way, the mustard tasted "spot on."

column9: Such a nice change and a legit everyday oli option
column10: Probably like you, we use olive oil at least every second day - so its an important part of my cooking regime.  The Village Press oil has a very fresh taste about it.  It just tastes more pure, cleaner, healthier and somehow - lighter.  Its a beautiful oil that cuts out having another big glass or oxidizing metal around and the tap works surprisingly good.  It would be five start except I havent figured out if the bad is recyclable.  If it is I will come back and change this to 5 stars.  I like that it is cardboard (light blocking is key) and that the cardboard is recyclable.  So if I can recycle the bag too, then its quite an exceptional all around product.  Back to the point!  The oil is really legit.

column9: This is a beautiful Olive Oil - very versatile
column10: I have recently tried this Olive Oil with a few of my favorite recipes and the usual daily cooking tasks. It was my first experience with New Zealand olive oil and wow....is it yummy! So light and fruity! You definitely want to use a light and fruity extra virgin olive oil in deserts, but I also recently used it in an Olive Oil & Garlic Pasta and it was exceptional.  For things like Salads (Vinaigrette in particular) this is a beautiful oil, but don't stop there!  I have been using it on everything and it really shines!

These mixed greens are my favorite.  They are flavorful with no side meat to add grease and calories.  Buying by the case saves me .60 per can.  I'm so glad Amazon is carrying the Sylvia's brand.  I've enjoyed all of their products that I've tried.  You can't beat just opening a can and having home cooked greens.

When I discovered Sylvia's greens, I brought a memory of my childhood back into my life.  My grandmother cooked greens with this same type of seasoning and I've missed that these many years into my adulthood.  I don't have the time nor inclination to work through trying different seasonings to develop the taste in these greens.  But thank goodness Sylvia's has!  These greens are just delicious and since I've gone on a grain free diet, fit in perfectly with my lifestyle of new eating.  But even if I was still eating with grains I'd order this product over and over just as I've been doing for the past year or so.  You won't go wrong with this product.  It's full of flavor.  Even my Mom and Dad love it when I send packs to them.  Mom says they taste just the way my Grandmother made them and as far as we're concerned that's the highest praise we can give!

Walmart, Giant and Safeway for some reason do not sell this product anymore.  This onion powder adds an extra flavor to food because it contains other herbs and spices.  After researching the internet, I found that the product was cheaper on Amazon.com although you had to buy a pack of 12.  I am very please with my purchase.
the local grocery stores stopped carrying onion plus.  Been searcing 4 it everywhere w/ no luck.  I am so glad i was able to find it here on amazon.
Sodium free, the California Style line of spices is a healthy alternative for tasty meals.
We use California Style Onion Powder on almost everything we cook.  What other seasoning can you say this about other than salt and pepper?  It makes meat and vegetables taste better.

I moved from the East Coast to the West Coast and friends of mine sent me these for Christmas.  They were fantastic!  Serving size was perfect for the richness of the dish.  Wonderful flavor and the the lobster was so sweet. Thanks Chris & Scott!
FANTASTIC is the only word to describe these Pot Pies!!!!  Everything I remembered and then some...  GREAT PRODUCT AND SERVICE!!!.....a MUST TRY!!!!

I love these assorted chocolates. Sadly it is not available in the States. It is nice to find it on amazon.com.I especially love the strawberry/orange "paste" chocolate covered ones.EDITED: I wish I can go and edit the seller feedback but so far it seems that this is not possible. I really love these chocolates and I think that the problem is not from the manufacturer but from the seller. The box arrived very perfumey -strangely- and that affected the quality of the chocolate because the chocolates also started to taste like perfume. :( If you could find a different seller then that would be great :)

column9: High in protein, poor in taste
column10: Kinda wish that liver thing was a thing of the past - never have had a cat that would eat the stuff but thought I'd try this since he likes all the other grilled varieties.  Honestly, the guy spit this stuff out on the floor!  Gave me a nasty look too and yelled until I changed his food.  Golly!  On the plus side, these varieties provide a bunch of protein and overall good nutrition for your cat, just buy their regular favorites with a different one thrown in for good measure.  Maybe you too can be cleaning off dried beef and liver from your drywall...:) Recommend but for the nutritional content and not the flavor, per my cat's request!

My cat loves the Fancy Feast grilled style.  Her favorite flavors vary, but she always prefers grilled.  (I accidentally bought chopped style once, and she wouldn't touch it.) Anyway, she is a nibbler, so she eats just a tiny bit at a time, and the grilled stays moist for hours. I'm not sure it makes a difference to her, but it looks better to me than old dried crusty food, ha!

Dil's Royal Tea is certainly not fit for royalty. Seriously, this stuff is rank...it truly rots! When I placed the order, I was somewhat hesitant, given that it was not yet rated. But, then I thought, "It's English tea...how bad can it possibly be?" As it turned out, this was faulty logic, indeed.  After brewing for the prescribed time, the resulting liquid neither smelled nor tasted like tea, or raspberries, for that matter. It had a sickly sweet and decidedly chemical aftertaste. Needless to say, I would never purchase another product from this supplier. "Caveat Emptor!"

I bought a sample of this product at a super market, but was unable to obtain this brand at any of my local stores.  I really like the taste and make my own drinks in the blender with ice, cappuccino mix and milk.. Yummy

I really like this coffee over ice, it's a bit of work but worth it. I once tried it frozen but it is much better poured over ice. I bought this for myself as retail therapy and I'm satisfied with it. I wish the chocolate flavor came through a bit more but it's better than not tasting it at all (like at Starbucks when the drink is so bitter). Mochas are my drink of choice and I'm glad I tried this brand. The price was right as well.
This is a really good mix--why aren't you handling it anymore? Actually, I can't believe how quickly we used this whole box--I have a very fussy food and drink family!

We came across these on a trip to Hawaii that a friend had asked us to get, and found that these were fantastic. So had to get some more and this was a great way to pickup without traveling back to Hawaii!!!!

For me,this is the best tasting Macadamia nut by Mauna Loa.I can't see any reason why they are so hard to find in the Bay Area.Target and Walmart used to carry them about 5 years ago,but since these tins are pricey,they mostly carry the chocolate covered or garlic flavors,if they even carry them .Still,this is one of life's guilty pleasures,and I don't mind indulging myself once in a while But if these tins get any more expensive (currently these go for an average of $6.62 a tin though Amazon's sellers,a far cry from when I used to pay for them,$4.50 ),I'm prepared to give this up and go for my other perfect substitutes--Planter's Cashew Nuts or Walker's Shortbread Cookies,or See's Toffeetes. So Mauna Loa,this is a heads up to start making this more affordable.

I am always looking for a good tasting low calorie drink or drink mix. I used to only drink crystal light but when I discovered the Sugar Free Hawaiian Punch mixes this is my new favorite.  I enjoy all of the flavors and this lemon berry is one of my favorite. I don't like plain water so I use this mixes in my water.  I really like the flavor and I would consider this a good low-calorie alternative drink mix.

column9: The best cake you'll ever eat
column10: I have ordered Caroline's Cakes for years.  Everytime I do everyone says its the best cake they have ever eaten.  I wish I could get her recipe!!!!I send them as gifts too and they always arrive frozen fresh and very well packaged.  Always on time.
The mix tasted terrible, no matter how much tequila and lime juice used. Yo are better off to purchase the liquid mix. I will not purchase again & do not recommend.
Easy to use, taste great, highly recommend for the use of a quick drink. Can add other liqueurs to make different drinks.
I bought this so I could bring a lightweight coctail for backpacking. Better than I expected since it is a powder!

column9: Put an irresistible clear crust on your burgers
column10: My son-in-law, who is a superb cook, went back to the kitchen and cooked burgers in the oven.  When he served them, I kept looking out to see if  the grill on the porch had been uncovered. I couldn't understand how he had that authentic Texas smoky taste in the oven.  I wondered how he flavored the burgers to get that taste of tomatoes, mustard, pepper, and vineagar just right.  There was a hint of molasses too.  The burgers were big, beautiful, and juicy.He pulled out the Char Crust box.  I was amazed that something this delicious could have come from a box.

Love Douwe Egberts Decaf coffee, however two attempts to get the decaf product were unsuccessful.  Each time they shipped the regular coffee and I had to call them and get it corrected.  Finally gave up and asked them to simply credit my account.  I guess I will try again on a later date.

PLEASE BE ADVISED, this coffee is NOT decaffeinated.  I used it and got violently ill b/c I am sensitive to caffeine.  Any where else it would be considered false advertising.  I am very disappointed with Amazon in having such shoddy oversight over how and what is advertised on their site.  To add insult to injury, the coffee is horrible.

column9: Great price but not great tasting
column10: I should know better than to buy pre-ground coffee any more but this was such an excellent price for decaf that I decided to give it a shot. This coffee was very acidic and harsh tasting but if mixed with half fresh ground beans it's a bit more palatable.Packaging was good (arrived in secure, individual foil bags).Will definitely never purchase this again though.

My 10 month old took one bite made a face and refused the rest. She eats anything. I tried it and so did my husband. It tasted like potting soil and has a very bitter after taste. I feel like some of the veggies are not cooked long enough and thats why its bitter.

My 1 year old will eat anything...well that was until I gave him Happybaby Gobble Gobble. Immediately when I opened the package I was turned off by it. It looked and smelled awful...this does not look like tastey baby food at all. Against my better judgement, I still let my son try it. The first bite he choked and gagged. I thought, "ok, it's just too thick". So I thinned it out with a bit of formula and tried again. Second bite he spit it out and tried to scrape off what was left on his tongue with his fingers! My son is NOT a picky eater by any means and loves food in general, so I knew this MUST be awful if he wouldn't eat it. Rather than torture my kid, I threw the rest out. Thankfully I had only purchased two pouches at the store before commiting to a pack of 16 on Amazon. If only I had read the reviews first!Bottom line, don't torture your kid with this OR waste your money!

My baby is a wonderful eater and has loved all of the variety I've given him until this food. He tried it and vomited instantly. I tried the next day and just let him smell it and he vomited again - lol. I tried it too and it was not tasty to me at all. I had two of these packs left so I waited a couple of weeks to try again. He liked it that time. Anyway, don't give up and keep trying because they just may like it after a few tries (or even 15 tries). It's a healthy meal.

Agree with the reviewers who pointed out this is too watery, acidic, and tomatoe-y. It doesn't taste like beef at all. It's a little sweet from the tomato, not in a good way. I think it's a problem with all Happy Baby foods I've tried--they are all sweet, maybe to appeal to baby's tastes. This works well for the fruits and veggies, but not so much for the meat and chicken. I want my baby to eat savory food too! The texture was not appealing--very mushy with some quinoa globs. Again, where's the meat? I guess I'll stick with the fruit pouches, and make my own baby meats, which my girl loves.
We love happybaby products, our twins like most of them.  Unfortantely this is nothing like the others.  Very dry, paste like.  Babies refused to eat it.

column9: My baby and my cat won't eat this!
column10: We had ordered some of these pouches after trying some other Happy Baby products that my baby loved. These had very little flavor and my baby tried a couple bites and then started to fight me. She even gagged in the process. Bummed that I had ordered a whole box, we tried again to no avail. Next, we  tried to feed it to the cat because she seemed interested when I opened the pouches. My cat won't even eat it. I recommend getting a small quantity to see if your baby likes it before ordering a whole box.

column9: Wonderful Beef Stew by Happy Family
column10: This Beef Stew is fantastic!  It actually tastes like beef stew, no artificial flavorings or colors.  Everything in it is organic and there is quinoa too.  Babies need to be able to taste what real food tastes like.  This product delivers!  All of the other baby beef stews taste like a mystery and loaded with extra "stuff" that babies do not need.  It has great portable packaging for moms on the go.  Great price too!

One of the things I just love about HAPPYBABY organic baby food is the unique combination of ingredients they offer.  I mean, how many companies utilize quinoa as the primary grain in their baby food?  I love that HAPPYBABY thinks outside the box to come up with an innovative mix of super healthy foods for our babies.  The bananas, black beans and rice work well together, both in taste and texture, and I know this is one meal my baby will gobble down every time.  Did I mention how much I love the portability of these pouches?!  I only wish they had been around when my older daughter was a baby!

column9: dried texture and crappy blend for baby food
column10: I have tried many different flavors from many different brands and by far, this particular flavor from Happy Baby is the worst texture and taste that I ever bought for my baby.  My baby just doesn't like it.  I let her try it three times and she just hates the texture and the taste.  I don't why they made the food so dry to begin with.  Turkey itself gives a little dried texture compared to chicken and they should have taken that into consideration.  And the food is so lumpy and it's not even in good chunky blend either.  In the end it was a total waste of money to buy this product.

The ingredients are just great that's why I ordered it but when I opened the pouch and tasted... I know it's very healthy but this meal is not eatable.  I have ended up adding few spoons to meals I cook or just other baby food but this is it.

Love this product!  Our daughter couldn't have soy or dairy so we really struggled to find food she could eat, not to mention organic food that fit that profile.  Loved this product, highly recommended!

Fish has that all important DHA that helps brain and eye development so I went looking for a baby food with fish. I was so excited to find WILD CAUGHT salmon in a baby food (wild caught salmon does not have the mercury content other fish have)! Plus it has other super foods such as lentils, sweet potatoes, and carrots! But all this goodness is only good if baby will eat it and she gobbled it right up!!

column9: I think it tastes great, but my daughter will have nothing to do with it
column10: We bought a 16 pack and have 13 left.  Of the 3 that we tried, she never once finished a single pouch.  I tried it and was really surprised because it is well seasoned with herbs and spices compared to other things she will eat.  It could be the texture - I don't know.  It's a little mushy, like baby food.  Probably would be better with pasta instead of amaranth, although I appreciate the diversity of grains.  Anyway, I love it, she hates it, so 3 stars.

This has been my baby's (now 21 months) favorite since he was 10 months old. He seemed to be bored of it after a couple of months. My husband then was going to claim the rest of pouches as his snacks and started to have it with an Avocado, my son reached for it. So now, we mashed, somewhat, an avocado in the Ratatouille and he would inhale it down in no time! It's also a go-to meal when we are having spicy grown-up food and I'm too lazy to cook him up something else. It also helps him "go" regularly.

column9: Try Before You Buy in Bulk
column10: My son is not a picky eater, but he really doesn't like this flavor.  I love the HappyBaby brand in general and so does my son, who is 11 months old.  I'm not saying this is a bad product, but I definitely would not buy it in bulk before you let your child try it.  You are much safer doing that with the fruit/veggie mixes.  Try before you buy seems like common sense.  However, the only store that carries this brand locally for me (Target) has a very limited selection so I couldn't let my son try this flavor before I bought it.  I imagine that is the same for other people shopping on-line.  I thought I could mix it with something else if he didn't care for it, but he will have nothing to do with it, mixed or otherwise.  I have to say that I agree with another review that says it looks & smells like cat food.  I try all of the food I feed my son and thought this product was bland, bordering on bad tasting.  I give it 3 stars, because I think this product is definitely not for everyone, and more of an acquired taste.  I highly recommend HappyBaby though!

My daughter loved this because it was chunkier than the Earth's Best stage 3 foods.  The only thing is that while Earth's Best is cheaper through Amazon Mom, this is actually cheaper through Fresh Direct, so we get our through them.

My daughter is not very picky, and would usually eat anything. I got her to eat about half a pouch the first time I introduced them to her, but it was a losing battle after that. They don't smell pleasant nor do they look appetizing. I really wanted to like these too, because they looked to be quite healthy.

Baby loves this.  She is 14 months old and I scoop it into her bowl and she feeds herself.  I love that it is salmon, which I don't buy for the family, so she is eating healthier than we do! It would be nice it this food were a little easier removed from the package to ensure getting every ounce of goodness, but still love the pouches better than other packages for travel and storing ease.  My older children are always asking to have some of the baby's food.

My baby does not like this kind. I do not like it either, it tastes fishy. Salmon is good for baby brain development. I tried to put butter or some seasoning to cover the fishy taste, but my son still does not want to eat it. He like other happy baby product like spinah, mango and pear, blue berries, banana and beet and broccoli, pear and peas. This one needs seasoning or I will not eat it either.

My baby loves this salmon combination a lot more than the popular chick chick (which is actually her least favorite). Yes, it does stink... its fish! I don't care for fish myself, smell or taste, but she digs this and its good for her. This brand has a much lower sodium content than plum and sprout and is cheaper on a different website. I make most all of her other foods but am not quite ready to tackle preparing meat so Happy Baby has been great for introducing chicken, fish, beef, and turkey.
This is great!  It smells great!  I love all of the vegetables in it.  Texture is not chunky and is eaten very well by my triplets, even the one with just 4 teeth.
This food is great!  My triplets love it.  I thought it tasted great too!  If I need to go on puree food I want this.
My son loves chick chick. This is the only baby food he will still eat. It is a little messy to open sometimes, but not a big deal.

My 18 month old likes them, but he will eat pretty much antying. My pediatrician suggested increasing my 3 year old's protein. I saw these online and saw they have a ton of protien.They arrived in the mail right away, and my 3 year old is not a big fan. She loves the Plumb brand fruit and veggie pouches and likes to suck them straight from the pouch. It is not very easy to suck it straight out of these pouches. I have been able to cut a small spot on the corner to make it work, but putting it in a bowl and using a spoon made it loose much of the thrill.My 18 month old likes them, but I'm not sure I'll get my older one on the band wagon.

My son loves this food.  He is 16 months now and I still use them.  Not all the time, but often.  The reason is that his molars are coming in very quickly and he is in a lot of pain.  He won't eat much when he's in pain, but these are easy on his gums.  They are organic and a quick meal.  My son is strong and a very healthy weight.  I make sure he gets as much organic, wholesome food as possible.  Buying these subscribe and save is a great way to give him good food and still save money.  He loves the whole line.

column9: Baby loved this on the first try!!!
column10: We tried this for the first time while on vacation this month(risky, I know...) and to our surprise our happy baby(13 mths) loved it! No problems, smelled delicious and gobbled it all up!  Definate must try! Signed up for regularly delivery!

I love the happy baby and similar brands of organic baby food in pouches, but they have one MAJOR downfall in my eyes- most of the blends are SUPER SWEET. It's difficult to find many pouches with just vegetables, and no super sweet fruits mixed in. I hate the idea of teaching my child that everything MUST taste sweet (spinach, broccoli, peas, etc- they're always mixed with mango, pear, apple, etc- they always just taste like fruit.) I LOVE that he Amaranth Ratatouilli is not sweet at all- it actually tastes like vegetables!! My child loves it. We frequently mix it into other things- pasta, rice, etc. It's great topped with cheese. One bit of warning though- this blend seems pretty acidic, so babies with sensative tummies might have trouble- I would just mix it in smaller portions with pasta or something else.

Mama Grain and Amaranth Ratatouille from Happy Baby have been long-time favorites since my son was about 10 months old. Even now he is a toddler, he still eats Mama Grain on occasion - it's good to take with us if we're eating out and he's being picky about what's available. It's thick and filling enough to supplement his meal. It has a sweetness from the bananas, obviously, but the black beans and the quinoa grain also help making it more lasting. So full of goodness! I agree the taste seems a little weird at first to us adults, but I actually like that's a different flavor - help to keep his taste buds open to different tastes, hopefully...

The Happy Baby Chick Chick is delicious and my baby loves it.  It's a hearty puree, not so runny.  It's got little pea sized pieces of chicken and pasta in it which she loves to gum on.  It smells good and tastes good.  I like that it's organic and wholesome.

I purchased the Turkey pouches because my 8 month old loved the Chick Chick.  This is nothing like the Chick Chick.  This looks like a dry paste and it smells bad too.  Currently I'm mixing them with a jar of the Earth's Best Organics 2oz veggie jar in order to give it some texture other than cat food.  This is absolutely nothing like the Chick Chick with is a hearty puree with actual pieces of chicken and pasta.  I would not recommend it.

This is the only way I can get my daughter to eat fish.  I often add extra coconut oil and cinnamon to improve the taste though.  She didn't like it the first time, but after a few attempts she enjoys it.  She screams when I try to feed her any other brand of salmon, and so I think this one is worth a try.  If they don't like it, just mix it with something they do like. Great ingredients, great product.

Cons:1. Neither of my children liked the taste. They loved Earth's Best, even the vegetables.2. It is not as convenient as the Earth's Best when travelling since you have to carry a spare container to serve this.Pros:1. BPA free packaging2. Organic and preservative free.The lining of the lids in Earth's Best is reported to contain BPA. My search for quality baby food continues...

My daughter did not like this flavor, she will eat it with a little bit of vegetable or fruit puree every other bite.  It is a bit of a struggle, and honestly it is a strong fishy smell coming out of the package.  This is also a chunkier and drier pouch compared to the other flavors.

My daughter likes these foods, but is not as keen on this flavor.  I think it is the the texture, this flavor is a little drier and more crumbly than the other flavors.  However, if I am not worried about the mess it almost makes a decent finger food for her.

I got this food for my little one in all the flavors.  I have to say the chicken is her favorite.  The pouch is great for traveling, and is a good portion size.  The consistency is a little chunky, just right for mine with 4 teeth.  One pouch and some finger foods is perfect for her.
I'm sure this Mama Grain is pretty healthy but it taste disgusting. Even my daughter who is not a picky eater refuse to eat this. The combination of sweet banana and beans doesn't go well at all.

So fishy that our cat is all over this the moment I cut the packaging open.  The smell is very strong.  My baby did not take to it.  It is our cat's food now.Their other products are much better, but this one is way too fishy.  It doesn't smell pleasant when you go out to a friend's house or restaurant.  If I just wipe the spoon and bowl without washing after feeding this and put it back in the backpack, after I get home the whole thing reeks.

I was so hoping she would like this because it is so healthy and would be easy to take camping and out to dinner...but she wouldn't eat any of it and kept spitting it out. I gave it to the dogs and they loved it and I am sure it is healthy for them!
This is seriously the ONLY food we have purchased that my baby rejected EVER.  She has eaten everything we've given her.  Poor thing gagged and gagged every spoon I tried...

My son is a little foodie and at 10 months has REFUSED to eat anything other then home made food. Lately I had started to become overwhelemed because I was coolong 3 different meals and I was worried that I wasn't making my son balanced meals. Insert Happybaby Super Salmon. Oh my god, he LOVES it! He eats the entire package. Some reviewers complained about the smell and yeah it smells kind of gross but it is FISH and fish isnt known for having the best odor. I would definetly recommend.

column9: I wish my toddler liked it
column10: I really wish my toddler liked this. It seems to be very high quality and it would provide more variety in his diet. Every so often he'll eat it, but it usually needs to be mixed with something else.  I think it tastes fine, but it wasn't a hit. I bought a case so I keep trying.
I (and my little guy) have loved almost all other happy baby products, but this was revolting.  On the up side, my dog loves it . . .
I wanted this for the omega 3's but my daughter wouldn't eat this.  It really smells and looks like cat food.

My son loves this food.  He is 16 months now and I still use them.  Not all the time, but often.  The reason is that his molars are coming in very quickly and he is in a lot of pain.  He won't eat much when he's in pain, but these are easy on his gums.  They are organic and a quick meal.  My son is strong and a very healthy weight.  I make sure he gets as much organic, wholesome food as possible.  Buying these subscribe and save is a great way to give him good food and still save money.  He loves the whole line.

My son loves this food.  He is 16 months now and I still use them.  Not all the time, but often.  The reason is that his molars are coming in very quickly and he is in a lot of pain.  He won't eat much when he's in pain, but these are easy on his gums.  They are organic and a quick meal.  My son is strong and a very healthy weight.  I make sure he gets as much organic, wholesome food as possible.  Buying these subscribe and save is a great way to give him good food and still save money.  He loves the whole line.

This is a really good product but not a great price.  Shop-rite's normal price is the same as the subscribe and save price.  They however have it on special offer so it is cheaper still, yet you don't have to buy 16 at once.

I was worried about it before I served it to my 12 month old... but after a tentative first session (there is a pretty strong salmon smell, and he seems opposed to strong scents), he's since eaten this package w/o problem, and finishes it every time!  We're pretty pleased with this meal - great texture and I feel good that he's getting some salmon in his diet.  We had one instance of diarrhea after eating this for lunch, but since it only happened once, I'm not 100% sure that it was because of the salmon package, but definitely I keep an eye for now.  It might have been one bad package in the stack... so it's still probably advisable to not serve this if you're going to be away from home :).

column9: Healthy, maybe. Smells/looks like cat food
column10: I really like the Happy Baby "Chick Chick" pouches and thought this would be a great way to introduce seafood to our baby. However, the consistency is much different - much thicker than the chicken pouch, and the smell! Well you definitely know it's seafood! It reminds me much too much of cat food.All is not lost - our little guy would eat it, provided I dunked each bite in some pureed sweet potato or squash first. But, I don't think we'll be buying this flavor again.

column9: I wish my kid liked this
column10: we tried some other organic baby foods lately and she loved them but unfortunately she hates HATES HATES this food.  She's never had such a reaction to any food before but actually cried and screamed at the first taste of this.  I guess it's just not for her.  We've given her other foods from happy baby and she's loved them but this one she will not eat.  Too bad I bought a huge package!
This baby food is both convenient and healthy. it's great to not worry about what my son is eating and be able to grab this when I'm in a pinch!
my super picky baby loves this. it taste good.packaging are so convenient too. when she wont eat anything else i always resort to this.

This is great baby food.  It has an interesting texture that our baby likes in her mouth, and she loves the taste.  I love that she gets protein that is more than puree, but not so thick she can choke.

My baby and I both loved the stage 1 Happy Baby pouches that we tried, so I had high hopes for this as well. To my dismay, it smelled like cat food and was gritty. I expected there to be more morsels of food,  but this was just mush. My son took a few bites and refused to eat any more.

column9: Natural fish oil for your baby. Stinky!
column10: I have to give it to the makers of this line of organic baby food. This stuff is obviously high quality. It smells very fishy even though salmon is not one of the first listed ingredients. Again I was surprised but my little guy wolfed it down repeatedly. I was happy to find an organic fish food for my baby. Thumbs up.

My baby loves Happy Baby's Chick Chick meal, so we tried the salmon. It is the first food that my 11 month old has ever spit back at me. I tried to feed him this four different days to see if he would get used to it, or change his mind. No luck. It's too bad that you can only purchase them in lots of 16.... lots of leftover salmon here.
My baby like this very much.I think the salmon is delicious,the salmon is good food,it can make my baby happy.

column9: My 18 month old liked it, my 3 year old did not.
column10: My pediatrician suggested increasing my 3 year old's protein, and try upping the fish. I saw these online and saw they have a ton of protien, and were salmon.They arrived in the mail right away, and my 3 year old is not a big fan. She loves the Plumb brand fruit and veggie pouches and likes to suck them straight from the pouch. It is not very easy to suck it straight out of these pouches. I have been able to cut a small spot on the corner to make it work, but putting it in a bowl and using a spoon made it loose much of the thrill.My 18 month old likes them, but I'm not sure I'll get my older one on the band wagon.

Okay, it does smell kind of like cat food. But it is packaged fish, which I think is what cat food is, so I guess that's not a huge surprise. My daughter really likes it, and I like that it's good for her, so overall we give this our seal of approval.

column9: I'd rather make this combination myself
column10: I believe the concept and the intended combination of ingredients is nutritious and may be delicious BUT not in this little package.  My 11 month old daughter took one bite and literally spit it out.  I tasted it and it was so lacking flavor.  I'll be making this combination for her on my own in our Beaba BabyCook.  The other fruit and veggie combinations are great, but this offering missed the mark completely.

column9: def more like cat food - baby did not like at all
column10: I don't see how there can be good quality salmon in this or lentils.....it is mostly potato and pollack (substitute cheap fish) --- this is really terrible for organic baby food - ugh, if i only had a cat to feed it to....
These pouches are the next best to homemade.  When I don't have time to steam and blend my own baby food, I always reach for happy baby!

column9: Smells and looks like cat food
column10: I purchased two boxes of this because previously I had purchased Happy Baby Chick Chick and my daughter loved it.  When I opened this pouch up I couldn't believe the smell and texture of the "food".  It smells just like cat food because it's fish.  And the texture is just like canned cat food.  I have two boxes of this that I can't use because my daughter gags as soon as I bring the spoon up to her mouth.  I don't blame her, I'm gagging as soon as I tear the package open.  The nutritional facts are outstanding but they need to make it taste and look better.  The Happy Baby Chick Chick is an actual hearty puree with pieces of chicken and pasta.  This is not even close.

column9: Didn't sit well with my baby
column10: I got a few different flavors of the HAPPYBABY food and this one in particular causes my daughter to gag and vomit. My daughter does not have a weak stomach by any means and eats a lot of different foods. But for whatever reason when she eats this flavor it comes right back out. After the third try I am giving up and concluding there is something wrong with this item.Even more disappointed that there is no option to return it with Amazon. I did however reach out to HAPPYBABY directly and are working with them to make this purchase a positive experience. For that I have changed my review from 1 stars to 3 stars.For now I will stick with the Chick Chick and Gobble Gobble flavors!
I ordered this one and the salmon but I got two salmon instead. I bet this one would be good if I ever got it.
Please do not send the salmon as baby will no eat it, please send the chicken on Happybaby Organic Baby Food. I am to received this once a month.Marlene layman

My son wouldn't eat it either! I tasted it... I would not eat it, also. Tasteless, unappetizing in texture and  flavor.It says "minimal processing"... does that mean it is not even cooked? No wonder our babies and toddlers hate it!!! I would NEVER knowingly feed my child or myself RAW meat.

I generally make all of LO's food organic from scratch (yes, I work full-time, but this is important to me, so I make the time).  However, I've tried a few pre-packaged foods...and while LO loves the taste of Chick Chick, and I like that it is more well-rounded than most others, I absolutely hate this packaging.  If my little one decides he doesn't want to finish the package after three bites, the rest is total waste...or I have to scoop it into a different container to store until he's ready to finish.Absolutely love the item, but hate the packaging.

column9: WARNING RECIPE CHANGED AS OF FEBRUARY 2012
column10: My daughter absolutely used to love the original version of the Chick Chick baby food (with Chicken, Sweet Potatoes, and Brown Rice). Unfortunately, the recipe has apparently just been updated (though not reflected on Amazon's page as of 2/24/2012) to include totally different ingredients (except for the chicken). Now my daughter absolutely refuses to eat this product. The consistency and flavor seem to have drastically changed. Hopefully your child will enjoy the new blend, but I wanted to provide a warning for those of you that may have tried the other version...

I give props to any mom, especially one that holds down a full time job or two, that can puree and strain her own food.  If that's you, hat's off.  You're my hero.  I'm no superhero, so my goal was to find the best quality, best tasting food with minimal processing.  Let's face it, there are plenty of organic options out there.  And these days, I think most of them are good.  The little man likes the Gerber organics fruits.  They're easy to find and inexpensive.  But hands down, the Happy Baby products are the best quality, best tasting (in my opinion) and most convenient of them all.  The pouches are great, especially for when we're on the go.  We can eat the fruit varieties without even putting on a bib.  The Chick Chick is the man's favorite (bib required).  The negative is that they're about twice the price of the Gerber fruits and meats.  So if you're on a budget, this may be a bit of a stretch.  Nonetheless, keep some pouches around for when you travel.  Baby will love them!

column9: L O V E Chick Chick
column10: I make a lot of my own baby food, but was not about to make a meat baby food. After buying a few different purees, I tried Chick Chick.  My fussy 9 month old LOVED it instantly. I don't know if it is the flavor or the texture (nice with some small bits in it), but she gobbles it down.  It is worth the price (especially if you do subscribe and save) and I am pleased that she is getting a high quality protein meal and I don't have to puree chicken!

I have 12 month olds and no time to write a great review, but they like all the flavors, the textures are great, and the pouches open easily. They don't reseal, but that's fine because there are never leftovers.

column9: Does NOT promote healthy growth and development
column10: I was hoping that the new recipe would include more protein/fat than the original, since in my opinion, the protein/essential fatty acids that are abundant in salmon are the best reasons to feed it to a baby.  Well, I should have taken the time to research the nutritional info before purchasing, because this item actually contains less of both. If you can manage to get your baby to eat an entire pouch of this, he/she will get a mere 1 gram of protein, or 6% of the RDA for a baby, .5 grams of fat, and 50 calories.That makes this a nutrient poor food.  And HappyBaby a pretty despicable company.

My little one loves this line of food, and I love how convenient they are!  We traveled to Europe for two weeks and packed a ton of these for the trip.  They survived several planes, buses, and boats.  Easy, convenient, and healthy... what's not to love?

column9: Used to be great, company changed the formula
column10: Why, why, why did they change the formula??  Our twins loved this.  Now just like gobble gobble, they wont take it.Company's website with the old and new formula: [..]Only guess is that sweet potato is much more expensive than corn (both the top ingredients).Wrote to happybaby to tell them how disappointed we are

column9: Used to be great, baby doesn't like it now.
column10: We just got a new shipment in, and it is not the same Chick Chick our son has come to know and love.  This new stuff resembles the texture of their "Gobble Gobble" food, which our son absolutely hates.  I'm sure this stuff is great, but if you aren't sure your kid will like it, don't spend money on 16 of them up front.Be aware that you can't return this item.

column9: Don't give up and give it more then one try!
column10: I gave this flavor to my 6 month old son but he did not like it so I tried to blend it, but still no luck. It does have very strong taste especially for babies who had only veggie and fruit blends. So I mixed the blended beef stew with green beans ( 1,5 oz of beef stew with 3,5oz green beans ) and my baby ate it all no problem.
