column10: I've been trying to find chicken jerky dog treats not made in China and these are the closest I've been able to find to this point (but I've found some made in Maine that look possible - I haven't tried them yet but intend to). These are US made, but not like what comes from China. They are hard and brittle and formed in some fashion into strips/bars. One of our dogs accepts them OK (not her favorite, but will take them), the other just turns his head away and only eats them when he realizes it's all there's going to be.But my last shipment from Amazon is going to be my last. I ordered several bags and they arrived with the pieces mostly in small shards. Don't know if Amazon shipped them in that condition or the shipper managed to mangle them en route (the box was not mangled in any way but it could have been dropped). But given the fact they're not ideal anyway, I'm not ordering any more.Not my favorite and not really recommended. Going to keep looking. The Blue Buffalo chicken treats (Blue Buffalo Wilderness Chicken Dog Jerky Treats) are good, but outrageously expensive ($10 for a 3.2 oz bag!) and mostly very small pieces, so after one bag, no more.

My two dogs (shih tzu and malkie) love these.  They are more crunchy than jerky, which concerned me at first, but the 'girls' handle nicely.  They receive one treat per day and this is usually it.  I also love that it's made in the USA.  I have repurchased several times and highly recommend.

Our 10-year-old Silkie Terrier Mabel is a very picky eater.  Because she has such a little mouth, she can't manage most treats.  These can be broken up into little pieces for her.  And because they're natural chicken, at least they're good for her.  I'm sure she'd recommend them highly.

column9: Okay but not a home run
column10: I ordered these when trying to find a chicken treat that is USA made. For years I had bought the Waggin Train brand.  My dog loved them, but had a diarrhea every time she went "number two" and neither we nor our vet could figure out why.  Finally after seeing the story about chews made in China, I stopped buying them.  Within a week my dog had totally stopped her diarrhea!  She has hardly had it one time since and that was last year.  Back to topic - the bag does say USA made which is comforting, but the chews are very hard and crunchy.  I just rescued a male Shih Tzu and he ate them, but my girl wasn't impressed.  I am still searching for a USA made chew that is not hard as a rock.
We have been buying these for a few months now and are pleased with the quality and that they are made in the USA. Our dog loves them.
Great product.  Dog likes them.  They are made in the USA.  They are a bit expensive but worth it.  I will buy this item again.

After reading articles concerning jerk chicken treat made in China, I checked the website for an alternative.  This product  produced in the USA provides my dog a  yummy treat and provides me with emotional relief that I am feeding my dog a safe treat.
Unless your dog is younger and has great teeth, I do not recommend you try these. They are extremely hard.

column9: What can I say, AXE smells good.
column10: Just as my title suggests; Axe Original smells great. If you dont feel like swiping $100 at macys for armani this would be a economical 2nd choice.One concern that I have, I last used this product 5 years ago. It is so concentrated that I honestly have to hold my breath for 5 seconds whilst im spraying and till the vapor beings to settle down."I do not over spray" so maybe its just because I'm getting older.Over all AXE, smells great, its economical, and their commercials are cool.enjoy.

I loved this fragrance from AXE. Congratulations to Unilever. Unfortunately there is no longer this fragrance here in Brazil, but hopefully soon Unilever bring him back here. For those who like to be always smelling, I recommend. Maybe some fragrances will not please you. I order the Jelly Belly gummi bears often and I am always impressed with the flavor and freshness.  I appreciate this brand using kosher gelatin; which coincides with my religious preferences.  The only thing I am not too happy about is whenever I or a friend orders this, it should be 24 packs that come, but lately we have only been receiving a box of 12.  Amazon is always helpful in crediting us back half the amount, but in all actuality, I truly want the product.  Still, if you have an affinity for gummi bears, you can not beat Amazon's price and Jelly Belly's flavor!

Jelly Belly bears is expensive, but they are worth it if you love gummi bears.  I have tried all of the other brands that produce them, but I half to say Jelly Belly Bears are one of my top two favorite of all times.  They have an amazing taste and I can (and do) eat them by the box full.  I never had any issues with the bears being faulty like some other brands.  I gave it 4 stars b/c I cant give 4.5 stars on the rating.  Its expensive thats why I gave them 4 (4.5 on my scale) stars.

column9: Jelly Belly vs. Heide Gummi Bears
column10: Both Jelly Belly and Heide have established themselves as leaders in the American Gummi Bear market, in fact, Jelly Belly was the first to ever make an American Gummi Bear. Unlike their European counterparts, such as Haribo Gold Bears, American Gummi Bears are soft and have a more opaque look to them.My all-time favorite Gummi Bear has been Heide ever since elementary school, but I give Jelly Belly a lot of credit for putting up a great fight. Jelly Belly bears are smaller and less resembling of a bear, but they sure pack a punch in terms of flavor. Heide bears on the other hand are larger and more bear-like than their counterpart, but flavor is more subtle. Both come in five distinct flavors and both are difficult to find in your average grocery store candy aisle.On average, Jelly Belly bears appear to be more costly than Heide bears per ounce, but of course that doesn't mean you won't find amazing deals like the one on Amazon that turn the tables. In general you won't go wrong with either brand, but my vote still goes toward Heide for bringing back all the memories of my childhood.
I am addicted to these gummy bears. They are so good.Plus for Muslims and Jews out there... These are Kosher Beef Gelatin.I know I can never find pork-free gummy bears ANYWHERE.

This particular flavor in the Coffee Bean Direct line is my least favorite.  I buy this brand often and usually find it to be quite good but this flavor seemed flat and practically non-existent.  I bought four bags in the offering I purchased and was disappointed with all four bags.  Not up to the brands usual grade.  I would not buy this again.

I like both the chocolate mint and the peanute butter, but my husband loves the chocolate mint.  They're convenient to carry for hiking and biking and easy to eat while walking on the treadmill.  Of all the protein bars I had looked at, Genisoy is highest in soy protein.  I was pleasantly surprised they taste so good.

column9: VERY impressive taste for a protein bar!
column10: I can't say enough about this product, but I will try to keep it short!!I just got finished eating this Crispy Chocolate Mint GeniSoy bar, and it was delicious!!  Having tried many types of protein bars, I expected this one to have that well known "in your face protein" taste.  I personally didn't notice it at all.  It DID  ~smell~ as if it would taste this way, but I was pleastantly surprised to find out that it's smell didn't do it's taste justice!!  It has a great chocolate mint flavor,and the mint isn't too overpowering, it is nice and chewy, but not the stick to your teeth type.  I am eager to try the other flavors GeniSoy offers in their bars.  I hope they are as good as this one!!ENJOY!!!
These protein bars are good! Similar to an actual candy bar of course more healthier. I've had many different brands of protein bars and these are the best I've had so far.

These are pretty tasty bars.  My wife and I eat them just candy bars / dessert (240cal).  I've tried most of Genisoy's flavors, and this is by far my favorite.  (My wife thinks it's a tie between this chocolate mint and the peanut butter.)  The only thing keeping me from giving the fifth star is the price (not bad for the protein-bar market, but still I wish they were a bit less).
This product has a good taste but was melted and stuck to the wrapper.  It made a mess getting it out of the wrapper.I could no longer find it in grocery stores and maybe this is the reason.
If you like protein bars with good flavor and substance, you might wish to try these!  They are great for a snack or a quick protien pick me up meal on the go!

column9: Good Product but 40% increase in less than 30 days WOW
column10: I tried this product for the 1st time on Nov-12.  Following recomendations from other clients and I like it. It is a good product better than other ones in the MArket.  I paid $10.43 a box. and Now they are priced at $14.58 WOW WOW WOW 40% price increase.  Unless this is a pricing error, this is very sad, this will force me to look elsewhere  Too bad....This product is avilalble at $10 else where  why pay more???The OLD Product Tasted MUCH Better.  Can you see if they offer the classic taste, that would be great!!!

Sugar is also present as corn syrup and isadded in the Genisoy blend.The roasted soy nuts seem to be removed.Calories were 240 are now 210.The undefined carbs have gone down from 11g to 8g with theGenisoy blend reformulated.The new taste is sweet. I found the "New and Improved" lacking in "Taste and Texture" compared to the old formula. I wish Genisoy would make the Mint bar like they used to. Of course everyones taste is different.

I really like the taste of these chocolate mint bars.  I love chocolate and mint together and was so happy that Genisoy makes these.  If you are hoping these are a crunchy type bar due to the crispy part in the description, then you will not like them.  They have a gooey and firm consistency and the crispy part is throughout the bar.  They remind me of a really good fattening candy bar.  What a great way to get your protein and vitamins and not feel guilty.

column9: If you're even a little tempted, try it
column10: I have only this to offer: it's a very tasty bar. It was getting hard to find in my grocery and drug stores, so I bought them by the box here. Prices was decent enough considering my only option was not to have them at all.
The mint cuts the sweetness a little.  The chocolate is full and robust.  Nice amt of protein to add to the day's intake.  This is one of my favorite Genisoy flavors.

The product is the answer to that awkward time in between meals when you're hungry for something more than a snack. Also, the bar contains 25% of your daily protein intake, which is great news if you are a vegetarian or, like me, simply prefer to get your protein from sources alternate to meat.I highly recommend the GeniSoy Protein Bar for college students. I keep it in my dorm for a healthy late night snack or in the morning on the go.
I like the taste of these bars, but beware when ordering that they may be melted.  UPS delivery of them to Texas gets them melted up nicely.  Doesn't affect the taste, but the flakes do get messy.

This is energy disguised as dessert.  I love chocolate (real chocolate, not carob) and mint.  Generally I'm nonplussed by energy and protein bars, but this one really surprised me.  I suffer from low energy and really get low on protein throughout the day.  I just took a few bites out of this bar several times a day and was good to go.  It also helped keep me away from sugary snack foods which is what I tend to eat when I get low on energy and protein.  This truly tastes like an indulgence.

I've tried all of Udi's gluten free muffins and they are all good, but the chocolate is the best.  You can reheat them up and they turn out just fine, not too dry like some gluten-free products.  They aren't the absolute best gluten free chocolate baked goods I've had (which is the chocolate cake from Kinnikinnick), but they are the best frozen ones I've had.I've made gluten free muffins from scratch, but if you're in a hurry or going on a camping trip or having guests over and have no time for baking...getting these frozen muffins is a handy thing.Recommended.  Try em all.

The product was good but the service was slow.  I ordered two extracts and the Shipping and Handing was $7.95 and it took over two weeks to get the product. I even contacted the vendor and didn't receive a reply. Not what I thought I was paying $7.95 for and I would bring your business someplace else.

My husband and I ordered this basket for his parents anniversary and they loved it.  My mother in-law said it was the best of Italian food (they are Italian New Yorkers who have retired to Florida) that she can not find in the supermarkets in her area.  They loved everything in the basket and said the presentation and quality were excellent.  I am so pleased that they were excited about this product because the older our parents get the harder it seems to be to find an appropriate gift that they will actually use.  The delivery was very fast and we are all extremely happy.
We gave this to some friends recently and they raved over how nice it was.
Great Xylitol product.  It is powdery and dissolves very quickly as compared to some of the competition, which takes forever to dissolve and sits at the bottom of your drinks
I like this stuff because it tastes just like sugar but is not unhealthy like all the other chemicals out there.  I mix it with lakanto or organic raw sugar, and it is perfect for me!

This sugar substitute is better for your health than most others but if you do some intricate research on xylitol you'll find that some use corn.  Their are some brands that don't but I think this one does but I'll still use it over splenda or other so called safe sugar substitutes.
if your looking for a natural sweetner get kal stevia or now stevia.the sweetness in stevia is much better and only a small amount is needed.

I am a jam expert as I have it for breakfast every morning. I have tried many marmalades and this one is way too sweet not much orange flavor. Look at the calories per serving, a whopping 65. Most people would not understand the metric calorie decription on bottle- it says 65g per serving-than means 65 calories to us in the U.S. Also, you can buy Smucker's new Orchard marmalade-three fruit for 2.99 in stores. This only has 50 calories per serving and much better taste than this one. I read the reviews on this brand on Amazon- I do not know what the people were raving about Mrs Bridges. Pass on this one.
My lab loves ice cubes and these are a bit bigger than your average ice cube. I buy the Kong freeze packets to freeze in the tray and both my dogs love them!

The Kong Easy Freeze is so simple to use that even your children can make Kong shaped `pupsicles.' The mixes are simple to prepare and feature wholesome ingredients that help support balanced nutrition.Simply open the package and pour it into 8 oz of warm water.Mix well and then pour into the Kong shaped  ice cube tray.Place in freezer and freeze for 30 min.Take out of freezer run under water and your four legged friends will be enjoying an icy treat that will have them wagging their tales. Both our dogs loved them.

column9: The Best Salmon I've ever Eaten
column10: The salmon arrived via UPS - fresh - not flash frozen.  The portion sizes were just right for cooking and the flavor was great.

I bought three flavors just to try them out, this flavor was by far the worst. I hate throwing food away but I just couldn't eat these! The White Cheddar is ok, I like them. If your looking for a sweet snack that is filling and yummy I'd go with the Cinnamon flavor, LOVE those. All packs are low in carbs and sugar and have good amounts of fiber and protein.([...]

column9: Good for an OCCASIONAL breakfast on the go, beware of exp date
column10: I used to eat these every morning for breakfast when I had a 1+ hour commute in upstate NY.  They are quick and easy to grab, but must be consumed with liquid.  I preferred a hot cup of coffee and a glass of water to wash everything down.  They would last me until lunch time, which was nice since I was always running from one campus to another.  I had always jsut purchased a box a week from the local grocery store.Be aware, however, if you buy in bulk from Amazon: we purchased two six box cases (72 breakfast squares), which for 2 people should last 36 work days.  If you factor in a few days where you actually have time to make breakfast or just want something different, these should last 1.5-2 months.  I don't mind buying things this far in advance, and it's never been an issue, but the expiration date of these bars did not fall within that 2 month range.  Now, most food products in packaging that I've had experience with are good past the exp date.  These, however, were soooo dry and made me want to eat them even less.  Whereas before you needed a cup of coffee, water or tea, now it was essential to dip the bar or take a bite and then immediately a swig of beverage even before chewing.

The Quaker oatmeal to go bars are just delicious. They're moist unlike other dry granola bars, and much thicker too! They taste even better when you microwave them for 10 seconds, sometimes I wish I could eat the whole box to be satisfied, but I'd go broke!These bars make a great addition to any packed lunch, or just a good snack when you're out shopping, at school, work, etc. A much healthier choice than a candy bar, or some fried fast food choices.I've tried every flavor and I have to say the oatmeal raisin is my #1 favorite, but in second place, the apple cinnamon flavor is pretty good.

These are pretty good!They are slightly different from the ones I first bought in a store (they lack the frosting on the top), but that's a good thing. They could be a little less sweet, but I guess overall, they make a good "grab and go" breakfast when you're in a hurry.

Must better than expected. Very filling, not oatmeal cookie like at all. Real crunchy taste. an easy way to get your fiber. I'll try them warm next time.  I got a good Amazon warehouse buy.  will order again.

column9: Great when you're on the go -- just like the name says
column10: These are very dense breakfast bars that really stick with you and keep you from feeling hungry all morning. They're chewy too, so it takes awhile to finish.
Like an oatmeal cookie- a bit sweat but good to eat!Quaker reputation is a bonus, but more cake than nutrient bar.
These are so hard to find in the stores these days; Amazon had them at a great price and they arrived quickly.

I was thrilled to be able to get the Oatmeal To Go Bars in Oatmeal Raisin flavor because I can't buy them in my area.  I can get other flavors but my preference is the Oatmeal Raisin. Thank you for carrying this product.
My 95 year old mother enjoys an Oatmeal To Go Square each morning along with a glass of orange juice.  She says that the square is absolutely delicious and nutritious.  Easy to eat.

I love eating oatmeal, mixed with milk and some honey , occasionally just a dab of butter will do. But I cannot always cook a bowlful when I really need it, say at 3 in the afternoon in a freezing office. Its messy, and if you dont bring your bowl back to the kitchen immediately, youre gonna be left with hardened paste.I got these Quaker Oatmeal To Go in the Oatmeal Raisin flavor. They are really heavy and dense , kind of remind me of a homemade energy bar, or a snack you would find at a health food store. I have eaten them both cold and hot. Cold they are a bit gummy, chewy but still really tasty. Hot they are like a warm melty mitten in your tummy and twice as yummy as they are cold.These would make the perfect "on the go" breakfast for anyone, adults, kids, and teens. They are super filling and satisfying.

Our long haired standard size dachshund love these.  He wishes though that there were more than just 2 cookies in the assortment that were decorated with the little sprinkles.  Those are his favorites :o).

column9: Beware of packaging in hot weather
column10: The honey is great, however, the packaging was a sticky mess.  As far as I can tell, the hot weather caused the honey to expand and it leaked thru the packaging.  It was the inside packaging, not the bubble wrap and box the product was shipped in.  The honey company did not stand my their packaging when contacted.  They stated it was Amazon's problem.  Not so.  Never was resolved.  Therefore, I'm only giving it 3 stars.

column9: Baronet Coffee Izzy's Blend Medium Roast Pods
column10: I purchased 3 boxes based on the 5-star reviews and am very disappointed in the quality. I have a Hamilton Beach pod coffee maker for work and when brewed the coffee looks like weak tea. I have to pour the coffee back in the coffee pot and brew again just to have a mediocre cup of coffee. Very disappointed in this brand and will not buy again.

My husband loves Izzy's Blend Medium Roast. He can make an eight oz cup with one pod perfect for his taste preference.  The individually packaged pods assure freshness and weight is heavier than the Senseo brand.

I am not a person who fancies themselves a Coffee Diva or anything like that.  But I know a bad cup of coffee when I have one.  These pods are without a doubt the weakest pods on the market.  I've tried many many different varieties.  When I brewed my first one and looked into the cup - I thought to myself - Hmmm?  Did I just make hot TEA?  Figured perhaps it was a bad pod.  So... I gave another one a try.  Same thing - WEAK WEAK WEAK!  And the flavor isn't there to back up the weakness.  So.... I gave it another try - THIS TIME - with TWO pods.  Still insanely weak!  Basically - I threw them away.  Not even worth a desperate cold Sunday morning cup when there is nothing else in the house!!  Better to have milk!  Sorry folks!

Pods are hard to come by these days, and I HATE Senseo coffee, but I found these pods online.  I've tried just about every brand and flavor of pods and wanted something different, so I ordered these.  This is very good coffee.  A little stronger than most pods, but not as strong as French roast.  It has a very unique flavor and aroma...almost like half hazelnut, half regular coffee.  The only downside is Amazon obviously ran over this shipment a couple of times with a forklift before it was put in a box and sent out to us (the box it was shipped in was in perfect shape, so it wasn't the post office's fault.)  I was very surprised almost all the pods were intact because the packaging they were in was a mess.  Time to take better care of your stuff, Amazon!

I own a Senseo machine and was using Senseo brand coffee for a full year before I found the Baronet coffees on Amazon. I buy this Izzy's and a decaf and they are delivered to me monthly at a price cheaper than the Senseo at Target (which is the cheapest I have found for the Senseo brand). The thing that really sells this for me is the amount of coffee per pod - much more than the other pods on the market. Not all Baronet pods are this super size...be sure to check the weight. There is a good 30% more coffee in these pods than the other brands, they are delivered to my front door and the flavor is wonderful!

column9: Best Pod coffee I have tried yet!
column10: I have tried Senseo and Wolfgang Puck medium roast blends and this product surpasses those brands for aroma, flavor and overall taste satisfaction.  Perhaps there are others that are its equal or better that I haven't tried, but this one is very satisfactory for me.

Purchased Baronet's Coffee Izzy's Blend Coffee Pods for Bunn My Cafe which works perfectly. This Blend had absolutely no flavor, no aroma and was watery. I tried first with 8 oz of water then the second cup 5 oz of water. It just has no flavor and I wasted my money.

Whoah! After the senseo pods because unavailable in any stores I shop at, and getting weird backstock and supply issues from senseos site-ordering, I finally looked at amazon again after a long time, and I found these bad boys! I picked the "izzy blend" whatever thats supposed to be, based on the description of the coffee, and its PERFECT. The pods are all oversized, which means when in the single pod brew tray thing, makes an ample amount of really good, creamy coffee. Theyre also all individually wrapped in foil, each like a bulging condom in the wrapper. That keeps them amazingly fresh. This coffee is good, at least the ones I got, really good. When I brew this, people pop out of hiding spaces sniffing around and mutterring "coffee! coffee... coffeecoffee! that smells like coffee!" and it does. I love my senseo machine, despite the issues ive had with it, I prefer the idea of ground coffee still instead of weird magical coffee concentrates. I never expected coffee this good to come from that thing! I tried using the "reuseable pods" which didnt amount to anything but some watery, slightly foamy, weak dribble. That was with the eco, and the duck, and that other thing. I'm in love with my senseo machine again! If you want creamy coffee, that tastes like COFFEE, without being some kind of awful acid filled starbucks over-coffee, then go for this. Its simply a damn good mug of coffee that does its job when it literally opens my eyes and wakes me up in the morning. Would highly reccomend this to anyone, the coffee is just great, its packaged perfectly, and the oversized pods are something I still cant get over.Thug life homies, may your pencils never dull, your fridge always be full, and may there be plenty of ninjas to snipe in your dreams.Good day.

We love these Pods and use them in our Senseo coffee machine.  Senseco Pods are becoming more difficult to locate in retail stores.  The Baronet pods work well and are of better quality than Senseo.  However for the foil packed singles  you will need to use the 2 pod holder, or just mash it down well in the 1 pod holder IF you have a Senseo supreme  (chrome) machine. If you buy Baronet pods in the loose package they are the same size as Senseo pods but we prefer the foil as they stay fresher, just adjust the pod holder selection and brew volume as needed.Izzy blend is our favorite regular blend, and the Baronet decaf coffees actually taste like real coffee, imagine that! Our favorite decaf is 100% Columbian decaf medium roast.The Baronet 'medium' roast blends are plenty bold for us and close to the Senseo dark roasts but with much more flavor.  Like it strong...buy the dark full bodied Baronet line up.

column9: Geat coffee for a wonderful machine
column10: As most of you know, BUNN is a great machine and this coffee is perfect in the AM and to relax with later in the day.

I love these pods. They seem very rich and have good flavor. You don't want to go over 9 oz or you start loosing the flavor. I use the double holder In my cap maker. The single is just to tight to mess with. I also wet the pod first. These are bigger than other pods so by using the double holder, I don't think it takes anything away from the coffee. I also bought the Nutty Irishman. It is also a favorite.Hope this helps. God bless.

I use a Bunn My Cafe.  Great tasting coffee in my large mugs.  Just a phenomenal flavored coffee compared to the lightweight Senseo's in the grocery store.  I like this one, Baronet Blast and Baronet Izzy's blend.  Baronet's coffees are made 30 minutes from my home - never knew it till I bought.  Funny how my favorite so far was actually only 30 minutes up the road from me - of all things...

column9: Baronet Coffee Izzy's Blend Medium Roast, 18 count Coffee Pods (Pack of 3)
column10: I took a chance ordering this coffee by depending on another rater's opinion and have not been disappointed. Very robust, distinctive favor. You know you're drinking coffee. It is a heavy weight pod; I would say more than enough for my usual 8 oz. size cup. I may give it a try, as I believe that the pod could tolerate a 10 oz. size.

column9: Good Tasting Soup From A Box.
column10: This noon for lunch I had a box of Dr. McDougall's Garden Vegetable Soup (lower sodium variety. It was quite good. The box contained two servings and only 60 calories each.I consumed both servings. Plus, it had no fat and, of course, the sodium was low. It was a good tasting soup and, together with a couple other items, made a good nutritious lunch.I like to find items like this because I can store  them in my pantry and have a good meal prepared in no time at all. Plus, I worry about proper nutrition and so many of the things you can store are so high in salt, sugar and fat. Not here! This is a good item. I've also enjoyed their lentil soup and I'll probably test a few other kinds. You wouldn't think such good soups would come in a box.Gary Peterson

column9: Hate canned soup, but LOVE this!
column10: I had long given up on canned soup.  I've never found one that I actually like (maybe since I make most food from scratch) but I bought this anyway per my son's request.  I served it over steamed rice (seasoned with salt and butter) and it was delicious.  My 2-year-old enjoyed it too.  I plan to keep a couple cans in the pantry for those nights when a quick dinner is in order.

column9: Wrong item -- this isn't what you will get in the mail!
column10: The item I was sent is not what is pictured here. Even the nutritional facts are completely different. Beware...if you are looking for Walnut Acres Tuscan White Bean -- this is not what it promises to be!!!
these taste like the inside of a peanut butter cup!  sweeter than peanut butter, they're also pretty crumbly.  still, though, one of these wonderfully satisfies that sweet tooth!

Just came back from Mexico....just one of these will satisfy your sweet tooth....they are crumbly and best eaten with a spoon...they taste JUST LIKE Mexican Wedding Cakes....(nut balls covered with powdered sugar...popular Christmas cookie)

I grew up in a community with a large Mexican population, mostly from Michoacan. I remember going to birthday parties and quinceneras and Mazapan was always there :) The simple rose packaging is soo pretty!It is very sweet and peanutty, personally I'm not a peanut fan but my lil sis loves these! Fun Fact:because peanuts were more available in Latin America when marzipan was first introduced, they substituted almonds and quickly became a traditional holiday treat.
This candy is great! Brings back Childhood memories. I love it!This also came earlier than expected, so I got a surprise. Can't find these anywhere around here! !
These came fresh and delicious and the shipping was really quick. These taste kindof like the inside of a reeses, and the texture is smooth. My kids even love them! I highly recommend!
I can't find these in stores since I left TX. The big box option works so well for me. They're sweet but not the worst thing for you. Basically just sugar and peanuts. I love them.
Arrived promptly, and fresh.  Am very impressed! Thank you for your professionalism.  Will not hesitate to order again, and will be very, very soon. :)Sincere Thanks.

column9: Ones bought in USA taste different.
column10: We also just got back from Mexico, having tried these.  They are DELICIOUS and really do, as one reviewer described, taste like the inside of a peanut butter cup.As soon as we finished the Mexican box, we went to the local Mexican grocery store (in Tampa) and found them.  Upon tasting, my gf and I decided the ones bought in the US were much less "peanutty" and far more "vanilla tasting" than the ones from Mexico, although they were still good. Although all the labeling on the US version is the same on the candy itself, the plastic that holds (several of) the candies is in English and there is no actual print on the US version that says "Made In Mexico" that I can read.  The Mexican one does, of course, say "Made In Mexico".  I wonder if the ones sold to USA resisents are made with a different recipe to suit our tastes?  I like the Mexican version better.

This is exactly like the mazapanes of my childhood. Absolutely yummy. This is not your typical Italian or Spanish marzipan, these are much lighter and creamier. De la Rosa has been making these candies for years and years and they are the best!

I tried this at the office and never would have tried it otherwise.  It was so good!  I am a big fan of peanut butter and this was just a perfect sized sweet snack.  The only drawback is how quickly it will crumble, so don't eat it somewhere that you can't make a mess!!  Otherwise, I give a five star for yumminess!
These candies are amazing.  I used to buy them in bulk all the time when I'd go to Mexico.

One piece is enough to satisfy a major sweet tooth, but the flavor isn't the best. It tastes like confectioner's sugar mixed with just the tiniest hint of peanut butter. If you like eating pure powdered sugar, then this would be good.

column9: Peanut butter with your Powdered sugar
column10: I read a review that stated that these taste like the inside of a peanut butter cup, only a little sweeter. They do not. They have the consistency of what you would find in a peanut butter cup, but not the taste. Another reviewer said these taste just like Mexican wedding cake cookies. This is actually the review that sold me on getting these. They do not taste like that either. I think the consistency is what sold these reviewers on the response that they give. I will admit that the consistency is fun, it's crumbly, and makes it seem more appealing, the flavor is in no way appealing to me.What these do taste like is a mix between powdered sugar and the faintest hint of peanut butter. The powdered sugar overwhelms this product and is not appealing to my taste buds. If you like eating powdered sugar than you will probably enjoy these. I am sure there is a market out there for these confections, I just would not purchase these again, nor can I recommend them.
This is Da BOMB!  Marzipan made from peanuts.  Especially great for peanut butter addicts who think peanut butter cups have too much chocolate.

I will begin with saying that I love tacos, and Taco Bell has some really great products, this one included.  With my experience, I received the product in a timely manner, delivered by UPS.  My complaint is this...their were broken shells in every taco dinner box I received.  The pricing was great, and it saved me some money on the product, but I think I would rather have unbroken shells when I try to use them.  So, I believe going to the local grocer or supermarket would be the best bet for future purchases.
I subscribe to these.  I love taco bell and I was always buying taco kits at the store.  sometimes two or 3 boxes a week.  This makes life a little more simple.  I love it

column9: Taco shells are destroyed in shipping
column10: I would not recommend purchasing this item as shipping destroys the shells. What good are tacos without being able to have them prepared in the shells?

column9: Taco Splinters = Seven Crushed Shells in First Box Opened
column10: Shipper's box was pristine! The individual boxes of product enclosed within green plastic wrap looked like they'd been massaged by a Sumo wrestler BEFORE they were even packed for shipment. My kids are teenagers and can roll with the punches, via Taco dippers or Taco salad bowl with the SPLINTERED shells that arrived. However, in their "it's gotta be perfect" phase this busted up mess is TOTALLY UNACCEPTABLE ... even at less than 2 bucks a box!Know any good recipes for Taco Shell Splinters?Update: When the splintered taco shells aren't smothered in salad dressing we found the shells to be STALE even though the BEST USED BY DATE IS OCTOBER 26, 2010...Hello Customer Service!

I went to my local supermarket recently looking for some taco shells.  I picked up box after box of various brands/types and they were all loaded with trans fat.  Even when they claimed zero trans fat, partially hydrogenated oils were still listed in the ingredients.  And the ingredients lists were far too long for something so simple.  I finally picked up the Taco Bell shells and the ingredients were very simple: white corn, corn oil, water, yello 5 & annatto for color.  No partially hydrogenated anything.Unfortunately, by getting rid of the trans fats and other stuff, these shells are a little bland.  It doesn't matter much as long as you have tasty fillings, but a little salt might have helped.  There's only 5mg of sodium for 3 shells, so they're great for people watching their salt intake as well.  The shells hold up well.  I packed some in my lunchbox a couple of times with the fillings packed in small containers and the shells didn;t break.I'd give these 5 stars for being the healthiest choice, and 3 for taste, so 4 stars overall.I did not buy the kit, just the shells, but I've checked out the ingredients on the taco sauce and seasoning packet in the kit and no trans fat there either.

column9: Tasty chocolate with trace of goji berries
column10: These confections are a very dark, bittersweet chocolate covering what probably really is a tidbit of goji berry.  They are enjoyable to eat as a candy although there is probably not enough goji berry in each to get much of the suposed health benefits of these berries.  Each piece is slightly larger than a traditional chocolate covered raisin.  The chocolate is very dark and shiny and thick.  The berry in the middle is barely discernable but definitely there.  A five pound bag is aboout 12 inches tall by 8 inches wide,  a good size bag of chocolate!  Overall, I am not sorry I ordered them, tasty and a reasonable value.

My puppy loves these vitality treats. After reading the other two reviews I became concerned and quickly e-mailed the company with my concerns. Here is what they replied to me which immediately relieved my worries. In fact, they loved these so much, they stole the bag off the counter and ate the entire contents in one sitting. None of them became ill. These treats didn't do a whole lot to help their breath, but I felt good about the ingredients.

column9: nice treat, but doesn't really freshen breath
column10: I like the dogwell treats, but though these seem high quality treats they don't seem to help my little dog's breath very much :)  I guess you can't expect much, it is a dog we are talking about.

Purchased a case of these earlier last year.My picky dog absolutely loved these.  Can't hardly get him to take a dog treat that isn't in this shape, and heaven help me if it doesn't taste like this.  He'll leave them on the floor rather than eat them.Previous reviewer is correct, these don't freshen breath like a mint.  They do however work great in cleaning teeth and working out those particles that hang around decaying and stinking up your pet's mouth.This is the only doggie treat I'd recommend with 5 stars.
My dogs used to love these when they were chicken "strips".  The last 2 shipments where circular, the size of quarters.  Same great quality ingredients but, a choking hazard!
I would recommend this for your dog.  Our puppy likes the strips and this item is NOT made in China. And it does help their breath.

My dog is the fussiest eater ever. He even turns up his nose at cold cuts, cheese and real freshly made bacon. I thought he would get bored of the taste of Dogswell Breathies Chicken Mint & Parsley but he eats them every day. Breathies Chicken Mint & Parsley is a winner~!

Usually, I never write reviews but I feel I must this time. I bought the 15oz Breathies from a local Petco and thought it was amazing (no health concerns experienced), so I decided to subscribe to these on Amazon as well. Unfortunately, the ones I received were contaminated and have been giving my puppies terrible diarrhea for the past 2weeks (we finally narrowed it down to the treats). After doing further research online, I discovered many other people had the same experiences. It's a great product, just not when contaminated - so good luck with the patch you receive (it is from China after all).
My Dog absolutely loves these treats. All I have to do is say their name and I have his full and undivided attention. Good value for the price as well

My very finicky little dog loves these chicken strips, sometimes it's the only thing that keeps her going when we've been hiking in  the woods...I wish she was a better eater but I am glad that I can buy these "Breathies"!Thanks so much...

column9: My dog loves the chicken and mint, and his breath is great!
column10: I discovered the parsley, mint and chicken treats on a trip to Seattle last year and a visit to a dog health food store.  It was pricey there,  but I bought a package.  Beau loved them and I found a great price on Amazon.  His vet says his teeth look great and his breath is really fresh.  He's a big kisser, so we can tell.  Go for it!!!!

column9: Best Breath Treat on the Market. Really works!!!!
column10: My husky had the worst breath for years, tried everything. Found these, wow, what a difference. I will buy these always. They actually work. A lot of products claim to work, these do.

Great snack or mixture that my toy poodle loves and will jump and cry for, far better treat than anything we've ever given her.  We take a strip and often cut it up into small pieces and mix with her food to help her get started with eating her regular food.  In addition, this helps my dog's breath and makes her happy as well as all of us who she likes to lick.  This is honestly the best treat we've found for our dog and amazon had the best prices I've found.  Setting this up on a regular delivery schedule has even saved me more money and keeps us with timely stock.  Well worth trying for your dog!

column9: Terrific treats, and apparently, a good company
column10: I have been feeding these to my dogs for years.... They love them, and despite being made in China, they seem to be a reputable company with a good quality product.Then, today, I notice one of the last strips in the treat jar had white fuzz on it. This did not make me happy. Then, I received my new shipment of strips, and they were much darker than prior shipments. I immediately emailed the company, to let them know I was very concerned about the changes to these strips.I don't think it was two hours before I received a response, which admitted there was a packaging problem that caused the mold and that it had been addressed, and that a change in the manufacturing process had likely caused the darker color of the strips in the latest packages.For me, a personal response was very reassuring, my dog is my best buddy, and she loves these treats. Hopefully, their standards are as high as they claim, there is simply no way to know; not on anything you feed your pet, or anything you buy in the grocery store, but I will continue purchasing these for my Daisy.

It's great for their breath and good for their teeth. Bobby has to work at chewing this dehydrated chicken treat just a little. It's worth the money knowing that your dog is getting only healthy ingredients.

column9: Dogwell Breathies - Healthy, tasty treat for your dog
column10: These are great for my dog, he loves them and he is picky.  They are healthy with no added fillers.  It helps to clean his teeth and freshen is breath.  With 8 teeth removed several months ago he can no longer eat petite greenies but has no problem with these strips.

My very picky dog LOVES these.  And even better, they really have improved her breath!  I worried when I saw they are made in China.  But after her annual physical, she is in fabulous shape (for a 14 year old, 8 pound dog!). I will continue to purchase these for her.

These are not made from "free range chicken". They are made in China and have been refused entry into the US before. I just trashed the bag that I had in my kitchen. These products are imported from China by an American company, packaged and sold as 'healthy' dog treats. I'm sending the BS flag to the top of the flagpole on this one. Buyer beware![...]

This product was the cause of my 2 dogs getting sick and ruining my brand new carpet. It took us a couple of weeks to figure it out but this was the cause. I highly recommend purchasing products made in the U.S.A., China doesn't have the same criteria we do....

Gary Regan's eponymous cocktail bitters are the best orange bitters available today.Not all cocktails are better with Angostura's classic bitters. Sometimes you want a little citrus lift in your drink. Although other orange bitters from Fee's, Stirring's  and Angostura itself are more widely available, they each have drawbacks. Fee's is overwhelmingly pungent... with orange extract notes that seem artificial. Antostura's Orange bitters don't have the magical concentration and complexity that regular Angostura has in spades. And Stirrings Orange Bitters aren't even bitters!

I was looking for Peychaud's bitters, needed for a Sazarac cocktail, and found that there are all kinds bitters out there... Not just the ubiquitous Angostura...Put a couple of dashes of this in a cosmopolitan, and it gives it a more interesting flavor.

This is a very well crafted product. Even though it's just an accent in most drinks you really get a huge depth of flavor from it. Despite being pretty alcoholic stuff it's even fairly palatable straight up (not that I'd serve it that way, but I tasted a few sips in a shot glass just to get a feel for it.) On the nose the straight product has a nice fresh orange scent followed by the bitter herb aroma and the alcohol, tasting it straight the orange is fresh but subdued by bitters with some notes of a cloves and fennel and wood.In my favorite application so far, the dry martini, it really ties the drink together and brings out the herbal notes in the gin in a very pleasing way. I'll no longer mix martinis without it.In a completely different area of the kitchen I flavored some sweetened whipped cream with a squeeze of fresh orange juice, a bit of zest and a few heavy dashes orange bitters for a nice not-too-sweet complement for rich chocolate desserts.

This product, I hoped, might be similar to Angastora bitters, which are truly bitter. HOWEVER, these orange bitters are really sweet. My grandson of 4 years age adds them to iced water and likes the mix. Forget it if you enjoy martinis and add bitters to make an Italian martini.
Very good...different taste adds something different to drinks.  The orange flavor is subtle and smooth. I've had many positive comments from friends.
These make good drinks greati enjoy a dash of orange bitters along w/ my angostura in an old fashionedor a bacon infused bourbon old fashioned with maple syrup

These bitters are fantastic. They are quite aromatic - as opposed to the Fee brothers orange that taste mostly like orange candy (which can be a good thing in some cocktails) - but they are more complex than the Angostura orange, which taste something like regular Angostura mixed with Fee's orange. A dash of Regan's orange rounds out a sidecar cocktail perfectly and turns this classic cocktail into a *classic* cocktail. It is nice that they also come in a bigger than usual 10 oz size.

column9: Hands Down Favorite Tea!  Good Blend. Good Flavor. Aromatic. Smooth. Great with Milk.
column10: I've been drinking this Bigelow green tea/chai blend about 6 months & it is my first choice every time I go to brew a cup of tea.  We also have Celestial Seasonings K-cups India Spice Chai, 8.8-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 2) and Bigelow Tea English Breakfast K-Cup For Keurig Brewers, 24-Count,  Boxes (Pack of 2) but I go through the Bigelow green/chai blend faster than the other two combined.As for personal taste, I don't like plain green tea, but do like chai tea (w/ milk).  However, I like this blend even better than just a plain chai blend.  I drink this tea with 2% or skim milk & 1 packet of sugar.This tea blend hits the spot and is perfect for my afternoon tea cravings.  As a bonus, one brew fills the office with a nice spicy scent.Disclosure: This product just came available through Amazon today, so we made our purchases through other sites.

I have been drinking k cups for about a year and half. I started off on coffee, but my chronic heartburn had me switching to tea. I've tried a lot of tea k cups and this one is by far my favorite. It has just enough spice to make it much more flavorful than the regular green tea k cups (green tea is my favorite tea). This k cup is delicious with Stevia in the Raw brand stevia then pour it over ice! I can drink it all day long...
I received a sample of this tea and was hesitant.  Most chai teas are creamy and heavily sweet.  This is perfect.  I enjoy it hot or cold.  The smell is quite nice as it brews.
I love this tea - it is my favorite. I drink it at least twice a day. It has just theright amount of flavor and I have no need for sugar with it.

You can't go wrong with Bigelows Tea Chai Green Tea.  It's amazing!  Whether you brew a small or large cup of it (I prefer unsweetened), the chai spices gives plain green tea (not my favorite tea) an almost sweet, full-bodied, spicy flavor.  Love it, especially in the evening.
I just received my shipment yesterday and I am in love with this tea. Will have to order more soon.

I found that coffee wasn't agreeing with me. I had no experience with tea but sent for Bigelow Chai Green Tea on a whim. I'm happy with the taste and apparent health benefits. I'll continue to order these k-cups.
I love chai and I love green tea.  Together they are perfect.  Tastes pretty good for a kcup.  Got this in a bigelow tea sampler and immediately had to buy more after one cup!
I love this tea but not enough to purchase at this new inflated price. It is now over $20 more than when I last purchased it from Amazon. I'll find a new tea, thank you. That's insane.

This is absolutely my favorite k-cup. I can't really handle a lot of caffeine, so I ordered this k-cup for afternoon drinks at work. It is lovely. The smell is amazing-- just a hint of spice that makes the whole office smell delicious. It has a great taste too-- the spice is subtle.As other reviewers have said, this is not the chai tea that you would think of getting at a coffee shop. If you are looking for that flavor, there is a chai latte k cup that seems to get good reviews. I would describe this more as a flavored green tea.I drink twice as much of this stuff as any other k-cup. Try it-- you won't be disappointed.
Great tasting AND healthy, too! I've used this product/ flavor for some time now. I love it and have found nothing, thus far, that is any better. I recommend this tea as a refreshing change of pace!

I wanted the benefit of green tea while enjoying my favorite, chai.I don't really taste the chai (probably because I'm spoiled w/ strong Starbucks chai latte) but this is good w/ honey. Makes me think I'm feeling better after drinking it. I'm sure that's just a state of mind.Most importantly, you get A LOT for your money. :)

I've tried other brands before and they did not impress meat all. When I tried  the Bigelow Chai Green Tea, I wassurprised at how good it tasted, I had it with milk and itreminded me of the chai I order at this Italian restaurant.It just has the right amount of spice flavor.
It is so delicious.  It tastes just like chai but has the benefits of green tea.  It clear- not creamy and absolutley amazing with cream and sugar-!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

column9: Perfect blend of Chi and green tea.
column10: We used to get this tea at the office .. but they removed our Kcup machine and replaced it with a pod type brewer... they didn't have a chi green tea mix so I had to brew one chi and one green tea pod .. it never came out the same .. I love the Bigelow mix ..

column9: Good green tea, but no chai.......
column10: This is a decent green tea, but there is no distinguishing chai flavor at all. All this tea tastes like is an average cup of green tea.

I ordered these as an alternative to Timothy's Chai Tea. I did not like the flavor & much prefer chai tea made from black tea than green tea. If you like green tea--you probably will enjoy this brand. If you prefer black tea--I recommend passing on this product.

I purchased this product without reading the reviews beforehand.  However, had I read the reviews I might have been clued in that this product is not what the name claims!  It claims to be Chai Green Tea, but the pictures on the side of the box show that it is in fact 3 different types of teas (i.e.Grey,orange,etc.), not the one actual flavor of 'chai' tea like I had wanted.I bought this product as a holiday gift and if I had the option to send it back I would as I made this discovery while opening the shipment box. I would gladly send it back shrink-wrap intact and all for something else.IMO, 'chai tea' is a specific flavor produced from a blend of spices and based on that I was looking for the 'chai' in this product but didn't find it.I have nothing to add about the actual taste or quality since it is a gift for someone else, but I just thought I would put it out there in case someone else reads this first before buying.

What I was expecting was a chai tea similar to one I find in popular coffee houses: a spiced tea infused with cream and sugar. This tea smells wonderful but the taste when you are drinking it is very plain to me. Also it is missing the cream and sugar elements so it has none of the flavor and body of a coffee house chai. I've also tried three other chais from Timothy's, Celestial, and Gloria Jean's and had the same reaction to them all during my side by side taste test. The K-cup chais are simply not the same as the coffee house chais. To approximate the coffee house chai you'll need to add your own cream/milk and sugar/honey and give it a little shake.

I got a kick out of hearing my staff laughing at the fortunes we came up with. Two successful rounds of fortunes, and I plan on being back for a third round.

column9: Great taste and service! What a fortune...
column10: This is the second time in 3 months we have ordered fortune cookies from Greenfire and again the service and cookies are impeccable. People were amazed to see that the fortunes were personalized and complimented us on the fact that they had never tasted such a fresh fortune cookie in their life. We'll order them again in June for the next trade show. Their service is very personal, they even check your copy and provide suggestions. Great people provide a great product that's for sure.

These fortune cookies were a hit!  My sister LOVES fortune cookies and was so excited to have her own custom fortunes.  We received help writing the fortunes from the company which helped a lot. Not only were these the best fortune cookies I have ever tasted, this company redefines what customer service should be.  SO many extra steps were taken to ensure that we recieved what we wanted, the order was customized not only to our requests but also to our timeline of when we were able to respond, etc.  Best customer service I have ever seen from a company.  The rest of the world should take notes and learn from this company.  Seriously amazing.  I highly reccommend them to anyone.

Another birthday means another order for fortune cookies from Greenfire.  This has become an annual tradition in our family.  Our son picks a theme and the experts at Greenfire come up with awesome looking fortunes to give to his friends.  I have also used the cookies as gifts for colleagues as well as clients and they think they not only look cool but they are yummy too.  I love the fact that we get to be creative and different at a reasonable price.  Perhaps even better than the actual cookies  -- the staff at Greenfire.  Always accommodating and easy to work with.  I am not just a customer - I am a part of the team.

The chocolate layer, while nice and smooth is so thick so that it overpowers the thin toffee layer and the delicate flavor of the macadamia nuts. I prefer the ones sold at Target stores during the Christmas season (Archer Farms brand). Those have just the right amount of chocolate to allow full appreciation of the crisp toffee and nuts. I have a very sensitive palate and I miss the crisp sweetness of the toffee and the delicate macadamia nuts. These are fairly pricey, too compared with the Archer Farms brand. Next year I will shop early at Target and stock up on their special chocolate toffee macadamia nut treats.

I actually haven't eaten these from a can, but I've eaten them from a bag.  They are addicting.  Like Lay's chips, you can't eat just one.  Chocolate coated macadamias are good, but these add the toffee flavor to elevate them to great.  My problem is I can finish off a bag by myself in one sitting.  The other problem is I can't find them anymore.  If you get the chance to buy some, don't pass up the opportunity or you'll regret it.
What!!!!!!!! $6.38 + $8.70 shipping, for a box that weight only 10 onz, no, no, no.Other place in internet has the same probuct for $3.??, an less in shipping

I have purchased both beef and poultry - this is a huge value - not sure why anyone would buy single envelopes at the store at 1.99 when you can buy this which lasts a long time, and is absolutely delicious. Highly recommend.

column9: Green tea that tastes like black tea!
column10: Disclaimer: I'm a huge tea-drinker and tea-lover! However, I don't like teas that are too bitter or astringent-tasting.Puerh tea (pronounced "POO-air") can be either green or black, which is really confusing. This one in particular is a green that tastes like a black! Puerh must be gathered from very old tea plants, which is partly why it tends to be quite expensive. Puerhs are supposed to be very strong-tasting, but this one is relatively mild.This Magnolia Puerh tastes very, very floral, almost like a jasmine, but is also very mild. It steeps up light, so don't over-steep thinking it needs to darken and turn it bitter. (Any tea will bitter if over-steeped due to the tannins.) The mouth-feel is light and silky, and it's very floral and aromatic. I do not agree with the product description that the flavor "changes with every sip", but it does take on a very faint citrusy flavor if you let it sit for 10 minutes before drinking. It is only enhanced by honey and milk.If you like Jasmine tea, you would be very likely to enjoy Numi's Magnolia Puerh tea. It's also a good choice for someone who loves black and floral, and wants to gradually ease into drinking more greens.
I needed this salt for baking. I looked everywhere and the cheapest price was from amazon. Great product.

column9: Good sea salt makes a difference
column10: This is a good sea salt.  Cooking with sea salt improves soups, meats, vegetables.
This product has been such a success in our home that I wound up keeping the second bottle that was intended as a gift for a friend.It really completes the meal without overdoing the taste.

column9: The Best and Overall Lowest Carb Count
column10: I try to watch my carb intake and Peter Pan Crunchy has the lowest carb count of all the major brands. (I am speaking of regular peanut butter, not special diet/low carb products.) I am so glad this is back on the market again.
Peter Pan is not available where I live.  This was a good deal to start with and now with the news that the prices will be going up, I'm really glad I got it.

I know taste is a very subjective attribute, but in my opinion Peter Pan is the worst tasting name brand peanut butter there is (both crunchy and smooth). I am literally "in-love" with peanut butter and jelly sandwiches - I eat them every single day (sometimes twice a day)! For this reason I consider myself "familiar" with peanut butter, and out of the 3 or 4 brands I have used regularly Peter Pan is the worst tasting. It seems to have a "plastic-like", chemical, artificial flavor that all the other brands don't have. I bought a case of (12) 18oz. jars and I am struggling to use them up!My favorite PB (both crunchy and smooth)is Jif, with Reese's a close second. Both have a very natural peanut flavor, with the Jif winning due to a slightly better consistency than the Reese's.
I had this tea for the first time at Thanksgiving.  I fell in love with it.  This particular tea has a very pleasing, delicate flavor.  I'm not a big tea drinker, though plan to be now!
i'm not a fan of the other Good Earth teas which i've tried, but i like the rather strong apricot flavor of this
I love this ice hot and even more iced.  Very light and smooth, highly recommend

column9: Perfect balance between ginger and apricot!
column10: I love the beneficial effects of ginger teas, but most of them are way too strong.  Good apricot teas with authentic flavors aren't widely available.  Although green teas are nice, the ginger flavor always overpowers the delicate green tea flavor.Imagine my joy when I happened upon Good Earth's Apricot Ginger Black Tea!  Nothing else comes even close to matching the satisfying flavor (not too sweet, which is gross!) and stimulating feel of good ginger, especially satisfying in cold weather when throats and nasal passages need soothing.  Simply inhaling the moist steam from my cup of tea brings a smile to my face and helps me breathe easier.I brew this tea at 175 degrees Fahrenheit, which keeps it mellow and wonderful, even if I leave the teabag in my cup longer than intended.  This tea still tastes good brewed at temperatures as high as 195 degrees.  Whenever I need a vacation from winter, up north here in the frozen midwest (only hours south of the Canadian border), I brew a cup of Apricot Ginger tea, close my eyes, and -- presto! -- I'm lounging in a Mediterranean resort.  No jet lag, no lost baggage, no metal detectors or pat-downs!  Life is good!  ";-}
Purchased this (and several other flavors) for my employees and customers.  They all like the flavor and I will definitely reorder.

I ordered these yellow and white swirled lollipops for my daughter's birthday party and they were a big hit with the kids. They look exactly like the picture shows, however I had to take a star because they didn't taste like lemon at all.

I am a Dad that makes my kids lunch every day. As most parents in my situation know-- it is a delicate balence trying to find healthy products the kids like and finding a way to make a couple lunches without spending half the night doing it!This product pretty much fits the bill. My kids would complain that their PB&J sandwich would get soggy by the time they ate it at school. So now, rather than actually making the sandwich for them-- I give the kids two slices of bread, this single serve peanut butter pack (together with a similar single serve jelly pack I bought on Amazon as well)-- a plastic knife to "spread it on themselves-- and they have a freshly made-not soggy- sandwich for lunch that they make themselves.This is a timesaver, a healthy alternative-- and it tastes good.

Good, quality product in convenient packaging.  Recently purchased these to take on family vacation, since I like peanut butter with a variety of things but did not want to be burdened with a large jar, knife, etc.  I thought these were reduced fat, but in any event, the peanut butter tastes great and the packets are so convenient.

column9: Great for people on the go!
column10: These little individual serving cups are perfect for someone who's on the go and doesn't have time to mess with scooping peanut butter out of a large jar. I just grab my fruit, grab a cup of peanut butter and I'm good to go! These would probably be great for a child lunch also!

These are super for Personal PB & J's.  One thing is portion control to help with my weight.  Another thing is there are some whenever I want PB & J and nobody's scarved it up, a big problem in my house.  Anyway,  I ordered this and some Welch's packs on Tuesday, it shipped immediately, and was here on Wednesday!  The kids love them too.

These are excellent cookies, we've been eating for years. But the $59.99 price is a rip off to the public, I wonder how these people sleep at night !  Gave 1 star for price otherwise I would give 5 stars...........

I received the purchase in a timely manner, however, I did not realize that a month from my purchase date that all of my order would be expiring.  As a result, I have to throw out the or serve stale water.  I hope the vendor will express the expiration dates in the product information.

I really enjoy African coffees and particularly the Ethiopian varieties. The medium roast was probable appropriate for this bean, but the roasting was very inconsistent which gave it a green coffee bean flavor.  It was reasonalby priced but not worth buying.

Discovered this sauce on a trip to Belize. It was on every table at the resort restaurant and with good reason. As opposed to many sauces that simply add heat to a dish, Marie Sharp's Belizean Heat adds a great flavor. There are many products in her line, but Belizean Heat has become a staple on our table at home. There are hotter products available, but none combine the all the aspects as well.

column9: Great snack with a cup of tea
column10: When I was working I used to buy the small snack packs of these and keep them in my desk for a snack on my break.  They became quite popular, and started disappearing as people found out that I had them and where I kept them.  Not a problem, I like sharing, but now that I'm retired I don't have to share.I buy the big box simply because of cost and in an effort to create less trash.  They're convenient and tasty and GREAT with a cup of tea.  I'm on auto-ship so they come without my having to even think about it.  Great price, too, cheaper than the supermarket.  I used to make my own crackers but the peanut butter would go bad before I used it all up.  With the packages like this I never have to worry about stale peanut butter again.Only 4 stars because I like Keebler Townhouse Crackers better.  Small sacrifice for great convenience and savings.
After the peanut butter scare, we threw them all away.  I guess someday we'll be able to start eating them again.

I was reluctant to pay so much more for cinnamon but the taste difference is amazing.  Cassia cinnamon reduces sweetness according to my taste buds but this cinnamon greatly enhances the flavor.  I can't tell if it enhances the sweetness or just doesn't reduce it but I love this product.  Considering that most people do not use a large amount of cinnamon I would not be deterred because of the price.  If it came in smaller quantities without a significant increase in price-per-unit it would be even better.DCP

I've always been using cassia cinnamon to make cakes, cookies and rolls. Then I read about ceylon cinnamon, which is healthier and taste sweeter. ceylon cinnamon, or true cinnamon, gave me the impression that it should smell so much better than cassia cinnamon. However, I somehow find the fragrance not as pronounced as cassia cinnamon. It is still good though. Maybe I'm more used to the smell of cassia cinnamon.
I was pleased with the order.  There is a definite difference between this and "fake" cinnamon. Taste fresh.  i just hope a pound will last for a while.  I put it in everything I can.

I have been taking cinnamon medicinally for many months now; however, in some of my research I found that the cinnamon I buy in the grocery store was not the kind that helps lower/stabilize blood sugar. I read that it was the Ceylon cinnamon that did this, so I ordered it. It is actually more mild than the grocery story kind, a little grittier, and it has a sweet taste. I use a spoon of this along with the same amount of turmeric (that I ordered from the same company), milk thistle, a liquid multi-vitamin, and water every morning. I feel this improves my health. I was a little concerned that there was no inner or outer safety seal on this product. The turmeric had and inside safety seal. I called the company and they said there was a freshness seal, but that is not the same as a safety seal.

This is wonderful cinnamon.  It is so much better than the regular ground cinnamon we find in our every day stores in the U.S.  This ceylon cinnamon is not bitter like the regular cinnamon.  I recommend everyone at least try this Indus Organic Ceylon Cinnamon Powder.  I will be ordering more because my husband and I love it.
I purchased Ceylon Cinnamon for myself and friends.  We use it in coffee, cereal, chocolate drinks.  It has helped my friend with diabetes.  It makes a nice light flavoring in many things.

The best I have tasted! Love it.Very tasty, the woody flavor is different than the cinnamon you buy else where. Not sweet at all which is one of the main reasons why I like it so much. It does not taste like extra added ingredients.I bought two tubs and have plenty, but hope in the future I will still be able to find Ceylon cinnamon, I don't think I could go back the the other one again.I recommend this cinnamon to everyone.
Great tasting organic cinnamon that tastes great. This is the real deal, and I highly recommend it to anyone and everyone.
I have used this spice for several years. Very good taste. Good product. I recommended this as one of the best cinnimons available. Always great shipping from Amazon!
Product was not good at all.  This is not a very useful product at all. I wish I never bought this item.

column9: Another fun shape for a gluten free pasta junkie...
column10: As a self proclaimed pasta junkie... gluten free for six years already... I have tried a lot of them over the years. This one is a really good corn pasta. I love the added shape option as it holds sauce and other bits of goodness in it's shell.
My 3 mini dachshunds love these. Especially the youngest dog-- with his high energy level, this keeps him occupied for hours. Highly recommended to keep them 'busy'!

column9: Absolutely wonderful for high-fiber oat-bran muffins!
column10: I discovered this oat-bran raisin cereal when at my mother's - it is not available in my area.  As a cereal, it is better than most oat-bran cereals we've tried, with nice crunchies mixed in with the flakes.  But it isn't what I reach for first to pour in my bowl for cereal.
