Yes, these noodles are dried.  But they are also SO much better than anything else on the market.  Amd much less expensive than others online.  The Amish make some great food.  A shame I guess that you have to live close to them to enjoy it.  I live close to a Mennonite restaurant and they have the most awesome and reasonably priced food.  Just me I guess, but if they are closer to God than we are, than maybe we should listen because then God gives them the most awesome food.

I have always made my own egg noodles but decided recently to make a stab at buying off the shelf, most have always left me wanting more, not tasty at all.  The Amish Kitchen noodles are the best I've ever eaten and that includes a lot of brands.  My husband raved over these (he doesn't do that over my homemade noodles doggone) so they have to be good, no not good, they are dee-licious!

First off, the taste and overall noodle-like properties of these noodles are pretty good.  But!  If you're like me and grew up in Ohio and Amish noodles are a staple of your diet these don't hold a candle to the vast majority of Amish noodles out there.  The biggest problem I have with them is their thickness; they're about half as thick as other brands you'll commonly find like "Homestyle Noodles" and "Country Pasta".  Ultimately, for things like soup and such these noodles don't hold up nearly as well as the others (you end up with noodle mush compared to a soup you can keep in the fridge for days with the noodles staying al dente).  Also, be advised the the bags here are 12oz vs. the 16oz bags of the two afore mentioned brands.  Ultimately, if you can't get comparable noodles near you (which is almost impossible considering I live in the middle of Wyoming at moment and our Wal-Mart carries Country Pasta) give them a shot; but in all honesty these aren't worth your money and you'll end up being stuck with 12 bags to eat.

These are the most tasteless noodles I have ever had.  I thought they would be good, but they have NO taste whatsoever.  I have to donate them to the commoditiy kitchen.  Shame, should not have ordered them.

I've been experimenting with various homemade soup and chili recipes in my crockpot this fall and winter, and was looking for a hearty noodle for chicken noodle soup.  I thought I'd give these a try, and WOW...are they good!  They cook up without sticking together and hold up well in soup, even after being frozen and reheated.  I keep 2-1/2 cup portions of various homemade soups in my freezer for a quick lunch, and this is one of my favorites.  Great price, too!

I was looking forward to rather substantial noodles (as advertized, home-style noodles), but these are very thin.  When they are cooked they have a tendency to glob together because they are not more substantial.  They did not meet my expectations.

column9: good but not what I meant to order
column10: I think I ordered the wrong noodles.  I thought home-style meant that I was ordering thick noodles, but these are normal-thickness noodles.

anything from the amish clan is going to be good "eatin" but the advertisement stated these noodles were wide and they are hardly wide!  at best, maybe medium.  i always get their kluski noodle and these wide ones are about the same size.  i was very disappointed in this product from an advertisement standpoint.wide should be WIDE!

column9: Great Sweet, Fresh Taste in a Handy Size
column10: I love the taste of fresh sweet corn. That isn't always possible. This green Giant Super Sweet Yellow and White Corn is a great option! It's handy and just the right size for me. It tastes fresh and sweet. It really needs nothing. Just heat it up and serve.

This product is delicious.  It's so crunchy.  It contains 100 calories per serving.  Has protein!  Carbs are moderate and fat is low.  I am on a closely supervised medical weight loss program and this is a real treat you don't have to feel guilty about.
This is a super healthy snack and tastes great too! Came when promised and in good condition.  Would buy from this store again.

If your a huge Torani Sauce User get this!  i use it for my White Chocolate Sauce and it keeps it from dripping eveywhere!  Amasing product and easy to clean and put on the sauces.  You can also leave it on like a lid.  I dont ever take mine off and I just pump new everymornign and you dont get that hard build up in it either!  I would recommend this to anyone!

column9: good fit for my Da Vinci chocolate sauce
column10: The pump is sturdy and fits well Da Vinci sauce bottles as stated. If you put this in your new syrup bottle be careful to use some of it first. Otherwise, it will overflow and spill. I only wish Amazon would sell this to have a chance of free shipping since you end up paying almost as most for the shipping as the cost of the item.
This works okay but is a little hard to keep pumping. Probably because the sauce I use it for is so thick. It serves the purpose tho!

column4: Jessica A. Canty "Homeschooling mom to three ...
column10: These pumps will drip for half an hour after you use them. They made a huge mess and I had to keep a bowl underneath them to catch what was wasted. I don't even want to think about how much of my sauce ended up on the counter top. I took these off after just a few days and threw them away.

I wouldn't recommend this product as after each use it drips constantly. You will end up losing too much of your syrups if you use this. If you don't mind it dripping and wasting most of your syrups, then it will serve its purpose.
Like this except for the post use drip!  I almost wish the end had a cap so it would stop the drip and likely stop the clogs I have read about in some of the other reviews.

bought in in conjunction with a big bottle of Torani chocolate syrup. the pumper is sturdy and it disassembles with a threaded cap just above the cap where it attaches to a bottle. I had to clip off about one cm of the intake straw that goes inside the bottle. it is rather ridged and would not flex and the cap was put in a bind that created a concern it would crack the plastic. I used those scissors that can cut pennies in half, clipping off small increments so it would be as close to the bottom as possible. I was so pleased to see the pump came apart for cleaning, my experience from coffee shops are these things are going to clog. Its the nature of such a thick chocolate. Now I know I wont have to pull the straw out of the bottle to clean it, just the pump part. When I placed it in the bottle, I did not just shove it in since another reviewer mentioned it would over top the chocolate out of the bottle, but I put it in a bit, then pumped out some of the air then there was no problem with extra sauce.

The pump fits the Torani Sauce bottle without a problem.  But it seems to randomly drip a little syrup after you use it.  We keep it on a paper plate to catch the drips which is not ideal, but it works.  Like another reviewer mentioned, you need to pour out a little sauce first to prevent overflow.

This sauce pump works adequately with the larger Torani sauce bottles.  I'm only giving four stars because I find it clogs pretty frequently with the Torani Mayan Chocolate sauce.  While this is probably more due to the nature of the sauce, it's still worth noting that if you do not use this every day, you'll likely have to clear clogs fairly often.
As long as you clean the pump a out once a week, it works fine. The syrup is so thick that it gums it up if not

column9: took a long time -- not for caramel sauce
column10: First of all, I bought these with prejudice.  I'd recently purchased Starbucks sauce and syrup and they included the pumps at no additional cost.  I got spoiled.So I didn't think to order pumps when I bought Ghiradelli and Torani sauces through Amazon.After reading reviews and looking at prices, I bought these.  Disappointed.Got a workout pumping the Torani Pumpkin Pie sauce.  But eventually it came out.Broke a sweat pumping the Ghiradelli Caramel sauce so I left it alone for a while.  Thought the problem could be because the stem is too long.  So, I cleared away the caramel and trimmed off 3/8".  Pumped some more for about two minutes and got a weak cough from the spout.  I thought to myself, "it won't be long now."  Except now, the pump doesn't even rise.  Got annoyed and started writing this scathing 1-Star review.  Looked over and saw the pump came back up and gave it another go.  Voila, caramel sauce.Changed the review to three stars for making me have to work -- Oh, and for the packaging or lack of; I'd expect them to be individually cellophane sealed instead of open in an envelope.*edit 02/03/12Knocked it down to 2-stars.  Like another reviewer wrote it's not good for thick sauces, it definitely isn't.  The stem and spout are just too narrow.  I have to apply great pressure, put my body in it, to pump the caramel sauce.  Too much work getting my morning coffee.  I will spend more for the right pump.

column9: Just a bit too small for thick syrups
column10: I like this pump pretty well. My only complaint is that for the thicker syrup (chocolate) that I have it doesn't always want to pump the syrup very well. The issue is that the chocolate dries at the end of the spout after a day or so and when you go to start pumping it again it's very slow and difficult. It's a mild annoyance, but I do wish I had gotten one that was just a bit bigger.

This Pump does not really fit the 64oz. Ghirardelli bottle...it is too long for the bottle.  It's possible to push it down and twist it on, but the end of the tube is laying against the bottle, it doesn't go straight down.  It works for what it needs to do, but I wish it really fit the bottle.
This does not fit the Davinci chocolate syrup bottle as they claim. It doesnt screw on all the way. completely useless! I contacted the seller but have received no response.
As always Jacobs coffee delivers on aroma and taste..No american coffee compares. My favorite coffee. You will enjoy this flavorful coffee.

Coffee arrived damaged.  Damage was from one pound of coffeelosing the vacuum packaging.  This damage occurred from handling at the warehouse where three pounds of coffee was grouped for sale.  Dispute the damage the coffee tasted ok.

Second German-made coffee product we have tried. This one was just as good as the first, best decaf that we have tried.  Highly recommend Jacobs Kronung Decaf. Pricing from Amazon was the best we could find on the internet and delivery was quick.

I first tried Jacobs probably twenty years ago when some friends sent it to me from Germany.  It is smooth, rich coffee, not bitter like so many brands I have tried.  I am hooked on this and any German coffees for the rich mellow flavor.  This is also very affordable.

column9: I really wanted to like this coffee
column10: I was so disappointed with the freshly opened bag whiff test. My first thought was that it was the same flat smell as opening a can of Folger's---not a good sign. I've yet to make a consistant cup of coffee from it. Every cup tastes a little different and not in a good way.I will not be buying this ever again. And I SO wanted to like this from other reviews I read. I've lived in Europe. I know good coffee. And this ain't it.I'm too frugle to throw it out....maybe I'll make Kaluha. *brightens

I get the sense that this is the Folgers of Germany. Note that Jacobs Kronung Decaf is Made in Germany by Kraft Foods Germany. That being said, this is a flavorful yet mild coffee. It is also quite finely ground... a pleasant surprise for me since I use this daily in my Senseo single serve coffee brewer. Since I prefer a darker roast, I like (not love) this; but I will certainly purchase this decaf version again.

Eden is a great ethical company with superior products.  This is one of their few products I wouldn't give 5 stars to only because they are wild blueberries which I don't care for as much as cultivated varieties.  If you haven't had wild blueberries they are smaller and have a different flavor.  As far as wild blueberries go, these are top notch!  My local store charges $8.25 each which would be $24.75 for 3 packages.

These dried blueberries are of a quality that I have not found elsewhere.  The fact that they are wild means they have almost twice the amount of antioxidants that you would find in cultivated blueberries. In other words, this is a super-super-food.And they taste great!  I like to add them to salads, especially ones that I'm serving to little people.  The kids love them.

I eat these on occasion. but they do contain a sweetener and are not for diabetics at all. The flavor is oily because they also add oil to them!I only buy them because i get free shipping from amazon. Other than that I wouldn't. better off to buy a frozen pack if that is what you like. but good in trail mixes!
Although pricey, these are concentrated and a little goes a long way.  I used them to make scones and they were delicious.

These dried blueberries are absolutely the most delicious by far that I have ever tried before and I have tried several different brands. I choose Eden brand because they are sweetened with apple juice rather than cane sugar. For some reason the juice sweetened berries don't make me feel that sugar spike the others do. I use these in my homemade breakfast granola and for just eating out of hand. I HIGHLY recommend them. Wonderful quality. Also, the resealable ziploc bag actually works the way it's supposed to! Very easy to get into and keeps the berries moist after opening. Love the whole package.
Berries are the small wild type described.  Berries go great in homemade blueberry pancakes.  Berries do taste a little like apple juice from the sweetening.
Delicious and, for the nutritional value, a great snack choice! They come tender and juicy with the tartness you would expect. I love these!
These dried blueberries have retained the sweet taste and go well as added flavor to food.

column9: Nice product, but note the size
column10: I bought these b/c neither fresh nor frozen wild blueberries are available where I live. I like that these don't have added sugar, 'evaporated cane juice' (basically sugar juice!), etc. added to them. Although they do have added fruit juice. They're a great snack and great on cereal. Just be aware of how small the packages are. They go quickly. Note- I haven't found any brand of organic, wild blueberries that is less expensive than these.

Y-U-M-M-Y! My kids (almost 3 year-old twins) love these blueberries. I love that the blueberries are sweetened with apple juice not refined sugar. They have enjoyed this product since they were about 15 months-old. Great size for tiny fingers and mouths :o)

I am happy that I've found this product (organic juice-sweetened blueberries) at a good price point. They are delicious but have more oil on them than others I have had in the past (purchased from a natural store in bulk). As I am not able to purchase from a previous, local supplier, I am glad to have these but preferred the less-oily product. I would also love for Eden to offer larger quantity bags.
hello~ every one.This product does not have the date when it was manufactured on it.And then..Can you find expiration date and pack date?

My little one LOVES Eden's cranberries AND cherries, so I was excited to try their blueberries.The pros:OrganicSweetened with fruit juiceThe cons:Uber smallAren't delicious (need to mix with something else to "hide" them so they'll be eaten by either myself of my son)

For me, the flavor of these blueberries is too mild and the texture oily.  I had been buying Fruit D'Or dried wild blueberries but they do not seem to be available locally any more.  In comparison, the Fruit D'Or flavor is really intensely blueberry.  If you like the Eden dried wild blueberries this is a great buy.  It sells at Whole Foods in Philadelphia currently for 9.99 per 4 oz pack.

I have numerous food allergies and got these as a healthy "on the go" snack. Unfortunately, I think the only way I would be able to enjoy them is cooked or baked in something since I don't like their taste "au natural." They are also extremely small and kind of hard to eat because when you put some in your hand, they roll all over the place!
My 1 year old grandson loves these mini M&M's.  Bought the box cause they are hard to find as singles.  Great quality and just enough for his little tummy.

Make no mistake...there is a HUGE difference between Crown Prince canned clams and Crown Prince Natural Smoked canned clams.  I'm pretty sure that when it comes to the nutritional powerhouse that clams just happen to be, most people either are unaware or just don't care how many key nutrients are provided by these little mollusks.  One little 3 oz. tin has 130% of the iron we need in a day and although it isn't listed on the nutritional label, clams are the best source of vitamin b12 on the planet at over 1000% per serving. Certainly not recommending to eat a whole tin everyday for health but half a tin every other day(refrigerate leftovers of course) will do the body good. Simply, put some good old clams = anemia's worst enemy.  Now back to how these clams packed in olive oil annihilate all other canned clams out there. Canned clams, even other Crown Prince canned clams have a knack for providing more SAND than clam. That's right, it's usually a grainy experience.  But not with these CP Natural in Olive Oil. Delicious and actually does this healthy treat some justice. Being a huge fan of the CP Natural canned oysters in olive oil, I just had to try these. It's safe to say those delicious oysters have some new competition breathing down their necks(9 out of ten oysters don't have necks but you get the idea).
Hard to find clams in olive oil vs. cottonseed oil.  These are great!  And cheaper to buy than in stores.

I did enjoy the Crown Prince smoked clams for years (cottenseed oil). They were sand and shell free in the beginning . Over the years, however, these tasty clams contained too much sand and shell to enjoy - spitting out the sandy treat. Surprisingly, these olive oil cans contain the same soft clam taste without ANY sand so far on the fourth can. Love them.

column9: Absolutely the Best Smoked Clams in a Can!!
column10: The Crown Prince Baby Clams are, without doubt, the best smoked clams in a can that I've ever tasted.  They are tender and flavorful and the olive oil acts as an enhancement instead of interfering with their flavor, like sunflower oil does.
better than any other smoked clams that I can buy locally.A bit spendy but I think they are worth it... this is my second order.

Crown Prince Naturally Smoked Baby Clams in Olive Oil, 3-Ounce Tins (Pack of 12)These tender, tasty, baby clams are lightly smoked and packed inolive oil.They are superb!They provide a excellent source of iron and B 12I eat them right from the can or add a touch of freshgarlic.They are also excellent in recipes.I have already ordered 2 more packs!
These clams taste good. I particularly like the lightness of the oil.  It's a handy item to keep for earthquake preparedness, equally good with noodles or plain crackers.

I received a different product. These are NOT "NATURALLY smoked baby clams".  They are "wild caught smoked baby clams". Taste very good. I get an allergic reaction to the oil in this product unfortunately, people with allergies beware: not every olive oil is "pure extra virgin"... Looking for something hypoallergenic with a similar flavor..
Una excelente selección de sales que se pueden utilizar en diferentes platos. Son sales de terminación que vale la pena probar

I really like this chocolate. I'm on a restricted diet and its one of the few treats I get to eat!  I especially like the chocolate cold - so I place them in the refrigerator.  The individual package is great for take along - and is just the right size anytime.

We had a taste test in our family (3 generations at once) and we tried several organic and non-organic chocolates.  The "chimpanzee chocolate" won hands down.  I don't understand why the two negative reviewers decided to write a review when they admit in the review that they don't like dark chocolate?  If you are looking for a chocolate - this is the best tasting according to our family.  (You could also do your own taste test with a bunch of chocolate bars and see if you come up with the same result!)

column9: Awkward packaging distracts from too-crunchy chocolate
column10: There's way too much packaging here for something clearly going for the "green" market.  There's a large recycled cardboard container with 10 small pieces of chocolate wrapped in individual, very hard to open (I have to use my teeth!) paper wrappers.  By the time I've fought my way to the chocolate it would have to be pretty amazing, and it's not.  It's crunchier and not as sooth and creamy as I would prefer, which is a common problem with very dark chocolate.  If it makes a wooden noise when I break it I know it's too hard.  The taste is just fine, and those who like a crunchy texture, and don't mind struggling with packaging would probably be fine with it.

Thus was ordered for someone else that loves the endangered species chocolates...especially the dark. Well, I tried a piece and it was not tasty to me at all. Of course I am not a fan of dark chocolate either so it's no surprise I don't care for it. I think I'll stick with my other chocolates.

When the Senseo's first came out, we started receiving free ones to test various coffees. I admit I'm a bit of a coffee snob and come from a long line of coffee snobs. My Dad roasts his own beans and when you've had fresh roasted? From a high end brewing system? Heaven. We have the latest model and for Senseo coffee having tried everything out there, honestly this flavor is very good. But that's with the qualification of it's Senseo coffee most of which kinda is on par with crappy diner coffee or instant. This is about the quality of Starbucks. Mass produced and flavored, but drinkable. I bought this because we have relatives in town visiting our baby and honestly, they just want a cup of joe when they crawl out of bed and don't seem to mind what it tastes like as long as it's fresh. I don't have the time or patience with an infant to wait on them so this was an easy solution that each person visiting can do themselves when they wake up at various times throughout the morning without risking anyone messing up the fabulous coffeemaker my family gave me over Christmas (these relatives have broken two similar machines in the past....sigh!). I do like the greener pod factor over the plastic k-cups and with going through so much of these, I'd feel terrible filling my recycle bin instead of our compost pile. So an easy fix and a win-win. If you love the Senseo coffee, this is worth it.

I can't seem to make a strong cup of coffee with these pods, even using two at once. The pods fit perfectly, but I think the problem is the pods are packed too tightly or the filter paper does not allow adequate water flow. They seem to swell into a ball shape and the water then flows around the pod and not extracting a lot of coffee. I'm going to try to engineer a fix and will update the review.

Your never going to mistake this for your $5 Starbucks specialty but it is a fast good cup of coffee. It takes a little experimenting with coffee strength (1 vs 2 pods) but once you find your preference you will be happy with this coffee.
I really appreciate this one coffee pod, its not over filled (which makes my senseo POP and water fly out in all directions) flavorful and nice, a great cup of coffee, that i will continue to order!

We gave my husband this single cup coffee maker for Christmas and needed to provide a steady source of coffee and naturally I turned to Amazon and this vendor. The coffe is what we needed and cost was great.....Good deal

The discription of this product is very misleading, the opening line is Java One French Vanilla OOH Pods, 14-Count Pods (Pack of 6)It leads you believe that you are buying a pack of 6 boxes not 1 box.  Also in the discription they list the different flavors of coffee you will be receiving...  I beleive they actually have the wrong info with this item!!
Pods are individually wrapped and dispensed very conveniently from the carton. One pod fits very nicely in the Senseo coffee maker. However, two pods are too thick for the two cup holder.

column9: Robust and strong....like coffee should be
column10: If you like weak, wimpy coffee, then this coffee is not for you.  But if you like strong, robust, tasteful coffee, with a soupcon undertone of bitterness, then Java One French Roast Coffee, 14-Count Pods (Pack of 6) is the best choice that I have found. I used to use Senseo Kona Blend Coffee (10% Kona Coffee Blend), 16-Count Pods (Pack of 6); it was good, but then when Amazon's inventory was temporarily exhausted, I found Senseo Colombia Blend Coffee, 16-Count Pods (Pack of 6) which was stronger. But now, Amazon doesn't seem to carry Senseo brands anymore--or Senseo doesn't sell thru Amazon (which is the former's loss). In any event, I needed coffee that featured pods that would fit my Senseo machine, and I serendipitously stumbled upon Java One French Roast, and I'm glad I did!  Further, the Java pods--unlike the Senseo pods--are individually sealed in air-tight wrapping, which means the coffee stays fresher, longer. Java pods contain a bit more coffee so I have to use the two-cup holder because it's deeper. Java costs more than the Senseos, but, in my mind it's worth it! Try it--you'll like it!

column9: Perfectly fit with Senseo coffee maker
column10: I gave a try with Java One because I want strong coffee than Senseo.Java one is 9 g/pod more than Senseo ( 7 g/pod)and fit perfectly in single brew tray, don't need to press or adjust anything.If you're looking for alternative coffee pod and better taste, Try Java One.
It's just right.  Not overly strong and has the right amount of vanilla flavor.

I like this brand because it makes a good strong pot of coffee without any bitterness or burn taste. It is the only coffee I purchase that is already ground. I'm not sure I've ever seen it sold as beans. Don't let that stop you from trying it. It arrives in a pack of four "bricks" that add up to a little over two pounds of coffee. I would compare it most closely with the Lavazza brand coffee's which I also like.
B004K7AIIIThis is a great tasting coffee. It has a rich flavor and not bitter. To me, it is better than other brands. I ordered this with a subscripton and will continue it.

column9: Not all Tchibo coffee is same quality!
column10: I thought this coffee would be as good as the Tchibo Exclusive Mild coffee.  I was terribly disappointed with the taste ot the Tchibo Gold.  If you like coffee with a great German taste, DON'T BUY THIS TCHIBO.

The Pina Colada flavoring was sweet and had sufficient coconut flavor. However, i still love the "original" confection the best. I would describe this treat to be sweet with a hint of coconut in a chocolate base.
These are the absolute best. But they will not ship to Hawaii so I just have to wait until I find it again at Ross.

column9: good product but looks like they dont sell to canada!
column10: they dont ship to Canada!!!! i would of bought a lot....too bad for them.....they probably dont know where is Canada anyway....good luck in the usa market....i will go shop the world! welcome in 2011!!!

column9: Delicious, but top of bottles came crushed
column10: Pink grapefruit juice is one of my favorites. Unfortunately the bottles were not packaged well. Could not pour without spilling because the top of the bottles were misshapen, I guess something heavy was put on top of them.

Purchased the pink grapefruit version as the white sugar free was unavailable, and previously delicious. This is exceptionally bitter, so a 1/4 tsp of a sweetner takes care of any complaints. Also can be diluted 1/2-1/2 to water and add ice, its refreshing and holds its own in flavor very well.
It tastes great, but its very sweet. The shipping is pretty expensive so you might as well go to BJ's and get these which come in pack of two's for about 9 bucks.

column9: A Little Sweet. A Little Tart. A Little Carbonated. Perfect Fruit Soda.
column10: I'm not much of a soda drinker, but I enjoy a good natural fruit soda in the summertime. Izze offers some unusual flavors to suit a variety of tastes, and their Sparkling Pomegranate is one of the best fruit sodas I've tasted. Pomegranate juice is sometimes described as "slightly sweet, slightly tart", but I always found the pure juice too strong. This soda is perfect, though. The sparkling water dilutes the pomegranate flavor just enough to leave its essence without curling your tongue. It's delicious. It tastes more like fresh pomegranate fruit than pomegranate juice, which is too concentrated. And it's lightly carbonated for extra refreshment. If you like a fruit soda that is flavorful but not very sweet, Izze Sparkling Pomegranate fits the bill perfectly. And it contains no artificial ingredients or caffeine. No sugar added. It's sweetened with fruit juice concentrate. 12 fl.oz. glass bottles.Ingredients: sparkling water, apple juice concentrate, grape juice concentrate, pineapple juice concentrate, lemon juice concentrate, pomegranate juice concentrate, cranberry juice concentrate, carrot juice (color), blueberry juice (color), natural flavor. One bottle contains 120 calories, 15mg sodium, 34g total carbs.

I am a person who doesn't like soda because it's too sweet.  I am also a big fan of pomegranates.  Consequently, I found this drink to be very delicious.  It is a bit sweet, mostly tart, and very refreshing.  It's really a melody of a lot of fruits, but the flavour is definitely pomegranate-ish.  Best of all, I can drink a lot of this without remorse, since it's way better for you than soda.

Izze Sparkling Pomegranite Soda is a mix of apple, grape, pineapple, lemon and pomegranite, and packs quite a tart and sweet punch! It's not a sugar-free beverage, but it is just enough to give you a little lift when you need a little something to get you through your day.Izze is more a juice drink than a soda, and it contains no caffeine or preservatives. Even though it is made from a recipe of blended fruits, it does have an outstanding pomegranite flavor -- very much like tasting the real fruit. It's the perfect beverage to bring with you to work or school and avoid the usual feast of chemicals available at the vending machines or fast food joints!

column9: Puts Standard Fruit-Flavored Sodas To Shame.
column10: The Izze sodas/fruit juices are quite good. They're a bit more expensive but put the standard fruit sodas to shame. They are, after all, 70% fruit juice and shouldn't even be compared to conventional fruit-flavored sodas. I've now tried two, the first was Blackberry and the present is Pomegranate. Personally, I like the Blackberry a slight bit better but the Pomegranate is outstanding. It's tart. I like than. No sickly-sweet sodas for me! The taste is good and nowhere near the taste of pure pomegranate juice. That's okay. It's a nice refreshing drink with a little bite to it and no added sugar. This stuff is excellent. I think I have two more flavors to try.Gary Peterson

Out of all the sparkling sodas that I have ever taste natural and not natural this has to be the most delicous of the bunch.  Everything about this soda is refreashing and you get a serving of fruit in each one, what more could you ask for.  This is my favorite flavor out of the flavors, it just has such a wonderful tart sweet flavor that leaves you feeling so wonderful and relaxed.

*****This Izze Pomegranate Sparkling Soda isn't exactly a soda and isn't a really a juice---it's a healthy alternative drink that's a bit of a combination of the two. It comes in small cans (8.4 oz) and these bottles, which I much prefer.Some pomegranate juices are sour, but this one is tasty and sweeter than most...actually it tastes like real pomegranate pieces (arils) do---perfect! It is a sparkling juice, and sweetened just with real fruit. It contains sparkling water (30%) and a mixture of many different types of fruit juice concentrates for sweeteners---no sugar or sugar substitutes---yay!Highly recommended.*****

When it read "original" I thought these marshmallows would be like the ones you bought before they came out with "jet puffed". These are no different at all and just like the ones at a supermarket, "jet puffed".

I'm glad to see that Amazon sells PETER PAN Peanut Butter in a 28 ounce size that can be ordered individually, especially since stores dont seem to carry PETER PAN in a 28 OZ or 40 OZ jar anymore and haven't in years for some reason, even though most people, including myself seem to prefer PETER PAN to both JIFF and SKIPPY, but perhaps it may be due to SKIPPY and JIFF outselling PETER PAN along with the fact that I haven't even seen a PETER PAN Peanut Butter commercial in years, plus you can only find PETER PAN peanut butter in a 16 ounce jar at the stores, unlike JIFF and SKIPPY which are also sold in both 28 OZ and 40 OZ jars at most grocery stores and even some retail stores like WAL-MART and TARGET.I also have a hard time comprehending why Amazon doesn't sell PETER PAN Peanut Butter in a 40 OZ jar size individually either since Amazon only sells them in a 3-pack, but I just love PETER PAN Peanut Butter along with the fact that PETER PAN was my favorite Walt Disney character and story during my childhood days.

This was blaa, imagine a sponge with a slight coco flavor.  It made a lot but it wasn't quite up to par for cakes.  I liked the idea of the mousse being included so I purchased it.  I won't buy it again.
Moist, rich taste with fluffy chocolate frosting.  I think its great.  People I have served it to thought it was homemade.  I'm sorry that others didn't think so on the Amazon reviews.

O.k., am I an idiot? I am thinking that maybe I made my cake the wrong way. The mousse was so thick and hard to work with that I couldn't even beat it with the beater. It got all stuck all over the beater wands, and then when I tried to spread it on my completely cooled cake, it ripped the cake apart because it was so thick. After I made it I started to think that maybe I should have only mixed one of the two bags of mousse mix included in the package with the milk and used the other bag in the actual cake (which I thought was very dry). I read the directions over and over and nowhere did it say to use one of the bags in the cake so who knows. I don't usually have problems in the kitchen though, so this one has me baffled!!

column9: If you love Rooibos - do try this blend
column10: This Provence Rooibos tea blend is quite delicious. 4oz is enough to make loads of tea. Lots of helpful info about tea making at the company's website, btw. The company gave a discount for the purchase of 3 teas, making this a good bargain. Pleasure doing business with them. Will order again.

Provence Rooibos is my top favorite tea.  Smooth, refreshing, aromatic -- recalls a walk in a flower garden after a rain (sorry to be poetic, but I don't know another way of describing it).  Culinary Teas deliver it promptly and freshly packed.  I highly recommend this product.

column9: Finally found it! We love these
column10: I bought these mint drops as a souvenir for my friends when i traveled to Europe last year. They loved them so much that they asked if I could find some more. After looking around, I finally found these on amazon. I have already gifted these to friends/family a few times.The minty flavor isn't overpowering like other mints in the US (eclipse mints etc). Its just a hint of flavor and very hard. Don't try to bit into it - you might break your teeth.I will buy this product again for sure!
These things are so delicious that I just wrote a review of a granola bar.

I love these granola bar brand and I love chocolate! What I despise is overly sweet chocolate stuff, which these bars are NOT!Rather addictive, which would normally be bad, but since they contains NO HFCS and keep the calorie count down below 200, these are a WIN!

I bought these in NYC during the great blizzard of 12/26/10, to take with me on Amtrak, as my flight home was canceled.  I shared them with my seat mates, and we all thought they were delicious.  Different from regular Nature Valley granola bars, sort of a cross between a granola bar and a candy bar.  As I was packing up to get off the train (after a 9 hour trip!) I still had one pack of 2 bars left, and heard a woman with a french accent ask the snack bar operator if he had any chocolate left.  He said "no", and I handed her my last pack, told her it was as good as a chocolate bar, and left feeling good about sharing something so delicious.

These granola bars are definitely a decadent delicious healthy snack!  I love these more than CLIF bars, which I typically eat.  The dark chocolate and the granola are a superb combination. Get yourself a box today!In regards to nutritional info, the label lists the following (2 bars in a package):190 calories8g of fat0mg of cholesterol140mg of sodium28g of total carbohydrates4g of protein

column9: Great, But the Price Used to Be Much Better
column10: I got addicted to these at the supermarket, as they're relatively healthy and fill my chocolate need. About a year or so ago, I signed up for these via Subscribe and Save, as I found the price wound up being cheaper than getting them at the supermarket -- that was when it was around $15 w/the discount. Now the price basically $25 w/the discount, and it's simply not worth it. Save your money, and buy them on sale at the supermarket for $2-$2.50/box. $4+/box is insane, especially when this is supposed to be a 'bulk' item that saves you money when buying in large quantities.

column9: This is my favorite nature valley flavor ever
column10: I love chocolate, I love oats and I love crunchy food. This is a perfect blend of all I love. Yum!

These oats'n dark chocolate granola bars are really tasty!  Hopefully Nature Valley will keep making them for a long time to come.  I like to crumble granola bars into vanilla flavored yogurt, and am looking forward to doing that with these.

column9: Tastes like chocolate chip oatmeal cookies
column10: Great tasting granola bar that makes a nice snack.  It's my new favorite.  I have not been able to find these in stores.

I love these so much, that I order them from Canada and pay premium price on delivery. I lived in Texas for three years, and started eating those, there.  When I arrived back in Canada, I was so disappointed to find out that we had chocolate ones, here but not this exact kind.  They are still good, but not as good as these little bars full of goodness.  The other flavours are good, too, but nothing comes close to this flavour.
Nature Valley Crunchy Granola Bars, Oats 'n Dark Chocolate, 12-Count Boxes (Pack of 6) - These bars are yummy! They're not too sweet and they have just enough chocolate to satisfy a craving!

I love this flavor (and the PB). I like it warmed so the chocolate is a little melty. The chocolate is well distributed throughout. I like the crunchiness and the fact that the bars are not too thick. Well done Nature Valley!

excellent product, I first bought them a week or two ago from the grocery store where I found them for the first time - so good, now I'm subscribing to them  :-)I usually prefer chewy bars, but these are not super-sweet and have a good cocoa flavor to themsatisfyingly crunchy snack and good for you in moderation, too!2-5-12I "subscribe" to these and they have gone up $1.51 since my last order 3 months ago & $2.75 since 6 months ago!  WTF??10-9-12omg, these are now over $4/box IF you subscribe & get the discount??  what happened?they're cheaper than that at any grocery store even NOT on sale!!!

I like it....I like it. From Amazon, who else? Kind of on sweet side, but real good for average folks. Since I'm a sugar-watcher, I've started making my own. I use one square Amazon's Baker's 100% cacao (Lindt chocolate is good, too) melted in microwave for about 2 minutes over a couple teaspoons of Cheerios, (sometimes adding dried raspberries, cranberries)...a few drops of Amazon's sweetener vanilla creme Stevia in cupcake 2.5 inch paper liners in micro-safe small Pyrex glass. Stir and mix when melted. Then cool. It's a super bar: crunchy, tasty and real healthy!Invented by retired engineer: M. Lucky

column9: Great product, but it is difficult to compare value
column10: These bars are my favorite, and Amazon has three sources. World Wide Sales it turns out is the best value. In all cases, the bars come 2 to a foil pack. World Wide Solutions offering has 6 foil packs per box. Here is where the confusion begins. The box is labeled "12 bars" in the lower left corner and a cartoon bubble on the upper right in the ad says "6 pack". I learned after recieving the order that "12 bars" means 6 servings since I consume the entire foil pack of two thin bars. Furthermore, "6 pack" means 6 boxes each containing 6 foil packs for a total of 36 servings for $28.05. Ordering a quantity of 1 yields 6 boxs, each containing 6 foil packs for $28.05 plus shipping.Cosmetic Solutions sells 9 servings (foil packs) for $14 and Amazon sells 30 servings (foil packs) for $30.

These bars taste fine, and the ingredients are okay too.  However, they are VERY crumbly which makes it extremely difficult to eat on the go without getting chocolaty crumbs all over the place.  The second you open it, crumbs fall.  If you want a quick snack at a "designated" eating area or something for an outdoor excursion, these may be fine.  If you have a habit of eating in your car or at your desk you may want which is less messy, or a large napkin to eat over.
These things are So 'F'ing good!And they were not even all mashed up.Shipped quick. Fantastical product. you will not be disappointed

column9: Great Taste, EXCELLENT VALUE 46c per packet
column10: Like most of us I bought these for a snack. Great for emergency snack to at 190 calories for 2 bars(2bars in one envelope).These bars taste great as most of the reviews agree.Great taste. I love chocolate but these are not overly chocolate flavored.GREAT VALUE: 6 Boxes for $16.5 with subscribe and save. Each box has 6 packets with 2 bars. So, 6 boxes of 6 packets per box = 36 packets = 46cents per pack of 2 bars. Delivered to your door!Basic Nutrition (1 packet of 2 bars): Total fat 8 of 42 grams. Zero cholesterol. 12 of 42grams are sugar. 140mg sodium.  Protein 4 of 42grams. Dietary fiber 3 of 42grams. Protein 4 of 42grams. These won't hurt you and they do not replace a good well balanced meal.Crunchy: These are a messy to eat. When you take a bar out of the packets, crumbs fall out. I solved this by pulling both bars out of the packet over a sink or trash can. Shake loose all the crumbs then put them back in the packet. Problem solved.For those that think these are too crunchy. Try: break off a piece and leave it in your mouth less than one minute then chew. I do this and it works great!I have had these for about a month now and I have just ordered the variety pack and the cinnamon flavor pack from amazon.Enjoy, I do.

column9: Oats & Dark Choc Ganola Bar FANTASTIC
column10: I found my first box of these at COSTCO a couple months ago.  I went back recently and they didn't have them.  I can't believe there hasn't been a single ad about these bars.  They are great!!!  I'm a sweetaholic but I can honestly say that these are soooo good and sooooo satisfying that one package (2 bars) for just 180 calories is a real boost for dieting.  Knowing that you're getting oats, which are great for you, and a good quality dark chocolate (which has the great antioxidants) makes this bar a "no-guilt" wonderful-tasting snack.  Love Them!!
perfect amount of choco and oat mix!  give these a try!you wont regret it!  also, its a pretty good calorie count for theamount of food!

column9: A great taste that doesn't get old
column10: I love finding yummy snacks on Amazon based on reviews.  I've found some great ones, but it usually always goes the same way... Buy it, love it, get sick of it.  I don't find myself getting tired of this one.  It's a great snack, it's not too sweet like many oat bars and its got a nice crunchy/crumbly texture.

I have always loved Nature Valley's Crunchy Granola Bars, but these are something special. The blend of oats and cocoa, along with chunks of dark chocolate, is perfect. My only complaint is that the grocery store that starts with a 'W' is always sold out, while the grocery store that starts with a 'K' doesn't carry them in my area.
Perfect oats and dark chocolate combination, and healthy too!! I use these for energy on my runs and/or gym workouts.

I'm not a big granola bar guy, but these things are crazy delicious!!! At about 200 calories it's the perfect size for a pre- or post- run/exercise snack. I also appreciate that Nature Valley uses truly whole grains instead of the fake whole wheat flour that you usually find in "whole grain" products. I'm about to dig into one as soon as I finish this review, mmm mmmmmmm!!!
These granola bars are now what I worship. They sort of taste like the crisp part of  a kit kat to me.

Unlike some food items this is a good price.  If you would have to pay shipping it would not be a good deal.  You still have to be selective, because not all of these Nature Valley products were priced at a good price.

I was a little wary after reading a few of the reviews, but these things are really tasty. If you like crunchy granola bars and dark chocolate, then these things are for you. If you've had their standard Oat and Honey (or whatever they're called), if add chocolate powder to the mix as well as little chocolate chips, and this is what you'd get.I neither know nor care how healthy they are. But they are tasty, not too crunchy, not too sweet... just right. I didn't order them to automatically repeat ship the first time I ordered, but they will be from now on.

It was my first time trying this granola flavor, and I thought that I like oat, and I like dark chocolate, so it's probably good. It's actually extremely tasty. So glad I bought so many of them during the sale.

column9: Love them and I get my chocolate fix, too!
column10: These are the best!  I have been on Weight Watchers for about 4 months and these calculate at 5 points per 2 bar package.  I love the crunch and the chocolate hits the spot for me.  Yummmmmmy!

column9: Best Tasting Nature Valley Crunchy Granola Bars
column10: I've tried all of Nature Valley Crunchy Granola Bars and this is my favorite. The next favorite is the peanut butter one.

column9: Tasty if it is not Stale
column10: When I originally ordered these bars I thought I was ordering a different product.  I have had Nature Valley before and never really cared for it.  I found the bars to be exceptionally stale and dull.When the product arrived I decided to give it another chance.  It was the Oats 'n Dark Chocolate.  I was pleasantly surprised with what I found.  The bars were not rock hard like the ones I had before.  The product also had a nice light taste to it.  It comes with two bars per packaging so you will have six in each box.  I found that I could eat one, set the other down for a bit, and then finish it later.  I realized that all the bars I had previously were stale.  These bars from Amazon were fresh and new.I am having these bars in conjunction with a slimfast, and working out.  This has allowed me to lose 14 pounds so far.I would recommend these bars to people who can eat bars that have light flavor and like oats.  I am definitely happy with them
I agree this is a fantastic product, Amazon, you are charging way too much.  I just got a box of 96 of them from Costo for $18.99.But thank you Nature Valley for such a yummy, healthy product!
I am praying these will not be discontinued since I haven't been able to find these in grocery stores lately!
These granola bars are great especially for a choc-a-olic, like me.  Am odering more today.

I was traveling last week and happened to drop in a convenience store that had these.  Had never seen them before, so I grabbed a few.  Glad I did, because they're delicious!!The best way I can describe them is like an oatmeal cookie with dark chocolate chips.  Same crunchy texture as the other Nature Valley granola bars.Have looked for them in my local store and can't find them.  Glad to see them here and plan to place an order very soon.  This is possible the best granola bar I've ever had!
These bars are delicious and offer a nice alternative to candy bars when you have a chocolate craving. My kids love them.

These are probably the worst of the product flavor line. I would suggest any other ones besides this one. Though I am not necessarily a proponent for overly sweet treats, these have a very strange flavor to compensate for the "less" sugar added. Though, if you research these, you find that they are full of bad things and that there are much healthier, better tasting options available (Kashi products, etc.). Though if you are loyal to Nature Valley, I suggest the Apple Crisp flavor instead.Don't eat these!
Product came as ordered but it is not good.  Dry, like eating a spoonful of unsweetened cocoa powder.  I cannot even give them away.

column9: Tastes like Cocoa Pebbles in a bar form.
column10: I had tried these a long time ago when I purchased them in the store. The ones I purchased online didn't taste the same to me. These taste more like a granola bar form of Cocoa Pebbles. I don't know if they changed the original formula or what, but I did not like the flavor of these at all. They do have a nice crunch to them, but I'd rather of ordered the plain flavor. I did not like the cocoa flavor in these at all. I dislike them to the point I won't eat them and you can't return grocery items, so I'd recommend trying a box at the store before buying in bulk.

column9: I am neither Hansel nor Gretel
column10: Seriously, this is a very good granola bar--taste, texture, size, etc. I would only suggest that the crumbs be retrained at the factory so that they can restrain themselves from raining down within the package, from the package to the plate, from the plate to the lips, but rather dive happily down upon my taste buds, which, after all, belong to the person who purchased the entire bar for that purpose.
If you like Nature Valley crunchy granola and you like dark chocolate then this is the bar for you. These are delicious!

This dispenser is exactly what you think it is and should be. My girlfriend always wanted one of the soy sauce dispensers they use in restaurants so as a surprise gift i searched for one and found this, the EXACT same dispenser they use one of our local restaurants. If that is the kind of dispenser you had in mind then this is the product for you. However, I would like to note that a month or two after buying this I saw the same dispenser in a supermarket for $2-$3 so I would recommend looking at your local stores if your only buying one of these and not in bulk. All in all though I am satisfied with this product.

column9: Good things come in small bottles!
column10: I have been a Kikkoman soy sauce fan since living in Taiwan. It is the soy sauce of choice even in the pop-up night restaurants that would not pass a U.S. sanitation rating but produce scrumptious food.The small bottles require filling frequently, even here at home in the USA. But even with the large bottles we never refrigerated it. Maybe some little loss from evaporation but no problem. I don't notice any taste loss as some say. The 5 ounce bottles are just right for the table, flow smoothly without dripping, and are very stable when bumped. I'm glad I bought two!Not to leave out the fact that the Kikkoman dispensers evoke fond and tasty memories.
Great size. Dispenses well. There is no cap or lid. If it falls over in the refridgerator(which mine did) what a mess!

I was extremely happy to see that the sellers package was sent quickly and came the 2nd day of the estimated delivery interval they provided. I was unhappy with the product itself. The product was shipped with 30 .625 oz Tic Tac boxes and 18 .5 oz packs. It's not that big of a deal to me, because I still got 48 packs of Tic Tacs which I love. I wasn't aware that the half oz packs were still made so I assume they have been sitting in the warehouse for a while, but it makes a difference in the amount of Tic Tacs you get. Replacing 18 of the .625 oz with the half oz reduces the amount of Tic Tacs by about 3 .625 ounces which is upsetting. You'll get your Tic Tacs but I was cheated out of a few more precious boxes.
I decided to purchase this product online because the stores where I have purchased it previously no longer have it.

I have heard people use buying tic-tacs with a credit card as a sign of fiscal irresponsibility. Imagine paying the full retail price and thirty percent interest on top of that from a nearly maxed out card!

column9: the best beef jerky I've ever had
column10: I'm a salty-snack fiend. I've always liked the dry, salty strips of jerky. I'm a little odd in my tastes in that I like stuff typically dry and crunchy, so sometimes I'll even leave a bag of jerky open and leave it in my glovebox for weeks to get it just right. I am not a big fan of marinated jerky - it's usually just slimy, and you nearly rip your head off biting a piece from it and then your jaw is sore for hours from all the chewing to get the gristle-filled lube-fest masticated enough to swallow safely.During a road trip, I stopped at a gas station and picked up some staples. I knew from experience that the other brands available at this pitstop were jerky's I was not fond of, and so I gave this one a go.This stuff practically melts in your mouth. Marinated, but not greasy. Easy to chew, and no noticable gristle or fat globules. It's not the type of jerky I would have normally gone for, but I'm so glad I did. On the way back from my road trip, I stopped at the same gas station and bought all the packets they had.Beef jerky has gotten so expensive over the years, you'd think they were marinating it in super-unleaded gasoline. This is one bag of beef jerky that you will not think is over-priced once you try it. If jerky were served at gourmet restaurants, this would be the brand to serve. My hat is off to Golden Island Cuisine for re-inventing the ancient art of drying meat to preserve it and making it taste good without pumping it full of MSG and formaldehyde.

Years ago I worked at the company here in California that makes this product. I really loved the flavors of jerky and would always buy the defect bags (misprints, etc.) from the outlet and give them out to friends and they loved the flavors too. The owners of this company have great relationships with their employees and vendors and were extremely picky about the ingredients they used to make their products.

I'll keep this short... this is very different from most brands of jerky, but it's actually quite excellent. It's heavily marinated, but not slimy, and the flavor is sublime. It actually tastes more like high-quality chinese food than standard issue truck-stop jerky, and that seems to be what it's aiming for. It's probably not for everyone, but i'm a full-on convert! I plan to try all their other flavors as soon as I get the chance.To the reviewer who had a freakout about all the so-called chemicals... well, there's nothing in here that's not in most commercial brands of jerky (sodium nitrate, etc), and it's made in california, not "some country where they don't regulate chemical additives" as you'd have us believe.Give it a shot if you're an open-minded jerky fan!

I was very exited to try this flavor, but was a bit disappointed with the experience.  First was the texture; it was a bit off.  Granted, anything cured in sugar is gonna be a bit sticky, but the meat had this "unnaturally" soft texture to it as well(maybe to much preservative and/or texture enhancer).  The flavor was ok, kinda like panda express Orange Chicken.  I was definitely sweet, but beyond that the flavor was bit muddy. Both me and my GF came to the same consensus, which that in itself is a feat.  I definitely like the direction Golden island is taking with their jerky products, and loved their BBQ pork jerky.  But this needs a bit more refining.
It did not taste good at all.  It was if they soak it in the mandarin orange way to long.  It made it soaking and way over powering.

I have tried every piece of chocolate sweetened with Stevia known to humankind. I was on a quest to find the best. This milk chocolate gives you 100% of the pleasure without the sugar and without nasty sugar substitutes like Maltitol. The only problem with this guilt free chocolate is stopping before you have devoured an entire bar and start in on second. It is expensive but if you have a sweet tooth for chocolate and value your health, it's a small premium to pay. This milk chocolate is highly recommended. I would give this chocolate six stars if I could.... and the customer service is GREAT!UPDATE: I realized these bars are NOT sweetened with just stevia. I looked at the label and wondered what in the world is erythritol... A little work on google gave me my answer. Erythritol is Maltitol-lite. Needless to say I am disappointed and changed my five star rating to four. For me Erythritol is about 50% better than Maltitol with regard to digestive issues. So I can eat more of this chocolate than I could Maltitol sweetened chocolate but eating more than a few bites is not good for me. Your personal mileage will vary :-)) My quest to find the best stevia sweetened chocolate bar is not over.
Good snack when you need a quick pick up. Also gives the feeling of fullness. Will be trying other flavors. Great price and quick shipping!
We bought these for a financial class, with the theme being "saving your life" and saving for life. They went over well for the mixed crowd.
The roe in red Capelin caviar is very tiny. While okay on crackers, with or without cream cheese, we found that it makes a really nice taramosalata.  My husband liked it also with creme fraiche.
You think you are getting some quality smoked salmon, but mostly you are getting a bunch of canned salmon products (7 cans). Just a little actual smoked salmon. For the price, kinda disappointing.

column9: The Kettle Corn for people on Weight Watchers
column10: This Kettle Corn is only 1 point per serving.  All the other "low fat" kettle corn I have found is 2 or even 3 points per serving.  It is salty-sweet, flavorful, and I can munch to my heart's content, knowing I'm still "on program".  A great evening snack!

column9: Guilt-free popcorn with a great taste!!
column10: It has become difficult to find this yummy, guilt-free snack in the local grocery, but I love it!  The solution?  I bought a case on line.  I saved money, it was delivered straight to me, and I'm always prepared for the munchies.Jolly Time Healthy Pop Kettle Corn Microwave Popcorn, 3-Count Boxes (Pack of 12)
I watch what I eat and love to eat a lot! 5 cups of this is only 1 weight watchers point and it tastes GREAT!!!
This stuff smells good and tastes fine at first but it is way too sweet and leaves that aftertaste of fake sugar. No thanks.

I love this stuff, although after eating a few bags, I'm getting a little tired of it. I've tried tons of other "light" kettlecorn and they didn't come close to this one. It doens't have that fake sugar taste that so many do, in fact I checked the bag to see if it was made with real sugar, but it's not. Of course, right after I bought an entire box of it, it started showing up on grocery store shelves...

For some reason, can't find this in stores in the Youngstown, Ohio area.  Marc's used to carry it but no longer does.  Marc's does carry other flavors of Jolly Time, but not Healthy Pop Kettle Corn.  I used to live in New Jersey and found it everywhere.  In desperation, I checked Amazon.  What DON'T they carry?  When I joined Weight Watchers many years ago, this was suggested as a low points, high fiber snack.  I love the taste.  Can't live without it.  Just hope that by the time I get to the end of the case, there aren't any freshness issues.  Love this stuff!

I'm a kettle corn fanatic and have to watch my weight, so the two problems are always at odds.  I've tried every low-calorie kettle corn on the market and this is the one.  I can't say it's as good as the real thing (NOTHING is as good as the real thing . . . sticky and hot and sugary and . . . but, oh, I digress) . . . but this one comes the closest and completes my daily need for an hour of curling up with a good book and a bowl of kettle corn.
My fav type of healthy kettle corn.Only around 250 calories for the whole bag.Sweet, salty and flavorful.Great price, speedy delivery.
Orville Reddenbacher smart pop kettle corn tastes much better.  Spend the extra couple of dollars.

I recently bought a box of the Jolly Time kettle corn popcorn because the store was out of our favorite brand.To be concise Mrs. Spudman and I did NOT have a jolly time eating this popcorn. It's excessively salty and tastes nothing like the kettle corn popcorn we are used to. It's so bad that even splitting a bag, we couldn't finish eating this one bag of popcorn. Treat it wasn't. Even Piper our begging shih tzu turned her nose up when offered a few pieces.Maybe we got a bad batch, but I'm not willing to buy more of this disastrous snack to find out for sure.

I got this because of the reviews but let me just say that after having my first bag...this stuff is definitely overrated.I'm going to compare this with the Orville Redenbacher (OR) light/98% fat free kettle popcorn that I usually get. This pops great and has very few unpopped kernels, so in that aspect they're about even. But the taste is way different. The Jolly Time doesn't taste as good and it is way too salty for kettle corn flavor. It's like they took normal salted butter corn and sprinkled some splenda into it. Half way through, I was on salt overload. Texture wise, the Jolly Time is not as fluffly either. So there is less fluffy white and more hard bits.I'm sure if you have never eaten microwave popcorn before, then this would be quite acceptable. But in comparison to other brands, it lacks. This was definitely a disappointing purchase that I will have to slowly eat...for many many many months. Since there is a plethera of selection out there, I doubt I would buy Jolly Time again.Also, it took Amazon 10 days from date of purchase to get it to my door. What is up with that?I think this product deserves 3 stars but I'm going to give it 2 because of the slow shipping and because the average rating should come down a bit. 4.5 stars is too misleading.

I bought this first because it was so much healthier (less sugar, calories, etc) than my normal grocery store's other kettle corn brand. I keep buying it because it is probably the most delicious popcorn I've ever had. It's very sweet but not overdone. The popcorn pieces themselves seem to be larger than most other brands I've seen (kettle corn or otherwise) and this makes the small package surprisingly filling. There were times when a bag of popcorn substituted for a rushed meal and I felt just as full.Other reviewers state that they like Orville Redenbacher's kettle corn better, but I bought their smart-pop option and for me Jolly Pop wins hands down. The Redenbacher felt like a chore to eat because I felt compelled to use up the box before buying something else.
Jolly Time Healthy Pop is a tasty low-calorie kettle corn.  My husband and I like it a lot.  We do prefer it packaged as 100-calorie packets.
I use to buy ACT II Kettle Corn but it wasn't in stock so I decided to try Jolly Time Healthy Pop Kettle Corn. I'm so glad I did because its delicious. I'll purchase this brand in the future.

I really like this popcorn and go through it so fast, although Orville Redibacker's smartpop version is better. If you're looking for the tradional kettle corn however, don't order it. It's not as sweet and does not have all that oil that makes the true kettle corn flavor so it may not be what you're looking for.

I make soup all the time from scratch or mixes, and this is one of the best!  Not too many instructions out there...this is how I do it:  Put the contents of the bag in a large pot (the one you intend to cook in).  Add 64 ounces plain water, cover with lid and place in refrigerator 24-72 hours.  It doesn't get soggy, and since these are whole and unmolested seeds (i.e., living) they keep, and may even begin some of the beneficial enzymatic processes of germination.  I put it in the fridge Friday night and make it Monday.Anyhow, after the soak remove from fridge and add 64 ounces chicken broth (I use Swanson, but whatever you feel).  Add four chicken bullion cubes and one-half to one teaspoon each of the following (to taste):  basil, oregano, italian seasoning and garlic powder.  Add one softball-sized onion, chopped, and two carrots, also chopped.  Add two de-boned skinless chicken thighs, trimmed of fat and cubed.  Salt and pepper to taste...  Bring to a boil, hold for about five minutes, lower heat and simmer for about two hours.  Let cool for a time, then serve.I was genuinely surprised how good this came out, considering I really didn't add much to what came in the bag.  Delicious, healthy, and for less than $10 a pot this is a lot of food for the money.  Plus, there's a ton of room for creativity and your own spin on things.  I'm going to try something different with each bag now that I have a baseline.  I think the most important aspects are some degree of presoak, 128 total ounces of liquid and some small source of fat.  The chicken thighs above (post-trim) add just the right amount...if you're going vegetarian or using very lean meat consider adding a touch of olive/sesame/pumpkin seed/sunflower seed oil (any or all!).Best of luck, and have fun!
