This product turned out to be really fulfilling.  It has diverse ingredients and they are very good for you.  I will purchase this product again.

Unlike some of this companies soup mixes, which i'm sure are also excellent, this soup is a more complex mixture of ingredients, making it more convenient to not have to mix it yourself from the underlying grains.

column9: Thick soup, a bit too thick
column10: We enjoy thick soups. The Bob's Red Mill Whole Grains and Beans Soup Mix takes thick a bit too far. I followed the instructions carefully, but the end result required diluting. When refrigerated, it congealed completely. I added water and microwaved, and the result was fine. I would prefer not to have to go through that process of continued diluting.

One of my dogs tore his ACL and had to have TPLO surgery which has a 12-week recovery period. I knew I needed something to keep him occupied so I ordered a bunch of Made in America treats off of Amazon.  This one is his favorite. He was so excited when I was opening the box.  He spent a hour chewing on it and was a dog again. I was so happy to find something he enjoyed so much since he can't run right now.  He growled at his sister the whole time to make sure she didn't steal his rawhide.  She got her own rawhide and also chewed it for an hour.  It was a nice break for me because I didn't have to watch him so much while he was enjoying his treat.  I'm glad I have 10 of them. We may actually make it through the 12-weeks with these chews!

Bought this thinking this would taste like real papaya chunks. I make papaya smoothies all the time and these were not good at all. It might be the syrup or something but it just didnt taste like papaya at all.

column9: not able to rate....item returned to sender
column10: This product was returned since I intended to order canned mango, which was and has not been available, but still appearing on the web site.  I have not yet received a refund for the papaya yet, and am wondering when that will occur.

I was very unhappy with this product. It was extremely flat and took 3 weeks longer than I was told it would take. Customer service was ok. I was refunded for the items but even after they said it would be here the next day it still took another week after to receive it.
the cheese was the greatest and it is always my favorite cheese. It is the one in the red package and if you love sharp chedder cheese, this is the one for you.....
My guest thought the candy was cute for my baby shower. One thing that sucked was some bags came with 2-1 pieces. I didn't have enough time to order more. I made do what I had.
I have a coffee maker that grinds my coffee beans.  It's hard to find whole bean decafinated coffee.  When I find it in the brand that I like, I am excited.  Seattle's Best is my favorite.

I'm by no means an expert, so this is only my own personal opinion, but as a Lapsong Souchong fanTeas Etc. puts out a quality product.  It has a fairly pungent smoky pine flavor, as well as an almost fatty richness to it as well (way better than it sounds!).  This may not be the tea for everyone, but this stuff got me through a cold and rainy winter in a drafty old house with no central heating.  Definitely worth trying, especially for this price.

If you buy this tea to drink, you may or may not like it.  I don't think I would use it for a beverage, but I didn't buy it for that purpose.  I bought it to use for cooking.  I brewed a few cups of this tea and boiled small 3 inch potatoes in it.  It gave the potatoes a lightly smokey scent/flavor.  They were delicious.  I want to use it for a base for potato soup/chowder next.  It has a bit of an overwhelming smoking scent when you are brewing it, but only has a mild scent and flavor when it is used as a food base.If you want to cut out the fat and calories from using smoked meat in your soups or just want to give your food a light smokey flavor/taste.  Try this!  I like to experiment with food and I really think this is a good product for adding flavor.

I've ordered most of the cheaper Tea's Etc add on teas and all have been great both in terms of flavor AND value. I cold brew using disposable tea filters closed with toothpicks in Takeya Airtight Drink Maker Pitcher / Jug, Set of Two and it works wonderfully (Those jugs are great, even better if you can still find them half price at Costco.)This is a Chinese black tea, but it's not as full flavored as most others in the same category. I think this is do in part to the fact that it's been SMOKED! This detail wasn't in the product description when I purchased it, but it was immediately noticeable when I opened the bag. It brews quite a bit lighter than most black teas and has a milder flavor, but it definitely tastes and smells smokey.If you're looking for a well priced black tea that's a little different, give this one a shot.

What happened was I ordered Coconut butter.. Never had cashew butter before in my life. So when i Got it I was like, WHat the heck!! But I decided to try it, Wish I had a camera on my face, cause I was INLOVE the second I tried it, so incredibly creamy... This is something I want to have on hand always.. I love the people at Artisan, they are very sweet, it's professional AND Courteous..  It was a mistake that I benefited from Greatly!! Try it, you will LOVE IT!!

I love this unrefined Sugar in the Raw and thought buying it in packs of six would save me money, but after I received and opened my 6-pack a friend bought 6 individual 32oz boxes at Walmart for a total of $16.98. Same Brand, Same Size and it is Walmart's regular price which I discovered they always have in stock!Sugar In The Raw/Unrefined, 32-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)

Very difficult to buy in the local stores so its handy to have 6 boxes show up at my door-- my daughter and her husband use it in their coffee and cereal-- .SUG50319 - Sugar In The Raw Sweetener, Not Bleached, Molasses Flavor

column9: Raw sugar with a delicate flavor
column10: This raw sugar has a very light golden color and a delicate flavor. It tastes much like regular refined sugar, which may be what most people are looking for.If you're looking for a raw sugar with a real-deal, authentic fresh cane juice flavor, I recommend Wholesome Sweeteners Organic Turbinado Raw Cane Sugar.
Dont buy it from here. The price is double compered with Walmart or Target. this sugar is very good for coffee, and tea
Great product.  But now I noticed my local supermarket carries this also.  This is no bargain from Amazon.

I love this sugar in my coffee and tea- nothing else beats the taste.  You can probably find a better price than this, though.  A 32-ounce box of Sugar in the Raw goes for around $2.50-$3 at my local Wal-mart, so definitely shop around before you buy.

I love this sugar. It tastes better than the refined stuff and it's better for you. I tried this in my Starbucks coffee once and have been hooked ever since. I saved a ton of money getting this 6 pack on Amazon. And I it will probably last me the rest of the year.

I used to buy this sugar for years. I do not eat much sugar, but still. This sugar is called turbinado sugar, but is misleading. I picked this brand just because it says real turbinado sugar, and other brands (in the local food store) that their sugar is brown because it is colored with caramel or something.HOW did i find out? I needed just a sweet water few days ago. I put this Sugar in The Raw in the glass. The water became brown and on the bottom of the glass i got just PURE WHITE SUGAR CRYSTALS!!!!! What a shame on the producer! U can try to put this sugar in your mouth and after few seconds you will spit out pure white crystals as well.I'm just wondering if the consumers can hold the company liable for such a practice.

Sugar In The Raw has been around for over twenty years and is still a great product.  Refining sugar has never made sense to me, as food is best when minimally processed.  Unlike brown sugar, which is made of white sugar and molasses recombined, raw sugars are not separated and recombined.  Sugar In The Raw, unlike brown sugar is not sticky and easy to measure.  Less processing of foods preserves more of a foods vitamins and minerals in their original form.  Sugar In The Raw makes fine tapioca and pumpkin pudding and requires no additional time.  tapioca made with raw sugar is slightly darker looking and richer tasting.  Makes good hot chocolate when mixed with powered baker's chocolate and milk.

Raw sugar is with out a doubt much better than processed white sugar. It tastes better having never been bleached (Yuck!) and is better for you. I only use raw sugar unless I have to use white (some baked goods require white sugar to turn out right). If you're trying to be more healthy and stay away from processed foods, Sugar In The Raw is a great way to do that, especially since the raw sugar tastes BETTER than regular! Makes it very easy to make a responsible choice.

column9: Why would you use use regular sugar you can get RAW SUGAR?!
column10: This is the best - I am a sugar lover but with raw sugar you don't use as much and everything taste better.  I have to think with knowing that you use less that for 1 thing you're getting more for your money and a lot more of a good taste of everything you like to eat and drink!  Myrt Meetze

Hmm. Seems that know one knows that  "raw" sugar is sugar refined to 95  percent purity.  There is no more nutritional value in raw sugar than in the more refined white table sugar. Whether "raw", "brown, or "white" they are all bad for your health.

For years this has been our favoite sugar.  Wife totally substituted regular white sugar with this and tastes much better.  Only thing I didn't like was the expense.  This is about 1/3 cheaper than our local store.

Close to the same price in Walmart per box, but free shipping if you join Amazon Prime membership, and it was prompt and packaged great. Love this sugar, once you begin using, bleached white sugar seems sickeningly sweet.
I only use Sugar in the Raw, and this is a great way to get it and have it on hand!
My husband wont put ANYTHING else in his coffee- we've loved this stuff since childhood.  The price here is the best I've seen anywhere.

column9: Not something which lends itself well to shipping
column10: I like Sugar in the Raw but having it shipped isn't such a good idea.  The package arrived slightly damaged and there was some leakage of the product.  I think I'm going to be buying this at a local grocery store from now on.  On the plus side, you get a lot of sugar at a very good price.

This is the best sugar, and it is raw, so it is not refined like the normal white sugar we all use.  I choose this over the white sugar anyday!  It just makes me feel like even though I'm using sugar (which is not so good for you), that I am choosing to use a "healthier" version!

column9: A healthy product delivered to your door for a deal.
column10: This is a healthy alternative to refined sugar & it's delivered to your front door without the cost of shipping if you choose free super saver shipping.  It's cheaper than the store costs & you can get the extra percent off if you choose auto ship. I just wish I'd realized that before I bought it.  I did have a box that was a little crushed and a tad leaked out of the box, but I weighed all the boxes - I have a shipping scale here - and it was only about half an oz - so it wasn't too bad.  I think it was my UPS man b/c I have constant issues w/UPS packages at my house.  I still haven't figured out how to contact Amazon about the issue.  I'll still order again & next time I will choose auto ship option to save the extra money.  If I have the crushing problem again I'll def figure out how to contact Amazon about the issue.

Started using this sugar after watching Seinfeld show for many years. Yea, I know, great product placement lol. I purchased out of curiousity one day after I was trying to choose sugar for purchase one day while in Wal-Mart. I use a lot of sugar to for my coffee but was beginning to step away from it due to its effects. I saw Sugar in the Raw and remembered Seinfeld used it, or placed in his kitchen. I gave it a try and have been hooked ever since. The taste is heavenly and makes your coffee taste like it came from Starbucks. I don't look at refined sugar the same anymore.

column9: addicted to sugar in the raw
column10: i like to use products that have the least amount of processing and this fits the bill perfectly. I love the large,easily dissolved crystals and the molasses imparts a hearty sweet flavor, especially in black teas. one word of advice though, watch for quality due to crop variations and pricing, many times it can be purchased locally at a much cheaper price.

This sugar has a mild taste and is wonderful on hot cereal. I use it for baking a lot, the only drawback I see is that it takes a bit for the bigger crystals to dissolve and incorporate into the recipe. The benefits of using unrefined sugar far outweigh this small problem.

column9: Bad packaging for good product - hardens into bricks
column10: The sugar itself I love.  I switched to this product when we decided to cut refined sugar out of our diet - and I use it in cooking as well as to sweeten coffee and put on hot cereal in the morning.  I especially like it for cooking - the result is a little less sweet than when using an equal amount of refined sugar, with a very pleasant taste like a faint touch of brown sugar.  It's great for sugar cookies and other baked goods that get rolled in or sprinkled with sugar - makes a nice crunchy topping.However, I had been buying it in plastic-lined envelopes that kept the sugar soft and fresh until I opened the package.  These boxes are horrible.  Every time I open a new one, I get a solid brick of hardened sugar that has to be microwaved and broken up with kitchen utensils, then repackaged in a plastic bag with a Brown Sugar Teddy Bear Clay Disc Keeps Sugar Soft to keep it soft enough to use.

I am a raw foodist and when I eat white sugar unintentionally in anything I eat, I feel that poison like effect on my body.  This raw sugar do not have it.  I experimented with food in terms of what kind of effect it would have on me.  I tried vinegar, organic soy yogurt, regular yogurt, organic yogurt, uncooked brown rice, uncooked oat etc....  only several things I could say that they were not poisonous and this was one of them.  I highly recommend it.

We are unable to find this product locally, so we order it online.  It is the favorite cake of my children and grandchildren.  I will order it again when we run out of this order.  This is the 3rd or 4th time we've ordered it online.

I have to say, I never thought I'd be looking for organic pudding, but the stuff you buy in the grocery store has so many other weird ingredients and doesn't really taste much like something that should be food. This has a great flavor, I can see and understand what the ingredients are for the most part (natural flavor, organic caramel color? not sure, but I'll take a chance!)The pudding has a good butterscotch flavor and this is my new favorite thing to have for dessert when I don't feel like making something from scratch. Calorie count for one serving doesn't seem too bad, though realistically, one box really should give you 3 servings instead of 4. I'm pouring them into small custard cups and if you use 4, it's a pretty skimpy serving. I make it with skim milk and it still tastes good and gives me a bit of sweet when I want one. :) It's yummy just slightly set but still warm!
Tried some right out of the box. Gooey, marshmallowy, but good. Lightly sweet. Very good with tea.
Very fresh product.  This is the freshness you only expect in a restaurant or at home.

This product is different from deserts designed for the western palate, being less sugary sweet than one might be accustomed to. Still, this is very good, the texture is one that I look for from mochi and the filling is quite tasty! I wasn't sure what I would think of red bean but it turned out to be very nice.
This was not exactly what I was expecting.  I thought it would be more like what I call "Vietnamese Sesame Balls."  Yet they were pretty good despite my mistake.

I especially LOVE the Green Tea flavor -- I also like it because it is not as sweet as most Western desserts.I love the almost-rubbery but oh so good texture and flavors that linger -- since it is not something you just chew and swallow like a cookie, the taste and enjoyment last longer.And red bean curd is also healthier than that white icing that you find in between the layers of that little brown cookie sandwich (which I also love, don't get me wrong)
They are OK, but I wouldn't recommend them for the price. This mochi is very marshmallow-like compared to other types.

The items arrived perfectly on time, however the Yomogi & Red Bean Mochi Sampler product was clearly past expiration date.  The mochi were cracked and dry, they didn't have the correct gummy texture that mochi have and the taste, although not bad, was poor.  The Japanese Green Tea Mochi, however, are perfectly fine, soft and plump.I believe a company that sells out these delicate items should check that they are in perfect conditions before selling the products, also because due to Amazon policy grocery items cannot be returned, even if defective as is apparent in this case.
Mochi is one of my most favorite treats.  Theses are of excellent quality with just the right amount of chewiness and sweetness.  Highly recommended!

My daughter wanted to try Japansese candy because she had read about it. She said this product was chewy and sweet. It was definitely different. It reminded me of homemade citrus candy. If you like chewy sweets you will like it.

I am writing to let you know that you send a wrong kind of product.I ordered Japanese Green Tea Mochi + Yomogi & Read Been Mochi, so they are 2 packs. As you posted picture, one kind should be different but what you sent is the same 2packs of Green tea mochi. It is different from the picture of these products you posted on amazon.com.Japanese Green Tea Mochi + Yomogi & Red Bean Mochi Sampler - 2x 8 PcI bought these for my friend's birthday gift whose birthday is this Friday.How will you do with this problem?

I bought these in the hopes that they would taste as good as people have told me. I was utterly disappointed in these things. They smelled mostly like playdough and tasted the same.Others may find this appealing but I did not.

O MY GOSH!! this bite size lemon wafer is so tasty.  We enjoy almost everything lemon and these wafers do not disappoint.If we must inject one concern, it is some of the nutrition info & some ingredients(1st three(3) highest content in product)for such a small serving size. SEE BELOW!!!!!!!!  A serious guilty pleasure because a serving is just eight(8)bite size(true to description)wafers.  It is so hard to eat just eight(8)because wafer is tiny and taste GOOD!!.  You decide!!!!!Nutrition Facts:Serving size - 8 cookies, Servings per container: about 4, Calories: 150, Calories from fat 70, Total fat: 8g, Sat fat:6 g, sodium: 30 mg, carbohydrate: 19g, sugar: 9 g, protein: 1 gIngredients:wheat flour, coconut oil, glucose syrup, sugar, whey powder(milk), dextrose, soy flour, barley malt extract, powered lemon juice 2% in the cream, salt, raising agents(sodium hydrogen carbonate, disodium disphosphate), emulsifier soy lecithins, Bourbon vanilla pods, lemon essential oil, spices.  May contain hazelnute, almonds, and oats.Product of Austria.  No colouring and no preservatives.  Keep cool and dry.
These wafers are so rich in taste it's like eating chocolates: you can only eat 2 or 3 at a time. Real lemon taste in surprisingly small parcels, but oh so good! We will buy more.

column9: Should be renamed Key Lime Pie.
column10: Taste Nothing like Lemon. I don't even want to eat the rest. It also has a strong bite to it.

Strong and lovely lemon flavor in a crispy little square.  They are delicious and tangy.  I keep them in the refrigerator because I think they taste better cold.  Just grab a few of these little treats to satisfy your cookie cravings.  Yum.

column9: can you say REAL LEMON TASTE?
column10: These are the best lemon wafers I've ever eaten.The aroma when you first open the bag will take you by surprise.Very crisp wafer, layered with the most robust, freshest, real lemon and cream taste of all-time.Received a very fresh product with an expiration date good well into next year.

These cookies are unbelievable. I worked at a natural grocery store years ago and fell in love with them, and I'm so glad to see them again! Lemony, bite-sized, and they're wafers, so they kinda melt in your mouth. SO yummy.
I love lemon cookies...And I really love these lemon cookies! These are great if you like a lot of lemon. YEA!!!!

These are a fantastic snack.  Peanuts surrounded by a cracker shell.  They have a different taste with the cracker shell being slightly sweet.  The fat grams are not as much as on some other varieties of nuts and they are filling.  I would highly recommend these.  They are also reasonable in price.
Arrived fast!  Great product.  Exactly as stated.  Would buy this again and probably will when I need more blooms and my own plants let me down.  Perfectly preserved!

Oh my good god. These are quite possibly *the* most delicious things I have ever eaten.In my life.I came across these raspberries last year at a Costco here in SoCal, and then - to my dismay - they recently stopped carrying them. I've since been searching EVERYWHERE, and I am THRILLED to finally find them here!No other brand of dried fruit can compare. Their blueberries and cherries are also excellent (and I usually don't care for either).Highly highly HIGHLY recommended!!

column9: Good product, but too much added sugar for my taste
column10: Was disappointed with the amount of added sugar in this product. Not a viable replacement for the frozen raspberries we currently enjoy. If you are looking for something sweeter than plain ol' raspberries that do not require refrigeration, then these might be exactly what you are looking for.
i would have expected these to be just pure raspberries.  Too bad.  It would have been so convenient to have raspberries handy for cereals and baking.
I am enjoying these in many ways, it is my favorite fruit.  I will certainly buy again.

column9: love 'em -- would be healthier w/less sugar
column10: i LOVE these raspberries. absolutely delicious and addictive. thing is...whole dried and organic don't make up for the fact that they add sugar -- and calories -- to something that really doesn't need it. at the very least, can't you please cut the sugar in half? then you'd have a customer for life.

column9: Too sweet, tasted like candy..gummy bears
column10: I bought this thinking it was going to be a good healthy snack of raspberries. I was surely mistaken. The raspberries are coated with sugar, and other syrupy stuff and it tastes like you are eating gummy bears! GROSS!

these are my favorite snack ever and I was so excited to see them on amazon. I ordered 4 packs and when they arrived I was so disappointed because they were not fresh at all. yes they are dried raspberries but they were almost crumbling and hard to bite into-normally they do have some moistness to them. The light dusting of sugar that these berries normally have were no longer on the berry because they were not fresh. Unfortunately although 3 of the 4 packs I purchased are unopened Amazon does not take returns on these. I wouldn't suggest buying these from Amazon-you won't be happy to have wasted your money on something inedible.

I used to be able to buy these at Sam's, and now Amazon is the only place I can find them.  They are the best dried raspberries I've ever tasted, not the dry ones I can occasionally find at the grocery store, and these are a much better price too.  I highly recommend this product.Carolyn in Clearwater

column9: excellent product at a good price
column10: These raspberries are part of my favorite snack. Mix them with whole almonds and Quaker's "Dark Chocolate Raspberry Almond" granola bar, and you'll have a truely delicious treat.  Quaker's bars are great but they are missing the almonds and raspberries required for every bite to have all ingredients.  Each bar needs 6 more almonds and 10 more of these delicious raspberries.

First of all, I would like to think that this is a healthy alternative to candy snacks.  Why?  Because I love them so much.  The taste and texture is fabulous.  The price is just right.  The kids love them.  So what's a possible drawback?  They can't possibly be good for your teeth!  So, get out the fluoridated toothpaste and brush, brush, brush after eating them!

If you have never tried these, you are missing out. Sprinkle them over oatmeal and breakfast will never be the same. Use them in oatmeal cookies in place of raisins. Believe me oatmeal cookies have never been this good. The price seems high but a little goes a long way with these tasty dried berries.

I have been buying Stoneridge dried blueberries for a long time and have not been able to find them locally, so I decided to try amazon.  There I found many different fruits that I had never seen dried, including the raspberries.  I have been very happy that I bought them.  Very tasty, and the Stoneridge brand cannot be beat.
I like them okay but they would be a whole lot better if they would add lemon juice.  Another company did blueberries that way and it really improved on the taste, mouth feel, etc.

Hard to find dried raspberries and this is the best I found so far.  It's way too sweet for my taste and recipes, but once I rinsed off a lot of the sugar and patted them dry, they were exactly what I wanted.  Great alternative for recipes that call for dried cranberries :o).
These dried raspberries are just the thing for salads, desserts, etc!  A nutritious snack as well year round!

Dried Fruit? The point of debate here is dried fruit. These are delicious; I ate many, many handfuls each serving. Their more like gum drops because of the sugar added by "infusion". I'm suprised that the oil does not factor into the flavor at all.Not a typical dried fruit.HIGHLY RECCOMENDED!!!

These things are so delicious I think that we have gone through 2 bags already. Put them in your cereal, ice cream, yogart and any other place you can think of. I keep a bay by my bedside for those nite time muchies.
Anyone who loves raspberries will find these absolutely delicious.  Not too sweet, not too tart, almost perfect.  Fresh berries would be the only improvement.  Great snack for all ages.
Purchased the raspberries for my daughter in college, did't last the night with her 5 suite mates.

It has been out of stock for a long time and it finally came back.  Now it looks like it is out of stock again.These are great for baking.  Chocolate chip raspberry cookie or oatmeal raspberry cookie.  It is also good to eat as snack.  It does have sugar.

I was devastated by this product, even angry. Don't they think, the manufacturers of this otherwise great product, that folks who spend their hard-earned money buying blueberries, are trying to eat a natural health enhacing food?Why contaminate these big, beautiful berries with one of the most horrible sugars ever invented by mankind. Yes, these blueberries are bathed with High Fructuose Corn Syrup. In fact, they have so much of this Genetically Modified sugar that eating a few of them mad me cough uncontrollably! The only way I could eat these blueberries was after washing them for 15 min in running water and this was not enough.Worse. Where foes it say in their advertisment that this supposedly natural product is contaminated with GM HFCS? I think, we consumers, should be able to look at a lable before we spend our cash. Please do not buy this product if you are looking for a natural diet!Why not sweeten this product with the new US approved sweetener Stevia?

I first purchased these vanilla beans from Costco during the holidays but I could never find them at any other time. I decided to look on Amazon and they have them for a great price. I love these beans because they are very plump and stay fresh for a long time. I ordered a different brand before I ordered these and they dried out after two or three months. These vanilla beans stay fresh for a year (I know because I used my last one a year from the first date I purchased them). The taste is wonderful and I use them in everything from buttermilk syrup to rice pudding.

THE BEST vanilla beans on the market, they are fresh, plump and big not like in the ones sold in the supermarkets, 3 inch dried out overpriced beans. Great value for the money spent. I was buying them at Costco but now have to order them on-line??? The packaging says KIRKLAND, the Costco lable and as with anything Costco sells these vanilla beans did not disappoint. I hope to find them there again but ordering on-line was easy, I had the beans 2 days later...great job Amazon!!!
These beans are a bargain and great quality.  They may seem a little too moist to anyone used to grocery store beans, but they are just fresh and stay that way a very long time in those tubes.
Arrived when they said they would and was what they said they were.First time I had used these and will again.
The beans arrived on time and so well packaged nothing could have gotten to those beans. Have them steeping in vodka making home made vanilla extract!

This cereal is great, especially if you make it with pomegranate juice for 1/2 the water content. Very healthy, better protein than other hot cereals. Tastes much better than oatmeal and rice cereal, imho

bought these for our chihuahua.  They are well made and keep his paws warm and dry.  Securing them properly is somewhat of a challenge.  Often difficult to fasten the velcro tight enough around his leg to keep them from falling off.  Otherwise, excellent product.

I have an 8lb chihuahua who seriously dislikes getting his paws wet or cold.He used to have a pair of "boots" that were purchased from a chain pet store that weren't comfortable and didn't stay on well. They also caused him to really kick while he was walking. Now that's a funny sight, but he couldn't move very quickly.These boots are comfortable, we don't fight to get them onto him, the first time I put them on him I thought there would be an adjustment period - no. He was prancing. PRANCING. The dog who HATES boots, was PRANCING in his new boots.

I purchased XXXsmall boots for my 6 1/2 pound toy fox terrier and they fit perfect. They were a little tough to get on the first couple of times, but once we got the hang of it, it's easy now. I really didn't think my dog would keep them on, but he does. He prances around as if he were a king. These are very well made and have velcro bands to adjust for the size leg. They look very cute on. Highly recommend them.

column9: Great until they fell off her feet and got lost first time I used them
column10: I should have listened.  Mittens don't stay on dogs' feet, period.  These came off the first time I tried them, got lost in the snow, it's over.  Nice price, but I had them on snug and they came off.  Sigh.

I really really wanted these to work for my adopted 8lb pom - adorable 11 yr senior.  Didn't even last for 2 city blocks. The toe area started to shred - and no, he doesn't have long nails at all. I need shoes to protect his nails - he tends to drag his front paw and vet recommended boots.  So if anyone out there has a suggestion, would greatly appreciate it!

These actually stay on my dogs feet, and are flexible.  They do rip a bit, but bought two sets just in case we lose some, - but we haven't yet!  My dog is a puppy and loves to run around in the snow, yet, they stay on.  Great for the price.  I have a 9 lb dog and he wears the XXXS.  XXs would be ok too.  Make them tight and you will love them.

column9: cute nut not extreme all weather
column10: I put these on my chihuahua and once he got used to them could walk ok nut first snow after arrival, he came in shivering. I checked his feet and inside the boots and feet were cold and wet. Boot was cold and wet inside. Dog did not go in deep snow so nothing came in from top of boot.

The beef jerky was pretty good, I really like the texture and the dryness of it.  I prefer a dry jerky that can be broken apart pretty easily and this was what I got from this jerky.  I had really hoped for more flavor from the meat, being grass fed and high quality, however, all I could taste was salt, and lots of it. this is NOT rasberry vinegar.  It is vinegar with rasberry flavoring.  Definitely not the same thing... it is pretty expensive for just regular vinegar with artificial rasberry flavoring added.
This is the best ! I add chicken mushrooms ,bok choy , green beans stir fry peas it is easy but you make it home made ! It is hard to get in Alaska so im always on the hunt:)

I tried this Pad Thai for the first time about a month ago. The instructions were very simple and I came up with a great tasting Pad Thai  with very little effort. I always keep some at home to serve to guests and for my wife who likes it very much. I recommend this to everyone who loves Pad Thai and Thai Food in general.
I love this product I love putting almond butter on them and some banana slices on top very tasty and satisfying

I love the Toblerone chocolate with fruit and nuts......so very tasty!  I don't eat chocolate candy as much as I used to but when I do I want it to have that just right taste and this brand is one of my favorites.  The candy is smooth and has the perfect blend of rich velvety sweetness and chocolate. Buy a bar and enjoy! Well, I think it's wonderful!

I ordered this product from Amazon, when I received it about 60% of the candy was melted in one big glob .It came with a cold pack but being put in the mail box on a day in July in the south the cold pack was boiling hot. I was very disappointed because I paid a lot for this product.

I made a dirt cake for my son's 7th Birthday/Hiking Party and used these as decoration on the cake.  They look so real and taste delicious.  We loved snacking on them after the party too.  Next time I make a "sand" cake I will order these and the shells to decorate.  Yummy!

I purchased these for a wedding cake.  It is a birch bark cake with adirondack chairs for the cake top.  I love the rocks and my husband did not believe that they were chocolate and edible!  Would recommend to anyone!  Love Love Love them!

My son's birthday party was at an indoor rock climbing gym.  We gave each child about 4 oz of these rock candies in a snack size ziploc bag as part of their goodie bag (along with Pop Rocks candies).  The kids loved how realistic the chocolate rocks looked.  The best part is that the kids and parents both said that these rocks tasted wonderful.  We bought a 3 lb bag to divvy up and the nutrition ingredients were on the bag.

column9: Prepare to have a lot of LAVENDER colored rocks
column10: Rocks are delightful but there were a lot of lavender colored rocks instead of the natural green, dark reds I needed.  But I had a specific project going on; others might not mind.

column9: So so chocolate, Missing ingredient list
column10: Looks very similar to the image provided, but I expected better tasting chocolate.  It tasted stale and definitely not high quality.  What was very disappointing was there was no labeling included, and no ingredient list provided. With increasing awareness of food allergies, I can't believe that any company can sell a product without one. When I tried calling the phone number of the company listed as the seller, it was just a voice mail that was full.
Bought these for my son's rock climbing party.  They were very realistic and as a bonus, actually tasted really good too!  Will definitely buy again if I am needing chocolate rocks for something!

I needed these for my mothers wedding cake and was rather worried because she moved the date up on me but these were perfect. They're pretty much M&M's in rock form which is wonderfull. Delivery was super speedy which was a big plus with how little time I had to get my mom's wedding cake together!

I bought these chocolate rocks to decorate my son's third birthday cake which was a construction scene.  People commented on how great they looked; they taste like M&M's!  There were plenty of rocks to decorate our cake with a road and still have left overs.  A pricey item but oh so worth the effect on the cake!  Great buy!
I got these when I needed some chocolate rocks to decorate a volcano cake I was making and they were perfect.

This is a delicious tea, it's got a light, almost (but not exactly) sweet flavor that doesn't become bitter over time, even if the tea leaves are left in for a very very long time. I highly recommend it.
Rich tasting up-scale tea, excellent for hot tea, if you are looking for the caffeine, too.
Delicious tea! Does NOT get bitter, no matter how long you let it steep. Chocolate flavor is subtle but becomes much more evident when tea is sweetened. Overall, wonderful strength and flavor!

This is a great morning tea; 10% goes towards a cure for cancer (you'll feel great about that). But ALSO add 1/4 tsp of natural chocolate extract (like you find at the Savory Spice shop)..and you have a GREAT chocolate tea the lets equal parts of tea & chocolate come thru. Fast shipping to client also.

This stuff is great, the chocolate flavor taste natural and much better than I expected.  Doesn't get bitter if it steeps all day!  If you like tea of any kind you will like this!  (Note, I normally do not like flavored coffee or tea, but this chocolate is subtle, natural, and very, very good!)

I'm a former coffee drinker and I'm always looking for that cup of tea that will satisfy my craving for something dark and roasty.  The tea itself brews up dark, and the slight chocolate essence makes it a richer cup.  It is very smooth and does not get bitter with extra steeping.  I'm totally sold.

This tea has a mild chocolate flavor that blends nicely with the black tea. It's perfect for a nice afternoon break. I don't care for sweetened tea, but I tried a little non fat dairy creamer in this tea and it brings out a bit of a nutty (hazelnut)flavor. I'm sure the chocolate flavor would be more apparent with sugar added. I was looking for a chocolate flavored tea without mint and this is perfect and delicious!
The service from BeverageGourmet was excellent. The flavor of the mango however was horrible. It tastes nothing like real mango.
I THOUGHT THE PRODUCT ITSELF WAS WONDERFUL, BUT I PAID AS MUCH FOR SHIPPING AS I DID THE PRODUCT SO I PROBABLY WON'T BUY IT ONLINE AGAIN.

After moving to England I found the local water tasted very different than what we had back in the US. Saw these in the store on base and picked a bottle up and haven't gone back to the local water since. Smart Water has a very clean taste and these 20oz packs are cheaper on Amazon than on the base. As an added bonus, they're smaller than the 33.8 oz bottles so they're much easier to distinguish when I'm at work and everyrone leaves their water bottles on shared space.

this is my other favorite brand of water besides aquafina.  i have never liked water, just tastes pretty lame, and i rarely drink it plain.  the closest i get is unsweet tea or one of those lil protein water add in things from special K or crystal light. but i can actually drink an entire bottle of smartwater.  and the price on these is pretty good.  its an amazon prime item so it ships for free, so im paying 15 for a 12 pack, that comes out to approx 1.28 a bottle. will definitely be buying a couple cases of these.
CAN'T FUNCTION WITHOUT IT...DRINK EVERY DAY.  OUR TAP WATER IS ADVERTISED AS BEING GOOD BUT IT TASTES LIKE SWILL COMPARED TO THIS WATER.  I LOVE THE EASE OF THE SIMPLE SCREW ON CAP.

I am not a big water drinker but there is a very smooth taste to this water that reminds me of Dasani.  It's very crisp and refreshing when cold and I like the fact that it has electrolytes in the form of calcium chloride, magnesium chloride and potassium bicarbonate.  Would recommend this water to anyone.

Does it make me smarter? Nope. Does it taste fantastic ice cold? Yup. I love this water. Why does it taste so much better than other waters? It tastes the way I imagine the polar ice caps taste, the ones that have never seen one atom of pollution,germs, dirt or anything else, just pure hydrogen (two molecules) and oxygen (one molecule).That's what this tastes like. Crisp. And it doesn't hurt, even though it's silly, to imagine as I drink it that I'm getting smarter from that added potassium and magnesium, two minerals we all need more of, especially our brains.I'm sure my brain, being mostly water, appreciates this. Yes it's a brain drink, psychologically at least.Smart Water is purified tap water although the website does say that some plants may use spring water.Every single mineral and chemical that can be in water is removed. Things like arsenic and chromium are not detected inSmart Water once it has gone through it's treatment and filtering process. The website for this states that itis "pure as the first drop of rain". Then the minerals potassium, magnesium and calcium are added to it.These minerals are important to good health and a long life. The website has a long list of solid particulatesthat can be found in most water, and throughout the list, after the purification process of Smart Water, nonewith the exception of a tiny amount of flouride can be detected.This intense purification process is what is responsible for the pure clean taste of this water. I was hoping to find out the pH since it is better for health reasons to drink more alkaline water but that was not to be found.I enjoy keeping Smart Water on hand as one of my go to brands of bottled water, along with Fiji and San Pellagrino, the winner as far as mineral content and alkalinity. I avoid drinking tap water as much as possible due to the chlorine it contains, which is a known health risk. This has a remarkably fresh pure taste and the health benefits that a mineral water can provide.  Comment | Permalink

column9: Good value but not for the discerning palate
column10: As mentioned by another reviewer, this did not arrive vacuum packed and I suspect this item may have been older stock.  Grinds into a decent cup of coffee but not one to savor.  Perhaps I am a bit jaded having been recently spoiled with several pounds of rich full bodied coffee beans.I give this the benefit of the doubt and 4-stars.  Although bland, it is drinkable and not overly acidic.  The most important factor for me, is that I got a great price for this.
In this order, The coffee beans were not vacuum packed which is the usual condition that I receive them in prior orders.
This product is an excellent solution to one of my pet peeves. I can now use one jelly packet for each slice of toast without the sticky mess of digging jelly from a jar.

I bought this for my boyfriend who likes to have jam with his muffin when he goes out to a coffee place. This is the perfect thing because the jam cannot spill all over the car, nothing to fill like a little jar, etc. These jam packets are great. And, according to my boyfriend, it is great tasting jam!

What more can I say about a Hershey chocolate product? It's absolutely my favorite combination of flavor and melt-in-the-mouth ecstacy. Packaged easy to freeze,retains its good qualities after being moved into a special home in the fridge.
i always buy plenty of these bars at my local store they are good and they taste real good.the wrapping is cool and the flavor is on point I usually get the 10 for 10 deal and it is the truth.
I use these for my diabetes reactions.  I freeze them and use a quarter bar when I need to.  Tastes great and levels my sugar level with a level dose of choc.

If you like really sweet chocolate bars, this might be for you.  However, it's advertised as special dark, which is false advertising.  It's only 45% cocoa; real dark chocolate is 70% or more.  This is a scam.

These bars do not have the rich, intense chocolate taste of other dark chocolate bars -- even Trader's Joe's which is in the same price range.

I bought this once and was very disappointed. Two stars only because I've tasted worse. If you like this then you have no idea what dark chocolate really tastes like. Try Hershey's Pure Dark Extra Dark instead.

I ordered this basket for Mother's Day as a gift for my darling mother. My mom has a real sweet tooth and I thought that ordering an entire basket of her favorite chocolate makerwould be the perfect gift. Boy, was a wrong. Each and every item was old and ashy. A couple of the items were rancid from age. Avoid this seller with a passion. Their lack of attention to detailruined my mother's mothers day.

column10: They had a tasting of this at my local supermarket. It's a sweet thick vinegar to drizzle on foods. I put it on some cheese. Fabulous!!! I don't think you would use it for a salad dressing but for fruits and other foods to accent the flavor it's wonderful. And it lasts a long time.

I have never reviewed anything before - BUT - my dog will not eat dog food - I have tried everything - of course there is a long story about why he won't - but the fact is I cannot get him to eat dog food anymore.  This however - he eats immediately when I put it down for him.  I doubt it is the healthiest thing you can buy for your dog BUT it beats human food for sure which was my only option.  If you have a picky eater for a dog - this is definitely worth a try!!!
the dogs love this product and the price is very reasonable...packaged well and easy to use...will continue to get this for the pets

column9: Good to use as treats for dog training!
column10: While I'm not sure about the nutritional content of this food, I've had very few dogs at the animal shelter near me turn these down as a reward during training.  These are great for training because they are small which allows you to reward the dog a lot without worrying about overfeeding it.  I also like the fact that they don't make your hands greasy or sticky like hot dogs or cheese.  Another plus is that these don't require any preparation, unlike most other dog treats, which need to be cut up into smaller pieces to be the right size for training.It seems that these are a fairly high value treat for most dogs, being on par with or a little better than other soft meaty commercial dog treats and worse than cheese or hot dogs.I don't think I would recommend them as a staple food for dogs, but as a training treat, they are great!
The dogs love this and with auto delivery I don't have to cart it from the store which any shopper is a pain. I never run out this way.

I keep these onions on hand at all times.  When ever I need to crisp up a salad or garnish a soup this is what I reach for.  And of course if I'm looking for a bit of crunchy as a munchy I've been known to grab a handful then too!

Product is crispy without being too hard.  It blends well and not does get "mushy.  I can be used in salads, on top of hamburgers, mixed into meatloaf, mashed potatoes and much more.  I keep thinking of new ways to use it.I've shared with friends who are now ordering some for themselves.

column9: Very nice mustard for meats that have been prepared with ginger or raisins.  Your guests will ask you for the secret ingredient!
column10: It seems today that folks expect mustard to be hot and only served on deli meats.  Well, it is time to explore the OTHER, time-tested ways to enjoy a flavor-intensifying ingredient.  Right up there with balsamic vinegar and fresh thyme, mustard is one of those crucial elements of fine cuisine.  Pommery is recognized by Foodies to be the best mustard on the planet, and Pommery has several variations on their classic "mustard in a crock."  This one uses ginger and other spices to give a more complex foundation to recipes calling for mustard.  I wonder if "mustard macaroons" won't be the next It Food!  Honestly, did you expect to see chocolate-covered bacon, or fennel-dusted chocolates?  Well, be on the leading edge of the wave and load up on Pommery!

I truly enjoyed these creamy pralines, they were very fresh and delicious! I received them as a birthday gift and they were delivered on my birthday, awesome! None of them were broken! I recommend them to others.
Great!! Loved the service and the product was delicious, my office family loved them also!!

My dogs love Natural Choice and I love that it is all natural.  The best part is that it comes promptly in the mail.  It is always in stock.  Couldn't ask for a better system.  When I am down to the last 8 containers, I order again.  So easy.  This is the brand I would be buying at the grocery store.

This is such a great product.  It sweetens and adds a lovely amaretto flavor without being made of sugar or artificial sweeteners.  The Madhava brand is terrific and there are so many flavors to choose from that I know I will be using this as my sweetener of choice and trying them all out!

This is a great, savory warm beverage. The mint can seem like a bit of a bitter taste, but I love to add a couple of drops of stevia and that's all you need to turn it into a tasty treat. Unique choice for a change for your taste buds!

I quit coffee a few weeks ago and really wanted to like this drink.  For people in the same boat, consider yourself warned that this beverage is NOTHING like coffee.As to its merits as a distinct drink, I'd have to say I'm still not a fan.  It's bitter like the previous reviewer has pointed out, but this bitterness is not (in my experience) alleviated by stevia.  While I'm usually a great fan of mint, this drink has a spoiled aftertaste which lingers on the tongue and is interlaced with nutty undertones.  There's not the slightest hint of chocolate, which is a shame because raw cocoa powder would be less bitter than this concoction.If the taste were slightly more obnoxious, I'd say it was medicinal, but as it stands, it might be possible to disguise the poor flavors using cream or sugar.  However, I think I'll just save my money and continue on my search for a coffee alternative which I actually enjoy drinking.This isn't to write Teeccino as a brand off; I'd suggest ordering the sampler pack from their website in order to make an informed decision rather than pin all your hopes and dreams to one large tub of a single flavor.
Teeccino is a very healthy alternative to coffee and the chocolate mint flavor is delicious.  The price was great, too!

I had to stop drinking coffee a year ago, and this stuff is a life saver. Don't expect anything that isn't coffee to taste like coffee, but this is the closest thing out there. I drink it by the potful every morning. Chocolate mint is my favorite of all the Teeccino flavors, and I've tried all of them. It's rich, dark, not too chocolaty, and the mint flavor helps me wake up. It tastes good with or without cream. I've experienced no physical side effects drinking this, unlike with coffee and black, green, and white teas.

As some other reviewers mentioned, it does not necessarily work for everyone as a coffee substitute. I've had teeccino for 2 weeks now and must acknowledge that it was hard in the beginning. BUT as soon as I followed a recommendation on a teeccino can - mixing teeccino with real coffee first and then gradually reducing the coffee ratio - I was being able to enjoy the drink AND I felt so much better - no after-coffee syndrome any more. I am still mixing in 1 tsp of coffee or less to 1 full scoop of teeccino, for the taste,  at the same time I am getting used to the new taste. I also mix in with non-dairy milks - rice, coconut or almond - coconut works the best for me, although a brand matters. I highly recommend to follow the instruction on the package - makes all the difference for coffee addicts - to slow down the transition from real coffee to a substitute. A taste of teeccino is great on its own - great job of its maker, it just does not feel right for a coffee addict. Give yourself time for your taste buds to adjust, and you'll start enjoying the teeccino as well. Also experiment with a coffee maker and non-dairy milks.
This is a great tasting product with the best price I could find online or in the store.  This is my favorite flavor they offer.

Both the chocolate and cinnamon Sweet Crisps are a wonderful sweet crunchy treat.  they pack a punch of flavor and if you're specifically trying to satisfy a chocolate craving, they'll do the trick. (my advice: eat them with the chocolate side down against your tongue).  What I specifically like about them is that they have some fiber but not a lot like some "diet" snacks so if you chose to eat the whole bag (which I admit to doing!  only about 400 calories which for a dessert is NOT BAD, baby!  better than an ice cream sundae or chocolate bar!) you don't run the risk of tummy troubles due to a huge influx of fiber.Also, my 3 year old picky eater daughter loves these and they have enough protein in them that I am happy to occasionally give them to her to help reach her proper nutrition levels for the day.  A much better option in that regard than most other types of cracker/bread/cereal items that kids are known to favor and usually have little to no protein.[...]
This is not a low calorie product and you will find yourself eating the whole bag.  It does have a bit of a cinnamon undertone but the chocolate shines through.
These are a healthy snack, low fat, whole grains and very tasty for those who watch what they eat, great snack to keep around for kids too...
Quite tasty snack..good chocolate flavor..not as tasty as the highly addictive cinnamon flavor but is still an okay "healthy" snack.

Once I tried these crisps,I knew I was hooked!!.They are crunchy,chocolatey,and way tastier than Quaker rice cakes. The calorie count per serving ( 90 ) isn't bad,either. I'm now on a quest to find where I can get these wholesale!. I would recommend these snacks to anyone watching their weight.Even if your not,these are a tasty alternative to a candy bar. Two enthusiastic thumbs up!..
For a great, low fat snack these crackers fit the bill.  They are very tasty and have a nice crunch.  I love eating them with Fuji apples.

I have a gluten sensitivity so tried these crackers, what a find!  They are pricey but wonderful with all cheeses or by themselves.  I serve them when entertaining and guests always ask me the name of these crackers, and say they are going to get them because they are so good. Try them, you won't regret it!!!

These crackers are crisp and have a good, cheesy flavor,  They are also gluten free, corn free, soy free,  nut and sesame free.  There are not too many crackers that I can eat, but these are delicious!

column9: Very tasty, but check expiration date
column10: I really like these crackers! They are crisp and very flavorful, and much better for you than most crackers which are loaded with hydrogenated oils. You can eat 15 crackers for only 130 calories and 2.5 grams of fat (no sat fat); and they are wheat-free. My 6- and 8-year old boys even love these! The only problem is they have a shorter shelf life than some crackers (which is probably due to no hydrogenated oils). According to the manufacturer they have a 210 day shelf life (~7 months). Unfortunately, by the time I received my case of crackers there was only three months left. If I buy a case of any boxed/canned product, I expect at least a 6-month shelf life (by the time I receive the product). Amazon graciously refunded my entire purchase price and will look into a method of insuring a fresher product or at least informing the consumer of the expiration.

I like the crunch and the taste of these crackers.  I miss cheese crackers since going gluten free and these are my favorites right now.  They are also lower in fat than some other wheat alternative crackers which is great!  If only they were not so pricey.
These crackers are healthier for you than most, and yet are very tasty and light.  I really enjoy them.

My [...] was addicted to all kinds of cheese crackers. When she had to go gluten-free, we searched for some adequate substitute.  While they are not cheddar goldfish crackers, they are very tasty and satisfying.
I love these thin crisp crackers. Hard to find in my area. Glad to discover a source for them here on Amazon.
These were the absolute worst crackers I have ever tasted.  If Styrofoam could be served in a box it would taste like these.  Save your money!
If you're wanting to feel good about munching mindlessly, you'll like these crakers.  It's not that they're bad, they're not as good as Cheeset's.  On the healthy side,they're better.
These arrived in good time with no packaging mis-haps. Great tasting apricots and no sulphur dioxide - yeah! I should have ordered several more packages.
Taste just like regular dried apricots but they are not sulphured so they are near black in colour.  If sulphur has bad effects for you, but you like dried apricots, this is a good choice.
These apricots are really very good.  They do not have that pleasing orange color, but the taste is wonderful.  I would certainly purchase these again.

Was a great find.  Great taste when added to coffee without all those calories! Perfect afternoon treat. Carton of 30 and the small size of each packet make it perfect for serving or keeping in a contained area. Great product!

column9: Very tasty, if you can taste it
column10: I love this hot sauce.  Most sauces as hot as this one do not have good flavor.  This one has a very nice taste, I use it on all kinds of things (It is thick, like bbq- but only use a drop!!). My favorite use is on dry roasted peanuts.  I put a drop in about 1/4 cup of nuts.  I put it in something with a lid and shake to coat.  Delicious and addicting!  It is seriously hot though.  Not one of my friends can eat it cheerfully.  If you think Tabasco sauce is hot, if you think jalepenos are hot, this is not for you.Keep it away from your kids and away from your eyes.

Simply put, this has become my basic table sauce for nearly every situation. It is way too hot for the general public, but for us pepperheads, it has great taste (sort of a steak sauce flavor), and massive (yet controlled) heat. It has a back-heat that builds over several minutes, which gives time for the flavor to be savored. A couple of drops mashed into a baked potato, spinkled onto scrambled eggs, or spread over a slab-o-roast beast yields the full range of taste pleasure and pain. It only leaves me wanting more. column9: Excellent Quality With Some Holiday Flavor...

column9: Cheap, easy to open, and light weight Emergency Preparedness Food
column10: Hey there retrodog (reviewer) - I use to eat this as a kid too. With mayo or Miracle Whip on white bread or toast. Lots of other great ways to use it too - in deviled eggs, or mixed with horseradish and stuffed into cherry tomatoes (add sliced olives to the top and it's even better). Mix with veggies to make a zingy tasting wrap. I've even known people to put it on their baked potatoes with sour cream. You can spice up mac & cheese with it too.In short: It's relatively cheap (3 sandwiches per 3 oz can), easy to open (pull top lid), and light weight (for back packs, lunch bags, and emergency "go" bags.In depth review:It may not be the healthiest item on the store shelves (relatively high in cholesterol and salt), but it is an excellent quick sandwich if you're in a hurry, very cheap (when you get it at a good price) for those who are on tight budgets (you can get 2-3 sandwiches per 3 oz can), it's also a great emergency food to keep in your home, and is also great for emergency "go" or "bug out" bags. These days, with threats of terrorism and so many natural disasters, an easy to pack, small, light weight source of calories is essential.It's more than 98% meat and fat from chicken and beef, which are 2 things (meat and fat) you want to eat if you're in an emergency situation (no other food available) and need protein and calories to keep you going. This way you're body does not eat its own muscle and fat, so you stay strong and warm until help arrives or you get yourself out of what ever situation you're in. Imagine Eskimos; they ate lots of meat and fat to keep warm in harsh conditions. I'm not saying you want to live on this stuff for months on end, but for a few days or a few weeks, it can save your life - it's cheap, easy to open, light weight emergency calories.Amour's Vienna sausage and sausage bits are also good for the same reason. Keep these, crackers (whole wheat is best), and canned fruit on hand ALWAYS, no matter where you live. Canned beans (any kind) and rice (if you can get moist prepared rice packets) are also good emergency foods. You never know when you might need to stay in for days or weeks at a time with no electricity and no outside contact, or you may need to bug out and live on your own, w/o shopping or going to restaurants for days or weeks.And yes, Amour potted mean is also a great treat for your cat. Although I can't tell if Pauline E. Nordin (reviewer) was attempting sarcasm when referring to cat food, or if she's really had to eat cat food or food that tasted like cat food due to financial distress, but our cats loved it. We use to give it to them once in a while treat when we were kids (50s and 60s). Again, a little too high in cholesterol and salt though (I wish they made a low salt version) so keep it as a once in a while treat only. That goes for you and your cats.What's a good price? You can usually find it on sale; three 3 oz cans for $1.00. At $19.08 for 48 cans that's just under 40 cents per can. Not a bad deal at all if you can't find the 3 for $1 deal near you. And if you belong to Amazon Prime (see PracticalWaysToSaveMoney to find out how to get Amazon Prime for free, we have a special link for Amazon.com related posts) you don't pay for shipping, which saves you money on gas instead of going out to a special store to find that 3 for $1 price. If you live in a very rural area and can't find the 3 for $1 price, or if getting out to shop is difficult for you, we recommend getting this deal at Amazon for sure.Don't need 48 cans? Ask your neighbors to buy in bulk with you. This is always a great way to save. Everyone saves, everyone has emergency food on hand. Win-win.How many cans should you keep on hand for emergencies? We recommend 2 cans for every 3 to 4 people in your household for each week of emergency food you want to keep on hand. For example, if you are a family of 3 and want to keep a 3 week supply of emergency food in the house (three weeks is now recommended by experts), stock 6 cans. That means one can will feed 3 people twice a week for 3 weeks. If there are 4 people in your family, bump it up to 12 cans and you can afford to eat a bit more or feed neighbors if need be (or your cats). You fill in the other meals with other canned emergency food of course.How long to keep? Some cans will show a "best by" date on the bottom. Some cans will show a date of manufacture. It depends on what facility is was packaged in. If it has a date of manufacture, according to Amour you're guaranteed good taste for a minimum of 2 years. But knowing this product, we'd say 3 years or more. Most cans with a "best by" date will have at least 2 to 3 years before you've come to that date (for example the can I bought this week expires in July 2014), but that doest not mean you can't eat it after that. According to Amour, as long as the can is sealed it's good "indefinitely", which is why it's a great emergency preparedness product. WTSHTF I'd eat a 15 year old can of potted mean over bugs any day if I were starving (thinking of those survival shows). But hopefully it will never come to that. And like all emergency preparedness foods, you should rotate on a first in first out basis. Eat the old stock before it gets to it's "best by" date and replenish with new stock. That goes for any food.

Anything less than a full roiling boil will make an insipid cup of tea.Use four tablespoons of tea per liter of water, let it steep three minutes, and you're there.

If you like weak coffee, you will like this. If you like flavor, go with any other cup but this one. Even on the smallest cup setting this coffee is pathetic, and I cannot even imagine it on the other settings. The Dunkin Donuts, Puck, Starbucks, and other Colombians are far superior to this.Bottom line: Green Mountain Columbian is about as good as water with brown food coloring. My Siamese cat likes to drink coffee, and even he would not touch this. Good kitty.

I have been a dedicated Dunkin Donuts coffee drinker for years.  To frame how I feel about this Green Mountain Colombian K-Cup I feel it might be best to share how I go about making a cup of Dunkin' coffee when I'm at home.I use a coffee scoop to measure out my coffee.  To my tastes, the perfect home brew is 7 mounded scoops and 7 cups of water.  I put all this in my Cuisinart 1200 and come out w/ 6 cups of java bliss.  I use sugar and milk in my coffee; when I make my coffee as stated it get a satisfying mocha swirl of coffee and milk.  Just by sight I can tell my cup is rich.Now, using that as my baseline, I find this K-cup to be very satisfying.  I have tried MANY kinds of regular coffee K-cups, and this is the first one that makes a satisfying cup of full bodied coffee to my tastes.  Granted, I brew on the 6oz setting.  If you take your coffee black maybe you can get away w/ the 8oz setting.  The cup reminds me of my beloved Dunkin' (note I said reminds, its clearly not Dunkin' but I don't mean that in a bad way).  It doesn't end sharp or bitter like the very popular Coffee People Donut Shop.  It has a muted finish, reasonably full body for a K-Cup, and nice flavor.  When I pour in the milk, I can take more than a drop before turning the cup white - which tells me the cup is rich.Its my go to cup when I'm not brewing a pot.I love this stuff.  I highly recommend it if you like your drip coffee as I describe above.  Why not 5 stars?  Well, it doesn't taste like the Dunkin' I brew from a drip machine, that's why !  Its at least on the same field though ...
I thought this a nice evenly tasting coffee with no bitterness or after taste. I enjoy it and will buy more in the future.
The Colombiam fair trade  coffee  cups are of an excellent taste any time you fill like taking a cup of coffe you will enjoy,the rich taste it provides a given a 5 star reading.

I have come across 3 K-cups so far that have either closed the water flow completely or allowed a very slow drip. My Kuerig has worked fine before and after those bad K-cups so I know it isn't my machine.

I'm not sure if I got a bad batch, but this does not make a good 8 oz cup like most other K Cups that I've tried.  I've had to reduce it to a 4 or 6 oz cup size to get a cup of coffee that is not like coffee flavored water.  I like a medium cup of coffee - not too strong or too weak.  I generally like the Green Mountain brand, but this is a weak, flavorless K Cup (and I have tried many, have found very few bad ones).

column9: I disagree with the reviews below
column10: I knew this kit would have to be soldered / assembled.  As such, this is a great / fun project.  All the parts are well labeled and the manual is 34 pages with pictures and great instructions.  There are many projects with fewer instructions, poor component labeling, etc.  Many projects are completed in 5 minutes, making them very boring.  This project took an evening to assemble while we listened to music and I explained the workings to my kids.  This project came with 6 sections so that you could check your work along the way.As a note, for people who understand what electronic kit building is really about, check out the following: (transistor clock kit) [...] (ham radio kit) [...] and (oscilloscope kit) [...]I am not affiliated with Elenco, or any of these sites, I just love building kits.What we as hobbyists really need are more complex kits with SMD components for those "weekend builds".

Seems to be a quality product, especially for the price. Unlike some of the other raters, I read the description and knew this was a kit, the project lasted about 10 hours and the instructions were great! I would seriously recommend getting a solder sucker if you don't have one, mistakes are easy to make. There is one important thing to note! The instructions tell the user to compare the output to another accurate multimeter at multiple points to test the device and calibrate the variable resistors. I don't have one, but I was able to get it decently calibrated by using common voltage sources, a AA battery, a 5V and 12V power cable, and home voltage.
I bought this knowing it would need to be soldered together. Overall, it was a great practice for anyone looking to practice soldering.

This multimeter is NOT ASSEMBLED! This means you will have to SOLDER it!Now that that is out of the way, I am an Electrical Engineer major and for one of our class assignments we have to piece together fully functioning mid/high level circuit board kits. THAT is what this is for. It does a great job for what it says it does. While this is not Fluke multimeter, and as such it is not as durable as one, it works just fine for such class projects.

All of the parts need to be put together.It would be a great project for someone who wants to put one together.I just wanted a multi meter, not a several hour project.

Supposedly, Crunchy Nut has been available in England for quite some time and Kellogg's finally decided to bring it over to US shores.  Kellogg's used to make "Nut & Honey Crunch", though it was discontinued a while ago. Like Crunchy Nut, they came in both flakes and "Os" versions. I have fond memories of eating Nut & Honey Crunch in the 80s, and missed it when it was discontinued. Remember the "Nothin' Honey" commercials? ;)Well, if you want to relive those days, give Crunchy Nut a try. To the best of my taste buds' recollection, the crunch and flavor are nearly identical. There is the sweet tang of the honey coating and satisfying texture of the peanut-sprinkled corn flakes. The flavor is comparable to frosted flakes, but with honey and nut flavors. It holds up well in milk, retaining it's crunch down to the last bite. Comparing ingredients and nutritional information from their respective boxes shows that they match up pretty closely there as well, though the serving size for N&H is 2/3 cup and for CN it is 3/4 cup. If anything, ounce for ounce, Crunchy Nut Golden Honey Nut Flakes looks a little healthier for you than Nut & Honey Crunch.That's not to say it truly healthy though. Sure, it is fortified with the usual assortment of vitamins and when eaten with milk you fill even more of your daily nutritional requirements. However, it is still laden with sugar, molasses, honey and High Fructose Corn Syrup. My taste buds must have changed a bit since the 80s because it is almost too sweet for me. Blame it on a steady diet of low sugar cereals over recent years. I would have a hard time eating this regularly first thing in the morning. Instead, I mimic a habit of my father's and eat a small bowl of it in place of dessert. You could even mix it with other cereals that contain less sugar (as my dad would do).Don't get me wrong, Crunch Nut tastes great on it's own, and if you have a sugar/crunch craving, it hits the spot. It even makes a good breading base for fried chicken. I just no longer have quite the sweet tooth I once did. I give Crunchy Nut Golden Honey Nut Flakes fives stars for flavor, mouth-feel and craving satisfaction. One star comes off for health impact though. If you decide to give it a try, I would shop around a little. Current 3rd party vendor prices are ludicrous. A much better deal can probably be found at your local grocer.

I'm a 20-year-old college student who religiously eats at least 2 bowls of cereal or oatmeal every morning. Prior to my finding this cereal about 6 months ago, I was on a standard rotation of Life, Frosted Mini Wheats, Raisin Bran Crunch, and Corn Flakes among others. I liked each one for different reasons, but it wasn't until I ate Crunchy Nut that I truly fell in love with a cereal.Normally, cereals are simply some combination of sweet, starchy, crunchy, and chewy. With Crunchy Nut, a new dimension is added: hearty. The peanut coating adds a definite protein taste to the cereal, much more so than Honey Nut Cheerios (another cereal I enjoy). For me, it's a great way to wake up, but I also use it as a late-night snack (with crumbs falling into my keyboard as I type this).The cereal is pretty sweet; I'd place it somewhere between Honey Nut Cheerios and Frosted Mini Wheats. There isn't much positive about the nutrition facts, but not much negative either.Overall, this is my favorite cereal, and that's saying something for a 7-year runner dependent upon carbs. I hope that Amazon can begin sending it as part of their Subscribe and Save program. I would be in cereal heaven...

A few months ago, I found some of the Vienna Reserve in a discount store and decided to try it in my regular brewer.  It was truly the most fabulous coffee I've ever had in my life ( and I am a very finicky coffee connoisseur).  I searched on Amazon.com for the coffee but only found the Vienna pods.  Lucky for me, I already had the pod adapter for my Keurig brewer and so I purchased several boxes and am more than pleased with this coffee even though it's not the Reserve.  To compare the two, the Reserve was a bit smoother than this Vienna and it had a very ' buttery-nut taste with absolutely NO bitterness which was truly amazing.  This Vienna is just as tasty but not as smooth as the other.  However, it's still a great cup of coffee.  I highly recommend this coffee for anyone who cherishes a great cup of coffee.  If you have a Keurig brewer, it's worth purchasing the pod adapter for this coffee alone!  The pods do fit this adapter very nicely.  If you are not familiar with how to insert the pod into the adapter-  well, it's quite simple:  Just pinch the top side of the pod with one hand and then shape the pod into a ' ball' and place into the adapter with the bottom ( which is labeled) down and begin brewing.  Voila!  A fast, fresh and easy cup of sophisticated quality.  An added plus to using pods instead of Kcups is that the pods biodegrade and you can add them to your compost pile if you choose.  K-cups fill up the landfills.

column9: Careful to use it in Senseo!
column10: The Wolfgang Puck pads seemed tighter than other pods and smells good, so I thought it would be great. However, it turned out to be wrong and the pods made a huge mess. Because they are too thick to be fit into Senseo system, you have to force it to close. The worse thing is that the cap of Senseo pops up and steam and coffee (from torn pod)came out, due to the build up of steam pressure by thick coffee pads.I end up to open all the pods to make coffee in a regular dripping machine. Taste is good though.

It is just like the jerk you get in a restaurant n Jamaica.Very flavorful and spicey, great on chicken, pork andseafood. I would recommend this product if you like to grill. It is also available in a smaller size.
All of the kids liked the peanut bamba, regular flavor, better. I like this kind, but it is a dessert and fattening...we still have a bunch left although we've gone through our regular bamba already.

column4: Christine "If at first you don't succeed, try...
column10: I picked this tea up just out of curiosity at my local supermarket in the international foods section.  Wow!  I'm not a major tea afficianado or anything but this tea is superb.  I have never tasted an "over the counter" supermarket tea like this before.  Celestial Seasonings, Twinnings, Nestea ... all crap compared to this!  Nice smooth, mellow yet bold taste.  A nice deep golden color.  I drink mine straight, but with milk its good too.I had my mother try some and she laughed at my astonishment about how good this tea is.  She said, "well you know how the British are about their tea, don't you?"  I guess I didn't know -- I sure know now!!Great great tea!  Superb, really.

column9: A fine and sturdy everyday tea
column10: This is a very drinkable blend of Assam, Ceylon, and Kenyan black teas from PG Tips, one of the UK's most popular brands. Although some California grocery stores (and Cost Plus World Market) stock this tea, I had not tried it until reading helpful reviews on Amazon.Each PG Tips bag weighs 38 percent more than the Lipton bag (that is available in the USA). As expected, PG Tips makes a stronger brew. Each PG Tips bag has so much tea that I can easily make a 12 ounce mug with a single bag. I drink my tea black, but PG Tips is clearly robust enough to maintain character with milk or sweetener.PG Tips is a sturdy, straight-ahead blend with more strength than Lipton's. It is a caffeine-rich tea - in part because each bag has more tea than other brands.PG Tips uses a pyramid shaped bag that allows more room for tea leaves to expand while steeping. Does it make better tea? I don't know, but it is a point of differentiation.HINT: PG Tips also makes a Special Blend black tea that is only slightly more expensive in stores. I much prefer the Special Blend to their regular black tea. The PG Tips Special Blend is a very hardy and rich breakfast tea. The Special Blend is more sensitive to longer steeping times (I usually steep mine less than 3 minutes), but I find the taste more complex and satisfying.Cognoscenti typically prefer loose tea. Tea bags contain the less expensive "fannings" or "dust," remains from processing loose leaf tea. And with some others brands of tea (not PG Tips), many people can taste the paper used in the bag.However, if you like I sometimes appreciate the convenience of bags, I recommend trying PG Tips as a sturdy everyday tea. And, I more strongly recommend their Special Blend as a hardy and rich breakfast tea.

column9: Not My Cup of Tea - And Pass the Rolaids, Please...
column10: My friend swears by this tea.  Other reviewers sing its praises.  I don't get it.  I find it to be a coarse, heavy, undrinkable tea.  The taste is reminiscent of tobacco.  One reviewer called it "sturdy."  That it is-- kind of the tea equivalent to the worst diner coffee you've ever had. I can't imagine serving this at a high tea.  I am a fan of Tazo's Darjeeling tea, which may explain my reaction to PG Tips.  There is nothing refined or nuanced in this cup.

After fooling around years ago with several different teas, my wife settled on this one. I have no memory of what I was drinking before PG Tips, but that must mean that it was forgettable. PG Tips is not. The English seem to know what they're doing in this department. No surprise there. To me it has precisely the right flavor, full and rich. If I get up in the middle of the night, for whatever reason that happens, PG Tips is there to quiet me down and put me back to sleep. (Won't work for those sensitive to caffine, I'm afraid, but I am not.) Now, after a long absence, I've returned to drinking it in the morning in place of coffee. My wife still thinks of it as something to have in the afternoon.  Just the best at any time. Try PG Tips!
This is the most delicious black tea! If you enjoy a "spot of tea", this could really be your cup! It brews fast and is a very smooth, very flavorful black tea.
