I was mostly a coffee drinker (Peet's) for decades.  When I drank tea it was loose leaf Darjeeling, but on a whim I ordered some of this tea.  I'm surprised to say that I've given up coffee altogether and only drink this tea in the mornings.  It is a great start to the day, enough (but not too much) caffeine -- I feel better, less jittery and I absolutely love the taste.  If you're looking for an everyday tea, give this a try -- it's better than any American tea I've tried.

Glad you like it!  This tea is the basic everyday tea and it's great.  If you like it why not look out for others like Clipper or Tea direct that taste very similar but are fairtrade so give your conscience a boost too...

column9: Good taste, but way too mushy
column10: For the taste, I'd give 4 or 4.5 stars. Pretty good, tastes a little bit like raspberry cheesecake (thought I mostly think it's like a yogurt flavor).Problem with this bar is that it's way too soft. It gets crushed/flattened in my pocket, bag, or anywhere else. Even when I'm unwrapping a new bar, it falls apart in the wrapper as I'm opening it! This doesn't affect the taste much, but it does hurt the portability of this snack item.Also, being a 90 calorie bar, it's not the greatest for satisfying hunger.

column9: OK FOR A CHANGE OF PACE BUT..
column10: ..THEY'RE NOT AS GOOD AS THE CHOCOLATY PRETZELS FLAVOR. THEY ALSO HAVE A DISTINCT DIET CANDY TASTE THING GOING ON. NOT HORRIBLE BUT LIKE THE OTHER FLAVOR, NOT SATISFYING ENOUGH, SO U END UP EATING 2 + THAT TAKES AWAY FROM THE WHOLE PREMISE OF ONLY 90CALS A BAR. FIBER PLUS BARS STILL NO.1 WITH ME.

Special K Raspberry Cheescake Bars 6 Bars per Pack, Pack of 6I was looking for a quck  breakfast substitute when I ordered these...I found them too sweet and "brief" for a satisfying breakfast bar but they make a great snack...When I want a sweet treat between meals or at nignt I have one of these instead of a more caloric choice such as a candy bar, cookies or ice cream...At 90 calories a pop it works for me...I don't think they are very high on the nutrition scale but, I suppose, they have their place...I DO enjoy them...They are tasty and at 36 bars per order should last quite awhile...Besides, they are nearly guilt free if you stop at one, which is usually enough for me, and I don't require them daily...I would have given this product 3 stars as a breakfast food but decided it rated 4 stars as a snack...I'm not sure I will order them again as they are a bit spendy...I will just have to wait and see...

this is my favorite i don't know why anyone wouldn't like this bar it really taste like a raspberry cheesecake i can't believe its only net 14 carbs. i can't stop eating after 1 bar.  and it is true i can't barely find it at my supermarket too so when i do see it i tend to stock up

This has to be the best flavor yet!  My problem is that every store I shop at can't keep this flavor on the shelf!  I called Kellogg's and they told me that the Raspberry/Cheesecake flavor is the most popular yet.  I guess I'll have to speak with the grocery managers and ask that they double order this flavor.

These bars are slightly dry in my opinion. My sister raves about these bars, so I gave my entire order to her.  I prefer my bars more moist and soft, these are almost crunchy but the taste is very good for 90 calories!

These bars are my least favorite of the Special K bars. I usually eat a bar in the morning on the way to work and figured I would try this flavor. I think it tastest horrible. I think Special K is grasping at straws with this flavor and I don't think it will do well. The combination of raspberry and cheese flavor they put together makes you barely want to finish the bar you started.I recommend not trying this flavor and sticking to the flavors you like.

Its sometimes hard to find good gluten-free treats, let alone wonderful ones.  This particular cookie is one of the wonderful ones and well worth the cost.If you served these and didn't tell anyone, they'd never know these delicious lemon wafer cookies are gluten-free.  They are just the right balance of not being too tart or too sweet and, though I enjoy the chocolate flavor wafer cookies, the lemon ones remain my favorite.  I've taken them along to potluck events and parties and people love them.Eat them as is or garnish a bowl of ice cream with them and you won't be disappointed.  And in a world of disappointment over what items you can't eat if you're going gluten-free, its nice to find something yummy that you can splurge on.
The price of this product is well worth the time to order. Lemon wafers are light and delicious. Packaged nicely to avoid crushing. Great transaction.
This is one of the biggest meat and cheese products that has Quality as well.I got this for my father and he was impressed as well.

column9: Picture is of the LARGE bar like the ones at Cracker Barrel.....
column10: But the candy I received are the small bars - less than 1.5oz each.While these are great for kids, I am disappointed especially for the price I paid which works out to roughly $1 per bar.If I saw this 1.4oz candy being sold for $1, I would definitely not buy it!Everything was great with the transaction, but the value for the money just isn't there.Next time I will take my $35 to Cracker Barrel!

I use this product a lot when I make Indian/desi food. I would give this product 5 stars. The onions are perfectly fried. Freshly fried is always better but this product is perfect when you are in a time crunch. The price listed here is outrageous though. I buy it at the local Indian stores for $3.99 to $5.99. $11.99 even with shipping the cost on here is too much.

Though my three pups liked the taste of these healthy treats, they crumbled into tiny bits.  I would not buy these again.  Now I give the pups Blue Buffalo Wilderness biscuits that I break into smaller bite sized bits for our three elderly Maltese dogs.

Both Bengal Spice and the very similar Celestial Seasonings product, Gingerbread Spice are my faves. I make sun tea in my backyard then pour the tea over ice for a very refreshing herbal 'tea' drink that doesn't need sugar, or lemon to quench a thirst. Here in the Southwest where summers are long, hot & dry, it's important to stay hydrated & this is a great pick-me-up.* This is a non-caffeinated tea(There's one other thing I do with Bengal Spice that might surprise you. When making jam or jelly, I sometimes swirl a bag or two in the hot jam a minute or two before pouring it in the jars. It adds a delightful exotic tone to some plain-jane jam recipes.)

This is just the best "herb" tea!  It's actually a sumptuous blend of a few exotic spices, with a kiss of vanilla.  It's yummy as a delectable pastry or dessert but it can be brewed up in a few minutes, smells divine, and can be consumed without guilt (read zero calories, fat, sodium, etc.,).  If you love cinnamon, you HAVE to try it.  The hint of cardamom, ginger, plus a few other all-natural flavors, simply pushes this tea to the top spot on the delight-o-meter.Unfortunately, it can be a bit hard to find outside Colorado.I hope you keep it in stock Amazon.  Thanks.
Much better than the teas Celestial labels as chai teas.  I use two bags of Bengal Spice to one black tea bag, add a packet of Splenda and a dash of milk and have a wonder rich chai tea.

column9: The best alternative to caffienated Chai
column10: This is a very wonderfully intense tea--much more so than all of the other Celestial Seasonings tea.  It is much more comparable to a Yogi brand type tea, as far as depth of flavour.  Try it with a touch of brown sugar and milk.In response to the reviewer who wrote that she adds a bag or two to jam: Have you ever tried it when boiling rice?  Add a few raisins and cashews, too...Mmmm!

Finally found the ultimate in tea.  The flavor and quality are what we have been looking for for many years.  Another plus--the strength is outstanding. You can get at least two cups with one bag.  In fact we leave the used bag in a little water, and the next day, add more water and heat (we use a microwave), and it's strong enough to drink and enjoy.  We're introducing it to our family and friends, and they are turning into addicts also.

This tea is full bodied and can stand up to milk. The cinnamon makes it sweet so you don't need any sweetener and there's no caffeine! Its great iced or hot. I've tried many chai teas that have been decaffinated and they don't come close to being as good as this. I'm am not a huge fan of Celsestial. I only like this and sleepytime.My friends have raved about this tea.

column9: This tea holds a prominent place in my cupboard!
column10: For a bagged tea, Bengal Spice is packed with fresh flavor.  When I selected a box at my co-op, I thought the flavor would be deeper and spicier.  When I brewed it, I was pleasantly surprised with the sweet notes that it had.  This is the perfect drink for the holidays.  The rich smell and sweet flavor is something I would drink while reading a book next to a fire or after an evening of sled riding with family and friends.  Additionally, I would consider Bengal Spice to a perfect dessert tea that would pair well with Matiz Andaluz Torta de Aceite, Sugared, 6-Count (Pack of 2).I love chai.  When I bought the box, I didn't notice that the manufacturer was calling this a caffeine-free interpretation of chai.  While chai was not the first thing that I thought of when I first drank this, I would find Bengal Spice to be an acceptable substitute for the real chai; Bengal Spice has all the right flavors and maybe with some coconut milk, it might be more in line with my vision of chai.I mostly drink loose teas because I find them to be fresher and more environmentally friendly.  As noted, this is a very fresh tea and compared to other bagged teas more green in its packaging.  The Bengal Spice tea bags not individually wrapped, which reduces waste.I will note that the unbrewed tea bags have an incredibly intense smell that I did not find pleasant.  Thankfully, once brewed, the scent changes and is quite nice and comforting.  Another potential negative for some will be the settling that occurs with this tea.  There is a progression of tastes with this tea.  As one might expect, as you get closer to the bottom of the mug, the spiciness increases due to settling of the various ingredients.  This may not be to everyone's liking and a good stir may be needed midway through the mug.All in all, a very fine tea.  I really like the flavor.  I see this as my go-to winter comfort beverage.

column9: an inspiration to the senses, a tea for the non-tea drinker
column10: Not that I despise or even dislike the benefits that caffeine brings, but sometimes, we just want something that allows us to relax. This is an exclamation mark in the herbal tea market and I have introduced many a friend and family member to the complex flavors and balance that Bengal Spice offers.  No matter the season, this blend carries its own weight, on ice in the summer, warm in the winter, it dares to be disliked. The simple packaging lends to the good-feeling of this treat and always makes me wonder why I ever buy the cheap stuff. Enjoy, this is truly a nectar of the gods, you won't be disappointed.
I buy this tea by the 6-box unit. It's great with or without milk. The cinnamon in it makes it so sweet I never use honey.

Alright, I'll admit, I wasn't expecting much when I picked this box up off the grocery store shelf for $2.34.  I used to drink my favorite loose leaf green teas at night, but when I started working earlier, even the green kept me up. I needed to lose the caffeine. I love spice, so I went with the kitty box here, Bengal Spice.I can't believe this is less than 12 cents a cup.  Right when you open the pouch you're overwhelmed with this amazing sweet smell of cinnamon and spice.  It only gets better.  The whole room ends up smelling like a bakery while you're steeping it, and it tastes as great as it smells.  Now I've got all my jars of fine loose leaf green teas, and one jar with the kitty box attached to it filled with Bengal Spice tea bags.  It has carved out a spot in my collection for years to come.  Forget dessert, it's in the cup.

This is a very good version of Indian chai, a mixture of black tea and various spices. The exact balance of spices in all versions of chai will vary of course.  This version is sort of in between the Northern Indian version and the Pakistani version.  It has more of a butterscotch sweetness to it and is less likely to give you digestive trouble.

column9: Why is this so hard to find?
column10: A friend turned me on to Celestial Seasonings Herb Tea years ago. The Bengal Spice has got to be an absolutel favorite. It's especially satisfying if you are feeling under the weather -- really seeming to help your throat.So flavorfull, you might even be tempted to try skipping the sweetener for once.Good stuff! I hope Amazon continues to carry it.
The is a great tea .... unfortunatly this is not carried by all food markets.

column9: Good alternative to Good Earth's product
column10: Tried this tea for the first time recently, and was pleasantly surprised. Found it to be a good alternative, and similar in taste, to the Good Earth Sweet and Spicy Caffeine Free variety, which seems lately to have had both a packaging change and a price increases at least via Amazon.One difference between the two is that the Celestial Seasonings tea bags come bulk packages in each box, with the tea bags group in tear-apart two-bag pieces. No strings and no individual tea bag packaging. Whereas the Good Earth varieties come with both string and tag attached to each bag, and then each bag individually packaged.But actually, since I use these teas for making homemade pitchers of iced tea, I don't really care about the packaging or wrapping differences. And I found the taste of the Celestial Seasonings Bengal Spice to be pleasing and enjoyable.That and, unlike the Good Earth varieties lately, I don't have to worry about getting the caffeinated tea variety by mistake with Celestial Seasonings. It's clear that their product is just herbal tea.

This is my wife's FAVORITE tea! We live in Switzerland, but import about 50--yes, fifty--packages of it each year, on our visits to the States. (Could it really be, that we go through 1000 bags a year?) A marvelous, really spicy chai without the caffeine--or black tea, for that matter. Sweet enough from the carob, so it needs no sugar. Our whole family enjoys it warm with a little milk, or cold just as is. The Celestial Seasonings "Brewmaster" hit it just right on this one!
Flavor-wise, this is my favorite tea. Hands down. Be warned: I like spicy foods/beverages. If you're sensitive to spiciness, this may not be for you.

column9: mmmm Bengal, where have you been?
column10: I drink this Bengal spice tea everyday! For some reason, it's very sweet, I thought it has sugar in it but according to rep at Celestial, they said sweetness is coming from natural mix of spices, and there are no sugar added... I usually leave it in the container for at least half day to get the full flavor of the tea. Having a case of this tea makes me happy!

The Bengal Spice is my new favorite tea.  While not a big fan of traditional Chai teas, I love this tea.  It has just the right spices, including nutmeg, that make the tea delicious with or without sugar or honey.  Is great served hot or as a cold iced tea.

column9: Beautiful spice blend reminiscent of chai tea
column10: I've been hooked for 30 years, which says something about the intoxiating blend of Indian spices in this wonderful, versatile tisane. One of the few brews I don't add sugar to, it's naturally sweet, making it a fantastic iced tea you can drink all afternoon without worrying about caffeine overload.It's also a pretty good herbal chai alternative, with classic chai ingredients such as cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger, black pepper and cardamom. Just add a little milk to your cup once it's done steeping and you've got a rich treat that feels indulgent, but without all the calories. Now my husband is hooked, so we buy in bulk. Highly recommended.

I love this tea but I can only find it at select stores. And sometimes it is out of stock. I decided to make my life easier by ordering a case of six boxes every 3 months to make sure I have a good supply. Everyone who tastes it raves about it. Some years I've given this tea for a little Christmas present or hostess gift. It has lots of flavor. My massage therapist says it also increases Yin energy. Try it, you'll like it.

column9: Wow! The caffeine-free alcohol-free drink I've been looking for!
column10: I saw this in my local Wholefoods and decided to give it a whirl. What a wonderful surprise - full flavoured, spicy, sweet and very satisfying - I have never had another herbal tea that comes close to this one - and even better can have it at any time as there's not any caffeine in it (or any calories which defies logic as it has quite a sweet flavour). The blend of spices is masterful - although cinnamon is listed as the prime ingredient I wouldn't say it dominates - the combination of ingredients used in this is a work of art!! Very pleased to find it sold in bulk at a good price on Amazon!!!!

Celestial Seasonings' Bengal Spice Chai is Colorado's laidback take on the Himalayan spiced delight. The Rockies have a passing resemblance to the roof of the world, with its K2 and Everest. Bengal Spice Chai aspires to be at the peak of taste. It is true to its spicy cinnamon flavors--but it's missing an essential element- milk. Oregon Chai Concentrate, Original, 32-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6), from the Pacific Northwest, is truer to the Indian original. Celestial Seasonings is best enjoyed while listening to Starbucks' freshly brewed World Is India, Putumayo's India with its rice pudding recipe, and Music From the Tea Lands with its own recipe for homemade chai. Drink it down!

I buy this amazing tea by the Amazon case and am sure to have it in the house at all times.  For a truly decadent and easy Chai, mix up a tall mug of Big Train, then add a Bengal Spice tea bag.  Wait 3 minutes as you savor the steam.  If this isn't what heaven smells like, then god isn't perfect.  Yes.  It is as delicious as its aroma.
Bought this flavor on a whim...and I absolutely love it! It smells divine and tastes wonderful. I could drink cup and after cup of it. Perfect example of what a cup of tea should taste like.

This is a really intense tea with lots of flavor.  You can make it with just water or 1/2 milk.  A bit of honey sets it off and if you want a dessert, just add whipped cream.  No caffeine makes this a great after dinner treat. Very good price and I got free shipping!

Bengal Spice by Celestial Seasons is my favorite herbal tea.  I drink it in the summer and inhale it in the winter.  I love the overwhelming cinnamon taste and I enjoy all the flavors.  To get the really full bodied flavor that I like, I only get one cup of tea to the tea bag; for that reason I have this on subscription so that I will not run out.  Great product.

Bengal Spice tea is rich with cinnamon and a hint of sweetness.  I drink it with or without honey- it's great either way. The aroma is fantastic!  My nine year old daughter likes it too- though she doesn't steep her bag so long, as the sharp "spice" can be a bit overwhelming for her if allowed to become strong.I have to add that we love the artwork on this box as well.  All the Celestial Seasoning boxes are nice, but this one is exceptionally beautiful.
If you love cinnamon red hots, this is it in liquid form.I make iced tea; it is not for the faint of heart and very unique.

My cousin gave me this tea to try.  After years of not being excited about many herbal teas, I am a convert if I can drink Bengal Spice.  I have been buying boxes and giving them to my friends and co-workers.Interestingly, I have cut back on my coffee habit because this tea satisfies my cravings for something hot and I don't even miss having the caffeine rush.I hope Amazon continues to carry this amazingly satisfying and mood altering tea.  One can't help but smile when drinking it!

Bengal Spice is one of the best spice teas I have tried...I like to have it with Milk and honey, leave the tea bag in for the last concentrated dropsAnd because this tea is NOT Import to my country, I have to find ways to get it.I purchase it in Amazon, send it to friends in the USA, and we smuggle it, :)Try it. It's like Vegemite, you like it or you don't.

Like many previous reviewers, I really enjoy the the flavors produced by the spicey mixture in this tea. It's a must during the chilly and downright cold months as drinking & smelling it warms you up from the inside out.
Their are so many flavors that come thru with one sip I would runout of a note pad writing them down.
Most of the negative reviews on here are because the tea taste like a red hot candy. That is the exact reason that I LOVE it so much. I just adore this tea. It has replaced my morning coffee.

column9: Best tasting tea - better than Chai
column10: I've been a Celestial Seasonings fanatic for about 3 years now.Their sleepytime, tension tamer, chamomile, honey vanilla chamomile, and mint magic teas all were pretty pleasant.  Oh, and around the holidays the local stores get the Sugar Cookie, Candy Cane Lane, and Gingerbread blends.This tea closely resembles the Gingerbread blend they currently sell, however, it tastes so much better.  There is an added ingredient or taste that just simply is missing from the gingerbread tea.  Bengal Spice tea is my new favorite tea.  I love the spicy initial taste, and depending on the cream you use, the after taste following is very uplifting.  It is a very rich tea and tastes very good with a sweet treat like some peanut M&Ms, or any other milk chocolate.Celestial Seasonings, hats off to you again for making such a great tea.Tea drinkers, you have to try this.  I'm a bengal spice-o-holic.

I can't get enough of this tea.  I use a boiling water kettle that I purchased here on Amazon to boil 32 ounces of water.  4 bags of this tea, with 3 packets of stevia goes into each pot.  I make two pots at a time, fill them half full with boiling water and let them steep for a couple of hours.  Then each pot fills one half of a liter 'bormoglio' canning bottle, fill the rest with filtered water and in to the refrigerator they go.  It keeps me out of serious trouble with diet colas :)  It's wonderful iced or hot, but this time of the year the refreshing cold tea right from the fridge is perfect and tastes sooooooo good.  No caffeine so great for those of us that are sensitive to caffeine too late in the day.  I finally have something good to offer friends that drop by and they have all commented on how good and refreshing it was.  No aftertaste left when using Stevia as opposed to artificial sweeteners or sugar.
Wonderful aroma and taste. A natural perk-me-up without the caffeine jangles. Add a touch of honey for a real treat. I drink it every evening and most days.
Our favorite tea flavor but there should be a discount over supermarket prices when puchasing quantity at a place that has no overhead!

I love this tea - it's spicy and sweet and very flavorful, no need to add honey or sugar. Really warming and comforting, great for a cold afternoon, or a chilly office. I am finding it increasingly hard to locate locally, so it's great to order online.

column9: This is the best tea I have ever tasted.
column10: I was looking for a tea that would help me with nausea and they was no ginger tea available at the time. When I read the ingredients I was ginger as was very happy. This has got me thru some very rough times and now I drink lots everyday. Sometimes the local store is out so I have ordered online and love the service Amazon provides.To this day I drink it on ice and have my best friend drinking it everyday also.

I used to love this tea, until I bought my most recent box. I had used a few bags of tea and they were good - you could taste the other spices in the tea. However, when I brewed some tea at work this morning all I could taste was cinnamon. It was horrible! Perhaps some of the bags were from a bad batch? The cinnamon oil flavour was just overwhelming and I poured the tea down the drain. I'm now reluctant to use any more bags from this box. Not impressed with the lack of consistency in the quality of this product.

I remember having some in the 1970's, early 80's, as a teen and then forgot it existed.I recently went somewhere and had a cup of it and was transported back in time.Then, I saw it at a local store and got a box and have been buying it since.I like it better than chai of any kind.I also am a lemon zinger fan.K?

column9: Great tea, and a great deal
column10: The tea is excellent and buying bulk allowed me to pay a much cheaper price w/o tax AND it was delivered to my door.  What more could ask other than to have the UPS guy come in and make the tea for me. I say YES to this purchase if you are considering.
This is one of my favorite teas by far! The taste that stands out to me is the ginger- and I love ginger.

I love this tea! I use it hot or cold and it tastes sooo good either way. It tastes sweet without any sugar! If fact, the first few times I made it I had to check the contents to make sure it didn't contain sugar or artificial sweetener. It really takes away my craving for something sweet after meals. Great product!
Love this Celestial Seasonings product which is no longer available in my grocery store. Subscribe and save is a great alternative

Some friends introduced me to Bengal Spice, serving it iced. I really like the spices and the zero calories is a bonus. I've changed from drinking a lot of coffee and then Chai to this, and am very happy with it.

I really like this tea I was looking for a Chai Tea that I could drink all the time and ran up on this. Although it tastes nothing like Chai Tea I like this much better it has the taste of something like red hot candies and since that is one of my favorite candies this fits the bill for me. It may take some getting used to for some people I put a little sugar and milk in mine and it's perfect for me I don't know if it's a popular tea with people it does have a unique taste.
I make this tea by the coffee pot full!  I add milk and honey an it makes some of the best chai type tea.  Too bad our local grocery stores have stopped carrying it.

column9: BEST damned tea on the planet!!!!!
column10: I have been drinking this tea for over 10 years.  I make a gallon of this iced almost daily.It is the best thirst quencher on a hot day....or any day for that matter.I sometimes add 2 bags of Harney & Sons Hot Cinnamon Spice and woooooooooohoooooo baybee!!!If you add any of the H&T cinnamon flavors, you probably won't want to add sugar as it naturally sweetens.I LOVE Bengal Spice soooo much, that I recently put it on auto-delivery...also cheaper to do that here and you get free shipping as well.  Most stores charge $3.75 per box or more.Good deal Lucille!

I like sweet foods and I add at least 2 tablespoons sugar to regular leaf tea, but this is so sweet I don't need to add sugar. I also don't add milk because I prefer the strong herbal taste and milk makes it more bland but creamy. For me personally it helps prevent and reduce headaches and stave off appetite. Highly recommended for people who want to reduce sugar in their diet.
Unfortunately I can't find it in any stores anymore! It's only online.Rich, but the cinnamon is not overpowering. Not chai.

This is great tea!  Celestial Seasonings has done a fine job with blending this spice mix.  It is very soothing and sweet.  I find it very comforting to my taste.  It's great for relaxing.  I highly recommend it!

I absolutely love this tea!It has a wonderful flavor, and as other reviewers have mentioned, it steeps strong. Strong enough that I can make a 16oz. cup with one bag, versus having to use two bags as with some of Celestial's other flavors.And if you're looking for even more kick, add a little honey - it intensifies the cinnamon even more!

column9: As a person who HATES Tea
column10: I LOVE Bengal Spice.  I think my problem with most teas is that I always have to add a sweetener or cream or something to it to make it tolerable.  This is perfect the way it is.  There's a definite cinnamon taste, but there's a subtle sweetness as well.  Kind of like a cider.This was suggested to me since I love Chai lattes so much (focus on the latte, not the tea). And it serves as a great, cheap, calorie free substitute.My only issues are:1. It seems to have stopped up my regularity, if you get my drift.  I've basically had to supplement my diet with more pure fiber.2. I can NEVER find it in stores.  They either don't carry Celestial Seasonings (odd), don't carry this flavor(odder), or are completely out of stock (not odd at all...but frustrating!). Thank God I can load up in bulk via Amazon. Note to Celestial Seasonings, please feel free to use this review to push more sales in grocery stores.  As it is, I've changed my shopping locales to (the few) stores that carry it.  So there!

This herbal blend is so flavorful! I drink lots of different teas and loose leaf herbal blends but this beats them all hands down. I even have a loose leaf chai blend from an expensive tea store and it is not as good as this. The price is unbelievable, and it is easy to find. It's also caffeine free. Celestial Seasonings is the best!

Like the other reviewers, I find this tea to be absolutely delicious. I first tried it at a friend's house last year, but then wasn't able to find it in the stores. Imagine my delight at rediscovering it.For those who are trying to cut down on sugar in their diets and are longing for a sweet treat: try this tea. With just a little dash of milk or cream, it is like a rich dessert - with no sugar or calories (except for the milk, if you add it).Now that I have rediscovered this tea, it will definitely remain a delightful part of my daily routine.Enjoy!

I've use this Bengal Spice tea to make an Iced Spice Tea blend for several years. About five years ago, all of the retail stores stopped carrying this blend in my area. I tried other spiced tea blends, but, none of them compared. So, I was overjoyed to find this blend at Amazon.com. So much so, that I have it on auto delivery. Thank you!

column9: A delicious tea which I am now drinking instead of coffee
column10: I discovered spiced tea on my vacations to India.  Now, I have a way to drink it at home.  This is a tea with a real flavor.  Not every supermarket carries Bengal Spice and by ordering it from Amazon, not only do I save money, but I am sure to have it.
This tea is Very fragrant, esp. the cloves and cinnamon, I think the taste takes a little getting used to, especially if you don't drink herbal tea on a regular basis - its strong on the cinnamon !

Delightfully spicy tea! I like to pop a teabag into a bottle with half water and half apple juice. Yum. Price here is about that of Celestial Seasonings teas in our local stores but this particular variety is difficult to find for some reason.
This is a great, flavorful complement when I make Indian food.  Great hot, and yummy as an iced latte!

I have loved Bengal Spice for years.  The natural food store I used to purchase it from doesn't carry it any more, nor does the lcoal vitamin store.  I found it on Amazon and I was delighted.  The tea was not in that wonderful box with the tiger sprawling, not that a box makes a difference.  The boxes and bags were smaller.  I used to be able to make two rip roaring cups and if I left my cup overnight, I would be greeted by that aroma next morning.  Not so much this.  I couldn't get much flavor from even the first bag and I have six boxes.  I am on a mission to find one of the old boxes to see whether my palate has changed or whether I just got a weak batch.  I want my old Bengal Spice.

column9: It's All a Matter of Taste -
column10: I've loved this tea for years and am no longer able to find it in the local grocery stores.  Surprising since I live in a major metropolitan area...Besides hot, it's my beverage of choice - as SUN TEA - in the summer - no added sweetening necessary.  If you like cinnamon & vanilla, try it!!
Bengal spice tea from Celestial Seasonings is the greatest tea in the whole world.  I have 6 boxes of tea to get me through the rest of the years.

column9: For those who Love cinnamon & spice...
column10: ...I recommend that you try this tea.  I admit that I used to drink this tea, I then tried another tea, which also has a very strong cinnamon flavor, and then I decided to try this one again.  I did not know how good I had it.  I am so happy that I came back to this tea.  It is without a doubt a winner.

I received a sample of this tea from FatWallet & have been addicted for over two years now. My pantry is full of every flavor they make but this is by far the best.  WOW--the best part of my day is getting up & curling up for "Tea Time" with my dog.  Life is good!!! You must make it the English way with a touch of milk & honey.  Chai just means adding lots of milk & sweetner to it for that smooth taste.

Celstial Seasonings makes a wide variety of excellent teas, of which Bengal Spice is my favorite.  Naturally caffeine free - it contains no tea leaves but rather is totally herbal - I like it with milk and a bit of sugar.  It is very aromatic and very much like a true India "Chai" tea.  We serve it often to friends who all love it too.  Ingredients are cinnamon,roasted chicory and carob, natural spice and vanilla flavor, ginger, cardamom, black pepper, cloves and nutmeg.  Wow!!  It is especially convenient to purchase from Amazon, as I typically find it hard to find in local - even large - supermarkets.

I bought this after reading the fine reviews for it.  I was looking for Morning Thunder because it had caffeine and yerba mate.  Six boxes Thunder and six Bengal... by and far Bengal has been my favorite.  It's interesting how the black pepper mixes in with the other flavors... definitely a huge wow factor.  I've never really been into tea, but this has been so sweet to start each day at work.  No caffeine too!
Bengal Spice is my favorite tea of all time.  It has a perfect blend of cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg and a hint of vanilla.  It doesn't need sweetener of any kind!!!.  Try it, I think you'll agree.

column9: This is the best tea on the planet
column10: I have been drinking Bengal Spice for thirty years.  It is hard to find Bengal Spice in the grocery stores, so I was thrilled to see it here on Amazon.  Bengal Spice has concentrated spices in it, which give it a warm, sweet flavor and is highly aromatic.  I have put a bag to "brew" in warm applesauce which gives the applesauce a great flavor.
Thanks for the great price on an even greater tea! I am so happy it is available on Amazon and I love the price and fast shipping too!

column9: The only Celestial Seasonings tea that I like
column10: I bought this tea last year and was surprised at how much flavor it has -- it literally burns your throat with all the cinnamon if you keep the teabag in, and has a sweet flavor without adding any sweetener. I equate it with the candy Fireballs. I forgot about it until now when I just got a cold and none of my other teas were doing it for me. Great stuff.
I can drink this tea all day, every day. Doesn't need sweetening. Best herb tea I've found!

column9: Bengal Spice Tea - the most satisfying tea I've ever tasted
column10: I find the combined taste of cinnamon, roasted chicory, carob, ginger, cloves, nutmeg and the other spices and flavorings in this tea to be addictive. This tea is definitely worth trying.

column9: Surprisingly good, but could be a bit better
column10: I'm not usually a Celestial Seasonings fan.  I find many of their offerings decidedly below par.  But Bengal Spice is actually pretty good.  It's perfect for cinnamon fans, as that is undoubtedly the boldest taste in this blend.  And it's true that you don't need to sweeten it; the cinnamon takes care of that itself.In terms of strength it's nice and bold.  The vanilla smoothes everything out though...it's not too strong, unless you let the bag steep for an inordinately long time.  But Bengal Spice does have one notable weakness....for those looking for a great chai, you might be disappointed.  Because while it's strong and has a nice flavor, the ginger, cardamom, nutmeg etc. is hardly noticeable, masked by the strength of the cinnamon.  It's a shame, because this blend is definitely better-tasting than some, such as Yogi's classic India Spice.  If the other "chai spices" in this blend had been stronger, this would be a 5-star tea.

The negative reviews for Celestial Seasonings Bengal Spice Tea are from people who were expecting chai. This company does imply this is their VERSION of chai, but NOT that it is suppose to BE chai... it is not a decaf version of chai... if it was, it would say that and I'm sure the taste would be different. This is a SPICE tea, that is decaf. That's all. Upon giving up caffeine, I turned to this to REPLACE my chai tea, and it did NOT disappoint! It is excellent, but like other reviews good or bad, that is MY opinion. My kids love it, and prefer it over hot cocoa when we add a touch of almond milk. Needs no sweetening in my opinion and I wouldn't change a thing! Again, it IS NOT CHAI! But it's a GREAT way to replace chai and the caffeine in it, if you're concerned about that.Although cinnamon is the predominant flavor, I have to BEG to differ on the thought that it taste like Big Red or Red Hot candy boiled in water... NOT SO. The taste is lovely when combined with the other flavors. I suppose you would need to taste it to form your OWN opinion. To us, it's FANTASTIC. Would recommend and would order again and again.

column9: Change in Recipe, But Still Pretty Good
column10: I had one of the "tiger" boxes of Bengal Spice tea for quite some time, but never tasted it.  When I finally tasted it, I was delighted.  It was superb. (Bengal Spice is, by the way, a combination of spices and of roasted chickory.)I don't care much for green tea.  But Bengal Spice was so good that I was able to steep it with bags of green tea, producing an excellent combination.I couldn't wait to order a six-pack of Bengal Spice. But one of the recent reviews that I had read was correct.  The formulation is dramatically different.The tea that I just received is pretty good.  I only found it to be "good" by adding a bit of apple juice.  Unfortunately, it's no longer superb.On well, I guess I'll buy more anyway. I just don't care that much for the taste of green trea.

I didn't like this at first. It was too hot (I like spice, including food, aromas and perfume. Hot and spicy aren't necessarily the same thing).  It did not taste sweet to me unless I used two tea bags.  Unfortunately this seemed too sweet for me this way and the smell was somewhat annoying.  Meanwhile, I ordered Jasmine tea around the same time which is an EXTREMELY bitter green tea if you steep it too long or with too hot water(found this out the hard way).  Then it hit me. Since I didn't like either of them, why not brew the two together and see what happens.  PERFECT EUREKA!!  They seem to balance and compliment each other.  The combination brew is neither too bitter nor too spicy.  It's delicious together and I feel good after drinking it.  The spices used in the Bengal Spice are all given as balancing to the Khapha dosha, as is Jasmine tea (did not know this when I ordered the teas).  I think I stumbled across something good here. I sweeten the brew with a touch of raw honey.

This is a very tasty tea - nice and spicy, plenty of cinnamon and the ginger gives a nice bite, and no caffeine.  Every box I've gotten has been fresh.  My gripe however is the lack of strings.  The box claims they save 3.5 million pounds(!?) of landfill waste every year by not using individual wrappers or strings/tags/staples.  That seems like an exaggerated claim, and the lack of strings and staples is a real annoyance in my book.  It means I always should use/carry a spoon in order to agitate the bags a bit while steeping, and remove them from the hot tea.  It's so annoying I even considered only 3 stars.  Mostly I drink tea at the office, and bringing a spoon around with me to meetings is odd, so instead I tend to wait until tea is cooler and use my fingers, which also is odd.  Individual wrappers I can do without because I drink frequently enough the tea doesn't go stale, but please give me strings and staples.
It's a great full bodied tea with Vanilla flavored creamer and sugar substitute. Enjoy it at work if I don't have to go out in the field.

If you are looking for something comparable to the Chai at you-know-where, skip this tea.  I bought some after reading the reviews, but felt they really missed the mark.  This tea should be simply called "Cinnamon Tea"--that is the ONLY flavor I taste, and not at all like Chai.  Imagine melted Red Hots dissolved in water, and that is about what this tea tastes like.  I love Celestial Seasonings tea usually, but this one is really overpowering with the cinnamon flavor, which should be better pointed out on the box.  I am going to try their India Spice tea based on other reviews, and will hopefully find something more complex like what I am looking for (and will hopefully be a nice substitute for the expensive Chai from Starbuck's).

column9: wHAT IS THE RAVE ABOUT? Red hot gum, that's about it!
column10: I have no idea WHAT people are raving about..I read all of the positive reviews only a half hour ago and thought for sure I could add to them. Now that I am back and have finished brewing a cup of this tea, I find that there has never been such an on point review! A cup of red hots brewed in hot water is EXACTLY what this tea tastes like- I could have boiled some cinnamon sticks from the cupboard and got the same taste. Where are all of the other flavors? Um, not here in this tea, I tell you that much! I am NOT sure if this has anything to do with this being the decafe version, but I will NOT be buying this again. I got through the cup by adding some agave and rice milk, but  I  feell like I just finished a pack of wrigley's red hot gum...what a hot mess!
It's basically the cinnamon challenge in liquid form and it smells like a craft store at Christmas. Won't be buying this again.
Hidden in the ingredients under "natural flavor" is some sort of herbal sweetener like stevia.  The taste has a shocking initial sweetness followed by a nasty bitterness.  Worst tea ever.

This was a big, hot cup of cinnamon-oil flavored tea.  Nothing about it made me want to keep drinking it and I am very disappointed in the flavor.  I completely agree with a previous review that commented about it tasting like "Big Red" gum.  I won't purchase this again.

I was initially skeptical about buying anything that was food-related, especially chocolate covered since I live in Virginia and it's still humid and relatively warm here.  When the product arrived, I checked to see if the weather had affected the quality but it looked perfect! It's what you would expect, gummy bears(looks like they used the clear-colored ones) smothered in good premium Swedish white chocolate. Although the shipping costs almost just as much as the product(hence the 4-star rating), I plan on purchasing again because it's that addictive!
Everyone loved the chocolate bears and they came a day early even with harsh weather conditions.. Will definitely order again
The product came well packed and i've used this ABC Sweet soy sauce in the past so, i know it's delicious. I use it when i make Chinese dishes
I absolutely love this mustard!  It is amazing on wraps, sandwiches, and grilled portobello mushrooms! It is the perfect blend; the garlic is not overpowering, but not too subtle, either.

Frankly, my kids drink a glass of strawberry milk every morning.  I wish they didn't, but there it is.  My kids love this stuff.  I have tried different strawberry flavorings, ones that are made with better ingredients and/or are organic, since that is my preference, but my kids hate them.  I wish this wasn't made with HFCS, but it is the only thing in my home that has high-fructose corn syrup in it, so I kid myself that it's okay.  The fact that is comes in a three-pack is very handy.  I may just run out of it one day and "not be able to buy it anymore."  But, for now, to keep the morning peace in my house, I will carry on with Hershey's strawberry syrup.

My Papillons (ages 8 and 9) have been the pickiest damn dogs I have ever met.  You know when the vet says "they will eat eventually, they won't starve"?  Well, no.  These damn dogs would starve if they didn't get to eat something they liked.  I have been struggling for years to find food that is not made in China, not made from chicken from China even if manufactured in the USA.  Finally, I found Halo.  I integrated the Halo Spots Stew kibble and the Halo Spot's Stew chicken canned into the Paps diet over 2 weeks.  Week one they ate half of the Halo and by the end of week two they were eating ALL of the Halo product and the small amount of the old brand was left in their bowls.  Their skin is fantastic, their poops are a perfect consistency (not too hard or too soft) and they are energetic and just happy and excited for meal time now.  I also feed them the Halo LiL Bits freeze dried chicken treats.  All of the ingredients are from USA and made solely here.  And, I am thrilled that my favorite TV talk show host, Ms. Ellen Degeneres is a part owner of the company.Thank you Amazon for offering this here as it is hard to get in my somewhat small town pet stores who seem to cater to gross China food that will make all our dogs sick.

I have spent 2 years trying to find some sort of dog food that won't break the bank, that's made with dog health in mind, and that my dogs actually like. having said that, I was truly skeptical about buying this, simply because of the price. I mean, it's dog food, they all look the same. But. it's. awesome. I started off by mixing in a spoon full of it into their regular food, and for the first time ever my dogs were cleaning their plates. its got chunks of real vegetables in it, and in combination with the dried food (also Halo, I mix the salmon with the lamb) my dogs are eating like kings and queens: 3 types of meat, 15 types of veggies & fruits...wow.I'm totally in love with this brand. I have switched over EVERYTHING, their treats, their dry food and their wet food.if halo comes out with a flavored water supplement for dogs, I'll probably buy that too. its just a great brand, reliable, and with a conscience.
My dogs love this food.  They eat it up as soon as I put it in their bowls.  I feel good about feeding my dogs this food.  You can see real carrots and green beans.

Love the item, but found it Cheaper at Vitacost.com.  Our dog had all kinds of health issues until we switched to Halo. Hs skin itched, he kept getting ear infections and he got very sore and limped after just a little exercise. Worst of ll, he could no longer go jogging with my wife and was acting old at the age of 6. Now he is healthy again and has the energy of a puppy again.

column9: NOT as Good as I hope for..try...
column10: I tried to switch my pug puppy to this food from another holistic brand and found it too rich for her. She started throwing it back up in just an hour or so after eating a very small amount of it. I switched her to WELLNESS Just for Puppy Holistic Nutrition. She has done very well with this. They also guarantee it or your money back. Price is comparable with Halo.

column9: Only dog food I will use
column10: After reading horrible reviews about dog food and with the onset of my puppy having seizures, I made him only home cooked meals specifically for dogs.  He was having stomach problems and went through many different recipes always consulting with my Vet, but then I found Halo dog food.  My dog eats this and looks for more, his stomach problems have subsided and he's doing very well. This was such a relief due to his seizures and stomach problems and I tried so hard to make him well.  He's been on Halo canned chicken Spots Stew now for 2 months and I am so relieved.  Now if only I could do something about the seizures, all would be well.  However, I give very high recommendations for Halo food.  A bit expensive, but worth every penny.  I need to add that I know how much Ellen Degeneres loves dogs and put my trust in her advocating Halo food.  I'm not sorry. Thanks Ellen.  Thanks Amazon for carrying it and offering monthly subscriptions.

This dog food is packed full of great stuff. You can see the chunks of chicken, carrots, peas and pasta. I feel good about feeding this to my dog. This can size is perfect for dogs under 10 pounds. My little chihuahua loves the stuff and one small can lasts us about 2 days.
THIS STUFF LOOKS GOOD ENOUGH TO EAT RIGHT OUT OF THE CAN. WE USE IT TO GIVE THEM A TREAT FROM TIME TO TIME. THEY LOVE THE CHANGE AND ENJOY IT. GOOD WHOLESOME FOOD FOR YOUR PETS.

column9: If only it would have worked...
column10: I wanted this wonderful food to work for Sheldon, but even a teaspoon added to his lamb and rice kibble gave us not so good results.  I wonder if he is just too little to try it...he is 4 months old.  Anyway, we may try it again when he is older because it seems like such a good quality food and that is what we strive to feed him.  I do have to say I was surprised when I opened the can.  I was expecting a chunky stew type food but it isn't.  It is a course puree with chunks of vegetable in it and that was fine with me too.  Also, he loved it!  If only it would have loved him back.

We lived in Britain for 8 years and this is the ONLY decaf black tea that you can't tell from the real thing!  No wishy washy decaf taste from this brand.  But this seller is charging an arm and a leg for it.  Used to be able to get this at World Market for $9 for 80 bags.

column9: Just like the real thing! Hard to believe its decaf!!
column10: I love PG Tips regular tea, but wanted to cut back on my caffeine. I just finished my second cup and I just can't believe it is really decaf. Wonderful.
This is the only decaf tea of the dozen or so I have tried that makes a "real' cup of tea - strong, with taste, and not overwhelmed by a little milk.
I am a big fan of the strength of PG Tips. While not quite as strong, this is the best decaf substitute for a good tea I have found.

column9: PG Tips is tip top with me
column10: PG Tips tea is the best tasting tea I have found. It is excellent for hot or iced tea. The taste is very bold and flavorful. I prefer the decaf because caffeine adversely affects me.
It has not been easy finding a good decaf tea; but this one is wonderful.
I love my english tea and was glad to find a place where I can buy it in bulk and for a reasonable price. I will continue to get this product or similar teas.

I love good, strong tea and only drink PG Tips. I was looking for a decaffeinated option and found this to be excellent! Most decaffeinated teas are very weak and leave me feeling dissatisfied with the taste and strength. This does not.I contacted the seller a little over a week after I ordered to question why they post such a long delivery estimate. They responded right away to tell me that the product was coming from the UK and that it doesn't usually take anywhere near that long.  It arrived the next day.  I am very pleased with the service and the product. I HIGHLY recommend both and will be ordering again in the near future.

After trying a lot of different Decaf teas, PG Tips is absolutely wonderful.  Over the years, I have been brewing different caffinated English brand teas because of the bold flavor.  When it became necessary to start using decaf instead, the one of the only teas I was able to find that still proved that strong, bold, smooth and yet not bitter taste has been PG Decaf. I would highly recomment it to anyone who drinks tea.  You can not tell that it is decaf.

I drink only pg tips tea. It is hard to find decaf locally and pg tips is the only kind of decaf I like and I need to cut back on the caffeine for health reasons. The product arrived in a timely manner, only thing is it is expensive, over $9.00 for a box of 80 bags,therefore I shall continue to try to find a more reasonable source.

I like plenty of tea at night, but want to be able to sleep so first I tried Tetley's decaf and it was OK. This, however is the best. It's darn close to the regular PG Tips which I drink early in the day. Worth any extra price.
Really yummy and healthy.  The ginger adds the perfect amount of spice to my morning.

column9: Organic, Low Sugar & No Artificial Sugar - Finally!
column10: We eat healthy. That means my kids drink very little juice and zero soda. By very little I mean I never buy it, they might have some at a friend's house or a party or something. Generally they drink only milk or water. But that means they feel left out when the other kids have sugar-filled juice boxes or caprisuns. Enter Honest Kids! Yes, they have sugar in them, that's what I like. Go look at a box of 'Roaring waters' - that has artificial sweeteners (and sugar too, something I never could quite figure out). I would rather my children had a small amount of real sugar than artificial sweeteners. Since they are used to drinking only water otherwise, they like these, they don't complain they taste watered down. In fact if you compare these to a typical CapriSun, its kind of like the difference between a Vitamin Water and Gatorade. When you are used to Vitamin water, (original) Gatorade is going to taste sickly sweet, if you are used to Gatorade, Vitamin water is going to taste like water with slight flavor. Ask yourself which you want your children to be used to?I've seen other reviewers complain that they are hard to open or messy - my 6 and 8 year olds have no problems with them.  They put the straw in themselves and don't have a problem spilling them.Now they don't feel left out when everyone else has a juice box, and I feel good about the amount of sugar they are taking in. At only 40 calories and no artificial sweeteners, this is exactly what I've been looking for!

column9: Delicious breakfast treat; also good deal from Amazon
column10: I have been eating these for some time now and greatly enjoy them.  Unfortunately, the item is not offered in any of the grocery stores in my new home town and I was excited to find these via Amazon.  I now have these set up for regular shipment via the subscription service and its a great convenience and great value.Pricing is also good for package.  I buy the 6-count boxes and there are 6 boxes (36 oatmeal bars total).  My cost, including shipping is about $15.50 and I previously had to pay $9.99 at BJ's Wholesale for 24 bars. Regular grocery stores sell each box for about $3.25 so I figure the Amazon deal is a good one for me.
Our one-year-old likes these, and they make much less mess than cookies or crackers.  They are great for trips.

column9: Tastes good, but watch the sorbital
column10: I was eating these for breakfast for a few months, and noticed I was getting some digestive problems. They taste good, have good nutrition, but if you have a sensitive stomach, watch out! Sorbital can have ill effects on the digestive system.

I started eating Quaker's Oatmeal To Go about 7 or 8 years ago - my favorite being banana.  But, they have all disappeared from the grocery stores.  We travel in our RV across the country, and I always look for Oatmeal To Go.  Not finding any, I now purchase Oatmeal To Go from Amazon.Quaker Oatmeal To Go Variety Pack - 24 Count please note: Does not contain Bananna / Contains Apple  Unfortunately, my first choice, banana, is evidently not being made anymore but I am happy with my present choices.Thank goodness for Amazon.
Great way to have a healthy fast breakfast! A little high in calories but that is offset by the health benefits of lowering cholresterol and adding high fiber to a diet.

I became a fan of these Breakfast Bars quite a while ago.  Much to my dismay, I could no longer find them at any grocery store.  Guess where I found them?  Amazon.com, of course.  I am very happy to have them in my cupboard again. They are very tasty (especially warmed in the microwave).  I grab one with my coffee a couple of mornings per week.
This is the second time I have ordered these oatmeal to go bars.  I take one to work, and always enjoy them with my coffee or tea.  They are quick to pack in a purse.
Sell me more! These things are the perfect breakfast. No, they are just perfect. Better price then the local grocery store and better selection.
Watch out for shelf life, this is alot of oatmeal bars to eat in a shorter than expected shelf life.

column4: Enhancer, Boston, MA USA "Do something healthy"
column10: These are great for a quick healthy breakfast. I like the cinnamin and the banana with the frosting. The Oatmeal raisin is kind of dry. I dont know why they dont have Maple Brown Sugar as a flavor for the Oatmeal Squares like they do with the regular oatmeal that would be great! I do recommend these.

column9: Excellent Quaker Oatmeal To Go Brown Sugar & Cinnamon Oatmeal Squares.
column10: These Quaker Oatmeal To Go Brown Sugar & Cinnamon Oatmeal Squares are great when heated in the microwave.  They are full of the good stuff we need to start our day and taste great.  When I get low I will order more for sure.  Thanks Amazon.com for the super low price and quick delivery.
I sent this to my "starving" student for a snack during class. They are great, healthy and easy to pack without getting all crumbly.

These are so darn yummy, they are out  of this world good and just are perfect anytime.  They hit the spot and really leave such a great feeling after you are done eating one.  They tate great just right out of the package but you can also microwave them to make them warm and they are amazing tasting that way.  It is the perfect on the go breakfast when you are short on time.  They are so sweet, love the amount of sweet.  The brown sugar is there but it is not overpowering like some brown sugar flavored bars are.  You will fall in love with these.  I have not tried the other two flavores but I dont like raisins and I dont much like bananas so this is my to go quaker bar of choice.

column9: Tasty, mildly spicy gravy for rice or roti
column10: Mirch (or mirchi) ka salan is a dish from Hyderabad, Andhra Pradesh, in southern India, often served with the local biryani, and it is intended to be a very wet curry.Overall, this is another winner among the pre-packaged Indian meals:  a mildly spicy, beautifully-colored, creamy-textured sauce for rice or bread made with a base of ground peanuts, sesame seeds, and almonds.  The flavor is very complex: the onion, tamarind, and coconut give it a slight sweetness; the garlic, ginger, tamarind, and curry leaves add a bit of tangy bite; and the large chunks of chili peppers lend a very mild heat.  I like to add cayenne powder to increase the heat a bit.  It is also good with a few raisins and almonds sprinkled on top and I have added whole cubanelle peppers steamed in the microwave to bulk it up into a complete meal when served with brown basmati rice.The quality of this product is similar to what might be found in a standard Indian buffet restaurant here in the U.S.  Some people may not like the flavor of some typical Indian spices, especially coriander, which has a soapy taste to certain palates, but fans of Indian food who like coriander should enjoy eating this.There are no preservatives and the mirch ka salan is vegetarian but not vegan as it contains some ghee.  As is typical of these retort-packaged Indian meals, it is high in sodium and fat.  As others have noted, it is easy to pour off a spoonful or so of oil before serving.Nutrition facts:Note that each packet is 2.5 servings but realistically is the right amount for one or possibly two people depending on what it is served with so adjust accordingly:PER SERVING:Calories 220Calories from fat 160Total fat 18g 28% RDASaturated Fat 4.5g 23% RDATrans Fat 0gCholesterol 3 mg 1% RDASodium 650mg 27% RDATotal Carbohydrate 9g 3% RDADietary Fiber 2g 8% RDASugars 3gProtein 5gVitamin A 0% RDACalcium 20% RDAVitamin C 0% RDAIron 15% RDAIn addition to lowering the fat and sodium, it would be nice if Kitchens of India would shift to printing or labeling the foil pouch and not enclosing it in an individual box for these case sales in order to reduce unnecessary waste.  The package also shows whole pepppers, and while there are large chunks, they certainly don't look like the illustration.The sodium and fat reduce the rating to four stars, even though the texture and flavor warrant five stars.

Some of the early reviews for this entree are pretty harsh.  I figured it couldn't be THAT bad so I bought a bunch at the blow out price.  It would have to be pretty bad to be worth less than a buck a box... unless it was inedible of course, and then I'd have wasted $25 or so.  I like Indian food so I took a chance.The first box had me thinking the worst.  I tried it alone, heated of course.  It was not a taste I was used to and, as another reviewer noted, it does look gross.  More importantly, there was grit in it, like sand.  Not a lot but enough to disturb. About every third mouthful I'd crunch on a bit of grit and think "yuck," to myself, "the bad reviews were right."But I bought a lot so I persevered.  The next box I mixed with rice.  Definitely an improvement.  More like a real meal and -- surprisingly -- no grit.  A relief.A box or two later I decided to add some cooked chicken.  Even better, and thankfully still no return of the sandy grit.I finished off the first tray (a 6-pack) this way plus with toasted hazel nuts mixed into the last 2 boxes.  Finally got it tasting just right for my palate.With add-ins of your choice this entree can be a pretty nice meal, filling and relatively healthy though high in fat and salt.  Alone as it comes I would only give it three stars, or "ok" as the star system rates. That assumes no grit.  I would rate my modified version higher but that's not the product as sold.One other thing I noticed as I started in on the 2nd tray of six entrees is that the spicy hot temperature rose steeply.  The 2nd tray may well have been from a different batch so quality control may be uneven.  At least the sandy grit hasn't made a reappearance.... yet....It turned out to be a chance worth taking for me but I can easily imagine that others may not find it paying off for them even at a rock-bottom asking price.  Your mileage may vary.

column9: The gravy is similar to butter chicken gravy
column10: Could do better with a  little less oil. I drained out 2 tspn oil from each packet i opened.Overall it tastes in like with rest of the Kitchens of India products.

column9: Guests rave about it - But you need to prepare it properly
column10: This product is marketed as a dinner or soup, and I can see how some people would be put off by it when consumed this way. Instead, I use it as a sauce for baked chicken. Simply lay out some drumsticks in a casserole dish, pour Kitchens of India Ready To Eat Mirch Ka Salan over the chicken (one package for every 6 drumsticks), cover and bake at 350 degrees for about an hour. Everyone who has tried it wants the recipe. They are always amazed at how simple this is to make.

column9: Taste is not consistent everytime I order a new batch!
column10: Its that weird feeling when you try the same thing over again and feel different altogether. The first time I've tried them, they tasted bland. The second time, they tasted amazing. The third time I've ordered them, they didn't taste good.Its maybe that ITC (original manufacturers of this product, Indian Tobacco Corporation, an Indian giant company) lacks quality controls. But I recommend that if you don't like it, ship it back and order a new batch. You'll not regret it.

column9: THIS BRAND IS NORMALLY VERY GOOD, BUT....
column10: I have curry pastes from this company that are outstanding...but this particular product just isn't good at all. My hubby loves Indian, too, and he is not a picky eater--but even he told me to find a new home for the boxes we bought of this stuff! I don't know how to describe it...it's kinda vinegary and sour and it has big hunks of banana peppers in it. It isn't creamy and the texture is almost grainy. I tried to rescue it with coconut milk and it really didn't help. The "curry" in it is very faint and it's just...well...you might like it but we sure didn't. As I said, we've bought many other items from Amazon in this brand of Indian foods, but this is just the opposite of the other items. It just isn't good.

column9: Very little veg content, and flavor too mild/heavy.
column10: This is an excellent brand, and I've enjoyed their other recipes, but not this dish. What you get is almost 100% sauce -- an extremely heavy sauce made of finely ground nuts. You will need to add your own vegetables to make a real dish out of it. The sauce is so heavy that even though it contains some nice spices, it still begs for more flavor.

This dish has wowed me so much that I now crave it.  It has a wonderful sourness (green chili and tamarind) that is tamed by the pureed almonds and peanuts that make this dish so rich.  I love the chili flavor, and it is one of the few Kitchens of India dishes that actually has ghee listed on the ingredient list. I feel completely satisfied by this dish.  It is a taste experience I want again and again.  My husband also likes it very much.  Very,very delicious.

column9: Good Flavor and Just Spicy Enough - Recommended
column10: Kitchens of India "Mild Chili Pepper Curry" is an authentic Indian dish that has a great flavor and just enough spicy heat to make it interesting. We are fortunate to have Indian friends who occasionally invite us to dinner but since we can't always count on an invitation whenever a craving comes on one us, these pre-made packets are a reasonable substitute. Here are my observations:Pros -+ Good Flavor; as noted above, this tastes very good to people that like Indian food (my mother hates it)+ Mildly Spicy; this rates on low to medium of the spicy scale, might be too much heat for some since it "stays with you"+ Low Carb; 22.5g Total Carbs - 5g Dietary Fiber = 17.5 Net Carbs in each packet (see serving size info in "Misc", below)Cons -- "Not as Pictured"; the picture on the packaging shows nice whole peppers, but they are actually cut up in the sauce- Oily; this has a lot of oil that will rise to the top when cooking in a pot (we skim some off)- High in Calories; each packet has 550 calories (400 from fat - but no Trans Fats)Misc -* Serving Size; package says 2.5 per packet, we find that two packets when served with rice and bread is enough for our family of four* Filling; this is a very heavy sauce based dishWhile not really a standalone meal, this is a good entree that can be used as the main course. We recently put it out when we had a BBQ and found that it also made an interesting topping on Hot Dogs.Highly Recommended!CFH
I have tried a few of the Kitchens of India varieties and this is one of my favorite.  It has some spice but not too much.  It's great with rice.
I am of Indian origin (may be that didnt help).I tried to cook it in a pan. I tried the microwave. The taste is awful.
What a waste!!! Hardly any "Mirch" (Green Chillis) in it and really oily. Doesn't look anything like the picture on the packet.

Combined with white rice, each packet is good for 2 solid meals, perhaps 3 if lower proportions of curry are used.  Heated easily in the microwave or on the range; I recommend adding chicken if you favor a meat option.  However, despite my carnivorous leanings, I've found myself generally preferring not to trouble with preparing any meats.  It's good and spicy compared to most food in Indiana, but it seems most everyone here can take it just fine with a little extra rice.  It's not too sweet in my opinion, but be prepared for a some excess grease.  Good stuff overall, and super easy.

Out of all of the "ready-to-eat" offerings from kitchens of India this is the least tasteful I've had so far.  I absolutely strongly recommend you combine this with some other starchy food like rice, naan, potatoes, or anything.  Eating it combined with something else makes it at least tolerable while eating it alone simply isn't.  The texture can be a bit gritty, it's similiar to eating food with an excessive amount of turmeric - even though it's not an ingredient in this product.  I say "can be gritty" because the quality of the product seems to be a bit inconsistent.  A few will be better than others, a few will make you want to throw all of it out.  Definitely won't be purchasing this one again!
I love it. Add it to any veggies and its a feast. It has lots of tamarin and so some people complains that it taste sour. I love tamarin sour. tal!tal!

These are good - they are great over rice, some tofu or whatever vegies you have laying around. But, more importantly and contrary to what the box says about being mild, mine were very spicy. Very spicy, but a good spicy. I enjoy spicy food, but have to eat these with 2 or 3 glasses of water. Other reviewers suspect that different batches have different levels of spiciness, so you ought to be prepared for some very spicy curry!I will be making these a staple of my diet tho!

column9: Horrible, Anything but Mild, Gritty, Awful Taste, Awful appearance
column10: This is the absolute worst food product I have ever bought.  It looks awful, tastes awful and is anything but mild.  After tasting it, I threw 5 unopened boxes in the trash.  Don't even think of trying this slop.  Yuck!

I really like the taste of the product, but I can confirm the grit a previous reviewer mentions. It's a fine grit and not in every bite. Sand is not listed as one of the ingredients, so I am not sure of the cause.  Since it's not overbearing, I would still buy again.

column9: Great mixed with cabbage and peas
column10: This curry is pretty strong and bold by itself. I still like it, but there's not much to it (it's just a... sauce?). I put it over rice and I like it. but I cooked up some cabbage and frozen peas and mixed it with this and I really really like it. I use 1/4 head of green cabbage and a 1/2 cup of frozen peas per pouch. I heat/cook these in the pan with a small amount of oil until the cabbage becomes soft before adding the curry paste. then I just wait for the curry paste to heat up and then serve with rice. cheap, quick, and healthier than stuff that's not as healthy.

column9: Mild Chili Pepper Curry - an OK product
column10: This particular product of Kitchens of India is much cheaper than their other similar products. Probably because it is not good. (It was eight USD when I bought it.)1) Product doesn't appear anything like as depicted in the picture. We have consumed two packets so far, but haven't seen a single whole pepper (like in the picture) in it.2) If you are health concious, drain the floating oil by making a small opening in the inner packet before you heat the product. You will feel much better knowing that that much less oil has gone into your body.3) Product taste is acceptable. We will definitely consume the remaining 4 packets over the next few months, but we definitely will not reorder this product.Since the taste is acceptable, much of the oil can be drained, and the product is cheap and eligible for free shipping, it is OK to order once and see if you'll like it.
This is quite spicy, but not too hot to eat.  There are big chunks of peppers in it, that I picked out.  The rest is just a sauce type mixture.  I enjoyed it with bread to dip in it.

column9: High on taste; high in calories
column10: I loved the taste of this preparation [so I'm ordering more]. However it has more calories in its 10 oz pack than any of the other ready-to-eat Indian dishes I've tried. One pack has a total of 550 cals [compared to the Tasty Bites preparations which have about 300 cal or so]. I think I'll try and drain out the oil with the next pack I heat up.

column9: inexpensive change of pace, greasy, a bit firy
column10: To be honest, it looks like something that came out of a dog. Fortunately, it tastes much better than it looks. It's greasy. You will want rice with it, or bread, or something to soak up the oil.It's surprisingly high in calcium, which is good. It's unsurprisingly high in fats and salt but, hey, live a little. It's not seriously spicy but, it made me feel right warm after a package ("2.5 servings" or 550 Calories).Good emergency food. It's palatable, it will last a long time without refrigeration, and it can be quickly and simply prepared in a variety of ways.

I absolutely love Indian food and have tried other flavors by Kichens of India, but this one is pretty bad.  It has an overpowering sour taste and I couldn't finish mine.  Try some of the other flavors instead (curry mixed vegetables, kidney beans - I forget their complete names).

I've tried a number of Kitchens of India products and this one is now by far my favourite!  I use it as a sauce with chicken and vegetables.  I do add a few hot chili peppers to make it a little stronger.  The depth of the flavor is amazing.  I'm gonna buy a bunch more in case they run out.

column9: Tastes good, maybe a little too mild?
column10: Tastes good.  The only problem I have with it, is that for how full of fat, calories and sodium it is, it doesn't have a very powerful flavor.  Meaning, you need to use lots of it for an average portion of rice.Probably best used as a gravy to cook meat or tofu in.

....but, for some reason there seems to be more oil in these entrees.  I love the KOI curry dishes, and this one isn't  bad at all.  A little spicy though even though it says "mild" so its not something I would eat often.  But, I thought it was pretty good and satisfying and have added it to my pantry for the days I want something a little different.  But, their curry and butter chicken meals are fantastic, and they are 5 stars for sure.

I like that this is ready to eat.  I used it over some sliced roasted chicken.  I ate it with rice, it was great like this.  I don't think I'd like it as much just right out of the pack.  It could be overpowering that way.  The heat is just right - warm really, not hot.  Less than a medium salsa but it definitely has some warmth.  It has a tad bit of sourness that combines well in the nut sauce.  It's really great for me because I like Indian food very often while my family does not.  There are Kitchens of India flavors that I like better, but I would order this again, definitely.  The color is more pale than the picture.  I like the taste a lot better than the color.  The texture, to me, is fine!  It's a nut based sauce after all.

column9: A bit hot, but OK on rice or pasta.
column10: A bit hot for me, so I may have to stretch out my subscription.  I live alone, so I broke it down into 3 small servings and used on top of rice.  This helped tone the heat. Waring for some with a touchy stomach like mine; DO NOT take a mouth full without a little taste test first.  The spice can cause stomach upset in some people.  (I have stomach trouble and this was to much for me.  Cutting the serving amount and adding rice allowed me to enjoy some of the spicy heat without killing my stomach.) Curry is not everyone's "cup of tea" but it can be enjoyed in moderation. I am quite sure some people will love it.  But for me it is just OK.
My family loves the Kitchens of India chick pea curry, butter chicken curry, mild chili pepper curry, and kidney bean curry!

This is my favorite - with one caveat.  It's too one note, and too heavy/greasy served alone, and high calorie for the amount you'd eat also eating it alone.  But added to a simple mix of cooked frozen veggie mix, it makes two awesome serving.  I buy this again and again.

column9: add cauliflower or can be used as dip
column10: I have really enjoyed these curries. I usually warm some in the microwave and dip pita or use bread to eat it. It's very healthy with lots of healthy oils in it.I do find it to be a bit on the salty side. To cut down on the saltiness, I saute cauliflower in a pan and warm up the curry over it. The fresh cauliflower adds a new dimension to this dish and makes it a lighter meal.

column9: Tasty, not the best thing for you
column10: I was impressed by the list of ingredients.  No chemical preservatives were used, which is nice.  It tasted really quite good, a nice bit of spice despite the title 'mild'. (I'm not too wimpy when it comes to spicy food).  I sauted some mahimahi filets, added this sauce and some frozen spinach. It was a good combination.I would likely buy this, and try other flavors in the future, but probably only if I could replicate the deal I had on this (~$4/6k).Enjoy.

This was not what I was expecting, but I was pleasantly surprised. I emptied the pouch into a sauté pan (I did remove some of the oil) and added some raw shrimp. I simmered it for a few minutes until the shrimp were throughly cooked and I served it over jasmine rice. This was delicious! I would definitely purchase this again, especially for $0.66 a box!

I bought this because of the good reviews, also because I like chili peppers. Unfortunately, I did not like it. I prepared it three different ways hoping to find an acceptable preparation. None of them were good. Luckily, I found a co-worker willing to take the remaining three boxes off my hands. I would not recommend this product - it's just not good.
This Indian food is easy to make and IMO tastes fantastic (for the price). I eat it with rice, sometimes naan.

column9: Should not have been packaged and sold.
column10: I'm sitting here imagining that this food product is made by hand, on a batch by batch basis, with whatever they can get their hands on at the moment.Well, this batch that I just received in the past week must have been an extraordinarily terrible one.  The texture is gritty, unpleasant on the tongue, the flavor is much too sour mixed with a slight hint of putridity.  I cannot endorse this product in any way.  It does not represent any kind of quality Indian cooking that I am used to.

It looks like puke, off white and grainy and probably tastes similar, too.I can't find any peppers that I could recognize.It looks like yogurt based sauce that anyone can throw together blindfolded.It is very mild.It has no recognizable flavor of any Indian spice.Worst thing is that it is not returnable so I am stuck with it.I will never by this brand again.
I ordered a box of 6 through a recent S&S deal... what a waste of money!  The worst tasting Indian food I've ever had!  Just avoid at all costs, literally.

column9: If you like GAS, then buy this product
column10: This product does not taste good. It's awful actually. And when I ate it, it gave me a lot of gas. Save yourself and don't buy it.
Yuck! I did not like this at all. the spices were bitter. There are better items from this company like the black gram lentils curry.

column9: Don't even think about trying this
column10: I tried this and it failed miserably on me.It tastes awful and is not even worth trying.It may seem cheap but it is not really worth it.
It tastes horrible, looks disgusting and waste of money and time.  Will never buy again.  Their butter chicken is much better.
