column9: Too sour, almost feels like rotten
column10: It may be a bad batch, I bought when amazon had them for sale1/3rd price of today :)That should have made it clear, do not buy

I recently came across this label in a local health food store but, they had limited selections and I found a, I think, complete selection of their products with Amazon.com and at a lower cost I might add, even with shipping.  In order to eat more whole grains I decided to order Kashi and several of Kitchens of India items to mix with for a great tasting and healthy meal.  Kitchens of India will not let the "well seasoned" taster of India's cusine down and does offer the new taster a wonderful and varied experience.  I can't imagne going though a day without at least one portion.  If spice and taste are what you look for - look no more as you have found it with Kitchens of India.

I don't mean to sound insulting or childish but I honestly felt it was kinda gross - it was like eating greasy slop. To be fair I ate it by itself, so it might have been much better served over rice as the flavor wasn't all that bad. Everyone of course has their own opinion...This just wasn't my cup of tea...served by itself at least.
If Indian curry is this bad, I will never eat indian food again. I should get a clue when they were on sale so cheaply. Is it suppose to be kind of sour?I gave the rest to food bank, share the YUK!

Finally, available in bulk in the USA.  There is no point in trying to convince you that you'll like it, you just need to drink it and see for yourself.  It's addictive.  And if you go to www.irn-bru-usa.com, you can get a free t-shirt with your bulk order (for enthusiasts, I believe it requires 4 cases).

So I finally got a hold of this stuff at the Metropolitan Market in Seattle.  The color is bright neon orange, unlike this yellow in the product picture.  The first thing I noticed was the smell, which reminds me of sodas I had as a kid in the late 80's.  I can't exactly put my finger on it, it's like sweet-tarts with out the sour and a high quality seltzer smell. Maybe its the fact that it uses sugar as a sweetener? The flavor is quite good and it first tastes like a dreamsicle, creamy and orange, then a complex tingly tartness that finishes cleanly without being too sweet.Is it worth paying for shipping to try it?  I'd say try to find it in some of your high-end local grocery stores first to see if you can save the money.  If you're curious, I don't think you'll be disappointed and shelling out the dough to satisfy your curiosity.  It's definitely one of the best sodas I've ever tried.  I can tell why it's the #1 soda in Scotland.  It's refreshing and interesting without being over the top.I would prefer it over a Mexican Coke on a hot day, and would go great with any sandwich, especially something like a bagel with cream-cheese and lox, or turkey on rye. But if you're having pizza, a Coke would be much better.  If you're still reading, another one of my favorite sodas is Reed's Ginger Beer Extra, which is spicy.  Another good soda is Fentimans Victorian Lemonade, which is a satisfying sour soda, that washes down msg-laden Chinese food like bitter green tea can't.

I love Irn Bru.  It is the ultimate hangover mitigater in its sugary form, the ultimate morning engergiser in its diet form.  Oh, the memories of the 45p cans of Irn Bru in 2 University Gardens at University of Glasgow...the finest days...

column9: this is what soft drinks are supposed to taste like
column10: it taste like champagne cola GOYA  makes it. But it is to sweet . when i visit my cousins in scotland  i buy has much has i can. it is expensive if have to pay for shipping  but it is worth it

This soda is from Scotland, and like American Moxi, it is an acquired taste. But once you get used to it you are hooked. IRN BRU contains 32 flavors. And like KFC's secret recipe, supposedly the recipe is a secret that only 2 people in the world know and is stored in a bank vault in Switzerland? The Barr's soda company is so protective that only the chairman Robin Barr blends the unique combination of 32 flavors. Now that may all be marketing hype, but it tastes good and is hard to find in USA.

We were very happy with our order, it was shipped promptly and packaged well so it was not damaged in any way.  We are very happy with the flavor as they taste great! It was exactly what we expected.  Thanks so much!

column9: Great soup but nothing like the picture
column10: I really likd the soup, but it was all liquid very few vegetables, They shouldn't make it look so good on the can. If it was a little cheeper I would buy it again.I get about 3 servings out of 1 can, it is a big can
This is the best tea ever! Great chai flavor with the added kick of Mate. I would guess that the GuaYucky reviewer does not like Yerba Mate. If you like mate, you will love this tea.
This product is deicious and a great alternative for coffee lovers trying to break away

I love Guayaki's original, but I'm not a huge fan of the chai spice mate.  I bought it, because I love chai and I love mate...not a great combination.  Something about the sweeter kick with this one doesn't work for me.  I usually drink two cups per tea bag, and the second one goes down a lot smoother.  Maybe I just need to dilute the first a bit mote.
I could not find this tea at any stores around where I live. I love the chi spice which makes this very nice. I have tried others but I keep coming back to this one.
I was a bit nervous that i may not like this as I am new to yerba mate tea. I decided to try it after seeing it on dr oz. Im using a splash of almond milk in it and it is pretty good.

I love this stuff.  My favorite way of having it is with a tablespoon or two of full-fat whipping cream (thanks Dr. Oz) and no sugar.  After discovering this combination, I was easily able to give up my usual Starbucks chai tea run.

column9: Mate Tea is Great, Chai Tea is Great, Chai Spice Mate is So-So
column10: Guayaki Traditional Loose Yerba Mate is a personal favorite, as is Peet's Coffee and Tea Masala Chai. Both of them have their own unique qualities that are great in a cup of tea, Guayaki's Mate in it's own unique taste, and Peet's Masala Chai in its pungent and fragrant mix of spices and black tea.So, naturally, I thought that I'd like Chai Mate. Wow... was I in for a surprise. The resulting mixture was a disappointingly weak blend of Mate and other ingredients. Now, I believe a great cup of Chai to be one that you can smell from thirty feet away - and you absolutely will get that with a good correctly brewed cup of Peet's. Pour some cream into it, and the dark color of the tea blends with the cream into a delicious looking cup of tea. Or even enjoy it plain. Or just with sugar. And the same with Loose Yerba Mate, you know the taste, you want a strong cup of tea, and you want it's flavor.With Chai Mate, you get a weak tasting Mate taste and a insipid tasting Chai taste that overall smells way too healthy for Chai and way too weak for Mate. Overall these two don't mix - neither, incidentally, does cream... pour some of that into the tea and it will look watery, thin, and not very inviting.Do yourself a favor, buy the Traditional Loose Yerba Mate and then buy a tin of Peet's Masala Chai and have two cups of GREAT tasting tea, not one cup of bland, insipid, and watery tea.
It is as my friend described it, Amazing.Aromatic and full of flavor, Chai Mate awoke my senses from the moment i smelled it.
LOVE THIS TEA, IT IS VERY  REFRESHING AND GOOD.  DRINK  IT EVERY MORNING. GIVES ME ENERGY AND HELPS ME GET READY FOR THE DAY.
Man this stuff his horrible.  Worst tasting tea I've ever experienced.  And I'm not not just referring to this brand. I would assume that all Guayaki tastes Guayucky.

column9: Having just eaten this for dinner, I have advice and raves
column10: First of all, don't be put off by the price. If you've kept track of grocery store receipts lately or the sharp increase in basic foods over the last year, you may see how this product could save you time, gas and MONEY.At the time of this writing, it cost about $16.88 for four packages of this mix. EACH package easily serves 8-16 people with soup left over.While the instructions note to add 4 cups of water or a water and broth combo, we quickly discovered we had to double or even triple the liquid added. No problem there, because we had more soup!If you don't have fresh veggies or spices around, this will suffice as is and it is thick and satisfying. If you garden, you'll improve the taste by adding fresh chopped parsley, garlic and whatever veggies you want. A can of tomatoes (or fresh, chopped ones) does no harm. This is a mix you can play with, add ingredients and spices.IMPORTANT: this is not a salted mix. It is full of split peas, barley, lentils, whole wheat pasta, dehydrated spinach, tomato, onion, etc. If you don't use salt, consider adding a salt substitute. I also added basil. It was delightful, quick and is now a pantry staple.Nutrition: 330 calories (1/2 cup) only 20 calories from fat. Significant source of iron at 22% of the Daily Value. Protein: 20 grams. Fiber - 8 grams. Add some bread and you have a meal, rounded out with some greens, perhaps.

column9: Superb soup that you can change umpteen times just by adding good things you like!
column10: I must admit that I didn't read enough to know what this soup would be like. What I mean is that I didn't really go through the product description as closely as I should have. I expected this to have a lot of dehydrated veggies in it, but alas--no such luck! That, however, is my deal, not the manufacturers.This soup is mostly lentils, peas, and veggie pasta. Not a terrible combo, really. In fact, it's pretty delicious. When I saw the first bag I pulled out of the box, I thought, "oh, no. I'm going to have to WORK to make this soup taste good." I was wrong. Last night, I opened the first bag up and made a delicous soup with just the ingredients in the bag, some chopped garlic, some leftover sauteed chicken, and a chopped tomato. Talk about yummy! It was hearty, "clean" tasting soup. By that I mean that the flavors didn't glom up and become one huge mess. I could taste the lentils, the barley, the peas. And the chicken, which I used very little of, was enough to flavor the broth a bit. It was really the one tomato and the garlic that made everything come together, so my advice to you is to go crazy with what you add. My next batch will be made with onion/veggie stock and zucchini, carrots, and a bit of chopped spinach. I can't wait!

column9: Not only is it not vegetable soup, it's not even soup.
column10: To begin, let me say that Bob's Red Mill makes quality products and this soup mix is no exception.  The ingredients are all natural and organic and this is unquestionably healthy food.  I've ordered a number of Bob's products and I think Bob's Red Mill is the kind of company that we should feel good about supporting.However, not only is this not vegetable soup, but in my view, it really isn't even soup.  It is a combination of lentils, split peas, barley and pasta alphabet letters made from some form of ground tomato & spinach powder or the like.  But these alphabet letters don't taste like vegetables.So, this is basically a mostly legume-based soup starter rather than a vegetable soup mix.  If you cook this "soup" as directed, it will have essentially no flavor other than the very bland taste of the legumes that are present.There is no seasoning whatsoever, no visible vegetables, and it does not taste like vegetable soup.Now others have noted that you can add your own spices, seasonings, vegetables and meat and that's true.  And once you do this, you might indeed have a very good soup, depending of course upon your cooking skills, or lack thereof.But if you're not a good cook, and/or are unwilling to add your own seasonings and ingredients, then you will likely not have a good soup.  Conversely, with most other brands I've tried, if you purchase soup mix and cook it, then you will indeed have soup.  With this "soup" mix, if you purchase it and cook it, you won't have what I consider to be soup.If you are planning on serving this "soup" to guests and you simply throw it in a pot and cook as per the directions, the end result will likely not be very good.The bottom line is that this is a good soup base.  But I don't think it should be called soup and calling it vegetable soup is even more of a stretch, because there are no visible vegetables or vegetable flavor.5 stars for the ingredients which are organic, fresh and very healthy.  But 1 star because most people would be unhappy with this "soup", if cooked as directed.  So we'll average the 2 and give it a 3 star rating.I can't tell you it's not worth buying, but if you purchase this, it's important to understand exactly what you are getting.

I'm always on the lookout for meals that are palatable to my toddler and me and my husband. This product passed the test. My version involves beef broth, a can of diced tomatoes, and whatever veggies are in my crisper that particular day. Plus, one cup of this soup mix feeds our whole family with leftovers so one package goes a long way.

Let me start out by saying that this is my 1st review, I have depended on other reviewers here on Amazon to help me with many purchases. I have rarely been let down. Thank you all.My husband has congestive heart failure and is on a very low sodium diet (1000 mg. max. daily). We thought that he would never eat soup again until we tried this prouduct. It's really hard to make soup that tastes good without adding salt. It was easy and very tasty to accomplish this feat with Bob's Red Mill soup mix. I sauteed some onions in a tad of butter, chopped some carrots and added the left overs from a (low sodium seasoned) roast beef that I had frozen. I threw this in the pot with the soup mix and added a packet of Herb-ox sodium free beef bouillon per cup of water. My husband had soup tonight for the first time since he had heart surgery and he loved it. I enjoyed it myself but did add a sprinkle of sea salt for myself. It was so good that I just had to thank everyone for recommending it.

column9: Try my delish curry lentil soup crockpot recipe!
column10: I take two cups of the Bob's Soup Mix and add eight cups of water or vegetable stock (or a combination) along with a package of the Kitchens of India Paste for Vegetable Biryani (and the flavor packet included) and put in a crock pot.  Cook on high for 5 hours.  Ladle about 2/3 of the soup into a blender and blend on high speed to make it creamy and put back in crock pot.  Add half a bag of frozen peas/carrots mixture to the soup in the crock pot for about another 45-60 minutes.  Ladle into a bowl and enjoy!I have been searching for a great curry lentil soup and finally have the combination I love!  I hope others will enjoy it, too!

I absolutely love this soup mix!  It has become a staple in my diet.  It is quite easy to make, and it tastes great.  I also love how cheap it is.  I use 1 cup of mix per batch, and there are 4 cups (approx) per bag.  Each batch gives me 4 large servings.  So that means this box gives me 64 servings!  At the subscribe and save price that means $0.20 per serving!  I dare you to find a meal that fills you up this much, is this good for you, and only costs $0.20!!!!Here's my recipe:1 cup of the Veggie Soup Mix6 cups of water6 TB of Vegetable Broth Powder (you can also use bullion or liquid broth)1 can of Tomatoes (either diced, stewed or half of each)season with Basil, Oregano, Marjoram, Salt & Pepper to taste  Throw all this in a pot and cook for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.It's that simple!Try it, you won't regret it...

column9: As with all of Bobs red Mill products this soup excells!
column10: As with all Bob's Red Mill products this soup excell's easy to make and wow is it great in the winter!!! I highly recommend it,  but as another reviewer pointed out increase the water by a bit; Id go up to 5 parts water to 1 part mix ;)
Yeah, it's a really good tasting soup.  Easy to make.  Throw in some onions, and some pepper and it's very tasty, very filling. I don't must like health food, but this stuff is genuinely good.

column9: A different recipe each time you make it!
column10: Bob's Red Mill Soup Mix is a nutritional powerhouse and a big money-saver. Add the chopped veggies of your choice, tomato paste, some extra brown rice or whole-grain pasta and you have a satisfying meal that you'll especially enjoy on a cold day.The flavor is rich, without the overpowering saltiness of other soup mixes. You can make it extra-hearty by tossing in chopped chicken and using chicken stock instead of plain water.Unless you're serving a crowd, you'll have lots left over. I like to freeze the rest and have a home-made meal in reserve for those nights when you're too tired to cook. (So much better than wasting money on take-out in a tough economy!)Love it!

column9: Makes a huge amount of soup
column10: I made just a single bag of this soup mix for my work lunches and added some fresh mixed vegetables, salt, soy sauce, and vinegar -- the soup came out more like a stew (because I used some starchy veggies) and I loved the chewy texture the barley added and the creaminess of the split peas.  I must have gotten at least 2 gallons of soup from this single bag and I'm still eating it a week later, having frozen some of it.  Very frugal and healthy!

column9: THERE IS NO BETTER SOUP MIX
column10: THIS IS THE BASE FOR ALL OF MY SOUPS.  ADD CHICKEN STOCK, BARLEY AND WHATEVER MEATS & VEGGIES YOU LIKE.  YOUCANT MISS.
An easy product to use. Just add to your original stock, cook to the desired consistency and enjoy.  Sure beats cutting up all those vegies. It's very versatile, but it doesn't last long around here.

column9: Great addition to other recipes, and a decent soup
column10: Bob's Red Mill Soup Mix is a blend of unseasoned green split peas, yellow split peas, barley, lentils and vegetable pasta.  The instructions suggest using one part mix and four parts water along with your favorite seasonings.I first tried making it with just some dried dill weed, salt, and pepper.  The soup came out feeling a bit insubstantial because the mix doesn't have any big chunks of veggies or pasta.  The broth tasted great though, so I took out my hand blender and I blended the soup until it reached a consistency similar to a thick split pea soup.  I added some Tabasco sauce and cumin and the soup ended up really good.The mix is also really great for mixing in with rice.  If you use a rice cooker, try adding one cup of the soup mix for every two or three cups or rice.  Increase the amount of water accordingly, as if you just added another cup of rice.  For example, if you're cooking 2 cups of rice and 1 cup of veggie mix, fill the water up to the 3 cup line.Overall, this soup mix is a great addition for other recipes or if you're willing to modify it with your own ingredients and cooking techniques.

column9: Veggie soup without lots of work.
column10: Great flavored soup that you don't have to start from scratch.  Very healthy choice.

Made this soup last night. It was sooo easy and yummy! I was not sure how much doctoring would be necessary to make it tasty for everyone and was surprised to find that it needed little help. I followed the directions on the bag and mixed with vegie stock/water (I had to add a lot more than listed!) and some of the basic vegies on hand - onions, garlic, carrot, celery - that was it! I tasted and it was delicious the way it was.(with salt and pepper to tase). I did not add milk to make the creamed version as I really liked the clean simple flavors of the mix. It was so easy, required no special ingredients or trip to the grocery store. Love it!

This is good stuff.I add a coarsely chopped large onion, a full bulb of crushed garlic cloves, about 1/4 of a 16 oz jar of better than bullion chicken seasoning, a half dozen bay leaves, 2 tablespoons of chopped basil, 2 tablespoons of ground cumin seed, approximately 1 tablespoon of sea salt, a tablespoon of crushed red papper flakes, and enough water so that this fills a 5 quart dutch oven when it's fully cooked.  It's more like a stew than a soup as it's thick, but it is very good eating and leftovers are even better.One package of this makes enough for several meals for both the wife and I.

This is a very tasty soup, and so easy to make.  Even just cooking it as is, with no added ingredients, it is delicious and smells wonderful cooking.I always find that I need alot more water than the directions state.

Every Bob's Red Mill product I have ever tried has excelled in taste and quality. This soup mix is no exception. I have made it with water and organic chicken broth with pleasing results. It is now a pantry staple.
This soup mix provides a good mix of veggies, grain and pasta.  It's tasty and easy to prepare.  Thanks for providing a great product.

I will be the first to admit that I am not usually one to recommend any of the higher priced soup mixes.  Being a an old time soup maker from way back, I am not at all opposed to soup mixes for I have a couple of them I favor, and are even reviewed here on Amazon. Bobs is probably the most expensive out of the lot however.  I have never bought Bobs mix from Amazon for it is available locally, (and fortunately at the same price Amazon offers it for). Its easy to imagine that a veggie soup mix is just about the easiest blend of mix to come up with.  They pretty much all have the same ingredients as to peas, peppers, corn, etc.  Its just the stock that is usually the random element as to its real flavor and return factor.  Bobs red mill mix however has definitely broken the mold as far as freeze dried veggies.  They have to be the tastiest that I have ever eaten.  And believe me, as an old time camper and hiker with decades of experience with one pot dinners over an open fire, that is definitely going some.  I have tried just about everything that you can buy, and made everything that isn't.  Trust me, Bobs has proven to me that not all dried veggies are anywhere near made the same.  As for the stock, it is very flavorful.  I would have to say just a notch or two below my own stock.  (And trust me again, that is very much going some)!  The only item I should mention is the same thing many other reviewers here have taken note of.  This is a no salt soup mix.  Not low salt, but none at all.  I really think it is going some in the other direction to think someone could eat this without any salt at all and throughly enjoy it.  But considering how really fresh and delicious it tastes, adding your own level of salt is easy, and for some a very convenient alternative. If its variety you favor, consider this mix a base for anything you like.  I have added beef to it, hamburger, chicken, pork, and even Italian sausage and they are all remembered as some of the best meals I have ever eaten.  Franky I think this is the best soup mix I have ever had, plain, or doctored.  I recommend buying it here on Amazon if you can't find it locally.  And that you order enough of it to qualify for the free shipping.  Believe me after you have had this soup once, you will want it again and again.... Highly recommend.

column9: Good for using your own stock and other modifications!
column10: (UPDATED -- see new info at end)Whenever we have meat with bones, we save the bones and scraps, including fat we'll later discard, and make stock (easy: just cover with water and add cut-up whole carrots w/ skin, cut-up whole onions w/ skin and cut-up whole washed celery with leaves and stems, several whole peppercorns, a few broken bay-leaves, and a couple of whole cloves; boil for several hours until everything falls apart; refrigerate until stock is solid like gelatin; remove ALL fat congealed on top of cold stock; heat again, to get one more crack at the flavors from the solids before discarding them; and strain in very fine strainer -- can now use as is, or clarify for bouillon by boiling 10 minutes with added egg whites & shells and/or other precipitates and then straining a few times through cheesecloth).It's wonderful to have this almost free stock.  But sometimes we don't know what to do with it or have extra stock we freeze, hoping we'll need it later.One frequent answer:  Bob's Red Mill veggie soup mix!  Add one cup of mix to 1 quart of fresh or frozen stock, simmer for 1 hour with or without additions, and we're set.  My husband tends to be very picky but absolutely loves this.  We both love that we control the amount of sodium and seasonings, either during cooking or individually at the table.  We also love that it takes virtually no time to prepare for cooking and is done in an hour -- "fast food", as long as we plan our rendezvous at table 60 minutes in advance!Frequent modifications:  (1) use instead of homemade stock any type of commercial stock, bouillon, etc. or just plain water, either in 4:1 ratio or up to 8:1 ratio; (2) add virtually anything from your pantry, fridge or freezer: cooked meat, fish or vegetables near the end just to get heated through, uncooked meat, fish or vegetables nearer the beginning to have plenty of time to cook, or grains or pasta in time to cook according to their package directions (but add extra water or stock to make up for liquid they'll absorb); (3) blend most but not all the soup near the end using an outside blender or food processor, or an immersion blender or potato masher right in the pot; (4) add fresh or dried herbs or other flavorings of your choice such as soy sauce or other ethnic sauces near the end; and (5) add milk, evaporated milk or cream near the end (or a roux or flour dissolved in water, as long as you simmer at least 5 minutes afterwards to cook the flour) to make a cream soup or gravy-like soup.But remember:  the basic soup itself, no modifications, is also great.  Have it your way, and enjoy!  A greatly appreciated staple in our house.UPDATE 7-23-12:  Our "new favorite" is to make this soup in a 4-1 ratio (4 parts stock to 1 part soup mix), add chopped raw onions, celery and carrots with the mix ("mirepoix", except you actually eat them "as is" at the end), also add with the mix some minced or chopped fresh garlic and a can of diced tomatoes with juice, add microwave-reheated frozen part-veggie meatballs or crumbled part-veggie leftover meatloaf plus any chopped fresh greens or sprouts from the vegetable drawer during the last 5 minutes of cooking, and top with rich, non-fat Greek yogurt (plain, of course) plus salt and pepper if desired when serving.  Delish!  It's now my husband's favorite soup.  So fast and easy, too -- five minutes of prep followed by 1 hour of unattended cooking and 5 more minutes at the end.  Incredibly fast, low-cost, low-cal and nutritious weeknight dinner or weekend lunch for family and lucky guests.  Leftovers are fabulous, too, for a second meal or for a reheatable lunch even days later!  Add even more flavor if you like by including one or two bay leaves during cooking and discarding them before serving.  :)

This is the best soup mix I've ever had.  It's not only easy to make, but also, flling.  I added some cooked chicken, potatoes, carrots and celery to the mix and shared it with friends.  I almost didn't want to share so they would think I did it from scratch.
Very self contained soup. Just add salt/pepper seasoning to your taste. Its good for quick fixes or when you are too lazy to cook anything.

I bought this to make soup. You can also put 1 cup of this and mix with 3 cups of sticky rice. Clean the mixture several times, then rinse the water out. After that, you steam this mixture until it is cooked (check after 30 minutes)You will have delicious vegetables beans sticky rice!Enjoy.

Reasonably priced and packaged. This seems to be the same dry soup mix sold in a #10 elsewhere, but somewhat cheaper. And, the best is, it easily makes an excellent soup. Add some spices, some meat and/or bullion, and let it cook! Be warned, though. If you follow the recipe on the package, you are going to end up with more of a veggie side dish that a soup. It cooks up pretty thick. Quick and easy, your stomach will thank you!

We are loving this soup mix , I agree with the other reviewer in that you do need to add a bit more water than specified , especially if you like your soup to have broth or are adding other ingredients like fresh carrots or potatoes .  We only added salt , pepper the first time making it and used vegetable boulion cubes to flavor the water  and it was good with just those ingredients .  The next time we made it we used water and vegetable broth and added some onion , garlic powder , salt , pepper and after the soup mix cooked for about half an hour added some thinly sliced fresh carrots and Potatoes (you can also cook the carrots for about ten minutes before adding them to the soup if you like them really soft ) it was very good and the kids even asked for seconds ! This is a great mix to have around , you can add any thing you like to the soup mix or use it by itself and it is still taste great .

A good price for what turns out to be a lot of great soup.  I use 1/3 to 1/2 of a pack, mixed with plenty of water and ample fresh vegetables to make great soup.  I guess I could just as easily add my own beans and pasta, but for whatever reason I find it much easier with this mix, and I make soup much more often than I would otherwise.  My favorite: 1-2 sliced onions, potatoes, carrots, celery, curry powder, sausage (I use veggie), salt+pepper to taste.  Super easy and delicious.Watch out for small rocks though -- my wife has had a few close calls biting into hard objects from the soup mix.

You can not find a healthier option for soup! Making the soup mix as is provides excellent nutrition but when you add even more veggies to it - wow - it is a bowl full of health! Super high in fiber, iron and protein while being almost fat-free! I like the basic nature of the soup mix as I can add my own spices/flavors and make a completely different soup each time! I make a big batch at least once a month and freeze some so I have super healthy lunches ready to go! Throw in whatever you have left in the crisper; carrots, celery, onion, asparagus, broccoli, peppers, ...
Makes a good soup. Needs to be ''spiced'' up a bit, but a lot better than canned soup for sure! Handy to have in the pantry!
This mix makes a great economical soup and you can vary it by the additionof some meat.

This was my first time trying this product, as well as any product from Bob's Red Mill. After reading the reviews and information on the company, I decided to purchase this soup mix, along with the Muesli.Package arrived in excellent condition and 2 days earlier than expected. I poured 1 1/2 cups of the mix into 6 cups of salted water. Added garlic salt, parsley, and pepper. Let simmer for little over an hour, while adding water when needed for a thinner sauce.The soup had excellent flavor, with all the ingredients having the perfect contribution. I finished 1 mug of the soup and was satisfied. There is about 6-10 mugs of soup left, which goes straight into the fridge. The 1 1/2 cups of mix I used was about 1/5 of the bag, which is only 1 of 4 that come in the well designed box.The company's values, along with the product itself, including nutrition, taste, and cost, add up to an amazing product, in my opinion. I have stored 2 bags in glass storage containers, as the dry storage life far surpasses the time the mix will spend uncooked. This is another bonus.A thank you to all the reviewers of this product, Amazon for carrying the product, and to the founder himself, along with the employees, for bringing this healthy, positive product into my life.

column9: Excellent soup, easy to make and well worth the price!
column10: This soup mix is amazing. My husband and I love it and so do guests. It looks like such a small amount, but it cooks up into a huge batch. It's exceptionally healthy, very easy to make, and well worth the cost. I am going to order a bunch to keep in our emergency supplies ince it's compact ans shelf stable.We did find that the soup it much more flavorful if you add a few things into it. Our favorites are bacon, onion, and carrots. I just saute them before adding the water and it helps give this soup such a great flavor. I personally like to oversalt things, so I add salt as well.

column9: Attention soup fans:  Try this delicious, healthy, and easy to make soup!
column10: I came upon a bag of Bob's Red Mill Veggie Soup at Big Lots.  I am a fan of creamed soups and the bag had a very easy recipe for turning the veggie soup into a creamed soup. I simmered some of the soup mix with water for about thirty minutes and then added some sauteed celery, carrots, onions, zucchini and a squash.  I cooked the soup for a bit longer and then blended away with a bit of So Delicious coconut milk.  The result was fantastic.  With a piece of french bread for dipping, I was in soup heaven.This Bob's Red Mill mix serves as an excellent base for soups.  My creamed soup had a distinct celery flavor, but depending on the vegetables you have lying around, you could easily make the soup taste more like peas or carrots.  For a fall soup with a bit of sweet edge, I think I will incorporate some apples.The contents of the soup mix include lentils and peas and alphabet pasta pieces.  It's nothing you couldn't put together on your own but Bob's Red Mill has done the work for you and for the price of each bag, I don't know how much you would save by assembling your own soup.  Each bag yields impressive quantities, especially when vegetables are added.  My 1 and 1/4 cups of soup mix with some vegetables yielded over four cups. I like my soups thick, however, so other people could have gotten more out of my batch by adding more milk or water.I will purchase this again and recommend it for soup fanatics!
I feel as long as I have this soup in my cabinet I always have a good meal quick. I sometimes chop onions and carrots and add it to the soup. You can also add shredded chicken at the end. Delicious!!

We loved this soup!  I cooked the whole bag and froze what we didn't eat.  One month later, the soup is there in the freezer when I need it.  I am not a big fan (I thought!) of bean soup but this has many distinct textures and flavors.  Of course, I did start mine a bit more complicated than Bob's directions because I was not necessarily looking for quick and easy and I was willing to invest a bit of time for a more classical approach.  Soup is best if you begin by cooking celery, onion & carrots, then add garlic if you like and perhaps a bay leaf.  I used lots of low-salt canned chicken broth (50% more than recommended) and finished with chopped parsley to freshen the color a bit.  Delicious!  Another bonus is the incredible amount of fiber that this soup has.  It really is a tremendous value for a very filling meal.  Will order more SOON!
I LOVE LOVE LOVE this soup mix. I just made another batch of soup using this soup mix,tomatoes and chicken, just for added flavor....It makes a very rich, healthy, hearty and delicious soup.

This soup mix is the easiest meal I make.  It qualifies as a hearty meal in my book, and it can be on the table and into a tummy that is headed out for soccer or football.  I discovered this soup mix from Bob's Red Mill last year and I have ordered it in bulk for my deep freeze.  It is like a bean mix except that it cooks much faster because all the pieces are tiny, but it still tastes like a real homemade soup.  There are even some weensy little whole wheat alphabet pasta pieces in there.  So cute!  You can dress it up any way you like.  There are several variations on the package, but it's also great just with broth.  Add some whole wheat bread and dinner is served.Here's a link to exactly how I cook a bag of it: [...]

Just had my first helping of this soup and enjoyed it !For the reviews who find it tastless ....... this is a true soup stock and not something you might find in a can. Use your imagination to make it what you want.  Just added a few pork chops. onions and chicken stock.  Many possibilities to this product. Not something with a lot of salt and other fillers to it.

Bob's Red Mill Veggie soup is a great soup starter.  Just use 1 cup to 8 cups water in a huge crock pot.  It really expands.  I added some turkey sausage, veggies and a pkg of brocolli soup mix.  It was so yummy and lasted us for days.  It is a great value, and I will order more when I am out.

column9: Very easy to make, Kids like it
column10: It only took an hour to make this soup and my kids really enjoyed it.  I didn't have time to add anything but a few spices, but the soup is good and very filling.  I didn't add enough water to the first batch, so it was very thick, but still very tasty.  Make sure you add lots of water.  I'm so glad I found this great healthy option.
This was a great base for vegetable soup.  You could easily add meat or other things but it was good just by itself.  Bob's brand soups and cereals have not disappointed us.
I cooked this in my slow cooker but it took over eight hours. Next time I will use the stove. It had was a little bland so I will add more spices next time. You get a lot of soup from one package.

This is the first time buying and cooking this soup mix.  I put 2 cups soup mix to 8 cups water, brought to a boil, and simmered for 60 minutes with a tablespoon of "Better Than Bullion" soup base in chicken flavor (that's what I had on hand)s added onion and garlic.  When the soup was done cooking, I added diced, smoked ham and finished simmering a few minutes longer.  I served this with Bob's Red Mill gluten-free cornbread mix (added cheddar cheese and green onions to the batter before baking) and my guests and I both thought this was the best meal we've had in a long time....they said it was better than Anderson's Split Pea Soup.  I thought so too.  Would I buy this again?  I certainly will and would hate to be without it.(Use caution for diabetics or carb watchers since it's split peas and lentils with a veggie based pasta...high carb all the way but so delicious)

I am so glad I purchased this soup mix.  In these economical days, you need all the assistance you can find.  This soup mix is really great in making soups and casserols. I just make a simple stock, pour this mix into the stock, let it simmer per package instructions, add whatever vegtables I want, simmer until they are tender, then add some precooked meat and serve.  I can really stretch my food budget using these mixes. They really do add a delicious, homemade and healthy touch to your meals.

column9: Makes the best soup and is very versatile.
column10: I love this soup mix. I have made both reipes on the bag and like them.  Once I used a hand blender to puree part of the soup and it reminded me of split pea soup.  I have also added a can of diced tomatoes over and above the 4 cups of water.  I find I like it a little better with the 5 cups of liquid, unless I want a thicker soup . I also added a ham hock, and one time, kidney beans. I have used Bisto Beef Mix, plus whatever spices I like, extra fresh onion and veggies.  There are so many ways you can change it up.

column9: Very filling for a vegan soup!
column10: This soup is extremely hearty and filling (with or without added ingredients), contains a fair amount of iron, and is extremely simple to prepare. It's also very budget-friendly - you'll be shocked at how far you can stretch a single bag.

My husband is skeptical of anything "veggie" or "healthy", but he gave this a shot.  We add some ham and spices and Voila! Very hearty and good!The best compliment you can get from him is, "Yeah, you can make this again!"  Thanks Bob!  Good stuff.

Really great, healthy soup starter! Also great as a side dish when cooked with less liquid. My 2 yr old couldn't get enough...he loved it!Easy to make with what you have on hand, I added a bay leaf and really like the flavor.

I made my soup with four cups of low sodium chicken broth, one cup of the mix, some chopped onion and carrots, and a sprinkle of salt-free garlic-herb seasoning.  It was delicious, and VERY filling -a meal all by itself!  Next time I make it I won't add anything extra, just to see how it tastes that way.*  As it was, I kept adding water and ate on one pot of soup for four days ... ("Pease porrige hot, Pease porrige cold...") Another reviewer mentioned that the soup was very thick when mixed four to one as recommended, and that is very true.  It could be eight to one and still make a nice soup...  I highly recommend it however you cook it!*I returned to lower the rating from five stars to three.  When I tried making the soup with just water and chopped onions, carrots and celery (no spices or broth), there was no rich flavor whatsoever.  This mix does have a wholesome mix of beans, peas and lentils, but it does not contain any spices or flavorings to make it a true soup mix.  It should be called "Bob's Red Mill Veggie Mix to Add to Your Own Soup."

I usually cook soup from scratch and rarely use canned or dry soup. However, sometimes in the dead winter or cool spring, I long for a bowl of hot soup but too lazy to drive out and shop for fresh ingridients. After reading great reviews about the Bob's Red Mill soup mix, I decided to try it for those special occasions.The reviews were all true. The soup mix is easy to use, delicious, fullfilling, and nutritious. I sautee some onions and garlic which are constant stables in my pantry. When I have leftover baked ham, I would freeze them and use the in this soup. Then I add water and the soup mix, bring to a boil, cover and turn off the stove. After a while or overnight, turn on the stove and stir the pot once in a while to prevent sticking. Cook until desired consistency. I only add pepper, but some people may prefer to salt the soup.One reviewer online suggested making a larger portion and freeze leftover to save cooking time. I tried it and found the leftover as good as a new pot once reheated on stove. Try this soup with bread or any meal. Delicious!

column9: Ok but not what I thought
column10: This is basically split peas, lentils and small soup pasta.  I guess I expected to find more dried vegetables, perhaps seasoning of some sort but this is a VERY simple base which you will build your soup from.  I think a better names for this would be 'split pea soup base' or 'split pea and pasta'. With a more accurate name I would give it a higher rating because the quality was good but I felt a little misguided by the name and description proveded when I received my order.

I made this soup last night and it was divine!  I was just going to use water and chicken stock (cubes) with some seasoning.  Then I decided to add some tomato paste and crushed some whole tomatoes (canned).  The flavors in the soup surprised me so much.  So tasty and it was no work at all.  Not to mention the entire thing is so healthy, even the alphabet pasta is whole wheat.  So thrilled to have to this on hand as the possibilities are endless.  I'll be able to add meat and all kinds of spices and seasonings to change up the flavor; not like it needs much help.  I also LOVE that there is hardly any sodium!!! 1% of your daily value!  That's wonderful!!! So many soups, even dry soups, are loaded with salt.  Not one bad thing to say about this soup.  I also paired it with some homemade caraway rye bread bowls.....HEAVENLY AND HEALTHY!

column9: A delicious way to eat healthy!
column10: As someone who has become more health conscious in recent years, I began using Bob's Red Mill products, including the Veggie Soup Mix.  I've been really pleased with all of the BRM products, especially the convenience of this soup mix, which can be altered from the delicious recipe on the back of the package to suit individual tastes.  For someone who wants to add meat protein, I'd suggest cutting up a turkey or chicken sausage for individual portions (a friend uses Asiago/spinach chicken sausage).  With all of the excellent vegetarian recipes available, the possibilities for this soup mix are endless.This Veggie Soup Mix is another Bob's Red Mill product that's convenient, versatile and delicious.  The great price through Amazon's Subscribe and Save option make it an easy way to eat healthy!

I really didn't want to order the 4 pack without trying it first. I went to iherb and got a 1 pack to try first for $3.91. Even got $5 off my order by using a coupon code  POB861.  It is just great soup. We add some chicken broth and small chicken pieces and some other spices to jazz up the soup. Everything we try just improves the soup mix. After we tried this first and really liked it, we then bought the Amazon 4-pack and will be re-ordering.

column9: Bob's Red Mill Soup Mix, Veggie, 28-Ounce Units
column10: Bob's Red Mill Soup Mix, Veggie, They have provided us lentils not the soup mix that I was expecting ( When it says that it is a Ready mix, I took it to mean that we just add water and boil.  We always keep all kinds of lentils at home and this was just a duplication of what we have.  Now I am stuck with this whole lot of the soup mix, or we have to go through the process of boiling the mix, and blending it in the mixer to make the soup.  I have to say that it is not a time saving process.  My wife is very disappointed with my decision to get this soup mix.

column9: Excellent meal as packaged.  Easy to prepare.
column10: Love this mix.  I just add a little salt during preparation.  Sure you can add more ingrediants but when I don't feel like fussing all day in the kitchen this is excellent as packaged.  The leftovers are excellent for a quick meal the next day.  The only thing I had to get over was its appearance after preparing it straight from the package.  I wasn't expecting it to look so green (foolish thinking when it has green peas).  Once I tasted it though, it was FANTASTIC!  Will continue to purchase this excellent mix!!

I just got this from Amazon today and decided to make it for dinner. This mix makes delicious soup. It is unflavored, so you should start up a soup base of some sort - I used 3 strips of bacon, a carrot and a celery stock. 2 cups of the mix made a lot of soup - we had 2 generous portions tonight and there are at least 4 more portions leftover. Way cheaper than any kind of takeout, and much healthier. Also minimal effort - it takes literally 10 minutes to put everything together, then it just simmers and is ready a couple of hours later.

Yeah...this was a really tasty soup blend that was as easy as throwing in the crock pot for an hour or two with the 4 to 1 water to mix ratio. I dont really think the pasta is evident in the soup, in that, i didnt really notice it, and the alphabet shapes were indistinct, lol. Otherwise, it was just a good hearty soup. A little goes a long way, so a 4 pack should last quite a while.Enjoy!

column9: Wonderful soup base, hearty and healthy
column10: I used a 32ounce low sodium beef broth as the liquid, you could use vegetable, chicken or your own broth for added flavor. I added 2 tablespoons dehydrated celery flakes, 1 tablespoon minced onion flakes and dehydrated garlic flakes, with a pinch of salt after cooking. Simmered for an hour and it was wonderful!! I bought mine at Job Lot and it was cheaper at $3.50 per package. I ate half + put the rest in the refrigerator for tomorrow.

column9: Excellent Soup Base, Great Added to Rice & Other Meals.....
column10: I wasn't sure what to expect, but this is a simple mixture of split peas, lentils, and pasta.  There are no spices, no dried vegetables, or anything else, so you will need to add a number of things to it to make soup, or a decent-tasting meal. That being said, it's great. I didn't expect that I would keep using it but it's become a staple in my kitchen. My housekeeper /cleaner buys it, boils it and prepares it as a side dish (bean salad). I prefer to add it to my rice pilaf, to make it a complete source of protein.If you do make soup with it, I would definitely add lots of veggies, potatoes, and chicken if you're not vegetarian.This is not just for vegetarians. It's actually great for people who are cooking meals for mixed vegetarian/non-vegetarian families.Hope you try it and like it.

This is a great base for making vegetable dishes as simple or intricate as you want. A little goes a long way, and as other reviewers have demonstrated, there are ample recipes across the spectrum of vegetarian and meat-loving tastes that use this mix. The product contains a variety of deliciously complementary ingredients, and when heated solely with water, has a pleasing natural aroma... but there's really no need to stop there!I like it as a quick and easy meal; add about 1-1.25 cups of the mix to 32 ounces of plain water or a box of this stuff: Pacific Natural Foods Organic Low Sodium Chicken Broth, 32-Ounce Containers (Pack of 12) and then let it simmer on medium-low heat for a couple hours. This makes enough for about three meals. For flavor, I add a little of this: S&B Oriental Curry Powder and and a little of this: Drogheria & Alimentari All Natural Spice Grinder Four Seasons Peppercorns , 1.23 Ounce Jars (Pack of 3) to taste.  Not much to it, but it's a hearty, warming meal.

I bought a couple bags of this at a local health food store & was surprised at how far this soup mix goes. I've had to add extra water while cooking & a little bit is filling. The package I have reads 19g of fiber & 63g of carbs for those who are carb counting & also trying to add more fiber into your diet. Fiber is the main reason I picked this up at the health food store, & that it's all natural. I wasn't expecting it to taste good or anything. My version I add a little spices, some beans & extra veggies with a little garlic powder. Like I said a little goes a long way. Rinse first though before you cook, that's what I've been told, so I try to do that with everything I buy.
Easy to use and makes a pretty good soup.  Needs some a variety of beans added to make it a five star.
This is a good soup, you need to add a few things, and be careful or you'll have a very full pot, but it is good.

I used a small a small baby food jar as my measuring cup.  To the pot, I added one jar full of the mix, two jar fulls of chicken stock, two jar fulls of water, and one sliced  green onion and let it simmer covered for an hour.  It was really  thick, so I added  4 more jar fulls  of water, and it was perfect.  I added a touch of salt and a gob of pepper (I love  pepper), and it ended up very tasty and extremely filling.  I think I will add some tomatoes and mushrooms next time I make it.

We've enjoyed Bob's Red Mill products for a long time, and I was delighted with this soup mix too.  Like some other reviewers said, it is plain and mostly unseasoned, but that is the beauty of it.  It's a good mix of vegetable pasta, barley, dried peas and lentils.  It's quick-cooking and rich and filling, but it needs seasoning and either meat or veggies added to it.  We like adding ham chunks, chopped spinach, onion, cracked pepper and canned crushed tomatoes, but we also like it with chorizo sausage (pre-cooked!), and mixed frozen vegetables.  I added some chopped cabbage once and it was great.  It thickens as the peas and lentils cook, so you can add more or less water as you wish.One of the best things about this soup base is that you add your own salt.  So many products come heavily and unhealthily salted but not this one. It's much better to add your own as desired!This soup is a little expensive - about $4 per bag - but it makes a big pot of soup, and with free SuperSaver shipping it's a good deal and something that I'll order again.

column9: really a good blend of flavors
column10: The mix is excellent for contents and flavor blending as well as having it sized to all get done cooking at the same time.  It can be flavored any way you want as it has a 'general' vegetable flavor.  I used onion and celery with a bit of garlic.  That is what came through the generalized vegetable flavor.  I used a 'boat motor' on it right in the pot and blended it to about half of it's original size.  I had the creaminess and yet the 'feel' of vegetable pieces on the palate.  This blend could be used for about anything.  It is sealed very well and for someone stocking up an emergency food shelter, it would work perfectly.  I would bet it will be good indefinitely.  All of their products are of this quality.

column9: Bob's Red Mill Veggie Soup mix
column10: I LOVE this soup mix. I am most definitely NOT a good cook --but this makes the easiest best soup ever. I measure out a cup and put it in the soup pan. Then I rinse and drain the mix about four or five times until the water is clear. After draining the mix the last time, I pour a 48 ounce can of Swanson's All Natural, Low sodium, no MSG chicken broth into the soup pan with the mix. Finally just simmer, covered, on medium heat for an hour or so. The longer you let it simmer, the thicker it gets. It's really simple, good, and healthy.
For being a veggie soup I was very surprised how good it was. All I did was add 2 chicken broth cubes per serving for a yummy meal. I'm definitely going to try more of Bob's soup mixes.

Love the product. Typical good quality Bob's product. Not a stand alone soup mis but a great and easy additive to stews and soups. I have used this in Turkey Soup, Beef Stew and even added it to a couple can of Progresso light soups. i will buy again!

I just purchased this product, made my first batch according to package. I added fresh herbs at the end, to add a little flavor. Cooks up in an hour, nice and thick, very flavorful. My husband is diabetic, so we are experimenting with a variety of healthy versions of staple food items. Great with some turkey sausage or a couple of strips of crumbled turkey bacon. I keep the open package in the refrigerator, the unopened ones in the basement freezer. Another item that will become a staple in my kitchen!~ yummy!~

column9: infested with meal moths and larvae
column10: I love this product.  It is easy to make and delicious.  But it is regularly infested with meal moths and larvae.  Kinda gross.

Don't feed this to your family unless you want your house to stink.  My husband and 4 year old ate this for dinner tonight.  They both enjoyed it, however, I did not enjoy listening to the side effects of all that wonderful fiber! The soup is very healthy, but seriously do not eat this if you plan on leaving your house in the next 24 hours.
when everythings cooked i love the chewy texture that the bran adds good thick consistency great starter kit indeed

I'm not sure how or why this soup mix is getting such good reviews. It has no flavor whatsoever. When they dehydrated the ingredients they pulled all the flavor out. I've tried everything to make a decent dish with this stuff, but always turns out bland and tasteless.The recommend mix is also WAY off (4 cups water / mix)...you'll end up with a lintel sludge that is nothing like soup. I think I could probably calk my bathroom with it or make a nice adobe hut however.If you are into very bland food this will probably be good. If you like flavor stay away.

column9: Bob's Red Pill Poup Mix, eggie
column10: I tried this soup mix for the first time and it was absolutely delicious. I prepared Bob's Red Mill Veggie Soup Mix using the recipe on the package plus I added fish eyeballs to it. The soup was very tasty, with a variety of beans, Green Split Peas, Yellow Split Peas, Barley, lentils and Vegetable Pasta and lots of fiber.I thought that the (4 pack, 28 ounces per package) was an economical purchase, in this category of product packaging soup mixes.It was even better the second day, as it gets watery.  I rub my hands thru the soft beans.

These chips look like the real thing and they taste alright but there is simply too much maltitol in them, especially for a single serving. The other drawback is that if you are sensitive to maltitol or have blood sugar issues, these are going to upset your system. I do get a craving for chocolate chips now and then (rarely since I'm low-carbing it) so I'm going to try and "dilute" these with Wondercocoa powder or sugar-free dark chocolate in a recipe and see how it turns out.

column9: Made in China and my dogs got sick
column10: Maybe what the box claims is true, no additive, no coloring, etc. However I did not notice it was made in China until I have looked at the bottom tip of the bag. Using tiny font size (more like 6pt), it states the product is made in China. While I appreciate the honesty, I could not trust the quality of the sweet potato itself. And I found that out after feeding a couple of them to my dogs. I am not stating all Chinese products are bad. However, most of produce I have dealt with came with great disappointment. Beware...these are made in China.  I personally would never purchase a food product from China, and it was obvious on this listing that this are in fact Made in China.

My two schnauzers absolutely love the apple/chicken Chews fromVeggie Life Vitality.  I was having a difficult time obtaining themfrom our pet store so I ordered them from Amazon.  No after ordering12 packages and trying to return them because they are defectiveI am told they are non refundable.  Very unhappy.  $50 in to thetrash.  Dogswell Veggie Life Vitality Sweet potato/chicken and  and Apple Chicken chews.

column9: Look out for mold!! Poor response from Customer Service.
column10: I bought 6 of these in Jan 09. They had an expire date of 2010. I opened up one of the packages and I found two moldy pieces. I didn't want to risk mold in the other packs so I tossed them out. I email Dogswell for a replacement, I asked for a different product and they wouldn't do anything unless I shipped them. Not a huge deal, but really you want to ship back dog treats that were moldy. I use Amazon Prime to save time, not waste it.

column9: Shelter Dogs Wouldn't Even Eat These
column10: I bought these for my dog and shelter dogs where I volunteer.  My dog snubbed them.  And, even the shelter dogs did not like them. They are of no value to me now. :(The dogs love the chicken strips though!

column9: Product does not maintain its softness
column10: My dog seems to really like them, but the sweet potato gets very, very hard once the bag is opened.  My concern is they are about and inch and half long and do not want to have my dog swallowing something that size and  hardness.  As canines are gulpers, I am concerned.  The same product with the the chicken and apple is much softer.

I didn't realize when I bought these that they were made in China.  In fact, I fed them to my dogs until someone looking at the package pointed it out to me.  I'm a little leery of buying dogs treats from China and other developing countries since the melamime incident.  Who knows what oversight there is on the production.  So, now I order *only* Snook's sweet potatoe dog chews from Healthy Happy Pet (through Amazon).  These are organic dried sweet potato chunks made in the US and my dogs **love them**.  I also get Sam's Yams but the Snook's are nice and crunchy.  I got a small bag for my sister's Shih Tzus and they loved them as well.  If Dogswell would find a place in the US to make their products, I'd be willing to buy.  But as long as they are made in China-- won't do it anymore.

I will admit at this moment I have no hard data to back up my suspicion, but we have been feeding these to our two dogs, one of whom is diabetic. Due to the fact that the chicken and apple treats boasted such bona fides as "no hormones" and "no antibiotics", we felt good about serving these up.The other day, the diabetic dog began throwing up, and I took her to the vet yesterday. The vet called with the results of the blood work and said the dog's liver enzymes had spiked. She asked me if we were feeding her chicken jerky treats which might be made in China. I knew about the Dogswell treats, but I was certain they weren't of Chinese origin. When I was at the store later, I picked up a package and found to my amazement that they are, in fact, Chinese.The vet will run tests on the remaining treats in the package to see if there is any melamine in the meat, but the change in her liver coincides with her getting these treats. I wouldn't advise anyone feeding these to their dogs without first checking the health of their dog's liver and the chemical composition of the treats.Rated One Star, only because Zero Stars is not an option.

i ordered these from wag.com not checking reviews first. wish i had.i gave these to my 6 months old puppy, and he's had horrible diarrhea for a day and a half.just came back home to a puppy with diarrhea AND BLEEDING. yes, bleeding. not 'some' bleeding, but significant bleeding (not a hemorrhage either).my puppy is very healthy otherwise, and i haven't changed anything else on his diet, except for these new treats.i am typing this review from the vet's office.

I like the simplicity of this treat--an ingredient list I can understand.Our puppy, a 1 yr. old Coton de Tulear, has loved these for months now.  He is normally a somewhat finicky eater, but he will perform his whole arsenal of tricks when he knows you have one of these in your hand.  He loves them so much, we buy this on the "Subscribe and Save" option with Amazon.

I have a little Jack Russell and a Chihuahua/Daschund mix, and they both go crazy for these.  I feel good giving these treats to my dogs because they're all natural and it's good stuff they're eating.  They don't last long though....they chew them up in about a minute.  They also love the banana/chicken and apple/chicken.  The banana ones are probably their favorite.

"Sweet potatoes?! My dog will eat sweet potatoes????"Yes, you may be surprised!!  I've fed my English Bulldog pup more treats than I care to mention and these are his favorite.  An especially a good choice for dogs with allergies!  From a taste standpoint, if he had his way he would eat the whole bag.  This is the closest thing to "scraps" that I've intentionally fed my dog.  From a health standpoint, bullies are know for their skin problems.  Kingston's coat is very shiny and his eyes and nails look great, too.  Due to his breed's susceptibility to hip dysplasia I also plan to try the Dogswell Veggie Life Happy Hips Sweet Potato Chews Dog Treats (15 oz.).  But with 6 bags, each holding 10- 15 treats, this has lasted me a while.  RECOMMENDED!!!

I have two 13-20 pound dogs (Yorkie-Poodle and Chihuahua-Doxie mixes) and these treats are perfect for their size.  The look and smell like dehydrated apricot with banana.  If I didn't know they were dog food, I could be fooled.The only thing that wasn't mentioned in the description is the place of manufacturing.  I would feel more comfortable with their claim of "natural" and "healthy" if I knew where they were made.Edit:  Once you open the package, you should put them in the refrigerator, as a previous reviewer stated.  I found that one of the pieces had gone bad (which, in turn, shows that they have very few preservatives).

column9: Look so healthy but made in China!
column10: I liked these treats for my dog and he seemed to find them very tasty.  Then I read they were made in China -- given other pet food product issues that originated there, I threw the several bags purchased away.

column9: A favorite for every dog that has had them !
column10: I have several adopted dogs and in my circle of friends, we have over 25 dogs combined (mostly rescues and adoptions).  This treat is everyone's favorite !  And, while they are "not for human consumption", I will admit that I find them very tasty also.If you haven't tried them, I encourage you to do so.  The price is right and the babies can't get enough !

column9: Al sweet potato chews mot created equal
column10: The Dogington Post issued a warning about Dogswell sweet potato chews.  This product comes from China.  The Veterinary Information Network lists four such products as implicated in the poisoning of dogs eating them.  This product is one of them and should not be given to our pets.
Had an issue with the chicken breast treats, so would not use these, since they are produced in China as well.
I wish I read the reviews closer before feeding these to my dogs.  These are made in China and you can draw your own conclusions.
I'm looking for a sweet potato treat and was interested in these til I saw made in china, I refuse to feed my dog anything that comes from China

Sorry for the pun but my pup really loves these things. They're obviously more expensive than regular treats, but they are definitely higher quality. My dog is allergic to grain so these are a god send. Much cheaper on amazon than in the pet store, especially with subscribe and save!

These are simply the best treats.  They are healthy and my dog LOVES them.  He is a very finicky eater and has digestive problems, so when I find something good - I order in bulk.  These are great - with no guilt!
Healthy treats for our Standard American Eskimo dog. He will do almost anything for one.

column9: Made in China but A GREAT PRODUCT!!!
column10: I have done so much research on foods/treats for dog consumption, I am obsessed with giving my pomeranian only the BEST food possible. Halo and Dogswell are the only brands I trust. My dog has had the biggest variety of treats but the only ones she will jump and whine for are these Dogswell chicken treats. She gets the chicken breast strips during her daily brushing, and then the chicken/sweet potato or chicken/banana ones whenever she is being left at home by herself. She loves them all. The sweet potato doesn't need to be refrigerated but the banana does. All retail stores sell these packages for at least $16.99-$19.99; Amazon.com offers a truly unbeatable price!

column9: Made in China but my dog hasnt had any problems
column10: i understand the concerns that people have about these being made in china but my dog chip hasnt had any problems with them.
A good health snack for the pups, and they can't gobble them down as fast as biscuits and other similar treats.

After finding that our Westie was suffering from dietary problems the vet approved food with limited additives.  This treat was the only one that was approved.  Sophie is absolutely nuts about "sweet potato chews ".  Besides being very difficult to find this product is also a bit "pricey".  The price here on Amazon beats any store prices we have found.  Price - free shipping - and a happy Westie make purchasing this treat hard to beat.  Thanks Amazon !!!
My  two dogs love this treat. Quality seems to be very good.  Amazon price is  very  competitive.

Ruby gets one of these after she goes potty, she loves them will do anything thing for them. I do however wish they were organic because non organic chicken is not really good for her, it increases your chance of cancer and makes tumors grow. If they ever went organic it would be the only treats I would buy her.

This is the only treat I give my dog - well, these and carrots.  So many treats can upset his stomach so a sales clerk recommended these.  They take a while to chew up, like beef jerky - so I can use this as I leave the house.  Kind of like "here's your treat and I'll see you when I get home."  Get's me out the door without any drama.  Doesn't mess with his digestion either - good stuff!

I have two dogs. One loved these sweet potato chews right away, while the other snubbed her nose to them twice. However, they both now love them. I feel great giving them something so healthy, low-fat and grain-free. The flaxseed and vitamins added are great, too. This was a good deal! I definitely will reorder again. A+++++
This is a great treat for dogs, they love it.  The cat seems to enjoy a piece also, hope it's good for her.  Recommended.
great healthy option for your dog. ONe of the few snacks without artificial fillers. My dog loves them.

column9: Veggie Life Vitality with Chicken & Apple
column10: Our little Tia loves these treats.  As long as we can save we will continue to order through Amazon.  Thank you!

My two young Siberian Huskies love their apple treats!  And all the better with chicken wrapped around them!  They are marked "Made in China" in small print.  They are not marked with any indication they have been irradiated like some dog treats.

column4: Alphi's Number One Fan "Alphi's Number One Fan"
column10: My dog Alphi loves this healthy treat.  Amazon offers a great price.  I highly recommend this product if your dog is finicky.

we were looking for something heather than raw hides (Our vet always talked about her weight)and i read a article about how good sweet potatoes are for pooches so i gave em a chance. the dog, a border collie lab mix loved em and quickly forgot about raw hides end of story and we all lived happily ever after. the end.

My 2 Pomeranians loooove these treats!  And because they are healthy and made with free range chicken, I feel good giving it to them.  And what a great deal on Amazon!  Much cheaper than at your local pet store!
my dog loves Dogswell products.  I once received a bag that wasn't good so always check but the company always stands by their product.  Really a great dog treat.
My toy poodle loves these treats to the extent that she will accept nothing else.
These treat are the best I have found in years and my dogs love them.

column9: My dogs go crazy for yams!
column10: I have 2 pomeranians who go absolutely bonkers for these treats.  You would think they have some sort of meat in them!  They are hard, but they are meant to be a rawhide alternative, meaning, the dogs are supposed to gnaw on them!  We started with these because I read the oldest dog in the the world (who has since passed) ate Dogswell treats.  We started with the Chicken Vitality Treats, but have since found out that one of our Poms has allergies to chicken.  These are amazing and my dogs cannot get enough.  I love the price on amazon and the delivery is SUPER quick.

My 9 year old llasa apso is so picky with her treats.  I buy many different kinds of treats and she just won't go near them so I have been donating them to the Humane Society up the street.  However, once I bought 1 bag of these sweet potato and chicken treats about 3 months ago while I was in Houston ,TX and brought them home and she just loved them! The price is great for 6 bags and free shipping.  I will be ordering from here for a long time.  Thanks again!!
My golden retriever loves them. He has food allergies and these work great! They are a bit hard so it takes some time to chew which helped replaced rawhides!! Highly recommend.
My dog will sit and cry and scratch at the door to the closet that she knows is where I keep these treats.

Our dog absolutely loves these. Who would've thought sweet potato would be such a treat? I've bought these in stores and they were less than fresh - not the case with this shipper. A good price, shipped quickly.

column9: My dog loves these healthy treats!
column10: These treats are an excellent alternative to traditional fatty dog treats.  My dog, who is picky and will not even eat pig ears, loves them!  I highly recommend this product.
My dog loves these as a treat!  She thinks she is entitled to one each day and actually waits and barks where we keep them if we forget!
A great tasting treat the cockers go crazy for. As soon as I grab the bag they come a running.

I found this product first at my local Target.  I was totally grossed out by the animal parts on display as I looked for a treat for my Pomeranian.  When I found these I was thrilled but not as thrilled as my dog when I gave her one!  She loves them and runs to the drawer I keep them in when asked if she wants a sweet potato!  The next time I tried to purchase them, Target no longer carried them.  Amazon to the rescue!

I was thrilled to find these for our three labs.  Sweet potatos are packed with tons of vitamins and good fiber.  The pups loved them and I would rather they have these as treats than Milkbones any day of the week.  As with introducing anything new into your dog's diet, expect some not-so-sweet potato gas from your dog.

I bought the sweet potato snacks on a whim at Target.  Our beagle LOVED them.  To the person who commented that the potato gets tough, they are supposed to be that way.  Raw hide bones, pig's ears, etc. are much tougher and dogs don't choke on those either. Also, it's nice that they don't have artificial coloring or preservatives.  I'm buying them in bulk now that I see Amazon carries all the flavors!

column9: Dogs can't get enought of them

Oh man, we've been searching for a treat that would take our chowhound cocker more than seconds to consume.  These treats take him a couple minutes to eat and he sits patiently for me to give him one.  They are great, all natural, and make me feel better than when I give them treats with filler crap in them.Who knew sweet potatoes could be a dog's favorite treat?

Our little Mini Schnauzer Rudi goes bananas for these sweet potato treats. The price here is almost half of what I'd pay at the local "Feed Store". We subscribe to the Auto Ship and have them delivered to the house every 60 days along with the Happy Hips canned food! So convenient and super easy!

This product is healthy for your dog in many ways, especially the coat.  Our dog goes nuts when he sees the package.  Only give the recommended number of treats per day!!!  Amazon has a great price; we save a lot money buying the pack of 6.

column9: Chicken and Banana Treats - dogs love
column10: My dog loves these things.  Great as a training aid or just for rewarding your pet.  My chihuahua mix loves these and they're not too large for her mouth even though she's only 13 pounds.

These are my four dogs, two Pomeranians, two Shelties, absolute favorite treats. As soon as I go for the bag they dance around my legs with excitment and I can feel good that they are getting a healthy treat.
Three dogs at my home love these treats. They love all of the products they have tried by Dogswell. They are worth the money.

A picky 14# Westie likes 'em so much she ripped open a bag by herself and ate it all!I like to cut up a piece and stuff it in her Kong... make her work a little bit if she wants it.  (Keeps her occupied and away from me too especially when she is being her attention hogging self.)I like the ingredients, all natural, although I am not expecting this product to give her much of "vitality" or "healthy hips" (Vitamin and supplements are just way to low a dosage to do any good really.)It does feel pretty moist, and if she didn't rip open the last bag and ate it all, it probably would go rancid pretty quickly.  I also recommend refridgerating after opening.

GREAT CHOICE! VERY HEALTHY NO EXTRA ANYTHING. I HAVE 2 CHIHUAHUAS AND THEY GO CRAZY OVER THEM. I HAVE NOT OUT MINE IN THE FRIDGE AND THEY ARE FINE. I DID NOTICE THEY ARE VERY WET AND CHEWY AND NOT CRUNCHY. IS THIS NORMAL.

Got the treats and right when I opened the first bag my dogs were all over me... Fed them one each and they would not leave me alone, this is like crack for dogs! I cannot touch the bag without them jumping around like mad monkeys. Very tasty I would assume from the dogs reaction!

my little 8 month old shih tzu absolutely lives for these treats !she waits by the cupboard and scratches at it for her next one ...they smell delicious from a human standpoint as well ...  i like that they are all natural (no preservatives added).she snubs all other treats now and is beside herself for the chikcen and fuji apple.

All 3 of my dogs really enjoy these sweet potato chews. It doesn't take them very long to chew them up, though.  Still a better alternative to rawhides, and certainly better for them.  There are different sizes in each bag, from about 2" x 1" to 1/2" x 1/2".  There are about 9 to 12 pieces in each bag.  Some pieces can be broken in half, to accommodate smaller dogs. I do recommend these treats.
I have the pickiest eater around, and she loves them!  They are a healthy, chewy treat you feel good about feeding your dog.

My dog Frances has been a sweet potato lover for a year. When I saw sweet potato dog snacks on Amazon, I had to get some for Frances. I also loved the fact that they were organic. She loves them! I have a very small chihuahua puppy and I bought her these treats because they looked tasty and are all natural. She LOVES them! And I love them because they keep her busy.
