These are a MUST HAVE! My dog LOVES these and shewould live on them if I let her.They are all natural nothing in them except realapple and real chicken.Try the banana ones too!!You & your dog won't be sorry.

These sweet potato chews are perfect for my dog. She has extreme food allergies and they are one of only 3 treats she can eat that I've ever found. They're very expensive in stores, so I was overjoyed to find them available on Amazon. Not only are they mega-cheaper here, BUT if you order them on the auto-delivery program, they're even less! Plus, it's been so hard to find them where I live, that it's great to have them delivered to my door. The only problem is, my doggie loves them so much that I had to increase the frequency of my order, LOL. I like it that they're really good for her too with no chemicals or weird ingredients, and they're made right here in the USA.

These claim to be "all natural" and healthy, but they're made in China.  I was feeding these to my dogs for some time, but when upset stomachs and diarrhea started occurring I decided not to buy these anymore.  It may be purely coincidence, but when I switched my dogs to Zukes treats, there were no more digestive upsets.  Why risk it if you don't have to?
My dogs love the Veggie Life treats and the sell for much more in pet stores. Amazon price is the best I've seen and the treats are healthy for your puppies!

column9: Dog's Love them - but refrigerate for freshness
column10: Great product, but you should refrigerate them.  First batch I bought spoiled.  Talked to company and they said they were trying to solve it.

I purchase almost daily from Amazon and recommend Amazon to my friends constantly. I think that makes me a very good customer.I have a very serious concern. When Amazon sells pet food and/or treats made in China they must be disclosed on the Amazon page as "MADE IN CHINA". No one who loves their pet will buy them, but Amazon will at least give us a fair chance to protect our beloved pets from these poisons imported from China.As a loyal customer, I expect Amazon to protect me and my loved ones from hidden threats. Amazon MUST disclose the country of origin for ALL food products! If Amazon is too ashamed to disclose the source, then Amazon should not sell it!I had to throw out all the Dogswell products I purchased, Shame on Amazon for selling without disclosing the source!
Our Airedale loves these so much he practically pushes us out the door as he gets one when we leave him home alone.
I have 2 small dogs and Dogswell treats are the only type they will eat.  They love the chicken and sweet potato and the small round chicken disks. They are the only treats I buy.
This is a great deal compared to how much you would pay in the store.  My dogs (2 Yorkies) love them, and it takes them a longer to eat which helps keep them occupied for longer!
My Sheltie Abbie is very fussy. she will not eat many treats like those bacon treats yuk!But she will do anything for one of these and they are good for her.
My dog loves these sweet potato treats!! The price is great and they were shipped very fast. I will definitely be buying these again from amazon.

We have a bichon frise, who is allergic to corn, soy, wheat, oats, chicken, beef, and lamb.  We got her when she was six months old, and she already had horrible breath and excessive tartar on her teeth.  We had her teeth cleaned by the vet, who told us her teeth would probably be a lifelong problem.  We were told to brush her teeth daily, but we couldn't even find a canine toothpaste that did not contain ingredients from the above list (beef liver being most common).  We also tried various "hypo-allergenic" treats for her, but most are very expensive, and she didn't even like them.  About three years ago, we started giving her one of these every day, alternating between the Vitality and Happy Hips varieties.  She liked them immediately and still goes crazy every evening at treat time.  She had her annual dental cleaning last month, and the vet told us that her teeth are in great shape.  We consider her improved dental health to be a result of giving her these treats each day.  I would definitely recommend this to families with dogs who have allergies!

I have a Great Dane & most treats are gone in the blink of an eye, but these Sweet Potato Chew Treats actually last a little bit. She loves them so much & starts drooling anytime I get the bag out. Highly recommend.

column9: Made in China but my dogs love them!
column10: I am looking for other sweet potato treats that are made in USA. I would feel more comfortable.  Having said that, my many little toy dogs do love these, even two older ones who have lost their teeth.  They just suck on them until they are real soft then swallow the soft parts. The treats themselves are rigid, some are bendable. I add a little water to a bag to  soften them first and it works. I worry about my little guys choking on them but they haven't.  Sure beats those awful rawhide treats I use to give them. I quit when one of my dogs almost choked to death on one.You have to be careful, if you do add water to refrigerate these so they don't get bacteria build up. Sweet Potato chews are just the best idea ever. Why did it take so long? Too bad we can't depend on things from China, but that is just the way it is.

Having purchased this dog treat (my dog's absolute favorite treat) in the store, I was surprised to find the mail-order version was different--the chicken wrapped around the sweet potato is much browner than any I have seen in a store. My dog still will eat it, but isn't as interested as he was with the less-cooked chicken version. I will say, though, that buying in quantity makes this treat a lot more affordable.

column9: A real treat for a toy poodle or your canine bunch of cute.

column9: So good right out  of the can...
column10: Here is my recipe using these delicious asparagus spears.I normally eat some right out of the can, they are so delicious.ASPARAGUS CHEESE BITESThese tasty miniature quiches will put you in everyone's goodgraces-especially if you surprise someone with breakfast in bed. Quiches retain heat, so cool five minutes before serving.12 slices old-fashioned white bread1/4 cup butter, softened1 (15-ounce) can asparagus spears, drained and cut up1 cup shredded medium cheddar cheese2 cups fat-free milk (try 1 1/2 if the bread is very fresh)4 large eggs1/2 teaspoon salt1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper1.  Preheat the oven to 350*.2.  Stack the 4 slices of bread, use a sharp knife to trim thecrusts. Butter one side of each slice.3.  Set out a 12-cup muffin tin. Gently press the bread,slices, buttered side down, into the muffin cups.4.  Top each slice with an equal amount of asparagus andthen sprinkle with cheese.5.  In a medium bowl, beat the milk, eggs, salt, nutmeg andpepper until smooth; ladle into the filled bread cups. Bake25-35 minutes or until egg is completely set.Makes 12 little quiches~The Rebecca Review

Great candy.  Fast ship, great seller If you like jelly beans, these are a must.  They are only available around easter.  I did find them on Amazon Though. Im not a real candy freak but these are just tart enough to make your tastebuds happy.

I agree with the other reviewer -- best jelly beans ever. Flavor throughout the bean, soft, melts in your mouth. Difficult to stop eating. Definitely stock up around Easter -- local Stop & Shop had 2 bags for $1.

column9: Deceptive Packaging - One is not like the others.
column10: The product description is deceptively incomplete. Other Crystal Light flavors come in packages containing multiple packets such as the other items in my order and indicate a total volume produced when all of the packets are mixed (5 packets per 3.4 ounce package makes 10 quarts of the Ruby Red drink) but they can be mixed to make just 2 quarts at a time. I expected that, similar to the Ruby Red mix, since they were by the same manufacturer, the Strawberry Kiwi mix would come in packets that, when all were mixed would produce 2 gallons (4 packets per 1.9 ounce package makes 8 quarts [2 gallons] of the Strawberry Kiwi drink) and that they, too could be mixed 2 quarts at a time. No where in the text was it indicated that each package had to be fully used and did not contain individual packets. If a photo had been available which there was not, I could have seen that the packages were drastically different and I would have known that they were not like the ones in previous orders.I like the flavor of the product but having to make 2 gallons at a time is cluttering up my refrigerator.

One of the only apple drink mixes I found that tastes good. I used to buy the Walmart brand apple drink, but that tasted too fake for my taste. This one contains some sugar so it has some calories, but taste wise it's like light apple juice with a hint of artificial flavoring.

For vases for my bulbs I used fabric remnants to cover the outside of some old soup cans and make them decorative. Then pour a bit of gravel in the bottom of each can you are using, place a bulb inside, and surround with more rocks about 3/4 of the way up the sides of the bulb until it is securely anchored. Watch over the weeks as they shoot up strong green stalks and then bloom into an intoxicating bouquet.

I have had a bottle of Spontaneous Combustion for 8 years. I love heat. On a scale of 1-10, I rate tabasco at a 1.8 or a 2. Spontaneous Combustion is a 9 or a 10. I use 3 drops to my chili while cooking (about 3 quarts at a time) to make my kids sweat, I add 2 drops more to my own chili to make me sweat. I use this product constantly, but it is so hot, I can only use a few drops to turn up the temperature.My brother-in-law's father is of east Indian descent and lives in Australia. He can go through a bottle in 6 months, but he's the only person I know that can ingest this amount, and stay standing. This is amazingly hot stuff. It is peppery, a little bitter, and hot hot hot! I highly recommend it.

It is a very good product. i love hot food and this sauce is really hot. the package took more or less 2 weeks to arrive. i recommend this hot sauce for the people who really love hot stuff. i would rate the strength of this sauce9/10

column4: Marc Tomko "Absence of evidence is not eviden...
column10: Spontaneous Combustion is HOT. I say this with sincerity, this coming from a person who can handle hot foods. Now, onto the flavor. If you've ever had any of southwest specialty food's "Hot Sauce From Hell" line, this is very similar in flavor. It's vinegar, peppers, salt, and slight tomato (barely at all). It reminds me of a tamer frank's red-hot (tamer meaning less vinegar, more mellow pepper taste..) but this still has a good vinegar bite.Overall this sauce is excellent, it's a little to hot to use profusely for me currently, but I'll work my way up there..

if you are the tipe of person who absolutely loves the heat, then you must get this hot sauce, it has a very mild taste to it and with just a couple of drops. in scale of it it is definetely a 10 and you can use it for cooking and you can use it to spice up your dipping sauces like the salsa for your corn chips.
the flavor was good, but it wasn't really that hot, i like  my hot sauce really hot, so all you need is one or two drops. spontaneous combustion didn't live up to that.

Reviews for hot sauces are hard to write. what's intolerable for one person is relatively mild for another. With this sauce, it really depends on what you add it to. Things with a lot of fat in them don't see the same ZOMG HOT HOT HOT as things that are low in fat. Example: 2 drops in a can of tomato soup is more than adequate whereas 10 drops in a can of firehouse chili isn't what i'd call "too hot". What I can say, is that the burn stays with you. My lips are still tingling 15 minutes after finishing eating my chili. This sauce is good for adding heat, but make sure you do so incrementally, tasting along the way. Flavor is lacking in my opinion, so I normally use something milder but with more of a chili pepper flavor when cooking, then use this sauce to boost the "burn" factor.

I've tried a number of different hot sauces, and Spontaneous Combustion has been really good, but I like a rather incendiary hot sauce. Spontaneous Combustion hot sauce is not the hottest sauce on the market, but it's calibrated just right for me.

I LOVE hot, and when I first tried this it fulfilled my requirements. It took awhile, but I built myself up from using one drop to over seven drops on two eggs. This is a great product, healthy, low sodium, great taste... from the only manufacturer in the US which does not use cans lined with a Bisphenol A epoxy.None of the other "Organic" suppliers bother to use packaging without BPATry their garbanzo beans and black beans as well!

these taste great and you can get recipe ideas on eden foods website where they have over 800 recipes.  I like their Eden Organic Black Beans, 15-Ounce Unit (Pack of 12) too!Adzuki beans are a good source of magnesium, potassium, iron, zinc copper, manganese and B vitamins. As a high-potassium, low-sodium food they can help reduce blood pressure and act as a natural diuretic. When combined with grains, beans supply high quality protein, which provides a healthy alternative to meat or other animal protein.Like most beans, adzuki beans are rich in soluble fiber. This type of fiber provides bulk to the stool and binds to toxins and cholesterol aiding in their elimination from the body.In Japan adzuki beans are known for their healing properties and are used to support kidney and bladder function.Gillian McKeith is a huge fan of the adzuki bean and refers to it as the 'weight loss' bean as it low in calories and fat but high in nutrients.  The high-protein content makes you feel full longer, and the low-fat content helps limit calorie intake.While adzuki beans are a great part of a healthy, weight-loss diet, they also contain protease inhibitors, which are known to disrupt the development of cancerous cells. This is important, because often when people try to lose weight they cut out many foods that deliver necessary vitamins and nutrients, which can be dangerous. That's why adzuki beans, with their nutritious, low-fat qualities, are an important part of a health approach to eating.

Stay away from their black-eyed peas, however!I used to buy another brand, but recently switched to Eden after learning they use BPA-free cans. Think dark chocolate vs milk chocolate, perhaps... but the difference is not nearly as noticeable as that. That would be a huge exaggeration. column9: Silk lies about guarantee of freshness
column10: I'll open the review with White Wave's (maker of Silk soy milk) response to me regarding the "freshness" of their product:Thank you for your recent e-mail to Silk®. We appreciate your interest in our products.We guarantee the freshness and quality of our products if opened by the freshness date code and used within seven to ten days. However, our products are perishable food items and spoilage may occur if the products are stored in the refrigerator beyond the recommended number of days after the seal has been broken or if there was an interruption in maintaining the proper storage temperature. We apologize for the inconvenience, and hope you will continue to enjoy our products.For us, the good news is that you cared enough to let us know about it.Thanks again for contacting the Consumer Affairs Department.Sincerely,Yvonne OrtegaConsumer Response RepresentativeHere is my response back:Thank you for your entirely cut-and-pasted, canned response. I appreciate that you didn't even bother to address me by name. Your lack of care and unfettered indifference overwhelms me.You obviously don't "guarantee the freshness and quality" of your products. Otherwise, you would be offering a refund on my purchase, or some form of compensation for the stale milk you produced.Your product's texture was a little off from day one and your product went completely bad on my family before "seven to ten days after the freshness date."There was no "interruption in maintaining the proper storage temperature" during our trip to WalMart, as we use reusable insulated shopping bags for our refrigerated and frozen goods.So, instead of trying to pass off the blame for your faulty product and shirking your promises, you should consider honoring your "guarantee."I had almost forgotten about writing to you, but due to the nature of your response I have to let other consumers know just how worthless a "guarantee" from WhiteWave is.I'm glad your title is "Consumer Response Representative" instead of Consumer Care Representative; at least WhiteWave is honest about that.
