The company does not operate properly I ordered the French Vanilla.  That is the selection I clicked on and I recieved the White Chocolate. They should contact a buyer BEFORE shipping a substitution.

column9: Warning: Make sure you're buying the right flavor.
column10: I bought some of this chocolate for my mother who can't have much caffeine. She used to drink Nestle hot cocolate, fat free-caffeine free, but they stopped making it in canisters so you have to buy it only the expensive way in the puches. Anyway, I saw the milk chocolate flavor of Stephen's on here, looked up info and found out it was low in caffeine so I ordered a BUNCH of it for mom. 110 bucks worth. We got it today and I opened it up and all of the cans were minct chocolate flaovor. I thought they sent the wrong kind... I checked my order and found out I indeed ordered the wrong flavor. See, the canisters look EXACTLY the same except the milk chocolate flavor has a small brown strip in the middle and the mint chocolate has a small green strip in the middle. That's the ONLY difference between the canisters. And since the initial thumbnail images on Amazon are so small, it's easy to not see such a little difference. yes, its' technically my fault, but they need more difference in artwork on the canisters. Not only that, Amazon would not take it back, even though it all was unopened, because its "food". and the company who makes it basically said "Sorry, but it sucks to be you". So here I sit, 110 dollars worth of hot chocolate which no one can use.

column9: Great flavor, wakes up your taste-buds
column10: This is a smooth bold taste with enough caramel to be noticed while not overpowering the rich coffee taste.  We love it!This is great coffee if you are particularly fond of flavored coffees, like we are. If you want just a hint of flavor, try the Sticky Toffee.

My husband and I love our coffee, and we love great coffee....we decided to try Coffee Masters flavored coffee because our gourmet coffee was so expensive at $15.99/lb.Well, we weren't disappointed..this coffee is terrific!!! Try it for yourself...you'll be glad you did.
I have been drinking this coffee for a few years, it is my favorite. It smells wonderful and the taste is great. I would rate it a five star, great price.
This is some of the richest, bold and best tasting coffee my wife and I have found.  No need for cream.  Smooth and delicious straight black!  Seller ships very fast!

This is great coffee!  I'm drinking my first ever cup right now and the taste is amazing.  I was a little concerned because it didn't smell that "caramel-ly" when grinding or making it.  The taste is great.  It's as smooth as people say and the flavor is the best caramel I've tasted yet, and I've been searching for a good one.  Highly recommend this, shipped quickly.

I bought this and two other Popin Cookin items for Chistmas and was very surprised how fast they came in!The rice tasted like bubblegum and the sausage,brocolli,and rolled egg tasted like jell-o!I was very satisfied with this product and I plan to buy more in the future.....BUY POPIN COOKIN!

Great fun and the flavors are ok.  The best part are the black power that you put on the onigiri.  The powder is tangy.  When I got this it came with the karage which was new to me.  It was interesting.  Alot of fun to make for those who don't know Japanese there are plenty of videos online on how to make it and are very helpful.  Loved it.

column9: Its fun to make but taste's odd
column10: I bought this over the summer and made it with my friend. The instructions are in Japanese,but there are pictures to help you,but me and my friend used a video on Youtube to make sure we knew what we were doing. It was really fun to make,but when we took a bite out of everything,we spit them out. The noodles tasted sweet,but in a really artificial weird type of way. The black seeds were the best part in my opinion though. The rice was okay,but more fun to squish than eat. I wouldn't mind purchasing this item again,though.

Like the other reviewers, we bought this after we saw the youtube video.  My three year old daughter would watch this video over and over again.  When we got it, it was much smaller than I thought it would be but our opinions were based off of watching a video so...  The directions are in Japanese but you can view the video on youtube and they are pretty much step by step.  The box also has pictures on the back which help to some degree to follow but if you are not familiar with the video, it might be difficult.The video shows something like a cupcake liner that is silver and the person squeezing the peach stuff into it.  The kit does not come with a cupcake liner, so if you are purchasing this for a child who has watched the video make sure to get the silver candy/cupcake liner.  There is not a spoon included in the kit like the video and the container holes are kind of small, we just flipped the fork around to stir.Regarding taste, I did not think it tasted good at all but it was worth it to get for the experience.  My daughter LOVED it.
GOOD product. Came right when it was planned to arrive much smaller than it is in seen in the picture but it's greet and really fun to use and I recOmend this awesome prouduct
This Bento Box was so fun to make. I recommend it for anyone who loves to be creative and make candy.

column9: Fun to make, NOT to eat! :)
column10: This was lots of fun to make, but it was not the best tasting thing I have ever had.The flavors were hard to explain. The gelatin was grainy and not smooth like gelatin should be. The textures were just weird! :) However, that was what I was expecting so it wasn't too bad.I will buy the sushi set, just because it's so fun to make!

I made it, it was fun but the flavors were a bit wierd but it was still good my favorite was the rice! The rice was sticky but it tasted good.So all of it went fine it was the flavors that made me feel wierd and awful in my opinion.

This was definitely all about the experience. I discovered this through a youtube video and it looked like so much fun. This is actually very difficult to make. The vegetables did not solidify and keep their shape. This was not good to eat at all. I recommend that if you buy this you are prepared to not have high expectations. There are also no english instructions so to figure out how to make this you have to search on youtube and watch the video.

It was very fun to play with this utterly edible DIY candy kit. Even though it was all in japanese, the detailed picture instructions made it very easy to understand. There are also plenty of videos on youtube that can help you with these.
this is a good thing to buy for kids and anyone who enjoys making things. It is good for presents

My family enjoys good dark rye.  I followed the package directions (just add three tablespoons of molasses and three tablespoons of powdered cocoa) and made the best dark rye we have ever eaten.  Three cheers for Hodgson Mill.  If you like rye bread, you will love this mix either way.  The bread mix works great in my bread machine and yields good volume, texture, color and flavor.

The Hodgson Mill Caraway Rye Bread Mix was an excellent starting point for making delicious home made bread.  I use a bread machine for the first and second kneads, but then always manually remove the dough and put into a silicone bread pan for the final rise and baking.The basic 1 1/2 lb recipe is fine and but to get a really deep deli rye taste I find that adding a Deli Rye flavor enhancer from King Arthur flour as well as some extra caraway seeds makes for a near operfect rye loaf.  I could make the loaf from first principles, but the Hodgson Mill kit is much easier and cost effective for all the ingredients vs individual purchase, it also makes for much less kitchen mess to clean up.I scored this 4 stars as it really needs a few extras to make the perfect loaf.
A good rye flavor and works great in my bread maker--= always perfect! - This flavor is my favorite!

I love using my bread machine but often don't have the time or ingredients on hand.  Hodgson Mill uses high quality ingredients that work terrifically in my bread machine.  I can depend on serving great loaves and the dough is easy to work with if I choose to stop the machine and make rolls instead.

This is, by far, the best bread machine mix I have ever tried. Thank goodness Amazon carries it because most of the grocery stores in my area have hardly anything on the shelves anymore when it comes to bread mixes like this. The price is very reasonable compared to what is sold in stores with all the preservatives that come with them.

I love this mix. It always works. I use the dough cycle on my bread machine and when it is done I roll it into a ball and put it on a greased baking sheet and cover it. In about an hour it is ready to bake and it is wonderful as it come from the box or as per their instructions on adding cocoa and molasses. It make a dark lovely rye bread for sandwiches or toast.

column9: Great starter and 1.5 lbs machine mix
column10: I bought this mix with new bread machine Zojirushi BBCCX20 (first bread machine I ever used). Mix is great way to start and learn process of bread making. It provides perfect transition to your own recipes once you feel more comfortable with machine and how the bread is done. This mix is meant for 1.5 lbs machine and mine is 2 lbs. Bread still comes out great (little smaller then meant in that machine). We still use it when there is no time to cook your own recipe that takes longer to put together.

I was sure hoping that this bread was good, as I purchased a pack of 6. The flavor was wonderful! I'm looking forward to adding a couple of ingredients to make it into a dark rye. Yum. Do be aware that this dense loaf turns out a bit smaller than some other flavors Hodgson Mill makes, so plan appropriately to accommodate your group.

I followed the tip from the review below to add molasses and cocoa, to make it dark. my husband was quite skeptical that i was putting "cocoa" in bread and asked if i was making dessert bread!!  i made it and you can taste the caraway seed a little bit, but it does not taste at all like cocoa, or to sweet.  it is very good. nice to have something to add to it to make it better. overall i have used quite a few of these bread mixes and sent some to my brother and they are delicious, especially fresh out of the bread machine!!  nothing better than piping hot fresh bread!!
I love this bread for Reuben sandwiches.  It is, I think, a bit heavy on the caraway.

This product makes home-baking so easy!  After baking, I slice, put about 3 slices in a baggie, several baggies in a larger one, and freeze. Convenient to take out the slice or two that I need. I keep several boxes on hand.

I purchased a nice Breadman bread machine several years ago.  I tried some bread recipes that came with the machine and from cookbooks, with marginal success.  After the first feeble attempts the bread machine was moved off the counter top and rarely ever used.One of the things on my "to do" list was to try a bread mix to see if it came out better, so I would know if the problem was the bread machine or the bread recipes I'd been using.  A few weeks ago I happened to see the Hodgson Mill Caraway Rye Bread Mix on Amazon and since I needed to increase my order for the Super Saver shipping I tossed the bread mix in the cart.  Man, I'm glad I did.  This bread is great and now my bread machine is ready for action.  The Caraway Rye bread is very similar to my favorite store bought bread and half the price!As a matter of fact, I liked the Caraway Rye so much that I ordered the Hodgson Mill 9 Grain and the Hodgson Mill Wholesome White.  Now I will have a nice selection of fresh breads and finally get some good use out of the bread machine.

The yeast which came with this pack did not 'proof.'  We had to supply our own yeast. Forgive me for being angry but isn't this something which a manufacturer should guard against?  The yeast pack didn't even have a date on it.

I used the bread mix to make "rustic bread" with a recipe from Mother Earth News.  It needs an additional 1/2 cup water and only 1/4 tsp yeast.  After sitting all night it's baked in a really hot oven in a preheated dutch oven.  It was fantastic!  For the complete recipe you can google rustic bread at Mother Earth News.

column9: Excellent bread mixes from Hodgson Mill
column10: All of the dozens of Hodgson Mill bread mixes that we have used are superb. They are superior even to the more "exotic" and costly (read - overpriced)fruit and nut bread mixes offered by a competitor which failed to rise and bake properly. We highly recommend Hodgson Mill mixes.

I received a bread machine as a gift and wanted to try out this rye bread. Never used a bread machine before I just followed the directions. Three hours later a perfect loaf on my first try! Needless to say it didn't last to long as a few friends happened to come by just as it was finished baking. If you enjoy rye bread this is a great one.

column9: best rye bread mix I've tried
column10: This is the best and easiest rye bread mix I have changed and has a great texture and taste.  My family loves it!
Very good, wish they would make a german style rye bread mix.Yeast packet works every time.

This ws the first Hodgson Mill mix I have tried, and I was delighted with the results. Followed the directions to add 3 T. molasses for dark rye and that is exactly what I got. It made a large loaf that disappeared like magic!

After visiting Denmark, I wanted to bake that dark rye I ate over there. This was very close if you follow the dark rye instructions on the back of the box. I used my bread machine, and then took out the dough and let it rise almost an hour and baked it in a long bread pan. Turned out delicious! I added some sunflower seeds also. Makes  wonderful sandwiches, either open faced Danish style, or with two slices.

column4: Dick Roten Dollar Control, Inc. "PEST CONTROL"
column10: ONE OF OUR  FAVORITES.  PUT INTO MIXER INTO PANS IN OVEN  DONE.
I love the flavor of this Caraway Rye bread mix.  It is easy to use and makes a nice solid bread without big holes or tunnels.

column9: caraway bread with what might be rye somewhere in there
column10: howdy y'all,i've made this bread twice now and i will be giving away the rest of the boxes. [*sigh ...*]it cooks easily and smells wonderful while it cooks. i was dang nigh drooling.  unfortunately the caraway is all that i can taste. STRONG caraway. the comment by another reviewer to add more caraway simply proves that people can be really, REALLY different. [*grin*]made it with vegetable oil once and with olive oil. the olive oil may have changed the flavor but i can't tell thru the vastly overpowering taste of caraway.rated a TWO cuz i was expecting rye with a bit of caraway, not caraway with lots of caraway and a bit of caraway to go with the caraway.if you like LOTS of caraway - as one reviewer seems to - you'll pro'ly like this bread.i wish they made a version with the caraway dialed way back. i rather like rye bread.take care,lee

column9: Disappointed... mix is more wheat and barley than rye
column10: I purchased a six pack of this bread mix and was disappointed.This bread mix contains rye, but based upon the ingredients list it contains more more wheat flour, and malted barley flour than whole grain rye flour.  If you are purchasing this product hoping that it is predominantly whole grain rye flour you will be disappointed.  If you are trying to avoid wheat due for health or allergy reasons please look elsewhere.

I made this in my bread machine, and it was fantastic!  The taste and texture were exactly what a rye bread should have.Next time around, I'll add 1 tsp of salt and 1 Tbsp molasses to fancy it up, but it's not necessary.All around, this bread mix is awesome!

I made this with my bread machine and it came out perfect! Very impressed. The taste is mild, which is OK I might try adding molasses to the next loaf :) and the texture is great for making sandwiches. It is also one on the ONLY brands verified in the Non-GMO project as having NO GENETICALLY MODIFIED ingredients.... Works for me...

This bread baked fine in my bread machine and rose well, but it was a letdown when it came to flavor. I wouldn't say it was bad; in fact it was good, but not any better than store-bought bread. I ended up giving the birds half the loaf and won't be purchasing this again. My quest to find a good rye bread mix that's as good as the deli rye I used to buy continues...
I love this mix so much that I have it on Subscribe and Save.If you like rye bread - get this mix.

I am extremely satisfied with both Hodgson Mill Bread Mixes that I purchased online. The potato bread mix actually rose and stuck to the top of my bread making machine and became entangled in the mixing blade, so it was difficult to remove. Otherwise, the bread tasted great!! The Rye bread was also delicious. It didn't rise as much, and I had no trouble removing it from the bread machine. The rye loaf was much denser than the potato bread loaf.The only drawback to purchasing these products online was the shipping costs. I have since found out that I can purchase the same brand products at HEB and Kroger grocery stores, and will not order online, again.

Couln't find rye bread mix anywhere. Hodgson Mill Caraway Rye Bread Mix, 16-Ounce Units (Pack of 6)Thought I'd try this product. Best rye bread you could find. I highly recommend this product if you really like rye bread. Better, and obviously fresher than you'll find in any store.

Not as rye flavored as I think rye should taste like. But, then again,... being from NY, nothing taste like jewish deli rye anywhere else:) Baked on whole wheat according to directions and reg loaf. Came out too dark for my liking. Nice rise. Dense. Great for sloppy sanwiches, or for soaking up broth of soup. open faced left over turkey sandwiches? Will bake on  reg light next time.
if you got a good bread machine, the bake comes out just great. Woke up to smell of fresh baked rye bread this morning. Great quality bread ingridents mix.

I use a bread machine and sometimes put the bread dough in a pan and bake. Glorious to have a 1 1/2 pound mix. The Rye is baking right now. I put 3 TBs of molassas in the batter to make it darker and I think will add flavor. Yum. Delighted to fill up the bread machine pan. My grocery only carries Fleishmanns (I don't like there mix) and another one that only makes 1 pound loaves. The selection isn't good either so I am in bread heaven to have Hodgson Mill available on my love, Amazon. Sorry, I have to go. My rye bread is done!

Have made two boxes so far. Both times the yeast gave poor results. The first batch the yeast didn't react at all. For the second box I followed the proofing instructions. The yeast seemed to activate but the dough only expanded about 50%. The boxes don't expire until 2012. I'm guessing that maybe the boxes experienced too great a temperature extreme either in storage or in shipping. Could setting in a cold truck in the bad weather we have been having kill the yeast? Or is the yeast just too old?The flour mix seems to be great. The dough mixes up perfectly. Next batch I'll going to use my own yeast; hopefully then I will produce a good load of rye bread. Can't wait....
One of the best Caraway Rye Bread Mixes I have tried.  I didn't feel there was enough caraway seeds so I added additional caraway seeds.  The bread was delicious.
or making into breadsticks for old fashioned home made soup 'dunking' the bestLet it snow now - 18 boxes into cupboard.

The first loaf I baked came out "rocky" on top.  I added about a tblspn more of water to the next loaf and that did it.  It not only looked much better and smoother on top but... most important... It tasted great!!  Really good tasting bread..  So good I'm going to try the Companies other breads also..

WARNING! You will love this bread!!! Be advised though, the yeast provided is not adequate. I live in the mountains at 8,000 feet and less yeast usually works up here, but I had to add another TABLESPOON of yeast to get the dough to rise properly. Like wild rice? We add one cup of cooked Lundberg wild rice blend. YUM YUM. Lundberg Wild Blend, Gourmet Blend of Wild and Whole Grain Brown Rice, 16-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6). Update: Apparently it was the weight of the added onions and rice that made the dough heavy and difficult to rise, but without these add-ins the provided yeast is sufficient.

We love our Sunbeam bread machine but had trouble finding good mixes for it in the store. Hodgson Mills products are great.  We've tried many of their bread machines varieties and like them all but this rye smells wonderful baking and is the tastiest yet.  I've found that using the light, white setting for all these mixes works best.  Whole wheat settings tend to overcook quite a bit.  Looking forward to trying the dark rye folks have spoken of. Thanks for the tips!

Hodgson Mill Caraway Rye Bread Mix, 16-Ounce Units (Pack of 6) Being a Civil War Re-enactor who cooks for approx 70 people each time out(17)per year. I am responsibile for baking bread and pies. I use this bread mix because it is easy, I can count on a wonderful loaf everytime. The mix mixes up easily, I can let it rise naturally outdoors and then bake it next to the fire in the dutch oven. I have tried frozen dough, does not work as well. Anyway love these mixes and only one local grocery chain carries them, now that I have found the 6 pk on Amazon, will buy from here. Needless to say I do make it at home also, but have tried it in my old bread machine, it does OK but comes out all ugly, would rather do it by hand and bake it in my bread pans. Beautiful, love the taste although I will try some of the other suggestions. Also, add a pan of water to your oven as you bake your bread, keeps your crust from getting to hard. THANKS Hodgson Mill!!!
The price is right and my machine makes a nice size loaf.  The taste is good, crust is just right.  I gave 4 stars because that is what the mix is.  For five stars the taste would have to be superb.
This product was a surprise as I have finally found a delightful,tasty, full body caraway rye that cooked up so easily in my bread machine.It is a must have on my list now!

I had high hopes for this, and other variations from Hodgson Mill, so I bought 18 boxes at the same time I purchased our breadmaker! First I realized that I had to set the crust setting on "light" to not get a nearly burned loaf (maybe a breadmaker issue?), but even then the missus and I agreed that each of the three varieties we bought were rather tasteless.

i moved to ohio and couldn't get a descent loaf of rye bread this is perfect. i don't own a bread machine but its easy enough to make with out one i don't even use a mixer. i put everthing i a bowl and mix with my hands. i do put oil on my hands so that it doesnt stick to me. i need it a few minutes and it's ready to rise. i have also made it where i didnt let it rise i put it into a baking pan spread it out so that its about 2 inchs high made indentations with my fingers sprinkled the top with herbs and you have a wonderful flat bread or foccica

I love rye bread, and grew up smelling and tasting fresh loaves of it in the New York City area.  I've been trying all the Hodgson Mill's breads and looked forward to this one.  So far I have baked three loaves of the rye mix, and it comes out looking very little like the photo on the box.Although the smell is somewhat pleasant (a fairly mild rye smell actually), the loaf does not seem to form the many tiny air pockets depicted or expected.  Thus it is incredibly dense, which makes for easy slicing, but a not-terribly-nice mouth-feel on those deli-meat sandwiches I remember from my youth.  The Publix supermarket-baked rye and rye-pumpernickel is actually much closer, from a texture point of view.Perhaps it is my bread machine, a slightly older Panasonic BT55P.  I am using the recommended whole-wheat cycle, which takes five hours, and have followed the bread mix instructions exactly.  I've tried using all butter, all oil (canola) and a combination of the two: same result.  I don't think I would buy this flavor again.  Stick to the white and honey wheat: both are fabulous.
If you like rye bread, you can forget it with this bread mix. I did not like it, the basic flour used was probably the cheapest flour on the market?????????????

We want you to know that we are very pleased with the quality of service your company provides. We sincerely appreciate your responsiveness and the way you conduct business. We have recommended your company to others because of our satisfaction with your service & product. We look forward to doing business with you for years to come.

I just received this order.  I ordered the Caraway Rye Bread Mix but unfortunately received the Honey Whole Wheat Bread Mix.  I haven't tried it, of course, having just gotten it, but I presume it's probably pretty good.  However - I really want the Caraway Rye Bread Mix, and don't particularly want to go to the trouble of returning the wrong item! Guess I have to order again and cross my fingers!

A dear friend who wanted me to feel included at her annual Christmas Eve buffet chose this mix to bake so I'd have a safe GF dessert.  Boy, were they a treat!She used real butter, and butter flavor Crisco, then added cashews for interest.  Yes, they were a bit fragile if handled roughly--but the flavor was wonderful...a lot like a pecan sandie. Since she wrapped up a plateful for me to take home, I ate another three with coffee when I got back to my house. It was terrific to have something that tasted like a real cookie, versus the nasty storebought GF stuff out there!The secret to baking GF cookies is to mound the dough up at the center for reinforcement, and never short the baking time.  [I learned this making Tollhouse cookies using King Arthur mix and the results were also great.] Thank you, Hodgson's.

I applaud any company that tries to make gluten free products however, this mix was by far the worst I have ever used.  The batter seemed the usual consistency upon mixing.  Unfortunately, the cookies gave off an awful smell while baking.  They tasted no better and were very dry.  I threw the entire batch out.  I'm sticking to gluten free bisquick and the cookie recipes I can make with it!

column9: packos pickles and peppers are a premium product
column10: pickles and peppers are called sweet hots at first bite they taste sweet like a bread and butter pickle but they then start to get hot not like habenero hot but more of a cherry pepper hot.they are a thick and crispy bite pickle and they are excellent very addictive.if you like pickles you will love toni packos pickles.also mentioned on a mash episode by klinger Toni has a restaurant in Ohio.these pickles are Great!!

I used this product when I had to take a quick teip out of town. Microwave it or eat straight out of the can! It amkes great instant nachos, and can be used to pour over a bowl of hot chili like I did to give it a little extra flavor.
I bought these for my Mom who was in ...inpatient re-hab.  She is diabetic and loved them.  She has been home for weeks and calls me to tell me how grateful she is to have them.

column9: Ripoff on shipping. Needs Amazon fulfillment
column10: A 6 lb bag the my vet insists on is $22 plus $8 shipping=$30!  Granted he had a urinary tract infection but there must be more reasonable alternatives.So it will cost me 5 bucks a pound for this stuff.  I can't afford it. Plus there is nothing that I hate more than overcharging on shipping to make it look cheaper. I can't find it any cheaper on Google.Does anybody know of an alternative?

One of our dogs whom we adopted as an adult had torn cranial cruciate ligaments in both back legs and a really difficult time getting around.  We opted for surgery on one leg to see if it would help, but the repair did not improve her mobility.  After two years of glucosamine supplements, she is tearing around the yard after our two younger dogs again.  It used to be a struggle to feed her the giant pills, and to remember them every day.  Now we just give the two younger dogs their Greenies and she gets her special one all at once as a daily treat--she views it as a reward, and it's easy for us to be consistent.  They are also labeled by week-day so that my partner and I no longer become confused about whether one of us has already medicated the dog on any given day.She has been on these for half a year now, and if anything, she has improved from her time on the pill supplements.  About a month ago she jumped onto our bed, which is about 3 feet off the ground.  We were delighted; for a long time she could barely stand up.  If your older dog has limited mobility due to joint problems, definitely give these a chance!

I have a 10 1/2 year old chow-shepard mix... a big girl about 95 pounds.  She started showing some signs of something hurting her as she laid or sat down and then when getting back up.  She didn't have a lot of energy to play or to go for a walk.  The Vet said she's getting arthritis we should try to give her some supplements.We came across these at a mega-pet store and bought a package.  I've followed up with two more and about to buy another to be the fourth month of this experiment.Does this work?  Well, for our dog, she no longer moans as she's lying down or getting up.  She's running around the house again, running in the yard after the squirrels and if we get anywhere near her leash, she's trying to get it off the hook for us to go, go, go.Miracle?  Maybe.  Right product at the right time for my `pup'?  Yes indeed.Do I recommend?  To every dog owner I know; and tell them Amazon has the best price too.

My dog has just turned 10 and we noticed on long walks, especially in the winter, she would get a little sore and limpy. While she's in pretty good shape and in excellent health, we were concerned about her joint health.My husband found these products at a pet food store and picked up a small package. For one week's worth of these treats, the total cost was $9.99.  I was skeptical as we'd tried a few other joint suppliments and not really seen any results.When I opened the package, I did appreciate that each day is labeled. When you have more than one owner in a house, knowing if the dog has had her daily dose can be an issue. This eliminates that problem entirely.We tried out the week's worth of treats and there was a small but noticible difference. Our bed is low to the ground and she had a much easier time getting up without straining and she wasn't limping after her walks.I decided to purchase a larger amount and saw that Amazon had the 28-pack for over $5 less than the store was selling it for. This made the decision for me and the treats arrived quickly thanks to Amazon Prime.Now, I have a dog who not only looks forward to her walks even more than normal but always is happy to hear the words "joint cookie" when she gets home from them.

Our 10-year-old Chesapeake Bay Ret had to have TPLO surgery after tearing his ACL.  Three months later, he's in great shape and I truly believe these treats -- along with another prescribed glucosamine "treat" and being extra diligent with his exercise -- has made all the difference!  Highly recommend!

column9: Our Dog loves them - but watch out please read
column10: Great treat for our Airedale who chomps them down...loves them...and yes his joints seem to be working great - think this product works great...directions say feed 1 a day.  Well our dog went in and had a weight gain and after 2 months of these think this could be the culprit so I am doing less often...maybe every other day or something.  BUT THEY DO WORK!!!
My dog loves these!!! Will keep them around for her. Healthy and she loves them.They do not smell too strong like some joint care products do. They are reallylike a treat for my dog.

I'm so glad that a women at my local PetSmart recommended these for our Dalmatian! They are much better than the pills and have more glucosamine than supplements. Before taking these she was having trouble getting up and down the stairs, her back legs would give out for no reason, and she was having severe muscle spasms. Within a few days of taking these she has gotten noticeably better.She also has a very sensitive stomach and even after taking these for 2 1/2 months they have not upset her belly at all!
My corgi loves them, which is great. Unfortunately they do have kind of a warm kelp on the beach smell to them.

I found these accidentally when I was searching for Greenies Dental Chews for dogs. My Husky seems to like them, but they are "smoke" flavor. I don't quite know if it does help with his joints, I just wanted to prevent any future problems.

I have four shelties, the mom is 9,dad is 8and the two babies are 7. These joint health seem to be helping the mom,she has arthiritus and she seems to be doing alot better mainly after her walk,she's not so sore. They All four get them...

column9: The Best For Your Older Dog
column10: My dog get's one a day, he is going to be 12, with other Meds I think they are part of a good formula, Very Unique, not the same old Greemies

I got a one week supply-pack at the farm and feed store 4 days ago for my 8-year old, 65-pound black lab. She has had trouble with her hips a lot this last year. I assumed it would be like other treats and she would turn her nose up at them, but she LOVES them! I haven't given them to her long enough to claim that the glucosamine & chondroitin helps any, but if it helps pets as it does humans, then I assume they will do her good. Because she loves them and they have the glucosamine in them to help her joints, I will buy them for her again! This bigger box on Amazon.com this time!
Nowhere did it say "SMOKE" flavor in this ad - except in the little image - now I see it on the bag - just to the right of the logo, that faint beige spot. Urk.

column9: Taste Good and Helps With Her Hips
column10: The only thing that my dog might like close to these are the Greenie Dental Chews.  I need to order more.

My little toy poodle takes a 1/2 of one every day.  They really help with her bad knees.  Hopefully they will work for a long time.  Otherwise she will have to take prescription medication or have surgery.

Joint care is very important for your dog, and you should start it early!  Once the symptoms appear - it helps, but you can ward off the symptoms longer if you start joint care early in your dog's life.  Ask your vet!
They seem to be helping my dog, and she definitely likes them.  I just ask her if she wants her Greenie and she comes.

I am so glad to have found this product.  My dog had a problem on walks when he would have to pull up his rear leg and hop.  As a puppy he was operated on with little success. The Doctor said it was common in Yorkies and there was nothing more they could do.  Now he is 4 years old and with the addition of Greenies Joint Care I rarely see him limp. He LOVES the taste, he can't wait to get his daily "bone"

I started using this, several months ago when my Miniature Schnauzer Maddie, who is now 13 was having trouble getting around, it has really helped her, I give her one each day.  I personally thinks it works.

They really do seem to help. Our 13 year old dog used to growl at the younger herd members. After starting these daily she seems a LOT more agreeable to their puppy ways.  We can't ask her obviously, but we've seen enough of a difference to keep giving them to her.
We dont know how old she is and she was having trouble getting up and down and our vet didnt help us at all so we wasted over about $200 on our dog when all we needed to spend was $20 on these.
I gave my german shepard one of these and it gave her diarhea.I have discontinued giving them to her and will not purchase again.

I purchased this product both for my dog and my daughters dog and it gave them both extreme diarrhea, explosive poor pups couldn't even make it out of the house. VERY embarrassed dogs!!! Both dogs suffered from this product.  We administered the exact amount for the weight of each dog.  They both LOVE their Greenies so I was shocked with this reaction.

column9: Spicy, sweet and tangy -- flavor perfection!
column10: What an outstanding spice blend!!!  It will allow you to create a most unusual and delicious dish -- a wonderful blend of spicy, sweet and tangy flavors accenting the chicken.  Adding dates, sesame seed, cilantro, honey and lemon to the exotic blend of spices, you will create a dish that is quite unlike anything you've ever eaten. Great for holiday parties, too, since it can be made in advance.  You and your guests will find this Moroccan chicken is absolutely delicious!!!!!!

We've had this spice blend since picking it up at a Whole Foods in Portland after tasting a sample.  Company was coming over and we needed something easy that could be prepped ahead.  Enter the Moroccan Spice Blend, and it received rave reviews.  We used boneless, skinless chicken breasts and marinated them for about a day and a half.  When it came time to cook, we just dumped them into a 9x13 dish and baked as directed for an hour.  Serving it with couscous, Moroccan carrot salad, and coconut cupcakes, we spent the rest of the evening thoroughly stuffed.  Absolutely delicious!  Sweet and savory, the blend had just the right amount of kick without setting our mouths on fire.  Fabulous!

The Cuisine Mentor Mroccan Spice blend is wonderful, complex, spicy, and earthy. We have found it is great also just simply sprinkled on top of chicken or salmon, vaying the amount by how spicy you want it. Our guests have also raved about how wonderfull "our" creations were.
This is a great product for spicing chicken.  Loved the flavor.  This is one of a couple CuidineMentor spice products I've ordered from Amazon and I've been pleased with all of them.

My husband started brewing his own beer when he received a Mr. Beer in a gift exchange.  Who would've ever thought it would mean he'd never buy a store-bought beer for home consumption again.  He made this with honey and it was a quality tasting beer.

column9: Contains 132mg of Chlorogenic Acid-a Potent Antioxidant
column10: Regular decaf contains 52mg of chlorogenic acid on average while this coffee contains 132mgs.  It's also organic.  Whole Foods sells organic decaf starting at $12.99 and going up from there, so this is a bargain with more antioxidants to boot.  The regular Rich Rewards Breakfast Blend contains 172mgs. of chlorogenic acid, but I'm not crazy about the taste.  Right now I'm hooked on Jeremiah's Pick Coffee Cocoa Nibs & Organic Coffee. It's so delicious that I can't wait to wake up in the morning for my first cup of coffee.  After 1 cup of high test, I switch over to decaf, because otherwise I get the jitters.

I first purchased a package of these dried cranberries just a few weeks ago (after having just enjoyed cranberries in the salad at a restaurant). It has rapidly become a staple in the family diet. All three of us really enjoy just munching them plain or--even more--as an element in our green salads.Dried cranberries in a salad add a nice tolerable sweetness and a different texture than just the green vegetables that we incorporate into the salad.I suspect that we will continue to use this for some time to come. And we may also experiment with other dried fruits as a component of our salads.Worth takjing a look at if you like fruits in your salads.

I am returning these cranberries because the ingredients list did not indicate that this product contains sunflower oil.  Hopefully Amazon will change the ingredients list to indicate this.  I hope this helps someone else before buying.Amazon was good and is going to process a refund for me even though the system said this item can't be returned.

These carb-free mini crisps are delicious and so satisfying when you need that "crunch" without carbs. I love crackers but am staying away from them and thought these would fit the bill. The trouble is you don't get that many in a very small bag for a fairly expensive price, plus the shipping makes it prohibitive for me to order again. If you don't care about price, they are worth it, especially for entertaining. But you can also search the internet for recipes for making your own a ton cheaper. That said, this is a great product and a nice company. Just wish they offered coupons or free shipping once in a while.

These cheese crisps are EXCELLENT.  I found some in the store (bigger ones in a plastic box) and tried them a few weeks ago.  I liked them so much that I ordered these on Amazon.  They're salty for some people's tastes, but they taste sooo goood!
These crisps are amazing! However, please be advised that if you order this, you will only receive one package of mini crisps, NOT 12 (like the title implies).

Okay...this ended up being a $12 bag of salty, baked cheese.  Seriously?! $6 for the bag and then $6 to ship it.  I didn't even realize until it showed up and I saw the packing slip!!Certainly not worth $12...not even $6.  I would say the most I would pay for these is $2 in a grocery store.  they simply were not that tasty.

column9: These are little pieces of cheese almost toasted.....
column10: Thought we would try them just to see what they were.  Remember doing a grilled cheese sandwich in the oven and a dribble or two of cheese would end up on the tray beside the sandwich?  Kinda crispy/crunchy but not actually burned, it would bubble and sizzle a bit and you could just pop it in the old mouth and crunch down on it... Well that's what these are, just out of aged parmesan cheese.  Not particularly bad, but not particularly good either.  Save your money.... Go make a grilled cheese sandwich for much cheaper.

column9: Satisfying crunchy snack, great for low carbers
column10: This is a great low-carb alternative to potato chips.These taste great in comparison to most other cheese snacks I've had... but I felt like there was a slight aftertaste, although I don't know what it is. I've had fresh parmesan chips from Whole Foods that were delicious and didn't have that same bittery after taste.Eitherway, I'm happy with the purchase, and would order them agan

The Parmesan crisps are good.  A great alternative for something crunchy when eating low carb.  I was shocked however when I saw how small the bag was.  I don't think most consumers know how many ounces a bag of chips is, but for $6+ S&H I was expecting a normal size bag of chips and this is a mini bag of chips (single serving).  So in my opinion not really worth the expense plus shipping for an afternoon snack.

These were just the snack I have been waiting for! The taste great and are low carb! I crave crunchy items all the time to be disapointed when I order something new and they just are not what I thought they would taste like. These have flavor and cruch. I ate them with soup and on salads and they are fantastic!

Just FYI, I checked the nutritional information on this product and it states it has 20 calories per stick.  Each tablespoon of Agave Nectar has 60 calories so each stick is 1 teaspoon.  So you would need three sticks for a tablespoon serving.  Just thought I would throw that out there for anyone thinking about buying this product and trying to figure out how many sticks they need to use in their tea or coffee, LOL!  I'm a two sticker;o)
this ia a good idea; however, difficult to open.  must squeeze/twist pretty hard & product oozes free - usually all over fingers.  also, portion size is a bit too small.  still love agave.

column4: Don't believe it just because someone told yo...
column10: I have used agave for many things and find that it is a better alternative to sugar.  It will not give you the sugar plunge you get from sugary products.  If you are using this product in beverages please realize that it is not going to give you that same sugary, syrupy flavor that some people are used to from regular sugar or substitutes.  It is a subtle sweetness.I have served this product to friends, and those who are used to a sugary taste in their tea didn't care for it as much as those friends who don't use a lot of sugar.  It really depends on what you are used to.  I have no complaints about this product.Agave is also better for people who have diabetes, as it does not spike blood sugar levels.Don't pass up on trying this great alternative to sugar.  It is worth letting your tastebuds adapt to the subtleness.  It is also great for baking.  Also, this is now labeled as organic, so another reason to try it.
The cinnamon honey sticks flavor was excellent. When added to tea it enhanced the flavor of the tea.

column9: Yummy honey in a convenient portion.
column10: I bought this in an effort to help myself quit smoking while watching my weight.  Also, I'd been looking for a smaller honey container to use to sweeten my hot tea when I'm at work.  These honey sticks definitely helped.  The honey was very good, the stick/straw seems to be a great way to package it as it doesn't spill out easily.  Plus, each stick is only 15 calories, so you can watch your proportion if that matters to you. I will definitely purchase this again.

column9: convenient way of taking your agave with you!
column10: I was hesitant about this product based on some customer reviews that said there were difficulties opening the little sticks and that they (the customers, not the sticks) got agave all over their fingers... I wonder if Stash read the reviews and changed their packaging?  I have not had this problem, and I'm usually *awful* at opening packaging! With these, I simply bite off the end (gross, I know, but I am a student and I don't/can't carry a knife around with me in my bookbag all day) and squeeze it into my coffee.  It's a great way to have my agave with me because most coffee shops and cafes have not yet started stocking this alongside their poisonous sugar alternatives (you know, those pink, blue, and yellow packets).  Keeps my blood sugar from spiking, sweetens my coffee--what more could you ask for?

These little goodies are so full of flavor and so good.  I bought these for my granddaughter in Minnesota and sent them to her.  She was thrilled, shared them with her sisters and now they are wanting to get some.Great gift idea!!

These are great to have!  I toss one in my daughter's lunch...have a few in my purse for a "pick" me up, etc.  Tasty, tasty!  Other people are so curious when I whip one out.  They are amazed it's a straw filled with honey.  This is the place to find the best price on these honey sticks.  Thanks for having them on subscribe and save.  Great program!

column9: Smell delightful, taste not so much
column10: I picked up these honey sticks because I'm in a chai tea phase and thought they'd be nice to add to a simple black tea. Upon taking one from the box, I was treated to a wonderful scent of cinnamon and spices that reminded me of Christmas time.  I brewed my tea, added the stick of honey and stirred.  As I took that first sip, I couldn't much smell the honey I just added.  As the tea coated my tongue I was waiting and waiting for the scent of the honey stick to hit my tongue and it never really did. I could taste a tiny bit of honey, but nothing more than if I added plain clover honey to my tea.  It was rather underwhelming.  My second cup I tried 2 sticks and it was a little better, but for the price, I'd much rather just buy chai tea bags.All in all, don't expect it to taste the way it smells.  Far too weak in just a simple black tea, but smells divine still sealed up!

My mom-in-law had rec'd 1 box of these in a gift box, but couldn't find more when she found she enjoyed the convenience of them in her hot tea & on toast.  She said the straws are just the right amount, they are less messy & the honey keeps longers than in a jar.  A 6-pk was a great surprise for her.  The price was reasonable for a convenience item.
These honey sticks are so nice in a cup of tea.  You can even remove your tea bag with them!

These Chai Honey Sticks are SO good!  I enjoy eating one or two when I have a craving for something sweet.  It also makes a fun non-sugar sweet treat for my toddler.  The straws are the perfect size to add to a 6oz cup of tea too.

I agree with other reviewers about Agave in general and also specifically this product.  Know that I have a pretty big sweet tooth, and thanks to Agave I feel I'm slowly taming it.  I do find Agave to be sufficiently satisfying -- with the right amount.  And it makes me feel very good to know I'm not jacking up my blood sugar level with sugar, and that I'm not putting sugar (which I increasingly think of as poison) into my body.  But you do have to use around the same amount as regular sugar, maybe sometimes less, sometimes more.  Various mfgs. of the product claim you can use less.  I have not found this to be the case.Regarding the sticks specifically, you do have to squeeze fairly hard and repeatedly to get it all out, and inevitably some gets on your fingers.  However, given the above pluses, in the absence of anything better I'm willing to settle for the drawbacks as opposed to putting sugar or -- quel horreur -- artificial sweetners into my body when I'm away from home.
These are straws filled with lemon flavored honey.  I love them.  They taste great and are easy to take with you.  I use them at work- very convenient for quick hot tea without the messy honey.

column9: Great for traveling or eating out!
column10: These are GREAT for carrying in my purse for eating out, or when we're traveling, as most places do not have Agave Nectar!Just wish there was an easier way to open them...I'm carrying a small pair of scissors to open them!

It's great to have agave in a portable format.  But is is difficult to open.  The directions say to pinch to open.  They are not so easy to pinch.  I have found if you bend the tube about 1 inch above the end then pinch the end it helps.  But the agave often gets on your fingers.

I was disappointed in this product, as I had read and heard that this was an excellent sweetner, and it only took a small amount.  NOT TRUE!  I had a 8 ounce glass of tea, and added two "straws" of Nectar, and you couldn't even tell anything had been added.  Expensive if  you had to use a whole pack to slightly sweeten anything.

When I ordered these, based on the description, I thought the honey was somehow hardened into stick-form and thus would 'melt' into a cup of hot tea.  I was surprised when I discovered these sticks were actually thin plastic straws filled with honey!  There is no way I'm going to insert a plastic straw into a hot cup of tea. I'm not sure it would work anyway; I suppose you could cut open each end and then blow the honey in the tea.  Does Stash think you're going to sip on these straws?  I don't know what the company was thinking when they produced this product, other than as a candy to be eaten.I believe the term "stick" does not accurately describe this product and is misleading.  I doubt it's intentional, however.  The Stash Tea Company is an excellent company and has many high quality teas and products.The honey flavored with chai spices is good enough but frankly, it it a very expensive way to buy honey.  Better to buy a jar and flavor it yourself.  I wound up using these Chai Honey Sticks by cutting open one end and pressing out the honey into a tea cup/pot, which was messy and time consuming.I love Stash tea... drink it every morning.  But this product is a bust and I would never purchase it again.

I broke my own rule and read JUST the ingredients on the back of package. Sounded Great! I gave my dog one of these "treats" and she loved it. The next day I read the package more carefully - and guess what? Made in China printed right there in plain view. I am very disappointed in AKC for putting their name on these products. A bag of twists and a bag of chicken jerky went right into the trash.

I recently purchased a small bag of these twists containing sweet potato and chicken because it appeared to be a healthy snack to "treat" my Scottie when she is a good dog.  She is such a picky eater, snacks included, so I was pleased when she reacted positively and enjoyed her  first treat.  But i was really surprised when I arrived home the next afternoon!  She had found the bag, and she was able to pull it down to her level....and she had enjoyed the entire bag!  The good news was no stomach upset.  I will keep these on hand and out of her reach from now on.Just call us content in South Carolina!AKC Sweet Potato Chicken Jerky Twists Dog Treats, 16 Ounce

My labrador LOVES these treats.  They have been very helpful to reinforce potty traning & good behavior.  However, after I had run out, the dog helped herself to our potato basket & ate two sweet potatoes!  Guess I now have to put these out of reach as well as the treats.
My dogs love these. And they are a very healthy alternative to very fattening biscuits. I like to buy them in quantity, so that I don't have to go hunting for them in stores.
Our picky dog loves these and from the research I did they seem to be the least controversial and healthy snacks you can affordably give to a picky eating dog.
I bought the Sweet Potato Chicken Jerky Twists for my dogs recently and they love them. They really get excited when I get them one from the pantry. I would highly recommend these for your dogs.

column9: AKC Sweet Potato Chicken Jerky Treats
column10: We were very pleased with theAKC Sweet Potato Chicken Jerky Twists Dog Treats, 16-Ounce jerky treats they were fresh and we want only the best for or pets. It is less expensive and we were able to buy bigger bags then in the grocery store.

When I received this package of treats, on 6/4/2011, the expiration of the bag of treats is 6/10/2011.  That is unacceptable!!  For a $19 bag of treats they should have at least a year before they expire which is typical.  I had to return the treats to Amazon and that is a pain when we are all busy.
Caution made in CHINA. To me that is a big red flag. No where have I sean anything saying pet foods or treats from CHINA are safe yet.

column9: AKC should stop selling this item.
column10: This particular AKC treat is made in China.  Shame on you AKC.  I can not believe American Kennel Club is getting treats for our dogs and it is made in China !  I have lost all respect for AKC over this.  And, customers NEED to know many deaths of dogs have been linked again to China dog treats and this particular treat.  Don't take my word ... look it up.  Also look up vet Dr. Karen Becker.  She is keeping up with the research on this product too.  I hope Amazon will remove these treats and stop sending emails to customers to buy them.
You would think coming from the name American Kennel Club it would be made in USA.  No.  It's made in china where chicken jerky is deadly to animals.

column9: Great Treats BUT made in CHINA
column10: I purchased these treats several times for our Yorkie Bruno. He really seemed to like them after all they were an AKC Product, so I thought nothing of making the purchase for my precious friend, as I trusted the quality & purity and the AKC Brand. I have since reconsidered making any further purchases of this product after hearing about the deaths and illness associated with both dog food and treats made in China. I was fortunate, in my particular case my pup showed no negative effects after eating them but I am no longer willing to put my pups health at risk. Please consider carefully where your pet food and treats are made. While the FDA still has made no connection between the treats from China and the Kidney, Liver failure & deaths of pets who died or developed serious conditions after consuming these products! There have been alerts & warning issued and some Companies have removed the products from store shelves. Be cautious about feeding your beloved pets possibly deadly treats/ food made in China...Buy American, at least there is some kind of regulations in place for quality, and safety.
I received this quickly. Good company. I haven't tried it yet! I'm going to use it for yogurt making.

I purchased this because Milkman is no longer available (sigh), for bqckpacking and daily use as on dry cereal or oatmeal. I first tried Klim, apparently Nestle's companion product, which was pretty good. I don't like Nido as well as Klim. Plus the Nido was packaged in those detestable styrofoam peanuts, ugh. Going back to Klim.

column9: BumbleBee Ruined this New England Classic
column10: What the flipping hell did they do to my clam chowder??  Normally, I eat healthy foods. We are a mostly-vegetarian household, but once in a while, PMS demands that I have some clam chowder. Snow's Clam Chowder to be exact. It is one of my few comfort foods, and I spiff it up a little so it really is like a good, hearty, restaurant clam chowder. It is delicious and creamy and has clams and makes me happy.  I picked up a can at Market Basket the other day. I noticed that Snow's is now "Snow's by BumbleBee." Ruh-roh, Shaggy.  It smelled wrong when I opened the can. Not bad or spoiled, just not right. The texture was all wrong. The color was different. Since I am apparently a doofus, I made it anyway. This stuff truly sucks. It has NO flavor. It tastes pretty much like lumpy school paste. Only more bland. Not even salty crackers made a bit of difference.  There was no warning on the label. Usually, when a company screws around with a tried-and-true recipe and ruins the product, the add a "NEW! Improved!" warning to the packaging to alert the public of their meddling. They didn't even do that. They just ruined it without any warning, and now my chowder is disgusting.  I've been eating Snow's for forty years, but Look's will be getting my chowder business, now. It may well be a dollar more per can, but that's well worth it since they know enough to leave a good thing alone.

column9: Bumble Bee has changed the Recipe
column10: Bought 3 cans of the condensed chowder a couple of weeks ago, 2 had bumble bee on the can the other didn't...Well the Bumble bee ones are not the Snow's that we all love, they changed the recipe.  All I can say is don't buy it if you like snow's, it's NOT.  It's nothing like the real snows not as condensed and I think it taste BAD.

There is a huge  difference between the taste of the old Snow's Clam Chowder to the new style that has recently come out and it's not good. I have contacted Snow's and they insist that both products are the same. Obviously they don't eat it.

Beware Snow's clam chowder condensed lovers. This is NOT the original Snow's. The label in the picture is the original but when I got the order it say Snow's byBumble Bee! Not the same clam chowder I have been eating since I was a kid.

I have three cans left of the Original Snows Clam Chowder and when I purchased the modified "Snows Clam Chowder" I knew right away something was terribly wrong so I compared the Original can with the modified version.The original can says "Authentic New England Clam Chowder" and the modified can says "New England Clam Chowder".Also the original can shows a sketch of a New England Trolling or Shrimp boat while the modified can shows a photograph of the soup in a bowl.The original which was creamy and thick says "Snows/Doxee Inc Cape May,NJ 08204-5400" while the modified looks to be made with skim milk and very thin and little potatoes and clams says "Bumble Bee Foods, LLC San Diego,CA 92186 USA. I think the clams are from Indonesia or Thailand or Vietnam or possibly made in these countries and shipped to the USA. Also the tuna that Bumble  Bee sells in those small cans is from Asian Countries and it is a watered down version with only 40% of the can has actual tuna while 60% is water. Not to go on a tangent but went to Costco and bought their Albacore Tuna cans made Costco Wholesale Corp. in Seattle, WA with the can comprising 99% of tuna and 1% of water.I think Bumble Bee Co is the company owned by Nancy Pelosi and her husband. They own 5 companies that "manufacture", and believe me this junk they are passing off as New England Clam Chowder is manufactured, seafood products.In this new modified version of Snows Clam Chowder the can still says the clams are from the New England coast which I feel is a lie.This present modified New England Clam Chowder is junk food and a distortion of what was a very good quality soup. I will no longer purchase this and all my friends whom I told to buy this product are now being told not too.

I've been eating Snows Clam Chowder for near 30 years. Since Bumblebee took over the brand it has become terrible! Less than half the clams, and half the potatos. Not near as thick, and the taste is completely different. I contacted Bumblebee, and all I got was a canned (no pun intended) response that the only thing changed was "it no longer has MSG". Anyone that is a fan of the original knows this to be an outright lie. To add insult, they sent me 6 coupons for......cans of Snows Clam Chowder. For all you fans of the original, call them, write to them, email them, do whatever you can. For for petes sake, dont buy this till they change it back. What a horrible soup it is now!

column9: snow's clam chowder by bumble bee
column10: i am a long time fan of snow's condensed clam chowder and found that the bumble bee company has obviously changed the original recipe. i was disappionted in this product and hope bumble bee will strive to get this product back to it's name sake's quality. the doxsee company has got it right.

column9: Not the same creamy chowder....this is soup.
column10: Really disappointed in the change.  Not at all what I was expecting.  Wish I hadn't bought a case.  It's a soup, not a thick and creamy chowder.  I won't buy again.  Tastes fine for a liquidy soup..has about 25% the potatoes that it used to...sadly, not a chowder and I used canned milk to try to thickening it up.  The store brand (generic) is better.

I loved the original Snow's clam chowder. But they've changed it & this stuff is not worth buying. Progresso clam chowder is much better, though still not as good as the old Snow's. So much for progress.

column9: Horrible soup don't bother buying it!!!
column10: I use to LOVE Snow's Clam Chowder, but like all the other reviews, since Bumble Bee took over this brand, it is the worst tasting soup I have ever eaten!!! Usually, eat New England Clam Chowder about once a month with BLT sandwiches. I bought this soup from Grocery Outlet and my boyfriend said "Well what do you expect"? So.... needless to say I will let the manager, of Grocery Outlet know, that he shouldn't stock this soup, in his store!

The new condensed clam chowder product is bland and watery.  It resembles nothing of the original recipe that was recently discontinued.  I wrote an email to the company about it and all they did was mailed me a letter with a couple coupons to get free cans of more chowder and another couple coupons for $0.30 off any snows product. -- Eat more?  Really?  I just told them I didn't like it.  Don't patronize me. -- And from the reviews I've read on here, it doesnt look many other consumers like it either.  It doesn't seem that this is a company who cares about their customer loyalty and longevity. At the end of the day, this company seems to be more concerned about how much they can save on ingredient costs to inflate their profit. Totally disappointing.  I boycott all Bumblebee products now.  Beware, Bumble Bee Foods, LLC owns other brands including: Brunswick®, Beach Cliff®, and in Canada under the Clover Leaf® name.  I'll buy my chowder (and tuna) elsewhere.

I picked up four cans of Snow's Clam Chowder.  I noticed it said Bumble Bee on it but didn't think anything of it.  I prepared one can and when I took a taste to see if it was hot enough, I was suprised at how yucky it tasted.  I thought I had done something wrong, so I rechecked my steps.1.  Open the can.  CHECK2.  Pour into small pot.  CHECK3.  Add milk.  CHECK4.  Heat while stirring.  CHECKIt should have tasted like a slice of heaven, but instead tasted like dog food.DOG FOOD!!!I doubt a dog would even eat this garbage.

This product now has the Bumble Bee name on the can as well as Snow's, and the taste is quite different than before the label change.  I do not know what was changed, but I personally do not care for the taste of the new product and will not buy it again.

Best clam chowder I know and I've tried lots. For one, it has lots of clams instead of mostly potatoes and other filler.  Easy to prepare. I add a dash of pepper and a dollap of butter. Makes a great lunch. Try it with a peanut butter sandwich as well.

column9: Bumble Bee has estroyed Snow Clam Chowder
column10: The last can of Snows Clam Chowder by Bumble Bee was the very last one I will buy. As a great fan of the original Snows Clam Chowder I was extremely disappointed, in fact was nauseated by what I was eating.

I was in the mood for N.E. clam chowder,since some cooler weather had just moved in... I have been buying Snows for years and have always loved its taste, texture,and size of the clams and potatoes..Yes you paid more but it was worth it. Saw the bumble bee on the label,but didn't give it a thought that it would be anything like their cans of minced tuna,though I should have...WHAT happened to the snows I know??? this is not the same..tiny hardly reconizable pieces of clams,and less potatoes. And as for seasonings forget it,just tastes like heated milk. What happened to the hearty pieces of clams,and potatoes and seasonings?????? I stopped buying the tuna,now it looks like I have to stop buying the snows,because apparently its now being mad by bummble bee. I started buying our store brand of tuna,which is most definately a chunk tuna,,,now looks like I'll be trying the clam chowder too... Good luck Bumble with keeping snows on the shelf. I'm with everyone else,,not the Snows we know!!!!!!

column9: Best canned clam chowder I've ever eaten
column10: I used to be able to get Snow's Clam Chowder at my neighborhood Food Lion Market.  When they stopped carring it, I was able to get it at Harris Teeter.  Then they stopped carrying it, and I obtained at at the Piggly Wiggly market.  Now none of them any longer carry it.  I was glad to find it on line at Amazon, so I ordered a case of it.  Now once, again, I'm able to enjoy Snow's delicious clam chowder!!
looked for product all over town, another similiar product has the market sewed up. Amazon.com came and saved the "SUPER BOWL PARTY"

Snow's is hard to come by in the southwest supermarkets butit is worth looking for or buying on line.  Closer tohomemade than the other name brands.  Less of a starchypotato taste and more clam taste with the most clams ofany canned chowder we have eaten. The potatoes are smalland don't outnumber the clams.  The only negative is that the soup is not a pearlwhite color like many other canned types of chowder.  It is morea light creamy brown.  We use skin milk to make ours tocut down on the fat, but use of a light cream or whole milkwould make the soup even better.  We also add diced celery,butter, ground pepper, and parsley for a real fish restaurantsoup.  We recommend Snow's to anyone that likes good chowderfrom a can.

column9: Something bad has happened to Snow Clam Chowder
column10: Just dumped out a pot of Snows New England Clam Chowder,"ready to serve".  This recipe is not the original clam chowder we have been enjoying for more than 3 decades.  It is absolutely horrible.I do not believe that the folks who are giving this product favorable reviews are talking about this same product we just experienced.Just because it is no longer condensed, I did not expect it to be inedible.
Snow's condensed clam chowder...Buy it IF you like 'hot milk soup'!NO FLAVOR, few potatoes and clams!Snow's New England Clam Chowder, Condensed, 15-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)

My husband spent some time living in New England and really fell in love with this particular brand of clam chowder.  Since we live in the West it is not found on our grocery store shelves. I was delighted to find I could get a 12pack for him through Amazon. While I am not a fan of clam chowder, the hubby rates this one at four stars. I for one can tell you it does look jam-packed with clams. We would definitely recommend this and I'm hoping to be able to find it again on Amazon.

Was very glad to have found this chowder as it is my favorite out of all the canned varieties. the only bad point I can make with the purchase is even though the box my product came in was perfect 3 out of the 8 cans of soup were severly dented. Not to sure what happened. Looks like a factory issue as the exterior box was fine.

A product once commononly found in almost any grocery store on the East Coast, is is now quite rare and very difficult to find.  This product is a classic New England milk-based clam chowder, usually available either condensed or non-condensed.  Tastes, to me, as it always has -- just great.  Best with Trenton OTC Oyster Crackers, also once common, now also extremely difficult to locate.
Love the product.  Snow's Clam Chowder is very good.  Was disappointed in the shipping.  Was not well packed.  Most of the cans were dented.

We are withdrawing our praise of products we had called company who told us they were USA company and finest ingredients, but we just confirmed printed in micro size print is MADE IN CHINA and seller just told us they are on recall list!

I have a Golden Retriever and she absolutely loves these treats not to mention that they are very good and healthy for her. You just cannot beat the price of this product, especially when you compare the cost with retail outlets.
Received order very quickly and the savings was a wonderful bonus!  However, I can't say I will continue to purchase this product.  Our vet has recommended something different.
I got my order quickly and in good condition.  My dog LOVES these treats and they are good for her too!

When I saw the picture I was excited. I was going to give this as a 30th birthday present but I decided to try if for myself. It was a huge let down.  I don't remember wink soda and it tasted like a generic mountain dew.  The candy could have been from any decade. BTW where were the gummy savers. It was mostly generic stuff. Not worth the price at all. Shipping was too much. If they would take out that nasty generic soda the shipping could be cut in half.

They missed the mark on this one. Zours is NOT an 80's candy. It wasn't introduced until the late, late 90's. They didn't include sour patch kids?Missed Bonkers, Fun Dips, and other now defunct candies. Lame!

Looking at my 80's box, I am very disappointed with it. I cannot believe that there is a 1 liter bottle of soda in this small box, it takes up a third of all the space! This is a flat out rip-off, that was space that could have had candy! Not to mention that it isn't even a brand that we'd ever heard of, so it does us zero for nostalgia. Furthermore, there are more suckers in the box than anything else! I feel like this box, which should have been very easy, was completely thrown together without much thought and is complete garbage, especially as most of the candy is still available in stores.I had to spend more money just to fill in that empty third of the box when  I threw the soda away!

The idea is a good one. Who doesn't want to reminisce about their childhood when they were free and innocent?! But the price is a bit steep and the products aren't that impressive. Many of these items can be found in certain grocery or candy stores, and for a fraction of the price. It would be much more impressive and tantalizing if there were items that you can't find regularly. I would like to see one with old favorites such as dweebs, bonkers, gatorgum or bar none (to name a few). Bring back those and you can charge me any price you want!!!

Most of the candy in this package goes into, as others have said, a generic feel. I was only 4 when the 80s started so I do remember most of these items, but I don't ever remember buying wax fangs for anything except Halloween.I do remember Wink, I've noticed that some reviewers have mentioned they had never heard of it. I believe it was a mid-atlantic, upper south drink, Tennessee/Kentucky maybe Ohio areas. It seems like I liked it better when I was younger, but I don't really care for soft drinks now so that could be the problem.The ones that saved this package for me: The Smoothie and Goetze's Cow Tail. I never saw Smoothie's sold anywhere except this one little corner drugstore back in the early 80s. I can remember going there with my grandmother and she would always buy me what is pretty much a Reese Cup with no chocolate. The Cow Tale brought back the most memories for me. There was a gas station called Hop In, where I lived. The Cow Tails were in a big see-through container and I think were 20 cents each. My friends and I, when in elementary school, would buy these every morning before school from the Hop In beside of the school. I can remember holding one in my mouth while playing Donkey Kong or Joust in the back of the store.For bringing back some memories, I give the product 5 stars. It was used in a recent 15 year reunion from high school. For product selection, I give it a 3. Most of these candies are still available. As a matter of fact, I just bought a large container of Fire Balls, which was my favorite candy of the 80s. I have to take a little off the score for the shipping and the inclusion of products that aren't exactly candy, like the Wax Fangs and the Wax bottles.Anyone reading this that wants to get a few good memories and taste does help you remember things, I would recommend it, especially for reunions, but I can't say for candy lovers to buy it.Now can someone tell me what those candies were called that were like Fire Balls, but they were extremely sour? My wife and I are from two very different parts of the country and she says I'm crazy, "That's explains why I married you!"Seriously, I'm thinking they were called Tear Jerkers or Cry Babies or something like that. One of the things I remember about those is that they turn your tongue yellow. So you could never hide them in school, in your mouth. Anybody know what those were called?

I might actually buy it if it had those. But seriously folks, just find a Sweet Factory in a mall and you can get 90% of this stuff for 90% less money. They're just trying to sell you on the 80's nostalgia title.

This is a major disappointment. I found a much better one elsewhere online.. Better yet? The store in my local mall carries better candy and without the shipping cost... AND, I for soda? I still find "Crush" in my local store. Sure the label has changed.... Whoa? I just had an idea.. I'll make my own box and market it here. It will be better than this one!.. Stay far away!

I bought this for my fiance's 30th birthday.  Some of the candy was smashed, some of the boxes had a tear/hole and there was very little candy.  This box is very overpriced.  This is by far the worst Amazon purchase I have made.

column9: Presented well, but item very is lame
column10: The title says it all. I bought this as a secret santa gift for someone thinking it would be pretty neat. However, when I opened the box I was surprised at how much it cost for what is actual presented. If it weren't for the price, it would be an alright gift for someone (mostly a child). The only possitive thing to mention, is it shipped and arrived fast.

column9: I wish I would have read the reviews.  Totally AWFUL!!!
column10: I was so excited when I purchased this product because both me and my husband grew up in the 80's.  UGH!!!!  Dont know how people can get away with crap like this.  I will need to go to the local candy store and purchase more '80s candy than this crap they sent me.  WARHEADS?  really?  My kids eat those from Walmart today.  Everything in the box I can find at Walmart or my local store.  I thought this was supposed to be HARD TO FIND....total rip off!!!!  Please put this company out of business because they are ripping people off!  Do NOT buy from them!

I received this box for my birthday, and the candy tasted stale, like it was stored in somebody's basement and the soda was flat.  The pop Rocks were melted into a single gooey mess, and some of the packages were wet.

I bought this as a gift for my husband's 28th birthday.  When he was a kid, his mother never let him eat candy.  Needless to say he is a complete sugar fiend, and would eat candy for breakfast, lunch and dinner if I let him!When he opened the box, he exclaimed, "This is a really cool gift!" and immediately tore into the box.  It generated a great conversation about what candy we remembered.Some of the candy appears to be knock-offs of the ones everyone remembers (where are the Pop Rocks??), and some of the candy we had never heard of.  Oh, and he opened the box upside down so he didn't see the "Don't Open Unless You're A Child of The Eighties!" until he closed it.All in all a very nice gift.  He's away on business now and hid the box from me so I can't eat any while he's gone!

What a neat, creative gift!  We purchased these for family members for Christmas.  It was very cute to see the joy over reliving old candy memories of childhood.  There is a great selection of candy to being back all the memories of childhood candy eating.  They went over very well as cute, different gifts- certainly not your same old gift box!

column9: Great gift for parents and grandparents!
column10: My boyfriend and I did combine gifts for the parents and I came across these in daily deals. I didn't realize how fast they'd sell out so I made sure to log on at that very time of the deal and ended up buying three from different decades. My boyfriend said that it was a really big hit along with bringing back memories of their younger days when they opened the boxes. Definatly recommend giving this gift!

Very dissappointing, I got this for my girlfriend who loves the 80's.  Most of the candy is stuff i can get around the corner at any convinence store, and I got killed on shipping.  For the price of this collection of candy I def got ripped off.  I knew what I was buying because of the candy list but wow just 1 piece of each candy! and 12 dollars for shipping!  I would not have been upset if the candy was really hard to find 80's candy but with the exception of the nintendo candy everything else you can find at a local store.

I really wish I would have read the reviews before purchasing this,unfortunately I bought it during a lightening deal and felt rushed to purchase it. Read the review I completely agree this product or sale is crap! The cute box in the picture isn't even in the shipped product, it all is just tossed in a shipping box with some cheezy saying I can't even read because it's covered in shipping labels, and tape. I opened the box to find the majority of the weight it a 1 liter bottle of some soda I have never heard of, and I would say about 50% of the candy wasn't even legit, and most of it was generic! Seriously disappointed in this product. I could have created something unique myself with candy from the $1 store because that's what this felt like! So save yourself some time and money and don't buy this product.

I bought this on a Black Friday deal, and after all the mixed reviews was pleasantly surprised.
