I'm not sure if these reviews are getting mixed with another product (there's another, completely different 80s candy box on Amazon) or if the manufacturer changed the product over time. There's no 1-liter of soda in my box, the candy exactly matches what's in the description, and the box/candy seems to be in great shape. I'll admit that I probably wouldn't pay full price, but it was well worth the discounted price and I think the concept is a lot of fun.

column9: Impressed and disappointed, all at once.
column10: Got this for my wife after she saw it and talked about it.  The box is an impressive array of 80's candy, and very well put together.  On candy alone it's an ok value, but given you didn't have to go find it all it is a really good deal.However, what we found is candy is a bit of a personal thing.  Perhaps 25% of the things were items we really remembered from being a kid.  25% were things we didn't like.  50% were just ok.  This is probably more an indication that you can't relive your youth than anything else....Still, I would buy again.  If nothing else it is worth the conversation it creates.
You can easily purchase all of the Items in this kit at a gas station or grocery store for a lot cheaper. I think this kit is way too expensive. But I love candy.
All the candy was fresh.  The items packaging is a bit generic, but other than that it was fantastic trip down memory lane.

column9: A great idea that I will try myself
column10: I was about to order this product or the other one like it for my friend's 35th B Day but see from the reviews that neither of these boxes seems to get the selection of candy quite right.  Since they are mostly still available you have all given me the idea to go hunt these candies down myself and make my own gift box!  It can't cost $30 even for a big box worth.

column9: Crown Royal Cask 16 is a more evolved Canadian Whiskey.
column10: Spiced plum pudding in a glass: Crown Royal Cask No. 16 takes the normally sweet and simple genre of Canadian whiskey somewhere new and more sophisticated.Cask No. 16 is a stunningly beautiful dark bronze hazelnut color.  I've never seen a darker more lovely dram.  The aroma is sweet and rich with figs and prunes (sweet dried black fruits).  There is a subtle floral and woody aroma too - with extended time in the glass.  Entry is sweet and light, but expands beautifully on the tongue with figs, both fresh and dried, more floral perfume, nutmeg and allspice and toasted pecans.  Finish is long and adds complexity with the wood showing up to add tannins' dryness to counter all the fig honey.  Just lovely and yummy.I'm not a big fan of Canadian whiskey in general.  I find it too sweet and too simple and the spirit flavor inadequately integrated with the grain sweetness (unlike sweet examples from Scotland, Ireland, and the USA which put the spirit better in the mix in my opinion).  Crown Royal Cask No. 16 is an exception.  It's sweet, sure, and there's spirit heat, indeed; but Cask No. 16 brings a wooded sophistication and mixes the figgy fruits with floral perfume and oaky vanilla in a way that is inescapably seductive.  I didn't think I'd love this one - but I do.  I LOVE it.  Bravo, Crown Royal.  They have elevated Canadian whiskey and produced something that can stand with the great spirits of the world.

Usually Amazon offers great prices so I am wondering if this is a typo?  Maybe you get two 16oz packages????

I remember Tutti Frutti from my childhood. It came in very small boxes, and there was only one flavour. Strawberry? That's somewhat strange, since Tutti Frutti, of course, means All Fruits.Today's children are spoiled, if you ask me. These days, Tutti Frutti comes in large bags, and yes, there is a mix of several different flavours in each. Unless I'm mistaken: pear, lemon, strawberry and orange.Personally, I find Tutti Frutti to be a tasty but nevertheless rather boring candy, which you can buy in any good grocery store here in Sweden. (Incidentally, I grew up thinking Fazer was a Swedish company. Actually, it's Finnish.) However, both Chappie and Norma Bates, known from my other reviews, love it, and so do the guys at the warehouse department where I work.I'll give All Fruits four stars. Sometimes, at least, the optimists are right. There really is progress.
This dip is absolutely delicious.  It is so easy to make.  The price is also exceptional.

column9: A real benefit for those watching calories
column10: Let's be honest.  0 calories?  Not likely.  But I believe they are within their rights to say 0 calories if it is less than 5 calories per serving.  So even if you ate the whole jar in one sitting, it would be less than 60 calories.  This flavor of dip is by far my favorite of the Walden Farms dips.  It's a nice alternative to plain vegetables.  If you've had ranch dip before, I think you will find this to be similar.

This stuff is awesome, I am a diabetic and so this sugar free rockstar is great for me. I love the buzz it gives me in the morning. Suffice to say this drink has less caffeine than 2 cups of coffee. My husband and many other people I know drink way more than that during the day. So the caffeine if anybody is worried about that is not really that much. The FDA recommends a person consume no more than 300mg of caffeine in a day. I don't drink coffee (Yuk) and I don't drink soda so I don't have to worry about that. I wouldn't have more than two of these a day though. Each can contains 160mg of caffeine. The taste of this is soooo much better than red bull (should be called red butt). Anyway I can't live without this stuff now!
You can go to an overpriced convenience store and pay less. All these 5 star ratings must work for them
Way, way overpriced.  You can get them at Costco for much less.  If only I'd known...Otherwise, I mean, the drink's good...

I drink at least 1 sugar free rockstar a day, but not for anywhere near this price. I purchased mine at CosCo for 28.99 for the same size of a case. That is less than half the price for those who don't like math :)

I used to be a Sugar Free Red bull addict.  Once I had Diet Rock Star, I converted.  The drink comes in a larger container than Red Bull, which is nice, but I also like the taste better.  It is great on it's own as a pick me up, but is also great mixed with Midori or Grey Goose (and I am sure other various liquors).  Plus, only 20 calories in the entire thing!  I highly recommend it.

This is my energy drink of choice, after Diet Coke. Sometimes if you just pound caffeine you get a weary, jittery kind of alertness, but sugar-free Rockstar gives me alertness with smoothed over edges. Good stuff. Wish it came in 12oz cans and six-packs.

column9: the boy friend can't get enough!
column10: My boyfriend is pretty much addicted to this stuff. And when albertsons stopped putting it on sale wee didn't want to pay 4 dollars a can so I turned to the internet! searched lots ofsites and they all had surcharges andshipping and handling fees beyond belief!! and of course amazon delivered with good prices and quick delivery!!!!

column9: Paid for next day delivery--received 10 days later!
column10: Don't expect timely delivery. I purchased this product as a time-sensitive birthday gift. Paid for next business day delivery. About 80.00 extra. Well, it arrived ten (10) days later. NOT next day, not within the week. No response or communication from seller. No cancellation of the charges. No response from Amazon either. Unless Amazon adjusts this I will be suing for unfair business practices to ensure they do not do this to others. Pick on anybody, but not a lawyer. I will report back if there is more to say. TRD, Esq.

column9: Ended up given to a food bank after forcing myself trying them
column10: I have tasted several spiced sardines (cf other reviews),  in comparison these are very bad IMHO.On my rating scale of o (worst) to 5 (best), these sardines rate as follows IMHO:Appearance 1/5 they look so pale; if the chili pepper was laid on the top, the packed sardines upon opening would seem less morbid/would be more appetizing.Odor 2/5Quantity 5/5Taste 1/5 too saltyTexture 2/5 too dry/bonyI will not buy again, ever. My PhD nephew hates them too -to my disarray- I 'm stuck with them/ bought too many.They remind me of the dollar store sardines which are terribly bad tasting too BUT 18 times cheaper (3 for a dollar).

Eagle Brand Fat Free Sweetened condensed Milk, Made with nonfat milk instead of whole milk, however, I can not taste the difference. I bake pies, put it in Coffee and so many other items and it taste the same as the regular condensed milk ... so good and Rich!. Did you know when combined with acidic fruit juice such as lemon juice, it thickens without heating to create velvety pie fillings, puddings and so many other desserts and you don't have to add any more sugar. Eagle Brand Fat Free sweetened condensed Milk is so thick, creamy and smooth...I love it! Thank You

I used to be able to find fat free condensed milk everywhere but now it seems to have gone the way of the Dodo. I desperately need this product for many modified recipes for lower fat, calorie and cholesterol content! The fantastic thing about this product is that it could replace regular condensed milk and make a recipe just as good - particularly my Key Lime Pie and various ice cream recipes
product arrived in a timely fashionpackaging was appropriateproduct expiration stamp well into the future (2013)fully satisfied with this experience.

column9: JUST as wonderful as its "fatter" brother
column10: This may be fat free, but you wouldn't know it -- it has the same "Mouth" texture and creaminess and sweetness and oh-so-wonderfulness as its fatter brother with the red label.Thank you Bordens for finding "Heaven on Earth" and putting it in a can!!!

We love to use these in our green smoothies. They provide sweetness and flavor, and help the body to be more alkaline. They are delicious, and we've always been happy with Angelina's Gourmet's service.

Expressed disappointment with product.  Was advertised as "diced" but ended up being large "chunks".  When I contacted the vendor, they acknowleded the wording was in error and refunded me my payment.  Looking forward to getting "diced" figs as well as apricots from same vendor.

A friend in the coffee business had given us some samples of Seattle's Best and we really liked the Level 4.  It's hard to find in the whole bean and we're almost out.  I will definitely order some more.  It is very rich tasting without being bitter.  We use three heaping scoops (1/8 cup each), grind it pretty fine and brew in our Bunn coffee maker.  We are now spoiled from using anything else.  Don't understand the one reviewer sayling it's "bilge".  What is he used to???

This coffee tastes GREAT.I usually purchase Folger's classic style blend from Sams $11 due to the convenience of the, packaging and expected level of flavor.  One day, I bought a 12oz. package of #4 from Seatle's Best from Wally World (Wal-Mart) for $6.00, having already experienced the goodness from Borders before they went bankrupt, I was happy to see a great price on the product.I absolutely have fallen in love with this coffee!  A cup of this, and "Coldstone Sweet cream" Creamer is great.  Simply put, I prefer to have my day start with that combination and I'm saddened whilst I am at work and my cup finally runs empty.However, the $31 price on 3 bags seems a bit high, as a 2-pack of 12oz goes for $15.00 on here as well.  Huge markup on the 3-pack, which makes no sense.

column4: Jolly Green Giant "You can try Birchbox too! ...
column10: I bought this at my local grocery store because it was on sale and I had heard good things about Seattles Best from other people. This coffee was so fresh, so rich in flavor, and stayed fresh until the last cup. Unfortunately I now I have three bags of Starbucks to plow through until I can buy this again. I also plan to try level 5. It works well in an espresso machine as well, very rich and satisfying, and the beans do not seem as dry as Starbucks.

column9: Makes my $20 coffee maker seem like a $200 one
column10: I'm wondering if the last reviewer got a bad batch because my husband and I LOVE this coffee!  Whenever we make a cup for guests, we're always asked what kind of coffee-maker we have.  We have a Home Depot $20 Mr. Coffee but this coffee blend makes it seem as if we have some high-end machine.  Coffee is rich without bitterness.  I add milk and 1 sweet and low to my brew and it is a great cup.

Beware any coffee that doesn't tell you what kind of coffee beans they use. There is no info on the bag and nothing on their website that I could find. I would be surprised if these were Arabica coffee beans, although they could just be really inferior Arabica, I suppose. I know lower quality stuff is being grown in Vietnam but that's generally the limit of my cursory knowledge of coffee beans. I know what I like and I hated this coffee. I drink my coffee with no cream or sweetener. To drink this stuff I would require cream, sugar, and a gun pointed at my head.My wife picked up a bag of this mud at the supermarket because we do like trying different brands but after one pot we threw out the rest of the bag. I realize that tastes vary widely but you might want to try buying only one bag instead of a 3-pack. Then you won't feel so wasteful as you're spitting this bilge into your sink.

I sent this to  my brother, he said it was cheap and smelled bad.  Thought it was all made in China.  Will never send again, you really get what you paid for and the 2 day free shipping with amazon prime does not make up for  crappy gift baskets.

column9: So much better than other brands!
column10: I can't say enough about how wonderful this product is! The pineapple chunks are so natural tasting, delicately tender, and supremely ( and yet suprisingly ) still juicy on the tongue, with just the right amount of sweetness. I've tried more than a dozen other premium brands and probably at least another dozen or more so-called "natural" health food store offerings, as well as several grocery store brands of dried pineapple chunks, but none, even the most expensive ones, come close to comparing to these. Simply the best!

column9: theres dried pineapple then theres mariani tropical pineapple
column10: Don't be fooled into thinking this is just dried pineapple.I am ordering these and i am scared to death that someday there going to stop making them.I really like dried pineapple but i have never had dried pineapple like these they are simply perfect.the texture is perfect and soft not hard or tough.the flavor is full and sweet not spoiled or syrup like,it is just dry enough to develop crystals of sweet sugar while still moist enough to chew like like soft gummy bears or fruit snacks.I cant wait for the package to arive in the mail

column9: The Best Dried Fruit I've ever eaten.
column10: Fresh fruit is difficult to keep in warm weather, so dried fruit is a necessary alternative. It's great for road trips, camping, just having around as a snack.Mariani Pineapple is my favorite of the Mariani products. This stuff is delicious--it has almost a bubblegum flavor to it. Although it has added sugar, it's still better for kids than candy.An excellent product, and this is from a very finicky guy.
Too bad I didn't notice the ingredient until after purchase.  It has too much sugar and uses sulfur dioxide for color retention.

I got hooked on these pineapples years ago when you could buy them at the Wal-Mart. Now, I can't find them there so I checked on Amazon to see if they sold them. They are delicious with coffee. I will continue buying this product. They are shipped on time and in resealable bags.

The good and the bad:Fat free and cholesterol free.  Good fiber source.Total carbohydrates is 11%, 16g of sugarBeen looking for some alternative snacks instead of chocolate bars, cookies, candies; I like this better as it is organic. 6-oz bag contains 4 servings. Nice resealable pouch.  Tender and tasty snack.Just a tad too sweet for my taste.Pineapples farmed from Thailand.
This product is a great snack and is cheaper to buy from amazon than from the local store.
These are the BEST!!They taste great and are soft and chewy. Wonderful for mixing with nuts and making your own mix. and they are kosher!!
The kids will kill for this product.  I ordered 2 cases, will order more, and more.  C. Morris

Jules Destrooper, Cookie Thins Almond 100G, 3.5-Ounce This proved to be an all time ripoff. I was expecting a broken case of cookies. I received 1 box of cookies worth $3 - paid $9.95 for the cookies, plus $6.30 for shipping. $16.25 for a $3 value. Never again will I shop Amazon.  Richard Rossi

Most of the cookies (almond thins) arrived as crumbs.  There was no protective padding inside the outer shipping box, so the rough handling by the USPS reduced the delicate cookies to little more than crumbs.
Yes, this is yet another great item from Walkers.  Just wish they weren't so expensive.  Everything is quality so we still treat ourselves to these cookies every month or so.
These shortbread cookies are the most delicious I've ever tasted- I treat myself to no more than one a day- they are truly addictive- and the ginger IS GOOD FOR YOU !!

I buy these to bake with and they are very good but sometimes can be a little tough when I use them in certain recipes such as no-bake cookies. However, this does not prevent me from buying them. I just wish I was able to by gluten-free quick oats that are packaged in this way.

These oats are very tasty.  I've used the Gifts of Nature GF oats for years and they are bitter, and take forever to cook and get soft, but they were the only kind available to me.  I ordered these on a whim, and I'm so glad I did.  They are sweet and delicious.  They make great oatmeal and even better no-bake cookies!

I was lucky enough to order these just by chance, but this deal is MUCH cheaper than the website I bought them through originally. I couldn't believe how creamy they were compared to the other 3-4 brands I've tried!! I make mine with the oats and water mixed together from the start, bring to a boil, turn down to low and let them cook about 8 minutes. I add apples, ground golden flaxseed, rice protein powder, a dash of maple syrup and a sprinkle of real cinnamon - delicious!

cream hill estates oats are the best tasting gluten free oats I have tasted,they are far better than their cheaper competator,most stores do not carry them because of the price,but they are well worth it.I am very sensitive to gluten and they cause me no problem.I just store the extra boxes in the refigerator,and they stay fresh no rancid taste at all.

These cook up creamy and delicious!  Don't rush it--mine takes about 12-15 minutes on top of the stove, then I add in some maple syrup, cinnamon, a dash of salt, a pat of butter, and sliced bananas-----YUM!!!!  They're pricey, but so are most gluten free products.  Will buy again.
I finally found out that gluten intolerant people can eat uncontaminated oats. They are delicious!!!

These oats are gluten free and are very good. They have become my breakfast staple. I like finer oats so I run them through my food processor. If I want oat flour I process them longer. I freeze the boxes that I am not using. They are excellent in baking also.

I ordered these rolled oats on the recommendation of a friend and have been very pleased.I used them extensively in baking for the holidays and they behaved as rolled oats should, the flavor is outstanding and they retain the texture of "old-fashioned" oat flakes that the readily available supermarket brands do not.I am very pleased and I will certainly buy this product again.The price is also much better than I paid in a local health food store.

column9: Cream Hill Estates Lara's Rolled Oats
column10: This is the greatest. I have shared the source with many of my friends.  The oats are pure and preparation is easy.  Prompt delivery of boxes is especially important.
These are the best gluten free oat's I've tried. They cook up very creamy and have a great chewy texture. If you're looking for a fabulous oatmeal this is it!

Hey, this is not chocolate in the actual sense. I expected it to be close to a container of chocolate frosting. It was not. It is like syrup, thin and runny. The taste is not milk chocolate. All you can taste is sugar and bitterness. There is no chocolate taste like anyone living in the US is familiar with.

I am not quite sure why this product is found under the 'natural' foods category.  In the ingredients we find artificial flavors and we also find partially hydrogenated oils.  This product most certainly should not be considered "natural" or healthy.

column9: Worst smell coming from a wafer
column10: Store brought, open at home and the package smell like it had a methane gas leak. Didn't think it came from the wafer. Ate one and immediately felt nausea, kept burping a methane like smell which made me feel like I want to throw up. My family could handle the smell, took out the trash which I ditch the wafer into. Husband walk by and almost threw up from the smell. What an cookie event that was. Don't get me wrong, Garden makes great chocolate wafers which I totally enjoy. But the Durian, don't say I didn't warn you.

If you have never had "Jack Fruit" then nothing can prepare you for the flavor of these wafers. Upon opening these, an odor I can't even begin to describe wafted up and I knew I was in uncharted territory. I forced myself to take a bite and really tried to give them a chance. After chewing a few times, I couldn't take it anymore and into the trash they went. I can only describe the flavor as stale (slightly rotten) oniony/garlicly kind of flavor.

column9: Found ingredients listed on another site
column10: 6. Durian Flavor - Wheat Flour, Vegetable Shortening (palm oil) (contains antioxidant (ascorbyl palmitate (E304), mixed tocopherols concentrate (E306), Soy lecithin (E322)))< Sugar, Whole Milk Powder, Corn Starch, Leavening/Raising Agent (sodium carbonates (E500) ammonium carbonates (E503)), Artificial Flavoring (contains emulsifier (propylene aglycol (E1520))), Emulsifier (soy lecithin (E322)), Salt (contains anticaking agent (sodium ferrocyanide (E535))), Artificial Color (tartrazine (FD&C Yellow No.5).[...]

These have a mild Durian scent and flavor that I love.  I got hooked on Durian in Hat Yai, Thailand with a scoop of Durian Ice Cream.  I have sought it out ever since.  It's an acquired taste, however.  The closed Durian cookies to my house are 80 miles away in a Vietnamese Grocery.  I guess someone once bought them, went outside and ate one, came running back in freaking out, so the Grocer tries to not let me buy them until I assure him I know what they are.  My kids were totally grossed out (fun!), but now the older one eats them.  Durian Ice Cream is better, I think, if you want a low-level Durian fix, but it's much harder to find.  I have a recipe posted on my blog [...]

First of all, I downgraded this from 5 to 4 stars because of the packaging only.  It comes packed in a plastic pouch that makes it very difficult to use every last bit.  As far as the good stuff, I betcha this is what they use in Thai restaurants for panang curry.  It is the simplest thing I've found when I'm really jonesing for some great curry - add some coconut milk (the real thing, not that lite junk), a little fish sauce, some sugar, and whatever veggies you have around - red bell pepper, carrots, zucchini, a nice fat serrano chili - maybe a little chicken - ladle it over some brown rice - voila!  A great meal. I have kept this in the fridge for over six months at a time with no molding or spoilage whatever.  Try it!

I order Panang wherever I go but never knew there was a Panang curry paste.  I'd been looking for Panang recipes on the web and discovered the paste.  I came straight to Amazon (the best company ever invented!) and ordered this paste immediately.  Two days after receiving the paste, I made Chicken Panang Curry at home, yum!  I can't say enough how grateful I am to have discovered how simple it is to make at home, how glad I am that Amazon carried the product and how delicious it is.  I live on an island and finding exotic spices etc is not that easy.  If you enjoy curries, try this one!

I first tried this curry paste in Germany after taking a cooking class with a Thai cook.  This is the best curry paste I have found for the recipe I have for Panang Curry.  It is a real hit with family and friends.  Other curry pastes just aren't the same!

Made chicken panang with it last night, and it was pretty tasty; you definitely need to add a few tablespoons of fish sauce (plain or hot), and more sugar than the recipe calls for. I hear that "Hand" brand panang paste is higher quality, so I'll give that a try the next time (not available here at Amazon, but Google "Hand panang" and several sources will come up).

Having never made a curry dish before I went out on a limb in purchasing this.  It is spicier than I thought it would be, but I am a wimp when it comes to spice.  Still very tasty and easy to cook with.
This curry paste is amazing - it tastes the closest to the restaurant-quality panang than other sauces/pastes I've tried.  Good price.

This is an excellent curry paste. My only gripe is that the bag it comes in is sort of awkward to measure the paste from. So I snipped the corner off of the bag and squeezed it out, which worked well but now it's awkward to store. Anyway, the flavor is really great. It's spicier than the panang curries we've had in restaurants but we're going to use some coconut cream to cool it down a little bit. Will buy again.

column4: Jon Atwood "Computer Geek and loving owner of...
column10: Curry has officially become my FAVORITE food over the past year.  I can't believe I waited 35 years to try it.We went through all of the grocery store curry pastes and never could find one that had great flavor and spice.Mae Ploy knocks it out of the park!  We always have 3 or 4 of these in our fridge & pantry.  These make super yummy curry with or without coconut milk (we've recently started using chicken stock instead of coconut milk to cut down on the calories)A definite MUST HAVE for curry loversAdd some Mae Ploy Sweet Chili Sauce, 25-Ounce Bottle (Pack of 2) to your pantry as well!  Goes great in stir fry and other asian dishes

I absolutely love Panang.  This doesn't taste like any panang I have ever had.  First, it's VERY spicy.  It's good, but it is HOT!I doctored it a lot, just to make it palatable, without burning my lips off!  :)

column9: So good my kids like it
column10: I learned about Mae Ploy from a Thai cook who was a wizard with curry. My kids usually don't like my cooking, but they like my Panang curry.
We love spicy food, but this was way too spicy (even for my husband, who is always ordering his food extra spicy). The flavor was pretty good, but we just couldn't handle the heat.
This is a wonderful short cut to Thai cooking.  I use it in many dishes.  Its so much easier than having to gather all the individual spices.

I've really enjoyed the dishes I've made with this.  It is spicy.  It has a kick.  But it has flavor and heat.  Nice consistency.  Nice color.  When you put it in the pan and heat it up the aroma makes you feel like you are a better cook than you really are.  It is hot... twice.  You know what I mean.

If you love the curry that is served in the traditional Thai restaurants, then this curry is for you. It is identical to restaurant curry and very simple to make. All you need to do is cut up your desired vegetables and choice of meat and wok them. Then add  one can of coconut milk, a half teaspoon of fish sauce, and about three tablespoons of the panang curry (if you like it hot!) Mix and voila, it is ready!! This product is easy to use and is simply delicious!!
Mae Ploy Thai Panang Curry paste is wonderful. Incredible flavor and enough heat to be interesting. I have tried other Mae Ploy curry pastes but I like the Panang style best.
Easy to use, has directions on the side.  Arrived in good condition.  Tastes good.  Add chili for more spices.

column9: A very good cup of coffee
column10: I had the St. Regis blend and find it very flavorful and a great breakfast coffee. I hope Amazon continues to carry this brand--I sent 2 of the packages to friends for Christmas, and now wish I had purchased more for myself!!
I've tried a couple of blends from the St. Ignatius line and really enjoyed them both.  This breakfast blend is really good.  I hope Amazon keeps carrying this brand of coffee.

I'm really, really pleased with this bread machine mix. First of all, it's really easy to make: just put it in the bread machine with water, oil and yeast. The yeast packet is included, so that's nice. It bakes up with a really nice texture and tastes great. It's great for making sandwiches and it's healthy! I will definitely be buying this again!

This is great bread mix. I put it in my bread maker and it comes out delicious every time. I've found that using real butter helps it rise higher than margarine or oil. I've added different ingredients to make different types of bread. We especially like adding flax seed, rosemary, oregano and minced onion. Bread is a little pricey but so worth it. Fresh & no preservatives.

I bought this product only because others said it was good.  I was surprised how well it worked as an oven bread.  I also had trouble with the rise as did many reviewers, but by adding some of my own yeast and proofing it in a 150 degree oven for double the time created a really nice not-too-dense bread that baked up beautifully.  I baked mine in the oven and made them into rolls instead of a loaf.Another note:  I added to my last batch 1/2 cup each chopped nuts and diced dates for a more mediteranean flavor.  After the first rise when you punch it down just put the add-ins and knead a few times to incorporate, then mold it how you like (loaf or rolls) and let rise another hour to 1 1/4 hours and bake as directed (shorter time for individual rolls) and enjoy.

Love these bread mixes; I use them for all my bread in my breadmaker.  I like to add tons of extra ingredients for even more fiber: seeds, quinoa, oats, wheat germ, bran, walnuts.  This makes a small, more dense loaf (don't add more than about 1/2 cup to 3/4 cup of extras).

column9: Great bread mix, but may need eggs
column10: The first batch I made was strictly according to the directions, and although came out tasty, it was very dense, chewy, and hard to slice.  In subsequent batches, I tried adding a couple eggs to the recipe and that seemed to do the trick - came out much better...fluffy and easy to slice.  I highly recommend this mix, but you may need to add eggs.

A box of Hodgson MIll bread mix and a bread machine makes a greatloaf of bread. The recipe is easy, and it has never failed. I do add a teaspoon of sugar and an extra dash of salt for my taste. You just can't go wrong.

column9: easy to use with bread machine
column10: Our first two boxes got over baked because we left it in the full time.The other are turning out great because I take them out 35min early. Your time may vary.The only thing you need to add is vegetable oil or margarine. We've used  both and it turned out the same. I would suggest using olive oil or another vegetable oil because it is easier to use.
Esay directions and not many outside ingredients necessary to add. Almost all inclusive:)

Definitely a few things I agree that other reviewers noted:1) Small loaf - only really makes a 1 lb-er even if it gives instructions on a 1.5 loaf2) Rise problems - my boxes don't expire until 2012 but I still had rise problems. A friend from the culinary school nearby said it might be because there is a lot more whole wheat in it (a good thing for the body, not as good in the bread maker). As noted in another review, baking it in the oven really did make a better and higher loaf.3) Butter is best - tried oil and butter and butter is definitely better.4) A little more salt - I added an additional 1/2 tsp of salt and that seemed to help with the rise as well.It's a great backup for when you're out of bread flour or yeast but I still think the best bread machine recipe from allrecipes.com (subbing in 2 cups of flour, 1 cup whole wheat) makes for the most delicious and closest to store bought I've seen thus far.

The Hodgson Mill Honey Whole Wheat Bread Mix is a excellent product. In fact most of the Hodgson Mill "whole grain" products are very good. It is hard to find healthy "whole grain" products locally and I ma glad that I can order them from Amazon and receive the shipments on a timely basis.The product from Amazon is a little more expensive than when I have found the product in a local store but I keep in mind that it includes "free shipping."I like the idea of buying and using products that I can make fresh that contain no preservatives and other "add-in" chemicals that you find in off the shelf products.

column9: Delicious, nutritious, easy to do with a breadmaker!
column10: My wife and I got a breadmaker for Christmas and were very excited to get some bread mixes to try out.  I'm a health nut, and this seemed like the healthiest mix I could find.  So, just pour in the wet ingredients, then the dry, then hit the "whole wheat" setting on the breadmaker (1.5 pound loaf), and 3:45 later, fresh whole wheat bread!I use this bread every day for my sandwiches. Just slice some in the morning (I store it in a large Ziploc bag), and several hours later I'm eating a super fresh sandwich. Even though the bread is a "honey wheat", I taste no honey in it, and it's definitely NOT sweet. This is a good thing, as I wouldn't want sweet bread to use for sandwiches.The bread keeps very well in a ziploc bag for roughly 10 days. It may not rise as much as some other wheat breads you buy in the store, but it's still adequate for sandwiches and very tasty. I tried the whole grain white bread, and it rose twice as high as the wheat, making it impossible for me to fit into a bag!The only complaint I've had is the way Amazon has played with the price. When I got it the loaves cost roughly one dollar, and now they're close to three dollars. So if you get lucky, it can be very economical to use this instead of buying commercial, processed bread. But if the price stays where it's at, it makes it much more challenging to decide which way you want to go, unfortunately.

The smell of this bread in the bread machine was amazing.  Unfortunately, that's about the only positive thing I have to say about this product.  It did not rise, so what came out of the bread machine was a misshapen clump of doughy stuff that tasted horrible.  I use my bread machine frequently with the Hodgson Mill White bread mix and it turns out great.  This Honey Whole Wheat mix was definitely disappointing.

column9: I added cranberries / raisins to mine ...
column10: This particular Hodgson Mill mix is very different in texture than the white loaf. It makes a more dense bread, that actually slices a lot easier. Since I don't have butter on hand normally, I have been using a vegetable oil, and it tastes nice. I suspect the butter will add an even nicer taste.I like my crust soft, so I not only set the machine on light crust, I lightly spray the crust with "butter flavored" oil after it comes out of the pan so that it remains soft.I added cranberries to one batch, and raisins to another. I then sliced the bread and spread it with my low-cal margarine, then sprinkling it cinnamon and sugar. It was ideal. Since I eat the whole loaf myself, I can't smell it as I wake up each morning, but I can toast it to bring out the freshness.I love this bread a lot better than the Krusteaz I can get at the grocery store, and by ordering it as a subscription through Amazon, it actually comes out very low cost.Healthy bread, Good taste, great price, delivered right to my door. I do love this one a lot!(Just a quick note - if you have trouble with your raisins clumping around the outside of the bread, be sure to "coat" them with flour ahead of time. I didn't have a problem with the cranberries, but my "sticky" raisins required a bit of extra attention.)

I was a little hesitate to buy this bread mix, because I am used to making my bread from scratch.  I could not have done better myself!  This has the perfect blend of ingredients to get a nice perfect loaf of whole wheat bread, without all the hassle of buying, storing, and measuring ingredients.  Everything you need is in the box.  Just add warm water (be sure and heat the water about 30 seconds in the microwave, should be warm to the touch but not so hot it hurts), add 2Tbs. oil or butter, then carefully pour the flour mixture over the water/oil in the breadmaker pan making sure to evenly pour it into all the pan corners and then smooth the top with a spatula, add the yeast they provide on the top, tap the pan several times firmly on a counter or table, and that's it ! Place in breadmaker. Perfect bread everytime !

I've tried many of the Hodgson Mill bread mixes, and this is my least favorite. This mix does not rise the way I'd like a mix like this to rise. At first, I thought maybe I got a bad batch of yeast, so I tried using my own (which I know is good) with the same results. It's almost as dense as a low gluten bread (like the Barley mix), which I was not expecting with this one. Their Caraway Rye mix has the same protein content, but rises much better than this one. I may try it one more time to see if I got a bad batch. To be edited later.

Maybe I'm just use to mixing my own bread in my bread maker, but this one didn't have the taste to please me.  The texture was great and it was super simple to make and it baked up with a perfect mounded top.  My problem was with the taste.  I could taste salt but no honey whatsoever.  As a matter of fact, I couldn't taste a good yeasty sweetness either.  I bought the box I tried at a local store and then when I saw what a deal they were here, I ordered some.  Then I baked it, tasted it and cancelled my order.  Mine is better and when you only have a few ingredients to add, it's not that difficult.  Especially since I buy my yeast in an Amish town where I get a pound of yeast for under $3.  Now THAT'S the deal!

I made this bread and the European Cheese and Herb bread.  I have a new Cuisinart Bread Maker, and the Cheese & Herb bread has always turned out gorgeous and yummy!The Whole Wheat, however, flops!  See the photos.  Every loaf turned out this way......

I AM NOT AN EXPERIENCED COOK. I RECENTLY GOT A BREAD MACHINE AND THE RECIPES WERE CONFUSING TO ME. SO MANY DIFFERENT FLOURS,BAKING POWER,SALT,BAKING SODA,YEAST,ETC....I WAS FRUSTRATED! AFTER SEEING Hodgson Mill Honey Whole Wheat Bread Mix ON AMAZON, I DECIDED TO GIVE IT A TRY. ALL THE INGREDIENTS ARE INCLUDED, EVEN THE YEAST. ALL I NEEDED TO ADD WAS WATER AND BUTTER OR VEG OIL. THE BREAD TURNED OUT GREAT AND VERY EASY TO BAKE. THE PRODUCT IS PERFECT FOR A NOVICE LIKE ME. I WOULD SUGGEST ANYONE, NOVICE OR NOT, TO TRY THIS MIX OUT. I HAVE SINCE PURCHASED EVERY VARIETY OF HODGSON BREAD MIXES AVAILABLE THRU THE "SUBSCRIBE AND SAVE" PROGRAM ON AMAZON. THEY ARE ALL EASY TO MAKE AND ALWAYS TASTE GREAT. AFTER A WHILE I MAY LEARN MORE ABOUT BAKING BREAD FROM SCRATCH, BUT I WILL CONTINUE TO USE THE HODGSON BREAD MIXES TOO.TAKE MY NOVICE ADVICE AND TRY THIS, YOU WILL NOT HAVE ANY REGRETS!
I like this mix and the 9 grain mix from Hodgson Mill.  Both make consistently goof-proof loaves.  The mix is almost $3.00 in stores so getting it with Free Shipping from Amazon is a great deal.
I purchased this bread mix and must say it is the best quality I have found.I will be purchaseing it again.
Excellent product was delivered prompty and in outstanding condition.  Easy to prepare.  Great bread.

column9: Delicious, but I'd appreciate some advice
column10: I bought a used Breadman TR555LC for $20 figuring it was worth trying out. Good decision.Next step was to order this stuff in S&S - good value.The first loaf was tasty but a bit dense. I figured the water needed to be a little warmer and added a pinch of salt for the second loafand it was better. Increased the amount of butter for the third loaf and it' even better.I've upped the S&S delivery frequency on this mix and also ordered the barley bread mix. Fresh hot bread - yummmmm.I'd appreciate some advice from bread machine veterans on what the best water temperature is and anything else that may be helpful.

column9: I am very pleased with the Honey Wheat Bread Mix
column10: The Hodgson Mill Honey Whole Wheat Bread mix produced a nice loaf of bread.  The taste and texture were very good.  In my machine the timing was perfect for the proper browning.  Very nice crust.

I have used about 18 of these mixes over the last year and have had varying results. I have used them all in my panasonic bread machine. One-third did not raise properly though the taste is always consistent and good. When they don't raise they are somewhat crispy but still usable. I just wish I could count on them to always be great so that I could be confident making them just before a meal rather than always half a day ahead.
I've used this mix for many years.  I make bread once a week using this product and adding my own touches. Always turns out great.  My signature dish.  Thanks.

A huge fan of the Hodgson Mill flours/pasta products. I purchased the box mixes for `convenience' when using my bread machine other than at home. After three attempts, I was producing paperweights. Customer Service  made suggestions of adding more water or using different yeast....this did not resolve the issue. The Wholesome White, Herb and Cheddar always bake perfect.

PRODUCT WORKS FLAWLESSLY EVERYTIME...HAS BECOME MY FAVORITE.  USE IN A BREAD MACHINE MY SON BOUGHT ME AND I NEVER THOUGHT I WOULD USE UNTIL I CAME ACROSS THIS PRODUCT...HAVEN'T BOUGHT BREAD IN A STORE OR BAKERY FOR OVER A YEAR AND DON'T PLAN TO AS LONG AS THIS IS AVAILABLE

This is my favorite of all the boxed bread mixes so far. I do set my bread maker to the lightest crust setting, as I prefer a softer crust, but it is great. It barely gets to cool down before my kids have finished off half of the loaf. With some homemade apricot preserves, it is just fantastic. Also, I like the texture too. I find it very easy to cut. I have been experimenting with my from scratch recipes trying to get that texture that is not too squishy and airy.
This bread was pretty good for a box. After following the instructions on the first box I felt the crust was a little too thick/dark. I changed the setting to color: light and it was much better.

I received the product quickly.  I have used two of the boxes of bread mix, neither one turned out the way they should have.. my fault?? I don't know.  Could be... I don't know but still the bread too heavy, and I have baked whole wheat bread before..

I absolutely love this mix.  While marketed as a whole-grain product, it is not entirely a whole-grain product.  However, it is still a great product.  We (me, my husband and my four kids) generally make the bread sticks and then dip in extra virgin olive oil seasoned with oregano, basil, and a pinch of salt.  We occasionally sprinkle with cinnamon and a little brown sugar.Because of its whole-grain content, it does have a slightly heavier and grainier texture which IMO adds to the experience, but initially it may take some getting used to if you are not accustomed to whole-grain products.When I first purchased this product I was set up on a 3 month delivery (12 boxes every three months).  I had to add an order after a month because we had used all 12 boxes.  I am now on a monthly delivery.  The cost is about 2 dollars a box which is a good price.
I purchased the Cheese & Herb and the Potato variety, they rose well and tasted amazing, I used the Black & Decker 1.5 lb machine to make the bread, will purchase these products again!
I'M VERY HAPPY TO HAVE A PLACE TO PURCHASE THIS AND THE 9 GRAIN BREAD AGAIN VERY SIMPLE TO MAKE AND THE ONLY STORE BOUGHT BREAD MAKER BREAD I HAVE LIKED.  THKS  JT

I was afraid to buy this product because of the split on positive and negative results, but I guess I am one of the lucky ones. It came out really well, I have a Hi-rise bread maker if that helps. All you do is add warm water et voila. It sliced really well with a bread knife and it was fluffy on the inside with a harder crust, but not too hard. I also used the "medium crust" on my bread maker just to see how that would turn out. I may try light next time to see how it does. All-in-all very easy, no mess when using the bread maker, and very yummy for toast, sandwiches, and french toast.I gave it 4 stars because eating it just plain like you would with bakery style loaves isn't all that tasty. I need it toasted with butter or something.Then again maybe this isn't the bread to do that with.One last thing-- I wasn't expecting 6 boxes of this stuff when I ordered it, so if you're tight on space you may want to consider that. I thought it was 6 envelopes in one box. Not a negative since we have room, but could be bad if you aren't expecting it.

I love toast in the morning and this is very good with jam or for bacon sandwiches. I use all of their bread mixes and have always had good luck with them. I gave them as gifts this year in baskets and everyone is happy with them.

Baked this at Thanksgiving for a friend who could not have refined white flour.  I used the bread machine to mix it and then followed directions for non-machine and baked it in the oven in a round ceramic bowl.  It came out as a perfect loaf of bread.  Ordering a six pack from amazon for Christmas baking after a special request from my husband who was disappointed when the remainder of the loaf went home with the friend.  Plan on trying some of the suggested additions to make artisan loaves as stand-by Christmas gifts and for the local shelter Christmas dinner. Easiest compliments I've received in a long time..

column9: Gr8 replacement for standard white bread
column10: I am a toast and jam with coffee morning person. White bread has no substance. This has a slightly nutty flavor to it. More substantial and flavorful than white. Makes great french toast. Did not detect the taste or sweet of honey. And if you are going to advertise it on the front of the package it really should be a main ingredient. If a slight addition then omit from front of package. I was hoping for a bit of sweet.

Two or three loaves a week in a thrift store bread-maker for about eight months now. Just great. Every time. I run hot water in the container, hot water for the mix, olive oil, make sure I can not see any water once the mix is added, yeast goes on top in the center. Easy. When done, I cool it in a towel. I eat the top crust right awy as I like it before it gets softer. Great for sandwiches. Have been using the whole wheat setting. Will be trying the Rapid rise setting next just to see what that does. PS I have the bread-maker sitting on some (1/2") dense foam rubber. (Just be sure to keep an eye on it for the first couple times.) Really quiets things down, especially for my downstairs neighbor.

column9: Love this mix and other Hodgson Mill products
column10: I've ordered Honey Whole wheat twice now.  The loaf bread is great but I've been starting to substitute it in other recipes, making some extra tasty delights.Try these pancakes:- 2 cup honey wheat flour- 1 cup white flour- 2 teaspoons baking powder- 1 egg- 1 cup sugar- tablespoon of oil- sprinkle of cinnamon

A friend gave me a box of this to try in my bread machine. It was very easy to make this bread. And not to mention, the bread was so yummy. All you need is a bread machine, water and this box that has the yeast packet in it already!

column9: I don't have good luck with this bread
column10: I make 2-3 loaves of bread a week.  Some members of my family prefer a healthy wheat bread as opposed to the white flour breads so I bought this Honey Whole Wheat mix.  Each time I make this bread, it doesn't raise nice like my other breads do.  I only use the bread machine for the dough mixing and raising part of the prep.  I then remove the dough punch it down and place it in a 9 x 5 bread pan so that I get a nice loaf shape rather than the crazy loaf that bakes in the machine pan.  Anyway, I have made 6 loaves and just can't get this bread to raise as nice as others.
I've tried various bread by this compan & this is my favorite.  You will love it.  Great price.

column9: Great all-in-one mix for the bread-making novice (or expert, it's that good!)
column10: I treated myself to a very high-rated and well-priced Sunbeam bread-maker from Amazon.com, but was a little apprehensive about "starting from scratch" with separate ingredients for various bread recipes. The Hodgson Mill mix produced tasty, chewy and overall delicious whole wheat bread at a very reasonable price per loaf.  Gives me the courage to consider venturing into "original" bread recipes.  Highly recommended!

If you really want to impress someone, have this bread baking when they walk in the door.  It is so easy to load the bread machine with this bread or the 9 grain Hodgson Mill bread.  I'd love to tell you that it stays soft for days but it's never lasted that long at our home. Great for sandwiches or just bread and jelly.

column9: Yummy and Tasty without the Drudgery
column10: WOW ... Hodgson Mill Honey Wheat Bread Mix AND my automatic breadmaker make a yummy, tasty loaf without the drudgery I recall with my Grandmother's homemade breads. The mix box even contains a yeast packet, you only need to add warm water and butter in the order your breadmaker requires and voila, a few hours later you have a hearty loaf of bread waiting for you. The smell of fresh baking bread and warm bread and butter still are my weakness. It's so good I make at least a loaf a week. I waiting for my next Amazon order containing Hodgson Mill White Bread Mix.BACKSTORY: My automatic breadmaker was a yard sale purchase for a whopping $7! The seller "couldn't get the hang of the Mother-in-Law gift" so it wasn't used much. It was like NEW but didn't have the instruction manual. I scoured the internet and couldn't find it's instruction/recipe booklet. I did find many bread recipes, helpful hints and raves about Hodgson Mill Bread Mixes. Of course AMAZON carries Hodgson Mill, and has customer reviews which helped me take the plunge...GLAD I DID!**UPDATE** OMG... made Hodgson Mill White Bread Mix for open face leftover Thanksgiving turkey sandwiches...didn't happen. The inviting smell as it baked had everyone looking at the timer anticipating a hot bread-fest. The BASIC-RAPID setting yielded a tall, hot, yeasty loaf; just like a big dinner roll yearning for a slathering of butter. ALL of which was eaten BEFORE the turkey was out of the oven. I had to make a 2nd loaf for turkey leftovers! My $7 yard sale Panasonic SD-BT55P Automatic Breadmaker has become a family favorite while Hodgson Mill Bread Mixes are my secret for the yum-fests.
I had tough time finding mixes for my older breadmaker, but I ordered this and was not disappointed. Followed the directions, didn't add anything else and it came out delish!

My daughter, who is NO cook, can make a mean loaf of bread with my bread making machine.  We have tried many of the Hodgson Mill flavors and find them all very tasty.  Something about homemade bread makes any meal better.

This bread is so easy, and it tastes great.  I add a little ground flax seed to increase the fiber, and a little crushed rosemary.  All in all, I'm very happy with this product and have decided to subscribe-and-save so I always have it on hand.  Happy baking!

column9: surprising taste of honey - not sweetness
column10: howdy y'all,i ordered this expecting to get a slightly different wheat bread but _not_ expecting anything special. boy was i surprised. [*grin*]this smells lovely while cooking and has a slight but distinct honey flavor. not a SWEET flavor - only the taste of honey, not the sweetness. very nice with lightly flavored sandwiches like chicken.rated a FOUR cuz it's better than i expected.take care,lee

column9: Stays soft and fresh for days!
column10: Unlike most b/m breads that dry out after just a day, this loaf held it's moisture and fresh appeal for 3-4 days after!  Great sandwhich bread!  I am so glad I have 5 more boxes to go through!
We expected Honey Wheat to actually have a taste, but this particular bread came out rather bland. It's not a bad bread, but we'll be looking for something else for next time.

column9: Excellent '1.5' pound loaf - WW RAPID setting on breadmaker
column10: When making the Hodgson's Potato I had used different setting - noticed this Rapid Yeast so set Breadman* [8 yr old machine] to the Whole wheat RAPID - Crust med - Pictures show the baking results and waistline will soon show the 'enjoyment of' this great bread.Did use not butter/margerine - just 2 TBS Canola oil and 2 TBS Pancake syrup as the additional water requirement.  Then added lots of dry Basil at the 'add' cycle beep.  Will be trying Cranberries -

I'm really glad I ordered a six-pack of these bread mixes.  We love the flavor and heartiness of the bread, and the price for six boxes was excellent.  We make this in a 1 1/2 lb. bread maker and every loaf has turned out well.  We look forward to trying more of the bread mix varieties that Hodgson Mill offers.

column9: High Quality Bread, but Could Be a Little Sweeter
column10: The quality of this bread was very good. It made a beautiful loaf, but I thought it needed to be a little sweeter, especially since it was called HONEY Whole Wheat Bread Mix. It must have had a miniscule amount of honey in the mix. The next time I make it, I will add probably at least 1/3 cup of honey to the mix. Overall it was very good.

Hodgson Mills always does such a great job with all their products and this isno exception.  Great taste, great texture, great overall product.  I cancertainly recommend this to any bread maker - machine or manual.
Everything was in the box for the bread machine. There was no problems. I just poured in the bowl and closed the lid and 3 hours later I had a wonderful loaf of bread. It was better than great.
My husband is on the Sugar Busters diet and can eat only whole wheat bread. I have tried all of the available whole wheat bread mixes for a bread machine and this one is the best by far!

A friend alerted me to these six-packs of Hodgson Mill Bread Mixes, which I had been purchasing individually at local supermarkets. The mixes are easy to make, and they've worked well with my Cuisinart bread machine. I've especially liked the wheat bread mix. Usually, I'll bake a loaf two times a week, and I feel like I'm getting bakery-fresh bread at about half the cost.

column9: Hodgson Mill Honey Whole Wheat Bread Mix, 16-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
column10: Great product for bread makers this bread taste great just like a bakery. Easy to follow directions.

I hestitate to buy the bread mixes in the store as I never can count on their loaf integrity. I have no hesitation in putting in a loaf of this in my machine before company comes and counting on it to turn out every time. The smell is divine and I get rave reviews on the taste. Nothing beats homemade!
This mix is easy to use and bakes up well every time.  Its texture is good and holds up to cutting slices thin enough to put into a toaster.
when the directions are followed to a t, the bread comes out perfect and delicious..

column9: Not very Good - Did not Rise - Solid Like a Brick.
column10: I ordered 6 of these at once and the first 4 of them were not good at all.  They smelled good while cooking but did not rise well, did not form a good loaf shape and were too solid after they were finished cooking.  I may have received old or bad yeast, but the date on the box said 06/06/12 so it the yeast should have still been good.  I kept trying thinking the next box would be better. By the time I decided to return what I had left, it was too much trouble to return as Amazon would not allow it.  I will not be buying any more of this brand again.

I have previously used the Hodgson  9-grain, and the White, and those were/are fine.  But the resulting loaf from this mix came out hard, seemingly already stale, and just falls apart when trying to make/eat my sandwich.  Not very tasty at all either.  Easily, I like the White best (so far), and the 9-grain also good, especially being so healthy.  Will NOT buy this Honey Whole Wheat again nor would I recommend it.  But, who knows, maybe I just got a bad batch?  But will not risk buying another...
I thought I was getting low sodium bread and it wasn't.  I made 4 loaves for some friends but haven't used the others because my husband is on a very low sodium diet because of his heart.
I've never found a bread machine mix I didn't like...until now.  It doesn't rise well, the bread is very dense and dry.  We have yet to finish a loaf.

The flavor and texture are fine but the package only makes a one pound loaf.  All my pans are for a 1 1/2 lb loaf.  So I need to buy a new pan but I'd rather you increased the contents.  I will now use 1 1/2 boxes to make a proper sized loaf.

This is a great tasting bread that the whole family likes, but I seem to have trouble getting it to rise enough and turn out with an even top (have made 4 times now).  And yes, I have carefully measured the water and checked the water temp. and otherwise followed the directions on the box.  I am using a Breadman Pro machine.  I think I will proof the yeast next time to see if it is still good (order arrived in September).  We are at 4,000 feet elevation so that could be affecting how the bread rises, yet I have had no problem using other recipes (no tweaking necessary) with this bread machine.  So for now, I give it only 3 stars as I am not sure what is causing my bread to turn out with an uneven top and a little flat.  I will try butter next time instead of oil as one other reviewer said that helped it rise a little higher.25 January 2010:  I did use butter instead of oil in the recipe (thanks other reviewer!) and that seemed to do the trick in getting the loaf to rise.  I do find that it bakes up consistently better in the oven than in the bread machine.  Yum!
This bread mix wasn't bad but we thought it lacked flavor and was a little too dry. Nothing special.

I loved this bread WHEN it was a reasonable, economical buy, $9.60 for a carton of six 1 LB boxes.Without any notice of a price change coming or explanation of why the price was being raised to such an extreme, the exact same product is now a whopping $16.01!!! Retail prices on whole wheat flour have gone up, that's no secret. But not almost double... In my book, this price hike is way over the line of reason and that ate 4 of the 5 possible rating Stars. Terrific bread, outrageously priced.

We want you to know that we are very pleased with the quality of service your company provides. We sincerely appreciate your responsiveness and the way you conduct business. We have recommended your company to others because of our satisfaction with your service. We look forward to doing business with you for years to come.
I tried 3 times this bread mix, it dosen't rise and taste not so good.

My Boston Terrier absolutely loves this. In fact, now he doesn't want to eat his dry food anymore unless we mix it with this. It claims that it is a complete diet, but haven't quite decided to stop the kibble yet as I want the dog to have to chew some food too. He used to wolf/gobble down his kibble as if starving, but since mixing the Grandma lucy's in with his food at night, he just sniffs at his breakfast, and sometimes walks away leading me to believe he is not hungry. I feed him less than the recommended amount since I am mixing it with the dry food. Maybe this will help him loose some of the extra weight he packs on as a sedentary housedog? I actually buy this at my local pet store, but was planning to order it online when first learning about it from a friend. Overall I would recommend this product.

I love all the Grandma Lucy's products and my dogs do too! My lab has urinary problems and bladder stones, and I have been mixing this food with Cranimals, and doubling the amount of water than what it says on the bag. Both my dogs have been on this food for a few months and she hasn't had any problems, better yet my other dog stopped having accidents on the floor. Grandma Lucy's dog food is the best out there. It is freeze dried to lock in nutrition versus dehydrated. Plus this 4lbs bag makes over 17lbs of dog food!

I bought this from Whole Foods along with the Caramel flavor and neither of them had much flavor at all. They both tasted like very watered down sugar water and took a quarter of the bottle in a single cup of coffee to taste it and even then it was faint. While I appreciate that it is organic, the flavor just isn't there. I will definitely be trying something different.

i found this product through a google search. i wanted an 1.organic 2.white tea 3.extract and i think this is the only one i found.i had some questions about the product so i wrote the manufacturer, generation tea, and i was impressed that they replied promptly and solved my questions.once i received it i was happy that it comes in a glass bottle with a GLASS DROPPER.i have to say that the flavor in this tea is not strong, as if almost has no flavor. i have to take into consideration that white tea has a very mellow flavor. hopefully that is the reason for the mild flavor. and not that it doesn't have enough white tea extract.the ingredients are few:distilled water, organic grain alcohol 20%, organic white tea. nothing else. NO sugar.it is important to note that it has alcohol.i couldn't find in generation tea website information about this tea levels of polyphenols and egcg.also, they don't include information if this tea doesn't have fluoride, herbicides, pesticides, heavy metals. but assuming that it is organic i take that it doesn't have those elements.the way i drink it is adding the tea extract to room temperature water so i can have an immediate drink, and not a hot drink.the reason i titled this review not sure yet and i only gave the product 4 stars is due to the lack of information to my above comments. if i find out the answers to those questions i will add them to this review.
We put this in everything!! It gives an extra kick to everything from sandwiches to egg salad to . . .
Hard to find a better mustard. Great anywhere especially for dipping. Been enjoying it for years. Try it, you wont be sorry.
Recieved the order twice but got the Gluten free style.Hate the taste and want the regular old Nances Mustard we grew up loving.

I grew up on Nance's mustard, but haven't found it locally in many years, so once again, Amazon saves the day.  It's thin enough to pour out of the bottle, but is still very creamy, and sharp, just like it says.  Add a bit of this to deviled eggs, and your family will rave.  Drop a touch into mac 'n cheese, and they'll wonder what your secret ingredient is.  Spread out some Ritz crackers, lay a little square of Swiss cheese on each one, then top it off with a tiny dollop of this, and your crew will polish off the whole box.  Good stuff!

I was first introduced to Nance's by my husband. He's a native of western NY. We use to receive shipments from the in-laws once a year, or we'd purchase a case when visiting NY and have it shipped home. For a while a local grocery chain carried it, but no longer. We were extremely pleased to find it on Amazon! I use this mustard in all my recipes that call for mustard. Makes delicious deviled eggs and great for brushing on chicken you are grilling.

I have tried alot of GF brownie mixes and this mix is my first pick. Betty Crocker is my 2nd and it is a really good to. King Arthur cookie mix is very good to. King Arthur's browny wasn't gridy. It came out chewy and soft, not dried out and I also added choc. chips to it. I follow the directions on the box. It tasted close to wheat browny that I have missed. I found this at Meijers. I hope I can buy it on Amazon soon and at a good price.

column9: Yay - takes just like regular brownies
column10: I've tried this and one other recipe (Betty Crocker) and this is MUCH better and tastes just like real brownies.  They are even better the next day.  I love love love these!  Keep it on stock for when you crave brownies :)

If I didn't know these were gluten free, I would have thought they were the best gluten containing brownies I've ever had. In fact, hands down these are the best I've ever had. Moist, extra chocolatey, and so tasty! They do take much longer than the package says to cook through (keep testing, because they do not carry-over cook!). Also I line my 8" x 8" pan with parchment to help get them out of the pan and cut them. So tasty! Also, to be fair, I can get them for 6.99 each at Whole Foods, so this isn't really any cheaper, but that's OK!

As-is, this is the most perfect brownie mix in existence for gluten free brownies. If I'm adding chips, I go with Namaste foods. But as-is, King Arthur Flour is, frankly, better than a normal brownie in every way. BTW they are less nutritious and more fattening than normal brownies because of all the starch, but awesome. I bake them using butter. Once I cut them into squares I take all the uneaten ones (if any) and freeze them. They are perfect reheated in the microwave, with ice cream or frosting or with brandied fruit, whatever. A must, if you want your brownies!

I have just done on a wheat free diet and was missing some of the stander snacks.  well these brownies were so good that my grandson didn't know the different.  Now I can offer food that the grand kids will eat.  Thanks!!!!!

I loved these brownies.  They came out soft and chewy and sweet and not at all gritty.  My mom who is clueless on gluten-free products tried it and said it was good if that was all you could have.  I guess it doesn't stack up to normal brownies for her but since that IS all we can have, it works for me!!

Hands-down the best gluten-free brownie mix I've tried.  As good as "regular" brownie mixes!  I wouldn't hesitate to serve this to friends/family.  Though I've got to say, they're usually not around long enough to do so.  In fact, I have to fight my husband for them.Thanks, King Arthur!  These brownies really hit the spot when I'm having a chocolate craving (which happens regularly)!  :-)

column9: Good Mix and Good Price for Gluten Free
column10: I have made these before and this is a better price than buying them directly from King Arthur. I add a little more cocoa powder and chocolate chips to make them really decadent. My husband says this has made Celiac's Disease much less depressing -- good sweets are hard to find!

I just want to say that these are by far hands down the BEST cake mixes that I have found that are Gluten Free. My family has Cealic disease and we love our sweets, I have tried several diffrent types and others are very heavy, these cakes acutually rise up and are fluffy. Hard to find in our local stores, so for thanksgiving I made a difftrent brand. Needless to say, my 9yr old daughter said to me "Mommy, this isn't a King Arthur cake is it"? Thats saying alot from a kid! The Amazon price is very reasonable in comparision to me driving to town and searching for them. They shipped promptly as well.

column9: can't tell they are gluten free
column10: Had these at a friend's house tonight, and I like them better than regular glutenful box brownies. I baked gluten, egg and dairy free for several years mostly from scratch, and these rival anything that I've tasted aside from a flourless chocolate cake. They are very chewy and chocolatey without being sickly sweet. Worth trying.

My son is completely gluten free, I am not, we both thought these were fantastic!  I even froze the rest of them and I have been eating them a little bit at a time.  The only drawback is that it was difficult cut them because they stuck to the knife.  This made the edges rough, not a big deal to us, but might be irritating if you were trying to serve them at a party.  Overall this a fabulous mix that I will buy again.

column9: No one needs to know they're GF!
column10: These brownies are by far the best I've tried. They rise well, and are rich and moist. The first time I made them, I froze several to make them last and they tasted great even straight out of the freezer. I made them for the second time yesterday, and added chopped walnuts. Delicious! The only problem is slight difficulty in determining appropriate cooking time, as this last batch ended up a little underdone in the center even when the edges got crusty. Well, there is one other problem: my secret fear now is that I will stop thinking of brownies as a "forbidden" food and accidentally eat the gluten version at a party someday!

This brownie mix is expensive and I like the ones that I make at home better. (though they take a lot more work!)I liked how I could just go to the store and buy a gluten free brownie mix for once, it saves a lot of time. They had a very rich chocolate taste, so I would advise that you cut the brownies small so that the taste isn't too overpowering. I'm not saying these brownies are bad or (though that might be what it sounds like from my very first sentence of this review.) that you shouldn't buy the mix and make them, I'm just saying that homemade is always better, though not too many of us have the time these days to make everything homemade. (especially us who must eat gluten free) Anyway, back to my review. They also have a nice texture which was not what I expected, and they rose very high. I didn't use the pan size they said to use, but I will next time. (the brownies didn't get cooked in the middle, but they got cooked on the sides, so I had to keep cooking them and the sides got hard.) Overall, this gf brownie mix is good, though you may need to boxes if you play to share them with your family! :)

These Gluten free brownies are very good! They are best when they come right out of the oven... warm & fudgie!I add chunks of 75% mint chocolate and it is wonderful! Only downfall is they are very crumbly when left out.
Another delicious Rishi tea. The vanilla mint doesn't overpower the chai, so it the tea has a nice balance to it. I appreciate the package of three tins--I can go through this tea pretty quickly!
I love this product! Our cat loves the stuff and meows for it. Just an FYI out there - check the prices. I found buying 3 2-packs to be cheaper than the 6-pack price...Buy this and enjoy!

NEW! 6- PACK Kitty Kaviar (6 oz)  My sister-in-law gave me a can of Kitty Kaviar for my cats when she came to visit one time.  Two years later I am still buying it as 2 of my 3 cats appear to be addicted to it.  They have a set time when they get it and believe me, they let me know when it is time.  One of them literally yaks at me and runs ahead of me down the hallway watching to make sure I am following.  I make sure I have plenty of cans and when I go away, the people who feed my cats are also instructed to make sure the cats have their Kitty Kaviar.  A little bit goes a long way.  It's all natural with no additives and preservatives, does not need to be refrigerated and apparently has a great taste according to my cats' reaction to it.  Can't be without it.

My cat would not eat any other treats on the market until someone introduced me to this. He can't seem to get enough of it, and will just about open the can by himself. He knows where it is, and jumps on the counter in anticipation of his next serving!! My husband will leave the empty bowl out, just so "Kitty" can't get one past me and trick me into a 2nd helping!! Definitely a must have if you want to spoil your cat even more.This is also a great value, as compared to local retail outlets.

column9: Cats Never Go Along With The Crowd
column10: Well, I have not personally tried Kitty Kaviar, but I recently got the 2-can special as I was ordering something else and wanted to avoid shipping costs by having my final costs go over what ever the top was then.  I have eight cats - several of them love anything fish - none of them are especially fussy.  And with eight cats, even if X number do not like Y product, some cat[s] will eat all or most of it.  Not in the Kitty Kaviar case.  Not a single cat was moved by the scent of Kitty Kaviar.  I left some sprinkled on a large plate; the KK was nibbled at, then ignored until I tossed out what was left [most]. Have continued to offer it, no takers.

My cats love this stuff, but last week I found Bonita flakes in a 3.52 oz. bag and a 16 oz bag for $4.57 and $25.99 respectively while shopping at a Global Foods market.  This is exactly the same stuff as in the cans but a whole lot cheaper.
Our cats love their bonito shavings and so do some of our neighbors.  I personally haven't tried it yet, but I'm sure it's good.
My cat loves these! I keep them in the fridge, she knows they're there and will meow for them until I break down and give her more. She absolutely goes crazy for these!

column9: Good stuff but way too expensive!
column10: The product itself deserves 5 stars as all 3 of my cats go crazy and sometimes even fight for it. However, Kitty Kaviar or "Bonito Flakes" as the Japanese call them are used in actual cooking and if you look it up under this name on Amazon, there are sellers who are selling it for a fraction of the price listed here. You can also find this at your local Korean/Japanese grocer in big bags that last months.
My cat simply loves this product. He just can not get enough of it. It is a great treat for a fussy eater.

column9: Best treat ever says my cats!!!
column10: After only one tasting of this treat, my cats decided that they liked Kitty Kaviar better than anything else that they had ever sampled. I have to store it in the freezer or they are trying to get to it no matter where I set it down!I was told by the store that all they do is shake the can to get the store cat to come to get into her crate for the night!

My two feminine feline are totally addicted to Kitty Kaviar and expect it every morning on their kibble (Royal Canin).  NOW, my local feed store is OUT - for two weeks!!! The Maine Coon is driving me crazy, badgering me about her Kitty Kaviar!  What a relief to see that I can find it here - I've been treating my babies with if for several years, from the days when I had five cats to my current twosome, and never did one refuse it. Amazing to read that some do.
Our girls LOVE this stuff.  We keep it in a cabinet with a sliding door, when ever the girls hear this door slide open they immediately wake up and assemble in front of the cabinet.
As far as cat treats go "Kitty Kaviar" is the only cat treat that will have your cat acting like a dog.  My cats actually beg for it.
Our cats love this stuff (anything to keep them quiet) had to re-order a 6 pack for the "little dears"

I have a total of 7 cats, 4 of whom are neighborhood strays that I feed. All of them love this product and look forward to getting some when I open the can. Blackie jumps up on the counter and pushes his nose inside the can, he just loves this !!!!!
My outside cats love this. And sometimes it is hard to find, so please keep it on your shelves.
I love this stuff - so do the cats.  Just a little sprinkle on their catfood really gets them in the mood to eat.I definitely would buy from these people again.  Great service and response.

column9: Your cat will kill for this
column10: Kitty Kaviar is a treat your feline will truely enjoy. It doesn't have a fishy smell but cats will kill for this stuff. I actually had to buy it by the case for him. I can't imagine an animal that would not love Kitty Kaviar. I've tried other shaved bonita tuna flakes and my cat CAN tell the difference. Go with the good stuff.
I gave this to my brother's cat for Christmas. She LOVES this stuff! Apparently, dogs love it too. It was under the Christmas tree, and his dog got into it and finished off the can.

column9: my six pound Siamese loves this
column10: this is the best treat ever and it is hard to find in pet stores.  My tiny kitty who is fairly picky gets this every evening, and if I forget she reminds me with her mighty Siamese voice.  I am delighted to find I can buy it online.

Our cat LOVES this.... and the price is the cheapest and the time to ship was fast and I recommend this to all.  The cheapist I have found it in stores is $7.99 a can.....  this averages at $4. and some change with the shipping... great deal

My cats just love this product.  I've been buying it for a couple of years now and it's the only treat they've not grown tired of.  I have one cat who needs to watch his weight and this is one treat I don't have to worry aboutJUST GREAT!!!
My furpeople thank you for your prompt delivery of their treats.  Everything arrived on time and in excellent order.  Keep up the good work.  Many thanks.  Barrie Smith
My cats love this treat. Doen't take much to appease them, just a small taste.
The only treats that all my cats have "gone bananas" for.  Excellent seller and FAST delivery!

My cats love Kitty Kaviar.  It is their favorite treat.  One of my cats has a very sensitive tummy and other cat treats make him sick.  This product does not.  While I can't say the smell does much for my human nose, the cats come running as soon as I open the can!  Yum!  Dried flaky fish!
My cats REALLY enjoy Kitty Kaviar sprinkled on the wet food! It is hard to find at the pet stores. This was a really good price. Very satisfied with puchase and service.
I love the bigger can.  My cats are addicted to it REALLY bad! And I mean ADDICTED!  It's a great cat treat!

column4: Desert Gypsy "A Brooklyn Girl Out West"
column10: I first tried this wonderful little cheese about four years ago when I lived in a town that should have been named some fancified version of Foodie Heaven. Nowadays, in my little town of five hundred, this little hunk of dairy nirvana is a little harder to find. Imagine my surprise when on a whim I did a search for this cheese today and it popped up immediately!If you've had and liked ricotta cheese or fresh mozzerella it's very likely you will LOVE this cheese. The flavor of this Greek sheep's milk cheese is delicate and light, similar to the aforementioned Italian offerings. It slices in slightly brittle but firm rounds and goes beautifully with plain crackers and crusty breads.According to my former cheese monger, sheep's milk cheese is much easier to digest because the fat molecules are smaller than in cow's milk. For some reason as I've hit my early forties, this matters, digestively speaking. I feel much better eating less dairy overall but sheep and goat dairy products work very well for me.If you can source this locally and save the exorbitant shipping, consider yourself having won the cheese lottery.

I saw my neighbor lady for the first time, today in months (she's a recluse)...she had lost a LOT of weight!  I asked how? She said drinking this Grape Vinegar.We just got home from eating dinner out, and she sent her helper over, to have me taste it!I LOVE it!I can drink this!I can hardly drink  Apple Cider Vinegar, that I know is good for you...but....this goes down easy!Enjoyable!I got right online to Amazon, and ordered 3 cases!
