column9: Best Cookies I have ever had
column10: If you love espresso, but don't always have time to make a cup, then try these cookies.  I love these cookies.  They taste just like drinking a cup of espresso.  You get 2 hard cookies per individual package.  I love all 4 flavors as I am sure you will.
The only improvement you could make -- is to make these cookies with zero calories because I can't stop eating them. These are the crunchiest and best tasting cookies I have ever tasted. More please!
These cookies are by far my favorite!  Nice and crispy (not crunchy), plus a hint of white chocolate & espresso makes for amazing texture and flavor.  Would definitely recommend these to anyone!!

These cookies are amazing and very addicting.  I love the smoothe white chocolate chips with the espresso taste.  Definately a great buy for a very versatile cookie.  I would HIGHLY reccommend these cookies to anyone!  With the holidays coming, I will be ordering these for gifts for teachers, coworkers, and family members.  What a great gift idea.  I have also used these cookies and incorporated them into wonderful desserts for potlucks and they have been a huge success.
Very stale beans.  Looks like it has been stilling at the where house for a long time. Will not buy again.  Dissatisfied.

column9: I sold my soul to El Diablo!
column10: ***Edited to add:*** I ordered this when it was sold out, so it was pretty fresh when it finally came to me after a week presumably right after they reordered it--I didn't check the roast date, but it got nice and foamy on top while brewing in the French press. Ordering when Amazon is out of stock is probably the key to guaranteeing you get fresh-ish beans. Requires patience, but if you don't live somewhere you can run out and buy a bag and don't feel like paying crazy shipping fees from the Intelligentsia site, what you gonna do?This coffee has a vivid, complex, dark flavor, yet it's incredibly smooth with no bitterness if you brew it properly. I'm not usually a black coffee girl, but I can drink this one straight up.Since Intelligentsia's description says El Diablo Roast offers a look at some of the coffees available each season, I'd imagine different "vintages" would have a slightly different flavor.Check out the brew guides on Intelligentsia's website. The French press guide will yield you a pretty strong cup if you follow the proportions (which go by grams of coffee to grams of water). But that's just how I like it!Finally, if you're going to drop this much cash on coffee, be sure to buy the whole bean and grind it yourself. I hope Amazon gets more in soon!

I love most of the flavors of this soup, but this is my favorite.  I usually add lots of things to it to make it a hearty vegetarian meal.  I like to throw broccoli florets into the water before I add the noodles, and then add a fried egg and some marinated tofu cubes.  I could live off this meal for months!  I am bummed it's not available at Amazon right now.  I cannot find these in my area at all!
Very good soup. Nice alternative to Ramen noodles. And they are made with Rice noodles.  Nice for those of us who can't eat wheat.

column9: Nice change from fried ramen noodles
column10: These are sold at my local Ingles supermarket. I have tried a variety of flavors and have found most of them to be pleasing. I do find them to be overpriced at the grocery store at around $1.50 a pack. Amazon's price is WAY overpriced.

This stuff tastes totally awesome; I would give it five stars for taste alone.  The price, however leaves much to be desired.  At my local Costco, they sell a 44 oz. tub of this for only $6.95.  Not only do you pay drastically less, but you also get an additional 8 ounces of delicious pub mix as well.I highly recommend this item, but do what I do and get it from Costco.  For a company that calls itself 'Top Notch Bargains', I think their prices are a notch or two above that of Whole Foods.

This item is normally delicious...However, the item was shipped out of date by World Trade..It was stale and oily...I returned both Pub Mix Tubs to Amazon...Amazon's return policy and easy axcess is awesome...I ordered it directly from the company itself later that week (UTZ)...Inquired about the dates on the items and was told (by UTZ)that date is the best sale by date...This date was a month old when rec'd...Not Amazon's fault but, the third party who had it in stock...All dates should be checked before it's sent out to consumers...Good business and common sense...Amazon, you still rock...Not your fault...Thank you
My local stores don't sell this and the local mass merchant only has them when they buy in bulk....Amazon always has these factory fresh and you can't beat the UTZ.... always good foods

OH my gosh....this is the best pizza sauce ever! I bought it on a whim at the store and fell in LOVE! I went from never making homemade pizza, to making it at least twice a month. This sauce is so easy and so, so good. It is flavorful but not too strong. There aren't too many onions in it and just enough spices. It's much better than I can make on my own!My favorite pizza is just a simple dough, a light coating of this sauce, and some fresh grated (preferably locally made, but ALWAYS premium) mozzarella. It doesn't need anything else for me. One tip, coat the edge of the crust with premium olive oil like Zoe, it really makes a difference!

I ordered this product on June 27, 2012 and received it June 29. The best by date stickered on the package is "030712". Assuming traditional month-day-year dating, that's almost four months past. Even if it's day-month-year dating, it's still close. I would not have even questioned the age of the product if the sticker wasn't there, but why add a 'best by' sticker if it's not needed...and why send it out if it's out of it's freshness period? Because I'm not the one consuming the product, I can't say if the product is bad or not, but I did notice that so far only ONE out of three of the treats I've used actually fits in the Romp n Chomp bone that I bought it for. This totally defeats the purpose of challenging the dog and giving him a treat that takes time to consume when I leave. Instead he grabs the refill treat and wolfs it down. Disappointing since he otherwise likes the bone. I'd hoped to be able to use it as intended with a treat insert once in awhile.

I just received these refills and opened the box to find that they are stale. I've purchased these in the past from a pet store and they've always been firm, but still chewy. The ones I received from this order are dry and most have cracked into pieces. They are not out of date and the packaging was intact (as far as I could tell), but they are definitely unusable. I gave this 2 stars because my experiences with this product when purchased at the pet store have been okay.
nuts and mix was not normal texture.  Everything was soft and chewySunflower seeds and almonds and all nuts should not be this way.

The picture is very misleading there are just a few apricots.  Although this was okay be forewarned the nuts are not very crunchy and there are very few apricots (maybe 4 in the first package).  Not worth the money.

I have four cats and they all seem to like this food.  It was the only one in a dry form that I could find that didn't have fish in it.  It is also good for their diet, the chicken and brown rice is easy on the stomach.

My older cat was totally spoiled by her previous owner, who fed her Friskies dry/wet food all the time (which contributed to her teeth getting rotten). I was able to switch her to Purina One Smartblend (a much healthier dry food) but was looking to add something with less fillers and more high-quality ingredients. We adopted a kitten who was eating Science Diet dry food at the shelter and I decided to switch her over to California Natural as well (SD has a lot of fillers in it despite being "Vet recommended"). CN was recommended at 3 different pet food stores by the employees, who feed it to their own cats (I also scored a few sample bags to test on my girls, which they took to without any problems).Both of my cats love this food and haven't had any adverse reactions. Their coats are still thick and shiny and their litter boxes are easier to clean as their poop is more compressed. The kibble itself is somewhat dense, but the crunchiness helps clean their teeth, which is a bonus. I mix CN with the Purina One and it's been a great combination thus far.As for LCM's review, if the company switch bothers you then fine, choose another brand. I was unaware of any change as the ingredients list is exactly the same as it was last year. If something does change, I'll edit this review, but for now, we're all satisfied.

My cats both have food allergies and they were throwing up even Purina Naturals.  After one of them developed diabetes, a moderator of a Yahoo group for feline diabetes steered me towards this.  We have had virtually no dietary problems, the occasional oops but not like before.  They also seem to have less feces, which is a sign of a good diet.  We have purchased 3 (15lb) bags since being informed of the P&G buyout, I have not noticed any differences but it may be hard to tell until the stock made by the previous manufacturer is exhausted.  In the meantime, I plan on sticking with this food.  I would like to try the Sweet Potato but don't want to buy such a high cost food and then find out they don't like it.

This is what we found after Science Diet discontinued their lamb and rice formula.  One of our cats is allergic to fish and corn, so we settled on this because we couldn't find anything else without those two ingredients.  Well, lucky us.  It's the best cat food we've ever used.  All of our cats like it.  Our cat allergic friends have fewer problems with our cats than any others.  We rarely see hairballs anymore.  The cats are prettier and fluffier than ever.  Great food.  Hope it never changes.

Our cat loves this food and after years of tummy problems, we've finally narrowed it down to corn or wheat allergy.  This "pure and simple" cat food is wonderful!  Thank you so much for a great product!

If you have a cat that has not been doing well, stomach wise, try California Natural.  Ingredients are simple - chicken and rice.  No corn, no soy, no yeast no anything that your cat could be allergic to.  I had gotten a kitten and his stomach was not happy for almost one year.  After numerous testing, different medications over the course of 8 months, my vet finally said maybe it was his food - I even went to a different vet for a second opinion. Second vet also said it could be his food.  So, I started looking at ingredients in different dry cat foods and looked at California Natural - minimal ingredients so less for the cat to get sick on.  Turns out this food worked for my fur baby and he's now 7 years old and doing great.

column9: Great for all cats, even sensitive stomachs
column10: I have 2 beautiful wonderful kitties, but one has a sensitive stomach. It was a nightmare finding the right food but im so happy it is this one, not something with filler and something with better quality food, my pets health/life is more important than a higher priced cat food. She used to have problems but since switching to this food, no problems with the litter box and no hair balls, been months now and we finally have her healthy, along with her brother who was very small and grew a lot with this nourishment! I would highly suggest this brand for a more natural food for your pet! It is the only thing my little girl can tolerate besides human baby food chicken flavor, but together i know they both get the nutrients they need and they dont gorge on it ever resulting in a happier life for all of us with no intestinal upset!

this smells soooo fantastic. since this is tobacco free, i mixed it with a shisha i already had; wonderful mix. update 10/2011: i have purchased this again and again, it is friggin awesome mixed with cherry or strawberry shisha.

I had been using Amazing Grass Chocolate Greens Superfood for quite some time now.  I wanted to give this brand a try since it was on sale this week at my supplement store.  I bought it on a whim and am very glad I did!!  Once purchased, I mixed some in my water bottle and drank it down before I started the car.  Instantly I felt perkier which was great because it was 4pm in the late afternoon and my daughter was wanting to go swimming.  Been taking it now for three days and I'd like to add that I'm even more regular?? TMI, but good information for those who care.  I feel better on Amazon Chocolate than I did on Beachbody's Shakeology!!!  Will purchase again!!!

Since it very expensive I tried some other things to supplements with. The taste of this products doesn't offend me at all, but I'm not crazy about the slight stevia flavor. I don't find it to be all that chocolaty either. I like to put a small amount of water and mix this with a frother to blend it really well and give it some bubbles. I then add a bit more water cuz if you use the frother with the water too close to the top it will spray out everywhere. No fun. I love it this way, it makes it seem almost creamy.

column9: Natural wheat bran, high fiber cereal
column10: I don't usually go out of my way to write reviews for anything other than music, but I will for this cereal. It is a very underrated cereal that I believe can help pave the way for a better diet. I eat it everyday at different times and not only do I always feel satisfied that I chose a healthy alternative, but the taste is INCREDIBLE! One of my favorite tasting cereals hands down. Sometimes I even just eat a handful dry if I'm in the mood for a dry food. Not only is it a good source of fiber (10g, or 40% d.n.) but it's also packed with essential vitamins. With only 80 calories per 1/2 cup, I say yes to All-Bran every time!(Hahaha sounds like an ad, but it's so true)
I have this for breakfast everyday with raspberries on top. It is delicious. I always look forward to eating it.

Excellent price on this cereal with subscribe and save.  I eat it every day, usually mixed with a little muesli or other cereal.  It's a great source of fiber.  The boxes arrived in perfect condition and the expiration date was over 10 months from the date of delivery.

My husband likes All-Bran as a cereal, and I really like All-Bran muffins.  I feel as though they are much more healthful than an ordinary muffin, they taste very good, and are easy to make.  I don't feel guilty when I have one with my tea!

All-Bran has been part of my breakfast for quite a number of years, and it's the only cereal I use these days. Of all the cereals commonly available at grocery stores, this one has one of the highest amounts of fiber and the least sugar. Yes, there are some that claim a higher fiber content but they are also loaded with sugar. All-Bran tastes OK the way it is, but let me share what I do to make it taste exceptional.First I add some skim milk to my cereal, and then a teaspoonful or two of sliced unsalted roasted almonds (I buy mine at Trader Joe's - good stuff and the best price you can find anywhere) and about the same amount of Plum Amazins (you can use any bite size pitted prunes). So we've just added more fiber, potassium, iron and all kinds of naturally good stuff to our cereal - and tons of taste. I then place my cereal bowl in the microwave for 20-30 seconds, and out comes an incredibly healthy, tasty and satisfying breakfast. Try it!
I was very pleased with my purchase.  I had seen this product on the shelves in the grocery stores but the price at Amazon was much lower.
The product is great, I got it in a pack of 5, which lower the price to the best you can find.

The All Bran Cereal from Amazon's subscribe and save is a real bargain.  Five boxes delivered every two months is just right for two adults and is much cheaper than the local stores.  The cereal keeps us both well supplied with fibre.  Its taste great with fruit (berries or peaches).  I add a little stevea and some skim milk and I have a health, low calorie breakfast or snack.

My husband has to eat All Bran every morning and every evening for health reasons, and I was delighted to find it at such a reasonable price and for free "Prime" shipping. I will definitely be ordering again.

It actually does taste really good. Moreover, after exercizing, I ate about a handfull (dry) without water. Filled me up immediately, which is the important thing for me is that the fiber functions as it is supposed to. Kashi's cereals didn't cut it for me in that respect, as much as I love the idea of the protein / fiber combo that they've got out at the moment.One person posted a lot about HCFC in this product, which is a concern for me too, but here's my perspective as someone who stays away from HCFC 99% of the time when I have a choice.Just to point out, there's 10 grams of fiber per serving and 6 grams of sugar. That means there's only 4 grams net carbs per serving. A single serving can (12oz) of regular Coca-Cola has 39 grams of sugar. (And even that overload is 'only' 13% of one's daily carb intake, technically.) A serving of this cereal has 80 calories and only 4 grams of net carbs, plus when I just bought a box in my local store I didn't see HCFC on the label. (I looked for that specifically.)So it is possible that Kellog's has changed the formulation on this food. I laud your principled eating, OGO et al, but for those who can't afford (or are ignorant of) alternatives to this product, it is a favorable choice above Raisin Bran, for example, or another favorite among people I know, Fiber Plus "Antioxidants" which has twice as much sugar and the same amount of fiber. All nutrition choices are individual, and peoples' needs and desires vary.At the same time, I wholly agree that HCFC is a horrible, horrible substance. When choosing things to eat, I want to know if it's included, just the same as I want to know if Aspartame is in my drink. However, my choice to consume this product is that of an informed consumer. I opt to purchase this product (5 boxes for less than $20 is the dealbreaker for me, a huge savings compared to other similar cereals such as Kashi or my personal favorite, F-Factor Skinnys (not available on Amazon at the moment, about which I am sad!)

I used to buy this cereal in the supermarket, but Amazon's price convinced me to start buying it through them.  You would think that coyotes would be more interested in eating bran -- they're not.  I was almost eaten by coyotes, and I am not made of bran.

I love almond milk and I always buy the unsweetend variety.  I've tried almond dream twice and both my husband and I dislike it.  We couldn't even finish the carton and I had to call the company to complain about the product so I could get my money back! It taste like they simply added almond flavor (like what you bake with) to water and then are selling it as almond milk!  I recomend you buy almond breeze or Pacific organic almond milk which both taste amazing!

My go-to almond milk for smoothies (because I prefer a commercial product to what I make) is Blue Diamond Unsweetened Vanilla. However, the half-gallon Almond Dream Unsweetened was on sale at a price I couldn't say "no" to, so I bought one despite the fact that it seemed to have more ingredients ("gellan gum?!") and calories (not a problem) than Blue Diamond. What, I reasoned, could I lose?Bad move.I noticed while pouring that Almond Dream Unsweetened seemed to have somewhat more body than Blue Diamond (which has the consistency of cow's milk) but I didn't think too much about it--who, after all, doesn't like a thick smoothie? Unfortunately, my morning smoothie, usually delicious and with all other ingredients the same, tasted like chemicals. CHEMICALS. And chalk. It was impossible to pull all the flavors together and while it wasn't undrinkable, it was by no means enjoyable. An EXTREMELY disappointing purchase.The manufacturer has been successfully marketing their Rice Dream amazake-like frozen desserts (they have some slammin' non-dairy/no-sugar-added novelties) for many years but, unfortunately, "rice smarts" are no assurance of similar results with nuts. Perhaps their chocolate, sweetened almond milk is better but I'm disinclined to find out because I will NEVER buy Almond Dream almond milk again. It's back to Blue Diamond for me.

It's low sodium, low calories, no tapioca starch (like all the other brands that make you bloated), & is very healthy. I usually sweeten with no cal "stevia" or other people i know use splenda. And it's delicious! Thank you!

I am very picky when it comes to coffee and certain beans that I choose to use to make it.These beans were suggested by a friend to me, and I did not expect much when I bought them,but they are very good quality, and have an excellent taste.  Nothing bitter to them, veryfresh tasting and soothing.  Great purchase, and a great price for a great product.

I actually bought this product at a local Smart and Final supermarket in my area (namely, Los Angeles and specifically in the Lincoln Heights community) and I'll be honest, it's not too bad for instant cappuccino. Now, I'm not a coffee snob or a coffee connoisseur but I have worked in coffee retail for 4 years previously (Seattle's Best Coffee at a local Borders Bookstore back in the days when Borders was still around [now defunct and its trademark and intellectual rights sold to Barnes and Noble]). Given that, I know a little something about coffee relative to the average coffee drinker.To clear out some misconceptions though, the only difference between a cappuccino, espresso, and a cup of coffee is the amount of water used and how finely or coarsely grounded the beans are. Otherwise, it's all just "coffee." Caffe D'Vita's cappuccino is more like "coffee" with a very heavy creamer and artificially-sweetened French Vanilla taste. No additional sweetener required. The French Vanilla taste is rather addicting, in my opinion. It makes you want to drink more of it at a time but the caffeine content is low so I wouldn't recommend it as your daily morning caffeinated drink.I use about 6 tablespoonfuls of it in a mug of roughly 10 ounces. Any less seems to give it a watery, milky taste that doesn't even taste like coffee. The bitterness is more pronounced with less tablespoons. Otherwise, it's not bad but not great for instant cappuccino. If you want something with more caffeine, I'd suggest looking at other instant cappuccino mixes than buying this one. I hope this was helpful.

Been drinking this beverage every am ,for about the last 5 yrs. Its decaffinated and I happen to like that fact, plus it has a light, creamy taste to it and not bitter. column9: First time I've actually enjoyed Flaxseed meal.
column10: Tried Flaxseeds in all different forms. I will say I do like the dry roasted ones but there so small they got annoying to eat.  I don't mind the taste of regular grounded flax seed but a little too much on and it's over powering in taste.  This combination with berries makes to me the perfect tasting food.  Bought them last night, opened up the bag cause I was anxious and the aroma was great and very fresh smelling.  So I had two spoonfuls straight up before bed.  Makes a decent semi-sweet treat cause of the berry taste.  Drank a lot of water to wash it down, which I shall warn anyone new to flaxseeds, drink lots of water (to avoid dehydration or too much going to the bathroom), unless it's the dry roasted kind.  Had a good nights sleep. Woke up feeling good and my morning dump was effortless (thank the fiber content).Now for the best part.  Had a spoonful or two in the morning as well as put some on my oatmeal. I have had this energy and focus all day. Got my work done earlier than normal due to focus.  My body is kind of craving more.  Bottom line, the tastes mix with berries makes this easier to eat straight up with no loss of benefits. It's only been a day or two, but after many bouts of trying flax before, I feel like I found the right combo and can finally enjoy the benefits that come with eating them.

This is the first time I have tried Flaxseed. People told me it did not taste good, but this product is very tasty. I love the mixed berries in it. I put it on my cereal every morning and it adds to the taste. I will be getting more of this product from this seller.

flax seed is super great for the body especially when you are training for a sport...it is a nice inflammatory and keeps your system cleansed daily:) 2 tablespoons for me in oatmeal or yogurt or even eating it plain works out just great! i highly recommend trying this out!!! i have been using this exact product for 3 years and it still makes me feel great...I usually alternate with this product and chia seeds both have similar effects but I like to switch it up for maximum benefits

The past few years since having my one and only child, I could not get rid of the nasty "H" ("hemi!") that just wasn't fun having. Since eating this daily, it's GONE. I've changed nothing else in my diet or daily routine so I attribute this to the Spectrum Ground Premium Flaxseed with Mixed Berries. I keep it sealed tightly in my refrigerator and it stays very fresh. Don't let the idea of taking flax seed be an unpleasant issue. It tastes great on cereal or, as I mentioned, in yogurt. column9: Tart, Deep, Flavorful Tea with Hibiscus Flowers
column10: ****Tazo's Passion Herbal Infusion is a somewhat tart, deep, flavorful (hibiscus-y tasting) tea. It is not berry-like in taste, although it is red in color. It's difficult to describe what hibiscus tastes like, but I find it a most pleasant taste. My husband says it tastes like pomegranate to him. Although Passion contains licorice root it is not sweet.The ingredients in Passion are: hibiscus flowers, natural tropical flavors, citric acid, orange peel, licorice root, cinnamon bark, rose hips, lemongrass and red poppy. It is caffeine-free!Tazo is an interesting company that makes only super premium teas. They are socially responsible, based in Portland, and have the motto, "The Reincarnation of Tea". Tazo is owned by Starbucks. Their web site is fun and quirky, with a Zen-type focus, definitely worth checking out. It is unclear, though, from their web site, how many of their ingredients are organic or kosher, and they do use some "natural flavors" in their teas--this wording seems a little vague for a super premium tea.On the paper tea packet, Tazo writes, "A tantalizing deep red tea made from hibiscus flowers, exotic herbs and natural tropical flavors." On their web site, Tazo describes the flavor profile of Passion as "berry, juicy, wine-like, merlot, sweet, earthy, dense". Tazo describes the aroma as "sweet, juicy, red fruits".I would rate this tea, and Tazo in general, as very good---better than premium teas like Stash or Celestial Seasonings---but not as good as other teas such as Numi, which is why Tazo Passion gets only four stars.****

Researchers in Taiwan have found that an extract of hibiscus flower contains some of the same health-giving compounds as red wine and tea. Many folk medicine traditions use the hibiscus flower to treat high blood pressure and liver problems." ~Susan Aldridge, PhD, medical journalistThe day after happening upon the idea of blending brewed and cooled Passion Herbal Infusion with orange juice, I found the lovely Tazo Iced Tea Collection. They have a recipe for Passion Lemonade and a Passion Tea Smoothie. I'm happy to blend orange juice, a packet of stevia and cooled brewed Passion tea. The taste is surprisingly good.Ingredients: Hibiscus flowers, natural tropical flavors, citric acid, orange peel, licorice root, cinnamon bark, rose hips. Lemongrass and red poppy.The deep purple/red color and hibiscus fragrance is enough to make anyone passionate about tea. Yet, is this really tea? It looks like tea, but it is really an herbal infusion made by steeping hibiscus flowers, orange peel, licorice, cinnamon, rose hips, lemongrass and red poppy in a swirling of hot water.The flavor is slightly reminiscent of hot apple cider or hot cranberry juice. This tea leaves a tingle on your tongue and I think it goes very well with a spoonful of honey.I do think you need two tea bags for each experience, so as to fully intoxicate the senses and experience the magic of the ingredients.Caffeine Free. Since the scent of orange reduces anxiety and hibiscus blossoms are said to lower blood pressure, this tea is a wonderful calming blend.NOTE: Many of my health/herb books say hibiscus flowers are not recommended during pregnancy. Please consult with your doctor before drinking herbal teas.~The Rebecca Review

column9: Pure vanilla powder made of maltodextrin
column10: I deducted one star for the "pure vanilla powder" name, and another for not being as aromatic as pure vanilla, so 3 stars.  I read the description above and thought I scrutinized the wording well enough to detect any misdirection, so unfortunately I didn't get to the ingredients list.  I have some Rodelle vanilla pods and the fragrance is amazing.  Compared to any vanilla essence I've ever tried, it's like the difference between freshly roasted coffee beans and folgers.  So I thought this "pure vanilla powder" would be the closest thing ([...] bucks for a little jar!), and easier to use than vanilla pods.  Well it turns out it's a jar of essentially corn syrup solids laced with vanilla extract.It's hard to avoid maltodextrin in pre-processed foods from the supermarket, but I'd rather not have it in my homemade foods too.  It's a good thing that there's a powder version on the market, because it has its own kind of convenience, but it doesn't seem to me any more fragrant than regular extract,  and unlike other reviewers' experience it seem like I do have to use more than liquid extract (also it cakes up terribly). Might be worth $3.50+shipping for the added convenience of the powder, but otherwise it's a pretty pedestrian product.  Win some, learn some...

I should have read the reviewers' comments before making this purchase.  When the label states "Pure Vanilla Powder", to me that means just that.  Nope.  As you will see after your purchase when you look at the jar, it has 2 ingredients.  The first is Maltodextrin, and the second is Vanilla Bean Extractives.  It tastes very good but you have to use a fair amount since it's been cut rather severely.  The manufactures of this product should be honest and indicate that Maltodextrin is the primary ingredient.

I used to get years ago and loved them. I hadn't seen them for at least ten years.I love the rasberry/blackberry flavors and the crunchy candy coating. The five poundbag lets me make small packets to share. So fun for parties!

column9: If it looks like a fruit and tastes like a candy is it healthy?
column10: I bought this as a gift for my sister who likes this candy.Although this version of the candy isn't as good as the ones found in local stores it's definitely on par.One thing though is that the black ones taste semi-bitter. Which I don't remember in the originals. It's more of an acquired taste. Also, there are some comments about the balls surrounding the jelly being too sweet. They are indeed very sweet but I like that since I only eat a few at a time instead of gorging myself on candy.One thing I would say, is that 5 pounds is a lot. Great price for content but you have to put it in a zip lock to preserve the freshness and even then... phew. Try going through five pounds of this stuff. Hope you have a family of 12!I read reviews and pretty much got what I was expecting. If you want exactly what you buy locally this probably wont do it for you.
I am German and was thrilled to find these on Amazon. My husband, who is actually American, loves the Haribo berries! And they are absoulutely fresh and the best value anywhere!!

column9: My favorite candy of all time...
column10: I fell in love with this candy way back in 1988 or so when I was a small kid and was given a small pack of these from a grocery store and thought they were the greatest thing ever.They have a very unique texture on the outside with the tiny crunchy coating and the gummy and chewy inside, and the black raspberry and red raspberry flavors are both different and great.Be warned though- make sure Haribo is the manufacturer of these. Jelly Belly and a few others also make similar shapped and colored candies but they are nothing like these. The imitators are basically cheap sprinkle covered gummy bears- avoid them!
The candy is awesome and very addictive.  The Online candy store has been terrific!  Very helpful and quick when I discovered a delivery issue.
These candies have proved very welcome around here - especially the berries.  I've often wondered where the best gummies come from and now I know.

Wow...I found these at T. J. Maxx a few months ago.  They are like biting right into fresh raspberries.  I have seen them before, but I always thought that they were black and red licorice.  NOT!  They are delicious and you will not be disappointed.  Great price.  Better than Walmart!!!

I am so glad to have found these on amazon! They are delicious!! Only one thing--they are so rich & delicious that you almost can't stop---don't make yourself sick on them! They are pretty hard to find so this made me very happy. Thanks for such a fine product.

These are wonderful candies and I just love them.  They can be hard to find and therefore I often find I have to order them from the internet.  They are so good, though, that is why I do go to great lenghts to find.

Great raspberry flavor! We used these at our wedding and guests were fighting over the left overs to take home.They are dangerously tasty, I have to hide them so I don't eat the whole bag.My husband is a raspberry addict and he doesn't like a lot of candy, but he loved these.To my taste buds, the red ones taste better than the black because of the knobley coating on the outside. Good thing is that there are always a lot more red than black in each bag. I have ordered 5 bags in total and they have all been like that.
The gummy raspberries were very fresh.  They were great, just as I expected.  I need to order more.

column9: Candy was hard and had no flavor.
column10: Loked forward in getting these and was disappointed when I got them.  Can't return because I opened the package. If you want the real raspberry & blackberry candies, get the Jelly Bellies, these are the true flavored ones.

column9: Good, but not as good as...
column10: These Haribo Raspberries are good but not as good as theHaribo regular gummies.  These have a very good raspberryflavor but I don't care for the tiny sugar-ballcoating on them; it makes them way too sweet and givesa kind of funky feeling when you're chewing them, toocrunchy for a gummi.  I had to try them as I like mostall the other Haribo candies, but I won't buy these again.

took about 9 days to come. they were in great shape in the bag. dont like that they rope you into buying two bags to get the free shipping. making your purchace $28 for two bags. they are soft and chewey. and dont stick to your teeth. they are the Real Rasberry candies you remember!! I used them for valentines favors in cute little celephane baggies, they looked very cute. im very happy with the purchace, however the sour cherries were a dissapointment.
I am not a big candy eater with this one exception.  This stuff is deadly addicting, maybe not for everyone, but I have trouble staying away from it.  Great great great.

I bought these to make into favors for a friends bridal shower. They were a total hit! Everyone loved them, and they looked amazing. We put some in tiny clear plastic bags, covered it with black tulle and tied it with a red ribbon...it made a great favor and table decor. They taste so good and were really unique. We had a hard time not eatin them while making the favors. This is a great deal because these are expensive to buy in smaller quantities.

column9: Ever tried to eat five pounds of candy?
column10: So. . . .I work at a place where I spend a lot of time online.  Because I live in a college town and I'm at that tender age where it's obvious that college was a catastrophic failure for me, but I've not yet found the "real" job that will keep me busy until it's time to put me in the ground, I work with a lot of friends that found themselves in the same situation.I was surfing around and found these Haribo Raspberries listed.  I remembered getting these in a little pack that looked like it was from a farmer's market as a kid -- a little waxed cardboard basket with these vacuum packed in the middle. When I recieved it, I couldn't believe the amount of candy I purchased for the reasonable price. Very yummy.

I hadn't seen these candies in years. They used to be our special treat at Christmas the ones I purchased on Amazon were just like I remembered them and my daughter's couldn't believe they still make them. Great product!!!!!!!!!!!

i didn't like this product at all and ended up tossing it. the soft inner part of the candy tasted really good but the hard, beady outer part was a headache. i ended up having to peel/scrape all the outer beady thingies off the candies just to get to the soft, jelly/gummy part of the candy. in the end it was just not worth the effort so i took it as a loss and threw it all away. since every person is an individual and has their own tastes, if you want to give it a try go for it. as for me and my opinion, i didn't like these candies at all as long as those outer beady thingies were on them. by-the-way, the beady thingies had no raspberry fruity taste to them, only the inner gummy part had flavor. the beady parts just had a sweet, flavorless taste.

When I was a kid,my mother use to make plum jelly from the wild plum bushes that grew in fields just of of Texas highways.This tastes exactly like it.Took me a long time to find this taste again and as long as I can get this,I will be buying more..

column9: The lentils make a GREAT base for quick, nutricious, and inexpensive homemade meals!
column10: I have been buying these lentils at my local grocery store for a long while now, but was delighted to find them on Amazon for so much less, no taxes and free to my door delivery!Now, why lentils, and why these particular lentils?1) Lentils are high in protein, vit B1, iron, and fiber!2) Lentils are low in fat, and are also low on the glycemic index!3) Lentils are a great base for many dishes: within 20 minutes you can have a tasty homemade dinner. Here is my favourite (start the clock): put on some basmati rice. In a separate pot, steam a large chopped onion for a few minutes. Add one can of lentils (always with the liquid!). Add dried garlic bits, chili powder, ginger powder, curry powder, all to taste. Stew for a few minutes. Add garam masala (a spice that can be purchased in most grocery stores) and cook for another few minutes. Serve over the basmati rice. There! Stop the clock! This should not have taken more then 20 minutes. Makes two servings (unless you are very hungry). This can be also prepared using oil (you'd fry the onion, instead of steaming it). The taste of the dish can be manipulated by using other spices (turmeric, cumin, etc.) and adding other vegetables (peas, tomatoes, cauliflower, etc.). You can also try adding some sliced almonds and a few raisins. You can prepare this a day ahead and take to work with you for an inexpensive, but tasty and healthy work lunch! The cost of the meal, including rice and the entire can of lentils, comes to less then four dollars (or thereabout).4) These lentils are organic, vegetarian, and kosher, for those who are interested.PS: Do not be put off by the "funny" look of the lentil liquid once you have opened the can. It is supposed to look like this. DO NOT drain the lentils!Enjoy!

I wanted to try a new recipe for a soup that called for canned lentils. I searched every grocery store in my area but could not find it, so I ordered...  The soup turned out GREAT!  The canned lentils are not mushy and are so easy to add to the soup.

These lentils are an amazing staple in my kitchen!  I love lentils for vegetarian meals, though I've made a few spectacular non-vegetarian meals with them as well, including one with diced carrot and celery, turkey bacon, and thyme, sauteed together, then combined with the lentils and a little chicken or veg stock. They are possibly good enough to be eaten straight from the can, but I have yet to be in that much of a hurry.  They're an amazing convenience, and really healthy, so that makes me happy.  I love lentils spicy, savory, in soups and stews, in salads, as side dishes, I've even made a sauce with lentils.  I used to occasionally buy these vacuum-sealed refrigerated lentils from Trader Joe's and they were great, but a little dry and also perishable.  These cans are the perfect solution, especially via subscribe and save, with which I can have a case in my pantry for both planned and impromptu meals.  Good flavor, good value, and they're organic!

Having tried several brands of canned lentils I found that Westbrai Natural Organic Lentils are the best. They are uniform in color and texture, have a clean natural taste and do not clog together like some I have tried. I will definitely be ordering more of these.Bravo Westbrai.
I use these lentils in everything! My kids like them in their pasta sauce (hubby & I do too). Great way to sneak in a nutritionally packed veggie!

column9: Excellent coffee, price is too high
column10: This is my favorite coffee - strong, delicious and bold. However, the price here is way too high, you can buy it much cheaper elsewhere. I usually buy it at Costco - 80 cups for $33.

I love a bold, strong coffee without a bitter taste, and this has proven to be my favorite. Strong and flavorful, even the decaf version is excellent. My second favorites are Green Mountain's French Roast and Timothy's espresso blend, if that's any help. If you like strong coffee, definitely give this a try!

This is, in my opinion, the best of the K-cup coffee choices, and we have tried them all !  I hope that they do not change the beans, the roasting or the amount of the coffee in the Tully's French roast K-cups...it approaches the best freshly ground brews.

We've tried so many K cups, and we keep coming back to Tully's French Roast. It is great both black and with cream, and the flavor is always strong but never bitter. Sometimes I want even more of a bite than this offers, so then I'll reach for Timothy's Magic Mountain. But on the whole, if we could only buy one type of K cup for our Keurig, it would be this one.

column9: My Favorite Coffee - Strong, Bold, and Delicious!
column10: I tried just about every kind of K-cup, looking for my perfect coffee. After trying, Tullys French Roast, I just started enjoying it and stopped looking. I wanted coffee that was dark, rich, bold, and enjoyable. This did it for me. I recommend it.EDITED to say that Tully's Kona coffee is great as well. Which is my favorite now? I'm not sure. Both are delicious!EDITED once more months later to say that my favorites are now:1) Italian2) French3) House4) Kona if I want something with a very strong taste.
If you truly like a bold "coffee" flavor, and not all the hybrids like mixing in vanilla or nuts, then this is for you. We love it.

I love Tully's French roast and Italian Roast coffee...If you want a nice full bodied taste and bold....Tully's is one of the best I have had...My brother loves it so much I send him some often since he is on Cape Cod and has no access to buying Tully's...We love to have it after our dinner as well as a good wake-me-up in the morning...I strongly suggest this coffee for true coffee lovers...

This is, as advertised, extra bold in taste. Maybe a bit too bold in fact.I don't really like bland coffee. I prefer a bolder taste, and this product delivers. In fact, as the French version has it, it may be a bit too "tres intense." There is some harshness to the taste, as my palate experiences this.Still, I'd rather too bold rather than too bland. . . .

This is my all time favorite.  As other reviews have said, good strong flavor, but not bitter.  No cream necessary!  My only complaint is the price.  I first started ordering this about three years ago.  The price then was about $22.  It then jumped to $29, then back down to $26.  Now, six months later it's $31.  Thanks to the other reviews, I ordered from Costco for about 10 cents per cup cheaper.
I got a cup of this in a variety pack of K-cups.  I'm glad I only got one cup of it, because I ended up pouring it out.  It was awful - tasted like charcoal.

column9: Tastes bitter and burnt, my least favorite K coffee.
column10: I got some of these in a variety pack, and I think I will end up throwing them away. To me they taste bitter and burnt.

I've drunk hundreds of cups of Tully's french roast.  It's the only coffee I have bought in a year.  I purchased 3 twin packs in my most recent order.  The coffee is TERRIBLE!  It tastes old, like it's been sitting for hours after brewing.  Not sure what Tully's did differently but now I'm stuck with 6 boxes of undrinkable k-cups because Amazon doesn't take returns on food.  Ugh!!  The "sell by" date on my boxes is March 2012.
The title says it all.  This brew is rich and just strong enough to get you going without causing your tongue to curl.

column9: The Best Keurig K-Cup Coffee I've Found So Far
column10: Tully's French Roast K-Cups make the best coffee I've so far tasted from a Keurig Coffee Maker.  There are many good coffees out there, but to my taste the French Roast has the kick I need.  Because of an attenuated sense of taste (autoimmune problems) I need coffee that has more than the average kick so that I can actually taste the coffee, and Tully's does the job.  My wife, who possesses normal, or beyond a normal sense of taste, agrees with me that this is excellent coffee.  No, it's not for those who like a mild tasting coffee, but unlike a comment I read in another review, it doesn't taste at all like an ashtray smells....not at all!  This is seriously good coffee, and if you like strong tasting coffee, give this a try.  I doubt that you'll be disappointed.*****UPDATE***** It's been about 2 years since I started using Tully"s French Roast K-Cups, and I thought I might add to my original comments.  Having tried at least 3 other brands of French Roast coffee, from San Francisco Bay, to Starbucks, and one other brand, the name of which escapes me at the moment, and I can say that Tully's makes the best of the four.  San Francisco Bay is a close number 2, but Tully's beats it out.  It is hard for me to believe that Starbucks would come in number 3 in a taste test, but it did.  If you like French Roast, by all means try the others if you like to experiment, but if not, take my recommendation and go with Tully's French Roast.  You won't go wrong.  It is a perfect cup of coffee every time!
A dark french roast you can savor every morning,and not a trace of bitterness. Wakes you up and wows your senses with hearty aroma and taste!!

column9: Strong and Bold, But Still Certainly Bitter
column10: While the French Roast tastes nice with cream and sugar (as does almost any coffee,) the Tully's brand of French Roast served black is almost flavorless aside from its bitter aftertaste. Nearly every K-Cup tastes good served with cream and sugar; French Roast tastes poor when served black. I suggest another flavor.
This coffee has a pleasant taste, not bitter, not weak. This isn't a very special coffee, but definitely worth drinking.

column9: Just OK: Strong Coffee, Bitter Aftertaste
column10: I prefer strong coffee with a smooth taste.  Tully's French Roast is strong but has a bitter aftertaste that only goes away if you use half-and-half (the bad coffee transformer).  It's just bad for your cholesterol and waistline if you use it every day, just to finish the batch of coffee I bought.My favorite was Coffee People Organic K-Cups but it's no longer available.  The second best is Coffee People Donut Shop K-Cups, but they're more expensive then Tully's French Roast (at Costco).

The Breakfast & House blends are not as bold but have a wonderful flavor as well. I have not tried the Tully's labeled "Kona" coffee, but I am sure it is great as well. I highly recommend this coffee. (VLS)

By far this French Roast has made me turn my nose up at any other coffee ! The smooth bold taste makes you feel like you are in a cute cafe enjoying a fresh brewed pot! I don't know if i can drink anything else! It just makes your morning K-cup of coffee special!
Well, better than Starbuck's K-cups.  And at a much better price.  The Tully's French Roast is by far the tastiest of the K-Cup French roasts.

Tully's French Dark Roast K-Cup coffee is the best we have found anywhere.  It has a bold flavor that is not bitter and is consistent cup over cup.  If you like strong bold coffee this is the one for you.  We've tried all the others and now buy Tully's French exclusively for our bold coffee.
This is our favorite (mine and my husbands) k-cup! its a nice strong smooth roast which can be hard to find in the k-cups, another pretty good one is the jetfuel but his one tops them all!
Great coffee, not too strong for by morning cup and still a great afternoon cup. I have added this blend to my favorites !

I had almost given up on my Keurig when I stumbled upon this one in the variety pack that came with the machine. Finally, something that tasted like REAL coffee! Bold, rich, balanced, delicious. If you like bold coffee this is a must try. I was pretty disappointed in the other K-cups I sampled. They all seemed somewhat watery and lacking in any texture or body. Tully's French Roast is the first I've tried that approximates a freshly ground cup of strong coffee. It's smoky and intense and overall very satisfying. Love it!

I have had my Keurig coffee maker for over 2 years, in fact I replaced my original on its two year anniversary due to our water's mineral content but that is another story.  Over the past two years I have tried many of the different coffees.  My initial favorite was Donut Shop which tasted very much like Dunkin Donuts coffee.  I was diagnosed with high cholesterol in early 2011 so I started drinking my coffee black and I found the Donut shop K cups to be very bland.  I started trying a number of different K Cups and found Tully's French Roast.  This is now my favorite coffee, it is very dark and has an intense rich set of flavors.  I am not a professional taster so I won't try and describe the different flavors but suffice it to say it has a rich depth of flavors that I look forward to each morning.  It reminds me of a good red wine like a Cabernet, where there are a number of different subtle flavors that linger in your mouth long after you swallow.  I enjoy it, I hope you do as well.Paul SpeeseRegular Coffee Drinker

Another reviewer said it had an almost bitter, fishy taste to it and that's the best description I could come up with also.  I expect some bitterness because of the type of coffee I like but the fishy, past it's prime taste was unexpected.  It wasn't the coffee maker because my daughter chose another flavor and it was spot on.  As I said in another review for this coffee...the sell by date was 15 more days out so maybe it was past its prime.

column9: Good for those who like a nice, strong cup of coffee
column10: It took almost a year, but after trying many different kinds of Kcup brands, my husband has finally found one strong enough for his tastes. For those of you who like strong coffee and have had a hard time getting it right with your Keurig, try this.

column9: Great Brew, just what a French Roast Should be.
column10: Tully's French Roast is described by the maker as being intense and powerful with a bitter end. Traditionally a French Roast should be light smokey-burnt and maybe a little sweet with light to medium body with intense flavor. Tully's French Roast fulfills the above description very well.
