I'm going to get Tully's from now on.  This k-cup tastes like a finely brewed French Roast with the full thickness and spectrum of texture and flavor.
It is a good price for great tasting coffee.  What more can I say than that, if you have a Keurig coffee maker this is a good deal for good coffee.
Great coffee.  I love a strong flavorful coffee, and this fills the bill. I drink my coffee black, so the coffee must have taste and body--this does.

Had some problems with this batch of K cups.  Seal seemed to be loose on some of cups and caused grounds in the coffee and overflow of water from pot.  Have never experienced this problem with any other K cups.
We just love this coffee it has the best taste of all the k-cups we have tried.  It's a little pricey so we only buy it once in a while.
I love free shipping thru Prime. The item came the next day as advertised. If you've ever used a Keurig then you know these are must haves.

column9: Best French Roast I have had.
column10: I drink only French Roast coffees...I found this brand K-cup to 'fill the bill' for my desire for a great cup of strong coffee in the morning.  If anyone knows of other coffees as good or better let me know...

Tully's french roast is a great bold cup of coffee with a slight bitter undertone. Bitter, used here by me, is meant in a good way, sort of the bitter undertone of semi-sweet chocolate instead of the light sweet tones of milk chocolate. It's a smooth but robust cup of coffee, a terrific way to kick start the morning.

A handful of my pods were faulty and when I put them in my coffee machine, the water ended up spouting out through the top seal of the pod and consequently out through the edge of my keurig machine. For how much these cost, I find this unacceptable. I would say 4 of my 24 pods were like this.
In my opinion, this is the best K-cup coffee out there.  I prefer rich, bold coffee and this particular brand and style has everything that I desire in a cup of coffee.
This coffee is really quite wonderful. We like a bold flavor without the overbearing taste that some have. This is perfect for every morning.

Well balanced flavor.  My husband likes strong expresso type of coffe and I don't like too strong coffee so I had to buy two different kinds of flavor before, but now we can compromise each other with this.

column9: Among the three best coffees for the Keurig brewer line
column10: This is one of the very best strong coffees available for the Keurig brewers.  It picks up up, slams you down, then picks you up yet again!...but does not bite you! It's even available now in our local supermarket!  However much cheaper to buy here on Amazon!  This one gets three thumbs up and ten toes!  It IS that good!

I have recently started drinking the medium and dark bold roasts (after being a long time flavored coffee lover) and absolutely LOVE this cup! Tully's Kona and French Roast blend are dee-lish! Reminds me a bit of the GM Dark Magic roast, but this one is a bit smoother!
These k-cups are just wonderful.  They are strong and very tasty coffee. I would definitely recommend this coffee to anyone who likes strong coffee.

This is our favorite K-cup for Cuisinart brewer, the Italian Roast coming in a close second.Excellent, robust coffee - the best of everything we have tried (our brewer came with a great selection of high-end coffees).One thing, though, it only tastes great to us on the 6 oz brew size, otherwise, it and all other coffees are diluted.

I purchased my Keurig coffee maker a few months ago and have been trying different brands of coffee. I love the Tully Coffee Cups and will continue to purchase them. The flavor and aroma are most pleasing and price per cup is fair. I am hoping Amazon.com will consider free ship on this product as I am hesitent to buy anything online when shipping is so high.Thank you!

I bought the Kuerig coffee brewer a year ago. My wife loves the variety pack. For me, however, there is only one coffee. Tully's French Roast is perfect roast. I can get it other places, but Amazon's just drops it at my front door. How great is that?!?
Great coffee at a good price. Tully's French Roast is one of my favorite K-Cups.
The Tully's French Roast is a full bodied cup of coffee and it stands up to making a second cup from the same pod.The price was right as well.Gnosses

For the last few years, I've ground my own Starbucks French Roast in my coffee maker.  When the coffee maker broke, I ordered the Breville K-Cup coffee maker (a great productBreville BKC700XL Gourmet K-Cup Single-Serve Coffeemaker With Coffee Cups And Perfect Pod Holster).  To my dismay, Starbucks doesn't offer k-cups.  I order the filter baskets, and attempted the make your own cups.  Just didn't taste up to par.Online, I noticed folks were comparing Tully's with Starbucks, so I ordered them.  Wow, am I sold.  Tully's is fabulous.  Starbucks lost a customer and Tully's gained one.  The taste of this coffee is superb.  Bold, strong and flavorful.  I am so glad I ordered the 2-pack.  I'll be back for more!
This coffee is the best!  Especially the K-cup, no mess, great taste, good price!
We've had our Keurig for 4 months, and as far as my wife's recommendations, the Tully's French Roast K-cups are her favorite--bold flavor, good taste!

column9: This is my most favorite K-Cup
column10: I've tried many different brands and types of coffee K-Cups, but this one is my most favorite, hands down.  Great flavor, strong but not too strong, low acidity and the aroma is just amazing.  For me, this is THE BEST K-Cup on the market.  I drink it in the morning, and afternoon and just love it.
Tully's French roast coffee (caf & de-caf) are my favorite! Buying the K-cups through Amazon is cheaper since you can get the free shipping...and I'm happy.

I have a Keurig B60 and have used it with a variety of coffee 'k cups' for several months now.  I was a little disappointed in the Tully French Roast.Now let me quantify that I  I tend to like my coffee "light and sweet".  I also find French Roasts to typically be among my least favorite types of coffee.I do sometimes opt for a bold cup of java.  However, I find the Tully French Roast to be more bitter than bold.  I've tired different cup size setting on the Keurig, but the Tully French Roast keeps resulting in a bitter cup of coffee.  It really had a burnt taste to it.I went so far as to run the same k cup through the Keurig twice to see if the Tully coffee was simply too bold for my taste.  I realize k cups are not intended for re-use but I was trying to figure out if the coffee was just too bold for my taste or really just bitter.SEE TIP AT BOTTOM OF REVIEW.While the second cup of coffee was on the weak side, it was still drinkable....however, just like the first, it was bitter.Where the Keurig is concerned I have found the best bold cups to be the Newman's Own Organic "Extra Bold" and the Emeril's "Big Easy Bold".Again, while not a huge fan of French Roast, I liked the Timothy's World "French Roast"; that brand is what you would expect, a nice cup of bold coffee.  The Tully's - just bitter.TIP:  While you probably don't want to reuse k cups as a regular practice, it does not hurt the machine, so if you like your coffee mild or want to cut down on costs, here is what you do.  Brew a cup of coffee using the k cup of your choice.  Then, go through the brewing process again: simply leave the used k cup in and lift and reclose the handle when the unit displayed 'Ready To Brew'.  This is best done with the small cup setting, otherwise your coffee will not be mild, but just plain weak.

I've seen this same product elsewhere at the much lower price of $48.00 for 108 K-Cups!  The pricing here is completely unreasonable as it's almost the same price for less than half the number of units.

If you are a smoker, this coffee is for you.  It tastes EXACTLY like an ashtray smells.  I love strong coffee though, but no ashtray taste.  My favorite is Starbucks Espresso Roast or Verona, I have found the Newman's Own Extra Bold to be the best replacement for that available in the k cups.

column9: Coffee Is OK - Amazons Price Is Poor
column10: Amazon has increased all Kcup prices by 21% for some reason. It was $23 and now jumped to 27.90 for some reason. All brands were increased the same so it wasn't the manufacturer. You can still get them for $.53 a cup at coffeeforless.com. Amazon is no longer the cheapest.

column9: Hill Science Diet Dry Puppy Food
column10: Have fed our Siberian Husky this food since she was old enough to eat solid food and she still eats it just fine and is in beautiful condition.

We have a 8 month old LabraDoodle and he loves this food. Prior to trying this food we tried several other brands, a few times Raja ate the food but threw up a little later. Even on the Science Diet brands we tried other variations like "Lamb Rice" formula and he did not like that at all. He would rather stay hungry than eat other food. There is something about this "original" formula.One note: make sure you keep the food in a sealed box, in cool dry place, as per instructions.
These beef sticks are the most salty ones I've ever tried.  I can stand salty but I can barely finish 1 stick due to it's heavy salty taste.

This sadly under-appreciated classic of the Croatian processed meat industry offers a taste of thickly saturated porkiness which will make you palates salivate until you finish off the entire content from the trade-mark orange tin can. You might feel guilty afterwards, you might feel like a pig, but this paté will make any  risk worthy of your exotic gourmet taste buds...same product packaged in tubes looses the impact of the original (canned) Gavrilovic pate.

There used to be a small tea store near my house which was absolutely amazing. After they went out of business, I tried to find similar teas online. I tried Adagio's dewey cherry, mango melange, hazelnut rooibos, apricot rooibos, and chocolate chai.The dewey cherry is pretty good.  It has a nice blend of sweet and tangy flavors.  This one is worth your while.  The others were disappointments.When I opened the mango melange, I felt like I'd been hit in the face by someone spraying perfume samples at a department store.  The effect was a little better once the tea was brewed. I plan to drink it all before I go looking for my next tea, but the next one won't be from adagio.Their flavored rooibos teas had the same problem -- the hazelnut and apricot extracts were so overpowering and cloying I couldn't taste the rooibus. In their chocolate chai, you can't taste the chocolate, the ginger, or the tea; it's just a wall of cinnamon extract. I may actually throw out the chai without finishing it.So the dewey cherry is pretty good, and the other herbals are drinkable, but stay away from adagio if you care at all about the complexity of flavor in your tea.

Adagio herbal teas are some of the highest quality and best tasting products in existence.  The Sour Apple is probably the one that is least like its name but is tasty nonetheless.  Pina Colada, Berry Blast, Blood Orange, Dewey Cherry, Mango Melange and Berry Blues all live up to their names and are simply delicious.

column9: again. mis sorted into Gluten Free and it is NOT
column10: Hubby loves oreos and pop tarts, so I know these are a hit.. but they are NOT gluten free and they are showing up in the GF search. Someone needs to pay better attention to this search designation or things are going to go badly for someone trusting your categories..

...since buying a whole case of Pop tarts.  My kids love these.  I just have to hide the surplus and dole them out occasionally or they would finish them in a week :)  The prices are good on these sometimes.

I'm not a fan of pop-tarts in general, but they're an awesome energy packed snack. It's 400 easily digested calories in a convenient foil pack (if you eat both). I take a pack with me on mountain bike outings and I ride 1-2 hours on average and typically eat one once I get close to 1 hour in, to ensure I have some energy, and another at 1:45 or 2 hours to maybe allow a 3rd hour (which my ass typically gets too sore to continue beyond).This flavor is awesome and the does a good job surviving inside my pack. It really does kind of taste like a big Oreo. This is one of the 3 flavors I can stand, the others being frosted brown sugar and cinnamon and Smores. I like my pop tarts cold or at room temp, but not hot from the toaster and these are no exception. This flavor is definitely the more edible kind of pop tar and a shame to be considered used for tiling your roof with.Recommended! I'm going to try dunking it into cold milk next time.

column9: Bulk purchase but expiration date is within 2 months!
column10: The product itself is good but I bought it in bulk and it expires only two months from my purchase date!  I won't buy from this seller again!

column9: Fresh, fast & a good value, but....
column10: This is the second coffee I have tried from Coffee Bean direct, and my experience has been similar with the 2.  It is fresh and aromatic, arrived quickly and is a good value, but not as good as coffee I have gotten from other roasters.Celebes kalossi is one of my favorites beans; generally a bright full bodied cofee which is not acidic.  The beans I got from coffee bean direct were fresh & oily, but roasted a little too dark, a bit bitter and not as bright as the other Celebes I have had.  Given that I can not get it locally at all, and stopped ordering from another online coffee shop when they raised their shipping rates (effectively doubling the cost of the coffee) it leaves me in a quandry.  I was going to order some4 Tanzanian Peaberry, my other favorite, but having been a little disappointed with the yergecheffe, I am up in the air on that one.  I see they carry Kenya AB, which I have never seen before (only Kenya AA) and have to wonder if they are buying lower quality beans? (certainly that is what would be indicated by the lower quality Kenya coffee).  Before I saw that I thought perhaps the roast was just off.  I guess I will have to think about it while i finish the 10 lbs of coffee in the freezer.  If I could get Aftrican coffee and Celebes locally, I probably wouldn't think about it.  It is not bad, and is nice for a change.  If it was as good as what I had been getting before I would keep both on subscription.  So nice to get coffee delivered this way, and Amazon has been really excellent service all around in this area.  i only wish the coffee was better.
Amazon came through for us yet again, able to procure exactly what we wanted, at a great price, and speedy delivery.

I'm as picky as they come with my coffee.  This one has it all!  Aromatic, robust, flavorful and not at all bitter.  I usually never even pour a cup that has sat for 15 minutes in the pot - not so with this one.  What a fabulous buy!

column9: very good coffee at a great price
column10: The Coffee Bean Direct coffees offered at Amazon are saving me money over my long time bulk coffee supplier. The coffee is is of good quality, and delivered quickly. I only wish that there was more variety and that there was an option of buying it ground.

column9: Buy Taco Bell at grocery stores
column10: I always buy this kind at the grocery store. It has the two pack of taco sauce inside. It also has enough shells to use which is 12 shells. My parents love to break their shells and make theirs into a salad with the meat and cheese and other but not me. I love keeping like it is and stuffing the meat salad and cheese inside. To me it just wouldn't be like real taco if the shell didn't stay the way it is plus it's dis-respect to the country Mexico, destroying their tradition.
My 12 month old devours this flavor.  I wish it was a bit thicker but overall a very good product.

I bought this after seeing one of my favorite cookie decorators use it and honestly I was less than impressed. Not only does it clump and get everywhere (worse than pearl dust) it isn't edible. (Yeah, it can be used on cookies, cakes, fondant and gumpaste but it honestly shouldn't be eaten.) I doubt it would kill you to eat it but it seems no different than the glitter you buy in the craft department. I will stick to pearl and luster dusts.

column9: Need Caffeine to function, I admit it!
column10: I was one of those people that would buy a red bull everyday at the gas station until I realized how dumb that was and if I just bought a pack of them at once I would save like almost 15 dollars.  I would keep buying the cases too but my bank account gets smaller and smaller, not fun.  Regardless I do need my caffeine fix, and since price is an issue I've learned to concoct my own secret red bull recipe.Here it is:  I take pure caffeine powder, Caffeine Anhydrous Bulk Powder 100 Grams and mix 2 grams in a water bottle (I have a high tolerance for caffeine, don't try this at home!) and add one packet of crystal light (fruit punch flavor is my favorite), Crystal Light On The Go Fruit Punch Drink Mix, 10-Count Boxes (Pack of 6).  Shake it up, and whoola!  You have a super powerful energy drink at your disposal all for less than the change in your pocket!

It seems like Im getting ripped off everytime I purchase Redbull but at least I dont have to get off my butt and go to the store!!!!  Three dollars apiece is too much to spend on an energy drink that taste like pee.  Thank you Amazon.

WOW!These are big!You can make a lot of RBV with just one can!These are big!WOW!PS: I will say that these are a bit much if you are only a casual drinker of redbull...if you are hard core or in college, then these really are for you!BLACKOUTS ARE INCLUDED if you consume this with alcohol[criminal charges may apply]
the red bulls came in great condition an were as they are in the store. these are the really big cans. came fast.

If you like some spice, this product may work out for you. It has great flavor, but I bought it to rim a margarita glass and was unable to get it to stick because it's so moist. I tried both with lime juice and without & just couldn't get it to hold on to the glass. I'm going to rub it on a steak next, and I'm sure it will work well for that, but it doesn't work well for my intended use.

If you can find this in a grocery store near you, it's definitely worth buying.  I paid $2 less for this at a small Thai grocery store, which also stocked two cheaper brands that are made with black tea (instead of the green tea this Pantai brand is made with).  While I think the black tea brands have more depth of flavor and are stronger, this Pantai brand with its green tea isn't too shabby either.  You  might just want to brew it a bit stronger than I did the first time (I have used 1/3 cup tea in 4 cups of water).  The bag is 1 lb, so it'll last you through many glasses and pitchers of Thai tea!You can't use regular milk to get the creamy taste, though.  You need to use either sweetened condensed milk or (even better) regular sugar and evaporated milk.  I haven't tried cream or half and half, but you can also used those if you have that on hand, I suppose.  It's just that the evaporated milk is cheaper and probably somewhat better for you with all the sugar in this drink, and lasts longer in the fridge (after opening).  Whatever floats your boat...I haven't tried the other Por Kwan brand that's also available on Amazon, but the other Thai tea blends that I've tried that are made with black tea just have a deeper, almost coffee-like flavor to them.  If you don't want that intensity, then this Pantai brand is a good option.  Tastes just like what can be found in any Thai restaurant, basically.  And definitely better than any instant Thai tea mix.

I just bought this thai tea mix in hopes of using it for thai iced tea, and I am extremely thrilled with the results! I steeped a tablespoon of the tea in about 3/4 cup of water for quite a while (20ish minutes) to make it nice and strong, then mixed in a tablespoon of sweetened condensed milk and a touch more sugar. I added in some ice and a bit of half and half and had a thai iced tea that was just as good as what I'd get in a restaurant! Truly delicious, and a pretty good deal too!

I bought a package of this on a whim to try out. I love iced chai tea in Thai restaurants and wanted to make some at home. Upon opening the bag, the rich flavorful aroma came out. I knew this was going to be good when it smelled wonderful before even brewing. There was no tea kettle to brew in, so I ran it through a 5 cup Mr. Coffee with great results! Instead of running just one pot, I ran three 5 cup loads of water with the same deep rich color as the first. The 4th pot was weak and was discarded. I'll be ordering more soon because I don't think this package is going to last long! ;)
This is a very high quality tea - I would definitely recommend it to you...an I even purchased several bags for friends to share.

column9: Warning - contains an artificial food coloring with potential side effects!
column10: I haven't had Thai tea in several years because the restaurants make it too sweet.  I purchased this one and a black tea version.  It tasted great, but I developed a migraine that I had to get medical treatment for.  I totally missed that it contained FD&C Yellow 6 food coloring, also known as Sunset Yellow.  The package I received had another label placed over the ingredients, so the presence of the food coloring wasn't noticeable on the package.  It is listed on Amazon's description, so it is my fault for having bought this.  I later learned that it can have several potential health issues.  There have been calls for the withdrawal of Sunset Yellow from food use from the British Food Standards Agency.  The Center for Science in the Public Interest has requested the FDA ban it in the USA.  Sunset Yellow is banned in Norway and Finland.  It is also in the black Thai tea mixture I bought.  I have gotten migraines from other artificial food additives, mostly artificial sweeteners and food preservatives.  I try to be careful, so I only blame myself.  I read every review, but didn't read the description that closely.  If you are looking for a healthy drink, this isn't it.

It's delicious and very tasty just like the ones I've had at Thai restaurants. It does say in the pkg that its green tea but hey GREEN is better and healthier than black tea and I'm happy about that because I never knew what it was made of, I just knew I loved it and ordered it all the time from Thai restaurants. I add white table sugar, half & half and ice and it is Ahh-MAZING. I brew 1 cup in 2 liters of water, at the end the leaves are pitch black like coffee but the tea is that beautiful burnt-orange color. I tried to go healthy and used agave once, honey once, and skimmed milk. It was gross that way and I had to throw it out.

I couldn't figure out how to make authentic tasting Thai iced tea and figured it couldn't be THAT hard.  I was right.  You just need the right tea.  This is it folks.  It's even got that hint of reddish coloring that is served in Thai restaurants.  Add milk and some condensed milk and you're there!
When I ordered this I thought it was powder but it's actually the tea that you brew yourself. Either way I brewed and had cups everyday and was satisfied each cup!
product tasted ok but not worth payng for it. would not buy again. would not waste mney ever again in the present time.
This is exactly what i was looking for.  Just like whats served in thai restaurants...very happy and will definitely order again.
This is one of my fav chilled drinks, and this is the best known brand.Item was delivered the next day!Thank you for keeping my fix.

Every time I go to a Thai restaurant I get a Thai iced tea and swear "Some day I'll make it myself". I've read about many types you can buy to substitute but to buy "Thai tea" to get the real flavor. I actually found this exact bag at a local market today called Central Market which is like a Whole Foods for about half the price but I would certainly pay this price easily because it's a pound of loose tea! Loose tea is extremely light so you'll have plenty to last you a long time & costs less than buying 2 teas at a restaurant. I don't care for condensed milk so I used half and half and raw sugar. (My local Thai place uses half and half) It was the exact flavor of what Thai iced tea should be! Even as it was steeping my mouth was watering. The tea is really good quality too. Definitely don't pass this one up!

column9: It's a good quality loose Thai tea.
column10: The packaging it comes in won't last you unless you put it all in a zip-lock freezer bag. I personally put it into plastic sandwich bags (times two). The brewed result is deeply orange and the flavor is somewhat weak. That's my usual tea to water ratio so perhaps I need to try again with a stronger mixture. I have had better loose tea from the Chinese market but this is admittedly much easier to procure. So it's good quality, not terrible but not excellent.

Guys, this is it! I have been searching endlessly for a way to make delicious thai tea at home after I first tried it at a restaurant. I scoop 4 teaspoons into a tea filter bag like these: Finum 100 Tea Filters, Large, Brown and let it steep in a mug of hot water for longer than usual (maybe 10 minutes). I like to wait until I get a strong and dark reddish color. Then I add a little bit of sugar to taste and a spoonful of sweetened condensed milk. The end result is an orange-color and creamy drink. I think it's really delicious and tastes just like what they serve in restaurants. It's great both hot and cold. Add some bubbles for bubble tea!

It tastes infinity times better with CONDENSED MILK. I used regular milk 2% and it felt like something was missing. If you don't have CONDENSED MILK. Whole Milk would taste better than 2% Milk.Originally...Brew the tea and sugar and water together and strain for best taste. Add ice, then chill. Then add the desired amount of CONDENSED MILK depending how milky you want the tea or how strong you want the tea to be. Viola! It should be a medium orange in color not blood orange and not creamy orange either.There are other brands I will definitely compare! It tastes similar to the restaurant style. Gorgeous orange color. Even the ground smells aromatic like the restaurant brewed tea. Once brewed it has a slightly different aroma. For those with a sensitive nose can certainly make that distinction. Otherwise you'd say it smells the same. I am eager to get the CONDENSED MILK to get that restaurant taste down pat!

Just received my tea in the mail. Along with the tea, I also purchased a mesh strainer. Make sure you have something to strain the leaves with when you are done boiling because you will have a mess if you don't. I have been craving thai tea several times a week and spending 3.75 a glass at my local Vietnamese restaurant was getting absorbent. This tea is very very similar to the tea I get at the restaurant. I am very impressed. Made exactly as the package said. Will be ordering more when this is all gone.

I, like many others, bought this to try my hand at making Thai iced tea at home.  It is made from green tea though, and traditional Thai tea is made from black tea.  It does alter the flavor slightly.The leaves should be brewed floating in the water then strained through a tea sock.  I use a little more tea than the package suggests (5-6 tablespoons per cup of water) and brew it a little longer.  With 2 tablespoons of sugar, and 3 of evaporated milk...This drink comes out almost as good as the Thai restaurants make it.  The price is good and I get my Thai tea at home for much less than $3.15 a glass!
This is such an awesome tea! I love it so much! My husband and I always go out to eat thai food and buy the tea and this makes it so we can drink it whenever we please!
This tea is wonderful. Authentic and tasty. I love it. Use milk instead of heavy cream and it's just as good. Yum

I love thai iced tea and always order it at restaurants, but this was such a low quality and gross product.  After seeping and straining like the instructions state, I sweetened and added milk...the tea took on a funky and artifical orange color and tasted gritty and artificial.There was no depth of flavor that the restaurants have. I also really disliked the artificial food coloring they added to the mix.  It turned the tea into such an unappetizing color. I am very disappointed.
This is my 2nd favorite of the 12 Lorann Oils I have so far. It is delicious and great in things like oatmeal. The flavor is rich and buttery, and really leaves you satisfied!

I looked everywhere trying to find this plant. My Aunt has one but didn't know what it was called. I took pictures of it and took them to every plant place and nursery I could find. No one knew what it was. At last I was sent to a nursery that is ran by a master of plants. He knew what it was as well as that is was a prehistoric plant. I hope it lasts long enough to look like my Aunts whose is very big and beautiful It is a very low maintaince plant which is just what I like. Thank you Amazon. Without you I may have never found it.

column9: You Want to Know How Tough a ZZ Plant Is?
column10: You want to know how tough a ZZ plant is?  I moved in late September and all my house plants were supposed to come directly to my house.  Other items went to storage until we finished the remodel.  You guessed it!  Movers packed my ZZ plant in a box, in a storage pod, outdoors in Arizona.  Our Fall was relatively hot this year--hit 100 degrees several times in late September and early October.  Just unpacked one of the last boxes today that were delivered from the storage pod about 3 weeks ago.  There she was--poor little thing. She was about the size of the picture in the upper right had corner of this page.  Four branches--three of which died.  The other is still green and there are 3 new shoots coming up out of the pot.  Gave her a drink and put her in filtered light.  We'll see how she does but I'm very hopeful!

column9: Horrible Quality - 2 of 3 stems died within 2 weeks
column10: I was so excited to have this plant.  It arrived very poorly packaged and the dirt had gone everywhere.  I repotted and watered according to recommendations.  Two of three sprouts died within 2-4 weeks after I owned it.  One hadn't fully bloomed yet and it just died.  The other just got all brown and died.  I think they were poor when they arrived and just didn't survive after repotting as a result.  Sad. They were all really thin and wobbly, nothing like the picture - where they have thick stalks and look big.  Just scrawny. I saw some at Ikea and plan to get some there if they are still there.

When it arrived in the huge shipping box I had no idea what to expect but after digging through the packaging  I discovered the the plant was in very good shape. I am amazed at the habits of this plant. It is already growing beautifully after only one month in its new habitat. It is quite fascinating to observe and requires so little but offers great rewards.I love it-- it was worth every penny!

I had no idea how BIG this plant was going to be, considering the price and how small plants typically are when sent by mail. For the price this is a great deal, plus they are beautiful and packaged nicely! I ordered some other plants for about the same price (including shipping) through other sellers, and it doesn't compare: the others are much smaller, come with at least one or two half-dead plants, packed in ridiculously wasteful and, in my opinion, non-professional manner. Cheers

Beautiful. green and just plain ole heathy plant arrived!  I hope that I can keep it that way for I have no "green thumb"!  But I did plenty of research on this plant, so my chances of keeping it healthy are good - hopefully.  Came across this plant by accident when I was looking for a window treatment(curtains) for my "barren" living room window.  It appealled to me because this plant did not have many reqiurements - I can handle that!

I love the plant! Easy to care for. That is until I put it in a clay pot 4 months later. Using miracle grow water control soil. Learn from my mistake, add gravel, and dirt to soil. After lots of research, I finally found out why my babies started drooping off the side. Hope I can save the little guys. No real directions came with the plants.

Plant arrive in a protective box looking very healthy.The soil was very wet and within a few days the branches rotted away. I repotted what was left of the plant but it was too late. I have purchased from this company before with great results but will never purchase live plants from them again.
Plants were healthy when they arrived.  Sent in a prompt manner.  Would recommend getting these plants as they are easy to grow and don't require much light.

Two or three months ago, I subscribed to this company for automatic delivery of their dried chicken "breasts" each month.  When this month's order arrived, I allowed my Golden Retriever to eat one only.  Within a short time he became severely ill and continued vomiting repeatedly throughout the entire night.  I am a retired attorney/judge.  I do not become hysterical over every complaint that makes a claim that some product or other can kill your pet.  Now, I greatly regret my cavalier attitude about this particular item.  Had my Golden been weakened in any other way, I do not believe he would have survived this incident.  My on-going purchase of this product despite prior bad press and numerous complaints was foolish.  But I trusted that the distributors of the dried chicken "breasts" would monitor this product more closely after the first recall of this product so that no other animals would be harmed.  Such was clearly not the case.  In fact, it appears that the only action the U.S. distributors took after the last recall was to print on each package that the product had come from the United States.  Closer inspection however reveals that although this product was packaged in the U.S., it continued to be imported from China.  Amazon is by far the best retailer on the Internet by far.  My complaint is not against Amazon.  But I feel compelled to alert other potential customers regarding the poisoning my dog suffered (and he did suffer).  I can imagine other pets who are smaller, older, or in some other way more vulnerable than my Golden, would and could actually die if they consumed even the smallest amount of this product.  It's true that this was not the case every month.  Rather it is an intermittent but on-going problem.  I cannot emphasize enough how serious this problem is.  It is absolutely necessary to eliminate the distribution of this product in the U.S. once and for all.  Please Amazon, end your involvement in this matter.

There are several listing on Amazon for "Hormel Bacon Bits" or "Hormel Crumbled Bacon", sometimes accompanied with the adjectives or descriptive phrases "Real", "Premium", "with Picnic Ham, "30% less fat", or "50% less fat"; at prices between $11 and over $42 per 20oz bag.  In fact, these are all the same product,  "HORMEL REAL CRUMBLED BACON";"50% LESS FAT.  The phrase "30% less fat" and the white or the dominantly light gold packaging are just photos of old packaging---not a current product.  Over the past year, I've ordered this product from at least 3 different Amazon merchants, and regardless of their description, I've ALWAYS recieved "HORMEL REAL CRUMBLED BACON; "50% LESS FAT" in the darker gold packaging.  So, don't worry about the "varieties", there are no "varieties"---there is just a single product.  You'd think that for $42 you are getting a better product (or larger package) than for $11, but in fact, it is exactly the same product and size.This is NOT "crumbled bacon", or bacon-flavored "bits" for salads---although it is terrific in salads.Think "chipped dry smoked ham".  This stuff is obviously the "sawdust", and small left-over peices, from slicing quality smoked ham for pre-packaged lunchmeat, etc. Some of the "chips" are pretty big, up to 1/2 inch. Being ham rather than bacon, it is genuinely "less fat" than bacon.I mostly use the chipped ham in omlettes, for which it is wonderful.Caution:  The ham chips are pretty salty, so always add them BEFORE adding any additional salt.Enough of the ham chips are large enough that you can use it to convert potato soup to "potato and ham soup", or as a very tasty addition to any vegetable soup. Mix a quarter cup of ham chips, half an onion (finely diced), (optionally) half a carrot (diced) and a can of sweet peas, cook on low for a half-hour and you've got great "ham and split pea soup".You can cook the ham chips with rice for great "ham and rice". You can spread mayo on a slice of bread and add a layer of ham chips for a terrific ham sandwich. Or make a fabulous "grilled-cheese and ham" sandwich. Mix with cream cheese for a great spread, or dilute with a little milk for a great dip.My Southern grandmother added "seasoning" to all vegetable dishes, from collards to squash to lima beans. What she meant by "seasoning" was a slice of "fat back" (thick mostly-fat bacon). And I must admit, her vegies were wonderful. You can accomplish the same thing (in a much more healthy way) with a teaspoon of ham chips and a couple tablespoons of good olive oil. I often add a tablespoon or so to "stir-fry" dishes---even those which feature chicken or beef---the ham flavor goes unnoticed, but pops up the flavor of everything else.The potential uses are almost limitless. Considering that the price of real smoked ham (which isn't half pumped-in water) often exceeds $35 per pound, $16 (the price at the time of this writing) is a good deal for 20oz.Since this is dry ham---it keeps very well in the frig, no need to freeze it in normal situations.  In my house a 20 oz package never lasts more than 2-3 weeks.  Because it keeps so well (and is so tasty that open packages don't last long), there is no need to buy it in the smaller 4 oz packages---except perhaps for camping or emergency food.

This is a very tasty product but way overpriced on line.  The sauce is readily available at most markets at a much lower price (much lower).

column9: Savory spicy sauce - a must have for any kitchen
column10: I grew up with this chili garlic sauce. My parents would usually use another familiar Huy Fong product Sriracha for our foods. This Chili Garlic sauce is a whole another level. It is like dog treats for humans. It adds a lot to any dish, whether it's rice, chicken, pork, noodles, etc. The ingredients are mostly natural, which is a plus.Pick a jar up if you haven't already. It is truly a spicy treat.

I love this stuff and add it to all my stir-fries: it's delicious, and not sweet, like the Rooster.  But this is ovepriced.  The same 8 oz. little plastic jar sells for $2.89 at my corner bodega, and they charge a premium for being open 24 hours.  When I make it to a grocery store, the jar is usually $2.29.  So the price here is more than double.  Two stars deducted for the overprice; five stars for the sauce itself.

column9: Good Vienna Sausages But Not As Described
column10: Goya Vienna Sausage Hot Sauce, 5-Ounce Units (Pack of 48)are good. They have a good texture and that distinctive Vienna Sausage Flavor with a slight "bite" of jalapeno. These are not packed in hot sauce. They come packed in chicken broth. The "hot" flavor is part of the meat mix.

this is the best coffee I have ever tasted, and I have drank a lot of coffee over the years. I would like to know why this particular coffee is not sold in local grocery stores? I can find it at the Sam's Club stores, but not at local stores. Please think about selling at the grocery stores.
Starbucks is always rich and full. You dont have use as many beans as other coffees. In fact I use about 2/3. Love Starbucks coffee!!

column9: I agree with the previous reviewer........
column10: I agree wholeheartedly with the first reviewer.  I didn't notice where he was from, but if you have HEB grocery stores in your area, they've got the best price on the whole beans in their largest stores... I think the 2.5 lb. package (not 2.0 like Sam's sells) runs about 23.00 (cheaper than Sam's!)  This is the best coffee that I've ever brewed--spoils you for anything else.Starbucks House Blend Whole Bean Coffee, 40-Ounce Bag

column9: Starbucks House Blend Whole Bean Coffee, 2.5lb Bag
column10: Beans were very fresh, quick delivery and now I'm just enjoying my coffee. I ordered 3 bags or 7.5lbs so I should have beans for awhile. Enjoy!

column9: One Of The Best Canned Soups I Can Remember!
column10: A couple days ago, I picked up a few cans (14.5 ounces) of Amy's Organic Soups and one of the varieties was the Chunky Tomato Bisque. I found it in the gourmet section of the store along with other Amy's products. I had a bowl of the soup late this morning for brunch with a helping of scrambled eggs. Mmmmm, boy, this is good soup! Gosh, I'm used to stuff like Campbell' s Cream Of Tomato and this is just worlds apart. Excellent flavor! Wonderful! Nice texture with the tomato chunks. It's one of the best canned soups I can remember, and it will go with a wide variety of other foods. This is a soup that I'll repeat again and again.Gary Peterson

I've used all the different GF flour I could find. Most others will do fine for a masked taste like banana bread or pizza crust but this is the only one I would trust for anything where flour is a prominent flavor, such as sugar cookies, white bread and cake.I would love to see this purchasable in bulk, so as not to be $5 a pound. I'll be buying other bulk GF flours (as low as $2.40 a pound) until that price goes down. This makes me sad.

I agree with the first review on here.  I have tried several gluten free flour mixtures, and this is the best that I have tried.  It does not leave a gritty taste in the foods.  It makes good pizza crust, cookies, etc. It is nice to eat baked goods with a more "normal" consistency again and no funky aftertaste as I have had with some other GF flour mixes.  I highly recommend this!

I have tried them all, and also the Gluten free Bisquick and this is by far the best all around flour.  Whether using for cornbread, pancakes, thickening gravy, or in cakes and pie crusts this flour has a "regular" flour consistency and does not add any odd taste to your foods.Yay, baking is edible again!
This flour made my GF cookies amazing! Have since used the KA Chocolate Cake Mix, and that was great, too.

My fiancé is gluten intolerant, so I've been doing a lot of research and experimenting to try to produce something that resembles her favorite foods, from breads to cupcakes, pancakes, pizza, and cookies. Of all of the all-purpose gluten-free flours we've tried, this one is definitely the best. She literally referred to it as "magic". The key thing that makes this flour so much better than the bob's stuff is that they have a good balance of various types of flours and emulsifiers. Your average wheat flour contains flour from various types of wheat with different protein contents, but its all wheat, because wheat contains the key elements of sugar, starches and proteins necessary in making great breads/cakes/whatever.So, when you are trying to mimic the textures and tastes of the things you get when using regular wheat flour, you have to combine various other types of flours to get a result that tastes like the real thing (or better, if you really work at it!). This flour has a very nice balance of starches, sugars, and proteins (from the various different flours), that produces foods with good texture and body, without making things too dry or spongy.Buying this flour online is significantly cheaper than buying it at our local grocery store, and though its still expensive, I don't think any of the competitors have a product that produces foods that taste nearly as good, so I think its worth it.

column9: I'd give it more stars, if I could!
column10: Looks like flour, add some xantham gum when baking, or use it for other recipes, and it is amazing!  This is the BEST GF flour on the market... hands down.  Their pizza and their pancakes are the 100% best, too.  Muffins... not so much.  Lose the nutmeg.  Otherwise, use THIS flour to make your own items.  I just can't seem to get a good pizza out of it.  Everything else is incredible, though!  CONGRATULATIONS KING ARTHUR!  This one rocks!

I was recently diagnosed with Celiacs and must bake gluten free. I am in process of trying different multipurpose flours. King Arthur has given me the best results so far..in cakes, cookies, pie crust's, etc. I prefer it over other gluten free flours I have tried so far. It tastes and bakes much like traditional flour...good flavor and good results!

column9: Excellent quality, too pricey for me!
column10: This flour is excellent.  I have used it to make cookies and pop-overs.  Both had "regular" food flavor.  We tried this flour because it was on clearance at a local super market.  I can't imagine paying for it otherwise and have been using Pamela's Products which are much less expensive.

King Arthur flours are simply, consistantly of great quality! This multipurpose gluten free flour is a very good gluten free product.  I have used it for breading, making gravies and sauces and in a quick bread recipe since I purchased it.  It's a good product.  Would like to see different packaging, but that is only my personal preferance.  I will continuie to buy this product whatever the pkg.
I have used this to make chocolate chip cookies and angel food cake and they both turned out great. I used king arthur flours before being gluten free, so I thought I'd give it a try. I'm glad I did.

column9: This flour is worth every penny!
column10: Why, you may ask? Why after spending several hundred dollars on all types of flours, flour blends andlots and lots of different mixes? Most have tons of sugar and call for lots of oil to get their productto somewhat mimic wheat. The Europeans do a far better job of getting a rise out of brown rice flour.Well, King Arthur hit it on the head 1st time out. NO SUGAR and they even managed to get some whole grainbrown rice flour in there too. If you want a "whole wheat" look add 1/4 cup Teft. Tiny bit more water. Mybest bread doughs spread like frosting.

Going Gluten Free has been a challenge especially because it isn't a choice!  I love to cook and eat, so missing out on almost everything has been tough.  I have use this flour for a few recipes and I have been impressed!  It is also cheaper here than at Fresh Market, so save some money and your health!

column9: Won the Dixie Classic Fair using this flour
column10: I made a gluten free chocolate cherry cake for the King Arthur Flour Great Cake Contest, competing with regular gluten filled cakes, and I won the contest at the Dixie Classic Fair.  I used this flour and their brown rice flour and other ingredients.  The judges said they would not have know it was gluten free.  That's what I want to hear!

I've always had a soft spot for King Arthur flour, and this product didn't disappoint.  First thing I wanted to make was banana bread and boy was my patience rewarded!  It measured and performed just like wheat flour, no kidding.  In fact, it was the best banana bread I ever made.  I couldn't keep my wife's paws off of it (or mine).  Haven't tried it for yeast bread, and I'm not really interested in that, since it wouldn't perform like a gluten flour, of course.  Just very pleased with it.  I did think the cost was a bit much for the ingredients, but now that I have the list, I'm going to try making my own by experimenting with the 4 flour/starch ratios.  If this works, it will have been well worth the cost.

This is one of the best gluten free flours.  I've tried almost every brand for my son (8) who has wheat and barley food allergies.  I recently used it with the King Arthur gluten-free pancake recipe off their website.  The first few pancakes were very dense so I added additional milk (almost double what the recipe called for) and they were delicious!  My other son (6) who is a pancake connoisseur loved them. He usually does not like gluten-free pancakes preferring Hungry jack (he's not gluten intolerant) and he gobbled them up.  My husband agree they were excellent.  Check around on pricing.  I misread the website and thought there were three boxes each 24 ounces for the listed price.  Instead I received one box.  Ridiculous in my opinion, but it's a free market.  I'll take my business elsewhere in the future and buy from a more reasonably priced seller.

King Arthur Flour is one of the best flours available and have used it for years.  I recently started using their Gluten Free Flour and find it to be excellent.  However, I purchase it in my local supermarket for $7.49 - so check around because 24 ounces doesn't go very far and at the prices listed here it can get very expensive to bake.  You will not be disappointed at the quality.

As someone who is just beginning my journey into the Gluten Free world, I appreciate being able to buy this product and try it.  So far, I have made only Banana Bread with it, but liked the results. As I find more recipes, I will be using it more.

I bought this product while searching for a gluten free way to bake, this box very small, the flour does not rise, even following all directions to a T with brand new baking powder, ect.. this is rubber when it cooks, Even the dog would not eat the pancakes.
Would buy this if it was sold in bulk. I don't want to spend over $6 for flour. Will continue to use my GF flour-blend.
awful.  tried this flour and it is awful.  cookies melted in the oven to soup.  doesnt hold its consistency.  have no idea how it'd taste because the food was not edible.  very dissappointing

column9: Love the flour but why so much Amazon?
column10: More than twice what it is on their website :( I wanted to order from Amazon to make life easier but I just can't!On the up side, flour is great and if you use enough binding agents and leavening, works well!

We enjoy Mrs. Mays products and will now add the Fruit and Nut Toppers to our list.  Great in yogurt or snacking on by itself, strawberry fruit nut toppers is a yummy addition to our pantry and my children's lunches.
This is a good product but not for chow hounds.  If your dog is a ferocious eater, opt for the regular nylabones and not the edible ones.

column9: Never Had Chia Oil that Tasted this Bad
column10: This was awful. I used to sell chia oil and never, never did it taste like this. It tasted rancid. Would not suggest purchasing this product. I purchased another brand from amazon.com and it was fine. I emailed the company about how bad my bottle of oil was and guess what - never heard from them. Bottom line look other places if you desire chia oil.

column9: My Dog Loved the Taste - I Loved the Quality
column10: My Great Dane is very sweet, but he is extra hard on toys and treats, destroying both in a matter of seconds.  This Zuke's Z-Bone was a different story, though.  While it didn't last for a tremendous amount of time, it kept my dog working for a while longer than his usual time.  He loved the taste and, although he had never had one before, after sniffing it, he jumped right in.  I loved the quality ingredients (I recognized what I was feeding my dog) and the fact that it freshened his breath.  I also appreciated that it was grain-free as my dog has sensitive skin.I will definitely continue to buy these!

Our dogs love Zukes and I was happy to find them on Amazon.  When I ordered these, they were the regular retail price, but I see now they are about 6 times more than that.  So I doubt I will be ordering from Amazon again unless the prices come back down. But these are great bones, made from great ingredients from a great company. Couldn't ask for much more.

My very picky shih-poo devoured this.  He even kept going back to the wrapper!  Even though flavor preference varies among dogs, these are conveniently available in singles so you can try one without buying a whole box your dog might not like.  Also, Zukes is high quality so there are no worries about questionable ingredients.
the picture shows the z-bone is green in color; however, I received a  black one in color. I doubt whether it's good or not coz I've never seen one in the pet shop and I can't compare it.

My dog loves these treats, and peanut butter is her favorite.  As I've said before, they are made in the USA and I like that...no junk from China for her.  Hard to find in our rural area so I try to stock up.
ok item if made in USA ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ??
I wasn't 100% satisfied with these suckers, there was really no flavor. I ended up throwing most of them away.

I started drinking this tea throughout the day to consume less caffeine, without going decaf.  I don't get jittery at all with drinking 3-5 cups a day of this.  I have been buying Choice teas for nearly 7 years now and have never been disappointed. I also drink 1 cup of Choice's Premium Japanese Green Tea for an afternoon "pick me up" if I am feeling a little groggy. Choice all the way!
My husband drinks this tea on a daily basis.  He has tried other brands but this is his favorite.

It's a good tasting tea. I drink it at work with stevia as a sweetener.  I was puzzled at first because it's darker in color than the loose ,silver needle white tea that I drink at home.  Whenever possible, I try to buy organic and fair trade. Organic is good for me, and fair trade is good for the farmers and their community.

I USED TO LOVE THIS TEA WHEN IT WAS CALLED "WHITE TEA" made from peony and had a plain tea taste but now it is WHITE PEONY and has a floral taste.I don't like it now and am annoyed that Choice seem to have discontinued the old tea.

This is the third time I purchased this tea. The first two times the tea had the light, but floral flavor like what you would expect from whit tea. The third case had tea that was more nutty and heavier, like the tea was a little old. Despite the variation in flavor, because of the price and the fact that all of the tea had a good flavore, I would recommend this to any white tea drinker who is on a budget.

Choice Organic White Peony Tea has been one of my favorites for a number of years. When I was no longer able to obtain it locally, I searched the internet. Most of the vendors were listed with Amazon.com. Now Amazon is offering the tea directly and the automated ordering feature with reduced pricing is not to be refused. Thanks Amazon!

column9: Too Good! Hint Of Mint is Perfect.
column10: Well, I try to keep away from things like this, but there they were: Newman-O's Creme Filled Mint Chocolate Cookies (13-ounce packet) made with organic flour and organic sugar. Hmmmm, how could I resist? Well, I couldn't. They're just one of my little occasional treats, or so I tell myself. Oh, these are delicious! Much better than the nutrition treats I usually eat The trouble is, I just can't stop at a reasonable number. They're just too good. And the "Hint of Mint" is just perfect!Gary Peterson

column9: Actually not my favorite, but good and good quality
column10: Like all of the Newman-O's cookies, my main issue with them is the bite - how they break and hold together when you bite into them.  For some reason, their recipes all result in what I find to be a somewhat unpleasant cookie experience texture-wise.  Unless I keep them chilled, for example, when I bite into them, they all tend to sort of moosh out of shape, and parts of the cookie will break leaving bare spots of the icing etc.  I just dislike how they have balanced the cookie between the filling and the cookie part overall.I've also tried several of their flavors as "dunkers" in coffee and milk, and while they will work, they don't dunk very well compared to some other cookies either.Having said that, I also feel that these particular cookies, while certainly tasty, aren't quite minty enough for me.  I like very strongly mint flavored chocolate cookies.  Someone else might prefer this type.They are healthful options for sweets that certainly don't taste bad.  I wouldn't buy them again and shared this review since other people might have similar preferences regarding the texture of cookies, which people don't typically mention in their reviews (and I wish they did).  But I certainly will not ding these as being bad cookies; it depends on what you like.
Tastes better than Oreos.  Unfortunately, they taste too good and I'm on a diet, so I have to let my subscription for these expire until after Christmas.

column9: Do you love the great taste of mint Newman'Os?
column10: Well, now they're available in a smaller size, at a higher price!13 oz, down from 16 oz.Sorry, capitalism requires you to bend over every 9 months or so.

column9: Bland as cookies but a good foundation for crusts
column10: I got these to serve a crowd of kids at a party.  They are very bland with no butter flavor so they never made it to the table.  I did find a way to use them, in cookie crusts for other desserts.  Mix with melted butter and flavorings and press into pie pan or springform pan.  I also made rum balls with them, so as a blank canvas they are good.
Great seasoning!  Whenever visitors come over and I use this, they always compliment on the Italian flavor... and the bag is SOOO big I have enough to send them home with a baggie.
product was as expected. good value for money. Could improve with a resealable bag. Will save me money over purchasing at warehouse club.

I purchased several different saffron's from Amazon and a local store to taste and sample.  This was of interest because it stated it was Iranian.  Having read that Iranian saffron was of the best in the world I was intrigued.  However, when received the label stated "Iranian Style". This was disconcerting. This is quoted from the product description:  "You will get about 500 saffron threads with this one gram purchase. We are known throughout Florida and the USA to have some of the finest quality Iranian saffron around! Since it is illegal to import saffron from Iran to America we have worked hard to source some of the finest Iranian style saffron from the nutrient dense lands of New Zealand, France & Greece."  Unfortunately I had not read this prior to ordering.  If it is not Iranian, why say it is?  Or at a minimum be consistent in the representations.To be fair I would say that it is good saffron, at least based on my limited saffron expertise, and compares favorably to the others I had ordered.  I am cooking with it and also taking it as a supplement having read of the clinical study proving saffron's efficacy in treating depression compares favorably to a leading pharmaceutical.Nevertheless there is a feeling of unease about the transaction which I thought to share.

If you like habanero. No, if you crave the aroma and flavor of habanero...this is the good stuff.  I have a collection of habanero sauces and seasonings, but this is always the first on I reach for.  If you want to prove that you can endure the heat of habanero, this will do that too.  But it's really about the flavor and aroma, and this one is superior.

I can't believe there are only two reviews for this product.This pizza crust is simply amazing.  I made one pizza according to package directions (it makes 2 large crusts) and with the left over dough I made some pizza rolls for the kids and a calzone for my husband.  You can roll this out with ease, fill it, seal it etc.  The kids loved the pizza rolls, my husband raved over the crispiness of the crust on his calzone and my pizza was perfect.Includes the yeast packet and xanthan gum.  Requires egg, oil, water, cider vinegar, and sugar (which is optional).  Easy to make, easy to roll, very tasty.

column9: Best GF pizza crust mix yet!
column10: This is the best gluten free pizza crust mix I've tried yet, and I've tried a few others.  My husband eats gluten free because I must, so he is always very vocal on letting me know if a gluten free product is thumbs up or thumbs down--and he really likes this one.  Not at all gritty, no funny tastes (which is his complaint on some of the gluten free breads).  We make one cookie sheet size pizza from one package of this mix.  I've never been a big fan of commercial pizza, but homemade with this mix and my favorite toppings is such a treat!

This crust is so good that none of my friends were able to tell the difference between this and crust made with wheat flour.  I have literally tried everything out there, and this is hands down the best, easiest way to have delicious gluten free pizza.  I usually mix mine in the food processor, instead of the stand mixer, and you get a very soft dough. I have been gently rolling it out on a greased cookie sheet and then flipping it onto a pre-heated pizza stone.  That way the crust browns nicely and totally looks like regular pizza. Each bag makes 2 thin crust pizzas, which perfectly feeds myself and my 4 kids (8 & under) with a bit left over for lunch the next day.I am so grateful to be able to eat pizza again--it is one of the things I missed terribly after going gluten free.  Try this crust, you will not be disappointed.

This pizza crust is easy to make and has a good taste.  If you prefer a softer type crust, you do not need to bake the crust before adding sauce and toppings.  Instead, after letting it rest for 15-30 minutes, add your sauce and toppings and bake at 350 for 25-30 minutes.  Turns out great and both my husband and I think it tastes better this way, a little less chewy.
Okay, I loved this pizza crust!  It was thicker than most pizza crust.  Reminded me of homemade crust my mom used to make.  Loved it!  Thank you for bringing pizza back into my life.

Gluten Free Pizza has been a real disaster for me.  I have tried many mixes as well as making my own.  None was very good.  However, I found this mix and Mama Mia!  This mix is excellent.  I actually reordered so I wouldn't run out and then purchased a couple other things of "Mama's" to try.  I would highly recommend this product. I made some garlic bread sticks and they were wonderful as well.  I would absolutely recommend this product to anyone and will purchase more for myself.
My daughter bought us these crust mixes and we liked them very much. A real treat and an easy meal. I will use more of these!
I did have to bake the crust a little longer but wow was this a good crust. Unlike any other store bought crust I have found. Absolutely no rice taste at all!!!!

I had previously bought King Arthur Pizza Crust mix, and that one was sticky, time consuming--but it was delicious! I decided to try GFM'a since I am a fan of the flour mixes. I am soo disappointed in this pizza crust mix. I am currently waiting for this pizza to finish---its been in there 35 minutes longer, at this point. Made a thick crust one, as that is what my son prefers. Followed directions to a "T"--I do think the dough is a lot easier to work with, as it is not as sticky as King Arthurs'..but I did do a small taste test, and it tastes blahhh. The flavor is off and I am so far unimpressed. I thought that by all the glowing reviews, it would be great---but sadly..no. I cancelled the subscribe and save for this one, KA may be more expensive, but at least it tastes awesome! I will do an updated review once I can finally finish cooking this pizza.

Made some pizzas with this mix and the results were awesome!!!!!  Couldn't really tell it was gluten free (and if you've tried other gluten free pizza crusts... YECK!!!!)  would highly recommend.  Good Job Gluten Free Mama!!!!  you rock!

I never and I repeat never post reviews on products! That being said, this is the best gluten free dough mix ever! I am a pizza guy and I was depressed when I couldn't make my own pizzas anymore. This product is simple and so delish. Make it thin style and make sure you let it rise for 30 minutes before you pre-bake. Wow I am just blown away at how much this taste like "real" pizza! Buy it, buy it, buy it!

Mama's Gluten free Pizza crust mix is the best I have tried. I have been using if for years now. Why? you ask.  Well let me tell you.  This product has a good flavor and a nice bite to it.  There isn't a funny after taste that some other products have, and it isn't grainy.  You can make it crisp thin or have a fat, chewy crust. I like to omit the egg, but have followed the recipe as directed with great results. I have split the recipe by using my own scale to half the mix and yeast pack, (also halving the other ingredients) , so as to make it stretch two pizza nights vs making it all up at once. The crust, once made, also freezes well (not longer than two weeks), but I have very limited freezer space for now. Now remember, gentle reader, that this doesn't contain gluten ingredients so it won't taste just like wheat flour crusts.  However if you are in need of something that works as a good substitute, I think this product can help you through.

Love this pizza dough! Seems like good pizza dough is the final frontier in the gluten free world. Search no more. Can't tell that it is gluten free. I cook this on a cookie sheet and flatten it under plastic wrap. It works like a charm and everyone loves it.
This is great pizza crust.  Fed it to my family members who are not gluten free and they loved it too.  Easy to work with and cooks to a crispy thin crust.  Love it.

I have been gluten free for a year now, and the only things I've found hard to replace are bread, crackers, and pizza crust--until now!  I'm still searching for the perfect bread and crackers, but Mama's Pizza Crust is a great substitution for gluten pizza.  I've tried many others from homemade to frozen to restaurants, and none have come close.  The real test is my family, and they love it too, which has made pizza night so much easier now that I don't have to make two kinds of pizza.  I have found that I can get three crusts out of a package (they are thin, but not too thin), and I freeze what I don't need after the initial baking, which makes the next pizza that much easier to make--just thaw and add toppings.  FYI--I also love the Boboli sauce on this crust.  Not to sound over-zealous, but try it, and you won't be disappointed!

This is hands down the best GF pizza crust out there, and I've tried many.  My non-celiac husband loves it.  The mix makes 2 crusts, but we like thinner crust so I usually make 2 thin ones and have enough left to make 2 individual pizza crusts to freeze.  I LOVE this crust.

This is the best pizza crust I've ever made at home. Have been cooking for a celiac husband for 31+ years and we both agree, this is the best homemade GF pizza crust we've tasted. The dough is light, not grainy, not tough, easy to cut, very smooth dough, and it tastes wonderful - now we don't have to give up good taste just because it's gluten-free! No one would ever guess it's gluten-free. It was easy to make. I baked both crusts and froze one for later. This is the only pizza crust mix we will be purchasing in the future.

I really cannot believe how good this pizza crust is and how easy it is to make.  What an unbelievable product, I will not use anything else, EVER.  I may have to stock up for a long time b/c I don't ever want to be without this crust.  My family preferred this over my gluten version for them b/c this one crusts up so well, no gritty aftertaste, simply AMAZING!!! LOVE It!!!

column9: Best gluten free pizza crust hands down!!
column10: This is the BEST gluten free pizza crust!  I have tried another brand and my own homemade version.  Neither compares.  This is chewy, crispy at the edges and the taste is SO good.  Been a year and a half since I went gf and this was such a great find, haven't had any decent pizza.  I let the gluten eaters in the house try it and some liked it better than the wheat crust I made for them. Thank you Gluten Free Mama!!  You made my day!
my husband is a pizza LOVER and he gives this crust his approval.....best gluten free crust out there....and we have tried them all!
I like the pizza crust fine. My husband wasn't very fond of it. I haven't tried any other brands to compare.

column9: Texture is better, Taste is lacking
column10: We made our first batch.  The texture of this pizza crust mix is better than others we have tried (crisp, not soggy).  The taste in not that great (both of us were not impressed).  If texture is what you want, this has it.  We will update this review on the second batch.second batch.The taste is not that good. It is crispier with a pan with holes in it.  I am trying a different brand.

Just found these at my local market and picked up the Ginger Spice.  I use Bragg ACV as my staple vinegar and read the ingredients, so had a ballpark idea of what this was going to be like.  Make no mistake, there's vinegar in this drink, but with the light sweetening and additional kick of ginger it's surprisingly refreshing and tasty.  Odd and addictive for sure,  I'll be picking one up whenever I see them.

Actually, I love the taste of the drinks. I'm just not sure how much to drink at one time - the whole bottle or 1/2 the bottle (one serving) or little sips throughout the day or before meals. Also, I'm so glad that they sweetened the drink with Stevia. This is the only sweetener that's allowed in my diet.

column9: Zero calories and zero everything else!
column10: This stuff rocks! Yeah, it has a little apple cider vinegar taste but I like it. The flavor is not overwhelming and it's a healthy, clean and refreshing drink. It is almost impossible to find good-tasting bottled drinks with ZERO CARBS that taste good and don't have aspartame or Splenda in them.  The other Bragg's Apple Cider Vinegar drinks have carbs in them but this Ginger Spice flavor is ZERO. This one is a keeper for me. On a hot day it's just perfect and it doesn't affect my weight or my blood sugar.
I think it's a yummy treat.  I plan on making my own version and keep it in the fridge.

I started out drinking the Apple Cinnamon per my health food store owner's recommendation on a really hot day, then after a few weeks tried the Grape flavored, and recently went back and she told me that the Ginger Spice was her favorite.  Now, I'm addicted! I eliminated soda-pop out of my diet completely about 5 years ago and only drink water so this is a nice, very healthy treat.  This wonderful, healthy drink is a refreshing way to get my daily intake of Apple Cider Vinegar.

I suppose I should preface this by saying that I normally dislike stevia (the sweetener used in this drink).I am giving this 5 stars for being healthy and detoxing, but 1 star for taste (averages out to be 3 stars). It is basically diluted apple cider vinegar sweetened with stevia. There isn't enough ginger. I think if there were more ginger and/or lemon juice (it doesn't have lemon now) it would be much better. And I really wish they had sweetened it with something aside from stevia - honey maybe, or agave. I think I would prefer to just take a shot of ACV rather than drag out the experience into a 16 ounce bottle.On the plus side, it made my stomach feel much better within about 30 minutes (I'd been having a bloaty day).I would actually consider buying this again, even though the taste is quite poor, because I know that it's detoxing and it helps my stomach.Bragg's: PLEASE make another version of this with a different sweetener! Thanks :)

I thought this might be a nice alternative to Carnation Instant Breakfast mix, but it isn't.  Even if you can get past the tinny aftertaste, the grainy, lumpy mix just will not dissolve!  I even tried mixing it with warm milk and it was still a gloppy mess.  Don't buy this stuff.

column9: Still the Best Clumping Litter I've Found
column10: My husband and I thought we'd try going "green" with our litter and after trying natural, flushable, non-clumping litters, we finally got fed up!  They got stuck in our cat's fur, didn't fight the odor, and didn't absorb urine as we'd hoped.  Fresh Step is still the best at clumping, trapping odor, and minimizing the amount of litter tracked all over our house.  In the end, we went back to Fresh Step and decided to be more environmentally conscious by paying more attention to how much we use in the litter box.  Even over other brands of clay litters I prefer this one.

column9: Fresh Step VS Tidy Cat...Fresh Step wins hands down!
column10: I was so disappointed with Tidy Cat scoopable litter that I was about to go back to the regular litter, but decided to give it one more go with a different brand. The trouble with Tidy Cat is that the soiled litter would turn to a thick, sticky mud that was very difficult to scoop and would leave a lot of mud-like residue behind. I would end up emptying the entire litter box, clean it out, and start from scratch which defeated the purpose of scoopable litter.Fresh Step proved to be a major improvement. It is so much easier to scoop and doesn't turn into the sticky mud that Tidy Cat would form. I can actually scoop now and not have to empty the entire litter box.Both Fresh Step and Tidy Cat controlled odor. Tidy Cat's plastic container was a bit easier to transport. Fresh Step prevents litter mess and waste; thus, saves money as pound for pound it scooped better and last longer. Fresh Step wins hands down as it is by far the most scoopable litter.  I just disposed of two new containers of Tidy Cat as it wasn't worth the trouble and mess.
This is the only litter we use.The price was very good.On the negetive two of six boxes were dammaged
This is great cat litter!  It seems to track less than some of the ones I have bought.  I love the convenience of shopping at amazon!

Dusty, when I pour it into the litter box, I cannot breathe nor see anything, just as if I am in desert and there is wind. Turn your head away when pouring it.2. Yucky fragrance. column9: Scent is too strong for many cats!
column10: In my experience (working with around 300 cats at our local animal shelter), Fresh Step tends to be too strongly scented for most cats.  They would prefer to use an unscented litter and sometimes will go outside of their litter box so they don't have to use this litter (not often, but sometimes).  As far as its consistency, most cats are OK with it.Because it is so smelly, it does a good job of camouflaging odor, but if you have a picky cat, I'd choose an unscented or less strongly scented litter.

Yes, Fresh Step does have good odor control... But it's really, really dusty! Every time I pour it into the litterbox and whenever the cats are digging in it, there's a visible cloud of dust.  Plus the cats track it all over my wood floors.  What a mess!  I notice now that other brands of litter advertise being '99.5%' or '99.7% dustfree' on their boxes. Fresh Step has no mention of this on its box. For good reason!

This is the only litter I will use. (Actually, I prefer the unscented version but I bought the scented this time.) When I think of the definition of a clumping litter, I think of this stuff. The clumps are so solid; it doesn't make a difference whether the clump was made from piddle or poo. It also clumps using a minimal amount of litter, which makes the litter last so much longer than any other brand. The clumps don't crack, crumble, or fall apart in any way when I'm scooping. My cat is obsessed with digging and kicking the litter around, and keeps her box pristine. She will continue to bury until she can't smell her waste; with stinky, weak litter this means she pretty much never stops burying. With this litter, she is satisfied after two or so kicks! She also likes to 'organize' her box... seriously, she will go back and make sure all the piddle cakes are on one side, all the poo cakes on another, and all the clean litter in the back corners. With weak crumbly litter, she will break up all the urine clumps into tiny pieces during this process causing the whole thing to smell worse since the tiny pieces are harder to scoop. With this litter, she can push around the clumps to her hearts content and they never break!! It also sticks to her paws much less than other litters I've tried. Its tiny weightless grains of clay also stay in the box when she kicks and digs, unlike other brands that have huge chunks of clay that hit the wall and floor with every kick. (There's still a lot of litter around the box, but that really has nothing to do with the litter. My cats a digger/ kicker/ flinger.) When I pour the litter in, there is a bit of dust. Its not a lingering menacing cloud like someone else said, that's so exaggerated. Its just a little dust. There is no dust cloud when my kitty paws around in it, and no dust cloud when I scoop. The scent is not nearly as potent (aka nauseating!) as other litters I've tried, but I still don't like it. Like I said, I usually get the unscented. Speaking of smells... the first time I used fresh step (after using a really gross store brand that was on sale) my cat seemed to be really confused. She always piddles right after I scoop the box, or after I clean it and change the litter. The first time she used this, she piddled, then buried it completely with only two kicks. When shes burying, she kicks a couple times and then goes back and checks if she can smell it, and repeats until its buried. She was absolutely confused by the fact that the pee had 'disappeared' in sight and in smell. She started to try to dig it back up! She looked like she was thinking, "I know I just peed here... didn't I?? Where the heck did it go?!" It took her several potty visits to realize that the waste was not just disappearing. Since using fresh step, I've only used a different brand one time... it was a disaster. She was clearly disgusted by the feel of the litter and the fact that it smelled horrible (and I scoop every day). After two days with that bad litter, she refused to use her box. She had an accident for the very first time. Since then, I've only bought this stuff. My cat is content and I am quite pleased.

I used Fresh Step cat litter for many years and was quick to tell any of my cat owner friends that it was the best "bang for the buck" litter. It clumped hard, making the chore of cleaning the cat box a relatively easy one. Sometime around 6 months ago, that all changed. Now, it forms a sludge in the cat box that is nearly impossible to scrape out. The amount of effort necessary to clean the box could easily induce a muscle strain or hernia for those unfortunate enough to purchase this litter. Interestingly, after having this experience (twice, because I thought maybe I just got a bad batch the first time) I turned to Scoop Away which I always considered to be a similarly good product, only to find the exact same thing. What the heck? Turns out both products are made by the Clorox Pet products Co. Consider yourself warned!

column9: Fresh Step Scoop-able Cat Litter, Multi-cat, 25 Pound Box
column10: Fresh Step Scoopable Cat Litter, Multi-cat, 25 Pound BoxMy cats prefer this brand of litter.  I've tried others, but this is their preferred.  I tried a side by side comparison and the cats didn't use the other brand when they could choose.  So, to keep my cats happy, this is the form and type of litter they want.Those of us who own cats know they can be picky and that goes without saying, their choice in litter is important to their overall health.
