Fresh Step has gone through several updates to its product and this new improved odor control is the best formulation yet and it has a pleasant scent.I fill the litter box with 3 to 4 inches of Fresh Step Scoopable, as the cat uses it, the scoopable formula works well to clump around the liquid waste and makes disposal easier of both liquid and solid.  Disposal in the trash is quick and easy and I refill the litter box back to it's original depth and the cats are very happy.  The odor eliminating carbon works 24/7, multi-cat formula fights bacterial odors, and the high-quality clumping clay clumps tight to help prevent leaving behind stinky crumbles.But remember this, I completely change all the litter in the box once a month and wash and dry their litter pans for best results.This is my cat's choice, so who's to argue, a good 5 scratches... oops 5 stars is their opinion.  For my cats this is the best litter and it is important to use a pooper scooper on getting the clumps out.  The more clomps that are remove the happier the cat will be and they will continue to use the litter, by having a box or to as back ups for those days the store is sold out or the weather is so bad you just can't get out to bring it home. *****Numi Tea's Chinese Breakfast Yunnan Black Tea is a premium Numi tea, both certified organic and kosher. The only ingredient is fair trade certified organic high mountain Yunnan Black Tea FOP (Flowery Orange Pekoe). There is nothing artificial in this or in any Numi tea.On the box, the manufacturer writes: "This noble tea is grown in the mist covered mountains of Yunnan province. What distinguishes this fine, organic black tea is its perfect sense of balance, exquisite tiger's eye color, and a lean vibrancy which makes it suitable at any time of day. Like a complex wine, it is the perfect tea for food, marrying well with a wide variety of dishes. It has a distant and hard to place floral quality, yet it leaves the mouth tasting as clean as spring water. And it energizes the body and mind more harmoniously than the best of coffees. We are proud to bring you this high grade leaf."Although this tea says "orange pekoe", it does not taste citrus-y, but has a strong morning black tea taste with flowery overtones. It is like a regular orange pekoe upgraded many, many times, with something delicate, lovely, and flowery added. It's the perfect morning tea, or for anytime you want a high-quality pick-me-up.If you like Numi teas, get it---you won't be sorry. If you are new to Numi but love regular black, this will probably be the best you've ever had, and you'll wonder why you ever drank the "old stuff"!*****

I'd recently asked some online friends in a food forum what they thought the best bottled barbecue sauce is.  Four out of five of them mentioned"Bone Suckin".  I was NOT disappointed!  It is not a thick gloppy sauce clogged up with corn syrup as most of the supermarket brands (Hunts, Kraft, etc) are.  The flavor is complex.  It is not too sweet, not vinegary, and with just a modicum of spice heat to keep it interesting, and so it tastes like barbecue. I've even used it in kitchen cooking (as opposed to grilling) and people commented on the great taste.I bought it from Amazon, but Whole Foods also carries it.

(i cut and pasted this from my website)---Phil Ford, a real estate appraiser and father of four in Raleigh, North Carolina, developed his sauce around 1987 while trying to copy his mother's recipe for a western North Carolina-style barbecue sauce.The resulting all natural, fat-free, fragrant blend of ingredients include: tomato paste, apple cider vinegar, honey, molasses, mustard, horseradish, lemon juice, onions, garlic, peppers, natural hickory smoke, natural spices and salt.This one gets [...] props for a magical combination of quality ingredients, simple packaging, clever name, and well balanced flavor. The only thing I found slightly lacking (a stretch) was that the consistency was a bit on the thin side.The smell is wonderful - a sweet yet complex aroma with hints of apple, mustard, lemon, onions, and the "smokiness" that all barbecue sauces attempt. I could see putting this on almost anything - I think I want to try this on swordfish next, then a Bone Suckin Burger after that.The first time I tried this stuff was a long time ago, during my college days, before I knew much about BBQ and grilling... and I had slathered the stuff on before the meat was ready for a barbecue bath. The result was a less-than-tasty, blackened mess. Bad experience for a bad griller - I blame it on the beer I was drinking at the time.But my most recent, and sober, experience was a meal of half rack of ribs and a few chicken wings all done the right way, when the meat is at about the 75th percentile of BBQ cookage. Sometimes that's hard to do - I compare it to household cleaners... sometimes you don't trust those all natural, "green" cleaning products because you assume they aren't going to be as strong. And sometimes you don't trust a BBQ sauce when they decide to limit ingredients to things that are not manufactured and/or processed. Not the case here.After my 100% objective tasting and review, I found other high ratings across the board:Rated #1 in Health MagazineRated #1 by Newsweek MagazineAll Natural, Fat Free, Gluten Free & Certified Kosher / Pareve.

column10: I am a very picky health concious guy who is an athlete, I try to pick organic foods, also I drink my daily green tea and matcha tea, all organic ofcourse, so when it comes to BBQ its easy to become unhealthy with the high fat and high sodium usually accompanied with preservatives, but there are healthy ways to BBQ and this sauce is a great supplement! This is not your run of the mill BBQ sauce, it is delicious. Has the right balance of sweet and spicy. Is also available in a thicker style, as well as a Yaki (Teriyaki).

I hadn't had it in several years until my sister gave me a jar of the thick Bone Suckin' Sauce a couple of months ago...heaven!!! column9: This salt will change your life
column10: Those searching high and low for salt that will change their life can end their journey with Murray River Sea Salt.I first stumbled on this salt at a local outlet of a cultlike nationwide chain store that pretends to sell only the highest quality foods but also happily lends its imprimatur to made-in-China foods that sometimes turn out to be tainted.  But, ignoring other controversies associated with that store, one day a package of this salt sold by that store stirred my interest which led to the salt completing the last step of its long and probably ecologically-unsound trip from Australia to my kitchen.Here's the thing about Murray River salt:  Its pinkish flakes are fragile and crumble easily in your fingers.  It also seems to dissolve almost immediately on contact with food.  This is in sharp contrast to every other salt I've tried.  We currently have 6 or 8 other kinds of coarse-crystal salt in the house.  None of them can be crushed in your fingers.  They remain large, hard chunks of salt.  Yes, they represent other flavors than the Murray River salt, but there is something gentle and friendly about this salt.  I have a totally-unsubstantiated theory that this salt is better for your body than the hardened crystals of other salts.Our household keeps Murray River salt in a salt cellar (in our case a small lidded wooden bowl) from which it is pinched with the fingers (instead of using the traditional tiny spoon) and crumbled directly onto food on the plate.  For sanitary reasons, only a small amount of the salt at a time is put in the bowl.  That way the bowl gets cleaned frequently.  Frequent cleaning seems like a necessity when fingers, even washed ones, are the tools of choice for dispensing the salt.  Words to the wise: If you invite nose-pickers to your table, provide a salt shaker and hide the Murray River stuff till they've left.  If you have small children in your home, wait until they are grown and are draining your bank account at the safe distance of some far-off college before purchasing and placing this salt on your table.Another reviewer mentioned that they use this as a finishing salt.  Our household concurs.  We rarely if ever add this salt to anything in the cooking process.  We keep Kosher salt and a couple of sea salts for most larger-salt-use cooking needs, like baking (which frankly seems like the only time one should add much salt to the cooking process).  But this is the good stuff for your table and the food you serve on it.The chain store mentioned above no longer carries this salt so Amazon is the logical alternative.Note that I purchased a 1lb bag, which keeps well because I live in a desert.  But next time I'll probably purchase a multi-pack of the smallest bags for a small amount more per unit weight in exchange for the convenience of having smaller packages.

The texture and flavor are unique.  I was a guest on a local culinary radio show where this salt was one of the things that I brought the host to taste and she described it "Like pop rocks" it's there and then its gone.

I love this salt! This is the 3rd time I've purchased it. It is in a flake form,which is great, as it doesn't need to be ground up to enjoy. It has a nice crunch to it, but not as crunchy as the chunkier salts. It's very light on the tongue, and a great addition to a salt collection.
I think this is the best finishing salt ever. Melts in your mouth, delicate flakes. I have purchased it for friends and they are thrilled to find a new culinary delight.

column9: What a difference a little bit of nice salt makes!
column10: We used this salt in the Sydney Seafood School cooking classes when we attended last month and I fell in love.  It's lovely and coarse.  The flakes are just the right size for "pinching" and the taste when raw is delicious.

column9: Really the Best and Gluten Free!
column10: I learned about this through the dementia research foundation part of the proceeds from this sauce support. We like it best on chicken, on the grill or in the oven, and also on pork. I gave the spicy to my son but I haven't heard back yet. Great sauce Bill! not too sweet, and Gluten Free too!

My husband and I LOVE this BBQ sauce.  So far verified to be delicious on grilled chicken and pork ... Next up, kabobs!  With all-organic ingredients, I even fed some ground up BBQ chicken to my 10 month old.  Can't wait to try the spicy version!

This is hands down my family's favorite BBQ sauce. Even my picky 8-year-old loves it!My husband received two bottles of it for Christmas, and we've been looking for a local source of it since. We're thrilled to find it on Amazon.Give it a try!

This is the BBQ sauce for health-conscious individuals! Not only does it taste delicious--almost like a Memphis style BBQ sauce--but it is made using the healthiest ingredients possible (without sacrificing taste). Every other organic or all-natural BBQ sauce on the market includes one or more of these less than healthy ingredients: corn syrup, gluten (wheat), and/or soy. Bill's Best is the only one I've seen that does not have any of these ingredients, yet it still manages to taste better than the others that do. Believe me, living in Tennessee for the past twelve years, and being surrounded by various types of BBQ restaurants, I have tried virtually every type of BBQ and BBQ sauce in an area of the country known for great BBQ. Bill's Best ranks right up there with the best of them! This is a must buy!

If you have never had these chocolates...BUY THEM! They are delicious and come from Germany. They are like truffles but have a slight hint of pistachio in them. Try them you will thank me. I am so sick and tired of American drinks and how polluted they are. This Chrysanthemum tea drink is really good and I am totally on the prowl for more yummy Asian particularly Thai fruit/tea drinks.

Delicious, loads of flavor without being overwhelming and burning. Very addictive. I ordered several other flavors as well and liked them all. Old fashioned quality is my main impression. The dusting of confection sugar adds to the presentation and taste.
This product is just what my chrildren and their friends wanted. I can assure you that it won't last long. I'm sure that I will be ordering again.
I happened to fall upon these candies at a little store in Oakland, Oregon and absolutely fell in love with them. The Green Apple and Wild Cherry flavors are by far my favorite.
Simple and delicious cinnamon drops with lots of flavor.  We enjoyed having these is a candy dish around the house for ourselves and guest.

My husband and I discovered Claey's Drops in our local chain drug store, but they only stocked lemon and horehound flavors. I am a big fan of anything cinnamon or minty. I also try to search out candy made in the USA, as I find candy from Mexico and Canada to have a strange, off taste to the sugar.The Claey's Cinnamon Drops are perfect! Not too large, not too sweet, and a true cinnamon flavor. The one pound bag is actually not that large. I plan to buy another bag of a different flavor, plus will buy my husband a bag of lemon flavor as a gift.

column10: at least if you have a blocked salivary duct, like I do.  My doc told me to suck on these to keep the saliva flowing. They're sour enough that they do that quite well.

The lemon drops were as expected but the took so long to get here that they missed the party for which they were intended.  We ended up having to buy some at the local store.  I guess we will snack on these for Halloween, instead.
At least 30% of candies have some different taste and not as strong taste as I would like for this candy or it used to be in those candies.
I found that this sauce poured over slightly warmed Brie served with crackers is just a great party appetizer. Use it to dip shrimp too - yummy!

I thought we were doomed to another night of boring broiled fish.  Boy was I wrong!  We put some Mango Peach Chile Sauce on our halibut and turned it into a gourmet meal.  It was so yummy even my 5-year-old ate it. We're going to try it on pork chops next.
THESE ARE GREAT, ALREADY CHOPPED, READY TO GO. HELPS SAVE TIME FIXING DINNER. ADDES A NICE FLAVOR TO RICE DISHES.

I try to keep one bar of this in the house, as it satisfies the most intense of chocolate craving without having to eat an entire cake/pan of brownies!The blend of chocolate and lavender is truly euphoric, practically instantly-stress-relieving!  Do allow it to melt to fully experience the flavors of the lavender and blueberries.

column9: Gourmet Chocolate for the Chocolate Lover!
column10: This is the best dark chocolate you'll ever find. You only need to eat 1 or 2 small pieces to fulfill your chocolate cravings. It goes well with coffee and nearly anything else. You will not be disappointed--it is well worth the money for this chocolate! Enjoy!!!

Being a complete choc-o-holic, and a bit of a chocolate purist at that, I really didn't expect to LOVE this as much as I do! The lavender (as noted in a previous review) is very relaxing. And, it's as if you can almost smell the lavender as the chocolate/blueberry bliss is melting on your tongue. What a delight! And, yes, just a small piece is all I need to curb my fiending for chocolate. I'm in love!

I tried this on a whim one day at lunch and shared it with some co-workers.  We were surprised at how much we liked the flavor of this bar.  SInce then I have tried several other Dagoba bars, and this one is my #1 favorite!  My husband even loves them and he is not a big fan of chocolate.

This is some of the best dark chocolate I have ever had. I love the flavor combination, it's genius. The texture of the chocolate is smooth without tasting oily and fake the way cheap chocolate does. It has real dehydrated blueberry chunks which give it even more texture. And, it's actually not that much more expensive than your average candy bar, try it.

Once you overcome the initial blast of floral lavender, this stuff is addicting. I bought a single bar @ WF with a RecycleBank coupon and find the portion size (a bar is a serving) to be perfect to satisfy the deepest of chocolate cravings.

I LOVE dark chocolate, any dark with fruits like orange, blueberry, raisin, cranberry, acai, pomegranate, but didn't care AT ALL for lavender. I think lavender is better suited for soap or lotion than eating. After a few pieces, I had to throw it out. The taste is just too weird for me.

You'll want to cut the larger sections and rinse the grit off them before putting them into soup. My first experience with using dried mushrooms. The shipping and handling is a bit much for the weight.
This is just like the butter you would find in a resturant if you like seafood and like to make it at home this is the butter you should be using

I purchased this 3 pack of pasta for Valentine's dinner really only wanting one bag.  The instructions on the package indicate 10 minutes of cooking time.  Before I even opened the bag I noticed many broken pieces in all 3 bags I received.  I proceeded to follow the cooking instructions while taking care of more complicated foods as the pasta cooked.  After 10 minutes of cooking many more of the hearts were broken and most of the hearts were not even a distinguishable shape.  The comment from my boyfriend upon his first glance was, "look at all the broken hearts" which was not the vibe I was going for.  Fortunately, we both have a sense of humor so it was something to laugh about but it was disappointing to spend so much money on shaped pasta that didn't keep its shape at all.  Some of this problem could possibly be helped by reducing the cooking time but not all of it.  I'll be using the rest of this overpriced pasta in something more hidden like casseroles, obviously cooking the pasta for a much shorter time.
Love this product. I keep it at my desk at work and easy to pull out and enjoy. Nice mixture of fruit, nuts and brown sugar
It's convenient for the office and taste good, but expensive for home use.  Good value for the office and on the road, but not for home.

Husband found these at a gas station. Am happy I can now keep them at home! He really likes this particular type with the nuts and cranberry raisins. I am not really an oatmeal fan, but he likes it for a quick and easy breakfast. Nice to get them delivered to my door by Amazon!!!!

column9: Great Taste; Favorite Flavor Combo; Convenient
column10: My office offered this item & the Apple (Orchard Spice) one briefly a couple of months ago - I love them both. I was hoping to get some on my own for those mornings I'm too busy to eat at home. I'm hoping Amazon will offer them soon. I love the separate little packets of sugar, fruit & crunchy nuts to add to the oatmeal to taste. Another plus is the size of the cup - big enough to stir the items in once hot water has been added!
The kids and I love this!  It's a great change from the Shredded Wheat we normally get.  We'll sad we can't get it on Amazon anymore, but hope it comes back soon!

Our family eats a lot of Cinnamon Chex because it is gluten free and a few of us sufferfrom celiac disease.  Many of the special gluten free cereals we can buy in our grocery storeor at specialty stores are very expensive (regular cereal itself is too expensive).All the Chex cereals are gluten free, but when we saw the subscription availability for the Cinnamon Chex,it brought the price down to less than $3.00 per box (a pretty good price for cereal).We receive 3 boxes once per month and it is just about the right timing for the amount we use.Very happy with the product, price and availability.

I don't know if innovation in an already amazing category is possible, but once Chex started their gluten free line, I knew that gluten free diets were main stream and I was happy! These cinnamon chex are perfectly sweet and cinnamon to keep you wanting more. They do tend to get a bit soggy if you dilly dally with your cereal, but that's nothing to keep me from eating the last crumb from the bottom of the bag. I love that I can easily find these at the grocery store, or order them in bulk online for an even greater discount. And to think I had almost given up on enjoying an gluten free breakfast....
These were good, but can get tiring after awhile as the cinnamon can get overpowering.  I like the pricing and variety of cereals offered at Amazon.

column9: Gluten free alternative to Cinnamon Toast Crunch
column10: Eaten dry out of the box, these taste very similar to cinnamon toast crunch.  When mixed with milk it loses a little of it's sweetness, but they are still delicious.  Great price on subscribe and save.
Simple...it's hard to find great tasting gluten free food, stop looking and buy these! It's a great deal and they're so yummy! Thank you!
This is my favorite Glutten free cereal. I can not always find it locally am pleased I can get it thru Amazon and by mail. This starts my day better.

As a newly gluten free eater I am so happy that this cereal is gluten free!  The combination of cinnamon and sugar and the crunch of the cereal is the best treat.  I eat this for breakfast, snack and dessert.  Love it!!!
It goes soggy quickly, but it tastes great if you eat it quickly or in small amounts.I like the flavor so much that I will be ordering much more.

I ordered these because I wanted to try something new for breakfast but when I received it I found that it is not only delicious with milk for breakfast it makes and excellent snack in the afternoon alone or crumbled in yogurt.  I also used them in a couple of recipes that called for other cereals and it gave that yummy cinnamon zing that made the recipe great (one of which was an apple crumble I used crushed cinnamon chex instead of frosted flakes as the topping).

IMHO this has just the right amount of cinnamon flavor and sweetness. I really like it.  Glad I can't find it locally because I would be an addict.  I have more self-control ordering off the Internet.  :^D

column9: Too sweet for me but mix with plain chex and you're golden
column10: I bought this because it was on sale and hey we're in a recession, right?I thought it was too sweet.  Maybe it is my adult tastebuds.  Tastes a lot like good ol' cinnamon toast crunch.I bought a couple of boxes of regular chex and mixed it with the cinnamon chex and presto delicious.

My husband and I could probably be considered obsessed with this cereal. It is *SO* good! We have a GF home so there are only a few cereals that we can bring in, the Gluten Free Chex varieties have saved us! We will toss it in the car with us on a long drive, a bag in my purse when we are going to be out and of course it makes the perfect midnight snack! We *LOVE* this cereal! The Subscribe and Save price is very good, I was grabbing it in the grocery store but to have it delivered at that price is better than anywhere I've been!

I was looking for something that would compare to Cinnamon Toast Crunch, but a healtheir version and Cinnamon Chex is it.  There is a nice balance of cinnamon/sugar.  I did not find it overly sweet and it is very easy to eat multiple servings as other reviewers have mentioned.  I have found a new favorite cereal!

I love this Cinnamon Chex Cereal ... it is so good I have trouble not eating the whole box at one sitting. The rice Chex has always been my fav, but now I have the best of both worlds. Yummmm is what I say.

We recently found out that our 13-month-old son is allergic to a multitude of foods, gluten being one of them.  We purchased a box of these and the plain Chex Rice Gluten Free cereal from our local grocery store and he loves both of them.  Since he is limited to the items he can eat, this cereal has a dual purpose in our home: as breakfast and a quick snack.

column9: Should be named "Cinnamon SUGAR Chex" - Too much sugar!  What were they thinking?
column10: I grew up eating Chex cereals - corn, rice, wheat, bran Chex... sure they had sugar in them, but they weren't ridiculously sweet.  This Cinnamon Chex is.  The description says "...less than 10 grams of sugar per serving!"  I expected that this would be mildly cinnamon/sweet but instead it is VERY sweet.  There is A LOT of sugar in this.  In fact, there is so much sugar in this first box I opened that it's caking up on the squares and there was a good quarter cup of sugar mixed with cinnamon left at the bottom of the bag.  Its like the whole box was doused with a heavy dose of cinnamon and sugar - just too much!  If you eat it as a dry snack, you can feel the sugar granules on your fingers and on your tongue as if you decided to roll some Chex in a bowl of table sugar.  It's not terrible, just way too sweet.  I am very disappointed.  Less than 10 grams of sugar per serving?  Seems impossible.  I wouldn't buy it again.Maybe it was a bad box or bad product run?  I dunno.06-06-2011 Update: 2nd box same sugarfest as the first!06-20-2011 Update: 3rd box same as other two.06-25-2011 Update: 4th box more of the same.  (yeah, I bought 2 packs of 3 for my first (and only) order of this)

This is my favorite readily-available gluten-free cereal. However, it arrived in a very damaged state. The boxes were poorly handled, so the cereal was quite crushed in all 3 boxes. What's the point of saving money by ordering through Amazon to end up with a box of cereal powder?
wow, it's amazing what this salt does for youur steaks on the grill.
Can't describe the flavor, except to say it is good. Adds a nice subtle flavor to food, and in some cases an interesting color; like on cottage cheese; it is very black.

I am using the salt and it is just fine but the seller was less than truthful. I bought a 2 pound bag and received a 4 ounce jar. Stay away from this thief of a seller. It would cost more to send it back than it cost in savings.
If you enjoy different foods-regular salt in a regular shaker-this isn't for you! If you like to spice things ud differently- it may be.

I used to buy this seasoning mixture at Sam's a couple years ago and then they discontinued it, at least at the stores around here.  I was so glad to see it finally offered on Amazon, at a higher price, but then 21 ounces is a big bottle of the spice that lasts a really long time even if you use it often.  I used it in all kinds of dishes since I like a little fire and spice in my food, but mostly I use it on kidney beans.  I know it sounds weird, but years ago when trying to add more fiber to my diet I discovered that a can of kidney beans with a little vinegar and a few shakes of this seasoning tastes really good.  The calorie content isn't too bad, it's really filling, and you're getting a good dose of fiber.  And best of all, it's really easy and fast if you use canned beans.I like the seasoning because it's just enough heat without being over the top and it has sort of a smokey flavor to it that reminds me of chipotle peppers.  The ingredients are:  Salt, Chili Pepper, and Other Spices, Dehydrated Red Bell Pepper, Dehydrated Onion, Sugar, Dehydrated Garlic, Spice Extractives, and Extractives of Paprika (as color).  It doesn't contain any MSG as far as I can tell from the label (You never know what they hide under other terminology though).  I've tried all kinds of other brands of similar type seasonings and could never find one that's just like this.  I'm hooked.

column9: Smoke and Spice and everything nice
column10: Length:: 0:39 Mins

We love it to cook with sea food. We bought it from Sam's Club two years ago, but it was discontinued at Sam's Club. I tried to buy it at Amazon, was not available. Finally, I got it from Amazon. Thank you so much.
We love this Southwest Chipotle Seasoning. We use it to make our salsa. I'm glad I was able to get it from here.

I purchased this for a friend who used to get this at a local "warehouse club",but they no longer sell it. He was thrilled that I found this great seasoning. He uses it on steak and grilled chicken. I ,being a vegetarian, use it on grilled potatoes. Here's my recipe: slice potatoes,onions,red &/or green peppers,drizzle with olive oil &/or butter and sprinkle on a fair amount of Tones Chipotle,wrap in a foil packet and grill until tender and golden brown . Amazing !!!

column9: THE BOMB!  A Must Have In Your Pantry.
column10: When Sam's Club quit carrying this spice years ago, I ended up calling Tone's to see where I could buy it.  Luckily, Tone's has a not very well advertised site that allows regular consumers to buy their product. However, over the years, I've noticed that the price on this spice kept going up & up.When I found the spice on Amazon, I was ecstatic.  The price seems to fluctuate on Amazon, but if you track it, you can get find a price point you are comfortable with & get free shipping (thus cheaper than the Tone's site).As for the spice itself:  I LOVE this stuff. I think it is the smokey spice that is added to the mix. We use this spice liberally & go through it quickly.  There is no heat to it, just a wonderful flavor that I cannot describe other than to say YUM.Try it; you'll like it!

What a great combination of wonderful spices. You can taste the smokey cumin along with chunks of onion and pepper flakes. I use this in our tacos, taco soup and anything that I want a little Chipotle flair. I even add it to my homemade cheddar to give it a Mexican flavor and it is fabulous. Another thing I like is the fact it bursts with flavor without "burning" you mouth. My friend from Mexico sais this is good because true Mexican food is not hot, just very flavorful. If you want heat add peppers. Add this to chicken and you have a great way to change up the meal. I love this product and keep it in my storage so I don't run out.

I purchased this seasoning a few years ago from Sam's Club and since then I have been unable to find it anywhere.  I really like using it on chicken and pork.  My grown children from comments on what I use for seasoning because they liked it also.I am so glad that I found a spot that carries it again.

column9: Wonderful Seasoning people aren't aware of!
column10: I found this seasoning at Sam's Club and now they don't carry it anymore and I can't find it anywhere else....ugh!  I use it in all kinds of foods including meats I do in the crockpot for burritos, tacos, etc. and include it as part of my BBQ rub.  It also goes great in mashed potatos with a generous amount of parmesan cheese!  I think it's not as popular as other spices and seasonings only because it's so hard to find and people aren't aware of it.  I'm sure if more people knew about it and purchased it, it would be easier to find.  If you find it anywhere, I suggest you give it a try because it's a great spice to have on hand for just about anything you would like to have that great southwest taste.  It's way more flavor then heat, so if you can't handle hot, don't worry!  If you like hot, just had some raw jalepeno....lol!  I love this stuff and if I can find it anywhere, will purchase a few jars to keep on hand because I luv it so much and it's so hard to find.  I suggest if you find it, you do the same because once you try it, I'm sure you'll be hooked too :-)
I love Tone's Southwest Chipotle seasoning.  I use it in my barbeque rub, on all kinds of meat, and it makes great southwestern chipotle dip.

Found this back at Sam's Club for about $8 a jar. Stocked up on it. The taste is amazing. Not too hot, slightly smoky with an excellent balance.  You can use it like season salt or combine with oil for a wet marinade application.

Some reviews complain this product has no heat. I say it has no chipotle. The ingredients list doesn't mention chipotle, just red peppers. This mixture doesn't look, smell, or taste like chipolte. It tastes and smells like cumin. I tried it on a piece of fish, and the cooked seasoning had no flavor at all. It does have a lot of salt--440 grams of  sodium per teaspoon. Over all, this purchase was a dead loss.

We love this seasoning - in burritos, in chili, in whatever we want some smokey ZIP.  First purchased at SAMS CLUB ages ago, but they don't stock it any longer.  Relieved to find it through Amazon, and bought one to give to a friend so that they, too, will get hooked!
Very good.  Chipotle seasoning's a necessity around here but not always easy to find.
this is the bomb the best seasoning for chipolte. I try it on a lot of different foods as an experiment and it is good.  Try it on scalloped potatoes

I have been searching everywhere for this item and have not been able to find it after buying it once at a wholesale store here in Florida. Finally I found it here on amazon ordered it and it was delivered within 4 days of ordering the product. Great service!
I really like this stuff! We had only one can of it and we used it all up. But I can't find it anywhere now. Great stuff! I would recommend it to best friend!God bless!

Delicious seasoning and essential for any dishes.Mothers recommend it,wives love it,ladies cherish it.Just remember "the clearer,fastest and no-tolls route to a man's heart is..........." and think of Tones Southwest Chipotle Seasoning.

I bought this spice with high hopes of enhancing my low and slow cooking.  This product has no heat and adds a disgusting flaovr profile to every dish I have prepared.  I can't emphaisis this fact tt has no heat.Best Wishes
Great spice, Great RIP OFF!! I could have brought this for $5.00 and did know what was going on and got RIP OFF for $50.00 for a $5.00 bottle of spice. Will never buy anything on AMAZON.COM!!
This is one of the best tasting green teas I have found and I have been drinking it several years now. I can always find it on Amazon at a reasonable price.

I normally love these truffles.  I waited until fall to buy these, being scared they would melt during shipping in the summer.  However, these have obviously sat around for a long time somewhere too  warm.  The truffles are entirely coated with that white film that happens when chocolate is stored somewhere too warm.  And the centers which should be soft are instead hard and dried up.  Tastes nothing like the ones you buy fresh in the store.  Horrible.

I love Lindor Truffles, but these are in terrible shape. Old (boxes were only 2 months from expiration), the chocolate is all white, and the texture is wrong (probably from sitting around in a hot warehouse too long as suggested by the reviewer above me.I'll update my review when Amazon gets another supplier...

I strongly suspect this caviar, which is widely available in US supermarkets is a reason for fear of caviar in 90% of American population. This product only resembles real caviar in shape and color (artificial). It would not qualify for caviar in Europe. It's from the wrong fish, it has totally wrong taste, and it also has whole periodic table on the label. It's like dying chicken breast into red color, marinating it in steak souse, and selling it as New York Strip Steak...Real caviar doesn't come from lumpfish, and real caviar only have two ingredients - caviar and salt. Try Red Pearl Salmon Caviar if you want to try caviar. You can easily find it on Amazon and other places online.

I ordered this product because it was slightly less expensive than the brand that I'd ordered previously. Neither had received rave reviews and I was pleased with the other brand but thought I'd give this a try and save a few bucks, and the packaging looked a bit higher end. WRONG. The other brand (Roland Black Whole Grain Lumpfish Caviar, 2-Ounce (Pack of 4) )is far superior to the Romanoff brand. As other reviews stated, there are many undisclosed additives, and it had a nasty green slimy texture.  Even mixed with egg salad, it had a terrible aftertaste. Ate it about an hour ago and still feel queasy. Spring for the extra five bucks and get the Roland brand if you want an affordable indulgence.Amazon was GREAT about this. They credited me the full value toward my purchase of the Roland, as the Romanoff product isn't returnable since it is a grocery item. Still loving Amazon!

I sent one review when I received product to say that the box was different that on order page ( PURPLE STRIPE instead od GOLD).  Now I know to read all reviews before buying.  I guess ROMANOFF has changed product.  Awfull !!!!!!! Why change a good thing.  Who eats sweet tasting caviar, and what the heck am I going to do with 6 more jars of this @%@%.
Love this on a toasted bagel with cream cheese and scallions or even dill, great way to enjoy caviar and not break the bank.
these landjaegers are great I've ordered them twice already, the trouble is my friends think they are the best so they do not last very long, it's hard to quite eating them and the shipping is fast.

Arrived as expected and just as it looks and without damage. I immediately made up 2 batches of soy milk in my SoyaJoy (which I dearly love).  Then it was a breeze using this nigari to curdle the soymilk, strain it and put it in my TofuExpress press (which I also dearly love).  In about 2 hours in the fridge I had a super firm block of yummy tofu that has a wonderful texture and flavor I can't get from the store bought stuff.  Makes the best tofu burger in the world. I will never go back to the store brands, even the organic handmade ones.  Also... I just tried a nifty little trick for the tofu burgers today.  Right after I curdle the soy milk and strain it off I stirred in some soy sauce and a big shake of Mrs. Dash original seasoning. Then I pressed the block of tofu. When I fried up the slices for the burgers in a hot skillet with a bit of safflower oil the aroma was great. I put that on homemade whole wheat bread with all the hamburger trimmings and some crunchy dill pickle spears. What an excellent lunch meal!  I will be buying this item again for sure!Also... from what I hear you get some extra Magnesium from this in your tofu which is great for your health. Our diets and modern lifestyle don't supply as much magnesium as we need to be getting and supplements of magnesium don't work like they say they do.  So every little bit you can get is better for you.  Compared to the other coagulators you can use for tofu, this one seems to be the healthiest and most bioavailable form of magnesium.  I heard one guy say that he makes a huge batch of tofu and after straining puts the liquid leftover into a foot massager unit.  He said the heat, massage and soaking in the magnesium salts draws impurities out of your body.  He swears he learned that in Japan and they have been doing it for a long time.  You learn something new every day!

Rooibos tea has been used for centuries in South Africa.  Not only does it taste really great, it is also good to help induce sleep AND it works to help calm an aching stomach and abdomen.  Whenever me or my kids complain of that good ole *stomach ache*, I immediately brew them a cup.  You can also reuse the Kcup a second time, and even a third though the third will be a little weak, making this a great bargain.  Off topic of the Rooibos, the mint tea can also be used twice in the machine with very little difference in taste.  Both can be used on the largest setting with no loss of taste.  I highly recommend this tea both for it's lovely unique taste AND its medicinal properties.  Enjoy!

column9: Comparison with Bigelow Asian Pear Rooibos
column10: I love all rooibos tea as a decaf wind-down in the evenings (incidentally I've heard South Africans pronounce it closer to roy-bos with a long O). I started out with the Bigelow Asian Pear Rooibos and loved it but thought I would take one for the team and try this one too. To my taste, this is less sweet, less woody and more earthly - I prefer the Bigelow but this might be a better choice for black tea drinkers.

column9: A very tasty tea with an unique and pleasing flavor
column10: My oldest daughter really likes this tea and seems to believe that it is better for her than a lot of other teas on the market.  I like the fact that it is caffeine free and has a tea-like taste.  I have been drinking Celestial Seasoning's Sleepy Time herbal tea at night when I want something hot to drink but it is a little light so I decided to try the African Rooiobos tea for myself. I like the flavor, it is a medium-bodied tea with a little bit of bite.  It won't replace my Earl Grey but when I want a flavorful cup of tea without the buzz this is a good choice (I brew it using the smallest cup size on my Keurig B70 about 5oz.).Celestial Seasonings K-cups Sleepytime Herbal Tea, 24-count Boxes (Pack of 2)

column9: A Great Tea for a Change of Pace
column10: Rooibos tea is definitely a departure from the mundane taste of black tea.  It has a much different, though still very pleasant, taste than one might initially expect.  It also has a very unique aroma and serves as an excellent complement to any good meal.  The fact that it is naturally free of caffeine also means that it is great as an evening tea to calm the nerves and avoid the energy rush of caffeine-containing teas that could lead to difficulty getting to sleep.  I must also say that, like other k-cup tea varieties, it is also well balanced and tastes similar to tea prepared in the customary manner.  Overall, this is a very drinkable and, through the use of a k-cup, very convenient tea for seasoned tea drinkers and newcomers alike.

The African Rooibos tea worked well for the Keurig coffee machine. Some teas tend to taste burnt because the machine makes the water too hot for green or black tea, but this red tea almost always came out nice. It is also pleasant to drink at any time since it is naturally caffeine free. And of course the single serving k-cups with the machine makes the experience so much more convenient than brewing a whole pot of tea for one person.

I grew up in South Africa drinking rooibos tea. We have purchased loose leaf tea and it is the best flavor. THese cups come close. They are a little weak for my liking, but taste better than the flavored varieties. This product is now a mainstay in our home. The K-cup convenience is unbeatable.

column4: M. Park "Mom of 4 boys & a girl"
column10: A friend had recommended Rooiobos tea and I searched for one available via K-cups.  This one is delicious!  It's a dark tea that really taste like a dark tea rather than green tea which although I like can sometimes seem like an underbrewed tea.  Fabulous that it is naturally caffeine free too.  Perfect for the late afternoon when I want a cup of tea, but don't want the caffeine.

I enjoyed this tea very much.  For the reviewer that was disappointed about it being decaffeinated, all Rooibos tea is naturally that way.  It's drank by many people for that reason, including expectant mothers.  I'm sorry you had an unpleasant experience because of it :(

I ordered this on someone's recommendation and it is a wonderful tea.  I cannot believe how flavorful and rich this tea is.  Everyone here at work has changed over and the four boxes I order (which I thought would last at least 2/3 months) have only lasted 3 weeks.  Enjoy

Love it. The flavor, hmm.... I do not have the exact words to describe it. I like a strong flavor coffee, and this has a nice strong flavor. I also find green and herbal teas soothing, and the rooibos has that also. It's not coffee, and it's not tea, but it does have some of the characteristics of both. No caffiene, so when I want a coffee late in the afternoon or in the evening, then this is my go to drink.If you're keurig machine has different size options, I usually go with the 10oz size. I found 12oz too weak. I never tried the smaller size options, so I do not know how strong it will be with the smaller sizes.It does stain your cup. But, I once read that if it doesn't stain, then you're not drinking authentic rooibos tea.I will buy again.

column9: Good - BUT very strong and not going to buy again
column10: Not really our cup of tea.  Worth trying once, but will not be ordering again.  It was interesting, but the flavor was too intense for us to find really enjoyable.  At least it is caffeine free.

column9: African Rooibos Tea is different & good!
column10: This tea which actually contains no tea is a good, decaf alternative.  Nice flavor and light red color to enjoy.
This is one of the best tasting caffeine free teas I have ever had; keurig, bag, or loose leaf.  Would recommend it to anyone.
K-cup brewing system makes this wonderful tea become superb. Twinings got it just right.It comes out sweet and flavorful. A nice end to a long day.
Caffeine free, smooth, soothing aroma and taste.  And to tak it a step further, if you spice it up with the right cream, it can't be beat.  This is a must have. Recommend this over any other tea.
I though the flavor was very weak, need to use 2 pods to get the strength I usually have with loose leaf. Will go back to brewing in my 2 cup tea pot.Deliver of tea was timely. Thank you!
This is a very mild flavored "tea." It doesn't need any sweetener, so it's a great caffeine-free alternative for any time of the day or night.

We've been drinking Rooibus tea since discovering it in Africa many years ago.  Now, with a Keurig, I've been ordering all sorts of tea and was pleased when this rooibus was offered.  I thought it would taste o.k. but sort of ho-hum/nothing special.  Well, I was wrong! This tea is an absolute zinger (to borrow the title of another tea). The taste is great and we've been drinking it at every opportunity.
I enjoy the Twinings Brand Tea, it always has great flavor. I had never had African Rooibos Tea before and enjoyed it's mild flavor and taste.

column9: Twinings World Tea, African Rooibos Tea, 25-Count K-Cups For Keurig Brewers (Pack of 2)
column10: This is an excellent tasting tea.  One of the reasons that I purchased it was because it is naturally decaffeinated.  The tea was delivered quite promptly as well.  If you are a tea drinker, I would highly recommend this.
This is my absolute favorite tea!!  It is very smooth.  I drink hot in the winter with a little vanilla creamer and cold in the summer. I always try to keep this on hand.

column9: Not like herbal tea at all!
column10: I bought this hoping to find something different, but not too different. This was great! I do not like herbal teas, so it had to be really good for me to like it. I do not use any sweeteners or milk/cream. It tastes a lot like regular tea to me.
This is a really awesome tea, it's generally sweet enough so you don't need to add sugar or sweetener.

They are not kidding about a unique taste!  This stuff tastes like soapy mud!  I am a bit of a tea connoisseur, familiar with some of the different tastes, but this stuff falls into the category of dirty carpet cleaning water.  Don't waste your money--now what am I going to do with 49 K-cups?  No wonder they are lowering the price!  My husband actually gagged....
I was a little disappointed that the tea was caffeine free.  I didn't find that in the description anywhere but other than that it was ok.

I looked these Halo pumpkin dental chews up on Amazon to see reviews.  I also read the ingredients on them, and found they were wholesome good food products that I would want my dogs eating.  I went by my local animal food store and bought two of these chews for the 25-60Lb size.  One was for my 20lb jack russell who is an avid chewer and the other was for my 40lb aussie/heeler.  Great ingredients.  Since this size has 85 calories a piece, I needed to give only half to the jack.  I gave the jack the half one and the aussie the full one.  Wow, were they hard.  Problem was my jack wanted the whole thing in his mouth while he tried to chew pieces off which he couldn't really.  So I thought uhoh I better get the rest away from him but if he thinks I am coming to take it he will gulp it.  So I distracted him with squirt cheese and took half of the half away.  The aussie promptly gulped the rest of hers fearing I was going after hers too.  So where these were great that they were hard so they actually had to chew on them, maybe not for gulpers.  The dogs seemed very happy with the taste and smell.

My dogs eat nothing but Halo brand dog food because it has all REAL ingredients and they love it!  The treats and chews are just icing on the cake for them.  It's their favorite!  I know they love it and that it's good for them so I can feel good about feeding them Halo!

I was given a couple of these as a gift for my dogs.  I always read the label and make sure that the dogs chews/treats/food is made in the USA and wholesome products.  The ingredients look healthy and today  I gave one to my senior wire fox terrier to keep him occupied at my office.  He went though it in record time and vacuumed up the crumbs as well.  A four paws up from here. Giving only four stars because I still don't know the outcome of today's chew!

I was quite impressed by these chews!  My dog is allergic to almost everything, so a lot of dental chews are out, but these have very few ingredients that are allergens and my dog just loves them!  The pumpkin one also helps with her digestion (pumpkin always has a way of doing that!)  They are definitely tough to chew, but my 15-pound dog is quite the chewer so she's in heaven!
My Chow girl Anaya loves these & they are made in the USA. Always a plus with so many treats that are made in China! YUCK.....

I am impressed by Halo's products, although the canned food variety is the only thing I had previously tried, when I was babying my dog while she was recuperating after her spay surgery. I can feel good about feeding her such wholesome food, and she devours it. This was my first time buying Halo treats. Even though the package says they're for dogs 25-60 lbs, my 17 lb, one year old terrier mix is still in the puppy stage and is an avid chewer. I was looking for a product to change it up from the old reliable rawhide, for something she would not demolish in 5 minutes, and something different than meat-flavored treats (for variety). I was unsure if she would go for the pumpkin flavor, but this was an instant hit! She LOVES the taste of these treats and has no problem chewing them. I gave her a whole stick and she worked on it (kept her occupied) for about 45 minutes until it was completely gone. They smell really good, like pumpkin pie spice, and although they are dark brown in color, they do not stain like some of the red-colored rawhide products I've tried. I have gone through half the bag so far (7 sticks in a bag), giving her one every few days, and she really enjoys them. I am definitely buying these again, and I am going to try the mint variety and see if that's a winner too. I'd recommend that even if you have a small dog, give them a try to switch up your choice of hard chew treats if your puppy or dog is a big chewer.

column9: Our Mini Aussie loves Halo Spot's Chew!
column10: Our 1 year old pup loves these things! They are a bit harder to break like the previous review stated but the whole stick is actually perfect size for our Mini Aussie (med. size dog). The leave his breath smelling minty fresh! Also the heart shape is a cute touch.Too bad our local Petco stopped carrying these all of the sudden, but thank goodness for Amazon :)

Halo truly is a great brand, natural and healthy. My only drawback for these are that if you have a smaller dog they are very hard to chew and break up for them it seems as my dog is having trouble with them. They are good though an stick by this product as well as the seller!

These have great ingredients and smell so good, I wanted to eat it lol. However they are really hard so if your dog isn't a big chewer, like mine, it's not such a good idea. Brownie stopped trying after 30 minutes. So these are going to be donated to the animal shelter. These are for medium to large dogs, not so much for small dogs unless they're really aggressive chewers.

column9: Our dog loves these minty chews
column10: We've tried other Halo products previously and have been happy so we thought we'd give this one a try.We first bought these at our local pet supply store when we ran out of Paragon toothbrush chews one day.  It turns out that our 15lb pom mix loves Spot's Chews and they smell great to us as well.  The only issue is that it's a lot of chew for a small dog, although they are labeled as being for "small/medium" pets.  They are hard to break so my husband was slicing them into thirds with a knife and we'd give a third of a chew a day.One cute thing is that if you look at them top down, they are actually shaped like hearts.

column9: Very tough and come apart in large chunks
column10: I worried that my dog would swallow one of the chunks that came off the stick whole. It looks very dangerous! I gave my dog one and threw the rest away, as a precautionary measure.

Amazon sent them with 'ice' packs, very heavy ones, placed ON TOP of the boxes of delicate chocolates!!They were not only crushed, but the styrofoam was so thin that the ice packs completely melted and were useless by the time they got here, even though I brought them inside the minute they arrived.The boxes of chocolate were crushed.If it's over 75 degrees where you are, don't bother to order them. They're not returnable.
These are great truffles. We have a Lindt store locally but the price for this 60-count box is far less expensive. The box of individually wrapped chocolates arrived cool and dry.

The chocolates arrived ruined.  It is clear that they were stored hot and somewhat melted, were then placed on ice and frozen and shipped in ice packs.The result:  A wonderful chocolate ruined since the smooth filling remained hard on thawing....these turned into bad Hersheys with this handling.The company should give up on providing the product, since they ruin it with their handling.(PS...one box was crushed).
The chocolates had melted because of the temperature they must have traveled in. Hence each piece is a distorted mess to open with fingers and all all soiled. Never again !

The current price for a 5-ounce (12-count) bag at your local store is about $3.79.  That comes to about 32¢ per truffle.  This package is for two 60-count boxes for about $50, which comes to 42¢ per truffle.  Duh.

column9: Excellent as wedding favors... but be home when these arrive!
column10: I used these to fill small boxes as wedding favors.  The wedding favors were beautiful, inexpensive, and delicious!  The price on Amazon was far better than what I could get even at my local [...] wholesale.  I live in Florida and ordered these in AUGUST of all times.  The box sat out on my shady but hot patio from 1 PM until 7 (I didn't realize the package was coming early).  Some of the truffles at the bottom of one box were melted, the other box was fine.  The truffles came in a very large box packed with Styrofoam and gel ice packs, but after several hours in 95 degree heat, some of the truffles were still a little damaged.  I think these are an excellent price, but consider the season in which you plan to order.  If you can't plan to be home in the hot season, this is not your best option.  Out of all 120 truffles total, probably only 10 or 12 were unusable.  Overall, this worked out great for me.PS. I found my favor boxes here: [...]  The small ones for 60 cents each are big enough for two of these Lindor Truffles.

I ordered the Lindt Lindor MILK chocolate package for my wedding for 2 reasons: First, I love milk chocolate, Second, the wrapper matched my wedding decor.  I wasn't shipped MILK chocolate, I was shipped Rasberry Chocolate...in a Pink wrapper.  Didn't have time to re-order for my wedding and thus couldn't give away my wedding favors to my guests.  Little detail to some, very sad detail to a bride.  How hard is your job?  Read Milk chocolate, SHIP milk chocolate.  Thanks a lot guys.
I try to get gluten-free products when I can. I thought I'd give this a try being that I like ponzu sauces. It's a decent, good sauce but I had to pay too much to ship it. Will try to find locally.

column9: Exactly I haven't had in years
column10: Crazy Hair has been a craving of mine for a while and this purchase made my day. Got it very fast and am very happy with it! Might buy more soon :)

I wanted a natural flavoring for use in home-made seltzer. This powder works well and has a nice flavor. It will cause a slight haze in the seltzer. This is probably due to the hard water I use to make the seltzer. If you used distilled water I believe the water will remain clear. The haze is tolerable in my experience. The flavor is great and that is what I wanted.

Product has correct aroma and taste but lacks proper cook-time to be tender. I prefer the now discontinued DROMEDARY brand from Moody Dunbar. I'll either have to cook them some more or just give them away. From a 58 year pimento user.
This is the worst flavor out of the three I've tried. The best is strawberry(fresa) and watermelon is pretty alright.
NOT the best flavor....did not taste like mango at all.  Some of the other flavors are much better.  Edible, but barely :)

I was a little iffy on trying this one, but my fiance talked me into it. I'm glad he did. I love this stuff! I wish it came in a bigger pack. We ordered this with several other K-cup products, and this one is my favorite. In fact, it's almost gone.
I have searched high and low for this product. and it as worth it. For me, I just have to add a sweetener and it is fine,I will order more. I cannot find this cider in any store, Thank you.
This just arrived and I must say this is very very good, not as good as you get from the farm but damn close!
This drink is a very good drink. With it being a hot eay to make cup of total enjoymet it makes me glad I got it.
I love the apple cider in these k cups and offer them to all who enter in our home!  YUMMY!

Absolutely delightful.  I love it.  Bought four boxes afraid it might disappear after the Holiday Season.  Delighted to see it remains on sale.  I want it always on the shelf.  I love it hot, plan to try it over ice this summer.
The Hot Apple Cider is wonderful!  Be sure to shake the K cup before making the cider.  Perfect blend!

I am happy and sad that this just wasn't a bit sweeter, but I don't need any extra sugar anyway.  It smells great brewing and tastes good.  I bought this for my husband, and he is happy with the flavor. I especially like that it is all natural, no chemicals, artificial flavors or colors.

This was an excellent purchase. The product itself was a perfect blend making it smooth and easy to drink. The service of the seller was great and very fast. I would recommend this seller without hesitation.
Being a Southerner, I have enjoyed real apple cider. This is nowhere near in taste.  Very weak...don't know what to do to make it better.
Tastes just like apple cider from a jug. I even ate some of the apple sauce left over not bad. Easy to use in my Cuisinart coffee machine.

Having just purchased the Keurig coffee maker and not being a coffee drinker (husband is), I was looking for other options and came across the Hot Apple Cider cups.  WOW!  Just as delicious as if it had been warming over an open fire.  Also love the teas, I make a large glass of iced tea and it only takes a minute.

This is a tasty alternative to coffee and tea in my Keurig brewer.  While not overly potent, it has more than enough flavor to please me.  A major perk is that it still tastes good if it goes cold.  I would definitely recommend this item if you enjoy apple juices.  :-)
This was pretty good apple cider, but had to add a little more sugar.  If you like a little tartness, you will like this.
It is a nice change to drinking something hot, it is ok but coffee is the junk for the morning brew!!!

I read the reviews. I read the ingredients list. I thought I hit it all.....Tried it at last and got ripped off by1.) Price is double that of other websites; amazon for shame on you!2.) Sucralose - discovered when experiments with chlorine compounds to produce new pesticides was tasted by a human. Ummm...it wasn't on the list of ingredients! I tried it once and noticed it right away, picked up the box and there it is, sucralose. I threw this away, the bitter taste AND aftertaste isnt worth it. I don't care how much brown sugar they say they added, you cant put both together and expect a postive result.Dont buy this unless you want a bitter taste and the sure to be in your near future-health problems with cancerous after effects of chlorinated fake sugar.....
THIS IS GOOD BUT LEAVES RESIDUE IN BOTTOM OF CUP.  I RETURNED THECOFFEE MAKER AS IT WOULD NOT WORK FOR ME.  KERUIG COFFEE MAKER

This is my least favorite Kuerig K-Cup purchase.  The swill tastes like wood shavings.  the left over pulp in the K-Cup smells horrid.  I added two teaspoons of sugar to get it drinkable.  Will never purchase again.

column9: Cider is wonderful, be careful with pricing..
column10: This cider has a very nice and sweet taste. While I highly recommend the cider, the vendor currently offering it through Amazon has it priced at roughly double the price that Amazon typically offers kcups.

I agree with Texas Mom and would recommend that you check your local Bed, Bath and Beyond. I was able to buy a box of 16 for about 10 dollars.You may also want to check out other online vendors. Most of them will sell the cider for list price. Most k-cups will average in price from about 50 cents to the high of 70 cents each. From this vendor, the cider k-cups are about $1.60 each, instead of .68 cents each from vendors like Bed, Bath and Beyond. I would recommend that you shop around for the best deal.

These apple cider k-cups are great. Rather than just use a powder with artificial apple flavoring and sugar, the k-cup contains real apple grounds with brown sugar and a couple other simple ingredients. Very happy with this product.
This price is a rip-off--it is DOUBLE the price charged on the Keurig and Green Mountain websites.  Shame on you Amazon for endorsing this price by making it eligible for Amazon Prime.

I looked at these at a different website where they showed the nutritional value ... it is pretty high carbs for a small drink.  I'll just keep using the packets I get from the store that come sugar-free.  I love the ease of kcups but just can't afford all those carbs ... crossing fingers they make SF apple cider kcups!

Pros:  Super delicious, great to have for non-coffee drinkers, tastes like apple pie w/ ice cream if you add a little french vanilla creamer-- yum, smells awesome while "brewing"Cons:  A dollar each?  Really?  And when I purchased mine from Amazon (because I couldn't find them anywhere in town), they were about $30 for 24 k-cups (currently, they're at $24/24).  Compared to your other non-coffee options, the per-cup cost of these gems is just silly.  I realize they're a novelty, and apparently not carried in any retail store anywhere in North Texas-- but I can't make a habit of dropping thirty bucks on novelty beverages...

I purchased these k-cups yesterday from Bed Bath & Beyond for $10.00. (not sure why they are more than double on Amazon.com) They are delicious! I added some Archer Farms Coffee Caramel and it was better than Starbucks Caramel Apple Cider!

I tried these out last weekend just as the temps have started to dip and I was not disappointed! I expected a very fake and chemical tasting brew but was pleasantly surprised that I got neither! I was very happy to ready that there are no artificial ingredients in this one too! This is a great alternative for when you want something different from coffee and tea. If I had to point out anything bad about them, maybe that the flavor is almost too sweet? If you brew it on your smallest cup setting (mine is 5oz for the Keurig B60 Special Edition) it is a tad tooo strong but in the medium size offerning its just right.  I hate having to buy 2-packs though...

I bought this cider last night and Bed, Bath, and Beyond (16 cups for $10.99 and used a 20% off coupon-GREAT DEAL!)  However, the taste to me isn't as good as Starbucks caramel apple cider....it's good but not great.
I was delighted with the flavor of the hot apple cider, nicely spiced, no sugar, and splendid!  Highly recommend.

I have enjoyed this cider.  I like it when I have come inside from feeding the birds or shoveling snow.  It warms me up.  It has a sweet but tangy taste that I like.  The 4 rating is because of the price.
These became a quick favorite of my family. I bought them on a whim and they have turned out to be one of my better decisions.
This tastes watered-down and weak, (even on the small cup setting) with an fake taste to boot!  I thought the convenience of hot apple cider from the Keurig was a great idea, but this isn't worth it.

The aroma while brewing was great, but the actual drink felt watered down. I recommend using the 2nd smallest brewing size on a Keurig Platinum - the taste was still a little off, but decent.I peeled the K-cup open after brewing to see the contents and it looked like apple sauce more or less. Keurig boasts that the cider is all natural with no artificial flavors or preservatives so I was curious. The ingredients however do list organic malic acid and Reb A, which is a stevia extract. I dislike any kind of substitute sweeteners, so that could be why the taste was off for me.For any Weight Watchers followers out there, each K Cup is 2 points because of the 20 grams of carbs.

Im a big K cup drinker. I have tried a lot of coffee and hot chocolate, teas etc. Im not sure if its the kerig cups or the Kerug brewer but these apple cider k cups never come out quite right. Once in a while ill get one that tastes ok. But mostly they taste like apple water. Ive tried them in other relatives brewers and have the same results. Ive tried shaking the k cup up before brewing to loosen the granules. Its like drinking flavored water. Id stick to the packages next time they are much more flavorful and much less expensive.

Can get it for half this price and no shipping on othe sites.  Look around and you will find them.  Start with Green Mountain directly.  Flavor is very good.  Just be careful giving to kids directly from the Keurig.  They brew at 192 degrees F.

I like the product, but it's way too expensive on Amazon. Keurig's website has a much better deal on these, and they have a club discount.  I buy from Amazon all the time and would like to see them start a club for K-Cups. More and more Keurigs are being sold, and the demand is only going to increase.
Was not very good. Disppointing since I was hoping for something for the younger members of the family and non coffee drinkers to enjoy. Better to use the water feature and dried pkg apple cider mix.
I love the taste of this k-cup. Highly recommend to add a little bit of cinnamon. It will taste even better.However, this apple cider k-cup is twice the price compared to other k-cups.

I purchased these as a change-up to our inventory of teas, coffees and cocoas my wife and I drink during the cold winter months.I've read other reviews regarding price. Although I won't include price into my rating, I will say that an item is only worth whatever someone will pay for it. As for these, I waited until Amazon had a sale and pulled the trigger. I got them for around $.75/k-cup.As for the cider k-cups themselves, I am pleased with them overall.  As with some of the cocoa k-cups, the larger setting on the Keurig machine produces a more watery result but this doesn't seem to affect the hot cider flavor as much as it does the hot cocoa.Flavor-wise, I'd compare the largest setting flavor to a green tea. Light and not overpowering, but the flavor is there.With the smaller Keurig settings, the cider has a more robust flavor and is perfect for being creative and mixing in other things. My personal favorite is a dash of cinnamon and a dribble of Irish wiskey.I'm giving this 4 stars because I think that these K-cup makers should be able to produce a K-cup that creates a consistent product at the larger Keurig settings, but I can't knock it too much because the lighter, more diluted tasing cider can be very enjoyable at times too.

these k cups are way over priced. double what keurig is selling them for. the actuall cider is good, but the vendor sucks. if you find that keurig is out of stock of these, try bed, bath, and beyond or this site: [...]. its about the same price as keurig. i buy alot of things from amazon, and bought some of these apple cider k cups when i got my keurig, not knowing any better about what prices to look for. now i know. do some searching online before you buy.

We love hot apple cider and this was no exception! My 9 year old drank 6 cups the very first day I got this.  It has a wonderful, fresh apple taste with just the right amount of spice.  We will be ordering this on a regular basis!
This cider tastes really good, but it shot my blood sugar way up!!  It may be all natural, but not good for diabetics.

I enjoyed a couple cups of this over the holidays, so I ordered two boxes for myself. The smell and taste are great, but I noticed that even though I really like the cider while I'm drinking it, I feel nauseous after every cup. Apparently, this is a common side effect of stevia. I typically don't use sugar-replacement sweeteners. so I wasn't familiar with stevia or that it wouldn't agree with me. Such a pity that Green Mountain had to add it because the cider would have been nice and tart with just the brown sugar and apples. Guess I'll have to go back to just coffee and tea. Too bad.
We had high hops for this K cup however when we got it, it tasted really nasty. The taste was off.
I really enjoy the taste of this product. I definitely plan on keeping this in my carousel as an option to enjoy during this cold winter.

Cider out of a little dry cup?  Yes.  It is not the same as fresh cider steeped with spices.  But it is just as nice in it's own way.  Smells like apple cinnamon oatmeal while brewing.  The taste is great, but don't stretch it too thin.  Standard mug size works well.  What's even better are the natural ingredients;  Dried apples, brown sugar, malic acid (good for you), and stevia (natural sweetener).  This is sure to be a winter staple at home.

Some of this cider came in the sample when we bought our Keurig machine. My wife liked it so much, we bought more.Coffee, tea, and hot chocolate are all things we drank before we had the Keurig machine. Hot cider was not. I'm no cider connoisseur, but this is good enough for me, and good enough that we'll always keep some stocked for cold days.

column9: Yum- Pretty Close to the Real Thing!
column10: I was pleasantly surprised when I tasted my first cup. I have a Kerig B60 and I set it on the middle cup size, and it was sufficiently strong enough. It tastes like authentic Apple Cider- very Good!  I made a cup on the larger cup size and it was a little more diluted, but still good.  Would I buy again...???... yes.

column9: Maybe I'm not a cider fan...
column10: Read all the reviews and decided to check this out since it seems like it's made with real apples and real sugar.While brewing, the aroma smelled amazing. However, my first sip left an icky taste.  The drink was way more tart than I liked and unfortunately there weren't any directions on what sized cup I should be brewing. (I made the large)  Added some light brown sugar, no change in sweetness or tartness.My wife said it tasted fine so maybe I'm just not a cider fan.  I could have sworn I've had it before and was fine with it - that and I'm a fan of every other apple based goods. (pies, juice, etc.)Probably won't buy again.

column4: My 2 Cents "A penny for your thoughts"
column10: As others have said, the quality is good but shop around. For some odd reason, the same cups can be purchased elsewhere for much less.

Very good taste if you like Apple Cider. Need to make this item in a spiced apple cider version. I try to look for less expensive places to buy this type of product, but what can I say, I am a fan of Amazon.com.

Just tried the Green Mountain Naturals Hot Apple Cider K-Cups for the first time and I have to say I was pleasantly surprised!  The initial sip is very sweet, almost like biting into a tart green apple, but as soon as the liquid slides down your throat, there is a nice pleasant semi sweet aftertaste.  The smell is out of this world, it just screams "FALL"!!  The smell and taste make me feel as though I'm sitting on a porch swing of a country home watching the leaves change color and the kids play in the yard.The reason I gave it four stars instead of five is I think if I'm not totally in the mood for this, the initial sweet apple taste might bother me.  But overall I will purchase this again.I bought my K-cups from Bed Bath & Beyond, using my 20% off coupon, a 16-count for about $10.
I used to have to buy those packages of instant cider for my husband. The GM Apple Cider is a perfect blend, not overly sweet or bitter, and easy to make.  Love the product

I was really looking forward to trying these Hot Apple Ciders. When they finally came in season, I picked up a box. As soon as I received it, even though it was summer, I eagerly brewed my first cup.First off the cider SMELLS great. You can smell all of the spices in the cider that make cider taste good and it will make your kitchen smell amazing.I brewed my first mug with 8oz of water and found the flavor to be not as strong as the smell. I brewed subsequent mugs with 6 oz. of water and those tasted a bit stronger and were much more cider-y.Overall, it's a good cider, but I definitely recommend using less water to make sure you get to enjoy the nice cider flavor.

We love our Keurig machine.  The apple cider is a great addition to the usual coffee and tea.  This is good cider, too.  We prefer it with the larger cup size because it is too sweet when more concentrated.  But I am sure everybody's taste is different.

column9: Sweet, But Hits The Spot On A Cold Night
column10: This Hot Apple Cider is really good, but sure is sweet.  If you don't like coffee, hot chocolate or tea, this is the perfect choice for you on a really cold night.  If you don't like sweet drinks, you can also "Irish It Up" if you choose to and it will tame down the sugary taste.  It's good either way.

If you have read some of my other k-cup reviews, I am not a big coffee fan but I do love my Keurig maker! This tastes very good, but I have learned to make it on the middle or low setting as like most k cups, this tastes very watered down. I can't really taste the difference from store bought apple cider that you make in the microwave. I do however love the convince of the k-cups for my maker! This is a perfect treat on a cold winter or fall day, I also enjoy the apple flavor on a warmer spring or summer day!
If you have ever been in the country on a cold fall evening, then you know the taste and smell of real Apple Cider. This reminded me of getting done with a carriage ride or coming in from sledding.

I love this product. The Keurig is so versatile with what it can brew. I never would have thought of apple cider until I tried it. It seems to taste best on the medium cup setting on my Keurig Special Edition. The apple cider is just what you need to warm you up on a cool winter day.

column9: Superb Flavor- we just love it!
column10: I went out on a limb and purchased one box of Green Mountain Hot Apple Cider and was pleasantly surprised! The flavor is right on- not overly sweet but just perfect, where I don't have to reach for my Splenda. There is a subtle cinnamon flavor to it which I just love and a "true" apple taste- not a fake taste by any means. This is the perfect drink for cold winter nights when I do not want a cup of hot coffee. I try to keep a few on "reserve" for my friends and family who do not enjoy coffee. I've yet to meet someone who does not enjoy this cider.  I highly recommend you try this. However, I purchase direct from Green Mountain- as the prices are far better than Amazon. Sorry Amazon- as much as I love you, I've got to shop where the deals are.

I enjoy a hot drink on cold winter evenings. I don't like coffee or tea at night. I've been drinking hot chocolate, but this cider is a pleasant change. I had doubts about my first cup, expected a more "cider looking" drink. I was surprised by the real cider like taste of this product.

This is a great hot cider.  Whether you are just relaxing around the house or clearing the driveway from the most recent snowfall, this is a very refreshing cider.  It is hard not to drink it by the thermos-full.
This cider almost tastes like Green Apple.  It isn't too sweet and has a little tangy aftertaste.  Very good.
I have been looking everywhere for apple cider k cups.  Decided to check out amazon, and low and behold here they are.  They taste great, but as someone else mentioned they are a bit pricey.

This product is delicious.  I'm addicted to them.  I add a little more water when I don't want it too sweet.  They work either way.  I'm so glad it is starting to get cold again since this item is better during cold season.

We didn't like these.  My husband and I both love hot cider, but these taste watery and don't have much spice at all.  You could put a cinnamon stick in, or you could save your money and buy cider, because these are yucky...
I love this cider, keurig was out of it, probably because of the time of year.  My order came fast and in very good condition.  Thank you

After the first cup, I wasn't all that impressed with the flavor. I'm not saying it contains artificial sweetners, but to me it tastes like it does. I'll probably finish the box, but I doubt I'll be buying it again. Tastes are highly subjective, so I can understand the mixed reviews for this product.

column9: Great flavor but take note of freshness date printed on the product.
column10: I purchased this through Amazon Warehouse Deals. I bought two boxes for my mother. For $10 a package it was an excellent price. I understand these were returns to Amazon but it didn't look like it. It was in brand new unopened condition. I normally would give 5 stars except for one thing. The "best by" date listed July 30, 2012. I got it May 31, 2012. If it was 6 months I probably wouldn't worry but two months is a problem. So I dropped it to 3 stars. The price and the fact I still have two months saves it. I guess I will have to help my mom finish these off. Luckily they are pretty good. I may buy again from the seller since the price is good. Wish the "best by" could have been listed before I ordered.UPDATE (July 13, 2012) Bought again through Amazon but from  another seller, ezee llc (lindasproperties), for $17.10 per 24 pack. That was way more than my original order but my mom wanted more. Seeing it was close to the MSRP of $19.99, I was expecting to receive a product that had a better "best by" date. No, this time it was worse. The "best by" date is August 17, 2012. I have little over a month to go. Granted my mom will probably finish it within that time frame but this is unacceptable. I'm dropping the product rating to two stars due to unsatisfactory experiences with two different sellers. I should get at lest six months.UPDATE (October 24, 2012) I guess my mom goes through this quite quickly. I purchased through a seller on eBay for $17.95 per 24 pack on September 10, 2012. This time around I got a package that was well more than a year out for the "best by" date. So I guess I know now that this product actually has a good shelf life if purchased from a proper seller. I realize my star rating is harsh since it focuses on the seller not the product. The taste and flavor is excellent and I have definitely purchased and drank this multiple times when I am at my parents.
