column9: Very Smooth but Lacks the Kick
column10: This is probably one of the smoothest coffee's I have had the pleasure to drink.  The only problem (in my opinion) is the flavor.  I love dark/strong flavored coffee and even with my grinder set to fine ground, I still lack the strong flavor that I love.  It might be because of the equipment that I use - where I can only get but so much coffee in the container.  I use the Keurig B200 coffee maker (along with the my K cup dispenser filled to the max and packed), along with the Breville BCG800XL grinder.  Again - smooth coffee with no bitterness but lacks the flavor.

The coffee I received looked blended with something an had numerous burned beans and char. I have no hesitation calling it the worst Blue Mountain ever. I would NEVER buy from this seller again. A friend of mine bought some at the sane time I did and his package was the same. Dried out, burnt in some cases beans and a harsh stagnant flavor.
If you want to spend $40-$50 for a pound of coffee, so you can tell your friends you did, go ahead.  But, while very good, this coffee is no better than other "premium" coffees at $12 per pound.
I am personally not a coffee drinker but my husband is.  I bought this for his birthday.  What did he say? Smooth.  Thanks a great gift idea!

According to my sister she like this coffee.  I've tried it and think it's not the best coffee I ever tasted.  In fact, in thier discription this coffee was grown in different location than the original Jamaica Blue Mountain.  This may had an effect of the overall tast. This is not a bad coffee just not worth the price...

column9: Don't Believe The Hype Wallenford Jamaica Blue Mountain Coffee
column10: I waited impatiently for this coffee to come and didn't mind spending the bucks for it, but it was a big let down. We could barely taste the flavor. I was p@%*$@! I could have just bought the cheap version at the discount stores like T.J. Maxx or Marshalls! Hold on to your dollars it is not worth it! Take this from someone who has immaculate taste who all the Jones' tend to follow. Maybe I got a bag of baaaad BEANS!

I buy this product on the subscription program and send it to my daughter out of state.  Typical teenager periodically runs out of money before payday and it makes me feel better as a parent that while I won't just send her money - she at least has food at hand when needed.  And these granola bars fit the bill.The chocolate chip are the best.  I've ordered three times now over the past 10 months and every bar right down to the 12th box has been soft and chewy.  That 12th box has come at the 3-4 month mark at times.  SO, if you are concerned about the shelf life - at three different times these have easily lasted past 3 months.

column9: Too much filler material, but chocolate chip the best flavor
column10: I'm not a big fan of the new type of Quaker Oats granola bar; lot's of barley/rice filler material, not many oats.  However, the chocolate chip is the best tasting in my opinion- well, maybe it ties with the peanut butter chocolate chunk.  There are enough chocolate chips in the bar to give the moist fattiness that we all desire, yet the chocolate chips are small enough such that you don't feel too guilty eating them.  Maybe that's a bad thing, because it encourages you to reach for another.The granola bars seem a bit smaller than I remember, but there's plenty of flavor packed inside.  These aren't too healthy; still a lot of corn syrup (though no "high" fructose corn syrup as they stress), fructose, dextrose, hydrogenated oils, etc..  Not intended to be a meal replacement bar (unless you ate the whole box), but they're a tasty, traditional snack.

column9: do not contain High Fructose Corn Syrup
column10: I love Quaker Chewy bars in a couple different flavors, including chocolate chip. Mostly because they do not contain High Fructose Corn Syrup, and also because they provide a healthy in between meals snack.
I love bars in a couple different flavors, including chocolate chip. Mostly because they do not contain high fructose syrup, and also because they provide a healthy in between meals snack.
All of the bars are of course past the expiration date. It doesn't affect the taste, but makes the bars break apart easily.

I love it that I am able to purchase only the Chocolate Chip kind, instead of having to purchase a mixed bag that my kids will not eat.  They are just as good as the one's I buy at Fred Meyer; however, the price is much less and there appears to be no difference in quality.

A great tasting bar if you are in a hurry. We go through a lot of them. Walmart sells the same item in an 18 count box here in Michigan for $3.99. This is a lot better price than anything I have found online.
This was a great price on an item that my husband eats daily- a staple in our house.  Gave me an opportunity to stock up so he'd have them in the house.  They were great!
We go through these like water - actually faster than water.  So happy that we can buy them in bulk at a great price.  Thanks Amazon.

column9: Yummy bars my kids will eat!
column10: Amazon offers a good price on these quaker oats chocolate chip granola bars.  They are soft to chew and my kids really like them.  Perfect for lunches and snacks.

I've loved these things for years. They are great to have around as a quick snack or to grab one if you have to skip breakfast or something. It's nice to be able to buy them in bulk like this and just have them in the pantry. Good price too!
The Quaker granola bars are jam packed with low quality ingredients.  Too much sugar and offer very little hunger satisfaction when compared with the competition.  Double thumbs down.
Same as you get in supermarket but REALLY cheap.  Quality, taste were great.  No problem with any of them.  Still got few more boxes left but I would definitely order it from here again.

I have 3 cats. I bought this after I almost lost my male cat, Gary. My cats love it!!!!!!!!! They eat this so fast! I put it out for Gary and my two females cirlce around waiting for him to finish! I don't have the heart to tell the females this is Gary's special food! I let them all eat it. The females do what aI call "speed eating" they love it so much. Gary likes it best when I mix a little water in it and make it softer!

I had to put my cat on a strict diet because he was having problems with bowel disease.  I switched from meow mix to this and my cats devoured it!  Although, they did not like the (Holistic Select Duck and Chicken Canned Cat Food ), they just nibbled that one and walked away.  After switching foods my cats symptoms started clearing up.  I highly recommend this food and I'm sure your cats will love the taste!

column9: All three of my cat's rate it a BIG 10! 10! 10!
column10: Simon, about 7 years old has some kind of adversity to most foods and throws up shortly after eating canned or dry cat food and nearly died from, can you believe, bronchitis? ...2 years ago. We have gone through many foods, dry and canned until I found Holistic Select canned cat food(He gets the Salmon or Ocean Fish). He loves it...and does NOT throw it up!!! ...even tho he only gets about 2-3 teaspoons morning and night and not a lot of dry, 2 x's day. He somehow still manages to weigh 14 pounds.Bella, a mostly gray with white chest and paws, about 10 years old would most likely fit within the widest part of a 16 oz soda bottle, in other words she is soooo skinny ...and might I mention FINICKY!  Her biggest nick name is Princess. She "cautiously" walks up to a new food I put down, sniff's it and IF she likes it, adjusts her sitting position, sometimes moving to a different angle before she slowwwly starts nibbling. She USUALLY does NOT like them and has this look on her face that says "You've GOT to be kidding me if you think I will EAAAAT THAAAAT!!!!! EWWWWWW!!!". She stands back up, shakes her paw and glances at me as she runs/hops off like a deer into the woods. Bella IS the reason I tried the Holistic Select. When I put the HS down for her, my eyes nearly popped out of my head. She QUITE eagerly, without hesitation or any adjustment to her seating spot or angle dove in as if she had not eaten in a week or more. She will only eat the Salmon or Ocean Fish. I have tried the Duck and the turkey and "no way!" I would so like for her to gain at least one pound! I think she still weighs about SIX pounds and eats as much as a fly. To make sure she is the only one eating her food, I bought her a bird cage "dining room". She is the only one of the three cats that fits thru the entrance.Then there's Bob, a brown tabby! What about Bob is what we always say. Bob doesn't run from much and eats more than he runs from. The least picky, doesn't throw up and is, like Simon about 7 years old. They're best buds, btw. (Bob also nearly died about 2 years ago from liver disease.) Usually, Bob quietly hangs out by his bowl near the stove, tripping us or getting stepped on. Knowing he is going to get HS, he has frequently becomes quite vocal in anticipation of his "Happy" meal.I, THE cats so recommend trying Holistic Select. Petco, when they kept it ON their shelves, sold it for $2.49 a can(even if you buy a case of it!). They said they did not sell enough for them to stock it and encouraged me to order it thru their website. I always have to "shop around" and found it on Amazon for $1.90 a can. I'm IN and Petco is losing OUT! (Initially, I would encourage buying a can, if you can find it at petco to see if your cat will eat it. They will order some for you but u have to check back <they don't call you when it arrives!>, they just put it on the shelf and it disappears FAST). Once you know it's good to go, order online. If you do the Prime shipping thing on Amazon, most everything you buy is shipped free.Merry Christmas!~Yvonne

My cats really love Holistic Select canned food.  I have tried other quality brands and often they choose not to eat them for whatever reason. I have not had that happen with Holistic Select.  I read the ingredients and was pleased - which always determines my purchases.

We have an 18 year old cat and he had actually lost weight and didn't look too good.  At the time we were feeding him his usual excellent quality dry kibble.  However, when I added this canned food to his diet ( he gets a small amount 3 times a day along with his dry food) his health changed dramatically.  He added some weight and he looks so much better.  Holistic Select pet foods are top quality.

column9: Donate this to The Cat House on the Kings Sanctuary
column10: I ordered several cases of this as a donation to The Cat House on the Kings in Parlier, California...a non-profit, donation run, no-kill, no cage cat and dog sanctuary that was recently featured on Nat Geo Wild.  It's not cheap but I admire them for choosing the best quality cat food for their 700+ cats.

column9: Food Disappeared Immediately! Cats Loved It
column10: My Vet recommended feeding some wet food everyday to my cats instead of only dry food to help prevent kidney problems in later life. Two other cats developed kidney problems later in life and needed additional fluids everyday.  I have tried a variety of cat foods, but this is their all time favorite. I like it because it is a Holistic Blend of great ingredients that the cats love. It has a soft, blended, wet consistency. I still give them Halo Dry food, a small amount each day. Everyone who visits mentions how healthy their fur looks.

The place I adopted my cat from included a case of the Holistic Select wet food, and that's all he's been eating since I've had him -- for the last three years.  He's been doing great with the Duck/Chicken, and he likes all of the flavors, which I rotate, with no ill effects.  I would recommend this brand to anyone that wants to give their cat really nutritious food -- I refuse to feed my cats the commercial brands due to their questionable content.

My cat, Sterling, is a rather picky chap and, after trying what I thought were every affordable and healthy canned cat food in my area, I finally stumbled upon this one. My cat loves every flavor but turkey, though I doubt it's the brand, he just doesn't like turkey. Anyway, my usual pet store is sadly taking these off the shelves, so I supose I'll be buying it here. This food is well rounded and (according to my cat) delicious. He is a discerning fellow, after all.

My cats really love Holistic Select canned food. I have tried other quality brands and often they choose not to eat them for whatever reason. I have not had that happen with Holistic Select. I read the ingredients and was pleased - which always determines my purchases.

Desperation led me to try this food although I wasn't crazy about the brewers dried yeast or potatoes. I needed to try something without fish in it for my kitties when 2 of my 3 cats started to get flaky skin from food that did contain fish. I found it quite a challenge to find a good food that doesn't include some type of seafood.  As this one did not, I reluctantly decided to give it a try.  All 3 cats seemed to enjoy it, but I will not be buying it again.  Even though the moisture is only the usual 78%, it is so mushy and just awful to work with.  My girls didn't seem to mind, but between the consistency, yeast and potatoes this just doesn't cut it for my cats.  I'll have to be satisfied with fewer foods in their rotation.
While the shipment was quick...more than half of the cans in the shipment were dented.  One cat liked it after introducing several times... the other did not like it.

I have been talked into buying this by my one dog...I had recklessly given him a sample, not realizing it would alter his taste buds and make him REFUSE anything else (except of course human grade food). So he gets it and is very happy to eat it plain or lightly adorned with a canned dog food.It's breaking my budget but better than breaking my heart which is what happens when my dog doesn't eat.

First of all, I love pearl couscous much better than the "original", however,the purchase was definitely NOT a good deal!!!My mistake for not being more careful. 6ea 11oz jars for 26.00 is horrible,considering I previously purchased a 32oz jar at BJ's for 5.00!!!!!!The product is great, but be careful re jar size before you buy.

I don't review things unless I love them or hate them. I love this one.It's fairly flavorless, as you might expect from most pastas. It very quickly absorbs anything you cook it with. I prefer cooking it in vegetable or chicken broth! I love it, and (most importantly) my two-year-old daughter loves it. Great for a quick meal with some chicken and veggies.To summarize: Cooks quickly, absorbs flavors easily, and it's easy for me or my little daughter to eat.

My wife and I have started eating couscous quite a bit. This pack is a bit cheaper, and a little easier to prepare than some of the store brands. There really isn't much taste - so it really is just "tri color". But the texture after cooking is pretty good, and it absorbs the flavor of whatever sauce you want well.We do like this, but when the pack runs out we will have to do a bit more searching before reordering.
My order was filled quickly, product is wonderful but hard to find in local stores! My Grandchildren absolutely love this.

I love Cool Whip, but the sugar-free version has one gram of fat per serving (two tablespoons), while the fat-free version has a lot of sugar. The Calorie Control Whipped Topping Mix is a very nice substitute.I use 3/4ths of a cup of the topping mixture with 2 cups of liquid: if you use two cups of water, then 8 calories per serving (two tablespoons); if you use two cups of non-fat milk, then 12 calories per serving; if one cup water and one cup fat-free milk (which I usually do), then 10 calories per serving. Whichever you use, be sure to use a good mixer. Note that Cool Whip is 20-25 calories per serving.Now, standing alone, Calorie Control Whipped Topping is simply not as good eating as Cool Whip, hence the 4 star rating. Alone, it has a slightly sour taste. However, it does very well with puddings, ice cream, etc.Plus, I have vastly improved this whipped topping by adding some Vanilla Cream Liquid Stevia (sold here on Amazon) to the liquid before mixing. NOW it is excellent as a stand-alone topping! I have also used the Chocolate Liquid Stevia to make delicious chocolate-flavor topping.I recommend purchasing from Ediet from their website (I buy the topping by the case). Try the chocolate cheesecake mixture!Edited to add in response to comment: The Calorie Control Whipped Topping Mix comes in six ounce pouches (it is a powder). A `serving' is two tablespoons, with 128 servings per pouch (so says the information on the pouch).When I make a batch (using 3/4ths of a cup of mixture, and two cups of liquid, either milk or water or a combination thereof) I get a very large tub: I do not know how much, but easily equivalent to the large size tub of Cool Whip. Out of one pouch I can make two such tubs, with enough left for about half of another.It is certainly a lot cheaper than buying sugar-free Cool Whip. Again, the taste is not near as good as Cool Whip, but I always add liquid Stevia (such as chocolate-flavored).

This is a nice tea. However, it does not really taste like Jasmin, nor like Rose. It does have some pink rose petals,  but no white Jasmin flowers. It kind of reminds me a taste of a lipstick. it says it contains natural flavors, but I find it hard to believe in - the flavor is very strong and as I said, it does not taste like Jasmin or Rose. I am kind of disappointed. I bought a few different teas from this company, and although  most of them have a nice flavor, the company has some serious mix up about tea names. They taste nothing like description. Or they have a problem with adding too much artificial flavor (or is it natural in fact? what is it then?). So you basically can't taste the tea itself and only taste the flavor
Tea is full of rose petals instead of jasmine  white flowers. Taske like Roses too. I would  rather look at roses than drink them. Didn't care for it at all
I can not say enough good things about Davidsons Tea.  I have been buying for over a year, and the quality is always superb!  Great job.

It's not "real" cheesecake, so don't expect that luscious consistency or mouth feel. That being said, this is one of the best low carb/lower cal deserts I've had. It was very easy to make and set up very quickly, it's easy to customize and doesn't have an artificial sweetener aftertaste.

column9: Not sure what to title this
column10: I got these chocolates as a gift, and just wanted to let people know they turned out to be quite a hit. My friend's dad drinks a lot of coffee and loved these. My friend doesn't care for coffee and he loved them as well. I personally didn't like them because I could taste the coffee, which I don't like, but they are worth a try. Great for coffee lovers who enjoy chocolate.

Walden Farms salad dressings are a hit and miss.  Some of them are a bit off, and some of them are really good, so I decided to try 'Asian' and was delighted.  Wasn't sure what I was expecting, but the taste is very much like soy sauce with a slightly thicker consistency.  I love to pour it over chicken or fish and then pop it in the oven.  The only downsides have nothing to do with the quality/taste.  1, Sodium.  This is to be expected with most salad dressings.  If you eat it in moderation it shouldn't be an issue, but since it's zero calorie, some people think it's ok to pile it on.  This isn't the case.  2, Price.  The price tag might turn off the average consumer, but for me it's a trade off for the taste that I love and the zero calories/zero sugar advantages.If you're curious, and just want to try it out, I say go for it.  If you're a dieter and are looking for a serious way to cut calories, I say DEFINITELY try it out.

column9: Really Good If You Make A Few Adjustments
column10: I won't eat most light or fat free dressings because if you read the label, what they take out, they generally replace with sugar and sugar spikes my appetite big time and yet, a 1 TBS serving of my favorite regular Hidden Valley Ranch dressing doesn't even begin to cover my salad the way I'd like. I'd need at least 3 TBS to make it how I want and that's just too much fat for one meal. It's almost the RDA for an entire day so that's not really feasible for me.What to do??I was THRILLED to find this dressing at my local supermarket. I think it tastes "okay" right out of the bottle but to my tastebuds, it does leave something to be desired. To make it into something I look forward to eating, I do the following:Hidden Valley Ranch has such a strong flavor so I can take 1 TBS of it, 2 TBS of Walden Farms Ranch dressing and approximately 2 TBS of water. Mix well and I have enough dressing for a good sized salad - about 1.5 to 2 cups of greens and it tastes GOOD to me. I don't feel at all deprived and I'm getting fewer calories (there are 70 calories in 1 TBS of Hidden Valley Ranch dressing) and it's plenty thick for what I want it to do and that's cover the salad. I don't want it drenched exactly but I want that ranch flavor with every bite. I eat this dressing almost exclusively now on any kind of salad - turkey taco, chef, asian greens, etc.Sometimes I'll add 1 TBS of flaxseed oil to the mix to get the benefit of the omega 3's however, be aware that 1 TBS of flaxseed oil has approximately 120 calories in it so if you're watching calories then take that into consideration.The above recipe is also not a bad dip for veggies though it is somewhat thin in consistency. I like it best on salads.

column9: Some and good, others are not
column10: As a general rule, in my opinion, if you stay away from the creamy-type dressings, you should be ok. For example, I love the balsamic one and the honey dijon is pretty good, but ranch and bleu cheese are just inedible; I would rather just eat my salad plain.  I'm on a very low cal and almost zero carb diet, so these (especially the balsamic) have been a life saver.  I'm going to try the cocktail sauce next.

These salad dressings are a great alternative to other popular fat free dressings.  I hate those sprays that are on the market now because there isn't enough dressing for a serving for pete's sake.  I like Thousand Island Waldens Dressing the best -- made a salad with veggie steak strips, spinach, black olives and mushrooms and this dressing was perfect! I've tried Ranch, Balsamic, Caesar and Blue Cheese.  The bleu cheese is bland, but the rest I've tried have been tasty and very satisfying.  I'm glad that I don't have to waste a 60-80 calories on dressing for my salads.

This review is specifically on the Ranch dressing, it may not apply to other flavors.  I have to admit that I bought this on a gluten free foods web site and completely missed the zero calorie description.  I don't know what people who eat zero calorie dressing are used to, but I was expecting a tasty gluten free Ranch dressing that is at least recognizable as Ranch(or dressing for that matter).  I can't believe there are reviewers saying this stuff has flavor.  Well, it does but the flavor is something like what you might get if you took a dirty dish rag, dipped it in latex paint and wrung it out on your salad: This is vile and nasty stuff! Don't waste your money on this one.

This dressing is the best! For those who don't know about Walden Farms, their products are gluten free, calorie free, fat free and sugar free. It is the only dressing you can use when on the HCG diet. I use this on my spinach and salads ... and also on my chicken, as a marinade! It is awesome. Sure makes the hcg diet a lot more bearable. Walden Farms has a whole line of products so fellow HCGers should check them out.

CALORIE FREE SUGAR FREE FAT FREE SLUTEN FREE CARB FREE CHOLESTEROL FREE!???!?!? MUST HAVE!!!!, lol ;) Got this from Save Mart for around $8.....dont try the Honey Dijon, it is DISGUSTING...has a bad after taste :/

For type 2 diabetics trying to control blood sugar by diet alone or with minimal medication the Walden Farms brand is heaven sent.  I have been using their dressings for several years.  Not all of their dressings are as good, in my opinion, as the Thousand Island but all will help control blood sugars.  What I like about the Thousand Island particularly is the creamy texture of the dressing and the taste.  You can use it on salads, burger melts or in a low carb rueben wrap. (I use the Santa Fe Tortilla 6 carb wrap)People who complain that Walden Farms products don't taste the same as 'normal' dressings have a valid point and it shows how much we have come to equate 'good taste' with sugar.  One way to check out your favorite dressing or catsup is to look at the ingredients and see how high sugar, corn syrup, and high fructose corn sugar, is on the list. It is no surprise that sugar is often up there near the top and often listed multiple times. Some dressings produced by major brands, however, have only two carbs per serving.  For many people, myself included, this is a tossup.  In some cases taste and cost may swing toward buying the major brand.  For more selections check at the Walden Farms website and don't forget to check at your local grocery or health food store to compare prices on this brand.Clearly, if you are looking to control your families intake of carbs, the Walden Farms brand is a good choice.  If you know of other brands with zero carbs that taste as good or better please add your comments to this review.  There is nothing I like better than hearing about something that tastes great with zero or low carbs.  Your comments may assist myself and others who are living with diabetes and want to live a better and longer life.
I love this product, but I think it is wildly overpriced for a bottle of salad dressing!

I am a really picky eater.  This is by far the best bottled salad dressing I've ever had.  And the fact that its no calories, no fat makes it even better! Thanks to this dressing and some salad, I'm able to easily stick to my diet.  Thank you Walden Farms!

column9: I can't believe this has no calories
column10: I've tried other salad dressings and have been disappointed but this was delicious! Skip the ranch and dijon dressing and get this one instead.

Actually, I think it's great because my husband loves it.  We do not use it as a salad dressing, but rather a 'sauce' for stir-frying.  It does really bring the Asian experience to what could have been some boring old dish.  We give it 5 stars!

column9: Best Ranch I have EVER tasted!
column10: If Ranch is your dressing of choice and you are looking for a dressing to fit a special diet need, or simply willing to try something new, try this.I expected this to taste like I was sacrificing something.  I could not have been more happy.  I love the flavor and the zing it has.  I'm not sure if the zing is from an acid, spice, or a personal reaction on the part of my tastebuds.For me, I prefer this to any brand, and any type, of Ranch Dressing.Thank you to Walden Farms for all the products you make available to us!This is something that you have to try and judge for yourself.

column9: Dressing good, but beware vendor shipping prices
column10: Got this dressing and others from DAB Nutrition last year, price for shipping was $6.95 total for up to 16 or 17 bottles - a great deal! Now the shipping is still the same for this flavor of dressing only. But if you try to order their other flavors you'll find that they are charging $6.95 PER BOTTLE. Quite a surprise when you see hundreds of dollars show up in your shopping cart. I spoke with Amazon and they told me to get in touch directly with the vendor because the vendor sets the pricing. I spoke with someone at the vendor who told me to get in touch with Amazon. Then she finally told me to email her manager, be brief, and explain the difficulty. I did this and got no response. Caveat emptor, buyer beware.

As other reviewers have said elsewhere, these Walden Farms salad dressings, and other Walden Farms products, can be hit or miss. But everybody's taste is different, so I would say they are definitely worth a try. When they hit it's excellent, with no calories, fat, or carbs, and few if any artificial ingredients. When they miss... well, you move on.Pay close attention to the pricing on these items. They are all over the chart, ranging from reasonable to highway robbery. Some have shipping charges of $4.95 PER BOTTLE! It would seem to be a mistake, but they refused to acknowledge it and actually defended the charge. Others are over $8 per bottle w/free shipping; no bargain there either. Some, with shipping, are over $10 a bottle. It's not difficult to find much better deals on the web-try allstarhealth.com for starters, and there are probably even better ones out there.

Walden Farms dressings are very tasty.  When I ordered this, it said 12 12oz. bottles...and the weight is still listed at 10.4 lbs., package wt. still says 11 lbs.  Imagine my surprise when the $9.00+ was for only one bottle!!  I can purchase this same dressing locally for under $4.00.  Buyer beware!

I almost didn't try this because I bought the Walden Farms chocolate sauce and marshmallow sauce several years ago and they were awful.  But thanks to Amazon reviews, I decided enough people liked the salad dressings that I should give them a chance.I found this at my local Fred Meyer (Kroger family) for a few pennies over $5.  The FM stores in Boise have a little diet food section, and that's where I found it.  I bought the Bacon Ranch, and I must say it's pretty good.  I had a full bowl of salad with plenty of dressing (I like lots!) for just 20 calories.  Very cool!I wonder how this would taste on shiritaki (yam) noodles?  I think I'll try that tomorrow.

I bought the basamic dressing at Albertsons & fell in love.  I first used it with salad while dieting & would use it on a cheat day it's sooooo good.  I made kabobs with bacon wrapped chicken & jalepeno (low carb);) on the grill & used this as a glaze just trying it out & they were the best kabobs I have ever had! I an not sure about the other flavor but basmic is amazing!

I love this dressing. I use it pretty much with everything. This year I decided to get serious about my weight (and lost 23 lbs by the way)and with some pokes from my friends I went to HCG diet (along with those friends). In my doc office I was introduced to Walden Farms products, although I've never heard of them before. Being an on and off dieter since I can remember, that would be shame on me. I am in love with their products now. Well, most of them. This Russian dressing is one of my favorites along with Chocolate dip. I use it with everything. Cucumbers, tomatoes, spinach. It goes well with everything. It tastes good, it's light and calorie free. And I might get addicted to low calorie eating after all. Dieting becomes fun when it tastes good.

I've tasted the best of the "real things," and they were wonderful and dreadfully high in fat, carbs, and calories; that includes dressings, dips, and sauces.  Yes, I've added up what goes into a salad, and those oil and fat content calories soar!  If you expect a fat-free substitute for most anything to be a close equivalent, forget it; you'll have to do with eating the tiniest bits of food to lose weight.  If you expect a zero-calorie substitute to taste the same, ditto.  However, the key here is to find the best of the WF products for you.  I can't do the Peanut Spread (and I'm addicted to Peanut Butter), but most of the other products I can manage.  Some of the dressings are really good, especially the Balsamic.  Loving sweets, I keep handy an assortment of chocolate sauce and dip, caramel sauce, pancake syrup, and I've recently "discovered" the blueberry pancake syrup.  The trick is not to use too much because, yes, there is an aftertaste, but if you use the right amount, it's a darn good substitute.  AND...the calories...the carbs...the fat...don't add up!!
I had to throw this out because it really didn't taste good. It's hard to describe the taste, but it didn't taste like anything that I've had in Japanese restaurants.
Surprisingly great flavor and now the family likes this best - even better than standard counter dressings!  We were pleasantly excited and will order more!

I was looking for no-fat salad dressings and stumbled across Walden Farms Thousand Island dressing. Wow, what a huge disappointment. Doesn't smell good, doesn't taste good, nothing. I'm serious. This product doesn't come anywhere close to the real thing and I have tried several no-fat dressing that do. Sorry, this needs to come off the shelf.

column9: Blue Cheese flavor is good for dipping
column10: Dip bold flavored vegetables and fruits like apples, celery, broccoli and cauliflower in the Blue Cheese dressing. You won't get anything out of it on milder flavored or watery vegetables like iceberg lettuce and tomatoes. Hope that helps.

Although I detest most reduced-calorie dressings, I like the Walden Farms Ranch dressing.  I have no idea how this can have zero calories.  Keep in mind, though, that if you're used to the high-calorie dressings, you'll spit this out with disdain.  However, if you, like I, avoid such indulgences, then your palate is ready for Walden Farms Ranch.
Considering this is a calorie free, sugar free, etc free, it is great! I am on the Medi-Fast diet so this products and the entire product line fits in perfectly. Best feature; it tastes very good!

column9: Strictly for Those on a Diet
column10: I would certainly compliment Walden Farms for their line of zero-calorie salad dressings.  It's really quite amazing how they can do this.The Thousand Island dressing is fair.  The major flavor that comes across is vinegar.  In small amounts, mixed into a salad, it does the trick.  It gives a kick to "boring" field greens.  In larger amounts, it's no better than tolerable, but you may feel good that you can have a huge greens salad and dressing for under 50 calories.  One thing is clear:  It does not taste much like full fat or low fat Thousand Island dressing.

At first try, I was tempted to give it a slightly higher rating, but I guess it depends on you sensivity to some of the "flavoring" used.  I actually had a fairly low expectation, so for me, this was a bit better than I expected.  I used it to make a tuna salad, so some of the flavors are better suited to that perhaps.  I am on a strict low carb diet so this seems to be good enough.

I have to give it 1 star because they wont allow for any less... this ranch dressing is also waaaaaayyy too sweet, the chemical taste of the Splenda overtakes the taste of the actual product itself...I could never understand why they have to add soo much artificial sweetener to something such as a salad dressing, this is one of the five Walden's Calorie Free product I have tried and been VERY disappointed with... I was already taking my chances knowing it was sweetened with Splenda instead of Stevia but for God's sake why make it soo unpalatable?!  there are soo many alternatives out there and why kill it with soo much sweeterner?  My other reviews for these products may be around the same... but darn... I best just make my own dressing, might not be 100% calorie free but at least it will be consumable.  Why does RANCH need sugar?! WTF?  I have made ranch from scratch and never once did I add any sugar to it!  Also there is a dry chemical flavor that comes with this...  I am sooo lucky my healthfood store has a nice return policy because after tasting all these dressing products I could NOT use them and felt jipped because these aren't that cheap..

column9: Walden Farms Salad Dressing is a Great Product
column10: The product tastes great!  It is an excellent product for those who are trying to lose weight.  I highly recommend this product.
I enjoyed the dressing.  I'm on a  VLCD and this fit the bill.  Splashed some Rice Vinegar to enhance the dressing.

This is not bad, it's good on a salad, and decent as a veggie dip as well.  It's very tangy, and nice in it's own way but does not taste like a normal full fat ranch dressing.  It's on par with other low fat or light dressings I have tried, but with 0 calories.  I like to add a little cracked black pepper to mine.  I may buy this again, but I prefer their Caesar dressing.
I ordered Walden Farms for a friend of mine that couldn't find it in the stores of the UK. SHe loves it. I purchased the Honey Dijon and am equally satisfied.
I was so excited for this product and unfortunately, it's terrible. I tastes nothing like Italian dressing or even any kind of dressing.
The Balsamic Vinaigrette salad dressing is very good.  I use it more as a steak sauce then a salad dressing though.  I like to use A-1 on my steaks and The Balsamic Vinaigrette tastes just as good.
Great taste--calorie free, carb free, fat free, & sugar free.  What more could you ask for?

I am a health food nut and in general don't like artificial food.  Walden Farms succeeded in making an almost all natural, good tasting substitute for a sometimes high-calorie food, your salad dressing.  Fabulous!

column9: No Anything, Good Tasting Dressing - Recommended
column10: Understanding that these are diet Salad Dressings, having no fat, no gluten, no carbs, no sugar, and no calories, will go a long way in forgiving a weaker taste than in their full calorie counter parts.The two flavors we bought (Caesar and Honey Dijon) are good tasting and enjoyable.Recommended!

column9: A Healthy Alternative, Depending on the Flavor
column10: I've tried a number of different flavors and found the Bleu Cheese and Vinaigrette more suited to my taste.  Nothing I've tried of these dressings really tastes like normal salad dressing, but these make terrific alternatives if you're looking for a dressing that minimizes caloric intake.  The Vinaigrette also has made a good "dipping" dressing for bread, etc.  Just try a few and see which ones you like.

I am a serious weight control person.  I recently lost 25 lbs and I determined not to regain it.  The key is lots of salad and lots of veggies with adequate protein and eat frequently. I use Bacon Ranch and add some straight balsamic vinegar to my salads.  Delicious.  I use the vinaigrettes on vegetables and then roast or BBQ them.  If you hate these dressings, in my opinion you don't REALLY want weight loss or weight control.  Are the "regular" dressings better?  I don't know and I don't care.  I am a 66 year old female athlete and I love being trim.

column9: Try Coleslaw and French Dressings Instead!
column10: I tried each salad dressings of walden farms and bleu cheese is one of the most unsavory ones that also ruins the taste of the salad. It tastes and smells like white glue. So I would suggest Coleslaw dressing which is great and can also be used for Caesar salad. French also tastes good for giving a spicy taste to the salad.
I have been using Walden Farms Dressing for about a year and it is a great tasting salad dressing. I love it

column9: Taste is Great Price is a rip off
column10: Great tatse, but I can buy it for 1/2 this price in the store. hey Walden farms..not all diabetics are RICH. Shame on you !

We are on the Ideal Protein diet and need dressings that have no calories. These fit the bill but are not edible. What a disappointment! Perhaps the other flavors are better but I thought that just about anyone could get Blu Cheese and Ranch dressing flavored right. Not so! They are awful.

column9: From a HUGE fan of Walden Farms
column10: We've been ordering these dressings directly from Walden Farms for many years and haven't yet had a flavor we didn't like.  Our favorites are the Caesar, the Bleu, and the Ranch, but we also regularly enjoy the Creamy Italian, Russian, and Thousand Island.  You can buy them directly from Walden Farms, up to 10 bottles in an order, for a flat shipping fee of $7.95. Make the salads as rich as you want with tasty ingredients -- we like avocadoes in ours, providing healthy monosaturated fat, or a dollop of virgin olive oil -- and save calories BIG TIME with these delicious dressings. Any of them will also make a wonderful dressing for cole slaw and broccoli slaw, although WF also has a very good Cole Slaw flavor.  And the kids love them as dips for fresh veggies.

The flavor is straight up vinegar and chemicals.  Honey dijon is my favorite salad dressing, but the Walden Farms Honey dijon is inedible, I almost threw up.  I wanted so bad to accept this product, I did not have very high expectations before tasting, and it was gross.

column9: Walden Farms product line is great
column10: Walden Farms Italian With Sun Dried Tomato Dressing Calorie Free, Carb Free, Fat Free, Sugar FreeAll of Walden Farms products are literally life savers. Not only are they fat free, sugar free, calorie free, carb free, etc. but they are absolutely deliciouse and at a reasonable price. I am on Nutrisystem now but am using Walden Farms products along with it and will continue with Walden Farms product line from now on. They offer healthy, tasty alternatives to everything you can imagine.

This product was misleading. We had no real idea that it was Fat Free, Calorie Free, heck ... everything free, rendering the product almost taste free too.Our first clue should have come from the fact that this salad dressing was coming from a health food company. Good rich, and tasty salad dressing will almost never be totally healthy. Our mistake.Do you have any REAL russian dressing?

I am a diabetic, hence must watch my diet. I recently bought, directly from the eDietshop website, the chocolate cheesecake mix. Simply wonderful. No sugar, almost fat-free, 60 calories per half-cup, very creamy texture, very satisfying. My wife (not diabetic) also loves it. Thus far I simply mix together the mix and milk, pour into individual serving cups, and refrigerate for a bit.If you love Cool Whip, get the Calorie Control Whipped topping. 8 calories per serving (2 tablespoons), no sugar, fat-free, etc. Easy to make (I had been making it with milk, which makes it 12 calories per serving, but recently decided to simply make it with water, as directions suggest, and found it still is great and creamy). Anyway, add this whipped topping to your chocolate cheesecake and you have a wonderfully satisfying desert for well under 100 calories.

A fine brand form the source ... it's rather delicate, but very addictive especially after a perfect Chinese meal.[Now remember this is a very specific smoky tea - smoked whole leaf over smoundering pine needles].For perversion - add honey and milk .... but then it becomes an after dinner treat.Beautifully packaged, presented .....
I can not offer to much in this review. This was a gift to a good friend of ours from China. He said that it was like drinking a good tea next to an open fire.
Seriously, can you think of a better combination? Cilantro and pesto. Our family adores this product. A for sure part of our staples from now on.

column9: Great smelling, but you'd better like hibiscus
column10: My wife loves this tea.  She even eats it (the blueberries are definitely edible and sweet), but she grew up drinking hibiscus tea all the time.I, on the other hand, bought it for the blueberries and green rooibos, which I assumed would be the predominant taste.  Truly, there are a lot of dried blueberries in this, and there is a lot of green rooibos, but it is the hibiscus that you taste the most (a rather bitter/sour taste when made too strong).  Sweetener definitely helps.  With Spring, a little goes a long way, so you get your money's worth of a healthy tea.The smell of this tea is truly mouth-watering, both dry and when steeping.  It is a very pretty tea, with beautiful light-blue tiny petals sprinkled throughout.My wife will definitely go through a lot of this tea, but as for myself, I will be grabbing this only as the mood hits me.UPDATE:  I have grown to really like this tea and I'm moving my four stars to five stars as a result.

I approached this tea with a LOT of trepidation. I had ordered two other bags of bulk tea from Davidson's, and disliked each one. Never the less, I figured I would give Davidson's one last go. I'm glad I did.As the other reviewer mentioned, the dried tea is visually appealing, light blue flakes contrast sharply with the deep purple of the rest of the tea. The resulting tea infusion is a rich purple (think McD's Grimace purple). If you brew in a clear container, this tea will most definitely belong on display when you have company.As for the taste - If you have read my other reviews, you will understand why I took my first sip of this tea over the sink. However, I was very surprised at how much blueberry taste this tea has. It actually tastes like it's primary ingredient, imagine that? My process went like this: *sip* "Hmmm, that's kinda good." *taste again* "Actually that's really good!".The "plain" brew has a slightly tart AND sweet taste at the same time, if that's possible. With very little additional sweetener, this tea could very easily help parents replace their child's soda fix with something much healthier.Final verdict: A good buy, and one that I intend to make again.

This is best tea I have had from Davidson's tea bulk company. Lot's of blueberries and pretty flower petals. They claim it is organic, but they put natural flavor in there. Please stop! Blueberries got enough flavor!P.S. If you have ordered another kind of loose bulk tea from this company, expect this package to be smaller. Even though it is 16 oz, blueberries weigh a lot more that just tea petals so volume wise you get less.

I used to waste money at teavana because that was the only place that could make me drink tea. But it was getting very expensive and I tried looking for alternative and I found this tea! It is amazing. I absolutely love it blended with green tea for extra antioxidants and iced!

I have been buying this tea for a couple years,  it was lovely (hot or cold) until they changed the formula and added cinnamon.While I enjoy cinnamon in many tea formulas, it is not an asset here at all!  As far as this household is concerned the cinnamon muddies the flavor, ruining the fruit/flower flavor that made it such a pleasure.  This significant change was not listed on the ingredients (as of May 2012).  We will not order this again until they come to their senses and change it back.

I was expecting this to be a light flowery/fruity tea and it was not that at all. The camomile flowers have tiny pieces that go through my nice tea infuser and they make a mess of the clean up process with how tiny the pieces are. I also got the cranberry orange and prefer that much more. This just doesn't work for me at all and I love this type of tea just not this blend at all.

A totally delicious tea; for me, it both smelled like flowers *and* tasted like flowers. (At first, I was weirded out, but now it's the first thing I dive for when I open the fridge. I feel a bit like Ferdinand the bull while drinking it.) Definitely a tea best made with ice. Yum.
This tea is delicious! Much better quality than I was expecting, for the low price. Tart and sweet. Love it!

I have tried many teas and after reading the reviews on Amazon about Davidson't tea I highly recommend it...the Spring Fruit and Flowers is excellent and I am looking forward to trying some other teas.  I appreciate the reviews about different teas so I can make a selection.  This tea is a beautiful red and tastes similar to passion fruit  teas.  Enjoy

This tea isn't at all bitter and I haven't even added any sweetener to it!  Unlike the cranberry tea, which took a little puckering to get adjusted to, this one was a delight from the start.  I'm very pleased with the fruity taste and smell and will no doubt drink many cups of this tea.  Very pleased over price and organic ingredients!
I really like it's great fruity taste. I always drink it iced with a touch of lime and sweetner. For me, it is a bi-monthly regular buy and at a great price.

column9: Underweight shipment, with a lot of cinamon peces that is not in the recepee
column10: The bag seams under filled .Waigt was 15.6oz not 16. Tea consist a lot of cinamon that is not in the recepy.When you remoove cinamon from the tea it is only 13.3oz.I feel cheated.

I just received my shipment of this tea and all I can say is WOW! The tea comes in a nice large 1 lb bag, so you really get your moneys worth. When you open the bag the smell hits you right away. It has a very fruity and light flowery smell to it. I brewed my tea and the tea gave a nice deep red color and the smell was just nice. I have tried alot of teas and have to say this is the best tea I ever had. If you like berry or fruit flavored teas, I would highly recommend this. The only disappointment I had was that I didn't realize it was caffeine free. I like my caffeine so when I need it I just mix this with another one I have with caffeine. I also like my teas over ice and this is just great. Thank God I used the subsribe and save. I think I am going to have to make them ship my next shipment sooner than 6 months, that's how good this one is.

column9: A little to tart, but otherwise it's good.
column10: This tea has a very nice aroma and also is very pretty. It looks like a very fancy tea and the flowers and fruit in it are full of colors: bright blue, yellow, red and purple. There is a lot of fruit is this tea and the dried fruit is very sweet if it's picked out and eaten. However, when it's steeped into tea the sweetness of the blue berries isn't retained and only the tartness is retained along with the floral ingriedents. I drink my tea without suger so it's a little to tart for me but otherwise isn't horrible. Maybe if you added suger or honey it would be better.

column9: good tea but little or no blueberries-2nd order had the blueberries
column10: I purchased this tea because of all the good reviews.  I like it very much and will order again. Maybe Davidson's has change the ingredients because I found a lot of rosehips and had to really search for blueberries and found only 1. I also have the chamomile flowers and mixed that with the spring fruit and flowers in my tea pot, the combo made an excellent tea.  I do love rosehips and the flavor of the tea but was disappointed that I couldn't taste blueberry.  For this reason alone I gave this tea 4 stars.  I just got my second order of this tea and it was full of blueberries, no rosehips and has a blueberry taste to it.  I will keep ordering this tea and I'm giving it 5 stars now.
Liked  this tea - it was different and refreshing.  It is bright red / maroon colored and makes for a very beautiful, refreshing tea when in a clear glass.  I drank it cold as iced tea.
it is one of my favorite teas. Contain blue berry fruits + other flower pellets. Great taste.

When I first opened the bag, I smelled flowers.  But once I made the tea, it's WONDERFUL.  The flowery smell is not in the drink.  It's blueberries, and very good.  The value of the tea is worth it too, but I did repackage the balance of the tea into a better bag for storage.  The package does reseal, but why expose a full pound of tea to the air if it not necessary?  That said, this is a wonderful herbal tea with no caffeine, and will be a wonderful iced tea in the summer.  I highly recommend it.

I was really looking forward to this tea, having purchased it as a juice replacement for my two young children. I regularly order Davidson's English Breakfast, as well as tried other offerings of theirs in the past, and have never been let down.Upon opening the bag, I was met with the overwhelming scent of cinnamon and discovered an abundance of cinnamon stick pieces in the mix. The presence of cinnamon is so prominent that I believe it should be stated clearly in the ingredient list. Unfortunately both of my kids won't touch cinnamon with a ten foot pole, so as a result of the misrepresentation of this item, they sadly won't be enjoying Davidson's Spring Fruit and Flowers tea.
The aroma of this tea is especially tempting.  I mix it with the Davidson Hibiscus and the Rosehips and add just a tad of Blue Agave for sweetener.

column9: Tastes bright and fruity, looks like a bird of paradise
column10: This tea tastes has a delicious tangy fruit taste, and looks gorgeous. I just recently finished my first bag and will be going back for more. I've been storing it in a glass jar on the shelf because of how beautiful it looked.

I love this tea! It had fresh dried berries all throughout it and taste very fresh and yummy! The price and quality can't be beat! I am so glad to find something as good tasting as Teavana but way better priced. Just wished they had more "blends" to choose from.

column9: A must have for frugal tea lovers!
column10: I'm so glad to have stumbled upon this tea, I usually pay upwards of 6-12$ for similar products... with a weight of under 4oz. 16oz for under 15$ is very exciting and affordable. Organic as well? Yes please! I look forward to trying their other blends and adding my own ingredients to them.
I love this tea.  Plenty of dried blueberries.  I often mix it with other teas to give them flavor like chamomile or green tea.  I have it on subscribe and save.  It's great!

I don't actually need it gluten-free, so whether it is or isn't doesn't really matter to me. (Tho the box says it is). But anyway, regardless of that, it's, like, really-super good. Helped calm my raging Asian food craving that's been going on for awhile :-)

Packaging did not state gluten free, called customer service who said they would resend.  Still not gluten free.  Now state gluten free is unavailable but still advertised. The one I received has caramel color and no gluten free description.  Be careful before you try to buy!

column9: mine not organic; not as pictured/ordered
column10: The diff between organic and not is not cosmetic or immaterial: if the item is shown to be org, it should be. I haven't tasted the crackers as I'm not sure what my next step is. Hoping Amazon will step in to rectify as I see nowhere to email them short of a return. Any tips in this regard appreciated.

column9: If your brewing you need these hops
column10: "This is a good deal". The cost breaks down to a dollare and oz and if your like me and love hops their is no guilt in adding more and dry hoppinig later... Go head and buy a few packs and save money down the line..

column9: An amazing price for a pound of good hops.
column10: After spending $2-$3 an ounce for hops, that were occasionally out of stock, I decided to purchase a pound knowing that it would get used quickly. These hops arrived quickly and are exactly what local shops carry.

This is all ginger root tea. The tea bags come in a resealable bag to keep them fresh. Most ginger teas have other herbs blended with the ginger, which can mask the ginger flavor. Not this one, its all ginger root.I wish Amazon would carry it so as to avoid the shipping charge!

Good size granules, excellent quaility.  The price was outstanding!  Can't touch this stuff locally for the price offered on Amazon, even with the shipping.  I will continue to use the Frontier Garlic Granules.
ALL of the Frontier herbs are awesome!  I will continue to order them in bulk, as long as they are much better priced in bulk on Amazon.
THESE TASTE SO GOOD AND CHEWY. THEY ARE FRESH. THEY HAVE A BIG FLAVOR.  AND MADE IN AMERICA.  I WILL BUY AGAIN.
My GSD and POM love these things I even cut in small pieces and ad to the Poms food when she gets fenicky, great for both there Joint problems.

I read the one review that was available and was surprised. One star, awful taste, what? I really liked it, it was not quite as good as Kerns Peach which is the BEST I've found, but its right up there. I remember drinking this product as a kid and it still hits the spot.

My husband purchased this.  And he loves the juice.  I am not a major fan.  As a side note though, I noticed that the Dollar Tree down the street from us offers guava juice, and I think it is the same brand.  That would be a cheaper way to purchase this product.  But I don't know if all the stores sell it.

i used to like kerns when i was younger. it was thick and fruity and delicious. guava was one of my favorites. recently i bought some and when i poured it on my glass right away i noticed it was syrupy and transparent when it used to be opaque and thick. i tasted it and it wasn't fruity at all, it was pure sugar and what's worse it wasn't real sugar it was corn syrup.i looked at the ingredients and corn syrup was the second ingredient after water. seriously? second ingredient? that's just sad and gross. i will never touch this brand of drinks again in my life.

I ordered this brand because I like to have some on hand for quick lunches or late night snacks and these were priced considerably less than Hormel Beef Tamales, In Chili Sauce, 15-Ounce Units (Pack of 12) (my usual brand).  The tamales themselves tasted fine to me, maybe not quite as spicy as Hormel but still good.  I did not like all the grease though floating around on the plate from the sauce.  The tamales didn't taste particularly greasy but I really did not like the sauce - gross.  I'll save the other 11 cans in our emergency food supply and most likely just discard the sauce and eat the tamales only..Not a bad product if you discount the greasy sauce but I'll be sticking with Hormel for future purchases - the tamales taste good to me and the sauce is not nearly as greasy.Update - I just checked again and Hormel Tamales are available again through Subscribe and Save AND they are several dollars less expensive than La Preferida. I just signed up. LOL

column9: Buy the bigger 1.2 oz. pack of 36 eggs instead
column10: I preface this review by saying that due to disability, I am unable to see product pictures, so purchasing this product was sort of a crap shoot.  However, the description of this item left a lot to be desired.  I should have trusted my gut instinct and not purchased this particular product.  I was hoping for the typical-size Reese's eggs, in their individual cardboard and plastic.  What this is, is 12 little mini-peanut butter eggs wrapped in foil, in a plastic egg carton sort of thing.  Are they good?  Sure they are.  Will I keep and eat them?  Obviously yes, but I won't order them again, unless the price is considerably lower for the quantity included.  I'll just get the 36-count of the 1.2-oz. Reese's Peanut Butter Eggs instead, as it's a much better deal.

The product arrived quickly and was wrapped well- but I can't imagine that it really cost $10 for shipping! In fact, I know it didin't cost that much to ship it. Seems a bit outrageous that the shipping cost as much as 3 jars of jelly. Because of the high cost for  shipping I may not order again. It is for a gift  so I have no idea about the taste or quality yet.
When I first opened it, It was clumped and possessed an off flavor, as though it was beyond it's shelf life.  Have used the Lemon Drop rimmer and it was great!
I'm not a big fan of this gum.  I don't care for the taste. I wouldn't order it again. I gave it 3 stars because my husband liked it better than I did.
I discovered Giant Chewy Nerds at Easter when they were sold as jelly beans. When Easter was over I couldn't find them any more. Finally found them online. Wish they were carried in stores locally.

column9: Love Nerds and they arrived amazingly quickly!  Thanks.
column10: I have recently developed a taste for these chewy/crunchy/powdery/nerdy candies.  I love them.  Purchasing them here is quick -- they arrived in two days, as promised, and easy!  I will definitely order from you again.  Thanks.Robyn

I love these raisins, and sun maid is the best I have tasted so far.  This packaging with the little boxes is perfect to grab and go.  If my energy drops while I am out I just reach in my purse and have just the right snack to keep going.  These also taste amazing, it's a good thing I got them in this packaging, I can see myself easily just eating the whole bag.  I have even converted my husband, instead of a candy bar I give him a box of raisins instead he loves them and with fewer calories it has helped in his quest to lose weight, he is down 30 pounds so far.  Just from cutting back in these little ways, I have also lost 40 pounds and the raisins are good for you, kind of like concentrated wine to me.  I was having liver problems and switching to these type of snacks along with exercise has cured my liver ailment.  I say try them to anyone, my husband was a chocolate bar, I hate yogurt guy and he loves these yogurt covered raisins.  Recommend them to everyone when they ask about our change in diet.  I know they aren't perfect the sugar in the yogurt is high.  My one and only recommendation to sun maid is to find a sugar free yogurt the raisins are sweet enough.

Initially I bought this tea because I wanted to try something different. For my surprise, I found a tea with a perfect blend of flavors. You can feel a touch of sourness of the cranberries and hibiscus flowers, the refreshing taste of the orange peels, and the pleasant taste of the camomile.. it is just perfect. Now I can't stop drinking it. I highly recommend it.

I am a fan of red teas. This is an excellent combination of fruits and flowers. A bit of more hibiscus would made it perfect. For that reason I combine it with pure hibiscus to enhance the sour tar taste. Overall is a good buy I recommend for everybody this bland and Davidson tea in general.
Ran across this tea in the grocery section here, it is my favorite iced tea. Mixed with their Hibiscus it's perfect. Rich and flavorful, very satisfying.  Highly recommended.

I really enjoyed this tea,  I'm not sure if all the batches are exactly the same, but mine was quite tart. I find that I like to add some stevia to mine to make it a little sweeter. It smells wonderful and has bits of fruit and flowers that you can identify.  I don't care for tea that is mostly dust.  What a nice large bag for the price.  Of similar quality to those found in "tea" stores that are much more costly.  A great find!

column9: Lovely complex flavor and you don't need much
column10: Just received this loose tea today and finished my first cup. It is probably sweet enough for many to drink without any sugar at all, although I added some agave nectar. I am off to make another cup and will reduce the sweetener (though I only use a teaspoon anyway, I will probably be happy with half that). The directions say to use two teaspoons of the tea per 8 ounce cup when preparing red teas, but I tried one teaspoon and it was plenty, so right there we have doubled the servings. An excellent deal also, especially with Subscribe and Save.

I got this tea and was in hooked from the moment I first ripped open the bag.  The mix of scents was amazing and the taste didn't disappoint!  Crisp with a little tartness... the flavors work well together.  I think I may buy a bag to make gifts for several tea drinker friends for Christmas.  The bag is large enough to allow me to divide a batch into several gift size bags!

I just love this tea! It's lightly sweet and the strength is easily adjusted by increasing or decreasing the amount used (I fill up 1/2 of a round stainless infuser) and then add some lemon off our tree & some honey (Ambrosia Pure Honey here at Amazon.com Ambrosia Pure Honey From Colorado's Western Slope, 16-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 4)). This is my first experience with Davidson's Bulk Teas and I'll be trying some more!  >^..^<
Can't beat the price and it's nice herbal tea.  I was and still am a coffee drinker but have been enjoying herbal teas of late.  Hard to beat Davidson's teas.

This tea is so very delicious. It is also a beautiful ruby red and looks great served in a clear glass mug. I bought it with the idea of using it for an iced drink but found I prefer it hot. I will purchase this again.

I'm getting into drinking more teas so I was looking for good teas online since they are soooo expensive in the store (anywhere from 6-10$ per 2oz) .  So I thought I would try this brand and flavor first.....LOVE IT....have already ordered and received 2 more bags of different flavors...excellent price, excellent flavor!!!

This was one of the first teas we ordered from Davidson's.  Over time, we've ordered several other varieties, but we liked this one enough that we have ordered it again.  My wife and I tend to drink a fair amount of tea and this is definitely a favorite!  It's a great price too, and we don't have anywhere around here to buy looseleaf tea, so this deal is perfect for us :)

This tea is a pretty good blend.  I think the orange flavour is a bit stronger than the cranberry, but we each have our own tastes.  Better to brew this one a bit weak and then step it up into a level that you will find enjoyable.  This would be a nice tea to offer after a holiday dinner for those who like the herbal teas.  This bag shall last me a while, but I'm not entirely unhappy I purchased it.

First purchase and will continue to buy this product.  I am a new tea person and find this herbal blend to be lovely at night time after dinner.  So far this is my favorite herbal blend.  Davidson's is a trust tea company - highly recommend.

There are also dried cranberry halves, along with pieces of orange peel that you can actually see.  Every bag of tea I have ordered from Davidsons has been outstanding and well worth it!

I gave up coffee and soda drinks and started drinking tea and bought this and also bought the Harold Imports 75-Ounce Capacity Teapot, White. Once again I'm thrilled with Davidson's! I've ordered three pounds of tea and each one is as delicious as the next. Who would't want a tastier and cheaper alternative to bagged tea?Looks pretty in a glass container, loose. I drink at least 8 cups of tea per day since I discovered Davidson's. Perfect to add some aroma and reduce cravings at my desk job. I wish I could give them more business but their product is inexpensive and lasts forever. I resteep leaves 2-4 times. I keep mine in containers though.I started with the Moroccan Green w/Mint, which is mild in flavor and only slightly minty. It's my go-to tea. This tea is awesome.  My son and I had some and he loves it too.  It's got an interesting blend of flavors, nothing really overpowering, just very unique and delicious.
This is a very nice tea with a citrus taste. Consider adding lemon for a little more zing. I just ordered several more bags of this tea as well as a rooibos from the same company.

Very Fresh, Very chunky, and completely awesome. Most chunky teas don't seem to have much flavor, but this brews quite strong. It's the perfect fruity blend of flavors. If you're looking for refreshing and healthy, this is it. It's a great price for the amount of tea you can brew with it too.

I thought the price for this amount of loose tea was awesome! I love drinking herbal tea and this was the 1st time trying this flavor from Davidson's Bulk Tea. I liked the favor of this tea overall. However, the reason I gave it a four star rating was because I felt it had a slightly odd aftertaste.

Having recently eliminated caffeine from my diet, I've been very interested in herbal teas because I love the ritual of drinking tea.  I've had good experiences with Davidson's teas and thought I'd give this variety a try.  WOW!This blend of caranberry, rose hips, orange peel, rooibos, and camomile is lucious.  I was pleased no end that it contains lots of dried cramberries.I'll subscribe to get it once a month---it's very seasonal as we move into October---but look forward to drinking it with local honey year round.

I bought this to test it for favor and because I to not like tea bags--they leave a paper taste. I wanted an herbal tea to drink instead of coffee and to have a change from regular tea. I use a coffee toddy to  make my teas. The coffee toddy comes with two filters. I use one for coffees and one for teas. I emptied the whole bag of this tea into the toddy and added water making sure all of the tea was well coated with water. I covered the toddy and let it sit for 12 hours. After the 12 hours I let the liquid tea drain into the glass toddy container. To use the tea I use 8 teaspoons for an approximately 500 ml cup. It is good cold or hot. The favor is very good. I do use stevia for a sweeter. The next time I make it, I will add more water, say another 200 ml, because the tea absorbs much of the water. After making the tea in the toddy, I gently rinse the filter, leave it wet, place it in a resealable plastic baggie, and store it in the frig. The tea I made lasts approximately 3 weeks in the frig at the usage rate of one of my servings every 2-3 days. Enjoy.

I grew up on this stuff. My dominican grandmother (born and raised) use to make this all of the time with milk and vanilla extract. My cousins and I would wait for it to cool in our favorite bowls and then eat the corners until we made it to the center which stayed warm the longest of course. And we loved the sweet skin the cereal would make on top once cooled.

This is a terrific product and I wonder why it has virtually disappeared off supermarket shelves.  Generations of babies used to eat it as their first cereal, but now cereals have gotten very fancy: flavored, instant-cooking, and loaded with additives other than just vitamins.  I have severe food allergies, and although I can eat wheat, I cannot eat most additives.  I cannot eat soy products, for example, and therefore cannot eat any commercial baked goods, all of which contain soy lethecin (an emulsifier) or, worse, bean derivatives (guar gum, carob gum), or corn derivatives(xanthine gum).  I can eat Farina without any unhappy reactions whatsoever.If people wonder why there are so many food allergies around now, let them just read the printed contents labels carefully.  Commercial products these days contain everything but the kitchen sink.  Even ice cream contains bean gums!

column9: A great Product but bottle easily mistaken

First I have to say that it is easy to get the marinade and the dipping sauce packages mixed up.  Just remember, Red label/cap is the Dippng sauce that has the familar bourbon flavor and Yellow label/cap is the marinade that goes so well with it.  I made the same mistake becuase I was not familar with the product and it's packaging and was just as frustrated as anyone else would be but I decided not to let the marinade( yellow cap) I bought go to waste.  So I tried it on Salmon, baked it then used the dipping sause(red cap).  Long story short, everyone was raving about it and when I took some to work for lunch, co-workers asked what resturant I went to.  Also for the heck of it, tried it on turkey wings and it turned out great.  I didn't even bother with the dipping sauce in that case, it gave the meat a nice rich flavor and served it over brown rice and steamed veggies.  So please before you pick up that bottle look at the color label/cap and remember-red is the dipping sauce ( bourbon flavor) and yellow is the marinade.

The whole line of Dreamfields Pastas claims to be much lower in carbohydrates than most and that is a very good thing. Pasta is known for its high content of carbs and being the situation that it is not permissible to indulge so liberally in large amounts of carbs, Dreamfields is what you would call a low carb eater pleasure. I have read many opposing views as to their claims and many more views at to their merits, and personally, I take sides with the majority that celebrates their existence in a rather meager market where options of low carb pasta are almost non existing. Of the few that are around I definitely put Dreamfields at the top. Why? Because it does not taste or cook like something other than real pasta. Goes well with sauces, without sauces just butter and parmesan and even their lasagna allows for that tasty dish to be enjoyed without a large amount of guilt. I can only trust the numbers the company throws at consumers to be based on solid research and information.  The fact of the matter is that being able to enjoy pasta such as this makes a lot of people very happy, and I am first on that list. Did not like the fact that for a while amazon stopped selling it because it told me that either the demand was low or that the company did not want to do business with amazon. For a while there I could not find it under amazon prime, just at outside vendors and the prices had seriously skyrocketed upwards to justify the purchase. Yes, I knew of other places where to obtain this same pasta (not the manufacturer which I find a little tad on the difficulty side) but another credible internet store that specializes in very healthy A-Z alternatives. I found this one, Dreamfields Pasta Healthy Carb Living, Penne Rigate, 13.25-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6), in amazon and I immediately made the purchase because I would be misleading if I did not say that I prefer to deal mostly with amazon for I never have any issues that I later regret and that is saying a lot. 4 Stars.

column9: If it sounds too good to be true...
column10: This pasta tastes just like any other pasta, but it also spiked the blood glucose of the person eating it just like a normal pasta would.  This isn't safe for diabetics, nor good for someone who is watching their blood glucose or trying to follow a low carb diet.

Not only did I purchase the six pack of pasta, I used the Subscribe and Save option so that I could have my low carb pasta delivered every two weeks. I thought this would change my low carb life. Wrong.5 grams of carbs per two ounce serving? Sounds too good to be true. Feel free to conduct your own research, but I think you'll find your body has no problem metabolizing this into glucose just as quickly as all the other pastas. The nutrition information on the side of the box states 41 grams of carbs per tiny 2 ounce serving. Apparently, the 31 grams of "Protected Carbs" exist only in the minds of those at Dreamfields. Google "Glycemic Response to Ingested Dreamfields Pasta Compared With Traditional Pasta" for more information.I'm sorry to to dispute the claims of the company, as I do not have a lab to conduct a study and prove them wrong, but I'm highly skeptical of their claims. I wanted to believe. I thought this would be a miracle, and I bought into it. I think I wasted my money.That being said, the pasta is delicious. I could not distinguish this pasta from any other "normal" pasta.
