column9: One of the best dog foods you can buy.
column10: I have been feeding my dogs Orijen for over two years now.  I was at a bar with a buddy and he was telling me how he switched his food to Evo and so I did some research on better dog foods.  I decided on Orijen.  I can't really tell if my dogs coats are better or they are more healthy.  On paper it seems to be the best food and it makes sense.  The food is sooo expensive and they jacked up the price about 6 months ago.  It does help they seem to eat half as much as my old dog food.  So, that cuts the cost in half compared to my old food.  A big bonus of this is there is half as much poop to pick up. That is huge as I am really lazy.  The other thing I noticed is both dogs had some nasty farts.  That pretty much stopped on Orijen.  Oddly my buddy said it will get worse with the higher protein diet, but it got a ton better.  I mean by dogs could drop some room clearing farts.  There are cheaper good dog foods out there like Blue.  I have thought about switching to it because it is 30 bucks a bag cheaper.  For now Evo is worth the money. His coat is shiny and glossy, his eyes clear and white, and he has more energy than any other dog at the dog park. I'm not at all sure it's because of this food, but he lost some weight last spring and has since been a lean, mean, muscle machine. I'm talking LEAN. I think when I got him off grains last spring, his body shed some weight that it obviously didn't need. I would highly recommend this food! He loves it...I can even use the kibbles as treats. Combined with Grizzly Salmon Oil, I hope Cooper lives a long and healthy life!

My 6 year old cardigan welsh corgi was originally on Eukanuba, which was recommended by our vet. But she had dry skin, a dull coat and not as much energy as a dog her age should have. She also tended to become a bit overweight on it.Based on a recommendation from a corgi breeder & my own research into the premium brands, I decided to try Orijen. What a difference! Her coat is now quite shiny and healthy looking. No more dry skin. Lots of energy, and she has lost a bit of weight & looks more muscular & healthy overall.She also loves the taste - no problem getting her to eat it. But feed according to how your dog looks, not how much it says on the bag. This is high protein stuff & your dog will gain weight if you feed according to package directions. My 25lb corgi (yes, she's a bit on the petite side), gets only 1/2 cup twice a day.No, the initial purchase price is NOT cheap. But because we feed so much less (no grains or fillers), a bag lasts just as long as what we were spending on Eukanuba. FYI - I just got a bag of their 6 fish food to try & she is wild over it.

My dog has eaten this food for 19 days. So far he has not gotten an ear infection, but still shows redness on his paws. He loves this food. He somehow could smell it through this lovely packaging and followed me around while it was carying through the house. His appetite also matches the recommended serving suggestion, which is wonderful. I am going to order another bag, so we can see if the paw and mouth allergies go away. He may have a food and environmental allergy as well. I feel good about the ingredients and how my dog responds to the food. I think this bag will end up lasting an entire month or very close to it.The shipping was also super fast, so not only am I happy with the food, but the seller as well!

My Lab Buster is a new dog - he has is figure again. Buster is a 11 year old Lab that loves to eat and it showed - he is now on the adult Orijen formula and everyone is commenting on how wonderful he looks. I recommend this product for all your buddies

She liked it first time and then not so much for the next two times and then the loose stools began. I think the quality of the food is good - but not sure what is causing this side effect. ...because it is FAR too expensive in quantity! :)Orijen dry dog food is rich in proteins as it is nearly 100% meat from a variety of pure sources: chicken, fish, etc.We mix this dog food during the dinner feed 50/50 with lesser grade Iams Healthy Choices as I'm not so sure a pure Orijen diet is a good idea for our aging Rottweiler. The food smells very strong and it is a very dark color - very different than lower-grade commercial dry dog food.The bag is sealed when it arrives, and has a very good shelf life while sealed (air-tight) in the bag. When opened, poor the bag into a sealable (air-tight) container for storage and keep in a cool, dry place.The dog food is so expensive, one could actually cook fresh food for the dog at lesser cost. But there is an advantage in dry dog food in that it is more convenient, and the kiblets help to keep the dogs teeth clean.

My Beagle was a troublesome eater. I did research and found Orijen but feared what a high Protein diet might do to my little Diva. So, I used innovation. I mix frozen green beans, chopped up apple, broccoli, and Kir yogurt or a small can of Chef Michael and mix it with her food. The cost of Orijen is irrelevant because as many of you have said I use a small amount of it. By adding different vegetables and fruit, everyday she has a unique meal. Polo is a beautiful animal and is exceedingly happy with no health problems, and my mind is at peace.  One size does not fit all but with a little creativity you can have your own win-win.

My spoiled little dog thinks almost all Dog food really sucks. This is just about the only dry food he will even consider eating. Believe me, I have tried them all and Orijen Grain -Free Adult dry is hands down the best out there. It's expensive but worth every penny. It's hard to find locally but so easy to order through Amazon.

column9: I won't feed them anything else!

I like "Vernor's", and drink it all the time. It is old fashioned drink from Michigan, since 1866, and the labeling was known for its lovely green and gold colors and the gnome character. If you look at the can it is actually called ginger soda instead of ale and is different than typical ginger ale in taste. Vernor's has a strong vanilla presence, is smoother and more moist, and sweeter than a ginger ale. It is closer to a cream soda than ginger ale, very good. A ginger ale is more dry, higher in carbonation, and has a spicier bite to it. Vernor's has 39 grams sugar in the full size can, versus 33 grams per can for Schweppes Ginger Ale. Neither has caffeine.The recipe has changed a bit over the years mostly in the choice of sweeteners. They use the same high fructose corn syrup that the cost-cutting mega soda companies use, rather than the cane sugar they used to use. The down side to that is that the corn syrup syrup drowns out some of the flavors. Many microbrews are using cane sugar again, although it costs more, to get a better taste. Vernor's is still aged in oak barrels for 3 years, no doubt accounting for the smoothness. All in all a great soda for anytime. The soda is also known, like other ginger drinks, for its use as a home remedy for an upset stomach.Vernor's is a regional soda, and there are many areas of the country you can't find it in. That is why it sells here. They may be selling it in glass bottles again soon, at least there is a page that says so the day I am writing this comment. Search at Amazon for ASIN: B001JK2SEG to see what I mean. Vernor's has quite a history, and there are two books at Amazon about the soda. The first is Vernor's Ginger Ale (Images of America: Michigan) ISBN-10: 0738551856. The second book is "The Vernor's Story: From Gnomes to Now" ISBN-10: 0472066978 a book about the company's marketing green and gold packaging with the famous gnome, and Vernor's fans.

Ok for the price that this is selling at you just cant beat it. I mean one of these bags will easily last you a month and thats if you make it like me and add about a 2 inch layer at the bottom of an 8-cup french press! So i was torn between giving this product a 3 and 4 and here is why. First off the tea is pretty much stem free like it says at least enough to satisfy me, second it has a great flavor even after i have been storing the bags in the freezer for the past 3 months. Anyways some of the cons are: after you open one bag you really need something to store it in until you finish it up because its pretty hard sealing them up after you open it, they have a lot of powder!! almost too much for my taste, but they never said powder free, and i dont mind too much i think it may even contribute to the stronger flavor of this tea. Next if you ever brew in a tea ball, you will have some pieces left in your tea, as there are a lot of fine pieces in this tea and tea balls seem to have a hard time of holding everything in. All in all its a great product! for the health benefits of Yerba Mate you need to drink a lot of tea so this is definitely a good product for that, and it taste pretty good not as high end as some but i would definitely rank it among my top favorite tea brands. That being said, a tip on how to make a mean cup of Yerba, get a french press put about an inch or two layer on the bottom, add in your nearly boiling water, mix, and let set for about 4 minutes then pour in a mug with a spoonful of Honey..its great! and an excellent alternative to coffee. Oh and if you dont have a french press and are thinking about getting one go for the 8-cup thats just enough for about 2 full mugs of whatever your drinking, and they make awesome cups of java too!!

I first tried this sports drink while in Iraq, it being so hot there you would sweat just standing outside, you looked as though you just ran a marathon, add physical work to that; you would loose needed electrolytes and vitamins, and could cause sever heat stroke.Tang sport works just like other sports drinks with the exception, Tang is sugar free, I like this the most because there are 0 calories, those other sports drinks contain a lot of sugar and calories.I tried to find Tang sport when I got home, but no store I shopped carried it.  Found it on Amazon and ordered it right away.
I drink 32 oz of water while I work out and these add a nice taste to the water and mix up very easy and taste nice.

If you like soft licorice that contains aniseed oil as a flavouring, you'll love these. The texture is perfect. However, the weird taste that lingers on your palate after you've eaten "black licorice"? Yes, that's not licorice; that's anise.These Pontefract Cakes are advertised elsewhere as being "much stronger in flavor from the previous Pontefract Cakes, which were manufactured by the Haribo company", as though "stronger flavour" is necessarily a good thing. Ha ha. You got it. Anise is the MSG of the licorice world.Unfortunately, this was the only brand in stock and available for me to purchase, here in the USA. They are labeled "Gustaf's Licorice. Made in the UK for Gerritt [sic] J. Verburg, Michigan", and I'm pretty sure the same product appears under both brand names (Gerrit Verburg and Gustaf's) as different items on Amazon.They are not so bad that I won't eat them whenever I have a lust for Pontefract Cakes, but the anise flavour is disturbing enough that eating them dampens my ardour for more. In other words, this 2kg bag should easily see me through until the day I can replace it with the real thing, possibly the boring old unenhanced licorice flavoured Pontefract Cakes from Haribo. Assuming they still do make theirs the traditional way, without aniseed.Still, these Pontefract Cakes do get a 3-star rating simply for being better than almost any other form of licorice candy available in the States. As I say, if you are used to anise flavoured "licorice", just ignore my licorice snobbery and give them a try.--Ingredients as listed on the bag I got: Sugar Cane Syrup, Glucose Syrup, Modified Corn Starch, Invert Sugar Syrup, Wheatflour, Liquorice Extract, Potato Starch, Glazing Agent (vegetable Oil, Carnauba Wax), Aniseed Oil. Allergen Information: Contains Wheat and Gluten. May Contain Taces of Sulphites.
These are not authentic pontefract cakes.  They have a horrible aftertaste.  The licorice flavoring is obviously a cheap substitute.  Save your money!
Just recevied my order and it is not the Haribro pontefracts flavor I hoped for...tastes terrible and leaves a horrible aftertaste.  Will never order this brand again.
I had been searching for this particular licorice for years! Thank you so much for having this product. I will order again!

Great little licorice morsels.  I've been on a licorice crave for several years and these cakes are the best i've had. not too sweet, with a fantastic licoice flavor.  I've tried all different kinds and origins of licorice candy and nothing can match Pcakes.  My family and friends agree! They keep very well in the fridge.

I bought this bottarga few days ago, I had an event and I promised my guests with a special treats, it really did empress all of my guests with its rich flavor with every bite, and the color is very rich golden yellowish makes you feel the luxury when eating it.the last and most important part I was worried to receive it late after the event but luckily I got it on time, I just placed a new order this time for my family for Christmas it is 100% money value.

i really liked this bottarga ,it is tasty ,rich color , it was delivered on time,and everybody said it was delicious .it was well wrapped and the good thing is that i received in the package a recipes suggestions which was useful to me .i highly recommend this product for its great quality

I first tried the Fruity Pasta at the Germany Pavillion at Epcot at Disney World.  I was hooked. I walked around all day and ended up eating a whole bag and went back before leaving for another bag. I got home and searched to see if I could get this tasty treat here in the real world.  I was very pleased to see them at Amazon and for a great price for 12 bags.  I think they were about $3.50 a bag at Disney.  Thanks Amazon for offering such a wonderful and yummy product.
These are my favourite candies from Haribo (and many of them are really great!). The flavors are delicios and they are just as sour as a sour candy should be. I also love the texture. Yummy!
These candies are not your typical kids sour candies...they have exotic flavors and not as tart as the others.

column9: Delicious candy but be aware of issues...
column10: I normally purchase this candy locally and was happy to be able to purchase from Amazon at a discount. Unfortunately, it appears I had a 'funny' batch. The first bag I had was perfect, but the second bag seemed to have been rancid or something. Some pieces from the bag had a very strong chemical taste.

I first tasted these in Europe 14 years ago, and I'm still hooked. They're the perfect texture. I don't like gummy candies that are too soft or gelatin-like. In fact, I prefer to buy sour candies that are less "fresh" so they're harder and chewier. These are great fresh out of the bag.The flavours are strawberry, apple and pear. Usually when I eat a bag of mixed candies there's always one that isn't my favourite but I eat it anyway because it's included in the bag. All of these flavours are yummy, and I still (after 12 bags!) can't decide which I like best.Trust me, if you like sour gummy candies PLEASE try these. You won't be disappointed!!!
I love the fruity pasta and this is a great deal.  All 3 flavors that come in the package are GREAT!  The only problem is you get hooked on them and crave them and can't really find them in stores.

These things are amazing. I studied abroad in Spain 3 years ago and I used to buy packs of this candy all the time. Just the other day I randomly remembered this candy and thought to look them up online to see if I could buy them. I ordered this 12-pack from Amazon and I ate all the packs way too quickly. These are really delicious and addiciting! They are marketed as being sour, but I do not find them to be unbearably sour where they start to hurt your teeth and gums. This is a really delicious candy and I would most certainly recommend that others try it! Also, this is a great price for a 12-pack.
For any sour candy lover, this is amazing project.  There are three flavors in the packet (sour apple, pear, and strawberry).  It is a great flavor treat if you are looking for something sour.
It's sour enough! I'm recommending this anyone who has lots of stress at work... Just chew them!

Great gummy candy.  Haribo never disappoints.  I tried these new sours and they are tasty--a bit different from your traditional sour gummy.  Amazon and Haribo gives us a great deal by selling them at this price for the quantity.

column9: My husband is a sugar junkie
column10: My husband loves sugar and this is his absolute favorite candy.  It is quite delicious and addictive.

This is one of my favorite candies.  Fruity Pasta has a pleasant tartness that is just right (i.e. not so sour that it will make you ill).  The three flavors (sour apple, strawberry, and pear) are equally delicious, so I don't find myself avoiding certain colors/flavors, as often happens with assorted flavors of candy.

I first tried these when i went to Europe, and got hooked.  Thanks Amazon for selling Haribo products, besides the normal gummy bears most are hard to find in stores.  These are especially good b/c they are not too sour and not too sweet, just the right amount of both.  And the flavors are really delicious, strawbery, pear and apple.
These candies are a perfect combination of sour and sweet.  The three flavors: strawberry, pear, and apple, provide a nice variety.
Try them, you'll like them. Yes, it's that simple. :)These taste slightly different than most gummis, but in a good way!
I bought these due to the high reviews.  They had a waxy texture and were ok but not worth 5 stars.

Although I was expecting assorted flavors (and that may have been my problem with not reading the description more carefully), I was thrilled these arrived in very short time.  My daughter was thrilled to have them for Christmas.

my cats weren't crazy about this food. i've fed them wellness for six years, which they love, but i opted to try for something different. i purchased this for soft food and the castor and pollux ultramix for dry food, which they really didn't dig. they ate it, but always left the chunks of carrots and fruit in their bowls. i read this same thing in other reviews. it was an okay food, but i wouldn't buy it again. but, they do LOVE the castor and pollux organix cheddar treats.

3 out of 6 of my cats loves Castor & Pollux's Turkey canned food. It has very high quality ingredients and my cats seem to find it pretty delicious, with it's big chunks of meat and recognizable vegetables.

The four cartons of cat food came in one big box perfectly packed. The shipment arrived within a couple of days. Fabulous service; I'm going to put in a once-a-month order. It'll save me a trip to the pet shop. Thanks Amazon!

column9: You won't even think your eating healthy....
column10: I'm normally a very healthy yet picky eater.  These soy crisp are really delicious.  They look like little rice cakes, yet pack the taste of a potato chip.  I absolutely love snacking on them and with the serving size being 20 for at about 110 calories, that makes it even better.

column9: The best of all the cheese soy chips
column10: I tested most of the cheddar soy chips available online and this one had the best taste and texture. You can't go wrong with these. Also, costs less than a bag of potato chips and is WAY better for you.

column9: Low Fat and Few Calories (HEALTHY SNACK); Great Taste
column10: Glenny's Low Fat Soy Crisps are a healthy snack and I absolutely love them.  Trying to be health conscious and trying to avoid fats, I was looking for snacks that would satisfy both requirements.  I stumbled on these snacks at two (2) places: Dean's Natural Foods stores and Whole Foods.Be careful that you only select the Glenny's that say Low Fat on the label. Why? This is important if you are trying to cut fat out of your diet as well as calories.  There are no saturated fats nor any trans fats nor any cholesterol in the low fat Glennys.  There is only one gram of fat per serving.  And the calorie count is extremely low (only 70 calories per serving) versus for the regular Glennys over 110 to 120 calories per serving.The taste is great and for those who need a crunchy snack sometime during the day; this is a healthy alternative to potato chips or pop corn.  Two small servings which would only be 140 calories and 0 saturated fat would provide you with 10 grams of soy protein, 25 mg of soy isoflavones, 3 grams of dietary fiber and more soy protein than tofu or soy milk.Cosmopolitan Magazine quotes: "Even better than potato chips. Delicious."Additionally, each serving gives you 4% of your daily calcium requirement and 8% of your iron percent daily value. Each serving would be about 10 chips approximately.  I open the 3 ounce bag and separate the contents into ziplock bags (10 chips apiece) so that I can regulate the calories and the amount of fat in my snacks.What is nice for those who are afraid to buy a 3 ounce bag of anything.  Even if you succumbed to eating the entire 3 ounce bag: all would not be lost.  You would be getting 20 grams of protein, 50 mg or soy isoflavones, 6 grams of dietary fiber and 300 calories total in the whole bag.  The taste is great whether you purchase the low fat apple cinnamon, the white cheddar or the lightly salted, the low fat barbeque...all have a great taste.I would highly recommend this snack..great taste.Sample a bag.  I think you will be a fan after that.There are 1.3 ounce bags (which are being offered on Amazon) which are even better than the 3 ounce (85 gram) bags (for those who are concerned about their will power) that I have been purchasing.  You have the bags already divided into individual snack portions with 24 bags in the pack.  Terrific alternative.  This particular selection is for a six pack of the 3.5 ounce bags which I have been purchasing at my local natural food stores.Note: The White Cheddar is my personal favorite of the lightly salted, barbeque and white cheddar LOW FAT selections.  Although all are crunchy and good tasting.  MAKE SURE TO SELECT THE WHITE CHEDDAR VARIETY THAT STATES LOW FAT ON THE BAG COVER (THIS SELECTION IS 70 CALORIES PER SERVING VERSUS 110!)..GLENNY'S HAS TWO DIFFERENT WHITE CHEDDAR PRODUCT OFFERINGS..ALWAYS CHECK THE CALORIES AND THE PER SERVING NUTRITIONAL VALUES.Bentley/October 2007

Glennys organic soy crisps have always been my favorite brand until the last few times I've ordered the 6 pack from amazon.  The crisps are overcooked and have a burnt flavorless taste to them. I wind up throwing out most of the bags because they taste like cardboard. I'm given up on Glenny's organic crisps.

column9: WOW Best Healthey High Protein chips Ever!!!
column10: I got the chips and I tried them....Awesome taste and consistency. I did an experiment with a bunch of people at the office... I had them try them and they all loved them. Great flavor without the bad stuff. As a result about 8 people in the office ordered them too. If you like the BBQ flavored chips order these without hesitation, you will not be disappointed.

I used to love these chips and would purchase them all the time.  My last two deliveries I found the chips were tasteless, dry and plain lousy.  I actually shipped them back and received a refund.  Hey Glenny's!  What the heck???

i regularly purchase the glennys ranch flavored soy crisps. they must of changed their baking process. the last 4 cases have lacked flavor, and are not as crisp. they tase the same as regularsoy crisps.

They are Delicious! Great for snack, as crackers or chip.  Great for Gluten & Wheat free replacement.  I couldn't find the sea salt at the store anymore.  Found & bought them on Amazon.  Thanks Amazon!  And thanks Glenny's!Thanks Alvita

column9: The Glenny's "Lightly Salted" Chips Are Great, But the "Sea Salt" Chips Taste Funky
column10: I've been enjoying the Glenny's Lightly Salted chips for several years.  They're great.  They're hard to get in the supermarket, so I buy them by the case from Amazon .  (Sometimes they're hard to get from Amazon, too.)I thought I'd give the Glenny's Sea Salt chips a taste.  Blech.  It has a funky taste.  "Salt is salt," I thought.  I don't know if it's only the taste of the different salt that makes the chip taste funky, or if they make that variety of the chip differently in other ways.I trashed the entire case of the Sea Salt chip, and went back to the Lightly Salted variety."To each, his own taste."

Glenny's soy crisps with olive oil,garlic & feta chese is good tasting!!!But people with hypertention will proberbly have increased numbers...When my wife ate the product her numbers were 188/109...next day with no product her numbers were 139/83...She still loves the product & will order more...

Folks, maybe it's because I'm not use to eating horrendously healthy snacks - but these truly reminded me of cardboard covered in cheap powdered flavorings.  And one thing I learned the hard way - food items are not returnable, even though they are in sealed bags.  So now I'm stuck with 24 bags.  And my daughter, who eats horrendously healthy (soy, tofu, etc), won't even go near them.  She also thinks they resemble cardboard.

Love these soy chips by Glennys! They are guilt-free, taste good and low calorie. I'm losing a few pounds by adding these to my new diet. This bag size is perfect for 3-4 evenings of before bed snacking.

I decided to try these as a protein alternative for my kids' lunches.  I like that they are organic, and the flavor sounded good.  I tried them when they came, and they really do taste great!  They have a light crunch, and they are the perfect size for kid lunches and snacking.  The kids really liked them as well, so I bought them again.

column9: High in protein and tastes great!
column10: I was so shocked to see that there were 7 grams of protein in serving of these chips that were only 80 calories.  This is really impressive, since most protein bars that pack similar amounts of protein are way more calorie rich and packed with a lot more sugar and fat.  I compared these soy chips with the PowerBar ProteinPlus High Protein Bars and here are the stats if you were to eat 3 servings of these chips (to get comparable protein amounts):Glenny's vs Powerbar:21 g protein vs 23 g protein240 cals vs 290 cals0 g sat fat vs 3.5 g sat fat3 g fiber vs 2 g fiber27 g carbs vs 37 g carbsSo the powerbar has 2 more grams of protein, but is 50 more calories and tons more carbs.On top of that the chips taste great and are perfect if you love crunchy, savory, carby stuff but still want to get that protein.  Highly recommended!--Don't worry, I don't work for them, I just did all these calculations because I literally could not believe the protein content in these considering they are also low fat, low carb and low cal as well.  Why doesn't this get any more cred?
the garlic,olive oil and feta taste is wonderful, chips are crisp.  I love them, and they're good for me.

I took a chance and ordered these on one of Amazons deals and WOW I am glad. I love the taste and the fact they are not horrible for you makes it even better. I will defiantly be sharing these and be ordering more. I plan on trying other things from Glennys.

column9: A nice alternative to the usual flavors
column10: These feta, garlic and olive oil chips are a great alternatives to the usual bbq, cheddar, sour cream and onion flavors.
These soy crisps have a genuine barbecue potato chip taste that is a great substitute for the fatty calorie laden chip. I highly recommend them.
These are great little snacking chips with the benefit of Soy.  Best of all, they are gluten free.  Great with tuna salad, jam, peanut butter, or chip dip.
These are yummy.  If you follow weight watcher's, they are a good 2 point snack!

I have long been an avid fan of Glenny's products.  Unfortunately, the two stores in my hometown that carried Clenny's Soy Crisps stopped carrying them.  That's when I turned to Amazon.com, from whom I ended up ordering from six to twelve bags of nearly each flavor.  They arrived at my door so quickly (in only two or three days, despite the prediction of more than a week) that I was completely astonished.  For people who are on Weight Watchers, they can eat twice as many of these crisps than they can other similar products for the same number of points.  The crisps are a delectable alternative to crackers and chips, and in lieu of croutons, I have crumbled them into salads as well.  I have even melted fat free cheese on them.  They are worth the money and the few days' wait.

I looooove these chips. Super tasty. Just got to watch out for how much salt it has, and sometime not every bag gets the same amount of flavor dusting. Seriously though, even with a dud bag or two I like the taste and the protein that I can get from munching!

I have tried many brands of soy chips and these are the best I have found. And they are one of the few brands that come in plain ol salted. I don't do the flavored chips. Their customer service on the home site needs major improvement, but Glenny's still makes the best chips.
These taste really good. I found myself eating a whole bag of them every day. They are very healthy for you and taste so delicious.
These crackers are extremely flavorful and taste great.  They are also gluten free and low fat.  This combination is very hard to find.

Looking for an easy way to incorporate some soy protein in your (and your kids) diet?  Soy Crisps are a fun and easy way, and delicious.  Don't worry, they don't taste weird.  Even my son (who hates everything) likes these.

I try to be healthier with my snack choices, and this isn't horrible. Could be worse, could be better. If you're a "healthy snack food" person, definitely check this out. If you're like me ... skip a soda and grab those Cheetos. :)

CRUNCHMASTER 4 CHEESE CRACKERS ARE THE BEST!!  I LOVE THE CHEESE FLAVOR, THE LIGHTNESS OF THE CRACKER & THE CRUNCHYNESS.  IT'S BY FAR THE BEST CHEESY CRACKER. NOT TOO SALTY AND THE FLAVOR ADDS TO ANYTHING YOU PUT WITH IT OR JUST EATEN BY ITSELF IT'S GREAT!!

I picked up these Crunchmaster Rice (Artisan Four Cheese) Crackers at a nearby Costco Store. They looked good, and a lady gave me one to taste. They were good. Into the cart went a six package box. They're the same as these, only packed together in a slightly different way.The crackers are excellent. They're real crunchy, way moreso than most crackers and they have the faint taste and smell of cheese. They're lightly salted and have a very low fat content. I enjoy them by themselves as snacks, or I eat them with smoked oysters or sardines as a light lunch. Or, I have them with a variety of spreads. They're pretty versatile, and delicious I should add.Gary Peterson
I get tired of wheat flour crackers because they are so thick.  These crackers and light and crunchy.  They are delicious.
My husband and I love these crackers.  Their regular rice crackers are good, but with the cheesy coating on these, they are our favorites.

column9: really like these but Amazon keeps running out of stock
column10: We really like these but half the time when you go to reorder, Amazon is out of stock. These rice crackers have a little bit of cheese taste which really makes a lot of difference in the taste compared to plain rice crckers.

Everyone who comes to my house LOVES these crackers.  For rice crackers they have a lot of flavor.  I love that they are also low fat so I don't feel guilty while indulging.  I do not have to eat gluten free but I still buy them for the taste.  I bought them at Costco but otherwise they are hard to find.  The sesame ones are good too but not as good.
The candy received in wonderful packaging. There was no broken pieces and not one button off the paper and the freshness was great

This is a staple food at our house. It's the only cereal that my children (all eight of them) NEVER get tired of! It has a wonderful toasty corn taste, yet it's packed with good-for-you stuff. Amazon's price (especially when their special is going) is outstanding.

I really LIKE this cereal, as opposed to..... well, this is something I can eat safely (without gluten). I put all those extra bags in the freezer but will definitely eat them up. Another popular GF cereal is so HARD and extra-crunchy that is beats up my tongue. This is quite tasty and just the right normal "flake" texture.

I love the flavor of this cereal and it is a good source of fiber also.Since I have had to change my diet to gluten free foods it has been a challenge to absorb the extra expense. I was buying this cereal at the local natural market and was paying $8.15 per bag plus tax. I am now purchasing this cereal in bulk on a delivery schedule and am saving  a lot of money. I usually eat this cereal once or twice daily and always enjoy the taste.
This is a great cereal that can also be used as GF bread crumbs. I use it on fish and chicken.

Prior to 2012, this was my favorite cereal. Tasty, healthy and gluten-free. Sometime in 2012, they reformulated the flakes such that they are now totally tasteless and lack any texture. They are thin and become almost instant mush in liquid. There is no longer any solid 'crunch' or interest. You might as well be eating cheap corn flakes. Save your money until they return to the old recipe.

My personal favorite cereal. Just thin enough to be crispy, just sweet enough to be tasty, and good for you with the Omega-3 from the flax seed.  Gluten free, organic, sweetened with evaporated cane juice. One of my kids balked at the tiny black specks from the flax so she mixes the Mesa Sunrise with Envirokids Panda Puffs and likes the combination.

I used to buy this cereal for my husband, who has celiac. He tells me that it's been reformulated and now the flavor isn't quite as good as it was and it gets soggy in milk quickly. Sadly, I'm switching to something else. For someone who must be gluten free, this is still a good option, but I'm not sure that the change in the product makes it worth the price anymore.Nature's Path Organic Mesa Sunrise Cereal, 26.4-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)

I am a Celiac and have ordered this item many times in the past.  It was very good and was a staple in my morning breakfast. However, my last shipment was not good at all.  I opened the first bag and it had a strong plastic smell.  I tried it anyway and it was terrible.  I poured out the whole bag and went to the next one.  Same result.  Not sure what happened, but I won't risk buying this again.Update: I found out from Nature's Path that this can happen when the product is expired.  This is more of a comment on Amazon for shipping me an expired product thant the product itself.

column9: Great cereal even for those who eat gluten
column10: I am a cereal maniac.  I eat it every morning.  I always have more than a dozen different kinds on hand.  Nature's Path makes a number of good cereals, but this is my favorite.  In fact, since the tragic moment years ago when Kashi company ruined Kashi Medley, Mesa Sunrise is my #1 favorite cereal of any kind.  If you like cereal and haven't tried this, you're in for a treat.It is especially good as a replacement for cornflakes: more substance, *much* less sweet, and doesn't stick to the teeth.

I eat this cereal almost every day, and have for a few years now.  It is so delicious!  I top it with different fruits and so far I haven't gotten bored.  It's just really delicious -- not to mention super-healthy!

column9: Favorite cereal of all, wheat and no-wheat
column10: This cereal is wonderful!  It has almost everything I like in a cereal, including 1)  it is delicious, 2) it fills me up (not a lot of puffy air), 3)  I feel good after I eat it, 4) it's organic, and 5) it doesn't have wheat or gluten.  Buying it via Amazon, it is also affordable (about $3.65/pound, compared to $4.69/10-oz box at the nearest health food store (90 miles away), which is about $7.50/pound).  The ONLY thing I don't like about it is that it MAY contain peanut, and my wheat-allergic daughter is also deathly allergic to peanut.  So, she can't eat it.  I can and I do.  She's jealous, because she started eating it and ate a couple of bites before she read where it might contain peanut, and she (picky, picky, picky eater) loved it.  Please Please Please would someone at Nature's Path figure out how to eliminate the peanut?  Anyway, if you're not allergic to peanut, try it.  I definitely  prefer this to any other cold cereal I have ever tried, period.
This is the only gluten free cereal I eat because it doesn't get any better than this.
This is a wonderful cereal. It actualy tastes like cereal. If you have celiac you will definitely want to try it.

column9: Excellent option for people with Celiac Disease
column10: When I was first diagnosed with Celiac Disease (Gluten Intolerance), I was surprised at how many cereals contained food additives or other items that I couldn't eat.  Even if I ignored the cereals that were made directly from wheat / barley / oats / rye (the 4 things I cannot eat), there were still many other cereals based on soy, rice or corn (maize) that had barley malt in as a flavoring, so I couldn't eat them.  I tried many cereals until I found this one and I have had this as my mainstay ever since. It is tasty, has an excellent texture and I am sure anyone would like it. You wouldn't need to be on a special diet to enjoy this as a breakfast dish.

column9: The BEST GFCF Cereal for the WHOLE FAMILY!
column10: This is a BIG bag of cereal, carried at Whole Foods for about $7.00 a bag. But, we eat this every day (even my picky kids - ages 3,6,8). It has a thick, crisp texture with a slightly sweet, nutty flavor. It also makes a wonderful, crispy GFCF breading for chicken nuggets - just coat nuggets with some melted GFCF margerine, dip into crushed flakes and bake for 20 minutes at 425 F. YUM...ENJOY!!
I've been trying to find a gluten-free cereal that tastes good and this is THE BEST so far. Love it. I'm buying them here at Amazon by the big boxes, pack of 6! :)

column9: What happened to this great cereal?
column10: Nature's Path Organic Mesa Sunrise Cereal, 26.4-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)I have been eating this cereal every morning for many years. My last shipment was different in several ways.  The flakes were thicker, tough and stuck in my teeth, and there was a gritty feel which gave me kind of a sore tongue.  I contacted the cereal company online and they promised to make it right.  Said the cereal had not changed its formula but during the period in question, there was a glitch and the flakes were rolled thinner.  Didn't seem that to me, just the opposite, plus the taste was altered for the worse.  They have sent me coupons to buy Nature's Path products, but no one around my small town carries it.  I will use them, however, when I get to a larger city, 50 miles away.  I then ordered the same cereal "with raisins" described as plump and juicy raisins, from a different on-line distributor.  It's the same, except the raisins are like little hard rocks. We ground the first shipment up for the birds, but they won't eat it either.

Unfortunately, all six packages that arrived were within one week of their expiration date, and all six packages of cereal were rancid.  To its credit, Amazon refunded the total price for the product.  We were very disappointed because we have been great fans of the Mesa Sunrise Cereal, which we have previously purchased from the local grocery stores.  Perhaps Amazon could somehow list the expiration dates of the product(s) before listing them on its website.

I purchased the Mesa Sunrise cereal because it is gluten free and supposed to have 6 grams of fiber per serving.  It has only 3 grams of fiber.  It does taste good, but I notice your description still says the 6 grams.  Suggest you change it.
This cereal is very delicious.  I love it because it has 3g protein and 3g fiber and amaranth,quinoa, and corn flour.  It has a great texture and rich tast.  I would definitely recommend it.

I just cannot say enough good things about this cereal.  It has a terrific grainy crunchiness, doesn't get soggy, and is high in fiber - does it get better?  Nature's Path is SO expensive in the grocery store, so I always buy it in bulk from Amazon - it comes in these gret space-saving and environmentally-friendly bags.

column9: Great Taste and Good Source of Fiber
column10: This is my favorite cereal. It's low sugar, low salt, high fiber, great taste, organic and has flax and omega-3. It's a very tasty cereal unless you like the super sugary kind. Make sure that when you get the box, you look on the outside of the shipping box to find the expiration date because the bags are not marked. The expiration on mine was about 6 months after the date purchase. Note that there are about 25 servings and 6 bags, so that's 150 bowls of cereal to eat in 180 days! That's a lot of cereal. You better have someone willing to eat it with you. If you don't think you can eat that much then try the 10 oz packages of Mesa Sunrise. I took the advice of another commenter and put half of it in the freezer to help keep it fresh. I'm on my second bag but slowing down. I change it up by adding fruit, like banana, strawberries or blueberries. I tried carob powder but should have mixed it in my rice milk first before pouring it on the cereal. Raisins or dried cherries would go good with it, too. This cereal holds up pretty well in milk.

Mesa Sunrise is better than cornflakes ever thought of being.  Healthy, multi-grain, gluten-free, low sodium, has flax (get your Omega-3's), and amaranth. (How many cereals have that?)  Oh, and corn too. I think it's delicious with fruit and fat-free milk in the morning--a complete and healthy breakfast. I highly recommend it to others with celiac disease.

column9: does what a cereal should do!
column10: This is a delicious choice for breakfast.  I thought it wouldn't hold me from hunger for long because it was flakes, but it really does a good job!  It stays crunchy considerably well, and has just the right sweetness.  Tastes healthy, but not in a gross way :0) You feel like you are making a good decision to eat it.  Definitely worth it, because of the volume of cereal you get!
If you are looking for gluten free cereal that is not sweet...this is the one. It tastes like corn flakes and holds milk well.

The number of palatable gluten free cereal flakes is quite limited and they are usually quite expensive.  This cereal costs $7.00/bag at my local health food store.  One needs a place to store a case of 26 oz bags, but it's worth it to buy from Amazon.com by the case.

When it comes to prepared cereals, this has to be one of the best manufactured in North America in terms of value for money.  That it is also delicious and that it doesn't go soggy as soon as you pour on the milk are two more good reasons to try and buy Mesa Sunrise.  And if you are concerned about all that other stuff mentioned described with words like "organic", "kosher", "gluten-free" and so on, then by all means enjoy the extra feelings of vindication.
I was so happy to see Amazon carry this product. It is very good, very healthy, and uses minimum packaging.
Mesa Sunrise is great - very tasty organic, wheat free, not too sweet, delicious ceral. I have eat it every morning if I can.

Sometimes there is an unusual aftertaste in wheat free foods from the grains that are used as wheat substitutes, but I don't find that to be the case with this cereal. It gets a little soggy if you don't eat it quickly enough, and I add dried cranberries to give it a little more interest, but overall it is good! I do not find it to be too sweet-I'd say it's slightly sweeter than plain corn flakes.

column9: I can enjoy this every morning!
column10: I like to eat this with almond milk, granola that containes raw nuts, seeds, and dried fruits, and flaxseed...yummy!  I've offered it to others for breakfast; they luved it, and the fact that it was gluten-free surprised them!

This cereal smelled strongly or turpentine or chemical, which indicates that the flax seed content has gone rancid. It is likely due to heat during storage or shipment to us. We had to throw it out. It was a waste of money.

column9: Used to be great.  Now horrible.
column10: My wife has celiac disease so she's on a gluten-free diet.  She used to love this cereal and we had it on a "Subscribe & Save" from Amazon.  The product changed in the last order and it's now horrible and we cancelled our subscription.  The manufacturer needs to go back to the former recipe!

This is one of my favorite Gluten Free cereals, and ranks near the top of my list from before going on a Gluten free diet. Highly recommend! Took one star off because it gets soggy pretty quickly, but I found a work around to that....eat faster!

NOT DISAPPOINTED WITH THIS PRODUCT!  I really love this cereal!  I have IBD and corn is more easily digested than wheat in my case.  This is far superior to plain ole' corn flakes!  Thanks, Amazon, for making it available.

column9: Great cereal but does have a strange smell
column10: I love this cereal and was so excited to find it at Warehouse clearout pricing, likely because the expiry date is a month away.The cereal does have a strange smell to it - sort of chemical-like. I have a very good sense of smell, so I really notice it.However, it tastes fine. And the smell sort of dissipates if you leave the bag open for a little while before eating it.I purchased 18 bags of the stuff, so I am happy that it had no bad taste.I threw them in all in the freezer as there is no way I am going to eat all 18 bags in one month, but I had read a review that the expiry date might be soon, so I was prepared for that.I think they did change their receipe, but I didn't really notice as I didn't buy it much prior to recently. It does get mushy in milk, but what cereal doesn't.Much more filling than Chex.I am happy with the purchase - much better than $8-$10 per bag that I have been paying at the grocery store here in Ontario.

This is a delicious cereal even if you don't have to eat gluten-free.  However, the cereal is not fresh.  The expiration date was only a couple of months away on the batch I ordered.  It's a lot to eat in a short period of time.

I used to buy Mesa Sunrise mainly to use for baking and cooking (it's fabulous crumbled as a coating for homemade chicken fingers). As my daughter has gotten older, she has started to like less sweet, more natural food (love it!) Mesa Sunrise has become one of her favorite cereals to eat for breakfast or even just to snack on plain. I love that it's not loaded with sugar, is gluten-free and is a good source of fiber.
This cereal tastes terrible.  I had one bowl and I could barely eat half of it.  They need to go back to the drawing board

I keep this cereal on hand all the time.  I like the taste.  It is low fat, low sodium and has 3 grams of fiber per 3/4 cup serving.  I open the bag and transfer it into a tupperware cereal container.  I also take the cereal with me when I travel.  When my family eats from the motel breakfast, I can eat this.  Amazon has a good price.  I order it on the subscribe and save program
Very satisfying and lightly sweet. I like the fact that it is gluten free and healthy.I found the best price for this cereal on Amazon.

The last two packages I purchased had a terrible smell and taste. There have been numerous other reports here and on the Nature's Path website of a bad, possibly rancid smell. On their website, Nature's Path has offered "to make this right" when someone submits a complaint.

I have been ordering this box of six large bags as I use them, but this last order had a use by freshness date of November 11.  Delivered Sept. 25th, used the first one week and a half later.  Have to give some of it away as no way we can eat six bags in 5 weeks..

column9: Last shipment had a horrible smell
column10: Used to buy this for half a year or so and everything was great. All of a sudden last shipment came (October 2011) and cereal in all bags had a horrible smell to it. Had to throw all 6 bags in a dumpster. What a waste!

This is a tasty cereal.  My husband must have gluten free products and has been eating this for 5+ years.  I have been driving all over town to find it.  Sometimes the health food store has it; sometimes a local grocery has it; sometimes no one has it.  I am saving time and money by getting it from Amazon.  It keeps well in the pantry so having 6 bags at once is okay and convenient.

column9: Funky Smell but still tastes great
column10: Could just be me, but it anyone noticing a funky smell off these bags that stays with the cereal - like plastic?  I don't taste it, I just smell it.  Like the bags got really hot and outgassed onto the cereal.Could be my sinuses from ragweed season - or it could be some really funky bags.  Anyone else?
I eat this cereal every day and love it. That is why I have to buy in bulk! I recommend it as a healthy good tasting gluten free breakfast.
This is the most nutritious gluten free cereal I have found! I buy it in lots of six ecopacks, and I am never out of it.

This cereal tastes great! It's light, crunchy and mildly sweet. You don't get any weird after tastes that other gluten free products tend to have. It tastes like real cereal and not a fake gluten free version of cereal... if you know what I mean. It stays crunchy in all milk varieties (dairy and non-dairy). I just love it!!! I even pack in little containers and take to work to eat dry as a snack. The cereal comes in environmental friendly bags. You get 6 bags per shipment. I pour a bag into a large air tight pasta jar for easy dispensing and I put the empty bangs in the recycle bin. You really can't beat the convenience and price of Amazon's Subscribe and Save. I highly recommend this product.

I love this cereal.  It is the only gluten free cereal that I have found that tastes good and is worth the price.  It doesn't get soggy too fast in milk and doesn't need any added sugar; a big plus. It also uses whole grains.  I order it by the case so I won't run out of it. Getting it by the case on automatic shipment also helps save a little on the cost.
i enjoy this gluten free product every day, sometimes twice a day.i eat it with soy milk and fruit.

I love this cereal! I'm gluten intolerant and it is hard to find a cereal that is multi-grain and gluten free. Most GF cereals are just a single grain and this one is not that is why it is so good. It stays crisp for quite a while in milk and is slightly sweet which helps and doesn't have a million calories per serving. I have this on my list to send to me every 2 months. This is a keeper! Another benefit is that it is organic and I liked that.

We love this cereal, both parents, child and toddler!  Unlike many other Gluten Free cereals, it contains a bit more fiber; which if you are Celiac you understand why I mention that!  The fiber content is not overly high, so I would gather that it has more to do with the flax.  It is a good crispy cereal with a fairly mild flavor, which is slightly sweet.  The one peculiar thing is that even though it tastes great, the smell is not as pleasant as the taste.  This is also likely because of the flax.  And if it gets past the expiration date, you will know it... nasty odor!  That said, it is probably the best organic, gluten free cereal we have found that has more nutritional value.  Unfortunately many GF cereals seem to lack nutritional content.  Buying it by the case from Amazon, using Subscribe and Save is hands down the best deal I have found.  Hopefully someday Nature's Path will make the Vanilla and Maple flavored Mesa Sunrises in the economy size too.
This is the only cereal that agrees with me and that I eat every morning.  I have Celiac disease so this is very beneficial in my diet and has the right ingredients for me.

I love Mesa Sunrise cereal. It tastes great, has protein, fiber, holds up well in milk or yogurt or juice and oh, did I say it tastes great? Two g-free friends recently tried it and agree it's delicious. The case of six bags came within a few days and shipping was/is free. It keeps well.
I have been eating this cereal for several years now and I never tire of it. Nature's Path makes some tasty, different cereals, they are whole grain and gluten free.

I started eating Nature's Path a few years ago when I was really busy getting my education degree. I have a gluten allergy, and my mom had this cereal in her cupboard, so I grabbed a couple of handfuls in a ziplock bag and went to school. It was delicious! I sometimes crush up Mrs. May's nuts and add them to my cereal for some extra crunch/flavour/protein. Sweet, but yummy!Later, I contacted the company and they told me they not only wash the lines between runs of gluten-full and gluten free cereal, but they also throw out the first two batches of gluten free cereal to minimize cross contamination! I am super sensitive, and I have never had a problem with Nature's Path.

The cereal was shipped in a box specifically made with perforations for easy opening for shelf display of the product.  Of course, the inevitable rough handling caused enough of the perforations to come apart that the leading bag of cereal by the opening got punctured in several places.This is a delicious cereal! Previous shipment had the product box inside an Amazon box; the contents arrived intact.  I'll reorder & hope that procedure is replicated.

Mesa Sunrise tastes great stays fresh. I eat it every morning with a banana. When I get down to last bag I order more. It only tskes a few days to arrive. Great price even compared to non gluten free cereals combined with free shipping you can't beat it.

This is my favorite gluten free cereal - and healthy too! My semi-local health food store can't keep enough of it in stock so I am thrilled to have it on subscribe and save. Nature's Path Organic Mesa Sunrise Cereal, 26.4-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)

column9: GREAT cereal - just happens to also be gluten free
column10: As I said in the title, this is great cereal that also just happens to be gluten free.  It's not a "kids" cereal, and has a distinct taste that is somewhat unlike any other (so it's hard to describe).  I purchase it by the case (six) of the large bags (26.4 oz./bag), and eat it often.  I don't know what else to say beyond that - great cereal, very good pricing even when compared to much poorer quality "supermarket" cereals.  Nature's Path makes a number of really quality cereals, and this is one of my favorites.  I give 5 stars only with truly superior products - and this one is a no-brainer.I can imagine there will be some who will not like the taste all that much (especially those used to sugared cereals), so perhaps buying one smaller box at the grocery store would make sense to "sample" it (if they even carry it - try a health food store or the "natural" section of your regular supermarket if they have one).

Excellent product.  I'm using a natural process to fight cancer in my lymph system and this is my usual breakfast meal.  No preservatives, artificial color or flavors means I can safely eat this cereal daily without feeding the cancer cells.  Since I love grainy foods, it's GREAT!

column9: Best gluten-free cereal I've ever tasted!
column10: It's difficult to get enough cereals in a gluten-free diet.  Nature's Path Organic Mesa Sunrise Cereal is the answer to that problem.  I first discovered it in the special foods section of a local supermarket, but it's so popular they can't always keep it stocked.  It's made from flax, amaranth and corn.  It contains heart-healthy Omega 3.  It provides fiber.  It keeps well.  It tastes so great I have no desire to mask it's excellent natural flavor with added sugar.  Mesa Sunrise is my favorite cereal.  I like it so well I order it from Amazon in bulk.  Do try it.  If you like cold cereals, you'll love Mesa Sunrise.

column9: Love This - It's our main GF breakfast option
column10: We usually eat a mixture of cereals in the morning - a little bit of a sweet cereal (like Cinnamon Chex or Panda Puffs), a few nuts and/or raisins, and then fill the rest of the bowl with Mesa Sunrise.  Very tasty and good for you!  Ordering it by the case at amazon.com is much cheaper and easier than bringing it all home from the store each week.  It's like having the mailman do my shopping for me.  Highly recommend.

I think this is really good.  it's like corn flakes but with a nutty flavor. i also love the fact that it is so healthy.  nice texture too. be prepared though, it is a HUGE amount of cereal. i have my whole family eating it.  But considering how much GF cereal costs in stores, this is a really good price and a great product.
This is not only a good tasting gluten-free cereal, but it is about 30% cheaper from Amazon.com than available in local grocery stores.
A tasty organic and gluten free product at a solid price comparable with mainstream products. It's got a good amount of fiber too. Recommended
I recently started eating this cereal.  From my first bite, I have loved this cereal.  I look forward to each bite!

If you need to eat gluten-free, this is a good cereal. The reason I like it is that unlike most gluten-free cereals, this one has a lot of different whole grains, and is not too expensive. I like to add raisins or banana to it, but it is slightly sweet on its own. It has a pleasant taste. A good standby.

Mesa Sunrise is one of only a few gluten-free cereals my husband would make a special trip to Whole Foods to purchase before it was offered on Amazon.It's a great tasting cereal, even for those who are not on a gluten-free diet. Good texture, doesn't get soggy in milk (unless, of course, you let it sit for an extended period of time!).I recommend this to anyone, especially those people on gluten-free diets. It's definitely worth every penny.
A great substitute for those allergic to gluten, but good enough to be eaten by all.

I've been eating Mesa Sunrise almost daily for several months now.  I'm on a gluten free diet, and I'm breastfeeding, so I have a big appetite.  I add raisins or Craisins to make it a little more interesting, but even without, I find it to be one of the most satisfying gluten free cereals I've tried.

I only eat this cereal and had always purchased it locally at a grocery store and they stopped carrying it.  I found it on Amazon, at a savings, and have purchased it in bulk 2x.  The only problem is you have to purchase it when Amazon carries it and not a 3rd party supplier otherwise the cost is not a savings as compared to the grocery store where I originally bought it.  If you want it no matter what, then the cost is irrelevant but I went to Amazon initially b/c the cereal is pricey to start with.  I love this cereal and I eat it in the middle of the day if I need a crunchy taste.
This is my favorite gluten-free cereal.  I top it off with banana and goat yogurt that cuts the sweetness.

Because of my restriction to a gluten-free diet I have a small list of breakfast cereals from which to choose and when I found this cereal I couldn't believe how good it tastes, it's a great flake cereal, one that I would recommend to everyone to try. I order it regularly, I can't live without it in my pantry.

I purchased this cereal because of my intolerance to gluten.  It does not upset my stomach so that is nice.  It tastes fine I like to sprinkle it with a little xylitol and use almond milk instead of cow.  It is not fantastic nor is it gross.  I am pleased with it.

column9: Nature's Path Organic Mesa Sunrise Cereal
column10: Mesa Sunrise is our favorite of the Organic Nature's Path cereals. We have eaten it for several years now. I also appreciate the eco-pac bags that reduce packaging and can be re-used as waxed paper. Amazon was the best price I found as of 7/07 and the free delivery was prompt and added to the value.

O.k., disclaimer:  in addition to being gluten intolerant, I'm actually something of a food snob.What's great about this:Good texture--it's like raisin bran, which is fantastic if you have adult-onset celiac and still crave raisin branHolds up well in milk.  It didn't get soggy fast.It's really gluten-free! No stomachache, etc.What's not so great:This tastes, I swear, like squash.  Even doused in really sweet almond milk and raisins, I couldn't choke down more than a few spoonfuls.  The taste, if you are a medium-to-supertaster, is beyond disgusting.This would probably be good for not-so-picky-gluten-free-eaters, but it's a bad idea for picky kids, so don't spend the extra to buy it in bulk, until your picky eaters have tasted it, first.More gluten-free food for my local food bank. Score.

The price of this product (and many others) via Amazon is excellent compared to the "Whole Paycheck" types of "healthy" supermarkets. I'm totally pleased with this cereal. It tastes great, but surely the sugar content boosts its taste appeal. Organic or not, sugar is sugar, and many have been advised to keep their distance from it. Nature's Path should consider using alternate sweeteners, such as, organic of course, brown rice syrup or raw blue agave syrup. The macrobiologists would be jazzed!

Nice to have a genuine multigrain product for a Gluten Free Diet.  This is a good tasting cereal, but it get soggy pretty fast.  I mix it half and half with some homemade Granola and it is a pretty good breakfast that way.

Have ordered this delicious nutritious salmon through the Subscribe and Save program for awhile now, which would be a good deal except almost every shipment has contained dented cans, as many as 50% of the order. Interestingly enough, the dented cans have their dented sides facing the center of the packaging and cannot be seen until the tight plastic wrap is cut open and the cans removed. Am looking into whether or not I can return a partial shipment. I'm not sure what the FDA says about dented canned food but my background in food service makes me unwilling to risk it, especially with seafood. If the issue can be resolved I'd love to continue buying it through this otherwise cost-effective and convenient program -LOVE stocking my home pantry and rotating my earthquake stash through Amazon Subscribe and Save!

column9: A little expensive for what you get but good.
column10: I get canned red salmon in my stocking every Christmas, and this year my husband was so busy that I ordered it for him to put in.  The price of salmon has gone up so dramatically over the past few years that it's hard to say whether it is a bargain or not but I think it's OK.This is not gourmet quality but it is very nice lunch or salad quality.Here's my favorite lunch:One half cup cooked jasmine rice - put in the middle of the plate.One half can drained red salmon, one half sliced cucumber, one sliced roma tomato, 1/4 avocado (sliced)all this arranged around the rice.  Put a sprig of basil or cilantro on the plate, drizzle a little of olive oil over, and serve with a wedge of lime.Follow up with a cup of quick steeped jasmine tea.Note that one can makes enough for two lunches - for ladies.  My husband thinks this is utter nonsense.Enjoy!
Wont buy again, I eat alot  of canned salmon, had this brand  before, but these 4 cans were not good.

This is the first canned red salmon I've tried and I was really pleased with the texture, flavor and taste - and the price.  A friend bought one of the cans from me to try and she raved about how delicious it is.  Since I really do not enjoy the smell of fish I much prefer this smaller size can which is ideal for one meal for my husband and me, leaving no left overs to "perfume" our refrigerator.Red salmon is considerably higher in Omega 3's than pink salmon. This fish is so good that I've only used it for salmon salad so far.  Perhaps I will make salmon patties out of it in the future even though I hate to add egg and crumbs to hide the delicious flavor!Additional comment - April 2012: I have never been disappointed with a Roland brand product but in the past couple of months the price of this salmon went much higher and have now switched to Pillar Rock brand which is equally as delicious and seems to have less fish odor even though it has skin and bones (more healthful) which the Roland brand does not have.If the Roland brand goes on sale at a really good price in the future I would order more of it.

I purchased several cans of salmon in anticipation of wonderful salmon. Instead, after 1 can was opened, a visual inspection revealed vertebrae with lots of little bones. A small bite revealed a good taste of salmon, however the whole can was disposed of as it was deemed not safe to eat, due to the bones.

column9: AN INGREDIENT FOR A GREAT SANDWICH
column10: This canned red salmon is the main ingredient of a great salad for sandwiches.  I have an aversive reaction to the skin, and the liquid is a bit much for including in a salad, but removing the skin and draining the liquid makes for a wonderful addition to Jessie's otherwise somewhat bland flavored dog food, and she loves it too.  So I can munch a tasty sandwich and Jessie can get more enjoyment from her breakfast--we all win with this product.

This is the same chili powder you get at the local market, but at a MUCH lower price per ounce by buying it through Amazon and in bulk. We've used it for years to make great chili. As I was making chili Friday night to have ready for football games this weekend, my wife tasted it and complimented my seasoning. I had to admit to her that the only secret in seasoning chili is to put enough chili powder in it so that it tastes like chili. LOL That's not completely true, a lot of other things add to the taste, but that is indeed the #1 requirement.I'll just use this large container to refill my smaller "shaker spice bottle" when its empty. We should have our chili powder requirements met for the next few years now.
A+ spice- exactly what I would expect to find a grocery store- except my grocery store doesn't stock this size.
A great product.  Past experience has shown good results.  Am very pleased with purchase.  Will reorder again from same source.
This tea is absolutely delicious.  I have it as a dessert and it is so satisfying.  The price is very high - I buy this at health food stores for $7.99.  I was hoping to find a better deal on Amazon.

I found this in a coffee shop and was delightfully surprised.  this is the best coconut tea I have ever had.  Everyone that I give a tea bag to,  wants to buy it.  It is perfect by itself or with cream.  it has just a hint of cocoa - I found it to be more for coconut lovers than chocolate lovers - although my sister in law who is a chocolate nut loved this tea.  Hopefully Amazon will carry this soon because the coffee shop is gone and I am running low...!

I buy this tea in a local gourmet coffee/tea shop by my home.  It's delicious!  I usually drink it with cream but it's great without as well.  It's a really nice dessert drink, but I drink it anytime.  I brought it to my grandmother's for Christmas and we served it during desert and it was a hit.

column9: Delicious!  But you can find it for less than ten bucks
column10: I found this tea in my local WF.  I love it with honey and rice milk.  I know that sounds odd, but it really complements the coconut and slight cocoa flavor.  I was hoping to find it here for less than I paid.  Guess I'll keep looking.

I found this tea at my local WF market -- and I'm officially in love. In fact, I'd rank it as my favorite, and this is coming from someone with a whole cabinet full of different teas ranging from loose leaf orange creamsicle to bagged Hawaiian macadamia nut. I recommend letting it steep a bit longer than you think it would require. I enjoy mine with brown sugar and cream. Dessert in a cup...and oh so decadent!

column9: Everything you wanted to know, but . . . ?
column10: I decided this product needed a dissenting opinion among it's unanimous six five-star ratings:) My favorite tea - and along a similar line of tea taste - is TAZO Well-Being Focus (black tea, roasted yerba mate, orange essence, and cocoa peel); to me, this Republic tea's taste didn't quite sit at the same five-star level. I have an embarrassing number of teas in my pantry due to years of searching for a tea that I love as much as great coffee - since coffee doesn't always agree with my stomach and skin. I love the flavor of coconut, chocolate, dates, and malt barley . . . which is how the label describes this tea. I added brown sugar and milk - and would rate the taste, at most, a 4.5. But this Republic of Tea tasted WAY WAY better than Zhena's coconut chai black tea (canister) or Celestial's decaf coconut chai (I didn't care for the latter two). At regular retail price, TAZO Focus is less expensive, too - so Republic of Tea's final rating tipped downward to four stars. (2012 February Tip: our local WF has this Republic of Tea on sale for $7.99, down from $10.99.) You might want to know that the label also indicates "low in caffeine", not caffeine-free, which must be due to the small amount of cocoa powder. There is also chicory in this tea, which now I know makes me very bloated (with increasing gas pains as I write, but I'll try to resist dropping this tea to three stars); I just did a medical search on chicory, and some of the people who need to be cautioned about chicory ingestion are those who are: 1) pregnant/nursing, 2) taking beta-blocker drugs or other drugs metabolized by cytochrome P450, 3) have allergies/rashes/asthma, or 4) at risk for gallstones. (fyi re: TAZO Focus - can be hard to find on local store shelves. I order in MAJOR bulk, online. Of course, I just now searched reliable sites and see that large amounts of yerba mate may increase my risk of cancer . . . ahhh, c'est la vie:))

I do low carb.  Seriously low carb, so dessert is a no-no.  I also adore coconut and chocolate, but those are also no-nos.  I found this at World Market when I went to get some Zhena's Coconut Chai (which runs not too far behind) and even at 10.99, decided to give it a shot.The first thing I noticed when I opened the can is that it smelled like a Mounds bar!  It has a more complex flavor because of the dates and Barley and because you're not just tasting a sugared-up product, but it truly makes me not miss dessert so much.I do a few drops of liquid Splenda (the packets actually have .5g of carbs because of the maltodextrin) and sometimes the tiniest shot of cream, and it's dessert in a cup!I wish I could find it a bit cheaper, but on the upside, it's 36 bags and not 18 or 22 like most packages have.  I do figure my satisfaction and the fact that it kills the urge to carb up are well worth it.  Will definitely buy again!

column4: Juanita A. Floyd "Life is too short to read b...
column10: Just wanting to add my two cents here so that maybe someone else won't get caught like I did. I have been a customer of Republic of Tea before there was an internet, so I like their stuff. I bought this as a treat because it says "a THICK naturally sweet....". OK. I tried it with one teabag. Not thick. Tried it with 2 and a splash of cream. Not thick. People thick is Bellagio sipping chocolate. This is just tea...

column9: No lie, this tea is very good.
column10: Embarassing to say, but I had this tea sitting in my pantry for a year.  I did have one cup of it back then, but it tasted OKAY, at best.  I steeped the bag in hot water and let the flavors alone dictate my rating of this tea.  That's how I always drink my tea - just hot water and the tea on its own.  I had someone tell me that I should try some good creamer (half-and-half) with this Coconut Cocoa tea, then add some sugar (real pure cane, not processed American brand junk).  The result?  WOW!!!  Talk about delicious! No joke, this tea came alive.  The creamer and pure cane sugar totally enhanced the coconut flavor of this tea.  I had two cups and made some for the kids and they really liked it as well.Yes, this tea is very delicious.  I read something in the ratings about this tea not being thick enough.  Well, no, its not a thick tea.  Its the regular consistency that you would see in any other hot, flavored tea. I see that there are eight cannisters available from the vendor as of right now.  Sorry folks, but I am gonna order all eight of them right now.  Yes, this tea is that good!UPDATE: Found better pricing for this item at the Republic of Tea website.  Vendor on amazon charges higher price and tacks on a high shipping and handling fee.

This tea is actually quite strong compared to the other chocolate teas.  I think I would like the tea if it tasted more like tea and less like pina colada.  Tea shouldn't taste like this.  I love the other chocolate teas though they are a great buy!(though not as strong D;)

column9: Did Not Care For This Tea
column10: I love coconut so I thought this tea would be for me.I tasted more chocolate than coconut. Also, I didn't care for the flavor/consistency aspect- it was like drinking a weak tea that should actually be a coffee.I have ordered other teas from Republic of Tea and love them - this tea just wasn't for me:(
Bought this looking for a change in teas. Must say it is a welcomed change as I am a "big hot cocoa fan"

The first thing that happens when you open the package is smell the coconut and fly to the Caribbean on the magical aroma this tea emits.  Your vacation ends there because the flavor is drastically different from the smell and in not such a good way.  It's not the worst tea in the world, but it just didn't do it for me.  The other Cocoa teas by The Republic of Tea I think are much better than this one.
This tea tastes just like my favorite Girl Scout cookie without all the calories! Sweeten with stevia to save even more calories.

I love this tea!  It has a complex interesting taste with a hint of chocolate and coconut (and I really like coconut and chocolate), and the best part is it is caffeine free!  It is the most delicious caffeine free tea I have ever tasted.  I can't find it very easily in my grocery stores so I sent away for several cans of it.

This is such a weak tasting tea, that it is barely better than drinking hot water.  Even using two tea bags per cup, it is deficient.  Considering the very high cost (I paid around $11 for the tin) it's ridiculously expensive, particularly when using two bags per cup.  I complained to customer service, and they told me herb teas are supposed to be weak, and I should doctor it up with sugar and milk.  Then offered, if I shipped it back, to replace it with a different one.  Are they kidding....I have to ship it back in order for them to replace the $11 tin?  I think the real problem is, when you look at the tea bag, there is barely anything in it....looks like not even half a teaspoon of "tea".  I guess putting adequate tea in the bag might have dipped into their profit margin.  I'd skip this one and go for another brand.

I keep some at work. Another reviewer mentioned it being hard to chew when it's stale, never happens in our household, but try adding to soup or a pot of beans.  Do think outside of the bag. You can even just moisten it and zap for a moment in the microwave.

Ok, to preface this, I AM A VEGETARIAN. With that being said, I haven't had REAL beef or turkey jerky in quite some time and I have been missing it dearly. Having tried many vegetarian jerkies I can honestly say that this is by far the best! Most soy based jerkies are strangely on the oily side and the flavors are usually off. Being a "dry style" jerky fan I am pleased with the chewiness of Stonewall's and the WILD flavor. I have tried most of the other varieties of Stonewall's but none seemed to please me as much as the WILD. I'm also on Weight Watchers and have found that they are fairly low on points (4pts per bag) and are a great source of protein for vegetarians (14g). Be warned, the WILD is quite WILD, spicy spicy but in a good way!

The Hot Pastrami flavor is divine!  I like spicy things and just ordered another shipment of these because I went through them faster than I had anticipated.  They are moist and chewy, but not so chewy that you're still chewing to make it swallowable after all the flavor's gone.  I think they struck a nice balance.A caveat: If you're used to Tofurky Jurky or Primal Spirit, these will strike you as a little bit airy.  Also, these are a bit higher in fat than the other brands: 8 or 9 grams per 160-calorie package.  These ones don't really feel too oily in your mouth, though.

This is a great jerkey substitute if you're vegetarian. The problem is, when it is stale, it's very hard to chew* (but still tastes good). When it is fresh, it is absolutely awesome.Stonewall's is my favorite brand of vegetarian jerkey. If you don't like your jerkey hot, I suggest you try mild or teriyaki. Otherwise, this is the stuff for you!*Edit: Someone suggested heating in microwave for about 10 seconds to soften it, and that works beautifully!

It is not easy to find healthy protein-laden foods, particularly snacks, that are vegetarian and tasty.  Stonewall's Jerquee fits the bill.  It is exceptionally convenient to pack in my carry-on bag when I travel.  This is more than a review.  This is a heartfelt "thank you" to the maker!  Well done.

I usually love these little treats, but the ones i got must have been sitting around at amazon for a year or so, because they were really hard and  unedible. had to give most of them to the dog :(  However, the expiration date had not expired (SELLBY NOV07), so i would say Stonewall's needs to move their expiration date up a few months.

column9: Pretty good if you don't like meat :)
column10: I thought this was pretty good if you don't like meat and still want something that is "chewy".I don't know what the other poster is talking about when he/she said it was "airy" as I have not noticed that at all.It is not as tough as real meat would be, and the Teriyaki flavour is really good too.I did find the Jerquee to be a bit greassy as they do use some oil in it.But I have had people that do eat meat try this and they really did like it. I would buy this product again!
The absolute best vegan jerky around and believe me I've tried them all. The heat is perfect.

column9: I could eat the whole case in a day!
column10: My local health food store started selling these 10 years ago and then stopped to focus more on vitamins instead of food!So now I order these directly from Lumen and usually get the case of "over and unders" which contains packages that they can't sell to stores due to the weight being off. This is your best bet since I read reviews on here of receiving them stale off amazon.The best flavors are the original mild, bbq beef and the teriyaki beef. I HATE the Cajun varieties, they are so dry and tough to chew.They are high in fat so I usually have to make my husband hide them from me since these are a rare treat for us in the house, I could eat 4-5 bags in a row!Caution if you eat too many bags over a period of a few days, you may experience gas!Try ordering direct and you'll be enjoying the BEST veggie jerquee there is in the US!!!!PS These are made in Louisiana, could you ask for anything more authentic besides the real thing (meaning meat)
