I loved the small size of the bags to bring along when I hike, paddle or any time I am going to be needing a snack!  Especially ideal if you are a vegetarian but even my non vegetarian friends enjoy them, once they try them.

If you're looing for a nice inexpensive jerky treat, you'd be hard pressed to find better. Stonewall's original and stonewall's original mild are some of the best tasting jerkey you'll find. What's best, is that this product is meat free. So for all you vegans out there this is especially a great treat idea. The package here is a store display container.  I keep them in the closet and when we remember we have them, it makes a perfect snack.  I think we'll be working on the box for about 2 month and that's with two jerkey freaks eating them.

The texture on these things is all off.  For one, they're incredibly airy.  I am a huge fan of Primal Spirit and Tofurky Jurky, and had been used to denser vegan jerky when I first tried these.  It felt like I was chewing air.  Also, because these are higher in fat (8-9 grams per 160 calorie package), they are a bit oilier.  Coupled with the airiness, when you bite down on these, you can feel the oil oozing out of the little nuggets into your mouth, which isn't too pleasant.I don't think the flavor is anything special, either.  To be fair, I'm not sure what chicken tastes like or is supposed to taste like, but there are plenty of wonderfully flavorful vegan and vegetarian products out there.  This is not one of them.
I love this stuff! The texture of this reminds me of real meat.  So if you are a new vegetarian you might want to try it!  I like mild and teriyaki the best!  Makes a great snack!

column9: It does the job as chew-toy for vegans
column10: An ethical workout for the jaw.  It tastes a little sweet, but teriyaki is supposed to.  Of course even considering a "vegan jerky" is to knowingly enter a state of sin.  This is a long-shelf-life processed snack food, not carrots and celery pulled fresh from the organic garden, but hey, no refrigeration required.
I didn't like these at all.  They're too hard and chewy with a weird texture.  I wouldn't recommend this product.

I've tried two flavors - Pepperoni and Original Wild - and have enjoyed them both.  The texture's pretty good - nice and chewy.  The moisture level is okay, but it could be improved by being just a tiny bit more moist. There's also a little bit of an aftertaste (which I didn't find to be unpleasant, but some might).  The spice level on the Pepperoni and Original Wild flavors were perfect. The Original Wild was medium hot, so it might be a little too much for some.  I loved it though.  I recommend that people try to buy this locally before spending a lot of money on it.  I bought mine from a local vegan store online, then discovered that a large grocery chain carries it in their health food section.

The "Original Wild" is a bit spicy for me, but "Original Mild" is spectacular, and Teriyaki Beef even better. Also like the spicy chicken one. I've tried all the veg jerky products and bewildered that none of the others come even close to this one for quality of flavor and texture. The others are loaded with sugar and taste more like candy than jerky; a couple of them are outright slimy; one was hard as a rock and flavorless. But the only time Stonewall's Jerquee ever displeased me was when the Poulsbo Market used a paper-punch to create holes along the top edge and hung them on a peg to dry out -- which I didn't realize until I got them home and they'd all been turned into hard lumps (which I ate any way). So now I have to buy them on amazon. I'll still get the fresh sushi at Poulsbo Market, that stuff's a dream, but what possessed them to poke holes in packaged foods???

I have always liked these but I haven't had them in years.  Today, I was hungry and saw them at the natural market checkout counter.  I got the flavor "spicy 'chicken'" and LOVED it.  It is clear that this is a love or hate product.  I buy Primal Strips when in need of a snack I can eat in the car and they are just ok...oily and get stuck in my teeth.  Flavor is just OK.  Stonewall's are drier and puffier and chewier but somehow, don't get stuck in my teeth.I am on a low-carb diet and these are only 7 g of carbs for 13 g of protein.  I am getting a case of the original mild since it is Prime.  Would like to see more flavors available on Prime.Definitely suggest buying a small pack first given the love/hate aspect.

I've been eating this stuff here and there for many years.  I purchased a packet at the grocery store and the product was speckled with mold.  Unfortunately I didn't realize this until I popped a piece into my mouth whereupon I instantly realized something was very wrong.  It was not expired.  I traded it in or another which was also moldy. ick.

I love other brands of vegetarian jerky. This one, I hate. It is spongy instead of chewy and smells and tastes like concentrated, stale, off-brand dog food. I could not get this funky crap out of my mouth fast enough. I should also mention that I'll eat just about anything, including bugs and grass. If it came down to it, I'd turn to them before ingesting another piece of this food-like substance.

I just purchased this jerky from a local store because they recently quit carrying the kind I like in my town. I ate a piece and thought it was disgusting. I wanted to give it a chance, so I ate a couple more pieces. It has a grainy, nasty texture and a terrible burned BBQ sauce flavor. For some bizarre reason it's made out of soy flour instead of strips of soy.The best soy jerky I've ever had is Tasty Eats jerky, since it's chewy and had a wonderful flavor. Flavor is of course subjective, but personally I thought the taste of Stonewall's is terrible, and the consistency is nasty. It tries too hard to look like meat, which I feel is pretty irrelevant to the demographic of people that will be eating it in the first place. Luckily it's Gluten-Free, so hopefully I can pawn the leftovers on my boyfriend...

I think its interesting how spread out the reviews are on this product.  I guess its one of those love it or hate it type things.  Personally, I LOVE this jerky and cannot get enough!!  My favorite flavors are the hot pastrami and teriyaki. You do have to chew quite a bit but its not the same weird chewy texture some other veg jerkys have, like primal strips.  I hate primal strips but I had them about 10 years ago and never ate once since, so if the formula has changes on those then disregard...  So maybe try a small bag of this before ordering in bulk.

I picked these up at Natural Grocers because I used to really love jerky, but am now vegetarian for four years, and I didn't like the Primal strips enough to re-purchase. I purchased the Original Mild and the Teriyaki flavors.The texture of these is spot on if you like toughier jerky (I do), although the outside has a weird sort of clumpy coating. Unfortunately, the taste is TERRIBLE. Both varieties honestly tasted like dog food. I also had two friends (one recently vegetarian, the other not) try them, and they said exactly the same thing. My friend's toddler-aged son loved them, though.I liked these even less than the Primal strips, and would not recommend them.
I bought all different flavors of jerky from this brand and it is sooo gross. I had to spit it out. Never again.

The overall flavor is pretty good (esp. for being vegetarian) and the texture was fine but, the one I tried, "original wild" was just TOO (spicy) hot! I don't mind a little heat but this was rediculous.  My mouth was burning for an hour afterwards.  This may be "fun" for some but not for me!  And I will give the "mild" a try - just to be fair).

column9: Stonewall's has had mold on it lately
column10: I use to buy a lot of this jerquee from Amazon, but for the past two months or more every shipment has been bad.The stuff has been covered in toxic mold, and I had to throw it away and get my money back.I will be ordering it direct from the factory from now on.I have read here others have had the same problem buying it via Amazon.Other than that, is is the best tasting jerquee out there.

The product I bought from amazon was old and moldy.  When I called the company (Luman Soy Foods)they replaced the old product and took care of me.  The product is great, just get it from the company directly!

column9: product was moldy, but company willing to fix problem
column10: I think the jerky would have been good, but...The packages I received contained jerky that had fuzzy white stuff growing on it. None of the packages had a read-able expiration date. The clearest packaging shows Aug 2011 (which means the product still had 6 months left in its life). When I contacted Lumen, however, I did get an email and phone call from them expressing their concern about my complaint. The man I spoke with was genuinely interested in investigating the problem. The company directly sent me three free packages to replace some of the moldy ones.

The seasoning is good, but the texture is not to my liking; it's almost spongy, and microwaving did not improve the texture for me. It is a little too dry and chewy, and has a weird aftertaste. I have not tried the other versions of this jerky. If you prefer a dry and chewy veggie jerky, I would go with the Vegan Dream brand. They have a sampler pack, with 6 different flavors. Also, as I follow weight watchers online, the 1.5 oz package has 4 points, with 8 grams of fat, 152 calories, 3 grams of fiber. There are lower calorie veggie jerkies available, if that is a concern for you.

I used to order bulk bags directly from the company years & years ago, but the shipping was a killer.  And I tended to eat about 5 servings at a sitting.  Through Amazon, I get 16 nice one-serving packets & free shipping.  I use it in rice or noodle dishes (shred it & add near the end of cooking). This is terrific stuff!!  I prefer the Hot Pastrami, but try a few of the others to see which you like best.

column9: Addictive and Actually Gluten Free (despite label)...
column10: This stuff is like crack.  There's no other way of describing just how delicious it is.  If it gets old, it gets a little hard, but they never sit around long enough to get old at my house.  I order this constantly and sometimes they run out, which leaves me craving it and miserable-- or begging my local health food store to dig in their back room for stray bags.  It's THAT good!!!  The only catch on Amazon is it's ingredients list wheat (in the soy sauce) as an ingredient, but the kind I've been getting are also labeled gluten free on the front.  I'm fairly confident it's a typographical error, because I've been eating it for a year now and no gluten reaction!  Enjoy!!!

i had high hopes for this stuff. i have tried several types of veggie jerky, in search of the tough, fibrous, highly seasoned jerky of my old meat eating days. granted, my memory is likely hazy as i haven't eaten meat for about 20 years. however, this stuff is NOT like beef jerky. true, they are a bit hard and chewy. and they are very flavourful, but....in my opinion, not in a good way.if you have ever had those dehydrated soy slices made by "so soya" (and others) then you know what these are. take those slices, marinade and fry or bake, and you've probably got something like this jerky. they have a distinct flavour - i really can't pinpoint exactly what flavour it is, but it is consistent in all of the varieties and it is not too pleasant. i found the tofurky jerky to have a better flavour and nicer dense texture, but i think my search for the ideal jerky shall continue.
I like to take Jerquee on trips since it doesn't need refieration.  This is one of the more spicy flavors which I really like.  I bought an entire case for my last camping trip
This isn't my favorite veggie jerky, but it's OK. I like the size of the packages. It's great for international travel when you don't know what the food options will be.
Try it--You'll like it. I buy a case of this stuff 3 or 4 times a year. Great snack on the trail or when I travel abroad.

column9: It's good but I ordered MILD and they sent WILD
column10: I love the mild and ordered it but received WILD. I ate it anyway but it's not as good.
I was looking for a meat free alternative to jerky that had a little kick to it. This item fits the bill!

This is a great jerkey substitute if you're vegetarian. The problem is, when it is stale, it's very hard to chew* (but still tastes good). When it is fresh, it is absolutely awesome.Stonewall's is my favorite brand of vegetarian jerkey. If you don't like your jerkey hot, I suggest you try mild or teriyaki. Otherwise, this is the stuff for you!*Edit: Someone suggested heating in microwave for about 10 seconds to soften it, and that works beautifully!

I like all the Stonewall Jerquee products. The fat content is somewhat higher than I'd like for very frequent consumption, but if you have an active metabolism/don't diet, it's a great higher protein veggie snack. Very tasty and satisfying to chew. Easy to pack, toss in a purse, travel bag, etc. Helpful for vegan's/vegetarians on the go, looking for protein away from home.
My title for this review says it all.  I like the Stonewall's Jerquee products, but this flavor is just too hot for my mouth.

column9: Not as good as other flavors. . .
column10: . . But, it could just be my taste buds (or lack there of).  I like the Stonewall's Jerquee items very much, just not this particulare kind.

column9: There isn't to much I can say . . .
column10: So far STonewall's Jerquee is the best of this sort of item I've found.  I always have it on hand.

As with all foods, your mileage may vary with this product depending on freshness and all that. I didn't much care for it at first, but I found it to be an acquired taste and I actually do like the product now.It can be a bit greasy, but word has it that if you let greasy 'jerky' products sit out overnight in the open air that it helps with that. I've never had an issue with it, so I don't know for sure, but I suppose it'd be worth a try if you like the taste but find it a bit oily.All in all, compared with some of the gross real-meat jerky products I've tried, this stuff is pretty good. But don't take my word for it, try it out for yourself.
I bought this for my son and he loves it!!!  A great snack, or a little something to have a long with lunch.

column9: Not as good as the "Wild" flavor
column10: These are tasty but not nearly as good as the "Original Wild" flavor. They were also quite stale when they got to me.

The first split second after popping one of these in to my mouth wasn't so bad. Then reality set in. The taste that overcame my mouth was honestly the worst I think I've ever experienced. I can't even describe it. I immediately spit it out and promptly tossed the two packages I bought. Yuk!

I COULD rate this item but "Mild" wasn't what I received.  The sealed box that said "Mild" on the outside actually contained "Wild" packets.  What a disappointment.  I was able to sell the item to a friend who liked it.  Order with caution.

when i first tried this, i like it right away!  great option for vegetarians and vegans especially if you used to eat meat and enjoy foods with tough textures.  the peppy pepperoni is my favorite flavor out of all of them but the rest are good too.

This is a great substitute if you're vegetarian. The problem is, when it is stale, it's very hard to chew* (but still tastes good). When it is fresh, it is absolutely awesome. Stonewall's is my favorite brand of vegetarian jerkey. I like mild best, and teriyaki is my second favorite. Both of these flavors are safe if you avoid spicy stuff like I do. If you like things hot, try some of the other flavors!*Edit: Someone suggested heating in microwave for about 10 seconds to soften it, and that works beautifully!

My husband and I both think this looks like and tastes like dog food. We were very sad and couldn't even eat more than one nugget size bite. We wish we had a way to return it! What a waste of money.

column9: What the hell is wrong with these reviewers?
column10: I've had plenty of fake meats, and i like primal strips, these, like others said, as well as all of their flavors, looked and tasted like a dog treat, they smell awful too, it was extremely disgusting i almost puked.
Awful taste it was soft and airy I fed it to my dogs.

I have no idea how someone can give this anything over 1 star.  This vegetarian jerkey is HORRIBLE!  As other reviewers mentioned...it tastes and smells like pet food...specifically, dog food.  I bought this for my g/f and she spit out the first bite.  We threw away the entire package.  What a waste of hard earned money.  I think the people that work for this company are reviewing this item, b/c it is disgusting.  Don't take my word for it...go buy some, but use it as a gag gift

Gave these as a gift to our building management office and they raved. Some had never had dark chocolate before but totally loved these. The little crackle of the espresso is great (I had one too) and I'd recommend these to any chocolatefan.

column9: So far, this is the best coconut water I have found for the price!
column10: I have been a great fan of coconut water for years since I was a kid growing up on Key West.  Now it's become a fad item.  I've tries every differnt brand.  I prefer non sweetened without pulp, but will settle for pulp when it's as good as Jumex's.  Most other coconut water with pulp in it, the pulp is all mushy.  The pulp in Jumex's coconut water is crisp just like it was cut from the coconut right before they handed you the can.  I would love to find it Jumex in an unsweetened formula.  And with Amazon's Prime Membership, you can't beat the free 2 day shipping on it.  I normally buy Conchita at Meijer here in Metro Detroit but it's a $1 a can and their pulp is all mushy tasting.  I'll be a returning customer, ESPECIALLY if you get it unsweetened.  I go through 2 cases a month by myself.

Swiss Miss has less chocolate in their hot chocolate mix. This makes it week tasting. I just bought a 60 count box and now find that I don't like the new formula. We checked with Swiss Miss and they admit to the change.
I'm very disappointed that Swiss Miss has changed their formula.  New and Improved? Not at all! This stuff tastes like chemicals.

WATCH OUT! You would be surprised at just what food products have artificial sweeteners.READ THE INGREDIENTS!The people at Swiss Miss added ARTIFICIAL SWEETENERS to the REGULAR SWISS MISS.I was drinking it because it was the one without artificial sweeteners. Then it began to TASTE FUNNY.I read the INGREDIENTS. You can't trust anyone these days.SWISS MISS is NOT advertising this change.I guess the FDA is letting it slide when companies add artificial sweeteners to NON-DIET food.Maybe that's the government's way of putting people on a diet.Makes me wonder if they are putting it in the food in schools.As usual the gov't doesn't get it--artificial sweeteners make you sick, NOT SKINNY!
Mostly sugar and corn syrup.  Very little chocolate.  Go for the real thing, Hershey's cocoa powder and your own sugar!

column9: Regular has artificial sweeteners in it -- tastes nasty
column10: Title says it all.  They reformulated to add artificial sweeteners to their regular hot cocoa.  I didn't notice until I tasted it and thought I accidentally bought the diet stuff.  Nope -- they put splenda and asculfame K (asculfame potassium) into their formula now.  It's really gross -- much too sweet with a terrible aftertaste.
The addition of these artificial sweeteners is the worst.  Terrible aftertaste.  This product goes from my favorite to I won't purchase.  Why would they do this?

We've used Swiss Miss cocoa for years, and I was excited to find the big box of 60 envelopes sold here on Amazon. With our large family, this size is much more efficient than the smaller boxes. With the available Super Saver Shipping, it's also good deal.It's simple to make, dissolves well, has a nice chocolately taste, and the individual envelopes travel nicely to school, work, sports and camping. Because the envelopes are metallic (mylar) inside, this product also stores for a long time without getting hard.My only complaint about this product is that it has just a little too much sugar in it.  But you can add more milk or water to it if it's too sweet for you.
Write to Conagra Foods and let them you that you don't like the new taste! Swiss Miss was my favorite hot chocolate for at least a decade. Now, it's just awful. What were they thinking?!?!

Check the date on any positive reviews.  No need to confirm with the company that they changed the formula:  you can see sucralose right on the ingredients list.  The new version is foul.  They now have no sugar added, diet, and half diet.  No regular cocoa anymore as far as I know.  I'm looking for a new brand this winter.

column9: Swiss Misses with New and Improved
column10: Hot chocolate's last savior perished today in a pathetic attempt to cut corners on quality. Now it can join Great Value brand with the comfort and knowledge that it saved a nickel a box.
I put one of these in my coffee every morning in lieu of sugar, and it makes a delicious coffee "mocha"! I love the convenient one-serving packaging.
great item will buy again. I would recommend this to anyone. Great for parties. Great to have for work or at home when company comes over.
arrived on time and arrived in a box thatcould be opened and used right out of the box. tasted great but didn't have marshmellows which wasn't labeled on the site, but still very good. thank you
Does what it needs to do. Great to have bulk quantities of hot chocolate for the office. Everyone loved it! Fast shipping.
you know swiss miss also has a caffinate product?today i was all over that!!

I have enjoyed using the sauce in beef and chicken dishes.  I have given friends jars of this and they have all liked it.  Well worth the money and Pataks has many fine products to choose from. I have bought a lot from them and never have been disappointed with anything.  Love it keep making it along with the curry paste.

column9: One of the best instant sauces
column10: This instant sauce is so good that I have even been willing to pay the ridiculous shipping costs. Nine dollars shipping for a couple of ounces of dried gravy mix is insane but I have been so desperate to find this sauce again since my local supermarkets stopped stocking it that I have actually paid it. I eagerly await Amazon Prime stocking it. Easy to make and chock full of flavour, reflecting its German origins this sauce is versatile and an easy way to add some kick to your cooking.
Gum is gum.  How can you go wrong.  Bought this as a gift for Christmas from the Amazon List on file and person was thrilled to get it.  Liked it very much.

The bonsai lost so many leaves each day after it first arrived.  My concern now is lack of new growth and certainly no sign of powderpuff blooms.  I am watering it via drip in the sink every 2 or 3 days.  Any suggestions on how to make it really healthy would be appreciated.

I'm not diabetic, but my girlfriend has Type I and missed being able to drink margaritas with Mexican food so she tried this mix.  I even tried it too just to see how it differed from regular (ie, Cuervo) margarita mix.Surprisingly, it tastes nearly identical to the regular mix.  We added just a splash of triple sec and mixed it just a bit stronger and it tasted just as good as a Cuervo premixed bottle.Some claim that there's a Splenda aftertaste, but I didn't get any aftertaste whatsoever.  Maybe certain tastebuds are more sensitive to that particular sweetener.  However, if you're looking for a sugar-free margarita, this is certainly worth giving a try.

This is the best margarita mix that I have tasted. The others have too much sugar, too sweet and have too many calories. I have them both frozen and on the rocks. Here is a great recipe:Any Baja Bob Margarita Recipe.Large Martini Shaker - Fill with IceAdd 1/4 Shaker - Tequila - See if you can find Cuervo Black (Very Smooth) or Cuervo GoldAdd 1/8 Shaker - Triple SecAdd Small Amount Grand MarinerAdd - Balance of Baja Bob Any Margarita Mix.Add Lime Juice (1/2 Lime)Shake and serve over Crushed or Cubed Ice or Blend into a Frozen Margarita.Let me know what you think.
My husband is diabetic, and I am conscious about sugar in our diet. Love my margaritas, and this is great! Mix it with 1800 tequila and Stirrings Triple Sec for a knock your socks off drink.

Of COURSE a real margarita is going to be tastier.. just like a coca cola tastes much better than diet. However,my guess is that they type of people that will buy Baja Bob's are diet coke drinkers and who want to have a mixed drink without the spare tire.  If you're used to diet drinks, Baja Bob's will hit the spot.  It's especially a treat if you've been avoiding margaritas because they're so darn high in sugar.  Tequila is 64 calories a shot.  Add your 64 calories of tequila to 0 from Bob's and you've got yourself a low calorie drink that's pretty darn good.One other note:  When I ordered the Margarita mix, I got a three pack and gave one bottle to a friend.  She's also a habitual dieter and very used to artificial sweetners, but she agrees that it's a good substitute.  I will probably end up trying other Baja Bob's cocktail mixes as well..
GREAT STUFF AND IN MY OPINION, THE ONLY WAY TO CONSUME LARGE QUANTITIES OF SUMMERTIME MARGARITAS WITHOUT GAINING 20 LBS.
This is just what I wanted and it's so hard to find in stores.  Low Carb and great taste.

column9: Yum!  I have finally found one that's tasty!
column10: I have tried a couple other brands of sugar free or low carb margarita mix and this one actually tastes like it should.  The problem I had with other brands is they weren't tart enough or had a distinct artificial aftertaste.  I found I was adding lime juice to them to get the proper tart taste that regular margaritas have, but all that did was add carbs that I didn't need.  This one has the tartness I am looking for.  I did alter the suggested recipe by adding 1 part tequila to 2 parts mix instead of 3.  Excellent!

column9: Baja Bob's Key Lime Margarita Mix
column10: I absolutely love Baja Bob's margarita mix and will buy it again.  I received it in record time and could not have been more delighted with my experience.

I am a faithful Baja Bob order "er".  I love this mix.  It's just the right mix without the super splenda taste.  I have been using this in my margaritas for a couple of years now and I have tried others but always go right back.  Worth the money!

I have tried every diet margarita mix I can find over the years and have yet to find a sugarless mix that I like well enough to give up the real thing. I am trying to cut calories where I can, but when it comes to my favorite cocktail, I have to go with the sugar. I was hoping that the Splenda would do the trick because I use Splenda when cooking and to sweeten ice tea and I like it, but sorry to say this mix still has the after taste usually associated with sugar substitutes.Even when using the half sugar-free mix with half regular mix the taste is still not to my liking. I hate to mess up good tequila so I have stopped using this stuff. I honestly feel that is is about the same as the mixes found in the grocery store or liquor stores. Bottom line: I'll have to cut some calories somewhere else. Too bad you have to buy 3 bottles to try it and find out it is not to your liking.Try it if you like but don't compare it to the mixes that contain sugar or you will be disappointed. If you only use sugar-free mix now, you might find that you like it better than the mix you are using, but you probably won't see much difference.I'm giving it 3 stars because I find it to be just average. Cheers.

We love this margarita mix.  It's really nice to have such a convenient sugar-free alternative. I would have given it 5 starts, but the proportions on the mixing instructions are a little too vague. I understand that there's a wide range of possible preferences, but it would be better to start off with exact measurements and tell consumers to adjust to their own tastes.

We were gifted some of this mix along with the "key lime" mix & liked the latter best but thought we would give it(the original) another try. Since this order we have found another mix "Master Of Mixes" that we like almost equally as well & it is some $2.00 a bottle cheaper. We are not saying that we won't order again but just not at this time. We will, however, order the "key Lime" mix when it becomes available.Thanks,Dean

column9: A way to cut the guilt when enjoying a margarita
column10: I first found Baja Bob's in our local state-run liquor store, and I do love it.  Mind you, I'm a seasoned diet drinker (diet soda, Splenda in my tea, Crystal Light, sugar-free Koolaid, etc), so I personally couldn't taste the difference between Jose Cuervo margarita mix and Baja Bob's sugar free margarita mix.  I also like to add a splash of Diet Coke to my margaritas, as it makes it taste like a really good, smooth Long Island Ice Tea, so that further blurs the difference between regular and sugar free mixes.The only downside?  Those 32 oz bottles disappear *fast*!  And they're not cheap.  I'm going to experiment with making my own diet margarita mix, but until that day, I'll continue to use Baja Bob's.  (There's also a powdered margarita mix available at Baja Bob's website, that's a little cheaper and easier to ship, but I have not tried it.)

'Ritas are my adult beverage of choice, so I'm a tough customer.  I'm trying to be more health-conscious, so this seemed like a good bet, given the positive ratings.  You *can* taste the difference between the high-cal high-carb syrup in regular mixes vs. the Splenda in Baja Bob's.  I am a diet soda drinker, so this is not a turn-off for me.  I used to cut the regular mixes with diet tonic to decrease the sweetness, anyway.  This mixer can be "sweetened up" a bit by adding some Diet 7-up, Mist Free, or Fresca.  I will purchase this again.
Good mix.  Love that there is no sugar.  Can't really taste the difference.

There is no doubt in my mind that I make the best margarita in Texas, no brag just fact.  However they are full of sugar.  Being a diebetic I have to find ways to cut back on sugar.  I have only made one of these so far and will tweak the contents to my liking.  They are not cowboy-ritas but they are good enough to rate a 5 star.

This is the best Margarita mix I've ever had.  The best part is the 0 calories and lack of guilt.  Because I don't use alcohol, the consistency in the blender is a bit lumpy but still good.  With alcohol, it blends very smoothly!

I bought Baha Bobs Margarita Mix on a friends suggestion .  What a great mix and zero calories !  My daughter and I enjoyed a drink on her birthday and she loved it as well . I purchased the mix at Amazon.com & it came so quickly !  A terrific product and the price is right .

This stuff is terrible - and I don't think it's because it's sugar free.  A margarita should not taste like it's made with Gatorade.  While I can appreciate the other reviewers needing it to be sugar free, it was their high marks that led me to buy it thinking it was good.

I was looking for a way to cut back on calories and sugar. The first sip tasted pretty good, but after a few more it is just too sweet. There is an after taste from the Splenda. I have two unopened bottles and a partially used bottle which will probably be poured down the drain. :(

I have mixed 'ritas from scratch and have drunk the bar mixes, from well to top-shelf.  Yes, if you're sensitive to artificial sweetener, then you can taste that part.  So what?  Other than that, you have margarita mix that tastes like the bar mixes.  And by the way, this stuff also makes a killer whiskey sour.Anyone knows that for a cocktail it's not the booze but the mix that's the diet killer.  Double tequila = 200 cals.  Add Baja Bob's, and a 'rita = 200 cals.  It's a no-brainer.  I don't know what motivates the the one-stars, but their benchmark mix for margaritas must be toilet water, or maybe somebody at BB's ticked them off.  Ignore them.

I bought this after reading the reviews on it and wanting on stay on my diet while drinking margarita's too.... After drinking it I have not wanted to go back to any other margarita mix this is my favorite!! I would only say that I get headache's from this and even after just drinking one for the evening I would still have a headache the next day... but I loooove it soooo much I continue drinking it still ....

These mixes are great if you are trying to follow a low sugar diet, like me.  I thought these tasted great and satisfied my urge for a margarita without blowing my diet.  Will surely order again and I thought the price was pretty reasonable.

This is by far my favorite margarita mix. I LOVE that it is sugar free and I LOVE that it taste so GOOD! I think you will enjoy this product as well. The only down side I have found it that I can't find it elsewhere so I have to buy it online.

column9: Love having a low cal option!
column10: I am a registered dietitian and was having a fiesta for my husband's 50th complete with Margaritas....  knew there must be a "diet" variety of the corn syrup, high calorie mixers on the market and found Baja Bob's sugar free on Amazon.  Ordered six bottles to get the free shipping---three of each variety and they were a big hit.  No one could tell the difference, especially after mixed with ice and Tequila (now there were some calories and more...).  Will definitely order again.  Only gave 4 stars out of 5 because I don't often drink marjaritas and really don't know a good one from a mediocre one, but my friends loved it.

column9: Very Good, Too Tart For Some
column10: This is 10 times better than the pina colada or hurricane mixes. It actually tastes like it should. Some here have found it to be a little too tart, but overall it is a very belivable substitute for the 'real' thing.

column9: Not Great But What Do You Expect?
column10: I have been using Jose Cuervo margarita mix to make my vodka collins. It's very sweet and fattening.  Cutting down on the amount of the margarita mix didn't help so I tried Baja Bob's.  It's not great.  You can tell it's no-calorie but what do you expect?  So what I do is use half Jose Cuervo and half Baja Bob's.  It cuts the calories in half and you cannot tell the difference. Until Skinnygirl comes up with margarita mix without tequila, it's the best there is.

This may be the worst margarita mix I've ever had, and it wasn't the sugar-free aspect.  It just tastes bad.  I got the 3-bottle set and drank 2 drinks out of one bottle.  That was enough (too much) for me.  The rest is going down the sink.

I was skeptical for good reason.  How can a mix with 0 calories be any good....well it isn't.  I wasn't expecting the taste to be as good as the real thing but it's absolutely awful. It's un-drinkable.I let 4 other people try it and overtime the same thing.... sip....1 second delay ..then the I really tasted something bad face.  One person even spit it out into the sink.  This stuff is gross.  Its basically green colored splenda water.  Don't waste your money.
These seeds are flavorful.  We missed not having the shells on them though. Good for healthy snacks.  Easy to bring along on the go in a purse or backpack.  Great for munching on at the movies.

I went through a case of Tamari Garlic Pepper flavor and really enjoyed 'em. Adobo Chile didn't go over as well - kinda spicy and barely got through half the case before giving up. Sux to sink $20 for a 12 case - they should make a variety pack.
I think these are great.  Light chilie flavor that's (to me) only mildly spicy and not too salty.  Will buy more.

REAL organic pu-erh which has been aged and fermented does not taste like grass.  When it is steeped, it should turn deep red and have a nice black tea flavor.  It should also not need much sweetening when steeped correctly.I do not reccommend this tea at all as I do not believe it is the real thing.  Go to [...] and get the REAL thing!

I really enjoy this type of tea and for the money this was a good deal. I prefer the more aged tea that is even stronger but it is more expensive. So I tried this less aged variety and was happy with what I got but if you can afford the more expensive aged variety go for it.
This is the best coffee I've had for the Tassimo one-cup brewer.  It is strong but smooth and very tasty.
Excellent coffee... I like it strong.  Could even be stronger in that at the end of the brewing the coffee is almost the color of water.

column9: Be careful  - this is a 1 pack at 2 pack prices
column10: This is a one pack at 2 pack prices.  Be careful that you do not mistake it for the two pack just because of the price -- I made that mistake once.
The caramel ones tastes great with just hot water!I haven't tried it yet...it may even be better with hot milk...
A cup of this with a dollop of whipped cream is heaven on a cold, damp or snowy, winter evening.  Heaven!

column4: Venus Starlee "Mom of 1 and a bun"
column10: I've gotten the Land O Lakes mint hot chocolate in the variety packs before and this is my favorite flavor, so I thought why not just drink the one I like best.  Actually, I mentioned it to my best friend and she ordered me a case last year for Christmas and I LOVED it!!!

We've had the Land-O-Lakes Supreme, French Vanilla and Graham and all have been excellent.  With numerous others as comparison (Swiss Miss, Nestle, Ghiradelli etc) Land-O-Lakes is the best I've had to date.

This is great hot cocoa!  The cinnamon is probably my favorite, but all the LOL hot cocoa flavors are good.  You can't beat the Amazon price either.  I can buy these at my local grocery store but they're .59 per packet.  Ouch.  A box of 72 lasts quite a while...unless you share, of course :)

column9: Tastes great, wish it were healthier!
column10: "Corn Syrup Solids, Partially Hydrogenated Soybean Oil, Polysorbate 60"It's really good cocoa, and I make it every morning for my husband (he won't drink coffee); we even bring it along on vacation so he can have it. I just wish that list of poisons above weren't included.  I've suggested to Land-o-Lakes that they make a ... "Sweet Nothings" version or whatever they want to call it:  a *totally* unsweetened version, so we can add whatever sweetener we wish to add.The corn syrup is unhealthy in the extreme; the 'partially hydrogenated' means trans fats (and soy is *not* healthy, contrary to the "common" "wisdom"), and the polysorbate has been shown in cosmetics to cause problems (and why is a cosmetics ingredient in a food item?!).That said (er... written), until someone comes up with a healthy product that tastes as good as this stuff does, he's gonna keep drinking these poisons every morning. {sigh}

column9: Supreme Chocolate Makes My Heart Sing!
column10: Instead of creamer and sugar, I add a packet of this to my eight ounces of freshly ground coffee each morning! For a mere 140 calories, I enter bliss! Comparable, both in yummy-ness and nutritionally, to a whole milk Starbucks Mocha Frappuccino®, this Supreme Chocolate mix comes in at 3 grams of saturated fat (30 calories, 14% DV, from hydrogenated soybean oil and coconut oil), 0 trans fat, and 24 grams of sugars (sugar and corn syrup solids). As for price, since I live three hours from the nearest Wal-Mart, the shipped price is actually a little better than I would pay locally, and it arrives practically overnight. The entire box of 72 packets is only 7"x7"x18", and consists of six smaller display type boxes of twelve packets each. These 6"x7"x3.5" display boxes will tuck neatly into the smallest kitchen upper cabinets, and will maintain the individually wrapped single serving packets in a neat upright position. All in all, this is a big luxury for a little price, which is something that makes my heart sing!
Walmart sells these at $0.47 each and these are priced at nearly $0.62 each. Enough said.

column9: This product really calls for 10 stars
column10: This the best hot chocolate I have ever had.  I love this flavor.  I introduced it my niece and she now loves it as well.
I love this flavor, It is the same price as Walmart, but this is easier, plus you get 72, hard to find 72 at walmart all one flavor

column9: An Excellent Cup of Hot Chocolate!!
column10: Being a hot cocoa lover as I am, it's hard to believe I've never tried Land O Lakes Supreme Hot Chocolate until I received it as part of a gift basket. I must say, it was one of the best cups of hot chocolate I've had in a long time.I've tried soooo many different brands....from the most expensive to the least expensive. This ranks up in my top 3...which is a hard place to get to in my eyes (or taste buds?).At approximately $0.40 a serving, this is a great deal.You'll find this hot cocoa rich in taste and quite creamy as well...even though it's simply made with hot water.Make sure you follow the instructions on the packet....6 oz. of water per packet.Go ahead...try it...you won't be disappointed!

On cold winter evening my husband and I enjoy drinking hot chocolate while sitting in front of the fire watching a good movie. This is the best hot cocoa mix we have tried yet ... it is delicious! Of course we also like to add a bit of Bailey's Irish Cream, which makes it even better. YUM!
This french vanilla delight is warm and soothing on a cold winter day, or even a not so cold day.  I first received a few packs as a Christmas gift and was delighted to see it available from Amazon.
i ordered mint chocolate and got supreme. i am very unhappy, becouse you cant return it..

This cocoa is rich and flavorful, nicely chocolately! I only wish I could get the flavors in individual boxes. I love most flavors offered, but would love to be able to get my favorites on their own! I like to give packets as Christmas gifts to people I work with done up with a cute package and winter poem. Everyone seems to love it!

I never get tired of mint chocolate cocoa! Can be pricey, try to catch when on sale or shop around Amazon's vendors for the lowest price. Quick turnaround when ordering, never been disappointed and I order ALOT!

I'm not a huge hot chocolate fan. They all seem to taste alike to me no matter the brand. I happened to get this kind in a mug as a gift. I tried it one night and I love it, love it, love it! It is ssooo good. I have never heard a bad thing about it!

This is the best hot chocolate I've ever had.  It's all my family drinks.  I give packets to people all the time to try and they always LOVE it.  BUT you have to mix it with milk to get the full deliciousness.  I'm never without a stash of this hot chocolate.  I buy it in volume because we drink so much.
Love this hot chocolate and I feel it I got this product at a very good price.People should try it it is delicious and so great to have on a cold winter day or anytime is a good time.

This cocoa dissolves in a nice way without a lot of chocolate clumps at the bottom of the mug. The cinnamon flavor has a 'cozy' aroma/taste. There are several other delicious Land O Lakes cocoa flavors including French Vanilla, Supreme, and Caramel. It's yummo in my tummo ( I find myself saying this a lot when I'm drinking it!). Several months a year the elementary school fundraising company called Market Day features a large box of Land O Lakes cocoa (assortment of flavors) for a much lower cost than in most grocery stores.
I was given these as a gift and immediately went to the net to find the other flavors available.  It's some of the best hot chocolate I've tried.

column9: Time to buy hot chocolate again
column10: And you might as well buy this. It is creamy and chocolaty, kind of like what one reviewer said before, like drinking a chocolate bar.
It may be a small packet, but it packs a powerful punch. I usually add a little extra water to make it not so strong.

column9: seriously? over a dollar a packet?
column10: I cannot believe how expensive these are!  Even at the local grocery store they are only $.69 per packet, full price.  When you add in shipping, you are paying over a dollar a packet. Outrageous!

These were a luxury item which I treated myself to.  I love these.  The lobster meat and rolls come packaged on ice and there is no worry about spoilage.  The lobster meat is pure lobster.  They list mayonaise as an ingredient {I hate mayo} fortunatley I did not see any on the meat...if there was any it was minimal. The rolls were very fresh.  You can easily grill them and have a meal in 3 minutes or less.  I actually ate about three of these for lunch..........it ended up being about a 45 dollar lunch worth every dime!

THESE ROLLS WERE GREAT.  THE LOBSTER MEAT WAS FLAVORFUL WITH ONLY A SMALL AMOUT OF MAYO TO HOLD IT TOGETHER.  HOWEVER, IT WAS THE BUN THAT MADE THE SANDWICH.  IT WAS A PERFECT SIZE AND DID NOT INTERFER WITH THE GREAT TASTE OF THE LOBSTER.  IT MADE A MIDWESTERNER FEEL LIKE HE WAS BACK IN ARCADIA.  I WILL BUY MORE.

column9: You don't get much better than this!!
column10: We moved down south after living in Maine for several years & missed the incredible lobster rolls we used to get.  I ended up getting these as a treat for my husband's birthday and he was ever so delighted.  The rolls themselves are hard to come by outside of New England and if you can get them, you pay through the nose.  This was the best of everything!  The lobster meat was wonderful...just the right amount of mayonnaise on it too!  And the quality of everything was just superb.  In fact, I can't remember having a better lobster roll...and I've had lots of them from all over southern coastal Maine & various other New England spots.  YOU WON'T BE DISAPPONTED!

We have ordered these twice now and have not been disappointed.  The lobster salad has just enough mayo to hold it together, and the spices used are delicious.  The amount of meat is incredible!  We plan on ordering these many more times!

I'm in the Midwest.  I've been drooling over pictures of thesee lobster rolls on the internet for months now.  I broke down one day and bought them.  I've never had a lobster roll.  In fact I didn't even know that it wasn't a hot sandwich until I read the instructions.  With shipping this came out to $117 so that's $20 per sandwich.  That's a little more than your Subway sandwich.  I got these shipped over night.  You get a box with insulation and ice packs inside.  They lobster salad comes chilled, not frozen.  I pulled out the plastic container holding the lobster.  It was about a pint I guess.  I set it on the counter along with the 6 rolls.  My fist impression was wow I paid $117 for this?  It didn't look like much at all.  I open the container with the lobster salad.  Visually I was awed.  Wow, look at all these huge chunks of lobster meat!  I took a sniff.  It didn't smell like anything which means it is fresh I guess but I was expecting lobster smell.  Also it seemed more like lobster meat than lobster salad because there was nothing in it.  I read the instructions and it said I could add more mayo which I did.  I can't complain about the vendor or the delivery but I can't say I was that impressed with the taste of the lobster roll itself.  It was bland.  Beats me.  I'm no expert.  There are a bunch of good reviews so maybe I don't know what I'm talking about.  When I get lobsters I savor it by chewing really slowly and I have that lobster taste in my mouth for a while after eating it.  Didn't get that.  Over the next couple days I finished the rest of the lobster meat but with less enthusiasm.  Don't' get me wrong they were pretty good but I found myself wanting to eat something else however I didn't want to waste $117.  The last one I heated the meat and added tarragon.  It was ok.  There you go.  That was my once in a lifetime lobster roll experience.  Not really for me.  I'll stick with live lobster.  Actually if I ever wanted lobster rolls again I'd just buy live lobster locally and make it myself.  the only reason I order off the internet was to get the authentic rolls.  Woopidy doo.  Seriously it was just white bread.

These were incredible. The lobster was unbelievable fresh, and the rolls were exactly right, especially brushed with butter and lightly grilled. There was ample lobster salad for six rolls, and while we added a bit of celery, it was equally delicious without. We're already planning our next order.

column9: Lots of lobster very little mayo :)
column10: I enjoyed this product very much I ended up eating everything in one day by myself nom nom nom...The lobster was plentiful, a ton is given, very chunky pieces of the claw and what not. There is just very little mayo, just enough to hold the lobster together. The rolls were tasty, as instructed apply a little butter in the insides and warm it on a skillet and apply the generous amount of lobster and bon appetit!5/5Will look to purchase again one day in the near future! :)

We just tried these for the first time tonight.  They were fabulous!  My husband said it was the best lobster roll he has ever had.  I have to agree.  There is so much gorgeous lobster meat in these!  There is barely any mayo and nothing else, just fresh lobster!  They arrived right when I had requested and packed properly.  I can see us doing this again soon!

Being born and bred in Southeastern Connecticut, I know lobster. Since being transferred to Southern Georgia with the Navy, I've really been missing New England seafood this last year. I've been to Hancock's website many times, but was always turned off by the very expensive shipping. When I saw the deal they had here on Amazon with free shipping, I immediately placed my order!I received my Lobster rolls yesterday (about 2 days after ordering) and have already gone through three...they are SOOOO good! When I saw the container of lobster meat I wasn't sure there was gonna be enough for 6 rolls, but there's plenty. They've done an excellent job with the mixture, they don't ruin it by putting in too much mayo like I've seen others do.If you're at all interested, I definitely say go for it. Yes, it's a bit on the pricey side, but well worth it. I just CANNOT find decent lobster here in the south, so Hancock will be my supplier for as long as we're stationed anywhere outside the Northeast. My next purchase...the Lobster Mac n Cheese. I have very high hopes for it!

Sent these rolls for a good friend's 79th bday present and just heard today that they were the best ever eaten - and these folks, as well as us, spend a bunch of time in Maine.  They're in Florida now and are salivating for their Maine adventures come June.  Hmmm - think I'm going to order them for my family right now!

This was my first time eating a Lobster Roll. I was very happy about this product. The rolls were a real treat also and complimented the lobster meat that was sweet and very fresh tasting. I added just a few drops of Key Lime juice on the Lobster Meat. I  also had speedy service. I ordered this product Wed and received this on Friday of the same week which was well before the estimated arrival date(I live in South GA). Thank you Hancock Company and Thank you Amazon again for having such a wonderful place to order products.Downeast Lobster Rolls

I recently received the Maine Lobster Salad, complete with authentic split-top rolls (just like the kind I had as a kid growing up in New England). Everything arrived cold and wonderful. The salad was superb... giant chunks of tender, flavorful Maine lobster... only a little mayo (don't want to smother the lobster!). This is a terrific product.

I got these as a gift for Christmas cause I had them in my wish list, I was disappointed in them, they had lots of lobster which cant be bad in anything, but were dry as in mayonaise wise. Everything was fresh when it arrived, but just not as I remember as in my days of living in New England and having this sandwich at Points East in Westfield Mass!! Just my opinion, you just might like them, but Id add more mayo and maybe celery..just missing something!!
He takes his mini bone into another room and eats it facing away from us. We believe he does this in order to hide it and be sure we won't take it away.

The medium are a good size for my 30 lb Sheltie.  This is his treat after his dailly brushing and he just loves them.  They do help his breath although, as another reviewer pointed out, they are not a substitute for brushing.  The pantry pack is a good value.

We have two small Maltese and they absolutely love these treats. We often break them in half to make the box last a little longer. As far as helping their breath, they help a bit. When it comes to their dental needs their is no substitution for manually brushing their teeth.
My little rescue mini poodle Bugsy loves these wonderful little chews. Small dogs like Bugsy benefit from the cleaning done with these.
my dog loves these and they really are good for thei teeth and their breath! This big bag enables them to be  at a very good price and do last quite a while. Reccommend, quick shipping!

column9: Package wasn't received, and both UPS and Amazon said it was the other's problem
column10: I have given my dogs these dental treats before and they are very popular with them. The package I found on Amazon was a good price for the large quantity ordered. Since now I have paid the money and never received the item, and basically have found no direct route of getting refunded, I am not happy. I will be reluctant to purchase from Amazon again because there was no way for me to get hold of them for a reimbursement. I contacted UPS and they said Amazon likes to handle these things directly. And from looking all through Amazon's website, it says to contact UPS directly. And when I try to put in for a refund, the product not arriving is never an option---and there is no phone number or way to email otherwise. I guess I am out $30 for this purchase. I am disappointed in both Amazon and UPS for their service. I think if the product arrived, I would have likely been happy with it.

Mochi were delivered in an acceptable state - quite soft and fresh, but deformed and squashed. As for the taste - well, they were OK with tea, but I could still taste the artificial ingredients quite distinctly, especially in the pink variety (presumably peach).. All in all, they are inferior to other mochi I have tried, though not too bad.

I'd already tried a couple of other varieties of this line and had liked them, so I expected to like this flavor as well, However, this tea has an unpleasant flowery aftertaste that makes it feel as though I'm drinking perfume. After a sip of this flavor, I feel like I need something else to drink because something about it just leaves me feeling thirstier than before.Maybe it's a taste some people enjoy, but it's not one I will be buying again.
This product taste terrible.Do not buy a big package from Amazon until you have tried a smaller size at the store first.  It tast nothing like fruit or tea.

column9: Love Love Love the Berries of Summer, Stop Me Before I Start Raving
column10: Lipton to Go Stix Iced Green Tea Mix, Tea and Honey, blackberry pomegranate offers a fresh-tasting sweet tea that registers only five calories and ten mg of caffeine per eight ounce fluid serving.  The Unilever product comes in a small box, in which are ten handy flutes, each of which is good for either two eight ounce servings or one sixteen ounce drink: it's also available as an economical flat.  It is, the manufacturer states, made from real tea leaves and contains 60 mg tea flavenoids per eight fluid ounce serving.  It is also sweetened with honey, and real fruit flavors.  It is, as well, easy to prepare.  You can add a packet to one bottle (16.9 fl. oz. of water), or to a glass of water: just stir and enjoy.  The tea does take a little bit longer to dissolve than some other mixing powders, so you do have to shake, or stir well.  It's obviously a handy thing to keep on hand for the office, the gym, the backpack, or anywhere you are on the go.  The caffeine helps as a pick-me-up when I get in hot and tired in the afternoon.I found the taste quite sweet and delicious.  What can I say, I just love love love the berries of summer, all of them, and though blueberries have now been called very healthy, I always loved them, and blackberries, raspberries, strawberries, gooseberries when I can find them, stop me before I start raving...  I just, at a local farm stand, run by a local farmer with a good reputation, bought strawberries, blueberries, raspberries and blackberries all at once, with only me to eat them.  And I did, don't worry about that.  Anyway, the pomegranate taste here does add a bit of tartness, and pomegranate is also considered quite healthy, too.  However, in the list of ingredients I find sucralose and corn maltodextrin as sweeteners: these ingredients concern me. I'm not a dietitian, just do my best to eat healthy stuff; this drink might, still, be more healthy than diet soda, I just don't know.
I ordered these for my aunts who are diabetics, but they taste so good I'm keeping some for me!!!
I like all the golightly products and usually keep one kind in stock at home. I also include these in packages sent to troops as female soldiers are weight watchers also.

Love the candy but it is sticky. I'm use to the life savers brand but this is still good and cheaper.  Would buy again!

These are not "chocolates" -- they are chocolate-flavoured hard candies.  Maybe there was some fine print somewhere saying so, but I ordered them based on the title "chocolates" and the photo.  Very disappointed.

Until last year the 1928 flavor was very dry and authentic.  Extremely retro flavored and reminiscent of the kind of neat dry tasting bubble gum packed in baseball cards of the 50s.  The 1928 flavor was something special and reminded you of your youth the instant you bit into it.  Completely unlike any modern sugary gum.Then last year they decided to make it more palatable to the modern taste.  It is not awful but a lot of the dry "gotta have it" flavor has been swapped for a gooey sort of modern sweeter type gum.  Now it is more sugary and bland at the same time.  You might like it if you like Disco music.In short...it sucks compared to what they were making last year.  All the retro has disappeared.Way to go Dubble Bubble.  I will now add you to Black Jack, Beemans and Clove as flavors that have decided to weaken your brand flavor in search of a wider audience.  Guess what?  Us lovers of the original are not fooled and we say---"See Ya!"  I will never again buy your gum.  And good luck trying to convince modern tastes that you have anything cool to offer.  You are the worst kind of sell outs.  The kind that die with a whimper...

column9: Best gum EVER!!  But bargain shop for a better price
column10: This is the BEST gum ever, I LOVED it as a kid.  I've tried buying it over the years, but the kind that is most commonly sold (the "original flavor") is NOT the REAL original flavor (the fake "original flavor" comes in a yellow twist wrapper & can be found everywhere).  THIS 1928 version is the REAL, original flavor I remember as a child growing up in the 60s, 70s and 80s (and beyond, until they changed the recipe to the gross version that you find most places).  The 1928 "original flavor" is the one I remember - the sweet cinnamon/clove flavor (but not the of cinnamon that burns your mouth like Red Hots or Big Red gum).  It's not easy to find, but I found it at our local Cracker Barrel then came here to Amazon to see if I could buy it in bulk.  I was thrilled to find it, but not at this price, no way!  Thankfully, I found a much better deal from a different vendor so make sure you check it out and don't get price gauged.  This gum is great, you want to be able to actually ENJOY it while you chew it (and have enough $$ left over to pay for the dental bills). ;)

Every curry sauce is different.  This one is very good and spicy.  Don't serve to people who want mild!  One jar of sauce + 1 large cooked breast of chicken, cut into bite size pieces, plus small pieces of red pepper and a spoonful or two of snow peas or sugar snap peas (also precooked), and anything else that appeals to you, makes a fine dish for anywhere between 2 and 4 people, depending on appetite.

We had guests over who loved the seasonings and went home and placed their own orders on Amazon.  Everyone couldn't get enough of Chef's Fun Foods in their mouths! I love my fruity martinis, but I'm trying to watch my sugar intake, so I hunted around for some sugar free mixers.  I ran across Baja Bob's and I'm very glad I did! Best for me to mix per my taste. Its an easy mixer. It tastes good. A martini mix that comes right to the door.

column10: It's not easy to find sugar free products like this on store shelves, so it was great to find it on Amazon. column9: Finally a no sugar flavoring with great taste
column10: Great flavor - I love this product with mineral water for a refreshing drink this summer.

I've been buying Nature's Path gluten free foods for a number of years, and have been fully satisfied. Anyone following a gluten-free diet knows how expensive it can be to buy the gluten-free version of anything - and when trying a product for the first time you hope it actually tastes good.  This is one gluten-free product I am completely delighted with - both in taste and price.  These corn flakes are crunchy and delicious (I like them better than the glutenated alternatives), and work well for other recipes.  Candies, cereal crumb pie crusts, fried chicken, etc.

Our whole family loves this wholesome cereal. Although definitely not as sweet as a lot of corn flake cereals found on the counter, it does have a delightful taste that is crisp and you'll know that you won't gain a lot of weight. We eat it with organic milk, organic blueberries & bananas, and it really helps us start the day with the energy we need. The large pack helps the cereal last longer than the smaller packs, which rarely last beyond a couple of days. We love this cereal, and we think it's really a bargain! We also love the free shipping, which we found to be very prompt more often than not. Thanks, Amazon!

column9: Not Gluten Free! Chance of Cross Contamination Because Made on Same Equipment as Gluten!
column10: My daughter who has Celiac had a severe reaction after eating this and the Mesa Sunrise Cereal also by Nature's Path for several days. This was the only new food in her diet so I checked the website of Nature's Path for more information. it turns out they make their GF cereals on the same equipment as the gluten ones. They promise they wash the equipment and throw away the first part of the cereal made yet there was still enough there for my daughter to react. I would never have bought this cereal if I knew that it was made in the same room much less the same equipment. Some companies are ethical and will admit when their food is processed in the same area or on the same equipment so people like my daughter have a choice of whether to risk their health or not.

These corn flakes are truly the best I've ever eaten.  They are crispy, stay that way for quite some time when served in milk, and are deeply satisfying insofar as flavor is concerned.  To boot, and very important to me, they are gluten free.  With some products, looking at the price-tag is a waste of time, I'd buy these anywhere, at any price.

This product is worth buying. I am sensitive to the smallest quantity of gluten and certainly DO NOT react to this product. As other reviews mention, it tastes great and has a nice crunch. I have also found that unlike other gluten free cornflakes, the texture in this one is consistent - I don't get any hard gritty pieces. Great with sliced up banana.

These are the best corn flakes ever. They are very crunchy, and we even like to eat them right out of the bag as a snack. Unlike many other brands of corn flakes,these take a really long time to get soggy. They stay firm and crunchy when milk is added. I love to eat them with fresh blueberries. Yum!
These corn flakes are quite tasty and GLUTEN FREE; organic too. This product beats national brands by a country mile and the price is good. Free shipping makes this a winner.

column9: It is a good beef soup if you know a trick
column10: Actually, this is a very good beef soup if you know a strick how to pour the soup out. Before using this soup, you should let container stand for at least few hours to keep all sweet powder and cinnamon staying in the bottom of the container, then when you are ready to enjoy the soup, you pour soup out gently and slowly in the pot. By doing this way, you will get only clear soup and all the sweet and cinnamon power staying in the bottom of the container, but you have to feel when you should stop pour out the soup. When I feel the container is very light, about only 1/10 of the liquid in the container and I stop. By doing this way, the soup is not sweet and not taste like cinnamon anymore, since then I love this soup because I don't feel thirsty after eating this Beef Pho soup. This Pho soup became my favorite because I can enjoy at home anytime and add extra thing I like as good beef, fresh slice of ginger.The first time, I tried this Pho soup, I didn't like it because it was so sweet as other reviewer wrote. You should try my trick and I am sure you will love this soup again.

column9: This stuff is nowhere near real pho.. terrible
column10: Pho is one of my favorite comfort foods. I make my own pho broth by gallons using a great recipe and freeze it so I can make pho when I feel yucky. I was excited when I found this in the Supermarket, particularly when I saw no MSG in the ingredients. I do use their other broths quite a lot so I am familiar with their products and am usually satisfied.Part of the reason I make my own is to avoid MSG and other items but lack of MSG aside this stuff is terrible. It's bland and by shortcutting by using spice extracts and lime oil it just doesn't taste good. Plus by having lemon juice and lime oil in up-front it ends up with that 'cooked citrus' taste by the time its heated for use. This product would be improved by leaps and bounds just by eliminating the lemon juice and lime oil - lime is added at serving anyway. The broth also needs to be infused with the roasted spices, not just tweaked with extracts, IMHO. Plus by eliminating sea salt and using small amounts of good quality fish sauce there would be a far more rounded and balanced flavor. All in all I think if I need a quick pho fix I will need to look elsewhere. Pity.
