I've made about 5 batches of wine this year, and this one was the best. Well balanced and nice body!
Purchased this as a gift and it was well received.  What a better gift than to give someone the ability to make their own wine?

Other reviews led me to believe this kit was low end. I tested it as I was putting it together and indeed it is a low budget item. Better kits sell for twice the price and premium kits for 3 times as much. I tossed in a 1/2 gallon of concord grape juice to get a satisfactory carbohydrate count. I suggest replacing 1/2 gallon of water with additional juice or reducing the volume by 2 or 3 quarts. On the upside it includes corks, shrinks and labels that most kits dont. I'm happy with it.

The Barolo is excellene and probably the best of the bunch. I did what other reviewers said, to make 5 Gal. not 6 and it definately seems to have made a much more full bodied wine. I will let you knoe after opening the first bottle months from now but as right now it already has a great taste.

This was my first kit purchase and as many, I was skeptical.  It has been two months and I have to say that the flavor and nose are really surprising.  I am a wine aficionado through Parker and also a collector. I know a little about wine.  The wine tastes wonderful, has a lasting taste, not overly astringent or hot.  It is around 13 percent alcohol.  I took the advice of some of the previous posts and made only 5 gallons.  It was the right choice.  6 gallons would have been much too weak for a titan wine like Borolo.  I recommend it highly and let it rest.  It gets much better.  I posted after ordering my second round.

This kit is really very good.  The directions are clear, the included extras are nice, the free shipping is great, and the packaging was very good.  But more importantly the wine is excellent.  It has a nice rich deep fruit aroma and a clean rich flavor.  I did make this as a 5 gallon batch instead of six (thanks fellow reviewers!).  This is a great value, and exceeded my expectations.  I have been home brewing beer for almost 20 years and wine for close to 10 so I have seen my share the good, bad and the ugly kits.  A word to the wise here... pay particular attention to your sanitation.  I recommend the many no-rinse sanitizers (check the many home brew catalog sites).  Sanitize everything, its easy to do with the no-rinse products.  The quality of my wine and beer really improved when I focused on my sanitation.  Also I do filter my beer and wine and I highly recommend that as well.

I started this wine (my very first) on March 18th - just under 5 months ago.  I closely, but not exactly followed the advice in Duane's review.  I reconstituted to about 5.25 gallons instead of the 6 called for in the instructions.  Instead of using BM4X4 (as Duane suggested), I used BM45 since it was easier to find in small quantities.  I rehydrated with GoFerm, per directions, then added FermaidK about 4 days into the fermentation.  After secondary fermentation was complete, I bulk aged in a carboy for a little over two months with about 2.5oz of Hungarian Medium+ oak cubes.  I finally bottled it in mid/late June.  My tastings during the process had me concerned that I either made mistakes along the way, or this was just too cheap a kit to really make anything drinkable.  Even a month after bottling, I was still concerned (though it had been improving).  I'm happy to report that I opened another bottle last night and it's really starting to become a nice table wine.  While I wouldn't compare it to any true Barolo's I've had, it does stand up reasonably well to Italian red blends in the $8-10/bottle range.  Pretty good in my book, considering it only cost about $2/bottle.Bottom line, this is a pretty good kit, with a few modifications.  But give it time.  The biggest key I'm learning in winemaking is patience.  If you make this kit, you'll have a decent table wine in 3-6 months.  I've since started the Vino Italiano Cabernet Sauvignon and will bottle that in a couple weeks.  Again, I've modified it, but it's going to be another pretty good table wine for two bucks a bottle.  Can't complain.

column9: Decent kit, seems to make pretty tasty wine
column10: This was my first Vino Italiano kit.  I've made other wine kits, and I also make mead (but not from kits).It turned out pretty good.  It has an odd odor, but it tastes good and there seems to be plenty of flavor.  Friends like it, that's good enough for me.  I did follow the suggestions of others here and made it as a 5-gallon kit instead of the standard 6-gallon.  I think it came out to about 12% ABV.  We'll see if it improves after aging a little.

This wine was very easy to make.  The instructions were very easy to follow.  Like many other people I made 5 gallons instead of six.  I feel that this is the only way to go.  I'm very happy with the end product.  On the last racking I filled the carboy with a gallon of blackberry wine.  At the moment it taste great!  Sometime in the cellar should mellow this wine. I cant wait! I just finished this batch on the 3rd of March 2012.  Everything went very well for a beginner.  Try it!

I've been making wine for about a year and recently tried this one. Following others advice I made this a 5 gallon batch. I also added raisins, peppercorns and oak chips. Although it's only been bottled a month this is the  flavor I've been trying to get, dry, oaky and a hint of pepper. I'll be making more soon.

I bought this wine and started drinking it right away.  It was drinkable but seemed like drinking fermented grape juice (which it is) My wife made a great Sangria with it.  After six to eight weeks the difference was amazing. The wine matured very quickly.  I have only made six batches total so I am not an expert but I think the wine is great.  Remember to let it rest a bit longer than 4 weeks.

It's been two weeks since I began bulk aging this Barolo kit and I am impressed so far.  The wine, even at this early stage is very drinkable, and has a beautiful, deep red color.  My only regret is having stabilized it before doing a malolactic fermentation, but I will do that on the next one.I took reviewer Duane's advice and used BM 4X4 yeast which I was able to buy in 30 gram packages from Fermentation Solutions in Campbell, Ca.  I also made this kit to 5.5 gallons and added 1 1/2 lbs of Zante currants (available on Amazon) for body.Though I have two much more expensive Winexpert kits going, I expect I'll be drinking this Barolo as my table wine while the other more expensive kits age.  You won't go wrong buying this kit, and with a few tweaks you'll have a very nice table wine for under 2 bucks a bottle.

I have made two of these and just ordered another one.  We usually drink 3 to 10 dollar wine and we really like this Barolo.  I make them at 5.5 gallons.  I added banana to one that made almost no difference.

I just finished up bottling this kit.  I strayed a little on this kit.  I made it five gallons to begin with.  Then I added about 5 pounds of Thompson seedless and Red Flame grapes plus one banana.So it has only been four weeks but yes, it is very tasty.  Keep your expectations in line with the price.  I think these are great kits to play around with.  They come with labels, corks and shrink sleeves.  I always bottle these in 2 liter soda bottles and then paste on one of the labels.  The Barolo label has a statue of a Greek God.  Love drinking this wine and looking at the label. ;)Vino Italiano 4 Week Wine Kit, Barolo, 15.5-Pound Box
Definitely add 3 lbs of sugar to raise the sp. gr. Make 5 gal rather than 6.  Package arrived in tact.

column9: EEEW! Bad grape juice meets stale Riesling...
column10: I am an avid red wine drinker, I love it!I wouldn't call myself a connoisseur, but I spent years bartending in several fine dining establishments and at the end of my shift would get to indulge in the finer things I'd never actually spent $40-$50 a bottle on myself.Six years later, two kids, now a stay at home mom and army wife I have literally resorted to $4 bottles of red wine at walmart (because formula, diapers, school clothes, etc obviously come first).  I'm always looking for a new hobby (as if running a household and carpool and sports aren't enough to do with my husband deployed 8 months a year!) and thought wine making would be a lot of fun and could involve my oldest son as a helper since he's into science and really that's what this is.  I followed the directions to a tee, and it is SO GROSS!  It tastes like stale grape juice, but has that tingly carbonation feel that you sometimes get with reisling.  It's really, really bad.  And I forced myself to drink a glass after running it through the aerator I own twice, and I really don't think there's much alcohol content at all.  I don't drink to get drunk or anything, but after a hearty glass of wine you should feel a little something!Also, when it said "KIT" and had vague information on the description, I was under the impression it came with everything!  You need to buy an additional $150 of equipment on here.  This being my first wine making experience, I was unaware of that.  TOTAL BUST!I'm going to try another brand and see if I have better results, I'll update!Thanks for reading!

column9: This is a Refill kit!!! Do not be fooled.
column10: I ordered this as a Christmas present. When we opened it we found out that you need about $200 worth of equipment to make this. I am an amateur beer maker and thought this would be alot of fun. When you order extra there it says REFILL kit. That is EXACTLY what this is! A REFILL KIT!!! This advertising is extremely deceptive. It also says nothing about all the extra equipment you will need, so here are the thing you will need to buy;*Primary Fermentor: food grade plastic (30) little capacity.*Carboy 23 liter glass or food grade plastic*Racking tube and siphon hose*hyrometer, thermometer, and test jar*long hadled plastic Spoon*Bottle Brush*Bottle corker*filter and filter pads From A wine retailerAnd now you are ready to go!!!

I ordered this marzipan last Christmas, amazed by the great deal that I had found.Unfortunately, the old addage is true:  you get what you pay for.This marzipan is made with corn syrup instead of sugar, so it doesn't have the same texture.Even more interesting is that I froze the unused marzipan in the same bag with a 'better' variety.  Within three months this marzipan had taken on a freezer taste, whereas the higher grade marzipan still tastes great even one year later.  They were both in the same bag together, so it can only be the ingredients themselves that didn't hold up.This may be fine for gourmands, but a more refined palate is going to recognize the difference right away.  I am so glad that I didn't buy the ten pound block like I originally intended.  It may be suitable where the marzipan doesn't take center stage, but when the marzipan flavor is important pay the extra money for a 60+% almond paste made with sugar.

Buyers Beware, 1 lb. of Marzipan for $4.99.. Sounds great, right?What they neglect to tell you is that there is an additional $9 shipping charge!!!!!!Insane.If this company *ever* thinks they will get another dime from me, they are sorely mistaken.I placed my order along with some books, and Amazon does not itemize the shipping charges, only gives you one lump sum for all the items you order... At *no point* does Amazon or the company tell you what the shipping is for this item, unless it is the only item you order, and then only right before the final checkout.It was only after paying, when I received itemized email invoices that I was informed of the $9 shipping charge.What an incredibly shortsighted business practice.1 lb Marzipan, for $16. No thank you.

First of all, the picture shown is not what's received.  It came in a round plastic container, not in a wedge shape.  That doesn't matter much though.What does matter is this marzipan was so-so; I've found some brands of marzipan can be amazing, terrible, and so-so.  This one is so-so.  Also, I thought I was buying unflavored, plain almond paste marzipan, but it turned out it was flavored with apricot kernels- which sounds delicious, but practically it only came out okay.The marzipan I get at my local European Deli smokes this one by miles and miles, but is much more expensive.  I'm going to try a different brand on Amazon.
Unfortunately the marzipan has corn syrup in it, so I couldn't use it. The corn syrup makes it sickly sweet. Too bad!
The marzipan has a very strong flavor....too strong.  Why are there apricot kernels in it?  And it was too sweet.

I used this to make a traditional Swedish dessert.  Product arrived quickly, and tasted great.  In fact, it tasted better than any other marzipan I have purchased, and rated on par with that I have tasted in Europe.  Yes, it has a little corn syrup in it, and yes, shipping does cost a bit.  It's 5 lbs after all, so it is to be expected.  Be smart and buy in bulk.  Wrap it well and freeze leftovers.
The items arrived faster than they estimated.  I had good email interaction with a sales rep from the creator.  The paste itself was superior in quality.
Absolutely delicious. Exactly what I was looking for. My Christmas cake was perfect! Very pleased with the marzipan and I will definitely purchase again.
My family owns dilettante Chocolates in Seattle nd has been making candy for over 50 years.  This is a great recipe!
This was fabulous. I used it as a fill with cherries in a wedding cake. It got rave reviews, and I LOVED it!
not much to say here.  it was shipped quickly and arrived in excellent time and condition.  product arrived fresh and tasty.  top quality stuff.
this is Great Stuff have been using it for years.It getting harder and harder to find in the stores,so I just figured i would start ordering it. Much easier

We use it mainly for frying up chicken strips and sometimes mushrooms.  We were buying it one box at a time from Martin's or Krogers, so I figured why not go the "pallet" route and buy a whole carton.  Best decision I ever made in my entire life, not like some horrible decisions I've made, including buying 25,000 shares of Facebook on opening day.  My wife is made at me about that, but I don't care.

I have been looking for a good batter mix for my pressure fryer and found it!!  I used to buy the mix from Pro-Selections, but it was expensive.  4 bags for $30!  It was good but I noticed it said it was mixed for them.  After looking around it appears that Drakes probably makes it for them.  I bought this blindly as I never heard about it before.  After some googling, I found that this is a pretty popular brand back east.  I tried it out this past weekend and it is pretty much the same as the Pro-Selections mix but at a much better price!  I will try to use it with some other foods, but my primary use is for Pressure Fried Chicken!

This fry mix has been a family favorite for over 50 years.  Growing up in Michigan where it is manufactured and living on the west coast I could only get it when visiting.  I was delighted to find the product through Amazon.  It makes great onion rings which was what my mother primarily used it for and pleased many a guest at family BBQs.  I have also used it for baking fish and was happy with the result.

Then you will love this. I actually like this better than some of the jar sauces out there. If you enjoy intense flavor then you can just add a second package. It's very creamy and once you start eating it it's hard to stop. My husband is not big on pasta, but when I made it with this sauce he couldn't get enough.

Pasta Knorr Sauce Parma Rosa Creamy Tomato / B000I2OOPWPardon me while I rave about how incredible this pasta mix is, but I'm just totally in love with this sauce. I love to eat pasta, but I am usually confined to the higher-fat alfredo sauces and cheese sauces because acidic tomato sauces irritate my acid reflux. That means no spaghetti and meatballs, which has been frustrating for me, but that's life, eh?Then, while I was browsing the sauce aisle for Knorr alfredo packets, I found this Parma Rosa sauce. I have no idea what 'vodka sauce' is that the other reviewers reference, but whatever this is, it is GOOD. If I had to describe it, I'd call it a creamy tomato alfredo, but even though it is creamy, it is also very light and pleasing to taste, not cloying. The tomato taste is exquisite, and the acid content is low enough to prevent stomach pains. The taste itself is absolutely wonderful - I can actually talk myself out of impulse eating by promising myself Parma Rosa later - it's that good!The Knorr sauces are fairly easy to make (the instructions are serious when they say to 'stir constantly', though, and I think it helps to preheat the milk before adding the powdered mix) and they store indefinitely in these dried packets (another reason to buy packets, besides the smaller carbon footprint in shipping versus jars!). Oh, and buying them on Amazon means I get them for half the price of the local market! For the Parma Rosa, I also add about a third of a pound of seasoned, browned ground beef as easy 'meatballs'. The portions are such that I can easily get two full meals out of one sauce packet, and the sauce stores perfectly in the fridge - this coming from a person who generally hates leftovers.~ Ana Mardoll
this sauce is very easy to make. just add milk or cream turns out nice mild sauce in ten minutes. i'll buy it again.

Pasta sauce from an envelope?  Never.  What kind of a plebian do you think I am?For this sauce, I'll make an exception.  Knorr sauce mixes are generally a cut above the rest, but this particular blend is creamy, cheesy (in a good way), and easy.  It's a nice side for grilled chicken with Italian herbed vegetables, and with some shaved grana padano on top, no one will think it's from a packet.  Also, Amazon has a great price, and the larger quantity doesn't take up all that much room in the pantry.Let's see:  creamy, cheesy, easy, and cheap? Hey, I think I went to high school with her.  But this one won't mind waiting in the pantry when mom comes over.  Check it out.

column9: Knorr Parma Rosa Creamy Pasta Sause
column10: I had trouble finding this particular sause mix in the grocery stores, luckily Amazon has it.  We love this sause and I have a recipe that only this sause completes.  I use it with polish sausage links, slice the links into bite size pieces, place on bottom of cassarole dish, mix the sause, add to cooked lg. shell mac.place on top of sausage pcs., top with sliced gr. peppers (& red peppers if you can afford them), onion, diced tomatoes - heat in oven about 15-20min at 350 and makes a great meal.

column9: Flashy and tasty pasta in a pinch!
column10: I am a *huge pasta fan,  really I am.  Anyone that knows me personally knows I prob.  dream about pasta at least three times a week.  hah!This is really tasty stuff.  Reminds me of Vodka Sauce.  Not to mention you can make it look really pretty if you put a little love into it.It's really easy to make!  Just warm up the powder and milk and mix it all together in a small pot..  Have the cooked pasta ready.. then mix it all together in one pot! THEN!  Place it on a cute little dish.. in the middle.. and put some green next too it... to add color!  and its a cute little meal!Really,  I love this stuff!!

I make thin spaghetti with the Knorr Parma Rosa sauce, add freshly ground black pepper, a generous amount of parmesan cheese and fresh baby peas.  It is a quick meal, easy to assemble, and has a rich but light flavor.  It's a good choice for children, and you just might get them to enjoy the baby peas in this nice pasta dish.
I'm a picky eater, but I LOVE this sauce. My husband and I make it at least once a week. It's easy, although it's hard to get the sauce thick like I like it but it is so good!
This sauce=awesome.  I add jarred marinated artichoke hearts and add the sauce to penne or rigatoni.  DELICIOUS.

This is a great product that is very easy to make. It never clumps, which is a great plus when it comes to dry sauce mixes.I personally favor the Knorr white sauces (e.g. the Alfredo or Garlic Herb), which is the only reason why I'm not giving this 5 stars.Overall, it's very enjoyable, nice to have around when you don't want to make sauce from scratch, and I would definitely purchase again.

These are probably by far the best puppy treats ever, and my puppy just loves them to the max, and for the price you get on here, its worth buying a few packs for what you pay for one at a dog supply store

column9: Delicious, beautiful, and more economic than it sounds.
column10: I tried this tea in a Teavana store where samples were available.  Not only is the blossom beautiful and exotic, but the tea is delicious.  It's smooth, uniform, and though delicate the peach flavor was definitely at the forefront.  I don't know if the pot I tried had been sweetened or not, but I was floored.  It's easily the best tasting tea I've ever tried (though admittedly that isn't saying much; I'm not a frequent tea drinker).The economic part comes in with the multiple infusions.  This isn't a makes-one-pot product; you can refill the pot and brew again with the same blossom and get multiple pots out of each 'ball.'

I originally tried this tea in the Teavana store, and was surprised at the wonderful scent. I'm not usually one for peach teas, but this was so mellow and fragrant, I couldn't pass it up. I didn't even realize it was a blooming tea until the gal at Teavana explained it to me.Not only does this tea taste good and is good for you, but it's beautiful, and more affordable than you'd think. The blossom it creates when you brew it is very pretty, it's half of why I drink it. And, each blossom is good for 5-6 brews, which means the 2 ounces in a pack (about 8 blossoms) is about 50 cups of tea. I use 1 blossom in Teavana's Perfect Tea Maker (the 16 ounce size) and I can fill the tea maker full 5-7 times before I consider the flavor and scent to be pretty diminished. For an artisan tea, that's an excellent value.

This was my first experience with blooming tea, and it made me into an enthusiastic believer!  My boyfriend had wanted me to look for chrysanthemum tea, without caffeine, at the new Teavana store at one of the local malls, and this was the tea I was told had the most chrysanthemum in it.  It looks absolutely beautiful when it blooms underwater, it smells wonderful, and it has a wonderful peach and jasmine flavor.  Unlike traditional teabags, teaballs can be used for at least three brewings, and one ball is even enough to brew an entire pot of tea.  This particular blooming tea might be on the pricy side for just two ounces, but in the long run it saves more money than getting a lot of teabags that might be cheaper but which can only be used for one cup of tea and still retain much flavor.  This tea still packs its full flavor after the first use and after the first day!  This was also my first time experiencing white tea, which, as it turns out, is lowest in caffeine of any of the other types of tea and is the highest in antioxidants.  And the fancy teaballs just make one want to brew this tea, since the presentation is so much prettier and more elegant-looking than a regular teabag, which one just throws in a cup of hot water.  It also helps that in Chinese culture, the chrysanthemum is believed to have the power to help a drinker to live to one hundred!

As stated, this tea is lovely.  Watching it bloom in it's pot (I have a clear glass teapot just for these blooming teas) is a a lot of fun.  How did it taste?  Not bad, flavor did not match looks, but I could taste a hint of peach and it was fun to chomp on the little candy bits.  I don't know that I would repurchase.  It wasn't tasty enough for me to be more than a novelty, your mileage may differ.  Shipping was rapid and the item was well packaged.

column9: A delicate, delicious and beautiful cup of tea
column10: This tea is so delicious. Very smooth with a light hint of peach (not "fake" or fruity). We also love the Strawberry Misaki blooming tea. I actually like the Misaki a tiny bit more.And it is lovely to watch the teas "bloom." We don't have a glass tea kettle, but they had some blooming teas in one at a Teavana store, we visited and it is pretty! The other poster is correct about multiple uses too. We use each ball about 6 times (in a cup of tea, not a whole pot). I've found all of the Teavana tea yield multiple uses (generally at least 5 or 6).These teas are so yummy. We don't add any sweetener. They are just perfect as they are!
This tea is wonderful to drink and is beautiful when you make it. It opens into a flower. If you make it in a glass pot it makes a great center piece when you serve it.
This is a delicious, light white tea with sweet peach flavor. Great to relax with in the evening as it naturally has very little caffeine. Tastes like summer.

I wanted to try this for the convenience factor. The flavor is very nice. It also doesn't add more liquid to a recipe, so it's great in sauces. I have so far only used it in mashed potatoes and potato salad. I think I will really start cooking with in in fall and winter when my cold weather standbys start appearing.

This is a good product, no artificial ingredients, MSG or hydrogenated oils and it tastes great! Make sure you give plenty of time for it to be delivered, took nearly three weeks to be delivered to me. Good enough though that I will probably plan ahead and re-order.

Excellent product.  I used it on a sea kayaking trip and all five of us were amazed at the excellent texture and flavor.  One package lasted for 2 Mexican food meals for five hungry paddlers in British Columbia.  I do have doubts that it would serve as well with warm water.

oh my oh my.... I mainly use this in mashed potatoes. I just mix in a few tablespoons and the flavor is wonderful. all of the products that I have bought from here are just fabulous... I recommend this company and their products highly.

This is a great sour cream and chives powder. Scalloped potatoes with this sour cream and chives is very tasty.Sour Cream and Chives Powder, 8 oz. I mix as much as I need for a meal.  There is zero waste.  The product stores well.

column9: Good Stuff, No nutritonal data info on label
column10: I like the taste of this stuff.  Mixed some with the cheddar cheese powder and had a great dipping sauce for my Sweet Sue Chicken Breast Chunks.  There is not an nutritional information on the label.  I even looked on their website for nutritional data for this product.  I am mainly concerned about the sodium content.  I like to monitor my salt intake.  Also, I would like to know if there is some calcium in this product (there should be, because it is made from sour cream).

I took this stuff on a two week camping trip.  I put it in chilli, made tacos and soups.  This is the best tasting sour cream powder I've ever come across.  Buy this stuff now!  One bag lasted 6 campers for about 3-4 meals used as a condiment.
The product was delivered in a timely manner.  It was easy to use and tasty.

column9: Scones are great....seller price is way too high
column10: Our family loves the Sticky Fingers English scones.  I decided to stock up on Amazon.  I ordered three differenct flavors which all shipped from different vendors.  For approximately $12, I was able to get 3 packs of scone mix.  I assumed that, given the price of nearly $12, I was getting a multipack from this vendor as well.  When it arrived, it was just a single package which I could have purchased at my local Cost Plus for $5.95.  Next time I'll read the quantity line more carefully.The scones themself are so quick to make and yummy.  We've tried almost all the flavors and they are all delicious.

I just discovered these at Marshalls and after trying them went back and bought all they had. But they don't always have them so I came to Amazon. WOW! These scones are a delight! Lightly crusty on the outside and soft and fluffy on the inside. Lightly sweet and absolutely scrumptious. Had them fresh out of the oven with some homemade yogurt. I found mine one day rummaging through a shelf at Marshalls. They don't always have them so I came here. Even at a dollar higher it's worth it! I will NEVER buy a hard $2.00 scone at Starbucks again!
I have given my dogs these treats for years.  Nice thing is even the older dogs do not have a problem eating these like they do hard biscuit treats.
My dog is actually a little picky when it comes to treats. He loves these though, and I don't have to feel guilty about giving him several throughout the day because they are very low in calories.

column9: My dog knows the name "Charlee Bear"....
column10: I ask her if she wants some Charlee Bear, and she perks right up- this is a new flavor for her- but she seems to think they're just as good as the egg and cheese, and (God forbid) the turkey liver and cranberry (for the holidays, you know).  The small size makes them great to hide around the living room (what- your dog doesn't stalk its treats?). She loves the "hunt", and has her nose working overtime to make sure she finds them all - the dog says they're a good thing ;)

I use a mix of training treats for my dogs and this is the only crunchy treat that makes it into the training treat bag. Generally crunchy treats are not ideal for the training I do because it just takes the dogs too long to chew them. These get munched pretty quickly and the dogs seem to love them.

A friend had offered my dog one of these treats and not knowing what it was made of, I wondered if my veggie loving dog would eat it. She not only ate it, she wanted more! When I read the ingredients I saw why...all natural, chicken and veggies....my dog's favorites.This is a treat I feel good about giving to my dog for both training and just "because".

column9: Apparently they taste good, and they are made in the U.S.A.
column10: I'll be honest, I decided to try these mainly because they are made here in America, and I don't have to worry about some toxic Chinese ingredients. My dog must really love them too, judging by his eagerness to do his tricks when these are in the treat bag.

Maggie is my little dog and she LOVES Charlee Bears.  When it's time for her to take a break in her crate, all I have to say is "If you want a Charlee Bear, get in your crate."  She runs to her crate and waits patiently for me to deliver on my promise.If she could write, I'm sure she would tell everyone that she hasn't met a Charlee Bear she doesn't like.

My puppy loves the treats, they're a great alternative to soft treats (especially the one I was using before, which was loaded with sugar).  However, he sometimes doesn't chew it completely and will cough up the treats if I give too many in succession (which happens when I'm teaching him a new trick).  A drink of water solves the issue, but you might want to keep soft treats on hand if you treat your dog during walks/exercise.
Great treat for motivating dogs!  Every dog I have used these with loves them!  Easy to carry with youfor reinforcing good behaviors!  Multiple flavors available-- my dogs love all of them!

these are handy dog treats for training, Charlie bear comes in a few different flavors my dogs love them all & I like the price on amazon only reason I didn't give 5 stars is I noticed these treats make both my dogs thirsty so I probably won't use during summer training- for indoor controlled temp with water available there perfect.
Great treats, my Dogs love them! I like them because they are dry and easy to keep in your pocket without making a mess.
Love love love this soy sauce. I have been purchasing the Ohsawa unpasteurized soy sauce from Raw Reform for several years now. Nothing else is this good!

Some may think that the type of lime juice doesn't matter much whenmaking key lime pie..but I'm here to tell you this product definitelymakes any recipe better.  The quality is superb, taste is fabulous,Nellie & Joe's is simply the best!

We lived in Miami in the 80's and this was on the store shelves there but I could never get it when I traveled somewhere else.  Now it is!Do not use plain old lime juice when a recipe calls for Key Lime, it is not the same.  Nellie & Joe's is the best.Here's the best recipe ever for Key Lime Pie:2 egg yolks, beaten1 (14 ounce) can sweetened condensed milk1/2 cup key lime juicePour into a graham cracker crustThe recipe doesn't even call for baking it.  The lime juice thickens the milk and eggs.  But I do bake it for about 10-15 minutes at 350º just to be sure.
I am a "PJ baker" I run a small bakery form my home, I love this product especially for key lime pies. taste like the realu thing and a lot easier than squeezing limes.

This product has a receipe on the bottle for Key Lime Pie and it is easy to make and taste great. The juice also works well with Ice Tea and other receipes that call for lime juice. Seems to taste alot better than the brand name or generic lime juices at least that my opinion.

column9: Nellie & Joe's Famous Key West Lime Juice, Original makes the best key lime desserts
column10: In reponse to other negative reviews, I have used and really like Nellie & Joe's Famous Key West Lime Juice, Original. It is a lot better than Plain Lime Juice made with only Persian Limes.When I contacted Nellie & Joe's at keylimejuice com, following is the response I received:Hello,The original is made with both Key Limes and Persian Limes. IT is the juice preferred by the largest bakers, such as Sara Lee, Edwards, Heinz Corporation.Laura CisekNellie & Joe's450 SW 12 AVENUEPOMPANO BEACH FL 33060954-783-4188800-546-3743954-785-9450(FAX)

Nellie & Joe's Key West Lime Juice is the ONLY bottled lime juice that doesn't spoil the taste of Margueritas!  In addition, it's great for cooking of all kinds.  The local store which stocked Nellie & Joe's closed, so Amazon is a life (or at least Marguerita) saver!  The juice freezes well if the bottles are frozen horizontally rather than vertically.  Highly recommended.

column9: Does not compare to fresh key limes...

It ruined 2 pies and I just gave up and went to the store and luckily we still had key limes in Colorado.  Such a shame because I wanted this to work, but if you are looking for the best key lime pie that you can make, stick with the fresh key limes.
I moved away from a grocer that carried this and was very upset until I found it here.  The best there is.Wish it came in singles though, as I won't use 12 in 5 years....

AS GOOD AS DR OZ SAID AND REALLY TASTY. TRY LOTS OF FLAVORS FOR VARIETY, I NO LONGER BUY THE ZONE AND/OR POWERBARS.

These are great! I found these bars in a local store and wanted to buy them buy bulk. My son in law is in Afganistan, when he was home on R & R, he tried one, and now he too is hooked. They are very good!!

I bought these for my grandmother who likes just a little of something healthy now and then to satisfy her sweet tooth. Purchasing from Adagio 2nd time. Awesome speed of shipment covered with full information about product, tracking numbers (even with shipped package photo). Adagio is not just good - Adagio is the best. Tea has fantastic smell, delicate test. I will definitely order more in the future.
I have been searching for cracker meal for some time, as my area no longer carries the product.  This is necessary for cooking seafood and chicken!

column9: When you get tired of searching...
column10: Living in Florida near the water resulted in lots of shrimp in the freezer last fall. We enjoy our fried shrimp lightly coated, and this cracker meal is one of the best. Tried store after store then looked on line and ordered a case from Amazon delivered right to my door. Shared some with my mother and stored the extra boxes in the freezer. Save gas,Shop on line!

Mushrooms can add a lot of flavor to a dish.  Canned mushrooms are bland and boring and fresh mushrooms have a limited shelf life.  Dried mushrooms pack a lot of flavor and have a long shelf life (I believe they are good for up to 2 years).  A one ounce package of dried is the equivalent of a half pound of fresh.  They need to be soaked in warm water for about an hour to hydrate before using.  The water used for hydrating can be used in your dish for added flavor.  It can also be reduced to concentrate the flavor.  Once hydrated, the mushrooms can be used in any application that you would use fresh or canned.The Chanterelles are a mild, less earthy tasting fungus.  They go very well with eggs, chicken and fish.  They are also great in a stir fry.The FungusAmongUs is a high quality brand that I highly recommend.
These chanterelles are very good.  They add a great flavor and texture to omelets, soups, and stews. I recommend soaking them overnight for best results. Happy with my purchase.
This stuff is tasty, and good for you. Shipment was prompt and packaging was very neat. Mushrooms were very good quality. We liked it though it's a bit pricey.

column9: Great mild coffee to start the day
column10: Right after we tasted this coffee we knew it had to be on our regular shopping list. It is mild with the right amount of taste. Try it and you will not be dissapointed, unless you perfer the bold tasting coffees.

column9: OK, but too weak for our taste
column10: We normally love Caribou Coffee and have tried quite a few of theirs over the years.  We just recently bought this one, Daybreak, on sale, and were underwhelmed.  It is just too ordinary tasting for our taste buds.  We are currently using and LOVING the Caribou Sumatra blend which is rich and very robust.  Reviews are subjective, so I just wanted to comment that this is the first Caribou we ever tried that was not fabulous; we just prefer stronger flavors.

This is my husband's favorite k-cup yet and he's tried many. He usually goes for darker roast in "regular" coffee, but k-cup bold flavors seem a little to bold for him. Just right taste - not all that "light."

I am very particular about coffee.  For years the only type I would drink was Wawa regular, which is very smooth.  When I got a Keurig for Christmas, I ordered a lot of sample packs to try various blends.  Daybreak Morning is my favorite.  It is smooth, mild, and full of flavor, but not too strong.  It is very good black, which is how I like it.  Daybreak Morning is going to be my regular coffee on the days that I don't go to Wawa.

This coffee is very mild and smooth, very good flavor. I find that darker roast coffee need cream to enjoy. This coffee is good all by it self, i enjoy drinking this coffee black, very smooth not bitter.

column9: So happy to share with you!

One of our typical dishes "arroz con pollo- rice with chicken) is prepared using this sauce in most parts. What makes Salsa Lizano so good?  It's the fact that they managed to bottle the flavor of Costa Rica.  If there is one definite thing that differentiates Costa Rican gallo pinto from Nicaraguan gallo pinto, it's the Salsa Lizano.  If you eat gallo pinto in Costa Rica, expect it has Salsa Lizano in it.  It's also good to pour some over the top of a plate of gallo pinto for a robust flavor addition.It's made in Costa Rica, pretty much only available in Costa Rica (aside from a few shopping avenues such as Amazon.com) and embodies a special flavor that can only be understood, not described well by anyone.  I can say it is not spicy.  It is flavorful.  It contains no yucky artificial anything.  If you ever get the chance to experience this sauce on a real or even semi-authentic Costa Rican gallo pinto recipe, you will surely be pleased.

There's nothing like it. Saute up some onions and bell peppers. Add leftover beans with a bunch of cooking liquid, and stir in Salsa Lizano's Liquid Crack. Throw in the rice. Serve with crispy fried eggs and a squeeze of lime. Close your eyes, and imagine you're in the heart of Costa Rica!

I bought this dog food because the bag showed pictured of veggies and chunks of meat, and with a name like "Beneful" I thought I was purchasing a nutritious brand of dog food. My dogs did eat this food, but after reading the ingredients I completely regret purchasing it and feel just awful for feeding it to my dogs. The first three ingredients are Ground yellow corn, chicken by-product meal, and corn gluten meal. How disgusting is that?! The main ingredient is a corn filler. One thing my vet told me a while back that I never forgot: "When you eat corn, what comes out of the other end? The same thing happens with dogs." Basically, dogs cannot digest corn, it is just a filler and causes them to actually eat more to feel full, poop out more, and retain less nutrients. The only meat in Beneful at all is a by-product, its not even a real meat! By-products are the stuff leftover once all the actual meat is harvested. We're talking beaks, chicken feet, eyeballs, even chicken poop! I would not recommend this product to anyone, for any reason, ever. It is an absolutely awful dog food. I can't believe the pictures of veggies and full chunks of meat on the bag can be allowed to be on the packaging of such a disgusting product; it is very misleading and should be considered false advertising.I recommend to stay far away from Beneful, and most Purina products. When purchasing a dog (or cat) food, the most important thing to consider is the first 3 ingredients; just make sure those first three are decent ingredients that you would eat yourself. Now that I know what to look for,  I usually buy my pets all natural, organic foods such as Blue Buffalo, Halo or Wellness.

I have just started my 15th kit so my experience level is getting up there.  I've done kits from a couple of other companies; Wine Expert, and Vino Vida.  I've bought kits from other online companies, from a local brew hut, and from Amazon.  I'll continue to buy these kits so long as they are selling them at this value.You cannot beat the Vino Italiano Kits.  They are complete with everything, delivered to your door with free shipping, and they make a really good wine.  Let me back up and say first that a wine I like may not be good to someone else.  We each have our own preferences.  I've had many a wine served up at restaurants with price ranges of $10 to $100 a bottle.  And the wine I am making now I like better than pretty much anything I've tasted from the restaurant, or the store.I have tried the Valpolicella, Shiraz, Reisling and the Montepulciano from Vino Italiano.  I have made a couple merlots, some white zinfandels also, but from other companies.  I prefer the reds, and made the others because my kids requested.I'll typically, but not always, spike the kit with additional sugar to up the alcohol content slightly.  If you follow the instructions, the initial specific gravity comes out around 1.080-1.084.  By adding a couple pounds of sugar in the form of corn syrup or simple syrup, you get to around 1.09 or better.  That usually will give a final ABV of 11.5 - 12%.  Other things that I do outside of the kit instructions include adding 1 cup of black oak chips, 1-2 tbsp of vanilla extract, and a lb or two of some black cherries, blue berries or black berries (found in the frozen foods section at the store).  Lastly, I like my wine not so dry, so I'll back sweeten just as I am bottling.  Again using corn syrup and usually between 8 - 16 oz per 6 gallons.  To me the corn syrup seems to be better than simple syrup, but that's just my preference.I love the stuff.  Currently my production is having a hard time keeping up with my consumption.  Cheers.

column9: Jury is out. NOTE- YOU NEED EQUIPMENT TO BREW THIS
column10: This is my second Vino Italiano wine kit. The first was a Cabernet Savignon. I had read reviews of that variety and I ended up making 5 gallons instead of the 6 that the kit calls for. Other reviewers had complained that the Cab was too watery. My adjustment worked out well for the Cab, but for this wine I probably should have bottled the full 6 gallons. Instead, I ended up brewing about 5.2 gallons. The finished wine is very dry and almost has an acetone flavor to it (that's a whole other issue for wine makers and I'm concerned that it might actually be ethyl acetate, but it's hard to tell. It might just be overly acidic due to the high concentration). When I add water to the wine (equal to approx 1/5 the volume of the wine) it mellows out a bit. Other than modifying the total amount of must during primary fermentation, I stuck to the recipe.For the price, it'll be a decent wine if it mellows out a bit in the bottle. As of bottling the wine is highly acidic (but, again, that's probably due to the higher concentration); it has a nice deep rich burgundy color; it's crystal clear with no signs of oxidation or residual sediment. I did not filter but I carefully racked during the final stage to ensure that no sediment made it into the bottles. The jury is still out on this wine, but, overall, I'm still a fan of the Vino Italiano kits. You can't beat the price.Oh, and if you're new to making wine from kits- this kit only includes the ingredients (grape concentrate, additives, plus corks, labels and shrink wrap closures) to make the wine. You will still need to invest another $70, or more, in the wine-making equipment. You will need: A 7 gallon Primary fermenter, 6 gallon carboy, siphon hoses, hydrometer, wine thief, container to hold wine during testing; 30 wine bottles (bottles you drank already work fine, mostly, if sterile and clean); an air lock (inexpensive); sterilizer (campden tablets or "Easy Clean"); a bottle filler (recommended and also cheap) hand corker and, preferably, a brew belt (to maintain proper temperature during primary fermentation). Visit your local home brew shop and they'll show you what you need. Or, visit midwestsupplies.com for mail order supplies. Their prices are competitive. So far I've done 3 kits, made Sangria wine from organic Concord grape juice, and now I'm working on some Cab Sav from juice I picked up at a local vineyard. BEWARE: this is addictive and can be both frustrating and incredibly rewarding. Good luck! P.S. Of the three kits I've done, I've been most happy with the Vintner's Reserve World Vineyard Collection California Red Zinfandel/Shiraz at $80.00. At that price it works out to about $2.75 a bottle (not counting initial equipment costs). So if you're contemplating spending a little extra for a "nicer" kit, I say go for it.

Like most items around town here. I am limited to quality and variety. I was excited to find the Dutch Licorice drops. I ordered quite a bit and put them up.The Licorice drops were delivered in a very timely manner and was very cost effective.Thanks

I buy Country Time Lemonade for my kids to drink in the warm summer months in addition to water. One of the reasons I like this product it that it's easy to make - "just add water."  No looking for a measuring cup or spilling the sugar. There is a handy little scoop included and on the back it gives clear directions on how to mix anything from 1 cup to 2 quarts. For me it is a little sweet when mixed according to package so I tend to add a little water and ice to mine, but it is great on a summer day. I've been purchasing it using Subscribe & Save and find I pay much less than any local store.

I buy this instead of sodas for my family.  It does have sugar, but not High fructose corn syrup, so I think it is better for them.  I don't drink it, but they mix it by the glass or the pitcher.  It's easy to use, and the price here for subscribe and save is about the same price I used to pay at Sam's Club.  Now I don't have to pay warehouse fees and I don't have to drag those heavy cans from the store to my car, from my car into my house.  Amazon delivers it right to my front door!  I'm a happy Amazon customer.

I began ordering this a couple of years ago on a different website for bulk foods. They charged over $20 for one cannister and that didn't include shipping. I found this on the Amazon website and have never looked back. I found it for a better price and its a twofer. Who could ask for more? I have never had a problem with the auto-ship as my family prefers this over the kool-aid and tang I also buy from this website. The product arrives in great condition, it isn't clumpy as you would expect from being exposed to heat or cold when shipping. It keeps well and I don't think the cannister it comes in is bulky at all. But then again I do all bulk shopping since there are 5 of us in my household. The instructions for mixing are clearly printed on the label and a scoop in included in each cannister.
Great product. Surprised that my automatic monthly orders were stopped by whoever. Back to getting it at Cosstco. Service not product my issue.

column9: good product but shipping charge ridiculous!
column10: My kids love this lemonade mix and I can definitely recommend this product. However when I went to buy it from Amazon, the cost of the product (2 82.5 oz canisters) was $13 and the shipping cost was $14.80!  Needless to say I won't buy it from Amazon.

I am not a water drinker.  I have to drink something with flavor.  To ensure I drink more water than soft drinks, I started buying this lemonade & True Lemon crystallized lemon.  Gives the Country Time just the right "pucker".  I go through a canister a month and am happy to get this on scheduled deliveries + 15% off!  Buying that way it's cheaper than Sam's club!

Great taste, but it's bright yellow!  Artificial colors have been banned in Britain and now require a warning label in Europe.  Couldn't they make Country Time Lemonade with natural coloring so that it isn't potentially harmful to our children?  It would also look more like the "real thing".

Taste great and there is alot of it. A bit pricey, but I don't like going to Walmart. One thing though, which is most likely UPS's fault is that one of them busted open and 1/4 of the contents was laying on the carboard the Canisters come packed on. It ended up all over my carpet...
I absolutely love this stuff, but I've found its cheaper (and quicker) to go across the street to Wal-Mart and buy this.
Amazed at how much, a company can get wrong. It looks like lemonade...I received Pink Lemonade! not happy and wasn't told of any changes to my order.

column9: Actually hot chocolate, not chocolate coffee
column10: We love our Nescafe Dolce Gusto coffee machine, and received several  flavors to try out with it.  As mentioned in my review of the machine, we do not typically drink more than one cup of coffee per day.  However, we all love hot chocolate, and I was delighted to find this as one of the flavors to try.It seems a few reviewers are rating this as if it was chocolate flavored coffee, but it is not. Before getting our Dolce Gusto machine, we drank instant hot chocolate made with water.  No more, this product has knocked it out of the running!  While it is not the best hot chocolate I have ever had in my life, it is much better than the instant brand we have used for years.  It's rich, creamy and wonderful.

column9: Tastes like generic Hot Cocoa powder
column10: Length:: 1:06 MinsSee attached video.

While the other Nescafe flavors seemed to be very rich and gourmet tasting, I felt this one needed to go back to the development lab.  To me, it tasted like powdered hot cocoa, and not a very good one at that.  I have tried adjusting the Choc/Milk ratio but didn't find a good taste.  It's a shame because NesCafe has such a good name in Europe where drinking Chocolate is held to a much higher standard than here in the US.  I expected a better product.

This is by far my favorite Dolce Gusto product. The flavor reminds you of typical hot chocolate with a little kick in it..not a straight, sweet hot chocolate...maybe like the difference between milk chocolate and dark chocolate. I liked it. My husband and I almost fought over the last 2 of these in the box! ha ha... I like regular hot chocolate, (even instant too!) but this is a good, slightly different alternative. It is super easy with the machine, too. We will be buying more of these...

I'm hooked on this product.  It's so good, and bad for you that I feel guilty every time I have one. I find this to be a good desert, it's not overwhelming  in chocolate flavor but it's smooth and creamy.  If you want more you can hit it with some chocolate syrup but it's a lot more rich than your typical hot chocolate.Again the price is steep, $1 a cup is hard to justify for a homemade drink.

column9: This is not coffee you dummy, its hot chocolate...
column10: This is my favorite out of the Nescafe flavors.  The nutrition facts deter you a little from wanting to drink it, but I'm sure it's the same as any other chocolate drink you will have.  It has a smooth taste and is enjoyable.  If only I liked the other flavors the same.

I've tried all varieties of Nescafe Dolce Gusto coffee offerings, and this is by far my favorite. To be exact, it's not really even a coffee, more like a frothy hot chocolate drink. Once again, Nescafe has taken out all the guesswork with measuring and mixing - I found the capsules to be the perfect mix, no adjustments needed.Where the drink disappoints is with its nutrition info. Each serving (1 cocoa and 1 milk capsule) has 6 grams of fat and 19 grams of sugar - and it's very hard to drink just one! Perhaps Nescafe will come out with a light or sugar-free version in the future.

My son says this is the best cocoa he's ever had, and I have to admit it's dashed yummy.  But, there are also very good cocoas in foil packets in the supermarket which taste this good.  On the whole an electric kettle and some packets of Land O'Lakes cocoa are just as good as the Dolce Gusto system for cocoa drinks.This is better than the Keurig cocoas.One big caveat:  we thought this could be made on the cold setting for luxurious chocolate milk, but it came out watery and disgusting.  After that, I went back and read the leaflet, and it's not meant to be made cold.  Cocoa only!

column9: The only hor chocolate that actually has milk!
column10: Delicious!!! I also own a Keurig machine and as much as coffe and tea are really good, the chocolate mixes are all watery. This is the first real hot chocolate I get from a machine that uses pods. Try it for yourself, you'll love it. Great Holiday gift, too!

This is the determinator to keep the Dolce Gusto in the beginning since I am a chocolate lover.  The little Dolce Gusto brews gourmet beverages, both hot and cold, period.  Now Dolce Gusto coffee is my a.m. favorite and this Chococino is my night time favorite.  Best price on auto-ship; quick delivery in 2 days from USPS - love it for no fancy packaging.

column9: Least Favorite of the Nescafe Dolce Line
column10: I love the speed and agility, as it were, of the Nescafe Dolce Gusto brewer. I accept the limitations as a trade-off for convenience. I do not like this flavor.Not every product can be translated into a single-cup device. In this case, the process for making the drink is the same for the other two-capsule drinks (cappuccino, latte machiatto and others). However, the goal here is to create a kind of frothy hot chocolate. It does that as it should. The problem is the taste.A good hot chocolate earns its designation by using good chocolate and good milk. This provided neither. It tastes artificial on every level.At least the coffee products they offer use real coffee. Those resemble more of a better version of a gas station cappuccino. The Chococino resembles hot chocolate made from Count Chocula cereal.--Brockeim

I had high hopes for this hot chocolate mix, but found it just O.K. It tastes what it is: a mid-priced instant, just-add-water cocoa. I like the convenience of using the Dolce Gusto machine and so will probably buy more of this for convenience sake, but as far as taste goes, I will probably continue to make and serve milk-based for guests or for myself when I want somethng that is worth the calories.

I have heard other reviewers comment that this tastes like instant cocoa powder to them, but I have to disagree. Personally, I feel it has a rich chocolate taste granted it is not as rich as a coffee house, but for something you brew at home it is really fantastic and has a lot more flavor than instant cocoa. I have to let consumers know this is hot chocolate and not mocha flavored coffee so if you are looking for mocha coffee you have the wrong flavor. I drink more coffee than I do hot chocolate but both me and my husband love this!
I love all the Dolce Gusto milky drinks and this one is no exception.  Good chocolate taste with just the right amount of milky foam.
Bought it thinking it was a chocolate type cappuccino .but great hot chocolate not too too sweet. Very creamy too.

Wow. I realize that this product must be going away as you can no longer find most of the coffees for the Dolce Gusto Machine at any of the stores.  I ordered these on-line because my kids enjoy the hot chocolate from the Gusto and they are easy to make.  I did not think that I would be sent 3 boxes that expire in approximately 3 months!  I have not idea exactly what that means (it says best by). So maybe it won't matter if we use it past the date of 7/12? The idea was to buy this many so that they would last a long time.  The taste of the hot chocolate is very good though.
very rich creamy and full of choc taste. Love one before bed,and yes,it does help with sleeping.This is so easy to prepare,and so satisfying.If you like hot coco, you'll love this.

column9: Kid can make his own hot chocolate
column10: I love my dolce gusto.  Coffee is great but my 4 year old can make his own hot chocolate without risk of serious burn.  The coco is hot just none of the stove or microwave issues.  Not too sweet either.
Awesome tatste just like all the other pods for this machine. Who needs Starbucks when you can have this in your home.

I think that this has to be one of the best Dolce Gusto Pods, as I have tried almost every variety they have. The taste reminds me of getting hot chocolate in Europe! The Chococino pod is versatile as you can add coffee  or espresso to this drink to make a yummy mocha. I Being a former Barista and  Espresso bar owner I have tasted my fair share of drinks and rank this product high on my list of yummy tasting beverages.  I highly recommend this product.
The product is really good. The only bad thing is that when I try to re-order it you guys don't ship to Puerto Rico no more.

I bought the Nescafe Dulce Gusto coffee brewer through Amazon and now I buy the capsules through Amazon, as I can't find them to buy locally.  I love being able to make my own cafe mocha and not have to spend the time and money to go to the special coffee store.  Well worth getting! Nescafe Dolce Gusto for Nescafe Dolce Gusto Brewers, Chococino, 16-Count Capsules (Pack of 3)
great flavor, easy to make, great tatste every time, good cocoa flavor, i add a littel bit of sugar, i love it in the afternoon!

I had high hopes for this as I like even the powdered hot chocolate mix. It tastes okay, just not good enough to continue to buy. I did make one cup as directed but stirred in a powdered hot chocolate mix and it tasted really good (better than either one individually) I do suggest you try that if you are not impressed with the taste.
I didn't know what the Chococino was until I tried it!!It was just a hot chocolate, but good one!If you have kids and they want to enjoy the coffee w/ you, you can make chococino for them~!

This was the first flavor I tried, and has easily become my second favorite (first favorite being the Mocha flavor).It's great for the kids too - they love that they can have a drink out of the Dolce Gusto machine.
Not a huge cocoa fan. This is okay tasting. It seemed a little powdery and dry and again, I got an odd aftertaste.

column9: Best tasting Hot Chocolate on the market
column10: One again Nescafe Dolce Gusto pods have a winner. Usually I'm only a fan of Hot Chocolate in the Fall/Winter BUT because of the ease of use of the Dolce Gusto Machine and the superb taste of this Hot Chocolate! So rich and smooth I think I'll go make a cup in a few minutes!

In terms of taste, this is perfectly acceptable, though one can make milk-based hot chocolate from scratch that tastes much better.However, you are paying for convenience:  it's a lot easier (and faster) to mix this, especially for a group, in the Krups machine than it is to boil milk!

As I write this, we're headed into summer heat. The only reason that's disappointing is it's harder to find an excuse to make this hot chocolate!Since you make it in the Dolce Gusto machine you'd think it has coffee in it, but it does not. It's just a frothy rich hot chocolate. If you're a chocolate fan, you owe it to yourself to check this out.

Chococino is a wonderful concoction of hot fluffy, foamy, sweetened milk and rich hot chocolate.  The Dolce Gusto machine really nails this one. It is quick and easy to make and even easier to drink.  For those who enjoy hot chocolate, Chococino is highly recommended.

column9: Rich milk chocolate flavor comes at a cost!
column10: I really wasn't prepared to like this flavor capsule for the Dolce Gusto. Considering I've been underwhelmed with the Green Mountain Coffee Hot Cocoa k-cups for my Keurig B40 Elite Gourmet Single-Cup Home-Brewing System, I was not expecting this to be much better.On the contrary, the cocoa is sweet, milky, smooth, and flavorful. But, at 150 calories and 89 cents per serving on Amazon subscribe & save, this is not too much of a bargain. For the occasional cup of cocoa this fits the bill, but if you have children around who like to drink a lot of cocoa and invite their friends over for it, this can get pricey. Green Mountain Coffee Hot Cocoa on the other hand is only 60 calories and 54 cents per serving.

This was supposed to be chocolate? This was awful. It tasted old, dry, and bitter. I didn't even detect chocolate. I tried 3 capsules to be sure I didn't get a defective one. The date on the box was far into the future so it hadn't expired.I was quite disappointed and don't find this to have any enjoyable taste - coffee or chocolate in flavor.

column9: Make your own. It tastes better!
column10: Of all the Dolcue Gusto flavors, this is the one I like the least. It's not that there's anything wrong with hot chocolate, it's just that you can do a lot better than this attempt. If you like hot cocoa from normal powdered mixes, then this is a slight step up. But it's not creamy enough! I'd recommend just making your own cocoa at home from scratch. You'll be more pleased with the results. This one's not worth 150 calories.2/5

This is the family Fave!  My entire family drank this Chococino in 2 days!  Easy to make and extremely tasty!  Put in the milk packet first then add the chocolate.  Delicious!  Keep any eye on the machine, however, as you must manually stop it when you've made your Chococino to your liking.

column9: The Only Hot Chocolate My Household Will Make From Now On
column10: The beverage flowing from Dolce Gusto's Chococino pods is a great cup of hot chocolate. I have not had better "instant" hot chocolate. The flavor is comparable to that coming from some of the more expensive packet-based mixes, but with none of the heating, stirring, clumping, and residue at the bottom of the cup.What I love about the Dolce Gusto that showed itself well with this beverage is the simplicity & cleanliness. Whenever I make myself hot chocolate, I will inevitably drop powder on the counter or spill all over the cup while I'm stirring. Dolce Gusto is simple, clean, and quick.The cost, however, must be considered. The chococino (like the cappucino  and the latte macchiatto) takes two pods: a milk pod and a flavor pod. At Amazon's current pricing, that makes each beverage just more than one dollar apiece. This is worth it for me compared to the cheaper cost of the mixes because we drink hot chocolate so infrequently. Compared to the cost of Starbucks hot chocolate, this is a bargain. But the cost is certainly not negligible if you drink it often.Chococino will likely be the only hot chocolate made in my house from now on.

column9: Great product...good deal compare to stores
column10: I purchased the Dolce Gusto machine and my first few boxes at Bed Bath and Beyond.  signed up for the subscription and saved a lot. Each cup costs me roughly $1.06 but on amazon its only about 89 cents. These prices are certainly a lot cheaper than Starbucks. Why pay more if you can really save and have them shipped to your door? I love the subscribe & save program and i'm so glad these are a part of it! The chococino is basically a rich, frothy hot chocolate. It is always a hit when we have company over!
I love having the automatic shipments, along with the notifications of their shipment so I don't panic.
I purchased this mistakenly, thinking that it was KCups. I have to mix it with hot water. While it is tastey, it is not worth the purchase of it's own machine.

I tried these out and imagine to my surprise that only one capsule had chocolate inside.Just like another flavor I tried, only hot milk appeared.Once again I must ask the question. Do these people not have any quality control?I love the machine, but I would like coffee or chocolate in the cup!

Everyone's tastes are different. With that said, I would definitely recommend trying these first. I tried Nescafe Chococino pods (along with some other flavors) in the machine I bought that uses these pods. Really wanted to like them but they were AWFUL. Bitter, synthetic--like something from a vending machine. The Dolce Gusto espresso/cappuccino/latte maker has been returned to Amazon; unfortunately, the pods are a grocery item so not eligible for return. I have two boxes--50 dollars' worth--of the cappuccino pods sitting in the box they arrived in--feel like I put fifty bucks into my office shredder. Bottom line is, should have tried them before ordering any equipment/pods off the internet. Save your cash--try them first!

Quality  of this product is good, my only issue is with the size. I purchased another one of the same brand at a cake decorating store. It was 4x the size  or this product and it was less expensive than this one. Won't be purchasing this from Amazon again.

column9: Mediocre at best...acceptable for the price.
column10: I started using Amazon groceries to order various healthy snacks directly sent to me in the office.  It has paid off enormously as I am in great shape eating lots of high energy food (low/ no sugar) throughout the day and this lets me a very light lunch.That being said I guess I was expecting more from these when I ordered them off of Amazon groceries.  The price was right but the biggest problem for these is that they are kind of tasteless.  You really need to eat them with something else.  The other major problem is that they come all broken and at best 20% of the crackers are intact.  You really end up eating the box as a "cracker chips".  Also the box has no clasps or folds so there is no way to actually close the thing which isn't exactly a bastion for freshness...Bottom Line:  They are alright and if your expectations are prepared before getting these you might be surprised.

I gave these 3 stars because I really like the flavor of these crackers, but as stated in many of the other reviewers' comments, they don't hold up in shipping, so for the packaging, I would only give them about 1 star.  I actually purchased 18 boxes (3 cases), 6 each of the 3 flavors and I had to open all 18 boxes to just get enough "whole" crackers for my guests (8 people) for Thanksgiving appetizers.  I could only get about 6-8 crackers per box that were not broken literally into crumbs.  I did, however, contact the factory and they were very apologetic and said they will address the problem and offered to send me additional boxes.  Hopefully these will arrive in better condition and they will get the problem resolved, because I would love to keep purchasing these crackers.

I agree with the first reviewer, that they are mostly broken up pieces. Approx 15% may be whole & intact. I also agree that they should have packaged them in a reclosable bag, especially since they are not manufactured with a strong preservative.I had low expectations for them before I took the first bite so I was v-e-r-y pleasantly surprised. They taste just like ritz crackers to me but without all the unhealthy additives & preservatives. The taste may be a little more mild, but it was still distinctly ritz to my taste buds.-On the plus side: Tasty! Multigrain; Not too much salt; Low sugar (2g/srvg); No Hydrogenated oils; Organic; No saturated fat nor trans fat.-On the down side: contains milk & wheat; Only 5oz per box (says 5 servings/bag but it was only 2 servings for me); 80-85% of crackers are broken even in an intact box.Obviously, our taste buds vary so I can't assure anyone they will agree with my verdict. But I personally enjoyed them & will purchase more despite the minuses.Hope that helps

thought I would try this product with my 3 finicky cats to upgrade their diet nutritionally from the commercial cat food that I can afford to buy. wanted to try better quality wet food but it's cost prohibitive so I bought this.  all 3 actually like it and eat the whole can of food--usually I'm throwing out some of it the next morning.  will keep using this product because I feel better about feeding commercially while boosting their nutrition; plus they like it!!!!!

The good part about this cornmeal is that it is organic - so you can hope there are no GMOs in  your evening polenta. The bad things about it is that a) its texture is too fine for polenta (which is why I purchased it in the first place); and b) it is BITTER. I am not sure if only my batch was bad (I did get 12 packs and I am only making my way through the third), or if it's something related to the type of corn they use, but the result is bitter. Only if I boil it for an hour, which is excessive, is the bitterness somewhat reduced. I will not be buying this brand again.
I buy this whole grain cornmeal in a health grocery store.  This stuff is hearty and delicious.  I wouldn't even consider another brand.  If you like yellow corn, you'll be in heaven.
no problem with the delivery and quality of the product.i'm reordering as soon as it's almost done.
I order this because I know it has no GMO's and is whole corn. Once you try real corn meal you won't be happy with the degerminated stuff you get in the store.
This is Dutch type licorice, made with licorice root and not anise. It is the firm type licorice, very stiff, and in the traditional cat shape. It has a vague saltiness, not very pronounced.

I have been looking for this type of licorice near and far.  It is very reminiscent of a licorice that I ate as a child that was circular and dome shaped.  I really like it.  It is noit too salty for me as some are.  Highly recommended by me!

They were indeed hard, perhaps slightly stale?(compared to american licorice)But I don't know, having never been to the Netherlands, what they are supposed to be like.They do soften up after a bit, and do taste great, very natural.They are a hit with my friends who have tried them.and are GLUTEN FREE!  Hooray.I wish for a smaller package order size ;-)

They have a good flavor and you get a good number of them.  If considering them you should know they are on the harder side.  Not harder like they will crack your teeth, but harder like it takes a minute or two to chew each one.  Stiff might be a more appropriate description
Licorice Cats =  YUM  Nice & hard.  Rich flavor, not too sweet. My only complaint?  They are gone too soon.

I am a licorice lover, and have been looking for a change from the run-of-the-mill locorices that one can find in stores. I've tasted licorice cats at a specialty store before and I was hoping it was the same--and it is! I am very pleased with the order--and the price--comes out to a little over one dollar for a 5.2oz bag (12 of them in an order). The candy is just soft enough to be chewy but not too soft to be mushy and sticky. It is just sweet enough to be delicoous witohut the sweetness taking over, and the licorice flavor is amazing. I've shared some packages with like-loving friends, and they are all raving about it and now want to order their own batch! Highly recommended.
The Licorice flavor is great. I thought they were too hard to chew right out of the bag. I had to put some in my pocket to soften them up a bit before eating.
My granddaughters love these. I like them too. They are not too hard nor too sticky. I bought these over other brands because they do not contain Corn Sugar or Corn Syrup. For me that is a plus.

column9: Finally!! I've found my childhood favorite at a reasonable price!
column10: I grew up LOVING the Venco Black Cats. It was always a treat to buy a bag or two...but, that's all I'd allow myself because they were so pricey. Looking on Amazon for my favorite sweet, I came across Gustaf's and the reviews convinced me to try them. THANK GOODNESS I did. The very initial taste was that they were ever so slightly different from Venco. However, after working my way through a few bags, that difference is no longer there or evident. These are every bit as good. So much so, I ordered a 2nd dozen only 2 days after receiving the first dozen. They have the right sweetness, chewiness and hardness. Now...if I could only find a Salmiak Passtilen that is like what Venco used to make, I'd be all set!
Great licorice flavor, firm and not too salty. This product was exactly what I wanted and with several bags they can be opened 1 at a time and enjoyed slowly.
Firm but chewy black licorice with great flavor. I love black licorice and have been trying different gluten free options. I will be ordering more of this one.
The wife loves them.  Tasty with a bit of chew.  The dogs like them too, but haven't provided feedback on the taste.

I gave up on licorice after See's Candy quit making the dome-shaped, diamond imprinted licorice pieces. Nothing else was remotely comparable. Finally, though, there's Gustaf's Traditional Dutch licorice cats. Buy lots!

I have never been a fan of black licorice ---- until I tried these ! These are the perfect balance of licorice flavor and sweetness. I also like that they are very firm so I suck on them awhile before I chew them up. These little black cats are perrrrrrfect.
One of the better licorices that I have tasted and I have tasted a lot. Great quality product that should be experienced.

Living in Panama, I found there is no licorice except a few stores in Panama City. We live about 6 hours West of PC, in the mountains, and there is no licorice here. In fact, there are very few sweets here.I have chosen to import 10 pounds per month to sustain my need for a delectable treat.Gustaf's Dutch Licorice Cats are the perfect treat! I share them with my friends, who have never tasted licorice, yet they know anise very well as it is a popular spice. I have only found a few locals who are not thrilled to receive a licorice treat when they visit.
I don't know if I got a bad or old batch, but these things were so hard that you can actually hear a crunch sound as you bite into them.  That's not my ideal candy style.

This is real licorice that you can get in europe (not limited to holland). The licorice has a bit of a taste of something else in it I can't really pinpoint but it's great to be able to get real licorice candy.  This licorice is mildly sweet.

column9: good stuff ... brings me back to my dutch herritage ...
column10: i like these ... the drops ... and the coins ... i always get a 'box' of each ... lasts me a while lol ...

Great licorice.  I am German and have been looking for this style of licorice for a very long time.  It has a very different texture and flavor as compared to the American style licorice.  If you have ever ate licorice in Europe and you liked it - this product is it.  A blast of licorice flavor that is smooth and can be eaten almost like hard candy.  And it shipped super fast!  Thank you!
I love black licorice, but I have to say, I'll be giving these away. The flavor is fine, but the licorice is very dry. Most of the licorice I enjoy (e.g., Kookaburra) has some natural oils in it.

column9: Just like I purchased at the Amsterdam airport.
column10: Good, chewy, not too salty not too sweet.
They almost to the stale side. Not recommended. Should have read the review before purchase. Thinking might return. Glad my sister didn't wait till Christmas to open.

My husband and I love the Chocolove raspberry bar and had never seen this coffee flavor before we came across it recently at a health food store.  It is amazing!  It is mocha to the max, containing tiny bits of ground coffee beans.  The wrapper indicates that each bar is equal to about 3 cups of coffee. The company uses smooth, belgian chocolate that is delish!  The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is because I would have preferred that the chocolate was fair trade certified, ensuring a fair wage for the chocolate producers and helping to ensure that the bar is slave-labor free (a large problem especially with cocoa beans from the Ivory Coast).
We use this in smoothies with Frozen X-plosion drink base and in recipes. The kids like it! It also can stay open on the counter for a long time as it is shelf-stable.

is what my husband said this coffee reminds him of.  He likes a mid (not strong) taste.  I don't drink coffee hot. My idea of coffee is a wonderful smell in the morning that I will make and add to a latte or I guess I mean a chocolate/coffee smoothie that I make at home.  This one suits that bill.  It is a full flavor to me or strong.  I believe it would even make a second cup if I so desired.Would I pay a huge amount for it?  No, I think this coffee is relatively expensive. There are only 15 pods in the box and it happens to have Marley on the box.  Is that the reason for the cost or is pod coffee just expensive?Since I don't have a pod machine I boiled a cup of water and added it to the pod in a cup with a spoon holding it down.  Worked well for me.Good coffee but not worth what they want for it.

column9: convenient, low-acid, but a bit weak
column10: The first thing that hit me is that these appear to be a low-acid gype of coffee....I didn't get that icky feeling some coffees give you after you drink them.  That is a definite plus.  But the coffee itself isn't that strong either.  I'm not into Kona or really deep flavors, I like just a medium blend.  But this still seemed weak.  It almost came across as coffee-tea than a strong cup of joe.I don't think I'd order this particular blend again.

I had never used these coffee pods before and used them in my coffee maker without a filter.  I was really expecting the coffee to smell great when it was brewing, but maybe it is to mild.  If you like milder breakfast type coffee or chai tea you will love this coffee.  I added a little light cream and it was very good, be careful with the cream it needs very little.  My first cup I put to much light cream and it overpowered the drink.  I would buy this again, it is something nice to give as a gift or serve to company.

. . .A little fussy about my coffee, and this coffee did not disappoint me.  It has a rich flavor, I can control the strength by adding or substracting the amount of water I use (which you can do wih all coffees, I know).
