I like this product and Delighted to have it:1. Delivered to my door.2. the 8 oz size.I sometimes only use 1-2 OZ (25-50 ML) as a coffee additive. (Both flavors)Like the Chicken broth here, getting 8 OZ boxes is GREAT! No throwing away spoiled product.The net cost looks higher per 0z/ml and no waste means a lower per unit cost and no sour mental feelings about wasting food.

I buy these crackers all the time and this batch was not consistent with what I have bought in the past.They were over toasted, hence did not have the same flavor. Still good but I think they sent you "seconds".

This cracker is tasty, healthy, and delicious with peanut butter, hummus, other spreads, with salad, and on its own.  My kids love them. All Back to Nature products are good quality, tasty products that I feel good about feeding to my family and myself.

column9: Good cracker but not what I was looking for
column10: This cracker was good but not exactly what I was hoping it would be. I was looking for something more healthy than the typical cracker which was why I bought it. The cracker by itself would be a good snack on its own, but I think the flax seed may make it a bit oily so when I paired it with cheese it didn't really work.

column4: Michelle K. Westenbroek "Can't live without b...
column10: One of the best crackers for crackers with cheese or just for munching,  Not salty, like a lot of crackers.  Enough flavor to enhance the cheese but not so much that it overwhelms.  Sounds like a cliche, but it really is a healthy cracker that tastes good.

column9: Back to Nature Multigrain Flax Seeded Flatbread Crackers - 5.5 oz.
column10: The crackers are made in Madison, WI by Back to Nature Foods Co.--made in the USA.I have a difficult time eating just a few crackers.  These are the best crackers I've ever tasted.They actually don't taste much like crackers.  They taste like fresh baked flatbread.  The texture is fresh and crunchy.The seeds get in your teeth but they're worth it.  This is a large hearty rectangle shaped cracker with seeds throughout.The crackers taste great eaten alone or with dips and toppings.The crackers contain unbleached enriched flour (wheat flour, niacin, reduced iron, thiamine mononitrate (vitamin B1), riboflavin (vitamin B2), folic acid) whole wheat flour, unbleached wheat flour, safflower oil, golden flax seed, cornstarch, whole grain millet, potato starch, brown rice syrup, brown flax seed, whole grain triticale, whole grain barley flakes, whole grain rye, whole grain rolled oats, evaporated cane juice, malted barley extract, sea salt, leavening (backing soda, monocalcium phosphate), garlic powder, parsley, onion powder, and vitamin E.The box has 6 servings (3 pieces).  Each serving is 120 cal., 4.5 g fat, 1.5 g polyunsaturated fat, 2.5 g monounsaturated fat, 90 mg sodium, 65 mg potassium, 18 g carbs, 2 g fiber, 2 g sugars, and 2 g protein.The package states that the crackers contain no artifical preservatives, flavors, or colors and no hydrogenated oils.I give these crackers 5/5 for flavor, 5/5 for freshness and texture, 5/5 for quality of size, 5/5 for environmental consideration, and 0/5 for truth in labeling--thiamine mononitrate is synthetic B1.The package is made from 100% recycled paperboard and the co. supports the Nature Convervancy--protecting nature, preserving life.
They taste great and until you read the label you wouldn't know of the 1st ingredient, white flour. I thought this was a 100% whole grain product but found otherwise.

These are a perfect balance of savory herbs and crunchiness.  I tend to like my crackers dry (eg, Saltines), but these have just the right amount of fat without being overly oily (like Ritz or full fat Triskets).  I ate them with hummus, and I was in heaven.Note that I bought these at a local store.  I don't know how well they ship.
These are tasty snacks that are healthy for you.  They're a bit pricey unless you buy them on sale and in bulk.
These things are delicious but keep in mind that your UPS driver will probably punt them toward your front door. Fine with me because cracker pieces taste exactly like crackers.
If one is seeking the very best flatbread/cracker in the universe, this is it.  Low fat and high fiber is just a plus.  A must for every health concerned pantry.
Great tasting cracker sort of like eating Potato Chips....can't just eat a few!
I really like these crackers because they are multigrain, vegan, and 'more natural' than their competitors. However, I really wish Back to Nature would go organic on all of their products. :(

column9: Tastes more like medicine that pomegranate
column10: I was excited to see an all-natural soda at my drugstore made with cane sugar instead of high fructose corn syrup, but one taste of this was all it took to decide never to buy this again. I like pomegranate juice and expected to like this soda, but it did tasted more like medicine than soda.All the cans in the store were dented and some were leaky. The aluminum is very thin and all the sodas got partially crushed and damaged during shipment. This is something to consider when ordering.
Pomegranate is one of the best fruits to eat, only makes sense it would make a great soft drink; and it does. Children will love this soda. The Cane sugar gives it a wonderful after taste.

column9: great treat for the 2 legged people
column10: Love this candy for an occasional treat but they were too hard and difficult to chew.  Did not send back because I thought they would soften up.

i received my orchid in great condition and quickly, however it's SO VERY TINY... it's going to be at least two years for blooms i'm sure, and for the price i wished i would have just gone to my local nursery...

I'm a bit of a tea junky- not a snob by any means, but I know when a tea offers a lot of flavor- and this is certainly it.I wouldn't recommend it to someone who, perhaps, doesn't like ginger- because the ginger can be a bit more overpowering than the orange.  Still, it's a great evening drink, as it is naturally decaffeinated. (makes me want to run to the kitchen and make some right now!) It has a nice aroma and the tea flavor is pretty mellow.Each tea bag is individually sealed in it's own foil bag- so each bag stays very fresh until use.And the seller? Well, my order came pretty quickly, the tea was well packaged (no dents, etc) in the box. No complaints.As I mentioned- I'm a bit of tea freak- with probably 8-10 different kinds in my pantry at all times. I'm ordering my next two boxes now, because I don't think I can live without this tea!If you like ginger, orange and tea- this is a nice addition to your stock.
This is a nice tea. When I make a pot of tea I tend to blend several different teas and spices and this tea added a nice mild flavor to my brew.  I would order again.

I really like all the other Green Sprouts products, but these are a no-go. Both the spoon and fork were broken easily by my 9 month-old baby. The spoon he easily snapped in half and the fork was shattered by him pounding it on the high chair tray. Luckily I was right there because the utensils broken and shattered into small pieces that were very sharp. I think they could be very dangerous if he swallowed a shard or put the broken end in his mouth. I would not recommend these at all. Instead try the Green Sprouts silicone toddler spoon. It is soft and flexible and has not yet broken for me.
These pine nuts were so good that I am buying another 3 pounds.  Definitely the best I have ever tasted.

This item arrived in a reasonable amount of time but instead of individual pound bags, it came in one large bag.The nuts themselves have been fine, however.  They taste fine in our recipes and even straight up.  We usuallyput them in pesto this time of year and it has worked out great.
I received this product within the expected time.  Product was fresh and the price was excellent!  Great company to deal with.

I.LOVE.THESE!!!!  Yes, I will purchase these again.  I have bought pinenuts from Whole Foods Grocery with less quality than these.  I'm very pleased.  I freeze the ones that I am not using because I think that all nuts, like oil, could go rancid.  I love these on salad, in pesto, and just mixed with raisins.  Great quality and great price!

Very soothing flavor. I know they say, "...feels like a dentist cleaning after chewing it..." but this one is the closest to making that statement true.  I usually don't leave comments on seemingly trivial items but this gum was good enough to take the time and recommend.
I bought this just on a lark. Now I think it is my favorite gum flavor. Very interesting and refreshing. It has a long-lasting flavor. similar to the taste you have after brushing your teeth.

This flavor is perfect, mild yet sweet and minty and refreshing and it's the perfect balance of all those. I gave one to my friend and he was surprised and said "This gum is delicious," and when we had to throw it out to eat something, he said it still hadn't lost its flavor! As long as this gum is made I will be buying this whitemint flavor. :)
This gum is so awesome, I don't know what I am going to do when I can't get it anymore. I am keeping my fingers crossed that the Limited Edition is not so limited. HIGHLY redommend!

column9: Shaun "The Egg" White lays another egg
column10: As you might expect from the world's most annoying athlete, another awful ad campaign.  Disgusting.  "Sell out" is probably one of the most overused phrases of the past 20 years, but despite this, Mr. White still continues to find new and creative ways to ruin his credibility and appear more and more like some sort of bizarre caricature of his own fame.  Maybe Sal Masakela will chew whitemint; count me out.
not going to say it was terrible but there was no maple or bacon flavor to this coffee. Other than that it was ok.

Ordered these for Valentine's Days plans which never panned out, so I had them all to myself, and I think I got the better end of the deal.They were sent rather promptly, and arrived quickly. The packaging was intact, and there was only a slight dent on the top of the truffles from the packaging, but they were not some ball of gooey dough or anything.As for size, they're slightly smaller than a golfball, so be sure to have a sweet tooth before you order. Taste-wise, they're rather good. The cocoa is not overwhelming, and you can certainly taste the chocolate underneath. There's also enough of each truffle to give you a satisfying feel after eating one, as opposed to some of the smaller packaged truffles where you eat a dozen and only then realize half the box is gone, one of these at a time will do.The only real Con I can think of, is that I still tasted a bit of whichever oil they used to sure up the truffle (safflower, coconut, etc.), and it slightly took away from the chocolaty taste.However, don't let that stop you too much. They were plenty chocolaty, and I mean chocolaty, not loaded with sugar.For the price I ordered them at (around $3 I believe), they were a great little treat, and I've been remiss about letting the review go so long.If you have a few spare bucks to spoil yourself and don't mind waiting for shipping, grab these, or order the bigger pack. You won't be disappointed unless you're looking for the absolute top-quality truffles (in which case, you'll be spending ten times the amount).

This is a great product. Easy to drink, nice taste that reminds me of almonds, nutty taste. I enjoy it unsweetened. Very effective, one week, along with a more natural diet, and my blood pressure has lowered 20 + points. But most remarkable is this company's shipping. Extremely fast shipping.

This product seems to work, but for me it is a maintanance thing, it's not a normal tea taste for me, but it's drinkable for the benefits that it provides. This is about the right price within about 10 or 20 cent of the local shops, so I can just go on-line order and it comes right to the front door.

O M G!!! These are the most delicious, addictive treat EVER!! I had to fight my husband off of the package -- HE DOES NOT EAT MARSHMALLOWS!! Forget milk and honey or ambrosia -- give me THESE! Make sure you buy more than one pack, especially if you plan to eat with others around.

column9: A big hit at my workplace.
column10: Everyone who has tried these things loves them. The only problem with them is they are gone, so I keep buying more. No more freebies! Lol!  The problem with marshmallows is they are eaten too quickly, but mabye all that fluff is not much sugar? Anyway these taste great, I think I prefer the pineapple a little more, but mango is really good. I always buy them at 711. They have mango in the center, and a slight mango flavor to the marshmallow I think. What a great idea, I wonder what they would be like if you roasted them haha!

Our Bichon really likes these little treats. We use them as a potty treat.  We like that there are no artificial colors, flavors or preservatives.The reason I'm not giving this product a 5 is I'm not quite sure what it means when the package labeling states "manufactured in the USA."  It's unclear to me whether that means all the products used in the treat also are original to the USA.  Since the labeling is unclear, I'm not willing to give it a 5 until I know more.  What I do know is giving my pet treats from China is risky to his long-term health (go to dogaware.com to read articles from dog experts on treats from China).

They don't print the ingredients here, but this is top notch stuff.  95% meat, no grain.  Just as importantly, my cats really enjoy it.  Also, it is listed here as 6oz, which is incorrect, it's actually 6.5 (significantly bigger than the usual 5.5oz canned catfood cans).

My girl cat has a very sensitive system and will frequently get diarrhea. I've had her on multiple foods, both Rx and high quality natural food, and still had to mix pumpkin in to get her bowels under control. Both of my cats are also overweight, so finding food that was both low cal and wouldn't upset my girl cat's tummy was a pain in the butt. I compared this food to some of the more expensive brands (twice as much per case) and the ingredients are identical. Each can has 150 kcals, so I feed my cats a can each per day. It's been a month and there have been no tummy issues, they are both slimming down, and their coats are nice and shiney. Very happy customer!

column4: these pretzels r making me thirsty
column9: Good but not what I was expecting
column10: I ordered these as a gift for someone because they wanted the old fashioned Mars bars that they used to sell in the U.S. the kind with the nougat, almonds and caramel.  We had heard the U.K. bars were the closest to that formula.  This candy bar tastes good but it has no almonds and the nougat is more chocolately.  If you're looking for a candy bar similar to a milky way, this might do the trick.  Was so excited, thought I had found the good old fashioned Mars bars.

column9: product fine, seller not worth it
column10: the seller should be ashamed to have sold all 24 mars bars that i ordered with their best by date only 28 days away. my boyfriend loves mars bars, when we are in the u.k. he eats one a day, and the expiration date doesn't matter, but this was meant to be a present to last a few months, maybe most of the year.  it is unbelievably frustrating that any professional company wouldn't rotate their stock, or consider the quality of the product they are shipping.  did they fall of a truck?  the mars bars are fine, for now. its the seller that you should avoid.  no excuses.

I'm guessing you probably already know what a mars bar is, so let's just assume you like 'em. Not a whole lot else to say. If you haven't had an English style mars bar before, I would say that they're one of they're one of the nicer candy bars out there. Well worth trying for anyone who considers themselves a connoisseur of fine junk foods! Do be aware though that judging by some of the other reviews posted, they're NOT quite the same as the mars bars that some buyers may have been expecting.While prices do fluctuate, as of the time of writing this package of 24 will wind up costing you just a fraction under $1.42 a bar. Amazon does sell these bars in packs of more than 24, and bigger the pack you buy, the better deal you get. So if you are able to find a deal that translates as good value from where you sit (and especially if you qualify for free shipping), this seems as good a place as any to buy your chocolate fix. If not, hey, look elsewhere.I took a star off because... Well, just the obvious. Mars bars are bad for you, duh! So please, enjoy in moderation ;-)Theo.

column9: Mars Bars are in a class by themselves
column10: My 91 year old father has been eating Mars Bars for years.  Recently he was admitted to a rehab center for a long rehab.  We purchase Mars Bars for him, 24 at a time.  He savors them, one per day, and has introduced me to them.  They are just tastier than any other candy bar I've tried in recent years.  Highly recommended!
I never recieved the Mars Bars that were ordered. I am very disappointed of the service. I'd like to ask for a refund.

column9: Best GF Brownies in a box!!
column10: Best brownies we have tried so far - from a mix! They get flaky on top like gluten brownies! Worth the extra money...

column9: Don't miss the gluten at all!
column10: I made these for a gluten-free friend after she broke her ankle. After she tasted them, she professed her undying love for me and these brownies. I tried them too - they were wonderful! Very rich and chocolatey without the chalky taste gluten-free baked goods have sometimes. I highly recommend this brownie mix!
These taste like a hot dog with mustard.  They were perfect for our BBQ.  We couldn't refill them fast enough!

This is probably the 3rd time I have ordered Post Alpha-Bits.  The service was excellent, and arrived fast!  I will definitely continue to order the cereal, as I have always liked it since I was a kid.

Post Alpha-Bits Cereal, 11.5-oz. Boxes (Pack of 6) i was happy to find this product online since i can't find it in the stores locally. ordering off the internet has made my life sooooooooo much easier.

column9: Fantastic taste on the grill or as a condiment
column10: I picked this up from a local grocery store and am hooked. It's just spicy enough to leave a tingle on your lips, and the mix of spices is superb. I prefer this to typical BBQ sauces. It must be the allspice and cloves.

These snails are of a satisfactory quality at an absolutely inexpensive price. The reason for the lower rating in the stars is that, despite the fact that they are advertised as very clean I frequently have found grit and bits of shell, not enough to be off putting, but enough that I would not have wanted to serve them to company. The other complaint is the non advertised inclusion of pepper, not enough to be hot but just enough to create a bit of a bitter taste, even with rinsing. I have found the 12 ounce cans of giant snails, of this same brand a much better texture, freer of grit and even though a bit more expensive worth the price. At an even better level are the helix escargot if you really want to taste a higher quality.These do not have to be stuffed into shells, I simply put them in a small oven proof bowl, after rinsing well and shaking the water off in a colandar - with chives, garlic, bits, a tiny bit of garlic salt and place pats of butter on top, pop them into a 375 degree oven for 15 minutes and they are ready.Hopefully one thing that has improved and that I did not make part of the qualification for my review was the packing, it was done very poorly and many of the cans were dented on the bottom - they were replaced, but be sure to check your whole package if you order them.

I bought a case of these before Christmas on a 20% off promotion.  I gave away a few cans as "stocking stuffers" but mostly we just ate them!  WONDERFUL.  This is a very reliable brand, perfectly tender and fresh.  The "very large" size is the perfect size for my escargot dishes and would also fit perfectly in smaller white mushroom caps.  I've kept my leftover "snail butter" (butter, shallots, garlic, parsely and cognac!) in the frig and we'll enjoy another can of these for Valentines Day with a fresh baguette.  Try them...you won't be disappointed and your guests will be blown away.  A whole CASE of these could be less than you'd pay for the same old/same old cheese,cold cuts, and chips for a single party.  Plan on six snails per person -- very rich.

The only reason there are four stars instead of five is that one of the ingredients is black pepper which was not listed on the ingredients of the product on line.  Some of us are not supposed to eat black pepper.The snails themselves are quite nice with excellent texture and flavor, and the price was right.  We eat snails regularly, mostly in the traditional snail garlic butter, tossed with Tinkyada brand rice pasta.  That makes a delicious meal without the bother of stuffing snail shells and washing the things afterwards.

I am not someone who will eat  snails very often, but I decided to try a simple recipe with these snails and a garlic sauce. It was extremely easy to make and the snails were fantastic- tasted just like the kind you would have in a fancy French restaurant!
My wife and I tried this product a couple of years ago. We enjoyed it so much that we started ordering it by the case. We consider it our own special treat.

These escargots were a wonderful introduction to snails.  I had something in California that looked and tasted more like slugs than escargo.  I can not believe that anyone could ever obtain 'fresh' escargo, so this product (yes, I have had other brands) has to be the top-o-the-line, as far as I am concerned. Great with pasta & sauce!  Wish I couold afford to have them for mid-morning/mid-afternoon snacks.  Either the 12-count giants or the 24-count very large are great!  I cut the 12's in half for pasta (any sauce is great with them) and use the 24 count whole.  Great stuff, Roland!

Roland has always been a product line i could trust.Full integrity all the way through.These snails are no exception.However - do NOT be put off by the description 'very large'.We serve them in a baking dish (for our convenience andeasier clean up - but I wager the larger snail shell couldeasily accomodate two snails... DOUBLE the pleasure and thesame preparation time.How good are they? We buy Roland by the case!

i have have purchased this brand before, however i had bought the 12count per can.although this 24 count are good they aren't very large for that matter they aren't even large, they are small.make sure you use 2 cans. 1 can isn't enough for a child

I fell in love with escargots many, many years ago, and have developed several recipes for them beyond the typical butter/garlic variety...and have been using the Roland brand for almost the same time frame.  It has, however, been very difficult to find them in local stores because we can only eat so many.  I was luck enough to find large cans (6 dozen) at the local Smart and Final store, but again, you can only eat so many at a time.  Luckily, I thought I would check on-line and found the 12 x 24 pack which is just what I need.Thanks for carrying them.BTW...I've attached my recipe for all you escargot lovers. Snails are hard to find in the mid-west and this was a great price. Roland delivers great quality and freshness, no sand or shell pieces, not rubbery at all. Highly recommend.

My husband and I love escargot but find them hard to locate in any of our local grocery stores so we purchased them by the case and they are very tasty. The recipe on the can is easy and delicous. I would highly recommend them.
If you have a taste for snails,  you can't beat ROLAND brand.  Large plump snails at a reasonable price.

My cat has had a delicate stomach. I have tried many different foods and tricks. Since I started feeding him this, he has had no throwing up. I have to feed him more than I did. He doesn't seem to get satisfied as quickly. His sister who has no stomach problems needs larger portions too. they both have no complaints about the taste. This stuff is expensive. It is worth it to not have him throw up all the time.

Newman's Own®Organics Advanced Cat Chicken & Rice Dry Formula, 76-Ounce BagI buy only this cat food for my cat. He has finally stopped throwing up since I changed to this. The nuggets are hard and he has to chew them up. That slows him down. His sister can eat any cat food with no trouble. She has better manners.

I know the front label says this food is for senior cats but my sphynx kitten is very active and this is also for active cats, so I figured I'd give it a try. I made a mixture of half Newman's Own Advanced with half of Kitten Chow (for the required kitten essentials!) and my kitty loves it. I like how this is organic and the nibbles are nice and hard to promote healthy teeth. I've also noticed my kitty's poop isn't stinky anymore because this food is of much better quality than the other so-called premium cat foods I've tried before. Tip: If you're feeding your cat a dry food mix and its poop stinks it usually indicates its poor quality - so upgrade. I'm going to continue feeding my kitty the mixture and once he's an adult I may switch over to feeding him just this exclusively.

With all the worries about recalled pet food I wanted something I could trust. I put it on auto-ship which lowers the price a little. My cat goes through one bag in a little more than a month and the whole thing will fit in her feeder (very convenient). She isn't a picky eater like other reviewers cats (although she turns her nose up at canned cat food), but she seems to like it just fine. When I received my first bag I wasn't about to do a taste test, but I did the sniff test. The organic smelled fresh and...well...like cat food, but the new IAMS bag smelled musty and sort of rancid. Shortly after when I was still weaning her off the IAMS cat food, I had an invasion of ants. Both open bags were under the sink in the laundry room and they went for the organic but didn't come near the IAMS. Maybe they know something we don't???

column9: Okay cat food but too expensive at Amazon
column10: I switched to this cat food when it became available at my local supermarket (Publix) for $9 per 3-pound bag.  Compared to others, I thought Newman's Own Organics Advanced Cat Dry Formula, 3-Pound Bags (Pack of 2) was a little pricey but I didn't mind spending more for an organic cat food. My cat wasn't thrilled with the switch but she eventually took to it but without the relish she had for the others.Now that my cat has adjusted to it and I can get it easily enough at my supermarket, I'll probably stick with Newmans' and purchase it there. But I will definitely NOT buy it at Amazon!  It is way too expensive here which really surprises me.  Even the Subscribe and Save deal is no bargain.So my final words are ~ this is not a bad organic cat food but it is way too overpriced at Amazon.
I switched cat food recently due to one of my cats' issues with always throwing up and she hardly ever throws up now, so all is well in my world:) they appear to like it.

column9: I highly recommend Newman's Own Organics
column10: It took some time, but I finally got my two cats to like Newman's Own Organics Advanced Cat Dry Formula. My red tabby male had a penchant for upchucking his food and this has put a stop to that. The pellets are small and hard and they seem to love crunching on them. I also mix Newman's Own Organics Advanced Cat Dry Formula with small amounts of other dry cat food as treats for them. This is premium cat food and I love the packaging's very effective zip lock and the graphics to. I highly recommend Newman's Own Organics.
I feel so safe feeding my cats Newmans Own it has excellent ingredents and my cats love it..

column9: The best for Willy and Joey,
column10: My cats love this food, and the best part is they rarely bring up those hair balls since the switch to Newman's .

I've had my cat for about 7 years and have had an issue with her vomiting for all 7.  I've tried sensitive stomach foods, indoor cat foods, hard vs. dry food, etc.  However, I've never purchased a pricier food for her.  With her vomiting about once a week now at least, I finally gave in and decided to try this and have been very pleasantly surprised.  First, she's only been eating it for about 2.5 weeks but so far, no vomit.  Second, she loves it and this is a cat that hates catnip, won't drink milk, won't eat soft food anymore and won't eat most other types of food.  The added bonus is that her coat is amazing!  She is so soft now and her coat is shinier than its ever been.  I definitely recommend at least trying this food.  I've stocked up on it!

column9: Finally found the perfect cat food.
column10: After reading other reviews I decided to see if this product could reduce "Sophie's" problem of throwing up her food.  She had been on Science Diet "oral care" for years and seemed to do well on it, except for not being able to keep it down 2-4 times per month. Apparently the problem was indeed the corn products and chemicals in Science Diet and other foods.  This 11 year old Siamese loves the organic Newman's and keeps it down.  Hooray!

column4: Helena-Sophia Exel "The Better It Gets - The ...
column9: Newman's Own Organics Advanced Cat Food
column10: Bless Paul Newman's heart. His services to the Feline Community are immeasurable. With four four-legged family members, health is an important issue. Two of my Kitties had difficulties eating 'ordinary' cat food. Allergies and even apathy ensued and I switched to 'Blue Buffalo' food. That worked for about six month. After this period my Cats wouldn't want to eat this food anymore. (Later I heard they had a recall...)since I feed my rascals Newman's 'Own Organics Advanced Cat Food', the allergy and apathy of my two darlings has receded. Their fur coat is shinier than ever before. My Feline children lost weight and they eat less of the Organics Food, than they did of the 'Franken Cat Food and even Blue Buffalo. For all of those who like to be sure that they give their beloved critters only the best possible food without breaking the bank, I recommend to subscribe to Newman's and thus get it to the same price or even cheaper than the Frankencatfood.Thank You Paul Newman for all You did to humanity and its pets and equally a big Mahalo (Thank You) to Nell Newman for keeping the family business in the spirit of her father. Newman's Own is the best. Period. (No, I don't get money for writing this;)

All of my six cats love Newman's Own Organic foods. I feed them the dry food and the canned. It's a bit more expensive than the other stuff, but it is organic. That means it doesn't contain any of the 'frankenmeat' that is in other non-organic pet foods. I know that I'm not giving them any of the 4-D meat (dead, diseased, dying, decayed) present in other non-organic pet foods. Google 4-D meats to learn what is in the usual brands. The extra cost is worth it because I don't need to deal with the expense of urinary tract infections and skin problems.
Nice to know my 15 year old cat is eating healthy organic food (and has done for years) AND that he loves the taste!

column9: Newman's Own makes my cats purr.
column10: The two rescue cats who adopted me were both about four years old. Both had been surrendered, separately, by their owners and became best pals at the shelter.  When they agreed to come home with me, I began researching the best foods to feed indoor cats.  Books were ordered, articles were researched and we discussed, the cats and I, if I should begin preparing their food myself in order to make sure they got the nutrients they deserved.  I read the labels of almost every dry and canned cat food on the shelves of pet stores and grocery stores.  Then, I found a bag of Newman's Own on the shelf of my local grocery story.  I read the label and found this to be the first and the ONLY cat food whose ingredients matched those recommended by vets and authors. Better still, I could order the food through the Amazon subscription service and have it delivered to my door.  My mature, loving cats are healthy, happy, full of energy, have grown incredible whiskers and we couldn't be more pleased.  The cats experimented with both dry and canned Newman's Own and have settled on a daily combination that seems to work.  They now purr when the package arrives at the door each month -- and they clean their plates every day.  As their caregiver, I'd give Newman's Own cat food -- dry and canned -- the highest marks, and its availabilty spared my refrigerator and freezer from being filled with frozen packages of home-prepared cat food.

column9: No more tummy troubles for my kitty
column10: I had a cat with irritable tummy/bowel . Not any more! Only took a week and he is all better. Yes, its expensive, but think of it this way: It saves on vet bills!

My cat, like most cats, is a picky eater.  So it is kind of hard feeding him because either he doesn't like the food or he gets bored with the food he likes.  He makes life a bit harder for me.  Luckily for me he like this stuff.  Now he doesn't wait for me to feed him, he goes right into the bag and feeds himself.

according to the dietician at our vet's office this food has several elements at too high levels for cats. the most problematic being ash. our cat suffered from uninary tract problems soon after we switched to this and had to spend 2 days in the vet's office at a substantial cost. might be a good product but for our 14 yr old, it was not a good balance of ingredients.

They don't seem to like it. Good news is that they are losing weight because they don't eat much. Seems to stale quickly. I can tell by the same morsels being left in the bowl day after day. Shedding is less and litter smells better with this food. Will probably not buy again.

column9: Cat loves it, and doesn't scarf it down like junk food
column10: I judge this product by my cat's reaction and health. She is not overweight nor underweight, she seems to like this product, she eats it easily but not greedily like it is junk food (which she has done with other brands). The price on subscribe and save is generally great, so overall we like this product and it is easy to purchase it from Amazon.

Love the convenience of having this dog food delivered once per month, every month!Love the healthful effects its had on my 12 year old prancing and still lively love of my life standard poodle!He got very sick on blue buffalo and it cost around 300 to have him checked out.....nothing wrong, except his food!Loved getting the free treat pack with the dog food....but they stoopped doing this!  Why Newman's own stopped this, I'll never know.But, I like it so much I've ordered the treats to be delivered every two months, and have just subscribed for their cat food to also be delivered.What you spend on good food you save in vet bills!Love Newman's!!!!

column9: Looks healthy but cat won't eat it
column10: The first thing I noticed about this cat food is that it doesn't smell horrendous. I poured some into my cat's food bowl and she ran over and started devouring it. She didn't do that with the other brands I've given her (IAMS, Hill's science diet, the goodlife recipe). She seems to really like this food and she hasn't thrown it up. I'm not a vet so I don't know how nutritionally sound this product is, but it lists a lot of organic ingredients and it has chicken as one of the first ingredients. I'll post pictures of the bag with that information. I know Newman's Own is a quality brand (I use their pasta sauces and salad dressing) so I imagine this product is high quality as well. It sure seems to be.Update 8-16-12: My cat does not seem to like it anymore after the first week. I mixed it with her old food and she picks around to avoid the Newman's Own pellets. I tried putting just Newman's Own in one dish and the other cat food in another. She won't eat the Newman's Own when it's separate either. I guess she prefers the cheaper cat food.
Sorry to say, my cat refused to eat this stuff. I am sure it's good but my cat wouldn't eat it.

column9: It's not the same product as before
column10: My cats used to love this product, but Newman's has changed it and now they won't touch it.  I had to cancel my subscription.
To expensive, I don't know what I was thinking. My cats didn't seem to excited about the food either.

My cat hated this food... won't eat it.To be clear... he also hates IAMS and Blue Buffalo. But he loves Hill's Science Diet.I try to buy him food that he will like that will be good for him. That usually means that it costs more... but a price can never be put on good health.

This review is for the Tiki Dog foods in general, not specific to this one variety. We have previously given our cats and dog Sharpie the Merricks canned food. But as they have had issues with recalls of late, many of the stores we go to have discontinued carrying it and we were pretty sure because of these recalls, we were not going to buy it anymore.Our dog Sharpie is very finicky. I have never met a dog in my life that has to be coaxed into eating. Part of this is because she is so submissive she has to be eating WHILE we are eating NEAR us as we are eating. If we're not eating or nearby, she seems to need approval that its ok for her to eat when her pack leaders aren't. But part 2 of this issue is she is very picky. And its not like we feed her Alpo crap either.But after the whole Merricks recall debacle, I bought a bunch of different brands of canned food to see which she liked the most. Tiki Dog was by far the winner and its not like I blame her. You take it out of the can and it LOOKS like food and not a foreign mystery loaf of something. There are chunks of shrimp and sardines and other yummy items that animals like. When we mix her dry food with it, she does not even hesitate. She eats her whole bowl in less than a few minutes where before it would take coaxing her to eat for a half an hour and then her not even finishing her bowl.This is more expensive than most but in my opinion, it is totally worth the expense. You really do get what you pay for. I would recommend the Tiki Dog and Tiki Cat to anyone!

column9: Dogs love Tiki Dog...even though it is not from Hawaii.
column10: My Australian Cattle dogs loved the Tiki Dog food.  The food is so nutrious and delicious, they fell in love with it.  I add it to their kibble and they chomp it down.Aloha!

I've used Szeged paprika and was impressed with the quality.  I didn't know they made anything other than variations of paprika until today.  My boyfriend had 8 lbs of baby back ribs and wanted to try using a dry rub.  I had selected a rub recipe online, but had to pick up some ingredients from the store by his house.  I was surprised when I saw this premixed rib rub and figured I'd save myself some time and trouble.  I peeled the membrane off the back of the ribs, dried them with paper towels, and rubbed them down with a generous coating.  We let them rest covered in the fridge for about 6 hours.  He cooked them on the gas grill using indirect heat - about 325 degrees - for about 2-1/2 hours.  They were amazing - smokey and flavorful with a touch of sweetness, but also let the natual flavor of the pork come through.  These are the best ribs, dry or wet, we have ever had!  I'm imagining this rub's potential on boston butts and tenderloins...yum!  I'm headed back to the store tomorrow to pick up their other types of rub - if they're half as good as this I'll be impressed.

Got a great deal for these rawhide bones.  My Pom/Beagle mix loves to chew and these are a great size for him.  They last a day or two before they're gone and are a great treat to mix in with others.  These are one of his favorites.  Fast shipping, as always, and this bulk pack will last a while for a great price.

I really like this dressing and it's hard to tell that it's calorie-free. I will say if you expect a straight honey-mustard dressing, that's not what this is -- there is a definite taste of vinegar (which makes up a large chunk of the product). But it's still good as long as you realize that going in. Even my son likes it!

column9: A little too sweet, but good
column10: I used this product on a spinach salad with chicken and apples. It was a little too sweet for my taste, but after I added a sprinkle of onion powder and a little fresh pepper, it was a nice addition to my salad. I really love these dressings, it makes following the HCG protocol totally, dare I say- enjoyable.

I love this dressing.  I usually keep a few Walden Farms small pouches in my purse to have when eating out.  A few days ago I decided to order a bottle for home and didn't bother noticing the shipping and handling charges.  (Amazon's Prime Membership has spoiled me.)Today, at a small local health foods store I bought an overpriced bottle for $3.45.  I just received the Amazon shipping notification and I will be paying over $14 for this bottle.The honey dijon dressing is very good (great on a spinach salad with blueberries and pecans) but certainly not worth the $14.  Amazon fulfills some of the Walden Farms dressings - I wish they would add the honey dijon.So five stars for the dressing, and one star for the very unreasonable S&H costs ($7.98).
Best use is for dipping raw veggies.  Enhances flavor of bland vegetables. No guilt or serving limitations.  Also great on fish or shrimp.  Balsamic vinegrette flavor better for salads.

column9: yuckity yuck - however - the CREAMY BACON is devine ;)
column10: Went to Save Mart tonight and happened to go down the health isle where they have specialty items and saw these. I bought two, the Honey Dijon and the Creamy Bacon. I taste tested them when I got home and found that the Honey Dijon tasted ok for a milisecond, lol and then found that it had a bad after taste....If you're going to pay the price go with the Creamy Bacon, yumz yumz, good luck!!!
I would rather have a salad plain than have to eat this. I have tried many low carb items and this is by far the worst tasting out there.  I threw it out after the first taste.

I despise low-fat/non-fat dressings and would prefer to eat a salad plain rather than use them.  But these Walden Farms Dressings taste great and make a diet less monotonous.  My husband likes them too, and he always prefers the high calorie version of anything.

I tried this on a lark, curious what a zero-calorie zero-carb dressing might taste like, and was pleasantly surprised.  It's pretty good, very good for "free", and certainly adequate for eliminating the "dry and bland" problem of simple salads.  I agree with others that it's more vinegary sweet than a regular honey dijon.  I find myself reaching for it over other low-calorie low-carb options.

This is a little bit sweet for my taste, so I added 1T of plain Dijon to the whole bottle. Now, it's perfect to put on my salads, and I've even marinated my chicken in it... YUMMMM! I will definitely still buy this even after I'm down to my goal weight. Thank you Walden Farms for making so many good products!
I have tried some of their other flavors and they weren't bad but the honey dijon taste like watery mustard mixed with sweet and low!
This tastes horrible, which is too bad because the ranch and balsamic dressings by Walden Farms are really good. I was surprised at how bad it tastes -- like vinegar -- yuck!
I like a lot of light type foods but this one is just awful.  But it is "free" of everything so may not be surprising.  But seeing others ratings makes me wonder if I got a bad bottle!0

I was introduced to Emily's chocolate covered dried fruit and nuts when my friend gave me some as a gift. Now it's my new favorite candy.  This stuff is so good, especially the cranberries and strawberries.  I've had chocolate covered dried fruit before, but the chocolate wasn't nearly as good as what Emily's uses.  This tastes like good, high-quality chocolate.  This is a great and unique gift to give someone who has it all.

I purchased Iams canned because our previous Siamese of 19 years loved it, but our current Siamese tastes it and then walks away. She eats turkey and giblets in other brands, so it's not a meat she doesn't like. I don't know if they have changed the flavor or if this cat is just finicky; but I gave it 2 stars, because if your cat will eat it, it is a very good quality cat food.

These pistachios were the cheapest I could find, so I didn't expect much as far as taste... But was I wrong.  These are probably the best I have ever tasted, and I am a pistachio nut... Haha, so I know good pistachios.  In short, this company will send you the best pistachios you've ever had for the least amount of money you've ever paid.  Highly recommended.

fantastic great delicious great service  grand splendid fantastic.fantastic great delicious great service  grand splendid fantastic.fantastic great delicious great service  grand splendid fantastic. what can i say but that this company is one of gods little gifts to mankind.

I thought I might be able to find a good buy on pistachios on the internet, especially if I bought in bulk. Well, not the case!!! My wife and I love pistachios and the best buy we have been able to find is at Wal-Mart. $6.98 for a one pound bag of premium pistachios. We love them.

column9: They don't taste like peanut butter at all
column10: I'm going to be honest here, I was intrigued by the marketing, packaging and general assumption that this treat would at least somewhat taste like peanut butter, after all, I only give my dog the best. I consider myself a first line of defense of sorts for my dog. After purchasing this product, I was sitting in my car and my curiosity got the better of me. I tried one. It didn't taste bad, but it definitely didn't taste like peanut butter AT ALL. Zero peanut butter taste. How does a company get away with such blatant false advertisement like this. It's shocking, shocking I say.But in all seriousness, there is no peanut butter flavor at all. Why say it when it's not true?Dog still loves them though. But then again, the only thing he doesn't like is olives.
My grandpuppies love this stuff, & it's very hard to find in my area. Haven't tried it myself, but they think it's tops.

My Shih Tzu loves this treat. She will not eat any other kind of pet treat. I ran out and was awaiting shipment. In the meantime, I bought some cheetos cheese puffs and cut a puff into fourths. She noticed the difference. Needless to say, she had to be without her treat for almost a week. I promise to be a better mom next time.

The price on these fell to a $1, so I bought 20 of them.  I'm pretty sure they lost money on that deal.  I was raised the next day.  Anyway, the product is great.  Dogs love them.  But I'm pretty sure they'd love stale popcorn too.. hmmm..

My dogs absolutely love these treats! Pup corn is great because we have older Italian greyhounds with bad and lots of missing teeth and they love them!

column9: Healthy and flavorful option, but not cheap
column10: My dog enjoys these treats, but they are expensive in terms of cost per pound. I had received the cheese version in a large bag from a family member as a gift, but this bag is significantly smaller. I think they bought it at a store like Big Lots for less.

column9: Pure Food For Those Who Control Their Diets.
column10: I just had a bowl of split pea soup for a part of my lunch. It was Amy's Organic Split Pea Soup and it was quite good. It says that it is low fat, but the ingredient list has no fat at all on it so it must be very low. The sodium, on the other hand is a bit higher than I like, but the fiber content is good. The taste is somewhat bland, but I'm not complaining. I get tastes out of the other foods I eat with it. It's a vegan product and has no added MSG or preservatives and is gluten free. A product like this should have great appeal to those who are on restricted diets, for whatever reason. Relatively pure foods are hard to find.Gary Peterson
I GAVE THIS TO MY GRAND SON FOR CHRISTMAS LAST YEAR I AM SORRY I DIDN'T REALIZE I SHOULD REVIEW IT.IT IS GREAT AND HE LOVES IT.

These fish-shaped pretzels actually taste better than I expected they would. Not overly salted, they do have a unique taste of their own yet retain mostly that classic pretzel taste. The small size of the pretzel snack is nice in that there are fewer crumbs encountered than with larger pretzel shapes that have to be broken or bitten into when eating.The package contains the usual glowing buzz words like: natural, goodness, no artificial preservatives, and baked.The first ingredient listed is "smiles" followed by unbleached, enriched wheat flour. One serving of  pieces has only  calories. Rarely do I limit myself to one serving so my intake of calories while snacking is considerably more. That's what happens when you snack right out of the bag instead of apportioning a reasonable amount before snacking.These would make a nice lunchtime snacks for the kids, especially in a packed lunch.

Buyer BEWARE: This if not a box of individual snack-packs, as shown in the product image.  This is a 6-pack of big bags of goldfish pretzels, and it is NOT RETURNABLE.  A huge freaking waste of $$$, thanks a lot, Amazon.

I just love these delicious little fish, and my grandchildren are very disappointed if I don't have some available when they come over. Buying these tasty treats in large bags is a wonderful way to make sure I will have some on hand for quite a while.
very good jam,it reminds me of loganberry.i gave a jar to my brother and he tasted blueberry.no matter,it was something i had never tried before.i was suprised that it was also called aronia berry
We are very happy with this products. Probably this is ons of the best tea with Chamomile. We would recommend it to everyone.

i love these chocolate cookies from Japan!!! They come in little individually wrap packets with to cookies inside, Awesome!!!! So chocolaty but drink with milk or water they will make your mouth a little dry.

This would be a great product but unfortunately the the orange peel slices are coated with sulfites (probably to retain color) and for this reason are unsuitable for many people who may have sensitivities to this common preservative.

Found this item and was thrilled.  This candy was a holiday favorite for years at my parent's home, but has not been available for some time.  I'm so very pleased with the quality of this candy.  Just as we remember!

I bought these candied orange peels because of the price.  I didn't know if they would be very good.  What a pleasant surprise I got!!  They are wonderful.  They are juicy and tender.  I bought them in a 2 LB pack because the shipping was more economical that way.  We like to dip them in chocolate.  I am very pleased with these and I shall purchase from this company again.

column4: Dawn K "Just your average culinary ninja!"

I was very pleased with this item, it came promptly, and satisfied my need for use in a cookie recipe.

Loved the taste It was just as they said very very YUMMY! I would suggest anyone who loves Chocolate covered cherry's to buy this !

I'm a huge fan of Cameron's flavored coffees, but this flavor was new to me. As usual, the beans were shiny and fresh right out of the bag.The smell out of the bag and while brewing was absolutely fantastic, and I got my hopes up for a rich chocolate and cherry flavor. Buy Jamaican Me Crazy or Chocolate Caramel Brownie instead.

The Holy Bible Mint Tins were a huge success at my Mother's 80th Birthday Celebration. column9: One of the greatest coffee's ever!

This was the most delicous and most "workable" fondant I have ever used.  The taste reminds me of Tootsie Rolls.  I am new to the fondant cake world (I am typically a buttercream kind-of-gal), but I wanted to take my cakes to the next level. Very pleased with the quality of this product. A beginner at cake decorating this was very easy to work with and the flavor was great as expressed by all that tasted it. Will be ordering more product from this company.
This fondant is easy to work with.Most importantly, The taste is ok, which in fondant world is not always the case.
Pleasure to do business with zum zum store  and dates a the best . Love them . Highly recommended .

I like Nature Valley granola bars because they fill me up better than other brands, such as Special K or the Quaker Oats granola bars. They're also chewy and sweet, great for a snack or a quick breakfast. My only complaint is that it is a little too sweet.

The coating of strawberry yogurt on these granola bars make an ordinary treat a bit more special. Nature Valley makes two other yogurt versions, one vanilla and one blueberry. All are good, but the strawberry is my favorite. We always keep a couple of boxes on hand for times when we need a portable, healthy snack. Very tasty and reasonably priced.
Great Product quick shipment, this was the only place that i could find the product.  It was also affordable.  I highly recommend this buyer.
These are my favorite Nature Valley as it is like eating a healthy dessert. I could not bear to part with these as I am a greedy little piggy with this flavor.

These are good if you want something really, really sweet.  I could feel the sugar on my teeth after eating these... They're not terrible, they're fast and easy when you're in a hurry or want a sweet treat that isn't ice cream or (real) candy.
I did genuinely get a subscription to these bars. you get a full case, and its cheaper than if you were to buy at the grocery store. pretty awesome.

The yogurt coating has kind of an artificial sweetener taste to it. The granola bars aren't bad, but not my first choice. Still, they were cheap and I'll eat them when I am hungry enough. Wouldn't buy them again though.
Yummy bars.  Fast shipping.  Not as nutritious as a Clif's Bar, but a nice taste alternative.

These are a good source of calcium and are very tasty.  They are also quite filling and satisfying as a snack.  I buy them by the case and consider that a month's supply. Each bar is individually wrapped and very fresh.

My first exposure to Patchi choclates was in Abu Dhabi, where Patchi stores are found aplenty. Now that we are back in the States, Amazon is the only place I've been able to find Patchi. Hooray! The chocolates are as rich and delicious as I remember. If you have never enjoyed Patchi chocolates - do yourself a favor and buy some!

column9: Like A Healthier Red Bull... Only Better!
column10: This drink is like Red Bull on proverbial "steriods." It has a robust, fruity flavor, and a kick like a cannon. If you are an addict of Red Bull, or enjoy a wonderful tasting energy drink with a massive kick, you need to try this.

I think Blue Energy tastes great and is a natural alternative to Red Bull. I've tried other alternatives and this is simply the best. It has a great kick (1000 mg of Taurine as well as caffeine and ginseng) and find the 8.3 oz. can to be just the right size and is easily transportable. It also tastes less artificial (some energy drinks taste like fizzy cough syrup). This has a clean taste and I don't feel gross chugging it down.I've been drinking this for over a year and a half now. It cured my jet lag on a trip to NYC in 2005. I'm glad I found it here on Amazon because even though it's stocked at Whole Foods, I usually end up grabbing the few remaining cans on the shelf.

I work at Whole Foods so this is not new to me. I buy one every day, I don't know what id do without it. It tastes great and it works too. I find the taste to be crisp and refreshing, unlike other energy drinks that taste like fizz with heavy syrup.

column9: Tastes like healthier, fruitier Red Bull
column10: Blue Energy is a nice energy drink that packs a punch that lasts about 3-4 hours then tapers off with no sugar crash. Tastes like a healthier, fruitier Red Bull, which is a good thing. It has about half as much caffeine as most other drinks. It's natural, not organic, and while not specifically touted as being allergen-free, it certainly appears to be as I've drunk several cans with no ill effect and I have multiple food allergies (to gluten, dairy, soy, etc.).For an organic energy drink that delivers on taste and performance without a ton of caffeine, try Opta Energy, which comes in two flavors: Opta Energy, Organic Berry Fusion Energy Drink, 12/12 Oz and Yumberry, Passionate Orange, 12.00 OZ (Pack of 12) ( Value Bulk Multi-pack). These are 1.5 servings per can sizes so that can be helpful if you need an extra little boost later without committing to a whole can. Also, they keep remarkably well after opened in the refrigerator. I've reviewed both flavors.

I have had this energy drink on a number of occasions.  It's quite effective as an energy drink, and I do like the taste of it.  The taste doesn't linger in your mouth while you're working out.  However, I do not find this price to be good considering it's listed on Amazon where prices are usually much better on products across the board.  I purchase this drink at Whole Foods for $1.99 each and on sale at $1.69 each.
IT IS REALLY GOOD WHEN YOU MIX IT WITH MOUNTAIN DEW IN MY OPINION. BUT I'M NOT GOING TO PAY A HIGH PRICE FOR IT...

This drink is not one of the best I have used. The taste is medicinal. I have better results energy and calorie burning wise with Celcius and VPX drinks. The Celcius available for really great value at Costco and the VPX, among many others, at Amazon, or Vitamin Shop. Blue Sky enters this market with a poor tasting product and hopes to overcome it's shortfall by claiming it is all natural. Too bad.

I use this -- for the most part -- instead of bread. I am Bi-Coastal and I keep these in the freezer both home in NYC and out West. I will have one or two a day and that is it for bread products. Two is 120 calories. You can use them to wrap anything you like. If you want some tensile strength just leave one on the counter for a while before using. This has cache. Who wouldn't want a crepe as a sort of ultimate gourmet taco? Not knockin' tacos or bread, but if you are a minimalist like me you want few things that are great. These take up no room. You can order them in bulk. Among my uses -- to wrap concoctions I create and make a meal. YYou do not neeed much of a concocktion. Max two tablespoonfuls. To put melted cheeze on and wrap up and make a meal. To put a spoonful of icecream on and wrap up and make a treat. To put a bit of preserves on and roll up for my equivalent of a treat. And you know what? When you do not need any, they are still there, taking up little room and available whenever you get the urge. Bread substitute? Well, everyone needs bread. I still go out for breakfast in NYC and will have a Bialy. But before I used to do three bialy's worth of bread a day. I have cut that by more than half. As far as I know this is the only product like this. I am well satisfied. Class act from California.

These are delicious pre-made crepes that you can use in your recipes instead of taking time to make your own crepes.  These are easy to use especially if you need a large quantity of crepes. Again, my fault for not reading more carefully, but it's a TOTAL rip-off. Don't make the same mistake!

In my experience (dealing with over 300 cats daily at an animal shelter), this is an above average cat litter.  Most cats dislike strong-smelling litter.  They will go outside of the litter box rather than deal with litter that has a strong scent.  This litter does not have an overly strong scent, like Fresh Step, so cats tend not to mind this one so much.  In addition, it has a finer consistency than a lot of litters (especially pellet litters, like Feline Pine), which is also a plus for most cats. There is also minimal dust to irritate the cats' eyes or noses.The one negative aspect, and the reason I only gave it 3 stars rather than 4 stars, is the price.  It is fairly pricey compared to similar generic alternatives.

Mao Mao is our first kitten and I was a little concerned about his litter box.  No one wants a stinky house!  This Tidy Cat litter is excellent.  Of course, I don't really have anything to compare it to, but I've heard horror stories about litter boxes.  Anyway,  it doesn't stink and everything is very nice and neat, except for Mao Mao who needs to learn NOT play in his clean litter box.  :)  Excellent product and I have no desire to try anything else.  :)

I highly recommend using the following litter scoop with tidy cats scoop; Ultra Pet Little Pearls Litter Scoop, 1-Count Scoop (Pack of 6) and get a 60gal covered plastic storage box from HomeDepot/Lowes, cut a foot wide oval hole in the top for the perfect large capacity low odor easy to clean litter box costing you under $20 to make for a larger DIY version of; Clevercat Top Entry Litterbox

column9: Tidy Cat VS Fresh Step Scoopable Litter...Fresh Step wins hands down!
column10: I was so disappointed with Tidy Cat scoopable litter that I was about to go back to the regular litter, but decided to give it one more go with a different brand. The trouble with Tidy Cat is that the soiled litter would turn to a thick, sticky mud that was very difficult to scoop and would leave a lot of mud-like residue behind. I would end up emptying the entire litter box, clean it out, and start from scratch which defeated the purpose of scoopable litter.Fresh Step proved to be a major improvement. It is so much easier to scoop and doesn't turn into the sticky mud that Tidy Cat would form. I can actually scoop now and not have to empty the entire litter box.Both Fresh Step and Tidy Cat controlled odor. Tidy Cat's plastic container was a bit easier to transport. Fresh Step prevents litter mess and waste; thus, saves money as pound for pound it scooped better and last longer. Fresh Step wins hands down as it is by far the most scoopable litter.

This is the only litter I've used since I got my cat, Indy, and it works very well. It clumps almost instantly (hence the name).  Very easy to sift out.  I used to get the big 20lbs (or more) bucket, which was ardous to pour into her box.  I like this smaller jug because it's easier to handle and refill the box with what i need quickly.  I live in an attic apartment.  I keep her litter box at the bottom of the staircase in the back of my apartmen.  My apt has never smelled like a cat bathroom to me or any guests i've had. Indy seems to like it too :)
Grandma seems to prefer this brand.  She shares it with her daughter.  It really keeps the smell from creeping up into the house from the basement...that's where we keep their  box.

We had been using the Arm & Hammer Super Scoop brand through the subscribe & save option, and found that it did not clump sufficiently, making clean-up for two cats difficult.  The Tidy Cats clumps better, and we've had fewer urine odor problems as a result, but I was disappointed to realize how wasteful the packaging is for this particular item.  It is three heavy-duty plastic bottles which each weigh only seven pounds.  I didn't realize how small a 7-pound jug actually is until we received the first shipment.  Since I've yet to come up with any ideas for reusing the empty litter jugs, and don't like the environmental waste of using so much plastic (even if we try to recycle it, plastic recycling is so inefficient), we may have to find some other litter solution.

column9: Quality food without the unnecessary additives
column10: Cats are carnivores.  If you check out the ingredients list for many of the common brands you find at the grocery store, you'll see the first couple of ingredients are *not* meat, but rather grains.  As well, the meat typically is made up of by-products, which are not suitable for human consumption.  Yes,  I know, we're not going to be consuming our feline companion's food, but the reality is with cats and their funky digestive tract issues, their food should not contain grain or meat by-products, plain and simple.There are a number of outstanding grain-free cat foods out there, but this one in particular our cats eat happily.  One of our cats was significantly overweight, and with NOW recommended by our veterinarian , my fiancee gave it a try. At the time he began this food, we were actually living on opposite coasts and I hadn't seen the cats in roughly 8 months given my travels.  When I saw our cat after that absence, I was shocked to see how slimmed down he was and how healthy he had become.  Using this food, in combination with that feeding bowl in which the cats have to stick their paws into to retrieve the food (looks like a flying saucer) has been the key to success!Unfortunately, this product is not widely stocked at pet care places in our area, but I am delighted that Amazon carries it.  I've been able to order it, trouble-free, and the food arrives fresh and ready to be consumed.  I highly recommend this brand and encourage you to read the ingredient labels on anything you feed your pet-companions.

I bought a small bag of this to try with my cats.  One is 16 years old and the other 10.  Both seemed to enjoy it as a snack, so I went back and bough the large 10lb bag, thinking I was doing them a favor.  The ingredients are impressive, however, as I slowly moved them over from their traditional Purina One to this product, both of them developed a severe case of the runs.  So, I portioned them back to a larger portion of the Purina One thinking they needed more time to adjust to this new food, however I can't seem to get them back to normal.  So, I have 95% of this bag and am not currently feeding them any of it.  I also had to get some remedy for the diahrrea, which is taking time to kick in.As I mentioned, they seemed to love the taste, but it has been a big problem for their digestive systems.

column9: Great for older cat with sensitive skin
column10: About a year ago, my 12-year-old cat developed an itchy rash on her forehead.  The vet ruled out more serious health issues, and speculated that it was an allergic reaction or food sensitivity.  And so began a year of cat food experiments...We tried a range of grain-free foods with various protein sources.  Some didn't help the skin; some she didn't like. The local pet food store suggested this.  The big selling point was that it doesn't have any "meals"-- no "chicken meal" or "fish meal" or "turkey byproduct" or whatever.  She has been eating this for the past 6 months or so, and her skin has cleared up remarkably.  And the fact that she taps on my cheek until I wake up and feed her in the morning suggests that it is also quite delicious.It is expensive, but it has helped her skin issues enough that it's been worth it.  (A trip to the vet costs quite a bit more!)  If you have an older cat that seems to have developed a food sensitivity, this is definitely a good option to try.

As any cat owner will tell you, cat digestive systems are a royal challenge.  Now! Dry Cat Food is a unique product that doesn't have any fillers, no grain at all, and the meat that is used contains no by-products.  Essentially, it's human-grade.Cat's are carnivores, plain and simple.  And this food addresses that beautifully.This particular formula, for senior and overweight cats, has made a huge difference in the quality of our cat's health.  My cats love the taste, never turn their nose up from this product, and my formerly over-weight cat is now looking terrific, and both he and his brother are very healthy - healthy coat, bright eyes, etc.Unfortunately this product is not sold every where (yet)but I am grateful I can get it here on Amazon!  I highly recommend this brand.

column9: Great for cat with Irritable Bowel Syndrome
column10: I've purchased the Now! Grain free (10 lbs) turkey with duck & salmon dry cat food 3 times now over the past 4 months.  Wanted to see how our cat with IBS (irritable bowel syndrome) would do on it.  He loves it, and will chow it down to the point where he would get fat, if we let him.  Have to portion it out to him thru the day.  Other cat loves it, too, and she no longer vomits on a regular basis.  Definitely a good quality product which is sold at our veterinarian's office, but I buy it online with Amazon for better price. Sidenote:  we're gradually starting to reduce the amount of budesonide medicine given to our cat with IBS problem to eventually see how he does without the medicine & if he's okay just being on Now! grain free food.
