They are not too sweet but just about perfect.I enjoy these in the late afternoon with a cup of coffee and don't feel much guilt about eating them. They provide energy and have a nice synergy with the coffee.

I've been a faithful follower of a massive muffin for breakfast for years and did not believe that there was any satisfying yet healthy alternative out there to switch to. Well this is it!!! They are just as other reviewers describe. I would also add the following: there are 4 cookies, and blueberry is somewhat chewier than other flavors. By the time you get to the forth one, you are about done with "chewing" and are no longer hungry. Most other breakfast bars do not get it right - you are done in few bites and are left feeling hungry until the calories "kick-in." Belvita has only 230 calories and it does last for 3-4 hours. Finally, these cookies are loaded with fiber, I will not elaborate, but it works. I've been on Belvita for several months and do not have any need/interest in switching to 600+ calorie muffins :)

column9: "Breakfast Biscuit" AKA How to eat cookies at 8am and not feel too guilty
column10: Nabisco is stressing the heck out of the claimed health benefits of Belvita. Whole grain! Natural! Fiber & Vitamins! Nutritious Sustained Energy! They talk about the last one like it's trademarked. If you check the website, the product claims to be specifically made with carbohydrates that slowly release over the course of 4 hours. To their credit, these "biscuits" (I can't in good conscience leave the quotes out) do a pretty good job in that respect. I don't know if it's because they honestly formulated it well or a placebo effect because that's what I was hoping it would do. In any event, it did curb my appetite for a while, and they taste great.Really great, actually. When you open the package, the blueberry scent is very strong, and the taste matches that intensity well. I appreciate the use of real dried fruit. If anything, they might be a little too sweet. Looking at the calories after eating them makes a lot of sense. Each serving contains 4 pieces, which add up to 230 calories. So that's about 60 calories per piece-pretty steep! But if they keep their word on staving off hunger for a few hours (in my case, yes) then they're not empty calories you would get with something like eating a handful of Oreos. The vitamins are a let down, though. You only get 10% of your daily required on just a few things, which is far far less than a cereal bar (or, you know, actual cereal). So if you can limit yourself to one pack at a time, they make a pretty good hold over snack until your next meal.

column9: Great for those with dairy allergies (and lactose intolerant, too)
column10: I grabbed these today, one of those running late days- skipped breakfast and found myself starving. I have a dairy allergy*, and it was the first of 10 or so "breakfast " items that I checked in the aisle that didn't contain milk ingredients.  I immediately regretted my decision when I got back to the office, because I actually looked at the box- not just the ingredients- and it looked pretty unappetizing. When I opened the pack, I smelled blueberries, and the pieces in the cookie seemed to be actual blueberries!  They tasted great, it reminded me of the blueberry muffins I used to get from Dunkin Donuts.  Granted, I haven't had dairy products in forever, and consequently cant eat most fast food or prepackaged stuff, so they may not taste as great to someone who can have the real thing- but they are the perfect thing to have on hand for mornings like today, or when my family gets donuts so I can pretend its a muffin.  Waaaa allergies suck.*note to people with allergies, it DOES contain wheat and soy, so not gluten free

The Belvitas are similar to the Nabisco Fruit Thins, only better. One of the first things I checked on was the blueberry content. Yes, dried blueberries are in there unlike in some other products called blueberry that only contain some other kind of fruit and blueberry flavoring.The Belvita (beautiful life?) biscuits come four in a package with plenty of little blueberry bits to add some delightful chewy texture to the biscuit crunch. There's a lot to like about this product: the good taste, the wholesome ingredients, whole grains as the first ingredient, the lack of artificial undesirables, the nutritional content and that all important degree of satisfaction. I'm looking forward to trying the other flavors in the Belvita biscuits line.

These are tasty and I am enjoying one with my morning coffee break while I write this, but reading the nutrition facts and the ingredients list on the package, I have to think that this is more of a tasty and somewhat healthy cookie than a substitute for breakfast. According to the package, a serving is four biscuits which adds up to 230 calories. Though that includes 4 grams of protein and 3 grams of fiber, it also includes 13 grams of sugar and 8 grams of fat.They are good, tasting like a nice butter cookie with a blueberry aroma and a hint of blueberry flavor. Still, I think I'll be more likely to have one from time to time as a little treat with my morning coffee or after dinner than to substitute a package for breakfast. There I'd more likely chose a low-fat fruit yogurt which would have more than twice the protein, less sugar and fat, and less calories.

Love these biscuits for all the reasons the other reviewers have stated. But what surprised me the most was that they passed the test with my label-reading daughter. She thought I had ordered something to replace pop tarts, but after giving the label a going-over, she was satisfied to the point of trying them herself. Now she also loves them. This must be what goes on in other households, too, since now they've become so popular all flavors have been out of stock (via Amazon) the past two weeks.The Oat flavor is currently in stock, but priced at almost 26 dollars for the same package of 3 I paid 12 dollars for. Please take price into consideration when you place your order.
After trying these from the airline, I am addicted.  They smell like baked blueberries and taste like crunchy blueberry muffins!

These biscuits are really good! I bring them to school as a snack after practice or before lunch. I think they are a lot better than Nutri grain bars and Quaker Oats granola bars. I've also tried the apple flavored onesbut the blueberry ones definetely taste better. It's also really easy to find coupons for them on the internet: [...]/ or just Google Belvita coupons!

I really like these biscuits. A little too much as they are very addicting. I wish the calorie count was lower. I eat these when I want a sweet snack, but not for breakfast, as I don't think they are filling enough. The blueberry flavor is nice, as well as the apple. These are a winner!
Great taste, but you have to get used to all of the seeds and smallpieces left in your mouth after eating.
Personally, I think these are nutritious, delicious, and reasonably priced.  Unfortunately, for whatever reason, my 19 month old and 4 year old aren't interested.  Oh well, back to the drawing board!

column9: Keep me full for quite a while!
column10: I was really surprised at how well these keep me full in the morning.  On days where I have cereal I get hungry well before noon, but these get me to lunch no problem!

column9: Breakfast buiscuits that aren't too dry!!! WOOHOO!
column10: I found these at the drug store yesterday. It was 5pm, I hadn't had anything to eat and my body was not happy.  This was the best "health" choice I could find. I bought them with the anticipation that they would be dry and brittle, like most breakfast biscuits are.I cannot believe how delicious the biscuits were. They were not overly dry. I could taste the blueberries.  A package of 3 bars contains a whopping 18g of whole grains as well as some B vitamins.  Overall, a good choice on the go.I will be buying these in the future!

Energy in the form of 4 simple biscuits, really lasts the morning through. The blueberry flavor also creates an excellent tasting product,  almost with a muffin like quality flavor. In a simple one word summary....flavorific.  I would definatelybuy again.
The blueberry belVita biscuits were offered this morning in first class on a flight.  WOW!  They are delicious. Highly recommend.

On my days off I have plenty of time to prepare eggs, but on workdays I need to guzzle my coffee and get moving. I feel guilty about not getting a proper breakfast and it doesn't help that my appetite doesn't really kick in until well after my second cup. Belvita has handily solved my problem. These things are sweet but not too sweet to face first thing in the morning, and they are awesome for dunking. You have to be careful though, they have a brittle texture that breaks easily, so if a piece falls into your cup it will dissolve before you can fish it out again. Not conducive to a good morning when that happens. I've gotten into a habit of checking the bikkie for breaks before dunking and it's all good now. Thanks to Belvita I no longer start the day running on just coffee for the first few hours.

column9: Delicious and perfect for breakfast or snack
column10: It's hard to find a good quick blueberry flavored biscuit or cookie that doesn't have a weird aftertaste. The dried blueberry in the belvita actually tastes like blueberries. The biscuit is light, crispy, and tastes really good, not to sweet, but with a delicious hint of sweetness.Each package is a generous 4 biscuits. While not diet food, grabbing one of these mid afternoon is going to be more filling and healthier than a candy bar.Each packet of four biscuits is:230 calories8 g of fat (no cholesterol)36 carbs3 g fiber13 g sugar4 g of protein18 g whole grain per serving

column9: I'm so happy I can eat pancakes again!!
column10: Now when I make a big breakfast for my husband and myself, I can eat pancakes, too.  I took a chance and ordered 3 at a time.  When I open my third box, I'm ordering more!  I put butter and the Walden Farms Sugar Free Syrup on my pancakes.  Sometimes, I'll use Splenda, almonds and cinnamon in the mix or Splenda with a cut up Godiva Sugar Free Dark Chocolate Bar.  It's amazing that I get to eat these yummy low-carb pancakes and still lose weight at the end of the week :o)

Another sugar-free low-carb product that is an excellent replacement food for those on restricted diets as well as those who wish to eat a healthy product that is just as delicious as other pancake mixes.  These pancakes come out light and fluffy and are delicious by themselves or with low-carb maple toppings with berries.  I add pecans to the mix and they are absoulutely wonderful.  Give them a try.  You will love them

I was feeling awful that Atkins had discontinued this line and suddenly there it was in a new package.  The original product seemed to have more vanilla (taste) in it but this is wonderful.  Thank you New Hope Mills for carrying on the tradition!J McCarthy

I am a diabetic and I love carbs which is the worst thing for someone like me. I found these products online and I now eat pancakes every Saturday and Sunday!  It is amazing how delicious they are when I make them with a little tweaking.My recipe is so good, I even had pancakes for dinner a few times!I always use  one package of sweet and low, 1 egg beaters container (2 eggs), a little bit of banana, almond, lemon or vanilla flavoring, a touch of oil and a touch of water, I shake it really well (have my own little shaker for this now) stir it to test the thickness of the batter...and start making pancakes.  I top it off with a little whip cream (sugar free and sugar free rasberry ice cream topping) and it is soooo goood!!!  Just  like eating at IHOP or Waffles restaurants!!I recommend getting a small container (for 1 person) with a top for shaking...it makes it so simple..less than 2 minutes and it is ready for the fry pan!

column9: PANCAKES ARE VERY GOOD - after modifying the recipe!
column10: Hi! 1st batch we made - had an unusual inside texture for a pancake - they were still very good - but .. a little wierd.  The inside texture was a bit - spongy or like the way an eggs are that are whipped/beaten and then used in an omelet or breakfast casserole.  A couple of days later, my son, husband and I made our 2nd batch, but this time we modified the recipe on the back. We used only 1 egg -- and that was the right modification!  Now the pancakes were just like regular pancakes!  They are delicious and certainly satisfy the "pancake craving".  We always add extracts to our pancakes - usually vanilla and maple, sometimes vanilla and coconut, sometimes vanilla and banana plus walnuts!  My ONLY issue is the SHIPPING cost us MORE than the product!! UGH .. bummer... nevertheless we are ordering another package - I will check to see if ordering more cost more in shipping -- if not might order 3 boxes as once. It's a shame food that is 'better' for us is always more costly -- but, that is not going to change.

column9: Not bad, but really quite different taste than regular pancakes
column10: These pancakes do cook beautifully, but to me still taste like air or cardboard, which is exactly why I was hesitant to buy a low carb mix.  They are better than mixes found in stores, but for me, not good enough to buy again, especially for the amount you're getting in the box.  I will try the 1 egg modification next time to see if there's any improvement on texture, so thanks for sharing that tip.  I'm disappointed they aren't better, but it's hard to make low-carb taste like high-carb goodness.  So, I would imagine this is an excellent product for some.  I would just rather not have pancakes at all than compromise this much.

column9: Very Good Tasting Low Carb Pancake Mix - Highly Recommended
column10: The New Hope Mills Sugar Free Pancake and Waffle Mix is fairly expensive but it is also very low in carbs, which is very important to me since I'm a Type 2 diabetic.The pancakes do taste different than "regular" pancakes, but they are still very good. When used with a sugar free syrup these make a very acceptable breakfast for a diabetic or someone watching their carb intake.One hint to pass along, we cut back on the number of eggs used in the directions as the first batch tasted very "eggy".Highly recommended!

Having recently been diagnosed with diabetes, it's been difficult to find something to eat for breakfast that won't shoot my blood sugar through the roof.  My one & two hour post prandial glucose has been consistently below 140 after a pancake breakfast with this product. Half of a whole grain English muffin shoots it up over 180. My diet choices are complicated by that fact that, in addition to a diabetic diet, I'm also on a low salt, low fat low cholesterol diet (I'm sure I'm not alone, however).  I agree with prior reviewers that the pancakes are a little eggy but they taste really good nonetheless; light, fluffy and yummy.  I substituted Eggbeaters for the eggs (reducing further the calories, fat & cholesterol); they still taste great but maybe not as fluffy.  Next batch I'll try half eggs & half Eggbeaters.  Wonderful product!
Received the product as stated and in good time. Pancake mix is good if not overcooked.

Having been on a lo-carb diet I was craving pancakes --- oh! what joy, these are light and fluffy and (almost) as good as regular ones, with sugar free syrup I can indulge and still lose weight. Great stuff, highly recommended, I will be buying more.

column9: Love the product, hate the cost...
column10: I have tried another low carb Maple...brand, which I am sure many are aware of, however, I prefer the taste of New Hope Mills. New Hope is also much lower in carbs than the the other brands sold in my local supermarket and Amazon. The taste is not rubbery, nor bland. It's easy to make and is an excellent substitute for brands with sugar. I have added crushed or whole almonds or walnuts and periodically a few pecans, a bit of vanilla to increase the fiber for some texture.What I dislike is the cost via Amazon. I went to the New Hope Mills site and discovered 3 (9oz)boxes for $11.95 or a case of 8 boxes for $25.00! Plus, my local supermarket has offered to order a case for me. Quite a big difference in cost!  So, although I like the convenience of Amazon, I will place future orders directly from New Hope Mills' site.  It's quite exciting to be able to order it in bulk and enjoy pancakes. Hint to Amazon, it would be great if you offer a comparable price w/Prime member benefits!

These are delicious pancakes and waffles.  However, there are multi-purpose mixes that you can use for pie crusts and biscuits, too with even less net carbs.  The waffles can be a little too full of air, but I solved that problem by adding more eggs.  Still, this is a good tasting mix.

I didn't expect this low carb pancakes to taste like the yummy carb laden pancakes of my youth, but dear Lord, these pancakes were horrible.  i followed the directions to the letter from the back of the box and made up the entire box (we love us some pancakes, and we have company over). The first few pancakes were the usual... not meant to be served.  But they kept getting worse.  Thick, gloppy, uncooked centers, and the parts we could eat tasted like glue and saw dust.The WORST part is, I called New Hope Mills to complain and they won't give me my money back or offer me a consideration.  It must be user error.  I can make pancakes, I've been cooking for over 25 years.  In fact I made bisquik pancakes yesterday for the family.So.... Skip this mix.  Unless you like raw centered glue/saw dust pancakes.  In which case, Enjoy!!

column9: Long term low carbers will love it.
column10: I have a feeling that those who gave this product bad reviews had very little experience with low carb eating.  Does it taste like a regular high carb pancake from Waffle House?  Of course not.  Is it yummy in its own right?  Oh, yes.  A quarter cup of mix makes four decent sized pancakes, which I cheerfully cover with low-sugar peanut butter or low-carb jam.  Sometimes, I'll eat them with just a little butter when I'm craving bread.  I do have to water the batter down some, as it's very thick.  I've also used this mix to successfully create beer batter for frying chicken or fish or veggies--it puffs up a good bit when frying, so a little batter goes a long way.  (If you decide to use the mix as batter, you may want to add some salt.)

column9: So nice to have pancakes again
column10: After weeks on the limited choices in Atkins, trying this mix was nice alternative to eggs every morning! The consistency was a little chewy and the taste quite egg-y, but with sugar-free maple syrup I was still in heaven with every bite. I also sprinkled on some cinnamon for flavor. However, next time I'll try reducing to one egg instead of two, and see if this helps cut down the egg-iness. Not bad overall!

column9: twelve dollars for three boxes at the manufacturer site.
column10: Why pay that much here? No idea. Never tried the product but in shopping around, New hope mills sells this directly much cheaper than sellers here. Don't be robbed because you try to live LC.

I am diabetic and I have tried many no/low sugar, no/low Carbs pancake mix and this one is by far the best tasting. So much so that my last order I bought 3 boxes.  Buy it, you will not be disappointed!
Pretty good product.  It is not exactly like the real thing but it will help you through the diet when you have a pancake craving without the carbs.

column9: Good Stuff, more expensive, but only a 3 carb pancake
column10: Where else will you find a 3 carb pancake?  Buy guar gum and make your own maple syrup with no carbs. More expensive, but, if you are watching carbs, try this item.  The taste is not the same, but, once you doctor it up, it isn't half bad.  Pretty good, infact.

I used to be a cook in college making eggs and pancakes for breakfast in the college dining hall.  It wasn't actually gourmet but it at least was a pancake.  I followed the directions to the letter on the box which wasn't too difficult but, like the others low rating reviews, it came out like a watery flat omelet.  It had a strong taste of eggs, it didn't rise very well.  I chucked the rest of the box out.  You might get a better result if you cut the mix with a little regular flour or add more mix than recommended on the package, but I don't think its worth the effort.  Better to just eat a normal pancake with sugar free syrup than this stuff.
If you like whole wheat pancakes, you will love this mix. However, I personally don't like whole wheat pancakes. Atkins All Purpose Flour makes a much better tasting low carb pancake.

I got this due to it being one of the cheapest...  I only recently had started low carb.  I didnt want to commit to buying some big bag that I might not use a lot (never have been one to bake or make pancakes a lot).  I made a quiche with it and fried a few things using it.  No complaints from me at all,  I never once thought: "Man this isn't good... it's probably due to the low carb mix and I bet a regular one would be better!"
The pancakes looked good and rose up nicely.  However, they tasted like egg which I hate.  I was disappointed in the taste.
These are pretty heavy and retain a taste of oil.  Better than nothing, but certainly not good enough not to have to make the real deal for my 10 year old.
I can't say that these pancakes are the best I have ever had, but after not having any at all for awhile, they weren't bad!

column9: This is NOT the Atkins recipe
column10: Although this is advertized as the exact Atkins recipe (Hope MIlls bought the right to make it from Atkins), it is not.  Very bland, very tough waffles and pancakes.  What a rip-off!
I was shocked at the tiny box of product that I recieved when I ordered this mix. I really should have read the details better, buyer beware!
The batter whips up alright but for some reason the pancakes are a little on the rubbery side- they were cooked per pkg directions.

I developed a severe case of hives after eating this product for a month.  I am not sure it's from the product, but the hives went away after I stopped eating it.  I do eat a similar product from Maple Farms that doesn't give me the reaction.  Although both products contain Gluten, I am told by my doctor that this product may have some ingredients that are different from Maple Farms.  I'm sure not everyone would get this reaction, but I did and I wanted to put out a warning.

The reason I decided to purchase this item is because of the other positive reviews.  But, after tasting it, I am not sure that the other reviews have ever tasted a real pancake!  These are yellow in color, have a gritty texture, and a eggy taste, sort of like French toast (and I HATE French toast). I am sure the rest of the box will sit on the shelves until it expires.

After reading several of the other reviews, I decided to purchase this product,  mainly as a way to adopt a more low carb diet.  Here's the deal:  Right away you notice that the mixture is extremely eggy. The mixture has the look of a pancake and cooks all the way through easily enough.  The taste: tastes like a dried up omelette.  Very eggy taste.  Hard cardboard texture.  No amount of syrup can bury this flavor.  Was not able to get through even one pancake.  Very unsatisfied with this product.  Could never recommend to anyone.  If you are trying to lower your carb intake; eat smaller portions of carbs.
I HAVE NOT  TRIED THE MIX YET. SO I CAN NOT REVIEW THE PRODUCT

I had been trying out various drinks looking for a guilt free solution to my unhealthy habit of diet soda. We have great water at home from a deep, deep well and it tastes wonderful but I found that I was still too tempted by the satisfaction carbonation gives me getting through a long day. I was going to try some regular club soda but came across the Crystal Geyser Mineral Water and plopped it in my grocery cart instead.  So glad I did! It is so satisfying, even the unflavored kind, and I'm now thrilled to have a 0 calorie tasty drink that does not include all the acidic and health-damaging ingredients of soda. This keeps me from eating out of boredom too.  Plus, my grocery store carries this 42.27 ounce bottle for just 89 cents each, a much better buy than amazon... but because I love amazon and am a Prime member, I did come here to see if it would be worth it to purchase from them. In most cases they have a better deal but I'm guessing with the weight and special considerations of shipping bottled water, it can't happen.
This is the best, without a doubt.  Some tea that you get is supposed to be cinnamon and it tastes so very artificial.  This is real cinnamon, and of flavored black teas, it's my number 1.

There is no other cinnamon tea out there that compares to this.  It's extremely flavorful without being overly powerful or tasting too black tea-ish.  A friend gave me some and I went right to Cinnamon Heaven.  I can't stop drinking it!

This tea is pure cinnamon bliss. It's the only tea that I find tastes best with no sugar or cream, as the cinnamon naturally sweetens it and milk would decrease the flavor. The best way that I can describe the taste is much like a 'red hot' candy. It's just "wow". Wonderful.
This tea is one of my favorites, and I've had trouble finding it. It has a delightful cinnamon flavor without being overpowering.
I can't believe how much I love this tea.  I save it for special occasions or days when I really need a lift so I can enjoy the silk sachet and the aroma.

The tea was a Christmas gift: it arrived in a timely manner and was carefully packed and undamaged. The recipient is enjoying the tea very much - says it is fresh, fragrant and delicious and the tin is lovely.

I first discovered hot cinnamon sunset tea last winter while i was studying at B&N.  I needed something warm and comforting so I chose to try this tea and I was hooked!!!  I immediately purchased two tins so that I may enjoy it at home.  I wish I could find the tea in bulk however. It gets a little pricey and I don't need multiple tins.  Oh well, it's delicious nonetheless!  I don't drink any other hot tea anymore.  Sometimes I'll even bring a sachet to a restaurant and just ask for hot water.  :-)

I was in a tea room in St. Augustine with my mother and the man running the place asked if we would like to sample some tea. My response was, "no thank you, actually I hate tea... I've never found a tea that tastes like anything more than lightly-flavored hot water." So the man said, well just give me a minute and I'll bring you a tea that you'll like.  He brought us each a cup of Hot Cinnamon Sunset.  I was instantly hooked!  No sugar, no milk, no honey, just water and tea.  This tea is lovely.  You don't need anything in it and the longer you steep the bag (in no more than 6 oz. of water) the better it is.  So, I guess I can't say I don't drink tea anymore.  I'm out of that first box of tea and I am now ordering more.  Even if you don't like tea give this a try you might be surprised.

I bought this tea after my wife brought a couple of sachets home from a friend. I am not a huge fan of hot tea, but this cinnamon tea is wonderful. It is just strong enough to really enjoy. It also smells great. Now that the weather is cooling down again, I'm back in the mood for more tea. The 20 sachets were gone long ago, so I guess it is time to buy some more. The canister is also very nice - this would make a great gift for that hot tea lover in your family!

I love cinnamon tea! I have been eying this particular company on Amazon for a while now and finally decided to try the cinnamon tea. Oh my, it is heavenly! I have a new favorite tea! I am so in love with this tea that I ordered a 50 count of this and some Paris to try. Yum!

I love the sweet cinnamon flavor of this tea! I had hesistated entering the world of tea drinking. I've always been more of a coffee person, viewing tea as nice smelling water. However, this tea has completely changed my opinion! I highly recommend this!

column9: Felt like drinking tea with the queen
column10: Recently I purchased this tea for my sister,an avid tea drinker. When she opened the box she was " wowed" by the silk sachet,and, said she felt like she was drinking tea with the queen. She really liked the cinnamon and orange flavors,as well. I would purchase this product again. She's even sending me a sample to share in this tea tasting experience.

column9: THE very best Cinnamon Tea EVER!!
column10: Without a doubt this Harney & Sons Hot Cinnamon Sunset Tea has spoiled me from ever wanting to have any other tea! This is a very smooth and delicious tea that is so aromatic that it fills the room with the scent of cinnamon. It tastes divine and with a touch of honey I don't even want dessert- THIS IS dessert :) Best tea ever- and now I am a 'tea-snob' having tried this! Ordered two more after receiving the first tin! If you like cinnamon, you will LOVE this.

column9: Everyone in my office loves this tea
column10: This tea is one of the best I've ever had. It has a strong cinnamon flavor, smells wonderful, and has a nice sweetness after it brews for at least 5 minutes. (I recommend just leaving the tea bag in as you drink, because the flavor gets stronger and I didn't notice any bitterness.)Everyone in my office tried this tea and loved it. Plus it made the whole floor smell like cinnamon.

column9: Best flavored tea I've ever tasted.
column10: In short, this beats all the other teas.  I'm an everyday tea drinker but tend to shy away from flavored teas.  I was introduced to Harney and Sons by their fabulous Earl Grey Supreme.  While the Earl and I will remain good friends, this has become my new favorite tea for when I really have time to savor it.  From the scent to the flavor I can't get enough.  This isn't cinnamon roll cinnamon, more of a red-hot cinnamon flavor that is just strong enough to not hide the delicious tea.  Perfection unsweetened, and ambrosia when a little honey is added.  Great stuff.

column4: J P Simms III/Cross Community Church "J Simms"
column10: This tea is excellent and is one of our favorites. The flavor is absolutely wonderful. The service was quick and efficient. I highly recommend the tea. Ordering from Amazon.com made the whole process quite easy.
Product shipped as expected with a thank you note from vendor. Was very pleased. More words. Extra time. Blah. Yadayada

I was introduced to this tea by a co-worker. I noticed the wonderful smell of cinnamon in the break room. She gave me one of her beautiful, little silk sachet tea bags. I was immediately hooked. Delicious. Naturally sweet. Wonderful. I was so happy to find this available to purchase on-line because we bought out the local grocery store's supply. The tin is attractive, the silk sachets are charming, and best of all...the tea is delicious! I highly recommend this product. In fact, I am going to go brew a cup right now!

I agree with all the other reviewers here. This is astonishing tea. I wish I could set myself up for a lifetime supply. It has so much flavor and is deliciously sweet without sugar, and without being overpowering. The best.

column9: My favorite and I'm a coffee drinker
column10: This is my favorite tea. I am a coffee drinker, but love this tea in the evening or when I need memories of home. The flavor is wonderul and the smell is amazing.

column9: unbelievable!  This is the best tea ever...
column10: I love tea and in my day have tried hundreds of varieties.  Never before have I tasted a tea with such flavor.  I had to call Lara just to see if there was sugar added and it wasn't mentioned on the label!  This tea has such a wholesome, comforting, cinnamon taste with actual sweetness...without any sugar or artificial sweetener.  It's amazing and a feast for your taste buds.If you haven't tried this tea, get it now.  Lara is a total class act and the product is beyond belief.  You will LOVE this tea!  It's amazing!!!I actually ordered one tin...upon tasting, I ordered another three!
I first got this tea in a spa, I enjoyed it so much it, I've ordered more. It's delicious both hot and iced!It's a must have for tea lovers!Enjoy!
This is my hands-down favorite tea!  It's wonderfully spicy, and very flavorful.  It's hard for me to use up any of my other tea when I have this on hand.

taste & packaging were high quality but product is overpriced compared to "Hot Cinnamon Spice". Per Harney & Sons web site, the two products are EXACTLY THE SAME. Read their FAQ's & one of the first FAQ is PRECISELY about this. Unless a reviewer (AROBINSON in "Hot Cinnamon Spice" review, compared Spice & Sunset in a different package (sachet or teabag or loose leaf), there is absolutely no logical reason for the difference in taste (AND much higher price). I enjoyed the taste but felt it left a clove after-taste more than cinnamon. Seems like Harney is a quality Company with helpful info on the site but having 2 different names for the same EXACT product is strange/misleading. I am sorry I believed a review that lead me to think that there were 2 different products -- thanks! Product deserves 4 stars but I get crabby when I have been misled.

column9: Chia Seeds at a great price
column10: A pound of white chia seeds as described! From my understanding the only different between black and white chia seeds is the color, so I'm glad I purchased white chia seeds; they're still somewhat dark in liquids and I don't think I would have found the look of black ones very appetizing. While at my friendly neighborhood Uwajimaya, I happened upon this freak of nature: the Komforte Chockolates Ramen Noodle bar.After staring in dull incomprehension for some time, with occasional muttered interjections of "the hell?" and "but WHY?" and so forth, I bought it and took it home. Really, how could you not?When first opened, the bar looked pretty much like your run-of-the-mill fancy-pants chocolate bar; no sign of eight-for-a-dollar pasta in evidence.  Ah, but when I snapped off a piece, the mysterious amendment was revealed! It appeared to be in the same pre-fried but uncooked form that comes straight from the bag, with which starving students everywhere are intimately familiar.There was nothing left to do but try it. *nosh*The ramen noodles in this chocolate are pretty few and far between, offering more texture than taste; the texture itself is something akin to soft nuts or cornflakes. The shape, size and markings on the bar strongly suggest that Komforte is made and/or owned by the same outfit that makes Seattle Chocolates.The quality of the chocolate itself is pretty good. It's good enough that it could stand on its own without playing up the quirk factor (Komforte's other offbeat chocolate bar flavors include French Toast and Tortilla Lime + Salt), but then they probably wouldn't be able to command premium prices for these chocolate bars. I'll probably try the others just to see what they're like, but I suspect the novelty factor wears off pretty quickly -- and then all you have left to market is an overpriced chocolate bar.(This review was originally published in slightly modified form at the author's blog, Confessions of a Laundry Faerie.)

Researched and tried every xylitol hard candy in an attempt to alleviate dry mouth and save my teeth in the process. Xylitol candies are hard to come by and ones not made in China are even moreso. The Ricochet line is made in the US and is excellent quality. It is a dense little powdery "mint" as opposed to a hard candy - there must be a real difficulty in melting xylitol and making it into a "suckable" hard candy - so one has to get used to the more rapidly dissolving "powdery" kind. That said, this rasberry sour is by far the best flavor, but that might be just my personal preference. However, everyone in the family, from grandchildren to husband, all say "yes" when I offer them some! Even tho there's a hundred or so in the container. I get these on autoship because I never want to be without them.

These taste okay, but dissolve very fast. For Xylitol, I prefer Xyloburst Berry mints that take longer to dissolve, or you can chew them if you like.It's like this - when I first got these, I over-ate them. The dentist says to consume 6-10 mg of Xylitol per day for your teeth. Each piece of these candies contains .4 mg, and 1 tin has 100 pieces, or 40 mg. Too much Xylitol isn't dangerous, but it can cause uncomfortable bowel changes, which is what happened to me. So now I'm more cautious about it.My strategy now, is to have some candies that are easy to consume (like these) to get my 6-10 mg a day of Xylitol, as well as some other very yummy ones that have low Xylitol for the amount of time it takes to consume them, like Dr. John's lozenge shape hard candies or Sparx. I've got a candy bowl set out that starts out with a dozen .5 mg Xyloburst berry mints in it, that I either eat or substitute for other candies during the day, to keep track of the Xylitol, and I haven't had any more problems with eating too much of it this way. (I don't keep track of the hard candies or Sparx - I eat whatever I want of those.)FYI, Dr. John's website also sells Xylitol lemonade that's interesting to try. I've found it can be mixed different strengths according to your taste and mood, and leaves me wanting plain water afterwards rather than another sweet drink.

column9: Not a huge energy boost, but convenient for short-term perk
column10: I tend not to use energy drinks or boosters, but recently tried Monster Hitman's shooters to enhance my energy level before working out with weights and/or doing a long cardio session.  For me, it's a mixed bag of good and so-so, but nothing really bad.The taste is very sweet - I think it tastes 'just like' Otter Pops 12/18 ct. Box.  I'm not kidding... just like 'em!  Takes me back to hot summers in the 80's, which is not entirely a bad thing.  Being a shooter it's about two swallows and it's down, so even those who find it too sweet shouldn't have a problem taking this drink down.The energy boost comes primarily from B vitamins and caffeine.  It's recommended that you don't use any more than one in a 4hr period of time, or ingest other caffeinated beverages.  I drink it after my morning cup of coffee and haven't noticed any nervousness or increase in heart rate, thus I believe the amount of caffeine is probably minimal for most users.  Kids however shouldn't use this product.Taken approximately 15 minutes prior to a workout I notice I'm more alert and energized for about an hour, but a significant dip in that energy occurs during a hard workout.  I eat a small breakfast prior to drinking this shot and workout for approximately 90 minutes on weight days, 40 minutes on cardio days - totaling 5 workouts a week.  I used this for both, but found I liked Celsius Calorie Burner Green Tea Raspberry Acai 15/12oz much better for energy on weight training days because it seems to hold my energy better than this product.  Monster Hitman shooter is good for a boost before a 3 to 5 mile run, because it doesn't add too much fluid to your system (limiting the need to urinate) and because it gives you a boost as promised.Ginsing, taurine, B2, B3, B6, B12 and the 'energy blend' are all effective and so far, I've not found any side-effects using this product other than a headache if I take it on an empty stomach.  No stomach upset, just the headache.The reason I give it 4 versus 5 stars is more about the duration of the effectiveness - I think the boost's longevity - at least for me, is very limited.

Works very quickly but comes with a bad taste. They reminded me of the cold medicine I used to take when I was a child. (heavy syrup with uugggghhhhhh). But yes, for energy, it's effective. They should come up with the bubble gum flavor.

column9: So that's why they call it Holy Basil!
column10: I've been adding Tulsi Tea to my diet.  I love the peppermint flavor and drink it daily along with my other great teas.I didn't really care for the flavor of this honey chamomile tea.  I don't think it was the honey flavor that was bothersome- actually the Tulsi just seemed at odds with the chamomile.  It actually tastes a bit like basil, which I hadn't experienced with the peppermint, I guess because the tastes meshed so well together.  In this cup, I actually felt like I was drinking Basil-Chamomile tea.I can say I've never tasted the anise flavor that people find prevalent in Tulsi teas.
I really did not like this tea. i general love chamomile tea and drink a lot of different brands  but this one has a strong honey flavor that totally overpowers chamomile.
I received the tea very fast.  It is a delightful tea and I sleep so well after having it near bedtime.  Thank you for being so helpful.

column4: Allen S. Burks / Martin Burks Chevy
column9: So glad I found these oyster crackers!
column10: Keebler Oyster Crackers have been a favorite of mine for years.  They are buttery, crunchy and absolutely the best I have ever tasted!  Then, that familiar red box became harder and harder to find in local stores in metro Atlanta.  I could occasionally find boxes at Publix, but then they dissapeared.  After months of frustration I found a Publix Manager and asked him why they no longer carried Keebler Oyster Crackers.  He dissapeared for about 10 minutes, returned with a puzzled face and said "they have been discontinued.  I just checked with my distributor."  WHAT?!!  You are kidding me, right?  Well, maybe they have been discontinued in Atlanta. Or, maybe they have been discontinued in boxes.  But, it just didn't make sense to me that Keebler would discontinue their oyster crackers all together...This is why I checked to see if Amazon offered these crackers.  Amazon did, and after about 2 years of frustration I  ordered these crackers right away!  I was thrilled to see them offered! Plus, they came to my front door in a few days.These 0.5 oz. packs are just right and go great with any soup or chili.  The price was good too.You can bet that I will order these again!
I am very pleased with the Keebler Oyster Crackers. I shared them with family. They are good as a snack and good in chili or soup.The price was right and I will purchase again.Dianne Long
Keebler crackers are wonderful! These crackers melt are  in your mouth delicious. They are so  good  I will definitely buy them again!
Compared to the Burry oyster crackers, the Keeblers are less salty and more fluffy.  Like a ritz cracker but less salt

I realize all at once that I've been eating (and enjoying) third-rate oyster crackers all these years -- compared to these Keebler oyster crackers, all other oyster crackers taste like paste! These are light and flaky with a lot of flavor. They remind me more of Ritz Crackers than of saltine-type crackers. The package (0.5 ounce) is just right for a bowl of soup or chili. These are a major step up from supermarket oyster crackers. I had no idea what I was missing!
WE'VE PURCHASED THESE OYSTER CRACKERS IN THE PAST AND LOVED THEM,THIS TIME THEY ARRIVED STALE - ALMOST RANCID. WHAT A DISAPPOINTMENT.THEY CANNOT BE RETURNED SINCE THEY ARE GROCERY ITEMS.

This cheese is a mystery b/c seller had no FDA label saying what we are consuming and by law they have to provide this,  i asked MANY times and there's no reply re: what it is.Its  3 pounds ( 3 seperate bricks of ) smoked flavor and really expensive.  ( arrives on ice packs )Tastes like motz rather than swiss.  You can buy better at your local deli for a high jacked price and no info from the smokehouse seller.Its ok but a mystery food.
I send this cheese to my mother. She loves cheese. This cheese is good quality, come in wonderful box. I recomended this one as good present for everybody.
An outstanding product, reasonably priced and the shipping was very prompt! I would highly recommend this to anyone looking for a high quality cheese at an affordable price.

column9: Good stuff and good for you!
column10: I use a lot of Caraway in my cooking....I was brought up on this, coming from a traditional Polish back ground!  From what I know, Caraway is a good food product for our bodies too.  This product is priced right and is of great quality.  I would certainly buy it again.
My husband loves rye bread made in the bread machine and amazon (Seller: Starwest Botanicals) is the best price I've found for organic caraway seeds.
I mainly bought these for my favorite caraway tea. Just put 1 teaspoon per cup and pour hot water. It's organic and tastes great!
This was a no-brainer----to get this quantity, and organic for this price, and they are good for your digestive system

The absolute worst company I have ever placed an order with.  Three weeks after placing my order I finally get word that my order had been returned because the bag tore, then they say they are out of this product and will not send any more.  So if you don't really want your product this is the place to go.

column9: The AD is miss leading and and untrue.
column10: I really hate leaving a bad review; this ad is misleading, and just plain wrong. This is NOT an issue of the product being bad.  It is an issue of the information given in the ad is misleading and untrue.  I cannot give it 5 stars, since I did NOT get what I expected to get, regardless of whether or not the bone is good. (I would not be leaving this feed back if this ad had been corrected. I asked that the ad be corrected, so that others are not misled too. I have waited over a week, and IT HAS NOT BEEN CORRECTED! So I feel I must share this information with others.)I ordered this product because the ad said that the retail value was $57.60, at a cost of $1.72.  It goes on to say that you are saving 97%.  I should have known that it was UNTRUE, but I read on and the more I read, I began to believe that it was a closeout item, and a good deal.They talk about "femur bones" (PLURAL); and the shipping weight is "1 pound;" as well as, the picture shows you 3 bones. So I assumed at the very least I would get 3 bones, and it was a reasonable, if I got free shipping by meeting their minimum.  Since I could not envision 3 bones having a retail value was $57.60; so I ordered, the "bones" with the hope that there were more. I assumed that this must be a closeout, and I thought I was going to get a good deal.  WHAT I GOT was 1 femur bone, if I had known it was ONE bone, I would NOT have ordered. ONE bone with a retail value of $57.60?????To the company's credit, they did refund me when I complained about being misled by the information in the ad. I have not seen the correction on my billing yet, but I would assume that since they told me it was being issued, that it will be on my next statement.Please note: You are NOT getting a good buy, or what you think you will get when ordering this product.  Since you get ONE bone; I believe that this one 6 oz bone at $1.72, plus $5.49 shipping is too expensive.  You are paying($7.21) for one bone that would cost $2.00 or less at a pet store.

Finally opened the package, and use these for the 200pm mid day work slump to remove junk food cravings. These bars satisfy immensely; don't feel hungry, tired or irritable and they look and taste fresh.  They are chewy, providing texture and mouth satiety.  Will definitely order again.  Purchasing by the case is cheaper than other stores.

I purchased this tea set for a friend who is into tea and it shipped quickly in lovely packaging and made a great gift. Also, the friend said all the teas are delicious and he loves being able to mix and brew.

My sister-in-law brought these from the UK, and gave me a box as a gift. Now I am totally hooked!!! All the chocolates are sooo delicious!  And as another reviewer noted, they are all great, unlike many assorted chocolate boxes where only half are good.  These make great gifts too.

These rock!  My Grandparents brought them every year when they came to the U.S. from England for a visit. The other post says it right. "They all taste good!!"  If you want English Candy at it's best this is the stuff!  -STERLING

I'm from Canada, we've been two years in Florida, one of our friends brought back a tin last year from Netherlands, now that i realize you can have them shipped, we will be able to enjoy our family tradition this year...lovely gift and eveyrone of them are yummy! i like the green hazelnut ones the best.A high quality product...All my christmas shopping is finished!Cheers

How many times do you get a box and bite into one of the chocolates and have to spit it out?  Not here.  Quality Street is the ONLY box (tin) of chocolates where I like all the chocolates.  Great as a gift!

Quality Street Candies are full of flavor. They are not like other candies or chocolates that are just too sweet. Quality Street candies give you the taste of every single kind and flavor they offer in the tin or bag: caramel, chocolate,coconut, almond, etc. They are great!I am so glad I found them again. They will bring back good memories. My mother used to buy them every year at Christmas time.

Although this was described as being a Mackintosh product it turned out to be Nestle. Could be that my taste buds have changed since leaving England but it didn't taste as good as I remembered, seemed more like the product that is available here in the States. My disappointment could just be my recollection that is why I am giving a three star. I received the product in great condition and it was shipped very promptly from England so I do not fault the seller.

column9: Nestle Quality Street Candies, actual Tin size
column10: I love Quality Streets and was delighted to see them on here, but I feel I was mislead with the description and picture. I was expecting the normal size (larger) tin for this $27.75, but instead I got a less than half size tin. The picture is misleading with no scale reference. I've seen this often on here especially around Brit foods, they find the smallest package picture them as the norm that we are familiar with and flog them at the large package price. Elsewhere on the net I could have bought the large tin for less than they charged for this small tin had I known what to expect.
Love love love this candy.  When I was a kid it was call "MacIntosh" and only came from England.  So glad to find it here and be able to share with my children.
Quality Street is our favourite sweets especially at the holidays and now we have introduced it to others who feel the same. Thanks for the great service
Love this candy,haven't seen it in stores in years, glad to remember the name and get it for Christmas. It is a little pricey but I will buy again next year.
The candy came on time and well packed. It is fresh and taste great. This candy is very good, have told my friends about my order. Would and will buy again!

This is a treasure of the absolutely finest quality chocolate confections. Have had these since my childhood in UK. You will not be disappointed with this choice. Buy and enjoy. Received them in very short time.
I have been eating Quality Street all my life - fantastic.Every Christmas I buy them for my children and grandchildren.

The product arrived on time and believe or not it was not melted, as I live in Las Vegas. Good job on the shipping and the time frame.  The only compliant I do have is its not milk chocolate as you expect from England.  It taste like good ol USA candy.

I have been loving this candy for 21 years. The two tin's I bought were sealed, but the candy was atrocious. Dis-colored, mis-shapened, crystaized.send back. Really a heart breaker...was for a neices' birthday...Blayne Christian, Napa, Ca.

This Item has been My Favorite For 30 Years.I have purchased This Item For My Girlfriend In U.S.A And She Really Loved It, As She Never heared of This brand Before.In My Country We Purchase This Item For All Occasions.So It's A Great Gift For Everyone.

I purchased this product and it was inedible having gone bad long before it was shipped to me. Apparently the return window on this product is only 7 days so they would not replace the item, despite it being only 2 weeks since I had received the product.Clearly chocolate in a tin should still be edible long after 2 weeks have passed.

The product was stale, 8 months old. My package was unaccounted for almost 10 days. I contacted customer service several times inquiring about my shipment, and did not get any help. I will not recommend or use their services again.
Got this as a gift for someone who reported that it was a nice mix and was delighted that 8 cookies were only 150 calories.

This was a beautiful birthday gift set. Everything is fresh and I felt so special as I opened the box because there was a huge birthday poster card. This is the perfect gift box for a secretary, best friend or daughter.It has such a lovely assortment of goodies that are actually healthy for you.I will be ordering this item for a very close friend real soon.

I order this for my dad when I couldn't be there for his birthday. He opened it while he was on the phone with me. He told me the package came in great condition, all the food was fresh and delicious, and the card made him feel really special. Overall a great gift.

I only drink whole-bean, grind-it-youself coffees. Sorry, I just couldn't go back to those other hot dark liquids that other people call coffee. No, once you get used to grinding your own you're hooked. The question might be, where do you get good whole bean coffees at a reasonable price? Grocery store prices for one-pound bags tend to be high. Likewise, specialty shops can be very high. I've found two good sources: Trader Joe's and Costco, plus a wide variety can be found online. For the past few years I have switched almost entirely over to my local Costco. A problem with Costco is that they may have only two different kinds, but the kinds may change every other time you go there.You just don't have much choice unless you work at it a bit. However, every bag I've bought has been excellent. Well, it better be because you can only buy it in three pound bags.My latest acquisition is a three-pound bag of Jose's 100% Columbia Supremo. Mmmmmm. Nice aroma! It's a medium roast, soft and mellow. No harsh aftertaste. It reminds me of Trader Joe's Columbia Supremo, and I understand that is just the government's grade for Columbia's finest. In any case, it's a nice coffee and I'll have no trouble getting through it. I might add, that I like to switch types from bag to bag and I've now tried coffees from all major growing areas of the world.Gary Peterson
But you get get it at Costco for HALF this price! Outrageous ripoff here. It is pretty good, it has a good bold taste.

You can find this one at Costco, at least in Southern California. It's really great for making "Turkish" Coffee (or whatever you name you have for it) - just make sure you finely grind it. It's the best we've found so far.

column9: lots of pearls for the price
column10: I make spice cookies rolled in pearl sugar.  I have a hard time finding pearl sugar in stores and when I do, it is expensive.  This is a very large jar that should easily last me a couple of Christmas seasons and it was less than half the price per ounce than my previous finds.  A good product and a good deal.
This is a big jar for a great price! These non-pareils are awesome, cute and well worth it!

this is the best grated 3 cheese blend I have ever tried.  it actually melts when it is on pasta --  thin strings of cheese drip down.  It is not dry or salty but almost creamy and has great taste.  I have never written a review before but want Amzn to carry the 5 pound size.  $30 for 5 pounds of cheese is $6 a pound.  $6 a pound for amazing parmesan, asiago and romano.  This really is the best deal around.

Nature's Path Maple Pecan Crunch is by far the tastiest cereal I've had in a very long time. You can feel good about supporting this company because they are committed to sustainable farming and Earth-friendlier business practices (according to the marketing on the box anyway). Even if you didn't care about that, you'll like the cereal. I'm eating it right now straight out of the box as I write this review. It's very hard to stop! The flax flakes and rolled oat clusters are very crunchy and satisfying. I can also clearly taste the maple syrup flavor.One box is 6 servings, with each serving providing 220 calories (60 from fat) and 20% of your daily dietary fiber intake (5g). If I had any complaints, it's that the box is a bit small. It is only 11.5 ounces compared to 13 or 14 for other Nature's Path cereal which contain 7 servings. Secondly, the sugar content could perhaps be toned down a bit to trim back some calories because it's very sweet. One serving is counted as 3/4 cup, compared to 1 cup for many other cereals. Because of the pecans, it packs more energy (calories) into a smaller volume than, say, Kellogg's Raisin Bran Cereal, which counts 1 cup as a serving, with 190 calories (15 from fat).At any rate, it's a very delicious cereal and one I'll be buying it again!

This is a favorite in our house. There are many different variations of this cereal, but the Maple Pecan Crunch is our favorite. It is a little high in sugar (10mg per 3/4 cup), but that is to be expected with "Maple" in it. There are 5g of fiber per 3/4 cup, so that is great.

I bought a 6 pack case of this when it first came out and liked it so much I set up a subscription.  Half way through my second order I finally asked my wife if the cereal seemed to have less pecans and less bunches.  When I asked she told me she was wondering the same thing.  Well I just received my third case and I have no need to ask anyone.  My first bowl had almost no pecans in it and no crunchy clusters.  Just to be sure this wasn't a fluke of a bowl I pulled the cereal from the box and found myself staring at what looked like a plain bran flake cereal.  I really had to look hard to see anything other than bran flakes.I'm very disappointed with what started off as a very good cereal. My subscription has been cancelled.
This cereal had been a favorite for awhile. In the stores around here, it costs as much as $4.79 per box.  Occasionally, it was on sale at kroger, but never as low as Amazon. I bought 12 boxes!

Favorite cereal ever.  The only downside is it's so delicious, that I am tempted to eat it not just for breakfast but after dinner for a snack/dessert.  Actually in the past I'd only eat cereal maybe 1 or 2 times a week, but the Maple Pecan Crunch has changed that.  You can both taste and smell that it's genuine maple syrup.  The cereal is just the right amount of sweet - not overly sweetened.  Nice crunch.  It would be even better if it had more pecans, but that's easily added.

I always thought I hated anything with flax in it.  Yuck!  Well, who knew???  This cereal is without a doubt the best I have EVER eaten.  It's so good I order it by subscription from Amazon so I never run out of it. I don't know what possessed me to buy it for the first time because I had never enjoyed "healthy" breakfast food.  Mostly, they tasted like cardboard.  Well all that's changed.  Now we eat it for breakfast, snacks (dry) and sometimes dinner!  Try it, you'll LOVE it.

column9: It's like having dessert for breakfast
column10: This cereal tastes so delicious I almost feel guilty for eating it for breakfast. It's almost like having dessert first thing in the morning! Sweet crunch maple clusters bursting with flavor yet not overly sweet, it's perfectly balanced...Yum! Decent fiber content is also a plus.I found myself grazing on it all day for a snack.

column9: Sweet treat and healthy too. Strong maple taste.
column10: Bought it on sale and am fully satisfied with product. Beats most other organic offerings in  breakfast section.Little more sweet than usual cereals but in line with muesli and granola.Kids still prefer the chex or life but this is so much healthier.We sometimes do dinner with it.

I thought as a healthy organic cereal, the taste would be rather lackluster.However, this is probably one of the best tasting cereals out there! It is a little on the sweet side as one might expect, but it's nice knowing that this cereal isn't drowned in hfcs like so many other cereals.They certainly did not skimp out on the pecans and the flax and oat clusters. The flakes also hardly get the really soggy feel like when you leave corn flakes in milk for too long.As a plus, the company is committed to sustainability and healthy products.

Hubby's on a health kick right now, so when this cereal went on major sale, I purchased it. Luckily, it was very very good. :) The whole family enjoys it. Will def buy again, but only when it's on a really good sale again.

I thought it was good, too sweet, but good. I mixed my cereal with rice crispies or cornflakes and I liked the result a lot better. I'd probably buy again for the right price, knowing I'd be mixing it half and half with another cereal.
I like it because of the following reasons:Maple syrup gives good aroma,Pecan nuts provides healthy fat, andcereal is crisp.These satisfy me.It is hard to stop eating.

Because its called Flax Plus Maple, I shouldn't have been surprised that it was maple flavored, but they went a bit too heavy handed with the maple.  Its overwhelming.  However, if cut with 75% of another cereal, such as muesli or granola, you get just the right amount of maple.  However, if you love to flood your pancakes with more syrup than pancakes, this would be perfect right out of the box.

I bought a six pack of this cereal when I saw it on sale because I eat a lot of cereal and therefore get sick of the various brands and makes pretty quickly. I had never tried this but had seen it in the store (usually for double the price of Amazon)so I thought I would give it a try.I have to say that I was pleasantly surprised. If you like maple flavor, you will probably enjoy this. It has pecan chunks, which aren't super healthy but do taste good. It also has oatmeal clusters that are somehow very light and add nicely to the flavor of the flakes which taste good as well. There is a decent amount of flax seed in the mix as well, which I am trying to eat more of. Overall it is sweet enough that my 4-year-old enjoys it but probably healthier than most of the sugar cereals out there. I bought three more six packs a week later and have yet to get sick of it. I will probably order this again.

I actually had to think about this product for a couple of weeks before purchasing it. I was nervous about the organic and flax. I didn't want to purchase something that would taste like cardboard. But with maple and pecan how could it be bad?? So I decided to give it a try and I am so happy that I did. The crunch pieces are huge and they are not cheap with the pecans. This cereal is great. Boxes are kind of small though.

I got these on a "health whim", you know those times when you really know you should be eating better. I thought I would hate them, but they are okay. No, they don't make me as happy as Cookie Crisps or Frosted Flakes, but they are pretty good for a health food and something I have been able to incorporate in to my diet. Yes, them I am eating them I sometimes wonder if I would still get the health benefit is a rolled them in melted butter and melted marshmallows making little "flax crispy treats", but there isn't a more tasty way to get this much fiber in your breakfast - so feel good trying them even if you aren't a "health nut". I am pretty sure I wouldn't be getting flax in my diet any other way!

Make note of the ozs / box, as it's not your typical junk cereal. Organic and nutritious ingredients keep you full with less, and you don't crash mid-morning. @ $7.98 for 6 (it's $5/box elsewhere), we couldn't pass it up. The taste takes some getting used to if you're accustomed to garbage, but the subtle sweetness really grows on you.

Nutritionally solid and very flavorful cereal, USDA organic which is about the only guarantee that the ingredients are wholesome, perfect start to your day. To add to that Natures Path has a great environmentally friendly business model which is a terrific bonus

column9: Has wheat in it. Not GF
column10: This cereal came up listed among the other GF cereals. Probably because there is a similar cereal by same company that is GF. So I wasted some grocery money on it. Hope my hubby likes it, I can't eat it. I should have looked closer before purchasing.
Nice to have these organic granola cereal.  My kids love them and they are a healthy snack.  I give them at their lunch for an extra  treat.  Love the taste.

The one star rating is really for the way this product is listed, not the actual cereal.  This cereal is listed under gluten free cereals in Amazon, and it is not gluten free. Wheat is the first ingredient. The name is very similar to Nature's Path Organic Crunchy Maple Sunrise, which I thought I was buying, not realizing there were two cereals with similar names made by the same company. Now I have 6 boxes of unusable cereal in my house. Things I learned: don't take Amazon's search results at face value; read every ingredient on the label of everything I buy, even if I think it's safe.

column9: Got 6 packs, then 4 packs left to feed my chickens.
column10: Ok, I don't like it all! The cereal tasted like cardboard box, and has nasty flavor. Finally I had 4 boxes left cause nobody wanted to eat them. I didn't want to waste them, so I used them to feed my chicken.

There is not much more to say.  There's a nice balance; not too much sugar, but enough to enjoy.  The flavor is surprising, in that usually something that carries this many healthy items generally will need to be forced down.  I only got to the bottom of the fourth box, as my seventeen year old seems to enjoy it as well.  That being said, I'm not sure if there were not enough nuts/pecans, or that they all fell into his bowls.  I hope the price doesn't go up.  There was one other cereal we kept religiously with maple and pecans from a health food store, but the price shot up to four and five dollars, plus, so we stopped buying that one.  Thanks Nature's Path.
My husband started a gluten free diet for Celiac and cereal is a daily meal for breakfast.  This box did not last 3 days.

column4: Michelle K. Westenbroek "Can't live without b...
column10: The combination of flakes, maple and pecans makes this cereal unique.  I first bought it from the grocery store and got hooked.  My grocery store only had it in stock once in a while, and then stopped entirely.  I love the Amazon Subscribe and Save program not only because I get my favorite cereal cheaper, but I never have to worry that it won't be on the shelves when I shop.

column9: was good last year, recently got just corn flakes
column10: we subscribed to this last year, it was full of nuts and oats and pecans etc, but the last 2 shipments we got seemed to have just the flakes, none of the pecans oats and other good stuff were in it, it felt like we were eating just tanned corn flakes. ended up unsubscribing.
I enjoyed this cereal. It had good for me things but even though it was maple it wasn't too sweet

I love this cereal and Amazons customer service is excellent. I had problems with my first order of this cereal with it being too close to the expiration date and tasting old, so I called Amazon and they apologized and sent out a new order free of charge right away. I didn't even have to return the old cereal and jump through hoops to get it made right. Excellent customer service Amazon!

This is a great tasting cereal. Not really low on calories but a nice fiber count. I use  to add crunch to parfaits as well as cereal. Will Buy it again and again. The organic and flax is an added bonus to the great taste.

This 6-pak of healthful natural cereal was among the first food items we ordered from Amazon.  The order was carefully and promptly shipped to our front doorstep.  The "special discount" price was unbeatable as well.  The product arrived fresh and, as advertised, is a wholesome breakfast cereal or--for some--may be eaten dry as snack food.  Good product; great deal on this case of 6 boxes!

This cereal is fantastic.  I have had 2 packages of 6 boxes now, and I will say that it is extremely good.I will occasionally open a box that is less flavorful than what I believe is typical for this brand, but still decent.  I have refrained from docking the item a star for that because I understand that this could be for any number of reasons, and it's an uncommon occurrence.It's full of pecan chunks, and has a delicious and strong, but not overpowering, maple flavor.
This is the best cereal that we've ever had. The sweetness is just right, not like most other cereal that are usually way too sweet. There are 10gr of sugar per saving.
Amazing cereal.  Great taste.  I ate it so quickly, and I was hooked after the promotion.  You have to love that it is healthy too.

The only reason I give this 4 stars instead of 5 is because there is just not enough cereal in the box. I didn't mind too much because I got it on sale at a great price. I also think that my husband was taking WAY more than a serving size when he would eat it. The cereal is delicious though and the ingredients are awesome. I wish more cereal companies would make cereal like this without the preservatives!

I'm the type of person who has coffee in the morning and heads out. Not anymore. Nowadays I sit down and eat breakfast. This cereal is that good. No artificial flavors or preservatives. Whole grains, maple syrup, pecans...yum. Got a pack of 6 and it was gone in two weeks. Don't hesitate to buy for children, the kids I babysit couldn't get enough of it. Their mom now buys it.I like that I can read/recognize all of the ingredients:Organic whole wheat meal, organic rolled oats, organic evaporated cane juice, organic wheat bran, organic pecans, organic flax, organic soy oil, organic brown rice flour, organic oat bran, organic barley malt extract, sea salt, organic maple syrup, organic coconut, natural maple flavor, organic oat syrup solids, organic molasses, organic cinnamon.Each serving has 220 calories and 5g of daily fiber (which is 20 percent of your total). I've been trying to find a cereal with a lot of fiber that tastes good. I find most don't taste very good. According to WebMD, most Americans only get 14g of fiber. I usually have two servings of this cereal for breakfast, so I'm halfway to my allotment of daily fiber.My nutritionist at Carolina advised me a diet high in whole grains and fiber leads to less weight over the years. Maybe this cereal doesn't help you lose weight, but it certainly doesn't put it on. These aren't empty calories, this cereal is filling and nutritious.

This is a delicious cereal, but equally as important, it's very filling. I tried the Special K thing for a while and was finding myself hungry about two hours later, which lead to snacking. I was a little hesitant to try this, since I find their Maple Pecan Granola Bars to be too sweet for my taste, but the cereal is spot-on. The flakes balance out the maple crunchy bits very well.That all being said, I still think I prefer their Organic Flax Plus Pumpkin Granola Cereal over the Maple Pecan Crunch, but this is a very good change of pace.
Bought this on subscribe to save & with extra discount added, so very good price & taste very good.  No complaints.

ok, I'm the kind of guy that likes sugary cereals like  cocoa puffs, and peanut butter crunch, and other sugar cereals that really have no value. however, there are some cereals that I like that are good and nutritious, and this one is my all time favorite! it's not full of sugar like the cereals I mentioned, but it tastes excellent! I just mentioned those other cereals to give you an idea of the crappy cereals I like and this probably one the best "healthy" cereals I've ever eaten! I highly recommend it!

column9: Superb Cereal, Good for Diabetics, Too!
column10: This cereal is so delicious, it's hard to find words. Please be aware that the maple flavor is not synthetic, it's real. Yum. For those with diabetes, it's an excellent breakfast choice, low on the glycemic index, high in protein and Omega 3s, low in carbs. I can't think of a better cereal than this one, and an excellent value as well.

This product is amazing to me.  I've tried many different brands...and I mean many.  The various cat litters I've tried always seemed to have one drawback, it's too dusty, can't stand the sweet nauseating scents (neither can my cats), and does not cover up soiled cat litter, just makes it worse from the combination.  I have had some difficulty trying to get my cats to use the other brands, but they did not like them and sometimes left me little messes to remind me.  Since I've purchased Arm & Hammer Super Scoop (and I will never buy another brand), everything is peaceful in my home and I've noticed the absence of "little messes".  This cat litter has very little dust, if any, is unscented, clumps nicely, and best of all, my cats like it.  Additionally, the perfume some brands use are toxic to cats, because when they groom themselves, they will ingest the chemicals from the perfume. I've had friends over with a very strong sense of smell, and they agreed that they could not smell urine or stool, and this was several days after I cleaned the cat pan.  I would highly recommend this product to anyone who loves their cats and kittens.

As others have noted, the clumps don't really stick together all that well. Plus, the litter itself doesn't seem to do anything about ammonia smell from cat pee, so it'll about knock you over when you go to scoop the box (unless maybe you scoop it every time the cat uses it, or something). I expected better from Arm & Hammer. If you're considering buying this, just don't. Get Fresh Step instead; Fresh Step's unscented litter actually controls litterbox odors, unlike this stuff.
Doesn't clump well at all. Breaks into pieces. Worse than average for odor control. Scoop Away is a much better litter.

I switched to this litter because our usual brand was not among the Subscribe and Save listing and I wanted to take advantage of that great program.  I felt very confident in going with Arm & Hammer because of the 5 star ratings and reviews, but YUK!  We've got 3 cats and this litter did not eliminate the smell from our laundry room at all, which I'm sure is due to the fact that the urine did not clump.  The litter box really was never clean unless I changed the litter entirely.  I do not recommend this product, and I'm thrilled to report that Tidy Cat is now a part of the Subscribe and Save program!

Highly reccomend.

column9: A very healthy breakfast cereal with just a few minor drawbacks...
column10: Product 19 is an excellent breakfast cereal. It has absolutely no fat, no trans fat, no cholesterol, and it is rather low in sugar content. Excellent! Product 19 even has 100% of vitamins C, E, B12, B16, iron and other nutrients as well. Very impressive! (Amazon states that it has only 10% of these nutrients but that is incorrect.)On the other hand, the cereal is low in fiber and it contains sodium and carbohydrates. Check the label to see if you're comfortable with the amounts of ALL the ingredients in this cereal before buying it. Product 19 is something that grew on me; I initially didn't like it but I kept eating it in the morning for health reasons. Over time I appreciated the taste more and more. This may be true for you, too. Not everyone will find this cereal to be tasty the very first time they eat it. You could add a few strawberries or blueberries on top of the cereal to make it sweeter; these berries are also very healthy for you, too.The packaging is attractive. The sealed plastic bag inside the box keeps the cereal fresh even a couple of months beyond the expiration date on the box.Overall, Product 19 is an excellent cereal for people who care about what they eat. It may take a little getting used to because of the taste and the consistency of the cereal flakes. Despite the "taste factor" and a few drawbacks concerning sodium and carbohydrates, I highly recommend this cereal as part of a healthy diet.

I'm a long time tea and lover and only rarely do I buy packaged teas, preferring loose leave teas instead. But I bought a bunch of these new pyramid tea bagged teas because they just looked so neat.This Lipton truffle one is the second one I'm trying.Packaging: I love the pyramid tea bags. I think they really work well, at a minimum they allow bigger tea leaves because there is more space inside the bag for the water to swirl the leaves around. The negative about this is that the bags are not individually wrapped (difficult to wrap a pyramid shape) so I try to use up all 20 bags as quickly as possible lest the flavor escapes.Flavor: Not usually a great fan of flavored teas because sometimes the flavor overwhelms the tea taste and you end up drinking flavored water with tea. This one is not bad. It's hard to mix all 3 flavors together and taste all 3. On smelling it, it smells strongly of caramel. On tasting it, the vanilla and caramel flavor is rather weak, the truffle flavor is stronger and you end up with a coffee-ish tasting tea, which isn't bad. After reading the other reviews, butterscotch, musty or even musky come to mind.In the end, all taste is subjective so you really have to try it yourself (and just buy 1 box first). In my humble opinion, I would summarize this as a coffee-ish tasting desert tea. I add sugar to my tea, so with the caramel or butterscotch and coffee taste this is definitely a desert tea. I wouldn't drink this everyday, but I would buy it again.N.B. Make sure you rinse your teapot or cup quickly after drinking this as the caramel flavor can remain quite a while.

column9: I guess I must be spoiled by Stash & PG Tips Teas!
column10: I guess I must be spoiled by Stash & PG Tips brand teas.This Lipton Black Vanilla Caramel Truffle tea is a very *scantly* filled teabag.  2 of them barely make the same strength as 1 PG Tips tea bag, and for a fuller richer 12 oz cup you should use 3 bags.
