column9: The Second New Flavor of the Quintessential Condiment!
column10: This was the second modern variation on an essentially unchanged, bestselling product for more than 140 years.  Other flavors are:Orginal Pepper Sauce (hot) (2500-5000 Scoville Heat Units),Green Pepper Sauce (milder yet) (600-1200 Scoville Heat Units),Garlic Pepper Sauce (milder) (1200-2400 Scoville Heat Units),Chipotle Pepper Sauce (mild) (1500-2500 Scoville Heat Units),Sweet & Spicy Pepper Sauce (mildest) (100-600 Scoville Heat Units),but this is Habanero Sauce (hottest) (>7000 Scoville Heat Units).Dueling histories of the McIlhenny Company are available: (authorized) Tabasco: An Illustrated History and (unauthorized) McIlhenny's Gold: How a Louisiana Family Built the Tabasco Empire, for those curious about how this most remarkable product and business empire came to be.Note: "A pharmacist named Wilbur Scoville invented the Scoville Scale in 1912 to measure the heat of peppers. A 'Scoville Unit' is actually a measure of capsaicin (the chemical in hot peppers that is responsible for their heat).Scoville's test was a comparative taste test that is considered subjective by today's standards. A more sophisticated method is in use today, but in honor of Wilbur Scoville, the unit of measure is still called the Scoville.The capsaicin level in peppers can vary from plant to plant due to local environmental conditions. This means that a pepper's rating is an average measure.The hottest pepper on record is the Bhut Jolokia with a pungency of over 1 million Scoville Heat Units (1,001,304, to be exact). By contrast, the Bell Pepper comes in at less than 100 Scoville Heat Units."
It adds some zest to whatever you put it on. Meat, vegetables, whatever. It is not so hot that it overpowers the food either. just adds a nice bite.

column9: A Little Flavor and a LOT of Heat Go a Long Way
column10: Habanero has two great advantages as a pepper--tremendous flavor and tremendous heat.  The Tabasco habanero sauce captures both, especially the latter.  It's got a serious bite.  A bit too much in my mind, to be honest.  More problematic is the consistency.  For some reason Tabasco's habanero sauce is much thicker than Tabasco's other sauces (and the Yucatan Sunshine habanero sauce).  This is particularly problematic when using the itty-bitty 2 oz. bottle.

The McIlhenny's  have done what very few in this space have been able to manage. They have engineereda habanero elixir for the extreme palate that tastes good on just about everything, and I do mean everything.I've got over 50 different brands of hot sauce in my collection and this jewel from Tabasco has pretty muchobsoleted all of them. It's got a mild island flavor reminiscent of a jerk/calypso sauce and it's guaranteedto make everything from bar-b-que to hamburgers to collard greens to bloody marys and even salads tastes better.It doesn't have that sting regular Tabasco has that hasn't been properly aged, but it will bite you, and it willbite you hard if you're not judicious with the amount you're pouring on. The best thing about this sauce is thatis commercially available just about everywhere. And at this price ($2.40) it makes sense to buy several bottles,cause they don't last long. And unbelievably, my local Publix stocks these 2oz. bottles for $6.99 each! Will rateout at about 8,000 Scoville units, and thats enough for most aspiring pepperheads.Warning - This stuff is addictive. After a couple of weeks on this juice you'll get the "hot sauce slobbers"every time you walk through your grocery's butcher shop. Don't say I didn't warn you. 5 Scovies!

If other hot sauces leave you feeling cold, try Tabasco Habanero Sauce. It adds great flavor and plenty of heat. Just a couple of drops is enough to leave a satisfying burn on your tongue and lips. I love sprinking it on chicken, eggs, and pasta. Just great!Buy a bigger bottle though. The 2 oz bottle won't last very long, trust me.

These fruit gems were delicious as expected.  I went for this packaging as a nostalgic gift for me wife.  I did have an issue with the packaging and selection in the box.  All the gems were clumped together, one larger clump on side and I guess the outkasts on the other side.  Would have been nice to see some packaging keep them in place as they are not individually wrapped.  Secondly the amount of loose sugar outside the packaging spilled out when these were opened.  Lastly and not sure how quality control reviews the packaging.  But we received only one yellow, a couple green/red/pink gems, leaving virtually 80% of the batch orange gems.  They sure are good, but I was expecting a balance of available colors/flavors.

As delicious as I remembered them!  The only drawback was that during shipping the gems came out of there slots and all ended up in one giant clump.  And this was in December so I can't imagine they could have melted but they managed to stick all together.

This is my first time trying this product, and I was slightly disappointed by them.  Certain flavors (particularly the yellow and green) left a strange flavor lingering in my mouth for a long time after I'd eaten just one of them.The fruit gems themselves did not fit very securely in the packing.  As soon as I removed the outer plastic wrap, I found the box covered in a sticky layer of sugar.  Inside the box, the gems had become all muddled up and were no longer in their set places.  The box was not divided into separate "spaces" for each gem, but instead split into two compartments where the gems were all just sort of tossed in together. I was hoping for some better presentation, and if this had been a gift, I would have been quite upset.  Additionally, the ratio of colors seemed somewhat poor:  I got a lot of reds and yellows, but very few yellows and greens, and not a single white one.  Not one!I didn't like these sweets much, because the yellows and greens (as I mentioned) left a particularly odd aftertaste and made my tongue feel weird.  The reds and oranges were not as strongly affected by this weird flavor, and I enjoyed them more.  They were quite irresistible!I'm not sure if I will be buying this product again.  The strange aftertaste was off-putting, and I would have been more disappointed by this product if there had been more greens and yellows in the box. I am glad that I mainly got reds and oranges; but this might not happen next time.  (I really liked the red and orange gems though, and wish I could just buy a box full of only them.) I didn't think that the gems were presented very attractively in their box, and would have definitely preferred that at least the colors be split up more cleanly - this would perhaps help with quality control too, and ensuring an even ratio of each color.I gave the product three stars because I felt it had poor quality control due to not having a very even ratio of flavors.  I, as I say, was glad that I mainly got reds and oranges, but if those are not your favorites, then it might be something of a letdown.  Anyone who loves the white gems would have been horribly disappointed if they had gotten my box - there wasn't a single one in them!I also give it three stars on account of the strange after-taste.  It spoiled things somewhat for me.  I was glad that it was only certain colors that were affected, or else I would not have been able to eat these gems at all.  I found that I was only able to have one of the gems that had an odd flavor, before the after-taste got too much for me.

Fruit gems are the best out there.  100% fruit juice and taste better than any of that bad candy out there.  Watch out, they'll be gone before you know it!

column9: Gourmet Taste on Soup Kitchen Budget
column10: In a normal day we will drink two pots of Folgers in the morning and two in the afternoon followed by at least one during and after dinner.  Would you say we have a drinking problem?  Actually it is not a problem but more a habit of consuming a quality taste.  When available those cups are filled with Gourmet Supreme.  Sometimes it just is not available.  Amazon has filled most of the empty holes for our coffee addition, however.  Maybe it is just us but the coffee we have received from Amazon appears to be of a fresher nature and not stale as we have received from other grocers.Even though we sincerely enjoy drinking this brand, we fault the producer for several matters.  There are too many instances of ground stems in the contents.  A rep from Folgers assured me that there were no stems in the coffee; however, coffee beans usually are dark brown and not in the shape of a ground light colored stem.  Additionally, it seems as if almost all producers of most products are playing with the net weight of it packages.  It used to be (dark age era) that a 16 ounce bag of coffee was a pound and no more.  If I wanted a larger container I had a choice of buying several one pounders or a three pound bag.  Most of the bags came as beans and I had to self grind it or get the clerk to do it for me.  Not today.  The large container here is 27.8 ounces today and we have no idea what it will be tomorrow other than the price will probably increase.  Even the old pounder is now 13 ounces.  I recall potato chips coming in a pound bag but today it's 10 ounces or 11.3 or some other amount of ounces.  Each time it is with a price increase.  My needs are simple:  top quality coffee at soup kitchen prices with no fillers or constantly changing packages.  If a price increase is needed because of fluctuating international markets then increase the price.Regardless of my comments in the above paragraph I still find Folgers a quality brand and will continue using it.

column9: My dog actually eats these treats!

*****Numi Tea's Monkey King Jasmine Green Tea is a premium Numi tea, both certified organic and kosher. The only ingredient is fair trade certified special grade green tea that is scented with real summer jasmine flowers from China. There is nothing artificial in this or in any Numi tea. Perfect!On the box, the manufacturer writes: "Jasmine tea is the oldest known scented tea, and ours begins its life in the gardens of Hunan Province. The rich soil and fluctuations in daily temperature yield a fragrant leaf which is further scented with delicate white Jasmine blossoms. During summer, these are gathered daily by the banks of the Min River and repeatedly mated each night with the prepared tea, naturally embracing all of the flowers' scent. When brewed, this smooth, organic green tea has layers of subtle fragrance and hints of moonlight. It is a most romantic tea, and, like a bowl of fresh picked flowers, will bring the joy of summer to your every sip."It sounds quite romantic, and it tastes wonderful. It is a true jasmine tea, and the taste of jasmine predominates, in a both strong and lovely way.If you like Numi teas, get it---you won't be sorry. If you are new to Numi but love jasmine green tea, this will probably be the best you've ever had.Highly recommended.*****

column9: Made in China - these treats caused anal rupture and renal failure
column10: I bought this at Costco after reading the ingredients - only chicken, sweet potato and glycerin.  Only later did I see that were made in China.  I had given my Standard Poodle 2 of them about two months ago and afterwards she couldn't poop for 3 days, a problem she never had.  I thought it MUST have been something else she ate but was concerned so I put the treats away.  Three days ago, I thought I was being neurotic and decided to give her 1 treat and see if there were any problems.  The next day she didn't poop and by that night a bump was forming next to her anus that clearly made her uncomfortable; by morning it was red and looked awful.  I drove her to the vet when it opened.  Her anal sac had ruptured.  She needed general anesthetic, surgery, and 14 days of antibiotics.  I told the vet my theory about the treats; she said that two weeks ago, another dog was brought in after eating the exact same treats.  She said that dog died of renal failure.  The vet also said that she had bought the same treats for her dog, and her dog was sick afterwards, so she threw them away.  I wrote an incident report to Costco and hopefully an investigation will follow.  These treats are potentially deadly.  For my dog, it made her very very sick.  The vet bill was $450.  I don't believe there are only three ingredients in these treats.
I too bought this at Costco and my dog is sick right now.  I am mad at myself for buying these and unhappy with Costco and Amazon for carrying them at all.  DO NOT FEED YOUR DOG!

column9: One of the better Hormel meals
column10: The Spaghetti with Turkey Meatballs is better than many others in the Hormel line in some respects and worse in others. My biggest complaint about the Hormel red pasta sauces is that they are all unfailingly too sweet and have a distracting acidic tang to it. This one, thankfully, doesn't have these issues at all. It is a very nice tasting sauce (a little bland but that's par for the course with this type of meal produced to be enjoyed by many different types of people) that pretty much makes the entire dish. The noodles are noodles. Nothing exceptional, nothing horrible. It's the meatballs where this meal fails. I understand that they are attempting to make a lower calorie meal and applaud their efforts but these turkey meatballs are terrible. They are overly dry and have pretty much no taste. Maybe if the meat was ground up and mixed into the sauce, this wouldn't be an issue but instead they are in fairly large chunks.As a whole though, I would rather eat this meal than many, many others in the Hormel line up. It still has way too much sodium (600mg) but comparing that to some of the other meals (upwards of 1300mg) it's much, much better. If you're looking for something that doesn't have to be refrigerated, is quick and easy to heat up, and is fairly palatable, you really can't go wrong with this one. Just cut up the meatballs first and mix it in with the rest. It'll be much better that way.

column9: Very dissapointed with the quality of these seeds.
column10: I have been a consumer of NOW foods goods for at least 20 years and have generally been very satisfied with their products (mostly vitamins or supplements). The packaging claims nitrogen flush technology in packing to maintain freshness and the expiration date is a year from now so the packaging presumably is not to blame. The circumstances of this order make it unfeasible for me to return them (they are now several thousand miles away from the US and the postage back would cost more than the product) but had I received them directly from Amazon I most certainly would have sent them back immediately. I can only hope that nutritionally they are uncompromised and that by including them in salads and other dishes I won't be reminded too much of their inferior taste.I recommend that you avoid this product unless you are able to buy it in the store and can see what you are getting.

The outer shell must stay intact in order for the nutrients to be preserved thus this product is a terrible value and I strongly recommend a do not purchase. Shame on you NOW FOODS for distributing such a low quality product. Why does Amazon continue to sell inferior quality products when they have been told that certain products are of low quality?

Let me warn you so you dont waste your money like I did - DO NOT BUY ANY OF THESE PRODUCTS. #1, not even one of these products contains ANY Watermelon. They are all basically the same with Sugar, Lemon juice, Melon flavoring (NOT Watermelon), and red dye. NOT one single bit of Watermelon in any of them. #2, They dont taste even remotely like Watermelon, and in fact all but Best Bargain have disgusting taste to them. I tried various quantities of the syrup from very little to a lot - and either way, they taste horrible! #3, you can EASILY make your own delicious Watermelon syrup. There are a number of recipies on the web. Some require rendering (boiling down) but you dont have to use those to get a very good homemade, TRUE tasting syrup.Avoid these products like the plague!!!Note - Dunkin Donuts does not seem to sell their syrup, however you can go to their web site and click the "Contact Us" button and send them a note that you would like to purchase their syrup (if you like it - and it is the best) and if you have a local shop, you can ask the manager if he/she wouldnt mind buying an extra one for you!Otherwise, make your own! Its the only way to get good taste. However, these products, Monin, Torani, DaVinci and Best Bargain are horrible and while they look like transmission fluid - I will wager THAT tastes better!

Several years ago, I went on a tour of the Celestial Seasonings tea factory in Boulder, Colorado.  The guide showed us the bales of tea as they arrived, machines that ground and mixed the tea, and a machine that put the tea in tea bags.  The tour included a visit to the room where the peppermint tea was stored.  Our guide told us that peppermint was stored separately so that it would not contaminate the other teas.  He did not tell us what was to come.The doorway into the peppermint room was surrounded by bright red stripes. This should have served as a warning to us.  We all innocently strolled into the peppermint room.  The smell of peppermint was overpowering.  It entered my nose, my head, my lungs, and then my whole being was infused with peppermint.  What a rush!  The crowd stampeded out of the room in a hurry.  For the rest of the day and into the next, all I could smell and taste was the mint.I am now addicted to Celestial Seasonings Peppermint Tea.  Every time I have some, I am reminded of that fateful day in Boulder.  The events of that day have changed my life forever.  Amazingly, the tea is still legal, openly sold in stores and on the Internet.  I think that the tea is great, but then again I am not an unbiased observer.  On your next visit to Boulder, take the tour.  Or go a safer route; buy the tea from Amazon.

column9: So far, it's the best salt I have found
column10: I felt that I had to give an update reassuring people a little more about this product.  I can assure you that I have no connection or financial interest in this company or in regard to this Himalayan salt.The reason for my interest is that I have an autistic son, and I am very watchful for contaminants in his food. I avoid the type of sea salt from the ocean since heavy metal contamination is an problem.  So when I found this Himalayan salt, I was glad because the label states that they monitor the contents for contaminants.  And it doesn't come from the ocean, which greatly reduces the likelihood of heavy  metal contamination.One reviewer was quite concerned because there seemed to be some sediment left at the bottom of a glass of water when he attempted to dissolve the salt.  He felt that this sediment was dangerous and not fit for human consumption.So I did some research of my own.  I tried to dissolve some of the salt in a glass of water also.  I noticed that some of it did not dissolve immediately.  It took a while, but eventually all but some red powder had dissolved.  So I know that some of the salt dissolves immediately, some of it will dissolve after a lot of stirring and perhaps after it sits in the water for a couple of hours.  But the red powder did not dissolve.I looked up Himalayan pink salt and found out that the Bavarian consumer protection agency analyzed the composition of 15 Himalayan sea salts sold in Germany.  They found that it was composed of 10 different minerals, including, of course, sodium and chloride (98%).  It contained 2-3% polyhalite or gypsum and 10 other minerals in small amounts.Gypsum is a very soft sulfate material made up of calcium sulfate dihydrate.  I am assuming it is safe for consumption since it is used as a coagulant in tofu.Polyhalite is a hydrated sulfate of potassium, calcium and magnesium.  It's reddish color is due to various levels of iron oxide in salt deposits.This may seem alarming, but I did yet more research and found that insoluble minerals do not absorb and simply pass through the body. Based on that information, I am not ready to assume that this insoluble mineral is harmful.Himalayan pink sea salt has been harvested from the salt mines in Pakistan since the 13th century.  So they've been eating this stuff for a long time.  And if they've been consuming it for that long, and if that's the way it comes out of the ground, I think I can feel pretty good about it.I am not 100% confident about my conclusions, but for now, I am feeling a bit better about serving this to my children rather than serving any other salt on the market.

When my grandson was born, Diogenes was able to retire and seek the sleep he so deserved after searching so many centuries for an honest man. My grandson speaks his mind eloquently and succintly.  Upon the arrival of my order of Funfresh Foods Real Food Trading Company Himalayan Pink Sea Salt, 2-Pound, I quietly served it at a family meal.  Almost instantly my grandson asked who put sand in the salt.  I smiled, chuckled and told him no one had put anything in the salt and that this was special pink salt from half way around the world.  "It has sand in it, Grandpa! I don't like it!" he replied.  Nay, nay, not so, I assured him (and everyone).  "Let me show you."I drew a small glass of filtered water and added a liberal amount of the pink salt.  (BTW, if you like the C.Cola bottled water, *asani, much of it comes from the same source in FL as my tap water)  So I swirled the pink salt around in the water.  Let me mention that I have a degree in science and a bunch, like a lot, of chemistry courses so I know that table salt, sodium chloride (NaCl) is really really soluble in water.  Well, after much stirring I got quite a bit of pink insoluble grains on the bottom of the glass and, most disturbing, the liquid was cloudy!  I've been watching it for a couple of hours now and nothing is settling out.  I'll keep watching, but what the cloudy water means is there is either a fine particulate that will settle out in time or there is something else in the "salt" that is not or not completely water soluble or is colloidal, which does not make me feel good about this product.It is my understanding that most table salt is produced by crystallizing the salt from a saline solution, either natural (sea water) or man made.  The difference between "regular" table salt (at least in the US) and Kosher salt is that regular salt is allowed to crystallize undisturbed and will form cubical crystals while Kosher salt must be raked during the entire crystallizing process, thus forming the light flaky crystals familiar to that form.This product, it appears to me, is a mined mineral that contains a high NaCl content that is not further refined.  It is finely ground perhaps in the hope that end users will not notice that it also contains rock, sand, or whatever makes up the Himalayas.  The product claims to contain less Sodium (Na) and that may well be true, but is that lower Sodium content because it has ground rocks/sand in it?I'm returning this because it is an inferior product that is not what it is advertised to be.  This might be fine for a live stock salt lick but it is not fit for human consumption!Many Hours Later:  The cloudiness is clearing, so my conclusion is that it was caused by very small particles that took longer to fall out of suspension.  Nevertheless, sediment is sediment and sediment is not salt!  This is another example of when a low price is not a bargain!

My family wouldn't touch it if their life depended on it so it's all mine...The only other item I have tried is the Honey Mustard Dressing by Walden Farms and it too is laking in that "OMG, this is just like the real thing" taste sensation that you might expect just by looking at it in the jar.  But, for those us who are always at battle with the buldge, it works.Walden Farms gets an A+ for effort, that's for sure.

I agree with CFH's review, below. It's a good calorie-free product, but it's not really "marshmallow." My son and I would compare it more to something along the lines of Cool Whip. Still, it's darned good! Just don't try to make a s'more out of it with the chocolate dip and a graham cracker -- I tried and it didn't make the cut.

column9: A Decent Diet Cool Whip...It is not marshmellow dip...
column10: I have tried two the Walden diet food products and so far.  I have tried the chocolate dipand the marshmellow dip.  I wasn't too crazy about the chocolate dip on my strawberries.  Ithought about tossing the chocolate in the trash however I hate to waste food and I almostfinished the jar...almost.The marshmellow dip is more like a diet Cool Whip cream to me.  I enjoy it on my strawberries.A relative of mine tried the marshmellow dip and thought it was marginally decent however I don'tthink they will be running to the store to buy it.  Me, I have purchased several jars for itmakes my strawberries more tasty...So should you buy it?  Well, It is a matter of tastes.The no calories is a nice feature and they do a decent job of mimicing Cool Whip in its taste.I would advise sorting all the Walden diet foods by Amazon customer ratings and use that as yourguide...

Walden Farms Marshmallow Dip, an anomalous 'calorie-free' 'food' is interesting. Like others have noted, does not resemble marshmallow fluff in texture, and only slightly in taste perhaps. Its incredibly sweet to taste in itself, almost unbearably so. It's....meh... BUT, given its insignificant to no caloric profile, it actually makes a fantastic filler. I found that I could add my post-workout protein and creatine mixture to this stuff, with a small amount of fruit, and enjoy a pudding-esque concoction with calories being contributed solely from protein and miniscule amounts of fruit sugar. In this capacity, the stuff works wonders. Undoubtedly beats the alternative: water, protein, creatine. By itself? Perhaps not the best thing, but definitely a great way to experiment with other foods and still save on unneeded calories.

column9: WF Marshmallow dip great in the right recipe
column10: My favorite is with 1 cup of plain yogurt, 2 tbsp walden farms marshmallow dip, 2 tbsp orange or strawberry or raspberry fruit spread -- in a blender or magic bullert --you can add some ice if you like -- and tastes delicious -- kind of creamsickle flavor.got this originally from the accuweight.com web site - but I may have modified the amounts.
I was excited to receive chocolate,caramel,and marshmallow in the mail. I sampled all three and then threw them in the trash. They were not edible.

column9: Please save your money!!!! It's awful
column10: I would love to say I like this stuff.  Especially since I spent $3.99 on it.  I wasn't expecting it to be just like the real thing but...OMG.  This stuff is really not good.  About the only thing it has in common with marshmallow cream is that it's white.  I actually spit it out.It's an awful texture and taste like an elixir of strange chemicals that are vaguely masked by a cloying sweetness.  I thought, as I spit it out, that it seemed illegal to be able to sell this as anything edible.  You decide.  But I warned you.  99% of people will find thisinedible.

Once you get it open it kinda looks like paste...but taste worse :p  So far I haven't been real impressed with the Walden Farms products, they taste too sweet. The BBQ sauce is edible, 1000 island dressing not bad, but this marshmallow stuff is GROSS!!!!
A great addition to a shake, and is wonderful as a topping on sugar-free jello!
Like the caramel dip, I would give this no stars if it were an option.  It is so bad, I took one taste and tossed it in the trash!
I got and tried the Walden Farms Marshmallow Dip.  Don't waste your money... it tastes like poison with a terrible aftertaste. YUCK.

I was so excited when I found this in the natural food section of my local grocery store.This stuff was so nasty I threw it out.  I tried to use it several different ways to no avail.Don't waste your money, it's not worth it.

This product isn't bad, but its definitely NOT marshmallow. I had also set myself up to believe it was going to taste like marshmallows, unfortunately, "It is what it is". Its a great alternative to eating marshmallows if you need to stay away from the bad stuff in marshmallowy goodness.Its worth a try if your pondering. My fiance enjoys it alot with strawberries, however, I'm not a big fan.

I bought Walden Farms peanut spread and this marshmallow dip, envisioning a calorie-free "fluffer nutter." I learned you can't get something for nothing. This stuff is awful. If you buy it, you'll be sorry.

First of all, this company was so quick !  I called to commend them on that and being on different coasts, they were closed when I called.  I left a message saying how happy I was, and they called back the next day thanking me !  It is a small family owned company, where you get the kind of attention that small company's can afford to give.  The product too, is so delicious.  I just can't say enough about them...try them and you will see !

I fell in love with the taste of lingonberries because of IHop which offers a dish of Swedish crepes/pancakes served with lingonberry butter and preserves. The combination is divine. Now, because of Amazon, I just received an order of Hafi Lingonberry Preserves and can order Lund's Swedish Pancake Mix, 12-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12) and create my own version of IHop's marvelous dish!Ah, the taste of lingonberries--subtle, light, elegant, yet fruit-luscious in each spoonful. Items like preserves and cheeses can be served two ways: ambient room temperature or chilled. I prefer the ambient taste--the chill retards the full flavor.So what does lingonberry preserves taste like? Not strong like blueberry preserves. Not exotic like blackberry or heady like grape or tart like raspberry. Subtle. Sweet enough but nothing near cloying. Perfect.Until the pancake mix arrives, I'll have lingonberry preserves on homemade biscuits. Yum, yum!Note: As this is a product of Sweden and shipped from Sweden, I must mention the packaging. The jar was double-wrapped in bubble wrap. And as a little treat came a tin of peppermint lozenges. Delightful!

I realized a week and a half before Christmas that I didn't have any lingonberries to put on my meatballs for our Swedish Smorgasbord.  So I looked up lingonberries on amazon and came across these.  So I bought them and got them really quickly. They tasted yummy and I think these are the same brand that they sell at Ikea. I was very pleased with the product and the fast shipping.

I had seen this product on the Dr Oz show and was so happy to find I could order it on Amazon.  I can't believe I received these so quickly from Sweden.  I love my preserves and will be ordering them again soon as they are delicious to eat and are so good for your health.

I bought some of the jam on a whim, wanting to add it to the homemade swedish meatball recipe I've been following. My room-mates start grabbing the jar, going "this stuff is good!" and proceed to kill half a loaf of bread laden with jam. We also added it to the swedish meatballs and they were eaten even faster than usual! Great product, can't wait to buy more of it.

I have to admit that I'd never heard of lingonberries prior to seeing a report on TV singing their praises.  The report said that lingonberries are higher in anti-oxidants than just about any other berry and that anti-oxidants may play a significant role in reducing instances of cancer.  Okay, so far so good.  But, where to find lingonberries?  I turned to good old Amazon and stumbled across these preserves.  Although a little pricey, I couldn't be happier.  I've ordered 3 jars so far and each has arrived quickly and in great condition.  The taste is wonderful, sort of like a refined cranberry, and it has become my daily spread on either whole wheat toast or a toasted bagel in the morning.  The calorie count is not too high, less than 40 calories per serving, so even though it's a tasty treat I don't worry about tacking on the pounds.  All in all, I'm very happy I heard about the lingonberry and even happier with the Hafi Preserves.

This is a very good product if you are interested in lingonberries. Lingonberries are good for you. Few vegetarian sources provide as much omega-3 fatty acids as do lingonberries. Lingonberries contain about as much omega-3 as does flax seed and taste a lot better, too.
Saw on Dr. Oz that Lingonberries are a superberry, but the only place you can find them is Sweden.  Have ordered a couple different brands,both very good.

This Hafi Lingonberry preserves not only arrived in a timely fashion, but also adds favorably to our morning and afternoon snack experiences.  Not too sweet, not too tart.  My husband adds it to the very healthy shake he makes for the two of us each morning.  I also occasionally like to get my healthy bit of snack in by dipping a few toasted pita chips in the early afternoon when I get most hungry.  Just one or two chips with a total of about one teaspoon of preserves will do it for me for a healthy snack that will not spoil my dinner.  Very happy with the product.

column9: Better than Cranberries and Great Breakfast treat
column10: Wonderful taste and texture. For Americans this is similar to a cranberry relish with a smaller whole berry size in the spread. I couldn't wait to open and taste and I was not disappointed. Wonderful! I look forward to using this as a preserve on my meat, chicken, pork and turkey dishes since I have sworn off eating bread. This would be delicious on bread, bagels, english muffins, oatmeal, pancakes, french toast. It's delicious!
Maybe it is just me, but I found these preserves to be too sour. A little pricey too. It had a nice consistency though.

The lingonberry was featured on Dr. Oz.  The lingonberry is the highest antioxidant berry on earth.  Since I am trying to be healthier, I ordered the lingonberry preserves to use in a smoothie.  The preserves tastes like a mixture of cranberries and raspberries - YUMMY!  I use 1 cup of unsweetened almond milk, 2 tbs. of lingonberry preserves and 3/4 cup of ice in a blender until it's the consistency of a thick milk shake.  You will not believe how delicious it taste.  If I have it for breakfast, I'll add some protein powder. The preserves are also good on toast or English muffins.  Order a jar or two - you won't be sorry.
Expensive but worth every penny.  A little thin for a preserve but stillis a great spread and taste.  Plus it is good for you.
The preserves are delicious!  I had never eaten lingonberry preserves before, but now I plan to order these again and again.  Also would make great gifts!Only 34 calories per serving!

After I read all the positive reviews I had to try some.  It is very good just on toast.  Pleasant taste, not to sweet or sour.  I will have to experiment trying it on a few different things as suggested in some of the reviews.
i found this product sweet with a tiny taste of  bitter and mixes well in yogart, chocolate pudding and a little flavoring of rum and it  is sooo  good. And it is healthy for you.

I heard about the good health effects of Lingonberries and so decided to try the preserves.  The taste is kind of a cross between a cranberry and cherry.  It is very good spread on buttered toast and can also be used in a shake.

This jam tastes terrific.  But if you are trying to avoid sugar, this one is not for you.When you search Amazon for "lingonberry jam, sugar free" it acknowledges your choice and this is one of the brands offered; however, it is NOT sugar free.  Sugar is the second ingredient listed.Truthfully, when shopping on Amazon you have to double check everything and cannot take Amazon's wordfor anything.  In the last few years Amazon has grown so big that it has gotten very sloppy on the details.  When it comes to specifics such as content of sugar, gluten, etc., their filters don't seem to be doing the job.  The title of the product may not match the product description or the list of ingredients.

column4: D'Ann "The Art of John D Moulton"
column10: Omaha Steak Pork Tenderloins are a sure thing.  Tender and delicious.  Quick delivery and good value.  I would always recommend them for quality merchandise.

I highly recommend these pork tenderloins from Omaha Steaks.  They cook up easily and remain 'melt in your mouth' tender.  Of course I add a lot of spices to them pre-cooking along with some olive oil.  The meat just readily falls apart when you touch it with your fork.  The taste I guess depends on the spices you use.  I mainly use garlic and black pepper but throw in a dash of several others too and the flavor is just remarkable.  I will be buying these again!
My two tiny chihuahua's love Itty Bitty Buddy's treats.  They are hard to find, not at many pet stores.  It's the best treat ever.....

I would like to say that my pugs (2) are very happy with the product...When the pugs are happy..there is happiness in the housewhole...Please advise if there are any coupons for this product, I know that the pugs will demand more..The review of this product is very positive, 100% good...please reply with information regarding the coupons....A very happy customer and proud owner of two pugs......Fred H.
My Shelties LOVE these things! And they are so "bitty" I don't have to break up a huge cookie. They are the perfect size for rewards.

I purchased the coffee maker based on being able to get Starbucks. I purchased boxes of Starbucks, Columbian and Breakfast Blend, but am now running low. I decided I would try some others. I hated Grevalia, the Maxwell House is OK coffee, but like drinking flavored water, when I saw the French Roast, which is supposed to be DARK and assumed stronger and fairly inexpensive, I thought I should at least try it. It is hard to replace Starbucks, but the French Roast is OK, not wonderful. I tried the Narob and several different others, but FOR ME this is going to have to be my Starbucks replacement.I had heard that Tassimo was supposed to get a better choice by mid to end of summer and it appears they have fallen short. I had heard that Starbucks was to partner with Cruinart, but so far it's not showing up. I'm not sure these single cup guys are so great, when you are forced to a limited brand of coffees. We are back to Corporate America manipulating our morning cup of wake up.
I'm not a coffee drinker so I'm going by my husband's taste. He likes it. Still a strong coffee but not overwhelming. I enjoy the fragrance more than the darker roast, that made me sick!
This is a really good coffee. I think this taste much better than Gevalia and at a fraction of the price. The auto delivery is the way to go because you save even more with this method.

I believe I have tried all the coffee T-Discs for the Tassimo.  The Maxwell French Roast hands down is my favorite.  I'll still try all new products offered but I usually go back the the French Roast.

column4: coffee drinker in PA "coffee drinker in PA"
column10: Surprisingly good! My favorite is the Starbucks Africa Kitamu.  However, if you purchase a two pack of the Maxwell French Roast from Amazon it's a better deal than the 5 pack....for some reason, they don't allow subscriptions for the 2 pack.
Maxwell has always been a great coffee. To put that same flavor in a T-Discs is great. I'm sure I will order more of the Maxwell coffee's.

I have been using this brand of coffee in my TassimoBrewer now for a few months and am pleased with it.I own a business where I offer my clients a cup andthey are pleased to receive a fresh brewed cup. If theywant it a bit stronger, I just end the brewing cycle sooner.

Maxwell House Cafe Collection French Roast is a good choice for those who like bolder, darker blends.  It has nice body and great aroma, without being bitter.This is a nice step up for an otherwise middle of the road coffee company.

This is a great strong roast, my husband and I drink it daily. We were drinking the Maxwell House morning blend, but we prefer the richer flavor of this one. There are no better prices on T-discs than on Amazon!

My husband and I were so disappointed when they discontinued Starbucks coffee discs., after reading the reviews on amazon and trying several different coffees, finally found this one, it's the best coffee so far and my husband is very pleased ! I didn't think its possible to find anything to replace the Starbucks coffee but this is it. We love it!

The cost is considerably less, however the loss of the Starbuck brand and African Kitamu t-discs was a real downer. I have tried many single serve coffees and Starbucks was the best. I'm sure it has had a negative effect on Bosch single serve coffee maker sales. At this time I'm considering a Nesspresso machine because of the bold, dark coffee blends available.

ordered a 5 pack and received a 4.5 pack. one pack had only one sleeve/box of t-discs. i took pictures and sent to amazon... but received no response. they got their cut of the sale so why should they care... . the coffee had a rich and bold flavor. i think it is a good value (so long as the quantity is correct). i will definitely buy this 5 pack again.

You've already discovered Tassimo, now discover one of their best and cheapest coffees!  This French Roast is just as good as the more costly Gevalia.  It's also better than the regular Maxwell House blend, I think it's called House Blend.  I used to buy it directly from Tassimo, but they have gone up a dollar per package so this is the best deal going.  Hope Amazon continues to offer it forever!
This coffee is a good choice for your morning cup, but isn't as great as some of the other offerings: Gevalia or Starbucks. However, at this price, I'm very happy with it.

You get a full (American sized) cup of absolutely delicious coffee. You'll be drooling while brewing! The aroma rivals any of the more expensive versions of coffee that I've sampled. You won't find a better price on any auction or shopping site. This coffee doesn't taste like it costs less than thirty cents a cup. This is the all around package. You will not be disappointed. Enjoy...I am!

This coffee isn't bad but it's nowhere near as good as the Gavalia Morning Roast.  It has a decent flavor and is fine if you don't like a strong coffee.  If I couldn't get the Gavalia Morning Roast, I would buy this coffee again but it would not be my first choice.

Latte's, Cappacino's and every other delicacy is fine but you can't beat a cup of Maxwell Coffee. This was a wonderful prchase my coffee habit is taken care of for a long while. Seller was prompt in shipping and it was everything they promised. This is a relationship I will cherish for years.
Flavorless, like water. Instant would be quite a step up. Do not buy.  It was listed as medium roast, but has no flavor.

column9: Great Flavor and Heat - Highly Recommended
column10: These McCormick Diced Jalapeño Peppers have a very good, distinct Jalapeño flavor and a good bit of spicy heat as well. These are diced small and are not completely dried out. Since I like my food spicier than most of my family, this is a great way to add to add spicy heat to an individual serving of salsa for me without making everyone else suffer.Highly Recommended!CFH

column9: That is the grape flavor I expected
column10: The grape flavor jelly belly bean cannot be found in other mixed flavor package.  So I took the risk to purchase a bag with sole grape flavor.  I'm very satisfied this the product because that's exactly what I expected--natually tasted grape flavor unlike some other brand's artificial flavor.
Chose Tao of Tea because my other brand was not available.  I was more than pleased at the fine quality, excellent aroma and rich taste.  I will definitely buy this brand again.

column9: Eat it for your health, not the taste
column10: Originally tried this on the recommendation of a doctor in Colombia, South America(!) for my constipation.  Pretty much like eating slightly sweetened twigs; putting in fruit helps me get it down.

Kellogg's original All-Bran cereal has simply the most dietary fiber of any cereal known to me.  The fiberis good for many digestive aspects.  I've been eating for several years, and it works.  The cereal is almost tasteless; fructose makes it a bit sweet.  So add fruit to it.  I add bananas which makes the cereal taste fairly good.  But it's never going to be a great breakfast.  One eats this cereal for health reasons, and for this purpose it's the best.

My kids love this fizzy soda candy, but it is pretty difficult to find. Each unit comes with six cans of four flavors (two sprint/lemon lime, one crash/orange, one loca cola/cola, and two splash/grape. The best thing about the candy is that it has a nice fizz to it.

Ferrero Rocher is a morsel of milk chocolate with hazelnut filling.  The candy has a pleasant slighty crunchy taste.  Even though I generally prefer dark chocolate, I find Ferrero Rocher very tasty and not too sweet.  I also like the individual packaging of the candies.  Sometimes I can stop at one. However, more often I have to have a "chaser".  They are a satisfying treat!I noticed that the price on the on this product fluctuates. There is a nice online tool that I use to help catch a good price on Amazon, this tool is called  "Online Price Alert".  This tool will send you an email when the Amazon item price reaches the target price range that you specify. If you search on "online price alert" in Google it will be come up at the top.  I find this tool to be very helpful.
Got this for my girlfriend for her birthday. It got here quickly, and undamaged. The chocolate is also delicious -- it's like textured nutella. Yum!

Did you know that the guiness world record for eating these things is standing at 9? Do you people all realize that with a little effort, you could be world record holder? BELIEVE and then ACHIEVE. I heard that somewhere.

Ferroro Rocher are very nice, we get them at the supermarket the odd time for a treat as the price is quite high.

column9: O La La, So Irressible!  (ATTN: NUT WARNING ALERT)
column10: Ever since years ago a Multimillionaire gave me this because he had so many and his wife didn't want anymore; already gave them all away - handed them (huge) over to me (He owned several Corporations so these were popular in gift baskets) AND I wished he hadn't!I got HOOKED!I love them because they are ever so handy all because they are each individually wrapped making it easier for one to keep in addition to its own box; a big bonus for someone like me who does not care so much about "Candy, Candy, Candy" but would love to have a little bite once in awhile and this is just so perfect (with the exceptions of Godiva Chocolate - that's a different story...)!Always loved Filberts aka Hazelnuts; never knew it was in the middle of it all (never read the package - LOL).Love the nice fine texture of chocolate and crushed hazelnuts on the outside and then the inner shell of chocolate which is smooth and creamy; then comes the best part - the Filbert or Hazelnut! YUM!As for the Chocolate itself - it has a wide arrays of Chocolate textures and its flavors as you savor it; I can taste the simplicity of regular milk chocolate to the more expounded in depth the semi bittersweet chocolate inside - it all balances itself just perfect.ATTENTION: NUT ALLERGY WARNING - THIS BOX DOES COME WITH A WARNING THAT MAY CONTAIN PEANUTS (?); BUT THE CONTENTS CONTAINS HAZELNUTS / FILBERTS (Same nut - name depends on region).

This is something I bought for my mother who has long enjoyed this candy. As usual, the candy was delicious, but the best thing was that it was delivered before Christmas, when it was ordered only about a week before. Very satisfied and I would order again.

These consist of a crispy chocolate shell with one hazelnut inside, nestled in a soft whip of chocolate. The combination of smooth chocolate and crispiness make this a very satisfying treat. Each is beautifully wrapped in gold foil, which makes them a perfect addition to a gift box or Christmas stocking. You can wrap a few in tissue paper and tie off one end, or simply leave one on someone's desk as a nice surprise. They are beautiful, luxurious and very reasonably priced. I actually prefer them over more expensive chocolates. They go perfectly with a cup of coffee.If you're buying them for yourself, the individual wrapping is great because you aren't tempted to eat the whole box. I usually have one or two at once, but am not tempted to have more, even though they're delicious. One piece has 73 calories, which is less than a lot of chocolate treats. I won't advocate chocolate as part of one's diet, but if you're someone who needs to indulge a little sometimes to stay on track for the long haul, these are great.The larger box is perfect if you're filling stockings, and the smaller box is nice for a small gift. This 5.3oz size is my favorite because there's enough to keep a few and give a few without worrying they'll go stale.
My husband and I both love these chocolates.  They would be nice for a gift for anyone who is a chocolate lover. Plus, they look "fancy" all wrapped up in gold foil!

column9: Very Good! Great as a gift and for parties!

They're great to indulge in if you find yourself not being able to afford $50.00 for a box of milk chocolate truffles or French pralines. A cute little gift for that special someone as well.

column9: The Best Treat I've ever had
column10: These candies are great!! I can't find the words to describe how truly great they are. All I can suggest is that you try them and see how you like them. Personally for me, I can't get enough of them.

column9: A key ingredient in my new favorite BBQ sauce for chicken!
column10: For the past 30 years, I've preferred an old family BBQ sauce recipe for my chicken - but NO LONGER! Combine 4 oz of this rich and flavorful syrup with 5 TB chili sauce, one small onion (chopped), 2 TB apple cider vinegar, 1 TB regular mustard, and 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce. Marinate your favorite chicken parts in a covered dish in the fridge for at least four hours, turning the chicken pieces occasionally. Grill chicken until thoroughly cooked, basting occasionally. DELISH!!!

My dog absolutely loved these, and he would have given them a 10 rating if he could.  Unfortunately he is nolonger with us, but he thought they were great for years, and this was the best price I ever found.  Very prompt shipping, and adequate packing

This shortbread is a little less moist than I like, but the taste is good. There is no artifical sugar aftertaste. They are a reasonable substitute for those with such diet restrictions.

I tried this on a whim and am so glad I did!  The product note that the tea is suitable for children is a little off-putting.  I drink it as a morning tea, but is a great anytime tea.  The aroma is amazing and taste is even better!  Can't beat the price either.

My day in and day out coffee is Starbucks Breakfast Blend...I got this coffee on sale at Amazon Warehouse. This is a good cup of coffee..good but not great. If you like a lighter roast..this is for you. I would say if you can get this for $8 a pound...go for it..

Product: "Amazing Grass Green Superfood" (unflavored)STRONG LIKES:* Nutritional Density:  This product contains a well balanced organic mix of nutritionally super-dense dehydrated grass & vegetable extracts (wheat grass, barley grass, alfalfa, "spirulina" blue-green algae, spinach and broccoli), natural plant-based antioxidants (Acai berry, maca, carrot, beet, raspberry, rose hips, pineapple, green tea and acerola cherry), fiber (ground flax seed, and apple pectin), enzymes & pre/probiotics (chicory root, acidophilous, amylase, protease, lipase, lactase, cellulase), and mild herbal stimulants (peppermint and eleuthero root).* Pleasant Taste: For the unflavored powder (the only version I've tried as of this writing), the texture is very slightly gritty (as you'd expect from dehydrated plant extracts and ground flax), but the flavor is pleasant and pairs well with other flavors ... the finish is faintly sweet, with a vague hint of raspberry and cocoa powder.MINOR NITS:* Premium Price: This is a somewhat expensive product, but don't let that deter you because it's very good value, given it's quality and high nutritional density.  On a serving for serving basis, it's still cheaper than a shot of freshly squeezed wheat grass at your local healthfood market - and it's more balanced too.  Prices should begin to slowly decrease as other companies jump onboard with wheat grass and spirulina production, and you can always use a bit less than the recommended serving size (especially if you're mixing it with other supplements).* Mixability: I'd classify it as "ok" on mixibility.  Stirring doesn't work well, so I've found it best to either use a drink blender, or scoop a little into a small reusable jar (along with any other nutritional powders you like), and shake it with your liquid of choice (I use fat free milk).* Nomenclature:  The claim of "amazing energy" is slightly misleading, because this is NOT an energy drink - it contains only a small amount of carbohydrate.  What it DOES contain are B-vitamins and pre/pro-biotic ingredients that indirectly help your metabolism. This is not a complaint per se, but rather an attempt to help clarify the claim on the label.BOTTOM LINE:* Highly recommended - a good and fully organic supplement for busy people on the run.  I'd have given it 5 stars if it blended a little better and was a bit more economical, but regardless I'm very happy with it, and will continue to buy it regularly.  You don't have to be a vegan to enjoy it.

column9: The taste isn't bad at all
column10: First a bit of relevant personal history: I've never been a "health nut" and although I've tried various potions and tonics over the years, I never tried any of them more than two or three times because they tasted so awful. I am definitely NOT the kind of person who will drink something disgusting that belongs on the slimy bottom of a tropical lagoon somewhere just because it will supposedly make me live to be 200 or something.With that understanding, please understand that my opinion of this product's taste and texture is that it is NOT BAD AT ALL.  This is a health supplement I can actually see using for the foreseeable future, because although I'd never say it's a treat, it's really just kind of inert - there's a very weak, mild "musty" flavor, a decent amount of mint (but not strong) and pretty much no other flavor. There also doesn't seem to be much if any aftertaste.Those who complain about "grittiness" either have a MUCH more sensitive mouth than I have, or don't understand that the drink must be stirred before each swallow, or are just plain picky from a visual standpoint.  No, it definitely does not and will not dissolve, but the particles are very small, seemingly soft, and completely non-offensive.  I notice virtually none of them when drinking this.  However, they will settle fairly quickly, so it's important to keep stirring before each swallow.  Failure to do this would result in very "rough" dregs at the bottom of the glass.The toughest thing to get used to is the look of the unmixed powder, and the color of the water once the powder is stirred in. Neither is exactly appealing and I had to psych myself up to actually try the stuff.  But despite my expectations, it wasn't at all bad.  It doesn't taste exactly good, but it's a flavor that I, even with a strong gag reflex, texture sensitivity, and major aversion to most similar products, can drink easily and actually hold or roll in my mouth for a few seconds without spitting it out or feeling sick.I haven't been taking this long enough to comment on the health benefits (although I do seem to notice some increased energy).  I will update this review in a few weeks to reflect my experience in that regard.  My main point in writing for now is just to say that based on the taste and texture, this is a health product I can try long enough to see if it makes a positive difference in my health and energy levels or not.Edit 2-22-2012: After a few days of taking this product, I have found that the slightly "musty" taste seems to be the green tea it includes. The green tea flavor is more apparent when using less water, while using more water brings out the mint flavor more powerfully. I'm feeling only slightly better energy since beginning this product, but I also have had a cold for the past ten days or so (caught before I began using this product), which is definitely dragging me down. I'll update this review again when I'm close to the end of my first month's supply.

My aunt recommended years ago that I try Greens First, or something like that. She is a dietician and knew my eating habits, which is to say she knew I didn't eat vegetables hardly at all. I never really liked the idea, I imagined it would taste gross and I really didn't care much about my health at the time.Fast forward to age 31 and I'm looking to lose some weight and try to avoid major health issues down the road. My girlfriend was using this stuff, and when she moved out, she left a full, unopened container of the Berry flavored version of this stuff. I decided I'd try it out. I read that you were to mix 1 scoop with at least 6 oz of water, and so I put a scoop in a 16oz glass and filled the cup with water, and mixed it all around. The visual disgusted me. It looked like I had taken a glass and dipped it into a scummy pond and filled it with it's water. But I got over that and took a sip. It wasn't bad! Not something I crave, but it wasn't disgusting at all. So I took a bigger drink, licked the chunky crap off my lips, and set it down. I kept going until the glass was half full and I noticed the sludge at the bottom. So I poured more water in, and kept at it.Moral of the story, it tastes good enough for me to mix with just water. However, I need lots of water. I just take on scoop, put it in my glass, then poor in water. When I get to the sludgy bottom, I poor more water in, re mix and drink down. Repeat until it's all gone. This gives me a healthy dose of water for the day, plus the greens.I can't say I have any more energy then before. I can certainly see how it would help with constipation issues, if you have those. And I've been losing weight, but I've also been working out and consuming fewer calories. In the end, I'll keep using it because my diet needs improvement.

It blends in fine in the blender, and the taste is good when mixed with the juice. It is very mild smelling and tasting. It does taste like hay or grass to me.  That being said, it's ground up grass and greens, so what do you expect?  I tried it mixed into to water and I gagged as I choked it down, but mixed with my pea protein powder (http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B000OP5ZHE/ref=oh_details_o02_s00_i00) it doesn't taste to bad.  I have only been drinking it for a couple of days, but I already feel like it gives me more energy.

In the past I had been using Barleans Greens but was looking to replace that product with a similar, less expensive green superfood powdered mix.  I am very pleased with Greens Superfood!  I use this powder twice daily in my smoothie/protein drinks...it claims to boost your energy levels and I agree.  I exercise intensely, daily and feel that the Greens helps me maintain my energy levels needed for my workouts and for the remainder of my day.  I love the taste and my kids think I am drinking Hulk food!

column9: Full of fiber lacking in taste
column10: I have switched to another brand of greens that doesn't seem to be as rich in fiber as this one, but has a better flavor.  It depends on your taste, but both brands of greens provide about the same nutrition.
Good tasting product despite inclusion of stevia among ingredients.  I like to mix this with powdered juice, like Green Magma.

column9: Love this! So glad I ordered it!
column10: I've been going through knee surgeries (9 total) over the past 5 years.  I wanted some sort of drink that I could incorporate into my daily routine to help my immune system and overall health.  I was weary of the taste, but I liked all the positive reviews & figured why not.  Now let me me tell you how I drink it- I bought a blender bottle (the kind w/ the mesh metal ball inside to help mix) fill it up with 12 ounces of apple juice, a scoop of the powder, ice, and shake shake shake. I love it!Will continue to order. :) :) :)

I have been drinking Green Superfood for awhile now and I must say that I love that I love it!!!I always mix it with a smoothie of some sort because if the drink is too watery it doesn't taste that great but otherwise...great stuff!

I'm sure I am no different than the rest of you who have tried countless products to be somewhat disappointed or it takes months to see the difference if any, but this product really works.  I've had digestive problems and have taken everything to keep a continuous flow (if you know what I mean), but this product immediately made a difference in my life.I had to work on the recipe because it is a bit grassy tasting, but I found if I mix my flax oil with the green superfood first to moisten it, then add to my milk, yogurt and banana, it doesn't taste grassy at all and very good.  This is surely a keeper.  So excited to finally find something that is worthy and effective.

I had a hard time drinking this with water, juice, or anything else but now I just put a scoop of it in my yogurt  with a scoop of organic ground flaxseed whenever I need a little snack or for breakfast and it tastes great!  I usually drink a glass of water afterward.  Works for me!

I'm giving it 5 stars because it doesn't taste bad.  I don't have to "mix" it with anything to kill the taste.  I don't have to put it in juice or make a smoothie.  It's very palatable, IMHO.I put a double scoop in water and drink.  It's a little "gritty", but so what. If it's good for you, what the hay!!?I haven't taken it long enough to notice any significant benefits, but based on the other reviews, I should be fine.I'm getting my "greens", and that's good enough for me.
If your looking for a great green product that is also organic, this is it and you can't beat the price.

Excellent product.  I mix it with apple juice for a great morning pick me up and when I dont have time to eat a complete breakfast.  Great way to get off the coffee habit.  I noticed an additional energy boost from my first use.  Taste is good and no problem with excess sediment because I use a shaker type cup with lid.  When drink is done I put a little water in the cup to get every golden bit. I noticed the enzymes have helped with a little digestive issue I have.  Easy way to keep balanced fruit and vegetable nutrition in my diet.
I am very pleased with this drink powder. Does not have a bad taste like most green food powders. It also mixes very well

This product was purchased for my mom. She's was using the real wheat grass n was tired ofsecuring them till she found this on Amazon. The powder is really gOod she adds them toJuice or smoothy. She feels her day goes well having organic wheat everyday.Good product. Recommended for any ages.

This powder truly is super !! I drink it alone with soy milk or add to a smoothie. Amazon has the best price, and if you have it delivered monthly you save even more. I will be using this from now on... With free shipping this deal can not be beat !!

I bought it because of the reviews here but when I mixed it with my Nutiva cacao powder, I almost threw up. Pretty nasty, I could taste the "greens" underneath the cacao. I was too scared to add my hemp powder to it. By itself, however, it was OK, it reminded me of watered-down juice.I still want to use it though because of the health benefits but is there anyway to disguise the taste? I travel a lot and I can't bring a blender with me. I am trying to see if I can add hemp protein and amazing grass green superfood together without gagging. Any advice? (tons of stevia??)
This product is great to add to juices, smoothies or any dish that needs a nutritional push. You can barely taste it and it doesn't clump up when added to liquid.

The first time that I tried this I mixed it with water. Gagged. Held my breath. Choked it down. I got the idea to mix it with V8 and it's really good that way!Might help some of you that had a hard time, like I did.

I don't think that any of these powders are really going to be able to be delicious AND do what they say they are going to do at the same time. I read the other reviews and there were a lot that stated this tasted great. I disagree, BUT I will say that this is a very good powder, and after using for only a week, I felt a difference in my digestive system and overall well being. So for me it does what I bought it for and more! I personally have a weird palate, so the taste wasn't that off to me. It was by no means delicious, and I do have to hold my nose, but I can swallow it without gagging. There is a grittiness to it, but I use one of those "Blender Bottles" and just shake it around a little to keep it from settling. This helps alot. By the way, I've gotten used to the taste after taking this for over a week, it still stinks though... :)

column9: Good stuff but the taste kills it...
column10: I buy and use "Wheat Grass Powder" from Amazing Grass. That product is superior, but this one leaves a lot to be desired. I happen to like the green vegetable juice taste many people do not like, so when I purchased this product I thought it would have the same green taste that goes very well in some diluted apple juice. I was wrong. Though it has excellent green ingredients, all of them organic, the taste is weird because they have included peppermint. The peppermint really takes away from the aromatic flavor of the grasses and introduces a minty aftertaste, kind of like brushing your teeth with a minty toothpaste and then drinking juice right after. Not too tasty. This product would be great if the peppermint was omitted. Buy their "Amazing Grass Organic Wheat Grass Powder, 30 Servings, 8.5-Ounce Container" and write to the company and tell them to get rid of the peppermint.

I got roped into drinking this over a year ago, when an order from iHerb had a sample packet.  I really liked the taste and the energy I got from drinking it.  So I purchased a canister (it's a LOT! of powder) and am still working on it.The taste is naturally sweet with a vegetably taste, but it's not bitter.  I don't like sweets much so it's right up my alley taste-wise.I usually drink less than a scoop at a time because I get a "high" from drinking it, which I don't like very much.  It's also a lot of vitamin A, and it's not healthy to intake huge excesses since it's a fat-soluble vitamin.  I also find that if I drink a whole scoop every day, then stop, I will get a headache and a weird loopy feeling of withdrawal.  Supplements are drugs - keep that in mind.And, of course, you shouldn't be substituting this for a healthy diet.  I use it as a periodic supplement to augment the days I don't eat enough leafy greens.Overall, the sedimentation left at the bottom of the glass isn't a big deal.  Add another 1/2 cup of water, swish, and drink the remains!

I'll start by saying I'm not a fan of green powder drinks - I've tried a couple of others and finally resorted to pill form.  However, trying to take the amount of pills needed to equal one scoop of greens was a bit much.  I finally quit the pills and resorted to thinking that there were no greens in my future.  Then I stumbled on this product and read the reviews and still wanting to "do" greens I decided to brave it.  I agree with the other posts here, this is some amazing stuff!  I haven't tried it plain yet, but I have mixed it in with some carrot juice/water, with my metamucil, with some veggie juice and in a fruit smoothie.  Every one of those tasted perfectly fine and I didn't get that just mowed lawn taste!  I will say that the mixing is not the easiest although I've learned to use a fork and start with a small amount of water adding a bit more and stirring etc.  I've not found any residue in the bottom of the glass and I drank it so fast it didn't have time to settle.  I've only been using this for six days but I do think my energy level is better than before.  Overall I think this is a major improvement on the "green" concept and I plan to continue using it.  I haven't tried the other flavors either but I figured if this one tastes ok the others are probably equally as good.  If you've been scared away by the taste of some other greens you may want to consider trying this one.

column9: I love Amazing Grass and so does my skin!
column10: This is a great product. My skin is noticeably more vibrant and supple; my energy level is clean, consistent, and lovely. You just feel fantastic with a little Amazing Grass in your daily life. This is my first Amazing Grass experience and I am extremely pleased. I've been using it for about a month and I still have a good amount of the good green powder remaining. So, you get your bang for your buck.The ultimate way to prepare - - a smoothie! Almond milk, spinach, frozen blueberries, a couple left-over slices of banana and pear, and some celery. And a hearty scoup of Amazing Grass and a touch of agave nectar!I highly recommend Amazing Grass!!

column9: Gives me a rush. Easy Greens
column10: Gives me a mild rush. Reminds me of a Niacin rush. Mixes well with hot water in a Classic Mini 20oz Blender Bottle Green.I am happy to be getting "greens" in an easy way.The taste is mild and I have no problem with it.

this has a BAD aftertaste....i will finish taking it due to the ingredients, but i hope there is a better tasting product out there. granted, it is just a brief unpleasantness, but taste good it does not in my opinion. i have to force myself to take it.
I am trying the various flavors still but I am hooked on this stuff.  Put it in a smoothie for breakfast, some agave nectar, almond milk, greek yogurt, heaven!

This product is great! It's really easy to make in the morning and I feel great! It tastes really good for a superfood drink.  If you are someone that doen't like the green taste, then try the chocolate favor. It's wonderful and my favorite.I've also heard the orange is tasty but haven't tried it myself. Would definitely recommend this!

Love Love Love This!! i did however find another product from garden of life and purchased that as well because it has more vegetables and herbs in it and will help eliminate herbs and vitamins you take on the side like turmeric etc

I received this yesterday, and just tried it this morning. I mixed one scoop with approx 12 oz of cherry juice.  It wasn't too bad- it kind of tasted like fruity seaweed (luckily, I like the taste of seaweed)  I'll probably try it in a smoothie tomorrow.
Great product!  Everything as advertised.  Plenty of servings which isn't the case for many other similar products.  A serving is small and quite manageable.

I have tried EVERY kind of Wasabi additive to highten the taste of the Mustard I serve in my restaurant (Waba Grill in Yucaipa).  This is the ONLY stuff that works.  I have tried 5 different kinds of "powdered" Wasabi, AND THEY SUCK).  I squeeze 6 bottles of this stuff into a gallon of regular mustard, and serve it, and my customers just love it.
