This stuff from (Roland) is cheaper, and I get it in 3 days or so.  Love it alot!!  Keep it in stock for me...........Thanks[...]

column9: Tasty, but not as good as the kind in the sushi.
column10: This wasabi is pretty good, but not nearly as good as the stuff that comes with the sushi typically.  I bought this wasabi because I can never get enough of the stuff that comes with the sushi... but beware...this stuff is hot!  You only need to use a small amount to get a big impact.I do worry a little since this product is imported from China.
Roland makes a good wasabi that works well in use. The tube keeps it fresh and the taste is fine.

I love Jam, but we never finish the big pots. We get tired of one flavor and open another jar, and another one... These little pots are ideal for us. They may be a little more expensive than larger pots but if you are like us at least, you won;t going to waste food. They are also very nice to put on the table when you have guests.We love the Stonewall Kitchen product and their strawberry jam is consistent with their brand, delicious!

Ferrara Pan Candy Company was founded in 1900, in Chicago, Illinois. In 1962, the company hit on a new great tasting candy - Lemonheads. Tart and sweet at the same time, it was a huge success, and a staple of the company. Later, the company spread out, making several other flavors of the candy, including Cherryheads, Appleheads and Grapeheads.Lemonheads are delicious, little yellow candies that are sweet and tart, and have that great lemon taste. Admittedly they are not as sour as the newer super-sour candies, but too many of those other candies just give you a wave of tasteless super-sour, and then you get to eat the super-sweet candy. With Lemonheads, you get a nice flavor of tart lemons, especially if you chew on them (which I recommend :-).When I was growing up in the Chicagoland area, Ferrara Pan candies were a staple of every kids diet. Now, eating Lemonheads takes me back to my childhood. Buy Lemonheads and enjoy a great candy. I highly recommend them!
OMG...these LemonHeads are great.  They came individually wrapped and fresh. My sister has also ordered from this company and had a wonderful experience.  We're planning to order more..
You get a small amount of candy for a large price. Look elsewhere this product is cheaper through other sources.
I tried these on impulse and cannot stop buying the things.  They are really, really good.  Verrry addicting!!

I ordered this bamboo plant for my boyfriend as a lil surprise gift, so he didnt kno that he'll get it.The shipping was pretty fast, but the vase is not dark blue. Its a brown vase with a white flower/plant on it and the whole thing looks smaller then i expected. I'm kinda disappointed of it but it still looks nice and my boyfriend really likes it, so i guess itz just fine.

Plant looks almost exact as in the picture. The description matches what I received. The plant is in great condition and shipping was quick. There are two things preventing me from giving five stars. One is the vase is brown and not dark blue as described in the title. No big deal for me. The second is that unless stones, marbles or soil is added to the vase the plant won't stand up straight on its own. Again, not a big deal but just know that this plant does not come completely ready to display.
Its beautiful and unique and perfect for any room in the house. The vase is very sophisticated to blend into any decor setting.

I love all of the lucky bamboo I get from 9GB.  They're always in good shape and have a lot of shoots coming off of them, and the vases are always nice as well.  Still not sure what the goopy stuff that comes on the roots is, but I assume it's a packaging technique to make sure that the roots stay wet throughout transport.

It wasn't worth it to spend the extra to have it shipped faster. The stalks are tied together with twist ties to make the shapes so I took it all apart so the ties wouldn't hurt the plants. The bamboo is doing great though. Had to buy a bigger vase.

I was so very disappointed when I received this in the mail. It is shorter than the picture shows (the braids only intertwine twice, not 3 or 4 times like the picture). And the container it comes in is small and looks cheap.  It doesn't even come with rocks or soil, so it doesn't stand up in said container. It was intended as a Christmas gift, but I ended up throwing it away because it looked so cheap. This was my worst Amazon purchase ever.

This vinegar is wonderful.  It's a huge bottle and the taste is beyond compare.  When Sherry vinegar is called for in a recipe, there is no alternative for its sweet, pungy flavor.  However, I use this vinegar for salad dressings and in place of red wine vinegar.  I purchased it only a few weeks ago and it is half gone.  I will be ordering again.

This product is available at a local gourmet food store, but I got about a third more for the same price, even after I factored in the shipping.  Plus, I didn't have to go get it; delivered to my door.  No doubt, we will shop here again!  Quick shipping/delivery.
Excellent Sherry Vinegar. Perfect for the professional chef or private use.Great flavoring for multiple cooking uses
I always wondered if using a ready good vinegar would make a big difference in salads.  Answer: yes! this produce is worth the money and a little goes a long ways.

This sherry is great. I have tried every domestic sherry I could find and none are close to this one. It is worth the money when your food turns out this good. It was packaged very well and I received it 2 days early. One of the best finds ever.
This is exactly what I have been searching for and finally found it on Amazon.

column9: Fresh, crispy and the perfect sweet / salty snack delivered straight to your door
column10: I love Chicago style popcorn (that perfect balance of cheese and caramel) and go to great lengths to get "the good stuff".  It is hard to get the perfect Chicago style but I am so pleased to have found KuKuRuZa and love the fact that Amazon will drop it off right at my doorstep!Finding a high quality Chicago style corn has always been a bit of a challenge.  The holiday season always brings the obligatory bucket of three flavors but the popcorn is not fresh and doesn't make my taste buds dance..  Occasionally I order from the other website (starts with a G) but it is so expensive it is hard to justify more than once a year.  Even less often I will trek out of my way to the mall and get a bag mixed up but it is a pain to fight the crowds.This popcorn was amazing!  The cheese was nice and cheesy and the caramel was light and crispy.  There was a 50/50 ratio which is typical but I like my popcorn a little saltier and tend to like 2 parts cheese to 1 part caramel but the kid and the husband picked up the slack and helped to finish the caramel that I left behind.  I will definitely order this popcorn again!  Perhaps next time I will add in an extra bag of cheddar and create my own mix.
This popcorn is delicious.  The combination of cheddar popcorn and carmel popcorn is a taste sensation.  A movie night with this popcorn is one to remember.

I have to disagree with other reviewers who said that the banana chips in this are the same as any other.  Normal banana chips are like eating rocks and are really tasteless.  These however, are little intense bites of banana which are soft enough for a toddler.  My son, who is incredibly picky and won't touch most fruits and vegetables, loves these and specifically asks for the strawberries (though he won't eat fresh ones).  As to the cost, while you certainly can buy these at Whole Foods and other similar places the packages they sell there are far smaller and are more expensive per ounce.  Actually, the Amazon price is even a little cheaper than buying direct from the manufacturer.

I love this item.  The strawberries and bananas are nice and crunchy and sweet, with the tang of the strawberries complementing the sweetness of the bananas.  Eating this is addictive - but at least you can rest assured you're addicted to something healty, low calorie and delicious.

column9: Wonderful, yummy product, worth every penny!
column10: Before I ordered these I had to call the company (got their # from their website) to see if these were freeze dried or just dried/dehydrated. Their listing should specify this, though it doesn't specify on they website either.They are indeed freeze dried, delicious and crispy.My only complaint (reason for 4 stars) is that after shipment they get a little beat up and a lot of the pieces break. Really only the strawberries though, but the container was filled with red strawberry powder.It's kind of disappointing to lose that little bit considering the price.The smaller pieces are OK because I bought these for my two boys 2 and under.It's a far better deal and product compared to the Gerber Little Fruits I was buying and paying nearly $3 and ounce for. What I know now to be tasteless freeze dried fruit.Bottom line: I will buy these again.
Excellent used in cereal. The strawberry flavor predominates. A great combo of 2 fruits. A satisfying taste sensation!

column9: Great healthy snack, a little pricey!
column10: I love the combination of the tart, crunchy strawberries with the sweet, crunchy bananas.  I agree with other reviewers that the strawberries get a little pulverized, leaving a red/pink 'dust' in the package, but this didn't bother me much...just have to make sure you eat these somewhere where a little dust mess is OK and easy to clean up.They are kind of expensive, but I haven't found another comparable product with this quality for any less.
These last for about a week after opened, they taste alright but not worth the extra price.  Would go to your local Whole Foods to pick up something better.
I love the "Just" products but this is my absolute fave! Great for a healthier something to grab on the run. Perfect for me and my son :)

I bought these for my daughter since she loves strawberries and bananas.  These are easy to travel with and I know they aren't loaded with sugar.  The taste and quality are great!  I only gave 4 stars because when they arrived a LOT of the strawberries were broken up and basically in powder form.  Thats not to say there wasn't a lot of the left though!  We will absolutely be buying more of these soon!

I really enjoyed these no-additives dried fruit snacks.  The banana chips tasted just like bananas - and not oil, which most fried banana chips do.  The strawberries were tart and just a little chewy and tasted like real fruit.  The lack of additives really makes a difference!I didn't enjoy the mixed fruit I'd gotten from Just Tomatoes previously - apples are a hard sell, as the skin gets tough and sour.  But these were really fantastic and I will be ordering more soon!

we love all of the just tomatoes products we've tried, and the strawberries and bananas are no different. its great in cereal, and just to munch on. my 16month old doesnt like fresh strawberries, but he loves these. its a quick easy healthy snack for the toddler, and for mom and dad too :)

We LOVE this fruit!! However the price was way to high for what you receive. The add was confusing since it said you would receive 1.2 pounds of fruit. That is by far a lie. It is much cheaper at the fresh market. Hope you have one near you.
but if you live nearby to a whole foods market, you can pick from a variety of these for a lot less money ($3-$8 depending on what you want).the cost on amazon must be a mistake.

This is a great product from a company which has so far impressed me.  I combine this with GreenSense Liquid Kelp and a little apple cider vinegar, and my plants are doing quite well. I searched high and low, tried some other products, but these from GreenSense are the best so far by a long shot.  Thank you GreenSense!

column9: One of the Best Knudsen Spritzers
column10: I've never been fond of sodas with just corn syrup and artificial flavors.  While, the R.W. Knudsen Spritzers aren't that much healthier, they do taste incredibly delicious.  I've tried many other similar products like izze's sparkling juices, but they can't compete.Most of the R.W. Knudsen spritzers use apple juice or white grape juice along with sparkling water as the main ingredients.  Still the strawberry does have strawberry (and pineapple) juice in it, and the flavor is undeniably strawberry-esque.  They are pretty sweet, but not sickeningly sweet.  Most sodas are probably a little sweeter than these spritzers.I would recommend this strawberry spritzer as my favorite flavor.  I also really like their peach spritzer.  The only one I've disliked has been the Lemon and Lime.
This is the typical tobiko you have at any Sushi restaurant. It was fresh and delicious. I used it on homemade sushi, eggs and salads. I loved it!

I love Dole's Pineapple Parfait - they used to sell in the stores in smaller packaging, but for some reason you can no longer find them.  Even on their website they no longer show a listing for the smaller size. Oh well more for me.  But the only place I can get is online at Amazon.  Thank you for being here.  I really do love the stuff.  Creamy parfait with pineapple, what's not to love.
GREAT WAY TO GET FRUIT IN YOUR DIET.SWEET PINEAPPLE TASTE.GOOD FOR NIGHT SNACK. GOOD ANY TIME. CREAM WITHIT IS SO SMOOTH.

I happened to catch a vendor who had one box of this hot cocoa left and had it at a very good price, in the $8 range.  Since them the prices have been $12 and above.  I just found that moving into winter that Sam's is once again carrying it in packets at a price in the $7-8 range.  I have found Nestle Hot Cocoa with no sugar was much more chocolate tasting than Swiss Miss.

Sellers should NOT be able to sell products that you eat or drink that are almostat their "BEST BUY DATE".  It's hard for 1 person to drink 60 packets of Hot Cocoain a 1 and half months. This product has been around for a LONG TIME.

If you've ever wanted a cup of hot cocoa that tastes great without a lot of calories and actually dissolves in the water, this is the product.  This cocoa is excellent and in my opinion, the best "diet" cocoa out there.  Other sugar free products just don't compare.  If you add a dollup of whipped cream, you don't even realize that you are drinking splenda (I think).I found this product at Sam's and went through 2 big boxes in one Fall and Winter season.  I shared this product with my weight watcher friends and they were delighted since it's taste is superior to other cocoas.  Currently, Sam's has removed it from the shelves. Hopefully they will restock it next Fall, but if they don't, I wanted to see if it was available online.  I'm very glad to see Amazon is selling it too.

column9: ingredients not the same as listed
column10: I normally buy the organic version, but since they were out of stock, I ordered these.  They taste as good as they normally do, but the ingredients are not the same as listed.  They are: wholegrain oats, sunflower oil, palm oil, sea salt, sodium bicarbonate: raising agent, natural flavouring.  I normally avoid anything that says natural flavoring and wouldn't have bought these it that were listed on the page.

Just got these for the first time, and hope they stay on subscribe & save. They are great just by themselves, am still experimenting to see what toppings I prefer on them compared with rice crackers. I don't particularly like regular porridge-type oatmeal, but love the taste of oats - so these are perfect for me. I used to make oat crackers myself (just whizzing up oat flour in the blender from rolled oats or buying it, adding enough water and optional oil/salt to work it, flattened and baked) but these are much better than anything I made. The texture is a little crumbly when you eat them but they still stay together as a cracker and it isn't hard to spread things on them (such as nut or seed butters, peanut butter, etc.).They come in 4 individual packets within the box (7 crackers in each), which can be helpful in keeping them fresh and also transporting them for a handy snack. I just put the remainder of a packet in a small container. They're quite filling - 91 calories, 2.3 g fiber, 2.3 g protein for 2 crackers. They're also big. about 2.5 inches in diameter.

In my opinion, there are no better oatcakes on the market than these. Deliciously oaty and crunchy, they have no extraneous ingredients. Unlike so many others, they're not too salty (but just salty enough). They hold up well to being topped with cheese, spread with butter, or festooned with jam, and complement either sweet or salty toppings. We have a standing subscription for these and wouldn't be without them (if you buy them at your local market, check the subscription price against what you pay and I believe you'll see a serious saving). We, however, subscribe for the convenience of delivery to the door and the certainty of never running out of these crunchy, wonderful treats.

I received this is great condition and in a timely fashion. It was exactly as I ordered. However they did not live up to the tasty review that was printed. To me they taste like cardboard. I will not buy them again. However the vendor did a wonderful job.

column9: A Must-Have That's Hard to Find
column10: I have had the worst time finding oatcakes over the years.  I would occasionally find some but they were almost always the sweetened kind - which are also good, but not what I wanted.I can see that some people might be puzzled over the adoration some of us have for oatcakes.  Basically, they are simple crackers made of oats.  You might best describe them as rustic.  Which is the charm.If you've never had them, I would say the closest common product to compare them to might be graham crackers.  However, oatcakes are denser, less sweet, less soft, and less crumbly.  They are slightly more chewy, and possess more texture.  Imagine taking steel-cut oats and rolling them out into very thin, flat crackers.  So, these are slightly less brittle than regular crackers, resulting in less flaking, breaking or crumbling.  They are sturdy, holding up to toppings and handling.In these boxes, the crackers are cellophane wrapped in sets of 7, which is nice since it keeps them from going stale.  Because oats are high in fiber, these are more filling than you might think, and each oatcake is a nice, largish size-maybe a little bigger than a regular saltine cracker (and round, of course).  So you will probably get a goodly number of servings per box.These go well with all sorts of toppings, and are great plain too if you just need something with your coffee or tea etc. to deal with a stomach pang but don't really feel like anything fancy.  I think a lot of people would like this for breakfast for that reason.  I often get up in the morning and don't want to eat a meal, but just want a little something simple and plain.  These are a healthy good choice for that.I haven't tried using them for other things, like cracker crumb coatings, but I can't see any reason why you couldn't experiment with using these for things like that which you would use regular crackers for.  I think they would make a really nice rustic crumb pie crust or cobbler topping for either sweet or savory pies, for example.

This was a great price for Nairn's Scottish Oatcakes. I am a Scot and these rough oatmeal oatcakes, as they are called in Scotland, are the best. Totally addictive but heart healthy!! They arrrived in a timely manner, well packed and unbroken and totally fresh. Try them with any kind of spread or just healthy butter spread and a piece of cheese, YUM !

column9: the best firmament for cheese ever invented
column10: oatcakes are a scottish marvel, and these nairn's rough oatcakes are the closest to the real thing you can reliably get outside of the UK. just say no to walkers and try the best.

OH! I love Nairn's oat cakes!I got hooked eating them in Britain, but they cost so MUCH here in the states, even at our local food co-op... [because they're baked in Scotland..how cool is THAT?]Amazon has a great price, and they are so fresh! If you haven't tried these, especially if you are a type 2 diabetic [oats are way better for us than wheat, and these crackers have no sugar added] I highly recommend ordering a batch..And go for the cheaper 'subscription' price. Heck, you only have to get two shipments per year to do so, and I'll bet after you try your first box, you'll find you'll be wanting to eat a lot more than that!

I have allergies. Most gluten free crackers have a lot of problem ingredients. Nairn's Oats Cakes are basically oats, oil, salt and baking soda.They are a great wheat free substitute for crackers when I want a crunchy carb. I found them when traveling in England. One day I was standing in the gluten free aisle of Whole Foods and heard a  couple talking with a  British accent. I asked them if they knew where I could find Nairn's Oat Cakes. They said no and that they certainly missed them. I was so excited to find them on Amazon.  I like the Red Box "rough" the best. The Yellow Box "fine" has a baking soda taste to me. I don't let myself buy the sweetened ones because not eating the whole box requires more will power than I have. Thank you. Becky, Colorado

I love oatcakes so of course like most I did the topping go around and I thought try something way different...hear me out it's not bad, marmite on oatcake lol Try it sometime, Nairns oatcake is great with anything on it or nothing just depends on the person.

column9: Great crackers for those with wheat allergy
column10: I love these oat cakes. Good with cheese or jam!  They have no wheat flour as I  have a problem with white processed flour.  So many oat crackers still have a flour base and these do not.  If you like a hearty oat cake with some substance, you should like these.

I've loved these oatcakes for several years, ever since a friend in Scotland started sending them in my Christmas box. I've ordered them from the online Scottish Grocer site but the shipping costs are very high. So, glad to to find them on Amazon where they qualify for free shipping!

These are an old family favorite that we haven't been able to find for years - was such a treat to wrap them up and surprise everyone at Christmas.  Not a "cracker" for everyone, very dry and best eaten with butter or cheddar, but if you like them they are terrific
My husband and his family like to avoid gluten, so these are a great choice.  We have a hard time finding them locally, so ordering them online is great.  Our young kids like them, too.
These are really terrible.  It isn't easy to find truly nut and egg free food items, so I thought I would try them.But they were dry, cardboard, flavorless - really, really really awful.

Just a few years ago lychee black tea was almost impossible to find.  Now there are several products on Amazon and other sources on the web.Lychee black is my favorite tea.  As the description says it's a quality black tea with a hint of lychee sweetness.I usually purchase my lychee tea in bulk, it arrives in a (resealable) bag and I pour it into a couple of different cannisters (one at home, one at work, one for my "travel kit").  I ordered this tea because Amazon offers it under their "eligible for free shipping" program, I can get the same amount of tea in nice cannisters (always good for sharing with friends) for the same cost I pay for bulk PLUS shipping to another vendor.I hadn't tried the Tao of Tea brand for the black lychee before, and was interested in doing a taste test with my usual brand . . . it seemed a little more flavorful and fresher.  I was pleasantly surprised.  The cannisters are the double closed style (a second lid under the slide lid).

The Tao of Tea Lychee Black Tea blends a fairly mellow, good-quality black tea with the taste of the syrup you find in a can of lychees.  It's not objectionable to drink, but it's not something I think of as a treat or luxury either.  If you're looking for a high quality lychee black tea, I would recommend Lupicia's version which mixes a high-quality, complex yet balanced Keemun black tea with a more authentic lychee aroma.  Of course, it's twice as a expensive, but in this case, you get what you pay for.

These capers are about the size of a pea (they are not the super tiny nonpareille capers which my husband prefers). These are very salty and briny so I rinse them before using them in a recipe (or just to pop in my mouth for a healthy snack). I like to chop these up and add them to everything from tuna sandwiches, Thai spring rolls, potato/macaroni/antipasto/garden salads to Asian stir fries, quiche, omelette's, deviled eggs and other egg dishes, braised/sautéed/roasted meats and just about any Italian and French cuisine. They definitely add a special 'extra' something to many dishes and they are quite versatile for hot or cold dishes. You could use them in limitless recipes. Just be sure to withhold some salt when you use them.On a side note: Capers are highest in Quercetin which is a potent flavonoid, very anti-inflammatory and also a natural antihistamine (these help my summer allergies immensely to my pleasant surprise).Needless to say, I'm going to be eating a lot of capers this summer and these are a great price!To taste-buds AND your health!

One of my favorite dishes to make at home is chicken piccata. It's a tasty chicken dish. One of the key components is capers, to add a bit of bite to the dish. Roland capers are normally the ones that I use (I know, they're not top of the line). Even though relatively inexpensive, they do the job on my chicken piccata (and other recipes calling for capers). A cost-effective ingrdient for a variety of dishes. . . .

I had a really persistent cough for months, even after seeing a doctor and being put on antibiotics. I had ear problems along with it, as well. Then, the other day, I bought a bag of Halls Defense just because I saw it at the grocery store. Now I find that I'm not having any coughing fits and my recent earache is gone, so I had to call and cancel a doctor's appointment I had made for today! Love Halls! (It also doesn't hurt that these drops taste good.)
I first had this hot sauce at Tijuana Flats in Florida -- a great restaurant.  It doesn't have that much heat by some standards, but it is tasty!
We have an Acupuncture clinic and serve a varity of hot teas to all of our patients and this is by far their and our favorite.

column9: THIS is the one to buy!  But BUY THE 3 PACK! It's cheaper!
column10: They guy who says not to mix this one up with the other one knows what he is talking about. I am a caramel flavoring connoisseur and as far as sugar free goes, this on is the deal.B
I use this flavoring in my coffee, protein drinks, protein ice cream. It has a wonderful flavor.

THANKS, I RECEIVED THIS SOONER THAN EXPECTED!!! THIS PRODUCT WORKS GREAT WITH MY PROTEIN SHAKES AND HOMEMADE SUGAR FREE ICE CREAM!!!! ALSO, THEY DON'T SELL THIS FLAVOR IN MY TOWN, SO THANKS AGAIN AND GOD BLESS!!!!

I originally had tried pumkin flavored coffee purchased at the grocery store during the hollidays last year, but since it was a seasonal item, I started using pumkin spice flavoring in the coffee.  Since the pumkin spice is not available in sugar free, I tried the carmel sugar free, and love it.

I like all the sugar-free (SF) syrups, except the chocolate which is just too bitter. I drink them in my coffee almost every day. This SF Caramel is the best, but I also like the SF Almond Roca and SF Coconut.
I took one taste and poured this down the drain.  The flavor and aroma is of artifical butterscotch, NOT CARAMEL.
Like I said in the other reviews Torani is a good syrup in flavoring coffee, desserts and teas! Thanks!

column9: Ordered this and received Classic Caramel instead
column10: I ordered this individual bottle instead of the three pack hoping that this way I would get the plain sugar free Caramel flavor instead of the "Classic" which the reviewers of the three pack complained of receiving. Well guess what, I received the "Classic" Caramel flavor which is absolutely horrible! The box that this glass bottle shipped in said Torani Sugar Free Caramel but inside was the Classic version. I do not know if Torani packs these individual bottles and ships them to Amazon and there was a problem with Torani's labeling or if Amazon packs these and labels them and someone in the warehouse isn't paying attention but the result is the same, nasty syrup. I called customer service and he didn't sound particularly surprised but did appologize and advise me he would see that the issue was corrected.

This brand of flours are highly recommended and good quality, I have never used any potato starch before but this one seems soft and powdery. This is a pantry staple if you have to have a gluten-free diet and you can even use it for regular cooking. Best if refrigerated by the way.
Good product, brand known for purity and can be trusted.  Very fine powder, works great in gluten-free baking. We especially use it in gf cookie recipes.

column9: Works fine for baking gluten free bread and cakes
column10: I bought because we have gluten allergy in the family. It works fine in home made breads and cakes. I recommend this product.

First off, I like that it comes in a pack of 4 and it is cheaper than in store.It also is called for in a lot of my gluten free recipes, so I use it a lot to make various gluten free goodies.But, the best part of potato starch is using it as a thickener in gravy, soups, etc. When I first had to go wheat free I wasn't sure how I would get my gravies to thicken.  I started using cornstarch but found that it didn't reheat well at all and would get all clumpy.  One day I decided to use potato starch instead - holy cow it's amazing a thickener.  It reheats perfectly and doesn't get those odd clumps in.  Even if I could suddenly eat wheat again, I would still use potato starch as my thickener!

This is a great product.  I buy my Potato Starch from Amazon each time I need it (subscribe and save, in fact) and it's always fresh.  So many wonderful things come out of my kitchen, and I have Amazon to thank for many of the ingredients.
I thought I wouldn't use that much, but after getting a bread machine, I use it weekly. Glad to have found a great product at a good price.

Many GF recipes call for Potato Starch - something distinct from potato starch FLOUR. Your final product won't be the same if you don't use the right one. But I have yet to find a local store that had this on the shelf. Thank you, Amazon, for hooking me up!

This is a great product and a good price.  Potato Starch flour is a must-have for gluten free baking.  We mix one bag potato starch flour, one bag sorghum flour and one box/bag either rice or corn starch, and voila, a one for one substitute for wheat flour. (Don't forget the xanthan gum to make it all stick together.)  Amazon makes it easy to get the product, which only some natural food stores carry.

Bob's Red Mill continually makes an excellent product that is safe for those whom are celiac or gluten intolerant. This starch is also excellent to replace corn starch and works for thickening, and for canning recipes that might call for a corn based starch. It is also the best starch I've found for my cake flour mix for cakes, desserts and pastries. Excellent product and customer service at a good value.
I like Bob's Red Mill products and this four pack is a good price, at least where I live. The potato starch works well in gluten free recipes.

Novus teas are quickly becoming one of my favorites.  I have purchased several of them, including the sampler box which allowed me to try 12 different varieities.  This one in particular stands out.I am typically not someone who enjoyes citrus -- it just is too tangy for my taste buds, however this tea is great!  It is mild in the lemon flavor and to use dessert analogy, it's more like drinking a lemon pound cake versus a lemon tart.Loose-leaf teas are usually superior to the crushed tea leaves in regular tea bags, but I often am impatient to deal with all the mess.  These are packed with loose-leaf tea in a mesh pyramid which allows for the benefits of the loose tea without having to clean out a teapot with the soggy leaves.  Each pyramid contains enough tea leaves for a small teapot, not just a single cup and are individually sealed for freshness.If you enjoy lemon chamomile tea, be sure to give this one a try.  It's great !!

I bought a box of these as a special.  Sure glad I bought when I did as the price went up drastically.  I love raspberries and wanted to try dark chocolate over milk chocolate.  These taste excellent!  I consider them a treat after dinner as if I was eating one of those very expensive chocolates but for much less the cost.  They are small enough that I don't feel like I am packing away pounds by eating one or two yet are very flavorful in a small candy.I would buy again but having 430 of them I have enough for awhile.  Will probably take some to work to share with the group.
This was the cheapest site I found these sourbelts after searching all over. They came within a few days and were soft. Will defiantly order them again on here.
The belts arrived in a plastic bag that wasn't sealed. I thought this is how they might arrive though based on the previous review. Other than that I loved the delicious sour belts.

Of course this candy is delicious, which is the reason I ordered it.  I already knew what I was getting.  The only thing that bothered me was that it came in a plastic bag that was not even sealed.  I also ordered green candies but these were packaged in the original boxes and sealed.  Although the description says unwrapped it should be more specific, because they also sell these candies individually wrapped so I assumed it simply meant they were not individually wrapped.  I would at least expect the plastic to be sealed.  Otherwise everything was yummy and definitely worth the money.

I bought this product with hesitation after the last reviewer mentioned the odd consistency but I can honestly say I had no problems whatsoever.  It is a good product, comes with the pump and is probably as good as you get from the major coffee shops.  It is really thick but I chalk that up to it being real vanilla and not synthetic.  I am 1/3 through the bottle and will probably buy again.

The flavor of the syrup is excellent. It has a strong, natural vanilla flavor without being overly sweet. It adds a nice compliment to my espresso drinks.However, the consistency of the syrup is why I am giving it three stars. The syrup in the bottle I received is partially crystallized (like a bottle of old honey gets). It is so thick that it clogs the pump sometimes and it is hard to get the syrup to dissolve in my coffee. I don't know if this is only a problem with the bottle I received or the vanilla syrup in general because the Amoretti Butterscotch syrup I ordered at the same time is excellent and doesn't have any of these problems.UPDATE: Changed to 4 stars. Amoretti has some of the best customer service that I have come across. A couple days after posting this review, I got a call from a representative of Amoretti. He explained that the reason the syrup is thicker than I was expecting is because they use real vanilla beans in the syrup. The pieces of vanilla bean can make the syrup thicken.Amoretti clearly cares about customer satisfaction and takes pride in their products. They offered to send me another flavor of syrup, which, like their butterscotch syrup, is smooth and delicious.As I mentioned in the original review, the flavors of all the syrups I have tried from Amoretti have been excellent. You just have to be prepared for some of their syrups to be a little thicker than some other brands. Now that I know why the syrup is thicker, I will be buying from them again.

column9: Great for those who need Gluten Free
column10: I bought this for my wife who has many food allergies. She cannot have wheat or items containg gluten.  This is one of the best products I have found. Its crunchy and tastes great. It seems that most things we buy for her lack one thing or another, this product has it all.  I even like it. She absoultely loved it and I am out of the dog house.....for as long as it lasts...

Another reviewer seems to have missed a point that is so important to those with celiac disease or gluten intolerance.  This is from the Bear Naked product description:  "Packaged in a facility that processes wheat, nuts, soy and dairy."  Bakery on Main is gluten free, and in my opinion is quite delicious.  So for those who must avoid all traces of gluten, and want to choose a product that isn't processed at a facility that also processes wheat, rest assured that you are buying a delicious product with Bakery on Main products.  I discovered their products at Life Grocery in Marietta, GA, a few months ago, and I've been hooked ever since.  I don't care for the apple variety, but the others are great.

column9: Bakery on Main Gluten Free Granola
column10: This is a tasty product, unlike some of the gluten-free foods that I have tried.  It is very crunchy with lots of fruit and nuts.  It has plenty of calories, but I use it as a topping for other, less-tasty cereals, e.g. bran flakes or some of the high-fiber cereals that remind me of twigs and leaves.  I will definitely be ordering more in the future.

I was very much satistied with this product. If it weren't for the reviews, I might not have ordered it though. It arrives absolutely fresh, tasty, crunchy, not too sweet, and delicious. I love granola and I'm now hooked on this gluten free (just about everything free)product. I've had friends and co-workers try it who also agree that it's tasty. I mix the "Extreme Fruit" granola with some yogurt for breakfeast just about every morning. You have got to try this product. I think it's great.
This granola has great flavor and contents: real, wholesome ingredients. Good crunch too. The package does not last long at all, because it is so good. I did expect more fruit.

column9: I can't stay out of this stuff!
column10: I keep a bag in the car at all times. I'm gluten intolerant and it's so great to be able to have granola again.  I can't wait to try the other flavors.

column4: Silvia Bridger "Publisher of The Truth About ...
column10: This granola is full of fruit and nuts, tastes good, and will be enjoyed by anyone with a wheat allergy.

For a Celiac patient who misses morning cereal, this is great! I mix gluten free corn flakes with the Bakery on Main Granola, usually Extreme Fruit and Nut. It's a good breakfast and can be mixed and put in a container for use anywhere. I recently took this mixture with me on two cruises.
This stuff is to die for, it is GREAT! If you are avoiding gluten I cannot recommend this granola enough. All of the flavors are very good.

We had been getting this granola at the health food store and found it online at Amazon.  It is much cheaper and more fresh than the health food store and delivered to my front door.  My entire family loves this stuff.

column9: Good when fresh, horrible when stale.
column10: I opened a package on August 14, 2010, with an expiration date of March 2011 and found, to my great disappointment, that it was wretchedly stale...not only the nuts, but the entire contents.  Customer service obviously doesn't care because they haven't bothered themselves to return my call...guess they don't want to deal with people who dislike paying for food that is not edible.

Have been purchasing this granola at the health food shop until I saw it on Amazon for a much lower price. The only true gluten free granola that doesn't make you feel diet restricted. My whole family sprinkles it on their yogurt and pudding and ice cream as toppings. I use it for apple cobbler. Can't seem to keep it in the house very long.  A perfect gluten free product for traveling.  MMmmm!!!!!!!!!!!

This stuff is addictive.  Everyone in my family who's tried it loves it, especially the whole dried fruits and nuts-- it's almost more like trail mix than granola.  Also, the flakes and grain bits taste kind of like Captain Crunch, which I like.Makes a great add-in for cookies and muffins, too.

This is so much better than the old fashioned oatmeal granola.  The flavor is outstanding and iBakery On Main Extreme Fruit & Nut, Gluten Free Granola, 12-Ounces Bags (Pack of 6)t's great in low fat vanilla yogurt!
This granola is amazing! I bought it on a whim at the grocery store, and now we can't buy enough of it. Every little corn cup is a super bite of deliciousness. It's a great snack anytime of the day!

This cereal is absolutely one of my favourites, love the flavour and the fruits and cannot believe that is gluten free, a real treat for people who want a nice cereal or something to add to a yogurt.I like also to add some nuts to this cereal, but the ingredients are of the highest quality and the packaging is really good at keeeping the granola frsh, a must buy.

I would highly recommend this granola to anyone who is GF (and even for those who aren't it's great) - my family, who isn't GF, enjoys eating it, too.  One of the things I really enjoy about this granola besides the flavor is that it stays crunchy even when you add milk to it. Give this a try!

I can honestly say that I do not have to search out gluten free products but I found Bakery On Main's Extreme Fruit & Nut Granola in the cereal aisle at Big Y. The packaging hooked me and I bought some.  Now I'm really hooked.  It is delicious and as far as I'm concerned a healthy, crunchy snack.  I've now resorted to buying it on Amazon.
I have been eating this granola ever since they diagnosed me with celiac disease and I just love it.  I panic when I am running out of it.

column9: My favorite gluten-free cereal - full of flavor and crunch!
column10: I've been eating gluten-free for almost two years now. One of my favorite breakfasts used to be a bowl of cereal with a handful of almonds and a container of yogurt. I picked up a bag of Bakery on Main Extreme Fruit & Nut Granola at the store one day, and I was hooked! As the name says, it's loaded with fruit and nuts. There is a good mixture of large, crunchy chips and flakes, seeds, and little crunchy nuggets. I signed up for the auto-ship service on Amazon, and get a shipment of 6 bags every 4 months. With the free shipping, it comes out significantly less than buying it a bag at a time at the grocery store.Gluten-free breakfast doesn't have to be boring... Thank you, Bakery On Main!

column9: The best ever! You won't miss any gluten at all...
column10: I am thrilled with this product..it's tasty and doesn't have any weird aftertaste or make me feel sorry for myself that I can't have gluten. As a matter of fact ..I prefer it to any granola I have eaten and have to ration my husband because he thinks it's the greatest and he doesn't have an intolerance to gluten. We're going on a trip this weekend and I'll be taking it with us.Since there's nothing served on planes anymore you can be sure it'll be with me.

This is the best cereal I've ever eaten! Crunchy and yummy, I add a bit of puffed rice to it and throw in a handful of pecans because I'm diabetic. Our whole family agrees that this cereal is simply fantastic and not because it is gluten-free. None of us require a gluten-free cereal, but we all agree that it's fabulous....our favorite from all of the assorted varieties available from this company. We have reordered and reordered this and go through several bags a week. It's great by the handful, too, as a snack. YUM!

I am celiac and I am always looking for new products. Usually the gluten free foods are tasteless, or to heavy, you eat a little bit and you fell like you ate a lot.When I first tried this granola, I couldn't believe it, was "WOW".I always look for it on the supermarkets, my sisters love it too.It's really good to have a company that do something so tasteful for people with special diets.

I accidentally discovered this snack several years ago.  It was expensive, but worth the cost because it was the only gluten free snack I could find that tasted good.  I am addicted to the product and eat a bag or two a week.  To save on cost, I order it on-line at Amazon and pay $2 less per bag when I buy 6 at a time.  The shelf life is good, so buying in bulk is no problem.  I have introduced the Granola to my friends who now also buy in bulk.  Give it a try and you'll never stop buying it.

This product is so delicious that I find myself having it at any time of the day that I feel like it. My only issue -- and why I didn't give it 5 stars -- is that I wish I could get the bigger bags instead of the 12 oz. ones.Update 6/14/12. This is great cereal, but the last two whole deliveries were so stale, it tasted like wet cardboard. If you can ship fresh product, I would be more than happy to get it again.
Whether you are gluten-free or not, this is a yummy snack!  The ingredients are quality and delivers the flavor to savor!

Since beginning my gluten-free diet, one of the things I missed was granola.  But now that I have found Bakery On Main granola, I can enjoy it as a topping on my yogurt or just with milk for breakfast.  Unlike other gluten-free granolas that I tried, this one has good flavor and is not as cardboard-like as the rest.  Even my wife, who can eat gluten, enjoys Bakery on Main granola.

While cranberry is 1st place for my taste buds, the Fruit and Nut is next in line! Love Bakery and Main products! Love there's not tons of sugar and that my not-so-much gluten free husband enjoys them too! Then you know you have something good going on!

My kids with multiple food allergies (including peanuts) already have enough on their plate without having to explain why they're eating weird looking stuff.  So I am thrilled to be able to recommend Sunbutter as a peanut butter substitute.  My kids don't have to do without that childhood lunch staple, the peanut-butter sandwich.Sunbutter doesn't taste like peanut butter; it tastes like sunflower seeds.  However, this is not an unpleasant taste, just different.  It has the exact same texture and mouth-feel as peanut butter, though, so it can be used as a straight substitute for peanut butter in all kinds of recipes.  We've used it as a substitute to make peanut-free peanut sauce, peanut butter cookies, and peanut butter fudge.  It functions exactly as peanut butter does, and as long as the sunflower-seed taste goes well in the recipe, it does just fine.  I should warn you, though, there are some contexts where the flavor just doesn't work with the recipe.  On the other hand you may find that some people will prefer the flavor.  Our neighbors don't have a single peanut-allergic kid, but they bought some Sunbutter anyway because their kids had it over at our peanut-free house and loved it.Sunbutter does have a couple of quirks.  First, if you expose it to alkali, it turns green.  So if you use it in a recipe that is heavy on the baking soda, you may get an unexpected result.  And of course since detergent is alkali, if you leave any on the knife and put it in the dishwasher, that which doesn't wash off will be a harmless but very ugly fecal shade of green.  Rinse thoroughly before putting Sunbutter-covered utensils in the dishwasher.  Second, it has more of a tendency than peanut butter to separate into oil and solids.  I used to buy it in the large tubs but when we'd open one up there was an inch-thick layer of sunflower oil on the top.  We tried to mix it in but then we found that the stuff at the bottom was so thick and dry that it couldn't be spreaded at all.  We developed two workarounds for this: one, upon opening a new container, we'd dump it in the mixer and mix it all up.  Two, buy smaller jars.Overall, three cheers for Sunbutter!

It is a major food discovery for me, and I am oh so thankful.

The "mono" means they are a combination of various oils mixed together, hydrogenated, then certain fatty acids called diglycerides are then separated out. It is truly amazing how many people when confronted with the truth will still try to convince others the opposite of the truth.Mono-diglycerides remain the most widely used emulsifiers in food production. They are called mono-digylcerides because they are made from oils that have a high mono saturated fat content, but they are still hydrogenated. These are used in a wide variety of food manufacturing such as, breads, bagels, muffins, cookies, cakes, pies, donuts, pasta mixes, potato chips, ice creams, almost all packaged desserts, nearly all margarines and other spreads. Your local grocery bakery including Walmart bakeries use these oils. New margarine spreads Benecol(tm) and Take Control(tm) contain hydrogenated oils . Just read your label. Remember...its' your health!There are many food oil companies that produce mono-diglyerides. So when you read mono-diglycerides on packaged foods, it is nothing more than hydrogented oils. Sunbutter, made from sunflower seeds, tastes and smells very similar to peanut butter.  My family eats so much of this product that we have subscribed to get a case of 6 from Amazon on a monthly basis.  There is also a "crunchy" version which is good as well.

Sunbutter has become the new grocery staple for me.  I developed a peanut allergy at the age of 25, having eaten peanut butter al my life.  I had always enjoyed peanut butter and had eaten it frequently, and was at a loss when I learned I could no longer have it.  I found Sunbutter about 3 years after my allergy developed, and needless to say, it was love at first sight (or taste!)  While it may not taste like peanut butter, it fufills my "fix" for peanut butter. I have never cooked with it, but have been told by a friend who has cooked with it that it does not work well in cooking.  Overall, this is a product I use on a daily basis, whether it be on a sandwich, on toast, or with veggies or crackers.

Sunbutter has the very best flavor of all the other nut spreads out there. Stores well too! This particular spread although pricey has good consistency. (Walmart's price for a similar product item is $4.59). After a little while it starts to get thick and gritty. Probably because I, as directed by the label, keep it in the refrigerator to extend the life of the product. I buy 6 at a time (auto delivery) to get the best deal.

A few years back I was diagnosed with a severe peanut allergy.  I was devastated because peanut butter was my most favorite food item.  I have tried MANY peanut butter alternatives and could not even swallow them they were so bad.  This SunButter is delicious.  It soothes my peanut butter cravings.  Its perfect with jelly, or on toast. I did a taste test with my 3 year old niece.  I made her a "peanut butter" and jelly sandwich using SunButter and she asked for another.  Enough said.  Try it.

I have used this product eversince I ordered it.  I know first hand of its quality and tasteI would recommend this product, to anyone who cannot have peanuts for medical reasons.  As a used to be peanut lover, I now have a much better product to satisfy my craving.Always keep this product..This is all I can have. Peanut products cause me to go into afalatic shock.Thank you for SUNBUTTER.  Bob Brown

column9: Better than peanut butter- great for those with peanut allegeries
column10: Wonderful product.  I am allegeric to peanuts but not to sunflower seeds so this is a great replacment.  I LOVE the taste of peanut butter but can't eat it.  I enjoy the taste of this creamy sunflower seed spread.  TASTES just like peanut butter. I use it in place of peanut butter to include using it in making MOCK peanut butter fudge (my alltime favorite fudge).  HIGHLY RECOMMEND this product.

column9: What do you mean it's not peanut butter?
column10: My wife has a peanut allergy, so making sandwiches for the kids and doing the dishes that result can put her into a bad place.  My kids and I do not have peanut allergies, but we enjoy the taste and texture of this product as though it were peanut butter.  The consistency is a little stiffer than The Name Brand peanut butter, but this isn't a concern.  We purchase this item with the subscribe and save program because we go through quite a lot.

Our daughter is severely allergic to peanuts. We've tried many peanut butter imitators. This one is the best tasting by far. We get the Creamy and add jelly or honey as you normally would and it's delicious. Amazon.com has this product cheaper and with faster shipping and cheaper shipping costs than the peanut-free company we usually buy from. I will be coming back to Amazon for all future orders.
Way better than peanut butter, tastes like heaven. You'll never go back to regular peanut butter again, its got all the taste and is probably better for you somehow.

My husband has been allergic to peanuts his entire life.  No peanut butter and jelly sandwiches for him ever.  My sister first found the Sunbutter at a country store, and brought it home for him.  At 50+ he enjoys his SUNBUTTER and jelly sandwiches almost every day.  For someone with peanut or tree nut allergies, the Sunbutter company has products that will please.
My family LOVES Sunbutter!  My sons are allergic to peanuts and tree nuts.  I wish we would have found Sunbutter sooner!

My son is deathly allergic to peanut butter, nuts/peanuts, so we had to sneak pbj's or not eat them at all for fear of his reaction. Then someone introduced us to Sunbutter. We tried it and immediately liked it and agreed that we needed to order some of this. Amazon had the best prices for a bulk order, so we bought online. I love the free super shipper, since we live in Alaska and would have to pay out the nose otherwise for shipping. Love it and will order more when we run out!

I haven't had a peanut butter and jelly sandwich for years due to a peanut intolerance and I have missed it so much.  I just tried my first sunbutter and jelly sandwich and I am in heaven!  If you are looking for a peanut butter alternative and you are/were a peanut butter lover, you should try Sunbutter.  I am thrilled to now have this amazing peanut buttter substitute.  I think I'm going to go eat some more!

My 16 year-old daughter has a severe peanut allergy, and this has been a great substitute and tastes great! I used to love peanut butter and we ate it by the bucketful, but we stopped allowing it in our house after a close call. If soynut butter has scared you off from trying other substitutes, don't worry, this is nothing like it. :)It has a smooth, creamy texture, not too sweet or dry. Its one downfall is that it looks a lot like peanut butter, which could be confusing to little kids with a peanut allergy.

column9: Excellent for families with food allergies
column10: Great products for families with food allergies as completely nut free.  Great taste and good texture.  I find it best to keep it in the refrigerator.

column9: Great alternative to regular Peanut Butter!
column10: Had to give up regular PB due to intolerance's. Was in tears until SunButter arrived. Love it! Should have switched long ago.

My son is allergic to peanut butter so I was looking for an alternative that our whole family would enjoy.  I have tried almond butter in the past and liked it.  However, the SunButter is much creamier than the almond butter that I've used in the past.  The SunButter tastes great.  It tastes a lot like peanut butter.  The creamy texture also makes this product easy to spread even out of the refrigerator.  It's a great product!
My daughter is allergic to dairy and peanuts, which is what led us to try this product.  Very expensive in grocery stores!  Very creamy and tastes good too.  We prefer it to soynut better by far.
I purchased this product as a replacement for peanut butter. We love it's taste and consistancy. Wish we could buy it in larger sized containers! Its yummy, and supposedly better for us than peanuts!
My daughter is allergic to peanuts and loves sunbutter sandwiches.  Now she can have a good protein substitute that is easy for me to prepare.  This case is an economic buy.  We love sunbutter!

my son's allergic to peanuts, and I bought this to try.  The taste is different than peanuts, and it took a little bit for me to get used to at first, but now it's great.  The texture is more like a natural peanut butter, where the oil separates if you let it sit for a while.  Putting it in the refrigerator helps a lot.

My child has peanut allergies so we tried both soy butter and Sunbutter.  Sunbutter tastes much better!  It has a richer flavor and thicker consistency than the soy butter we tried.  My daughter requests a Sunbutter sandwich almost everyday for lunch!  Too bad it costs around 6 dollars at our local Super Target!  Trader Joe's makes a store brand for around 4 dollars a jar, but by buying the 6 pack for 21 dollars on Amazon, I can save .50 cents per jar!!!  Cool!!!  I think I will place an order here instead of trying the Trader Joe's version:)
EXCELLENT!  Arrived quickly, best price out there, and an excellent alternative to Peanut Butter for those with Peanut Allergies...tastes just like Peanut Butter, if not better!
Taste is delicious and the price is $2-3 lower than retail. In addition, it's great that refrigeration is basically optional, so you can leave the sunflower butter at room temp for easier spreading.

I first bought this for a kid who is allergic to Peanut Butter. But after tasting Sunbutter, I buy it for the kid and myself. Tastes better and is better for you than Peanut Butter. I signed up for auto shipments which makes it a better deal.

My son is allergic to peanuts, so on a recommendation of a friend I bought this as a PB substitute.  I love it, and am happy that I can still have "PB&J's" without worrying about allergies.  The consistency is very similar and the taste is incredibly close to peanut butter.  I haven't tried baking with it yet, but am planning to do so soon.  I recommend this to absolutely anyone I meet dealing with peanut allergies!

Sun butter is a great alternative to peanut butter for those with allergies. It's very close to the taste of PB that I love it (and I'm a PB brand snob), yet different enough that my husband, who doesn't like PB, really likes this. Meanwhile, my peanut-allergic son loves it. (And it's far FAR better than the soy butter they try to pass off as a PB alternative.) This brand separates more than the Trader Joe's brand, but the price is a little better and it's easy enough to mix the 1-lb jars.

We use this is our daycare for a peanut butter substitute.  Prior to Sunbutter our kids missed the pbj sandwiches and peanut butter with apples after a couple of new enrollee's had peanut allergies.  With 34 kids we decided to make our center a nut free facility.  Our kids LOVE their sunbutter & jam sandwiches.  Several of the parents now use it at home instead of peanut butter.  Give it a try!!
This stuff is amazing.  If only Amazon kept it stocked all the time...the price here is unbeatable when available.
We love this product at our child care! Due to so many peanut allergies, this has been a great substitute for making sunbutter cookies, sandwiches and spreading it on whole wheat bagels!

I opted for sunflower butter after looking for alternatives to butter/margarine, which are high in cholesterol.  After finding it on supermarket shelves and disappointed by the price, I decided to check the internet and was pleasantly surprised on the better deals. Now, if the can do the same price for the all natural (no salt/no sugar)....
We love sunbutter and are so glad that we can now get it through Amazon.  Sunbutter is a peanut-free substitute - it is a healthy easy choice!

I ordered the SunButter for my husband who likes peanut butter but can no longer eat peanuts. He received 6 jars 2 months ago and has polished off 3 of them already. he said it was the best thing I could have ordered. The next time he would like the Crunchy if it is available

column9: allergic to peanut butter No problem!
column10: I am allergic to peanuts. Finding sunbutter has eased the pain of missing my peanut butter sandwiches. Better than soybutter.

When our youngest was diagnosed with peanut allergies I needed something that my oldest could eat but would be "safe" if she decided to share with her little sister.  This product tastes great and we're no longer missing peanut butter and jelly sandwiches.  Only negative is that my husband loves it and we go through it too fast!

Our family loves Sunbutter's Creamy Sunflower Seed Spread.  Sunbutter came highly recommended from another mother in my Moms of Tots group 3 years ago.  Our youngest son was diagnosed with a tree nut allergy & the allergist recommended to avoid all peanut products as well.  The switch from natural peanut butter to Sunbutter was very easy.  I use Sunbutter's Creamy Spread in my baking recipes & for no-bake cookies.  We have tried other brands, but nothing compares to Sunbutter.  Sunbutter Creamy is delicious, easy to spread & works well in recipes.  This is the only brand we buy...nothing else comes close to Sunbutter's taste.

column9: Great for those who can't digest peanut butter
column10: My husband is allergic to peanuts although he really enjoys them. For many years he wished he could have a peanut butter sandwich but wasn't about to risk breaking out.  This product has been such a delight for him.  He is able to enjoy the Sunbutter on bread and crackers.  It is a close enough substitute that you won't even miss peanut butter after tasting this.  Since we live in Florida we put it in the refrigerator otherwise the heat would make it quite runny.
I recently tried sunflower seed butter from the local grocery store and fell in love with the stuff. Finding it for half of the price on amazon made me even happier.
Since I cannot eat peanut butter love that Sunbutter taste very cloes to peanut butter!!!!
It tastes just like peanut butter but it is safe for those with a peanut allergy (it is sunbutter).  Delicious.

This is a great product for people with nut allergies.  It a peanut butter alternative that has the same texture and nutritional value as peanut butter.  If you like the taste of sunflower seeds then you should like the taste of Sunbutter.  It was a lifesaver for our family when 2 of my 5 children were diagnosed with severe nut allergies.  They specifically test each batch for traces of peanuts and tree nuts.  We have used sunbutter on sandwiches and in baked goods.  We use it all of the time and we buy it in bulk so we never run out.

column4: A Research It Maven "Just the facts please"
column9: NOT Organic (as description states it is) - added ingredients.
column10: The description states that this SUNBUTTER is organic with NO added ingredients, which is it NOT. This is the regular Sunbutter Spread with sugar, mono dyglercides, salt, etc. However, it is very YUMMY! And the price of twenty dollars and change (for 6 jars) is very good these days! We keep it chilled in the refrigerator to preserve freshness once the jar is opened, and because it thickens the spread, which is thin at room temperature. These 16 oz jars contain 280 tablespoons of spread and the nutritional info on the label states that 1 tablespoon has: 100 calories, 8 grams of fat, 3.5 grams protein, 60 mg of sodium (very low sodium), 3.5 grams carbs, 2 grams of fiber, and zero trans fat, zero cholesterol. Naturally contains zinc, niacin, iron, magnesium, copper and vitamin E. A VERY tasty spread, tho Organic would be better. Product of the USA so it meets all USDA guidelines.

I like Sunbutter, not because of peanut allergies, it's just tasty. I first found it in North Carolina when visiting, but it is not in my local stores. With Amazon Prime I receive it in 2 days with free shipping and no sales taxes, so that's even better than buying locally.It's good spread on sliced apples, celery sticks, or mixed with honey when you can't decide what kind of snack you want.I would have given it 5 stars, but I like the crunchy better, but for some strange reason, crunchy is a dollar more per jar. What's with that?It is an intersting alternative to peanut butter and everyone knows that sunflower seeds are healthful, providing essential minerals and this one provides 27% of your RDA in just 2 tablespoons.
This is the best tasting peanut butter gluten free alternative product that I have ever had!!Highly recommend...

column9: Doesn't mention soybean allergy warning in description
column10: The back of the jar has the following warning:ALLERGY STATEMENT:Made on equipment that processes soybeans.I don't have an allergy, per se.  Even so, I do try to avoid soy whenever I can.  It's in everything, though.  I should have known that even though it wasn't mentioned, it had to be in there somewhere.Other than that, it does taste pretty good. It has a more roasted flavor than peanut butter, but I like it for it's own qualities.
soothing tea. great before bed. I've gotten 5 other people to like it. Helps with stomached. I will continue to buy.

column9: Tastes like red bull sugar free - but with better ingredients!
column10: Tastes like red bull sugar free - but with better ingredients!Hard to find in stores and online.  Price seems a bit high on amazon now.  I'll order it if/when they lower it to less than what it costs full retail per each can.
Buy it from guru directly - much cheaper and also free shipping. Amazon used to sell Guru at a discount, now it's really marked up. :(

I love this drink. We use this drink at the office to keep energy high. It is a great alternative to those sugary drinks. These ones taste better than their regular ones. They are a little more expensive but worth it. Enjoy.

If my dog could review this product, she'd give it 5 stars. She obviously loves the bacon flavor and being a very licky puppy, this is a real treat for her. As the pet owner, I like that she seems so content with the product, but it's a non-traditional way of delivering a treat and seems a bit awkward. The treat is given through a roll-on ball, like the old deodorants. With little treat bites, you can reward a dog with one or two nibbles, but regulating the number of licks or the time they're allowed to lick doesn't work so well. For training purposes, I wouldn't recommend this product, but just for gratuitous treat giving, I think it's just fine.

column9: MY DOGS DIDN'T LIKE THIS AT ALL!!
column10: I tried this product on my dogs 3 times and each time, they would not touch it!  Admittedly, my dogs are picky, but no even one of them would try it.  They would walk up and sniff it, but they would not even taste it.  My dogs (3) are all small dogs and don't eat a lot of food.  Maybe if your dog is larger or less picky, it would appeal, but I can't say I would recommend this product.

My dog is small and loves loves treats. But treats she can toss in the air and run around with. She couldn't get the idea this was just a taste. She really thought at some point I would give up and give her the bottle. I am passing it on to a friend who is trying to train her dog not to pull on the leash. I realize this is a training tool but my dog didn't seem to think so. She did like the taste.

column9: Smells Super; Our Dogs Have no Taste Appreciation
column10: I reluctantly give this a 3 due mainly to the smell of the Liver Flavor.  The sole purpose of the product is to offer a flavorful break from the ordinary dog food flavors they normally receive but alas both picky Yorkies refused on several occasions to even take a good whiff.  They love freeze dried livers from chickens, beef, pig and lamb but cannot stand Lickety Stik.  Just to test the situation I tried the Stik first and it was a resounding NO.  Then after they had freeze dried livers and again it was NO.  I took their favorite dry food and applied a small amount on several pieces and mixed them in with untreated food.  They literally segregated the morsels into edible and Stiks.  The Stiks did not get touched while the unflavored were eaten with vigor.  Determined to prove that the Yorkies are just picky I offered a few licks to the neighbor's Retriever and he looked at me as if I am the fool I am.  Success did not open its heart on several days ago nor did it when I tried one more time with the same negative results.  I cannot say that any of the other flavors have any similar aspects since I only received the one container.  Bottom line:  Human Rating: 3  Dog Rating: 1 too many.  Sorry but the effort was there.

column9: Our Six Dogs LOVE The Lickety Stik!!!
column10: Our six dogs (four of our own, plus two foster dogs) all LOVE getting their "licks" from this Bacon Flavor Lickety Stik!!!  They are all medium to big dogs (Boxer mixes, Pit Bull mix, Black Lab mix , Plott Hound & Greyhound mix) and they all come a-runnin' when I pull the bottle out.  Even Mollie, our finicky-eater Black Lab mix, loves it.  Sometimes, they try to take a bite, but they all quickly figure out that the trick is to lick the little roll-on-deodorant-type ball.  The key, of course, is to hold the bottle while the dogs help themselves, as opposed to giving them the bottle to do with what they please...  ;o)The bottom line is the Bacon Flavored Lickety Stik gets a unanimous "Four Paws Up" from my test panel!  Highly recommended!

I have to say this is an unusual product.  It's made on the same order as a deodorant and the dog licks the roller to get the flavoring.  We got the liver flavor and all the dogs loved it.  In fact, there was some times when two dogs were trying to lick the roller at the same time since they can't seem to wait their turn.  It's definitely something to try...don't know how well it would do training your dog instead of the regular treats, though.  It'll probably get gross after a few lickings too but a damp paper towel should fix it up...especially if you wipe it after the dog uses it.Unfortunately, I can't comment if it really tastes like liver flavor.  The dog's aren't talking but they definitely seem to like it...Oh yeah, and its made in the USA!

column9: Interesting Idea - Little Dogs Loved It
column10: Well, the title says it all.  The little dogs of the household loved this interesting twist on the traditional treat.  They did not seem to understand why they were not allowed to walk off with it, but they grasped the concept eventually.  Often traveling with our two smallest poms, this "roll-on" style treat is a simple, non messy, non-poop-inducing alternative to traditional treats.  It is "just enough" when you want to reward them without having to worry about making a mess in the car.  I am not sure if this concept will catch on with the mainstream, but as long as it is competitively priced, I can see this being a useful tool for many dog-rearing activities.  While we are far past that stage, I can see this being helpful for different training activities as well.  Bring yourself and your dog "outside of the bubble" and give this new treat a try.

Can you imagine how this product came to fruition?  It seems like an accident.  Like the guys in R&D accidentally filled some roll-on deodorant tubes with dog food flavoring.  Or maybe it was a large-scale Big Lots-style buy where the guys at the pet food factory got an incredibly great deal when a Ban roll-on factory got flooded and had to unload a warehouse.In any event, what seems like a really weird idea is...well, a really weird idea that our dog LOVES.  Of course there's not much nutritional value to letting your dog take a few slurps off the end of a liver-flavored roll-on doggie treat, but hey, there's not much nutritional value to that rawhide toy you just bought him either.  Give this a try for dessert.

When I first saw this I wasn't to sure but I love to give my pups new things to try. When it came in I checked it out....it looks like a roll on deodorant. I had to laugh but then came the taste test. I think my dogs are in love with this! We have small dogs...all less than 6lbs and I have to roll the ball for them to get more flavor so it's not so bad but I imagine that larger dogs can roll the ball themselves. If you're looking for something new and different then you may want to give this one a try!

column9: PetSafe Lickety Stik 1.6-Fluid Ounce, Bacon Flavor
column10: Nina, Sam(antha) and Grizzly are "licking it up."  The feature that appeals to me most is that the calorie count is so low per "taste."  It's a real snack alternative that many of us with pets should consider!Great idea!I rate "PetSafe Lickety Stik 1.6-Fluid Ounce, Bacon Flavor"...Five stars!P.S., As many pet snacks are notoriously high in fat, I truly recommend this as a low-calorie alternative!P.P.S., Maybe they should come up with on for us humans?  Just a thought!

I ordered this, not sure if my dogs would like the roller ball or turn their noses up at it, but I'm happy to report they loved it! They went at it with gusto-so much so that I had to put it away after only a few licks-afraid they might make themselves sick. Little did I know that my little monsters would find a way to knock it off the shelf & absolutely destroy the bottle while I was at the grocery store. I came home to a shredded bottle & 2 pomeranians with very guilty looks on their faces.....I think this is a great product & if the reaction of my dogs is any indication-so do they. I will definitely be ordering more when it becomes available, but might have to invest in a lock box to keep it in....lol!

I have the most picky dog in the world.  She's a big dog, which usually means they'll eat anything, but not my dog, so when I got her the Likety Stik, I honestly didn't think she'd like it, but she loved it!  And what a great training tool.  Rather than fill your pocket with treats,(that usually go through the wash) you have a neat, no fuss way to reward them.I did have to squeeze it to get the liquid moving along after she'd licked it, and it dripped onto her pure white, newly bathed ruff, but it came off with just water, so no worries.I then took the Stik over to my in-laws to give to their obese King Charles spaniel, and he of course loved it, because he eats anything.  What they liked was being able to give him treats that didn't add to his weight problem.Lickety Stik is a great new way of treating your dog.  Whoever came up with it is a genius.  I'm going to buy every flavor for my dog, and one for my in-laws dog.
Length:: 0:16 MinsJoy-Joy likes these strange little treats.  They remind me of roll-on deodorant.  They have a very strong smell.

The roller ball on this treat (basically gravy) does not roll around readily from the friction of my dog's tongue licking. The only way to get gravy out of the bottle to where the dog can get it is by squeezing the bottle to force the gravy out around the edges and letting the dog lick the gravy off the surface (kind of defeats the purpose of bothering with the roller ball). I let my dog lick this treat for two sessions, but when I went back the third, the roller jammed so no matter how hard I squeezed, none of the gravy inside was coming out. I stood the bottle upright and pushed down on the ball to try to loosen it from the bottle top edge and let more flow through. This seemed to get the flow going again for 2-3 rough squeezes, but it shortly jammed again. I can still move the roller ball around with my fingers, and there will be a little gravy stuck to the part of the ball I move into the open, but it's not working as it was the first two times. There is still 2-3 tablespoons of product left in the bottle. Sorry, but I'm not going to sit there and manually roll the ball around with my fingers or forever tinker with pushing down on the ball so my dog can lick a miniscule amount of gravy at a time. I've checked for anything blocking the area between the bottle end and roller ball, but haven't seen anything likely to stop the flow or rolling (no dried clumps, etc). The convenience is lost if the gravy doesn't come out by itself from squeezing the bottle and the roller ball can't roll with the dog's tongue alone.I would recommend not using this over any carpet or floor surfaces you don't want to risk getting stained since there will likely be dripping. The gravy (when it did come out from squeezing the bottle) comes out from all sides of the ball at once instead of from one point where the dog can focus, so depending on which side your dog likes to lick, it might not catch the gravy from the side that isn't being licked right away in time to catch the gravy before it falls to the floor.The taste seems to be rated middle to low by my dog. My dog loves bacon flavored treats (can't get enough Beggin' Strips) and ate this product up readily enough in the beginning when it was new, but it's since become clear he isn't crazy about it. Now he's seen what this gravy is about, he might take one or two licks then walk away. I have to keep calling him back to encourage him to finish up and take another lick. I don't think I would be able to get him to finish the bottle even if it were flowing properly.I'm not sure I would bother buying more of these unless I was assured of the reliability of the bottle not jamming again and the roller working properly. I would love to see some sort of refillable roller bottle offered so I could fill it with some cheap homemade gravy instead (there is no way to refill these bottles yourself) since I do like the concept of limiting how much gravy he's able to get at at a time via this roller mechanism.

My little diabetic shih-tzu, Lily, is notorious for hating anything new. I am constantly on the search for healthy new treats that I can give her after she has her insulin shot (every 12 hours...ugh!) I received the Liver flavor Lickety Stik and was prepared to donate it to the local animal shelter because I was just sure Lily would turn up her nose to it. Lo and behold...she liked it! It took a minute or two for her to figure out how to get the treat out and I squeezed the bottle too hard and some dripped on the floor, but Lily quickly lapped it up. I don't think the ball turned very easily, but she was determined to try to get the treat-juice out of the bottle. I think this is a great idea, but I am only giving it 4 stars because the packaging was hard to read and the ball didn't seem to turn very readily.

column9: A clever idea that didn't work.
column10: The smell and taste of the Lickety Stik was an instant success with our dog.But the dispensing ball dosen't move easily, very much of the time,and it's a nuisance for us to keep helping the ball turn for our dog to get this treat.We get more on our hands then our Golden gets in his mouth.When we try to turn the ball for our dog, even we find it difficult.The roller BALL is a concern, we don't consider it 'pet safe'.If our Golden Retriver got this bottle,he could easily bite this roller ball out and would try to eat it.The ball requires a strong tounge to move it, even at that it gets stuck.We can't imagine this stik being at all compatible with small dogs.If you squeeze the bottle to force the liquid out around the ballmost of that drops to the ground between licks.This would be a great idea if it worked, and was truely 'pet safe'.

column9: Great Idea- My dog loves it.
column10: I have one dog, Rex, a Shepherd/Lab mix and he absolutely loves the Lickety Stik. Now if he sees me get it out, he automatically sits or gives me his paw.
