I posted a review for the Spiced Apple Cider by this company complaining about how sweet it was, but that was mild compared to this one.  Far too sweet.  I took one sip and poured it out.  Now I have all these k-cups that I have no clue what to do with!

I just received these and had to try one. The first cup had an odd caramel taste to it.  I kept drinking and finally got used to it. The second cup was better.  My husband thought they were too sweet.  I will finish the box but will try the plain cider next time.  The caramel made covered up the apple taste and made them sweet.  Not bad though for only 10 calories.  I didn't need any dessert last night!
To describe this product--words escape me--terrible; horrible; waste of good money. do not do it justice--how about just plain Sucks!!

I had gotten another brand of apple cider for my Keurig and it was the most fantastic thing I have ever had. I bought this cider expecting a similar experience. Unfortunately, it tastes like apple cough syrup. It is TERRIBLE. Just to make sure my taste buds aren't out of whack, my roommates both tried a sip. They agreed with me that this is not a good product to buy.Even worse, I can't return this item so now I am stuck with 55 more k-cups of crap.
So delicious for K Cup Brewers....could not get enough of it when it first arrived.  I'm pretty sure I had about five cups of it before a couple of days had passed!

column9: Beware if you are allergic to Phenylalanine
column10: This product does not state it is "Low Calorie Sugar Free" you only find out when it arrives.  There is a small yellow flag stating it on the box.  I cannot use any artificial sweeteners as they cause a severe allergy attack.  This product has "Phenylalanine" an older artificial sweetener.  Grocery items are NOT ELIGIBLE for return.  Amazon did work with me and gave me a refund because it was not stated in the description.  As of today the product description has not changed so BEWARE.
Bought this for my husband. He found it in the pantry before I could tell him it was there and loves it. The carmel flavor is great.
Tasted way too sweet with a terrible after taste.  I would not recommend this product if you are looking for a more traditional apple cider flavor.

I love hot cider, however this one didn't taste great to me. The artifical sweeteners spoils the taste. When it brews the caramel apple scent is just wonderful, and makes you want to try it, but I think it would taste much better if no sweetener was added and you could sweeten it to your taste.

column9: Tried it loved it...subscribing to it.
column10: This one is good.  I am going to try to Carmel Apple on next.  Glad it is not like their coffee's which were just bad instant coffee.  I would buy this over the Green Mountain brand every day of the week.

I was really looking forward to having some good apple cider out of my Keurig machine. The cider has a wierd taste to it and a very bad aftertaste. After my wife and I both tried a cup, we ended up throwing the rest of it out.

column9: Cant use this in a Keurig!!!  WTF!
column10: This product doesn't fit into a  Keurig K-Cup Brewer.  You just use a knife to puncture the lid, dump it into a cup, and fill it with hot water.  Could use a Keurig to fill it, I suppose.  Wasted 3 until I realized this.  I gave it 1 star because it tasted OK.  Use the Keurig name to charge extra.  Not acceptable.

I'm allergic to aspartame and have bad kidney problems after drinking it unknowingly.  I ordered this product and would not have if it had said SUGAR FREE.  I would've had a clue that I couldn't drink it.  Ingredient labeling should be mandatory.  It certainly wasn't advertised correctly and completely wasted my money.  Buyer beware.

This is "low calorie" It contains aspartame. This is not made clear in the item description or on the box. The individual K cups aren't labeled low calorie or diet either. Just "natural flavor" It has the disgusting chemical flavor of artificial sweetner.

I was very hesitant to order this product because of the negative reviews. I'm so glad that I went ahead and ordered because it is so tasty. It's warming and relaxing on a chilly fall day. I don't ever drink anything that is sweetened with sugar and I am used to the flavor of aspartame so I found no odd flavors in this at all. I also bought the natural apple cider ones made by Green Mountain Coffee from my local BB&B because they are so expensive on Amazon. I found that I actually don't like those as much as the Grove Square. They are very acidic and don't contain any of the delicious seasonings. If I doctor up the plain apple cider with a shot or 2 of Torani sugar-free brown sugar and cinnamon flavoring then the Green Mountain version almost tastes as good as these Grove Square cider cups. If you regularly use artificial sweeteners in your beverages then I don't think you will be at all disappointed in the flavor of the Grove Square Spiced Apple Cider Cups.As a side note, I always clean out my used K-cups in order to put them in my recycling. Because they contain an instant powder, there is nothing left behind in the Grove Square cups. The Green Mountain apple cider cups contain a really gross mush of nasty reconstituted apple. It's a little off putting.

column9: It didn't taste like cider at all
column10: This cider was horrible.  It had a fermented smell to it when it was brewing and didn't taste any better when I actually tried it.

column9: Horrible, spend a lil more and get green mountain
column10: I was very excited to find a cheaper cider. However, it is most likely worth the expense to get green mountain brand. Unfortunately I did not realize that the product was artifically sweetened. When it came I saw on the box that it was and tried it anyway. Luckily one of my roommates enjoyed it so was not a total lose.
It is hard to find much of anything sugarfree that really tastes good but this apple cider is the best.  I also love the regular hot apple cider in sugarfree form.

Just got the Grove Square Caramel Apple Cider K-Cup order yesterday. Tasted it, loved it and promptly ordered an additional 2 boxes.  I'd give this 10 stars if I could.  The apple taste is pure, the caramel is spot on and the ease of use is outstanding.  Thanks Amazon & Grove Square.  I have this on subscription order for every 2 months.  This will be good for my emergency preparedness "stash" also.  Wow!

I personally just prefer the regular spiced hot cider (no caramel). I like it a lot and when having guests it's easy to just have them on hand. The taste is not as great as home made, but name something that is!! I give this five stars for great taste, no aftertaste, and ease of use. Enjoy!!

I wish there were more SUGAR FREE choices.  This is very tasty and great for Autum warming up.  Same goes for Sugar Free Caramel Apple Cider.  I drink these during the cold evenings, less calories etc. than hot chocolate & no caffene.

I was so disappointed!  I received the cups and tried one right away.  It was like hot water.  The cups felt empty so I opened one to see.  The "cider" had melted or something, causing the cups to be empty.  I thought maybe one or two could be bad, but it was the whole box!  Soooo disappointed!

This is the best cider I have ever had! It is absolutely DELICIOUS! Some 'instant' drinks have a weird after taste, and this does not at all. It has a creamy taste to it, I think because of the caramel.
It is nice and warm but way too sweet. Might try using lemon juice to tone it downsome.  Hope that works.

While the green mountain apple cider have a relatively okay taste, the combination of sugarfree and caramel in this product provided an overpowering sweetness. No one in my office will drink the things.

I love this cider.  I mix it with Bicardi's Oakheart Spiced Rum and it is delicious.  There is nothing better when there is a chill in the air or on a rainy day.  Try it and I know you like the combination.  Very tasty.

All of the other reviewers seem to be in uproar.  I understand the statements knocking the "caramel" flavor, it is admittedly not very appealing.  The Cider flavor on the other hand is wonderful.  In fact, I would go to say that the Cider K-Cup is my favorite K-Cup product.  My family uses our machines daily (sometimes hourly) and when we have it, the Cider pack is one of everyone's favorites.The only complaint I have is that it's taking 3-5 weeks to ship at the moment!
You know that saying you should try it before you buy it. Well don't with this product. It that bad. I don't even know how they can market this.
Really enjoyed 1st few cups but after a few months (still before "best by" date) product solidified and stuck to top of k-cup making it useless.

I ordered this item for myself and it arrived very quickly.  The flavor is good if not a little sweet.  I liked it so much that I wanted to order for my sister in law. Placed the order and selected next day delivery to surprise her.  Well, that did not happen.  I would have at least expected a heads up from the supplier that next day delivery was not going to happen.  I am very disappointed!!

I am not sure why all the negativity about this product. I think it tasts pretty good....even my husband thought it was good; better than the spiced cider and he is pretty picky. a good drink for a cool, fall evening or winter day. We have our own well and only use well water or botten water which has no chlorine in it....I think if you are on city water and using city water it would definitely alter the taste. My daughter and son-in-law, and my colleague also enjoy it. I tried my colleagues and am ordering my own.

This product works fine in my Keurig coffee maker... I just do not personally care for the flavor.  It is VERY sweet - - tastes pretty much like most instant cider mixes. For me, making it weaker improves the taste.  Again, the product works fine; my 2-star rating is based mostly on my personal dislike of the flavor.

I am addicted to caramel apple cider - and being only 10 calories and fairly inexpensive, I wanted so much to like this product. I thought even if it wasn't the best cider I'd ever had, it would at least be a good enough substitute for when I was watching my weight and couldn't afford to go to Starbucks. I was so wrong - what a waste of money! First off, it smelled so bad that it made me nauseous. I brought it to class with me, and was worried the whole time that everyone around me could smell it. Then, the taste was unbearable. I took a sip, gagged, tried adding some fat-free whipped cream, sugar-free caramel syrup, and cinnamon - still disgusting, the awful cider taste overpowered anything I put in. Needless to say, I wasted $10, will be throwing out all the k-cups, and will have to look for my cider fix elsewhere. Take the bad reviews seriously - I wish I had!
This cider smells and tastes wonderful.  Only 10 calories if you are counting.  Perfect on a chilly evening or if you are feeling a little under the weather.  It's a treat!

I was a bit leery when I ordered this product but it is fabulous!  No aftertaste at all and if you set it on a smaller cup, it is just the right strength--not too weak at all.  I do doctor it a bit though.  Before I brew, I put about 6 cinnamon red hots in the cup, along with a cinnamon stick.  Then when done, I add a light sprinkle of my own mix of cloves, nutmeg and cinnamon.  Almost as wonderful as my freshly simmered REAL apple cider!  The "caramel" part of this drink is what really makes it yummy!  Perfect for that cool autumn night, or anytime.  Highly recommend this drink!  And the price is wonderful too.

This product is made with aspartamane, but that doesn't bother me. I only drink diet sodas instead of regular ones whenever I have the occassional soda (try to limit it to 1-2 a week) so the taste doesn't bother me, I also use Stevia and Spenda at home so I'm accustomed the the different sugar-free flavors.I had such high hopes for this drink. I was looking forward to having a cup of hot cider at work. Granted I didn't think it would taste like real cider but I'd been looking forward to a hot apple-y drink.When my shipment came in I brought it to work and had my first cup. Immediately I could smell it. It smelled really good at first. If you put your nose too close you can smell kinda a sickly-sweet scent. I tried it and nearly spat. It tasted extremely chemically and entirely overwhelming. The "caramel" was caramel only insofar as what a machine can reproduce. It was not caramel as I was expecting, not even slightly.I tried letting it cool and drinking it cold. It was perhaps a teensy bit more palatable.I tried watering it down. That helped. The Keurig at work only goes to 12 ounces. So perhaps ones that go to 16 ounces might diffuse the flavor a little more. This is why I gave it a 2 star instead of just 1.Now these things just sit forgotten in a drawer. Maybe I can figure out something to do with them...
I LOVE K-KUPS AND I LOVE THIS APPLE CIDER-GREAT FOR ALASKA WHERE I LIVE. THIS BRAND IS NOT TOO SWEET AND DOESNT MAKE YOUR LIPS PUCKER WHEN YOU DRINK IT!
This received bad reviews however i thought it tasted great. You definately could taste the carmel apple. Def a must for the fall drinks. Thumbs up!

I am one who watches and has to carbs and sugars and for years been wanting a descent hot cider certain brand i used to get in the envelops didn't taste no where near as good as these do.Another sugar free hot cider brand i tried used to be horrible aftertaste etc. These here are good very delicious treat for the fall and winter seasons and good to have for guests who come over who also can't have sugar and want a nice hot cider for a treat. OFfers a variety to the keurig k cup line up besides the usual teas, coffee cocoa etc Hot cider is a fave  of mine so I decided to try the carmael apple first I do plan on coming back to buy more of these and to try the spiced cider variety of these too. Excellent product will recommend to family members and friends.
this is really good for what it is and fairly cheap too. i liked is so much im buying more!!does not settle like the cocoa

This is one of the BEST ciders I've ever had. It's very smooth and much more caramel-y than I expected. And, it only has 10 calories!! It's delicious! Even my roommate who hates the "artificial sweetener after taste" thinks this is amazing. Great purchase, will definitly buy again!
I'm not a coffee drinker so this was a great idea for the Keurig. Since it's summer I've been making it and pouring it over ice for a refreshing treat.

It would have been nice if aspartame had been listed in the product description.Instead I am stuck with a box of cider that no one in my house can drink.Aspartame causes migraines in my family, as well as just not being a healthy alternative.Funny, now I see that the aspartame is listed in product description.  I wish it had been there when I ordered.
This is better than the Green Mountain cider... Great for winter, especially with a shot of dark rum to warm it up...

SO HAPPY!!! I ordered Mexican cinnamon from two other vendors and was dissapointed to find they sent me cassia (the type predominantly used in USA & in just about every grocery store). The two are not interchangeable (unless in dire straights). They have similar but different flavor profiles, Mexican/ceylon is sweet, Cassia/US type is not. They are two different species. Mexican/ceylon is beige/light brown and looks like bark, unravels easily, is chewable straight from the bag and is able to be broken. The view from the side is many layers resembling a cigar. The other is very dark brown, hard and would likely break a tooth if attempted to be bitten even after soaking, is intensely hot in comparison and from the side is a single layer that resembles binoculars.This Mexican cinnamon is delicious! I just ordered another shipment.

column9: As close to homemade as you can get and still have it delivered via UPS
column10: This is the closest thing I can find to my english Mom's homemade seville orange marmalade in the US. It gets delivered in convenient packages of six, so you can spread it on your toast nice and thick.

Being very far from a gormand; but one who is very particular about my English marmalade; I would have to say that about the 3 biggy of the Brit variety that Duerr's would be the best both in taste; in the amount of the peel; and the prices as well actually.  For more years that I care to count Dundee used to be my favorite but like another chap said; Dundee changed the receipe and it is just not any good anymore & I would venture to say, if I was a Brit I would be ashamed to call it my own.  The colour now is off, no peel to speak of and well, getting rid of the white pot for common glass was just the straw that broke the camel's back.  I tried to write the blokes to express my dismay and they did not even have the courtesy to reply.  Lots of people rate Chiver's high and it is alright I suppose but my penny's on Duerr's that is for sure
My dogs love them but I'm too nervous about them not being made in the USA. Melamine scare was no joke.

column9: Natural Balance treats- out of balance
column10: I normally like the Natural Balance Sweet Potato & Venison or Sweet Potato and Bison. But this 14oz bag came busted up and the treats are a bigger size than the size in a smaller bag. The treats were really brittle and broke easily. I wouldn't buy this one any more but will buy the smaller ones in a store.
These are great treats for dogs with sensitive stomachs.  I have to admit that they smell pretty yummy (for the dogs) too!  And they love them!
Natural Balance is a great brand, but these sized snacks just didn't cut it.  They came very broken up and the smoke flavor seems to be stronger on these than the "small bites" variety.

There is no corn, wheat or soy, nor artificial coloring or flavors in these biscuits, so hey are easy to digest.They are made of high quality nutritious ingredients which help keep your dogs healthy.Initially, they may not really take to them, especially if they are accustomed to lower quality treats with all those artificial flavors and by-products, but once accustomed, dogs will love to be spoiled with these biscuits or rewards for good behavior.Give your dog a healthy treat that's really special.

My dog with the food allergies didn't care for these. He didn't want to eat them because they were rather hard. My other dog with no allergies loved them!! I like the quality and the fact that they will not make him sick so maybe he will come around!
Bottom line - our dog loves these treats.They are light and crunchy, unlike some other brands that have more moisture in them.

column9: Just as good as the food
column10: These dog treats are the same as the kibble that I feed my dog. My dog was vomiting for no apparent reason. After my dog's veterinarian told us about the food, I started her on it and after a week on it she stopped vomiting...that was four years ago. The dog treats are the same as the kibble. They come in two different sizes (small for small dogs and puppies and medium for medium sized dogs). My dog is 47 pounds and about 20 inches tall and I feed her the medium sized treats. Sometimes I find that the bone shaped treats split in layers so they are thinner than usual but my dog doesn't seem to mind.
Great treats for dogs who have food allergies and sensitive stomachs.  I would buy these again for my dog.  Fantastic!
My allergy prone dog loves these treats.  He can't have enough of them.  No allergic reaction with these treats! Will continue to buy.

column9: Great Compliment to the Dog Food
column10: These Natural Balance treats are a great compliment to the matching dog food. My dogs love them and it makes it easy to give them treats that don't counteract the limited-ingredient dog food.

Both my dogs are older and, while I used to be able to use them as garbage disposals, they are now older and have very sensitive stomachs.  I felt bad not giving them treats, but most treats these days caused intestinal difficulties.  I found these in an out-of-town pet store and, since they claim to be safe for sensitive stomachs, thought I'd give them a try...I now buy several bags at a time, in assorted flavors, from Amazon and, not only do my dogs love them, there have never been any stomach issues.
Great treats.  Bulldogs are allergic to everything, but not these treats !  The LID diet and the LIT treats have been a miracle for this Bulldog.  Never itched again and loves the treats.

Having dentures and med dry-mouth, this gum is the only one that provides relief. I've searched everywhere in my town, unsuccessfully, for a steady source and reasonable price for Freedent. Now I have it. Amazon offers the lowest price and prompt shipping. 5-stars to Wrigley and Amazon. FYI, this gum is NOT sugar-free, but its benefits and worth it.
The price was amazing and the shipping was the faster than I expected.  I was very pleased.

It's not Amazon's fault by any means but I assumed (mea culpa) this gum was sugarless and it isn't.  For that reason and that reason only, I would not purchase this item a second time.  Everything else was very good (i.e., arrived quickly and packed well).

I have been purchasing items from Barry Farms for quite awhile now and as always am very impressed with the high quality of everything. But this Tarragon is actually far superior in flavor and/or freshness than any store I had found.THANKS!!! Barry farms for quality items at FANTASTIC!!! Prices

column9: One of the better fake plants for terrariums
column10: This is one of the best terrarium plants I have used.They are the right size for my 12'' net cubes for large adult mantids.The mantids love to climb on these, and they provide good protection for them.They are metal wire reinforced for bending into any possition, and the base hasa nice weight to it so the plant wont fall over.I have several of these, the bad news is that the branches tend to pull out ofthe base they are glued to.I have had to hot glue many of them back on.Another plus is that they are not slippery plastic. They are made of a compossitof materials so your pets will not slip on the leaves and have a good footing.Price is fair as well.I would recommend these for your terrarium, just have a tube of glue handy!!

column9: Love the look, not as sturdy as I'd hoped
column10: I have ribbon snakes that are a little over a foot long and weigh next to nothing. I bought 2 small and 3 large Araceae plants, about 4 months ago, to decorate their aquarium. The reason I like these plants so well is that they are more like real plants than most aquarium decorations that are either too flimsy to hold up anything at all, or too stiff and sharp to look safe. The snakes love them, I have the tall plant against a branch, so it helps support the leaves, but the snakes like to coil around the stems and I find at least one of them in it almost any time I look.The problem with them - The stalks of the plant are glued into shallow 'divets' in the base, so there is very little surface area that keeps them glued together...thus they don't stay glued together terribly well. They would be more sturdy if they were glued into drilled holes. At least one stalk on every plant has come unglued (2 off of some of them).I knew they wouldn't support the weight indefinitely, and had they broken at a later point, I would have chalked it up to them outgrowing their plants. But four months seems like an awfully short life span, especially considering how expensive they are. I still really like these plants for their enclosure and will continue to use the plants and just try to re-glue them as they come apart.

I love this product!  I chose this company because these are made with natural dyes and no chemicals.  They are absolutely delicious and I have a hard time eating just one at a time.

They appeal to that craving I get for something crunchy/melty yet they are very delicious and good for me. These little gems are quite addictive (in the best sense of the word) and I HERE I am ONCE AGAIN back to buy more for the third time...without apology!:-) Sooooooo good!
These chocolate sunflower seeds are fantastic.  And as opposed to JUST chocolate, they are on the healthy side.  The price here at Amazon is the best!

I am a firm believer that nuts are an important part of a healthy lifestyle. Unfortunately, sometimes nuts are just plain boring to eat, but this mix actually add a little bit of chocolate, which makes the entire mix taste great. Don't be fooled by the high amount of fat because it actually contains a lot of unsaturated fat, which is actually good for your body.
lots of healthy ingredients, even DARK chocolate on the soybeans (which are as soft as marshmallow!), but if you're watching calories, beware! Each little packet costs you about 260!

FOR A NON-ORGANIC OR NON-GOURMET ITEM THIS TASTES AMAZINGLY FRESH, CRUNCHY AND YUMMY. BEWARE: CALORIE COUNT, FAT AND SALT CONTENT IS CONSIDERABLE.BUT ONE BAG UPON OCCASION SHOULD NOT EXPLODE YOUR CHOLESTEROL COUNT.crunch! fresh! yum! salty!!!! and a good deal -- free with some other stuff I bought.

Oh my these are good!  Really good!  I'm not fond of the trail mix with raisins and so I did some research and came across these.  Soooo glad I did.  They are Fabulous!  A perfect blend of almonds, honey roasted peanuts, sesame sticks, dark chocolate covered soy nuts (for that added sweet, but not too sweet....and soft as heaven!), walnuts and pecans.  Excellent, excellent product.  Already on subscribe and save.  The kids love them as do the parents.  Sure to please anyone.Highly Recommend!

These are mostly all nuts with little or no added salt or oil.The chocolate covered soy nuts are good and there are only a couple in each pack, plus a couple of the sesame sticks.So overall a healthy snack with minimum processing, sugar, salt, fat.

This is one of my favorite snacks.  The small size is perfect for an afternoon snack, or to tide you over until a late lunch.  I keep a box at work.It's healthy like trail mix, but has a touch of chocolate and honey to keep you coming back.  Unless you're allergic to nuts, you have to try these.  You won't regret buying a case.

Usually when I grab something on my way out the door it ends up being convenient but full of carbs and empty calories. This trail mix, however, has a nice mix of healthy (yet tasty!) ingredients - whole almonds, honey roasted peanuts and sesame sticks, dark chocolate covered soy nuts, walnuts and pecans. The convenient, single-serving portion size is just right and is filling enough to leave you feeling satiated without needing another pack. Also, there aren't too many peanuts, which seems to be an issue with other trail mixes. I especially love the dark chocolate covered soy nuts which provide a hint of sweetness without being overpowering.The Daybreak Blend variety is really yummy, too, especially if you like a fruitier, sweeter taste. :) I keep a couple packets of the Daybreak Blend in my car since that kind doesn't contain anything that might melt.

column9: Fresh, Crispy, Crunchy, Tender,  & Light, yet Satisfying
column10: Deeeeeelicious!!! Outstanding flavor packed in these little pouches.  Love the combo of lightly salted, & delicate nutty sweetness. Tender, yet crisp, light, and still filling/satisfying. These make a great lunch,or in between snack. Perfect!  Difficult to find in the store with the sesame sticks, (the ones with pretzels arent nearly as good& I love pretzels) great that Amazon has them at a reasonable price.  Thank you Amazon for carrying a great product.

At first, I was sad that the bottle says "for decoration only", but after going to the India Tree FAQ page, I found out why:20. Why does the label say "For Decoration Only" on the Silver Dragees? What is in them?Dragees are a very old European tradition and have been used in Europe and the United States for years to decorate wedding cakes and other fine pastries. The FDA in its Compliance Policy Guide 7117-03 classifies silver dragees in the following way: "When small silver balls known as 'silver dragees' are sold exclusively for decorating cakes and are used under conditions which preclude their consumption as confectionery, they are not considered to be in the category of food or confectionery."Because they are not categorized for food or confectionery, the FDA does not want the manufacturer to list the ingredients. However, it may be helpful to know that they are made mostly of sugar. They may also contain small amounts of gum Arabic, wheat flour, artificial coloring, and/or a very thin coating of silver.The European Union recognizes silver as a legitimate color additive and states that "small amounts of it consumed on special occasions are not harmful." Silver appears in medicines, cough drops and tooth fillings as well as in our water supply in controlled amounts. It is used to purify city drinking and swimming pool water. It occurs naturally in the soil in which produce is grown, and thus finds its way into the vegetables that we eat.You may wish to access the FDA ruling cited above on the web. You may also wish to visit the website of the Agency for Toxic Substances and Disease Registry (ATSDR CAS #7440-22-4) for more information on the effect of small amounts of silver on health.

The tablets themselves are actually pretty nasty, like sucking on a vitamin, they take some time to dissolve so you've really got to be willing to put up with having these fairly unpleasant things in your mouth for at least 3-5 minutes. I recommend rolling them around all over the top of your tongue as you do, and trying not to swallow too often so you can really let your tongue absorb as much as it can. Another tip is that if you plan on trying this with liquids, do so after you've tried it with more solid foods as liquids will dissipate the effects much quicker.I gave it the old lemon test and I was shocked at just how sweet and delicious they were. Really, it made lemons taste like delicious lemon candy, not at all like those artificially flavored lemon drops. Natural applesauce was a bit much, but apples are already sweet so I sort of expected it. I also tried cheese, carrots, peanut butter, and while the peanut butter seemed a bit sweeter, the others didn't seem to show any affect at all.What impressed me the most, however, was tea. I poured myself a tall glass of unsweetened Lipton and it wasn't at all what I expected. Rather than making it taste sweet, it just removed the bitterness. Again, it's hard to articulate the sensation, but I can say that if you've ever wondered what tea tastes like without being overpowered by sweeteners or the natural bitterness found in most teas, try it with these tablets. The effect will wear off after a few minutes when you drink, but the taste you get is so uniquely pure. In all honesty, you haven't experienced tea until you've had a cup with one of these.I've read that wine is also good, so I may try that sometime in the future, along with other bitter fruits. I'm also curious how tomatoes, sweet potatoes, pumpkin, and bell peppers will taste. Whatever I decide, I really feel these things have opened up a whole new world of flavor experiences, and I'm really looking forward to trying them all.I totally recommend these tabs just for the experience, but as an alternative to sugar, they're way too expensive at this point.Happy Tasting!

This used to be my favorite beverage.  Until recently, I drank Ocean Spray Cranapple juice at least twice a day, and on the weekends I guzzled a glass every breakfast, lunch, and dinner. A cup of Ocean Spray has at least 30 grams of sugar, and that's approximately the same amount in a Snickers candy bar. And not only is it sugar, it's high-fructose corn syrup: very bad if you're health conscious and even worse if you're trying to control your sugar intake. Would YOU eat a Snickers candy bar three to four times a day?  Most wouldn't, but that's the amount of sugar I was consuming on a daily basis.  When I learned how this affected my waistline and fitness goals, I immediately switched over from fruit juices to water and I lost 10 lbs in less than a month.  The truth is, fruit juices are so high in sugar and calories, that they're not that good for you, whether they're vitamin-fortified or not.  You're better off drinking them either in moderation or eliminating them from your diet altogether.

column9: Santa Fe Bean Company Culinary Refried Beans -- a good find
column10: This product contains only beans.  I like the mild cereal/bean flavor, which does not overpower other ingredients I may add, such as yogurt and a packaged Indian eggplant, tomato, and onion dish.  The product doesn't contain added salt, and I don't miss it.The product rehydrates rapidly in a microwave oven; I heat to only a bit higher than body temperature.The bag looks like a sturdy coffee bag.  The bag has a double-ridge zipper seal.  If I start sealing from side of the bag, the zipper works fine.  If I start sealing from the middle of the bag, the ridges can get "cross-threaded."The bag is completely sealed until I cut the top off with scissors.  However, the ends of the zipper seals are not quite long enough to be fused into both sides of the bag, so I think that an extremely small and energetic insect could get inside.  I keep opened bags in my refrigerator; if not, I would keep them in large zipper-lock bags.  Again, this issue does not arise until the seal at the top of the bag is cut open.I had been using the Santa Fe Bean Company instant fat-free vegetarian refried beans (which I reviewed), but I prefer the lack of salt and the price of these culinary refried beans.

These are great beans!  I much prefer the flavor of these to the Fantastico beans.  I really like these beans in bulk like this because I keep them in a larger food container and make portions that don't divide so well when using the smaller packages.  I use 60g of beans to 150ml water (about 1:2.5) and 1/8 teaspoon (about 3 grams) salt.  The difference between these and the smaller packages though is that you have to add the salt.

I wanted to try dehydrated beans for the cost factor, as we use a lot of cans.  I looked at this company's "seasoned" varieties, but I noticed all but one had beans, salt, oil as the ingredients.  This one is totally plain, just beans, but much cheaper.  If all they are adding is salt and oil, I thought, well I can do that.  So, I decided to give these a try.I was very pleasantly surprised.  There is no dog food smell, like the canned beans.  Instead you are greeted with an earthy grain aroma.  I just added some baco bits, salt, and dried onions, and yum, these were great and ready in 5 minutes!  I will be ordering these again in the future.  I just wish they offered the same scenario with the "culinary" style (i.e. totally plain bean) in black beans and lentils, etc., as the price is better than the seasoned varieties.They come in a dark plastic package that has a zip-lock top, so you can reseal the bag between uses.  I imagine this would be a good emergency food item, as it looks like it will store very well.Anyways, for others on the fence, like me, I say, give it a try.  They taste great.

Well, that person did some extra searching and found that another site described this tree for sunny locations. And of course, the bonsai died.

I have been using Nido for several months now.  I wanted a powdered milk that would dissolve nicely in cold water and this one does it perfectly. Great to drink alone or in your coffee and makes a tasty hot chocolate mix, better than any of those on the market today.

column9: Very nice to have on hand.
column10: This is nice just to have in your pantry for those times you are out of milk and need some for baking, cooking, etc. It's a fine powdered whole milk not powdered skim milk, so has a good whole milk flavor.  Also good to keep around if you are just one person or even two, who don't drink much milk. If you need it for baking or whatever then you have it.

Since the demise of "Mr. Milkman" powdered milk, I have looked for a comparable product.  Nido instant milk was suggested to me by other grieving former Milkman customers and I am so glad I tried it.  It has good whole milk quality.  Excellent taste and texture, especially compared to the low or no fat powdered milks that you find in the grocery store, which taste like chalk.  (Try finding powdered WHOLE milk at your local store - good luck!)It's perfect to add to a hot beverage.  It blends easily.  (This specific product does NOT have added sugar.  Beware, a children's version of Nido does.)  Although it is not Mr. Milkman, it's a close second.  And I am very grateful that I have found it.

Nido has become the powdered milk of choice for backpacking trips.  It's got a very creamy taste that goes great with oatmeal or cereal.  We pre-mix it would instant coffee (add a bit of cocoa too) for a tasty breakfast or after dinner caffeine fix.  Once you try this, you'll never go back to non-fat dry milk!

column9: Good taste, good mixability, good value in general, just be careful with humidity
column10: I bought these four small cans because usually powdered milk can be very sensible to humidity. There are other choices, like a huge 4 pounds can, and in the end that can be cheaper. However, I prefer to pay a little bit higher and can 4 small cans, its convenient ... unless you have 5 children.Well going to the product: this is is powdered milk made un Mexico. The taste is really good, for sure much better than any 2% fat milk that you can buy in the supermarket. How does it compare to the taste of 4% fat fresh milk (say for instance Horizon, Or Archer farms)? Well I say that the flavor is the same, parhaps the powdered milk has even better taste since it feels a little bit creamier. However, you have to understand that how creamier it feels dependend on respecting the suggested proportion (4 tablespoons per 236 cubic centimeters).For me the taste is GREAT. Also the preparation is really good, my recomendation is to buy some Shaking glass or use and Hydratation bottle to shake the mix and you will get perfectly homogeneous milk. I use and hydratation bottle at work to prepare my milk, eventually mix it with powdered smoothies like Vega Whole Food Shake.Summarizing: its a really convenient product, tastes like fresh milk (or better), it mixes very well with cold water, the price/liter is very competitive compared to good brands of milk (e.g. Horizon) and you don't need a fridge. The only precaution you should know is that powdered milk is very sensible to humidity and fungus, so I recommend good storage, ALWAYS USE AN ABSOLUTELY DRY SCOOP so that you don't introduce humidity into the can.

column9: tastes better than other dry milks
column10: this milk tastes great but I did end up finding it at walmart cheaper so check your prices first before buying.

This powdered whole milk is fantastic in coffee.  We usually drink 2% milk, and I found that when I would use my K cup coffee machine and add 2% cold milk to the freshly made coffee, I would always have to microwave the coffee to get it back to being hot enough to drink.  This slowed down the instant dire need for a great cup of morning Joe, and made the K cup process too slow!  I was looking for a milk product to store for emergency food, when I came across this product.  I bought it, and had to try it out.  I never got around to making "milk" with it as it is just so good in coffee!  3 heaping teaspoons in a 12 oz "black magic" K cup coffee and stir.  It is so smooth, and rich, and it does not take away any heat, so no need to re-heat in the microwave!  I went through the entire #10 can using it that way, and sharing it with others to let them try it, they too love it, and have ordered it.  It does come in smaller containers.About that "emergency food" use, I called Nestle and it only has about a year shelf "use by" date stamped on it, and all they would say is "it is best to use it before the use by date stamp" and they would not say how long it actually would last, unopened. They did say that when it is made into milk, it should be used within 24 hours which was a surprise to me.  It is made in Mexico, but by Nestle's stated very high standards and they said their quality control is as high as in the states there.I am storing a smaller container on our camping trailer for those times we run out of milk, with no stores nearby, and since I am going through it quickly enough, I will have a couple cans on hand for "emergency food" but will have to rotate them within a year.  If anyone has used powdered milk  way past the "use by date" please tell us here in the reviews...

column9: Finally tried this... and it's great stuff.

column10: I loved this milk.  You can spoon it into a cold glass of water and it makes a refreshing glass of milk.  Also great in coffee.  I like it much better than the grocery store nonfat powdered milk.  Huge difference.

column9: This seriously tastes like real milk!
column10: This is the same consistency as real milk and looks and tastes just like it! I am shocked at how good this is. It always seems like I am out of milk when I am craving cereal but I will never be out of milk again now that I have discovered this stuff. It mixes up quickly and easily. No lumps or anything. I hope they adjust the price of their organic apples down a little in the future.
I have rescued house rabbits - and a chinchilla - and they all love Just Apples.  Give your rabbits and other small animals a healthy treat they will love!

I have been eating these things for years, and was thrilled to see that I could order them from amazon.I eat them as a snack, just grab a handful and go.  My kids (5 and 4) love these as well.  We make a snack mix out of the Just Apples, Just Strawberries, and Craisins.  I've added them to oatmeal and they are good that way too.They are addictive, so be careful not to eat too many.  A small handfull is about equal to a whole apple.
I love these 'cause they're tangy and chewy and great for snacks on the run.

column9: Tastes great, don't like the shape
column10: I love the taste of these, but I don't like the shape.  The apples have been cut into thin strips, which are actually uncomfortable to bite into.  They don't hurt or anything, but they are a little awkward.  I think the reason they are the shape they're in is because they still have the skin on them.  I do like that because the skin has so many of the nutrients.These taste very good.  And there is no sulfur or any other additives, so all you get is the apple.

Just Tomatoes Just Apples, 8-Ounce Tubs (Pack of 2)These are little shoe string granny smith apple strips and are they ever good!  My grandson just loves them.  I have found this brand to be of excellent quality. I have since ordered many of their other products-some are freeze dried and some are regular dried with no added perservatives or sugars.  These apples are the regular dried type.  Don't hesitate to buy them!
It is a good munchy. Gives you the satisfaction of a crunch. Fresh apples are much better.
Very good experience with Clubs of America.  Deliveries have been great quality and the customer service people are very friendly.

In a word? Runa Guayuas is cool.  The peppermint is my favorite flavor.  The taste is simple and delicious without the sometime bitter taste other teas tend to develop if they are steeped too long.  What I really like about this product is that even though it has quite a bit of caffeine there  is no jittery or jolted feeling after I drink it but just the feeling of being totally awake.  I have been substituting this in for coffee especially in the afternoon and I really like it.I highly recommend giving this product a try! Not convinced?  Runa is a socially responsible company who works close with the farmers in Ecuador who grow their Guayusa.  Their story is inspiring and this is a business worth supporting!Cheers!

The guayusa, as always, gives that nice balanced boost that I've come to love. However, the ginger balance of this really does it. To be honest I think ginger is usually an overwhelming flavor in a lot of teas, and this one does it right. The orange adds a hint of tart sweetness (no, that's not an oxymoron) that really rounds it out.One note for the prior review, while it may be cheaper on other sites, for this product the shipping options actually make it cheaper than where I've seen it pretty much anywhere else.

This is by far my favorite guayusa. There's an incredibly solid blend of just enough of the hint of the smooth, clean guayusa taste with a refreshing crispness of peppermint. I have struggled with stomach problems for years and significantly cut down on coffee as a result. The peppermint guayusa is great as peppermint is actually a known stomach calmative. As always the balanced energy effect is exactly what I need for that 3PM pick-me-up.

I was so psyched to try this peppermint flavor of guayusa.  I love the traditional flavor too, but it's always nice to have a little variety.  It's good to know that drinking this tea will wake me up as much as a cup of coffee, but won't lead to a crash afterwards.  I also appreciate the high level of antioxidants.  It's perfect to sip snuggled up with a book on a cold day!

column9: The best Tea I have ever drank
column10: I actually buy directly from the Runa website as their prices are a little better. This tea is amazing, I used to drink coffee like a mad women now I drink 1-2 cups and then it's the Guayusa tea. I actually can feel the difference when I drink this tea, energized but not jittery, focused and the taste of this tea is like no other. Besides supporting these local farmers buying this tea also supports the rainforest as this tea is grown under shade. I can not say enough good things about this tea and highly recommend this product....

I apologize to the makers of this drink for saying this, but it is just not good. At all. To be honest I think it tastes curiously like mouthwash. I can't really get past that and enjoy it. It's almost like mint tea that has waaaaay too much sugar in it or something. I am a HUGE fan of Synergy/GT's Kombucha, but I thought I'd try this because it's slightly cheaper. I have to say that the Synergy is well worth the extra $12 per 12 bottle case (I purchase the cases at Whole Foods for $35).Even if I could get past the minty mouthwash taste, I still have to question the health benefits of this brand of Kombucha given the ingredients list. It reads: Lightly carbonated water, sucrose, herbal tea blend, Kombucha cultures, lactobacilli, acerola juice concentrate. You don't even get to kombucha until the fourth ingredient - and that comes after water and sugar?? One can drink seltzer water with sugar and "herbal tea" for much cheaper than $23/12 bottles. Seriously. Spend the extra few bucks and buy the Synergy, whose ingredients are as follows (this is for the "Trilogy" flavor): 95% GT's organic raw kombucha, raspberry juice, lemon juice, fresh pressed ginger juice, and 100% pure love.Bottom line, if you want mint soda, then by all means, seize the day. If you want real, raw kombucha with health benefits AND a delicious taste, go for Synergy/GT's Kombucha.

this stuff is candy water - if you like sweet sugary drinks, then why even bother with kombucha? - isn't coke zero more what you're looking for? It's completely clear so there aren't any live cultures I can see, though I'm not sure they can survive in the ingredients listed on the bottle anyway - I know I can't. It's cheaper than GT Dave's variety, but it tastes nasty, all bubbly, minty and sweet at the same time. Like a party in my mouth with a bunch of uninvited guests - seriously, stay away!

If you are desperately looking for a replacement to all the kombucha that has been pulled off the grocery store shelves lately, this is not the solution.  Rarely do I buy something and just throw it away, but this stuff was undrinkable.  I wish I had researched it a little more.  If you need kombucha, make your own or order real kombucha.
Pretty good overall- a little more sweet and less fizzy than I'd hoped, but good price and doesn't have to be cold until opened.  Synergy Kombucha is still my favorite, but this is not far behind.

column9: Terrible copy of the original by GT Love
column10: Too much sugar, added seltzer instead of fermenting long enough, too costly, a waste of money for anyone needing kombucha for health reasons
Quite refreshing.  If you want something different with a bit of a "gottcha" then try Kombucha Tea.  Your thirst will be quenched . . .

I've been trying a few Kombuchas and get this one when I'm in whole foods because they only have a few brands and this is the cheapest. None of the others spill all over the place like this one. I thought that it was because i was shaking it by accident but now I realize that it's not that. And, honestly, it doesn't really taste as good as some of the others. Sorry.

This product is the only one I have found that isn't Rx to help IBS!  I love it.  If you like a sour fermented taste then you will love it!  It is refreshing especially when super cold.  Thank you Carpe Diem!

This stuff is not like real kombucha.  I'm another big fan of GT synergy. I've actually made kombucha on my own that doesn't taste nearly as good as synergy but better than this stuff. column9: Great product at the right price!

I enjoyed it very much.  Great taste and I would buy this product  again.

column9: Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee K-Cup Coffee
column10: This is the best K-Cup coffee that I have tried so far!  I have tried several from the sample box.  I only have one cup before breakfast.I would highly recommend Gloria Jeans Butter Toffee coffee, and the price was reasonable at Amazon.

I've always liked Gloria Jean coffee, but this butter toffee is exceptionally delicious!  If you haven't had an opportunity to try it you're really missing out.  It was easy breezy way to order it from Amazon and came early.  Gotta love that too.

column9: Very good flavor, but miss the old pack sizes

This is a great coffee for those that want a smooth, flavored k-cup. I add only a small amount of milk to my coffee because the flavoring is enough! :D

My favorite coffee is the Coffee People's Donut Shop.  This was just not good for me.  If you like a mild flavored weak coffee, this may be for you.
Gloia Jeans Butter Toffee coffee has a great taste. The smell of the aroma as the coffee brews starts an enjoyable experience. Sit back, relax and enjoy a cup!

Amazon offers the best deal on KCups. I like to purchase them in larger quantities and ordering them from Amazon is quick and easy. My husband and I especially love the Butter Toffee cups that give you a hint of flavored coffee that is not overpowering.
