Butter Toffee to me should be sweet so I understand what they are saying.As far as Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee, it is a good tasting cup of coffee and the flavor is consistent. The value of this item through the Subscribe and Save program makes it a good value for the dollar as well.

I have tried this flavor every way possible.  Cream, cream w/sugar, black w/sugar, black, small, medium, large, made with the B40 machine at work, made with the B70 machine at my house...  Every way tasted bad.  I like a lot of different flavored coffees and flavored k-cups, I don't know why this tastes so bad.

This may be just personal preference, but I just don't like this flavor AND it's watery. I shouldn't have ordered 50 ct package without having tried it first.(duh) Compared to the others I've tasted, it is like a much cheaper coffee. I last used the small cup setting on my Keurig, and will continue to do that to take care of the watery component. We will drink it, but we wont enjoy it! HA!

Wonderful coffee, and I used to subscribe and have itautomatically delivered, but I quit because the pricejust kept going up so I bought a set of "eco brew"reusable pots for my Keurig, I love them and I amthrilled that I am not throwing a K-Cup away every day.

I was excited to get this flavor and the reviews were great. I am sorry to report that I am not impressed at all with this flavor. It is somewhat weak in taste and I can BARELY taste the butter toffee. I will not buy this again.

column9: Not the worst k cup out there, but there are too many better alternatives to justify this one...
column10: My only foray into Gloria Jean's brand of k cups before this one was when I tried the Hazelnut flavor that was included in the sample pack that was included with our new brewer.  Needless to say, I was unimpressed with it.  I had all but written Gloria Jean off as a weak coffee brand when my boyfriend's sister gave us a few of her Butter Toffee k cups to try out, insisting they were much better than the Hazelnut.  At that point I hadn't tried another butter toffee flavored coffee from any of the other brands, so I figured it was worth a shot.What a letdown.Butter toffee does smell like its namesake when it is being brewed.  I had a lot of hope for it because of how it made my kitchen smell during the brewing process.  The flavor follow-up was nothing short of weak, though.  For one thing, I couldn't detect any butter toffee flavor in the coffee itself at all.  Shame.  The other downside is that, instead of being just a slightly boring, but good cup of regular coffee, this one somehow managed to be bitter and weak at the same time.  Nothing robust or flavorful about it.  Just weak coffee with a terrible aftertaste.So I've only had the chance to try two of Gloria Jean's flavors so far, but I definitely won't be going out of my way to try any others.  I'll stick to Timothy's and Caribou Coffee from now on.

I personally think this one smells better than it tastes.  Nice buttery aroma, but kind of watery when I drink it - even after doctoring it up with cream and sugar.  If that doesn't fix it, nothing will.  I had high hopes, but this one just doesn't pack enough of a flavor punch for me.  Will not repurchase.

After lots and lots of research, I have broken down and bought my first Keurig.  Ho-le-crap!!!!  The coffee is so good.  It came with a sampler pack and the Butter Toffee is by far my favorite!!!  I brewed a cup Saturday morning and my child came down stairs asking if I made french toast for breakfast! HAHAHAH!  This is the best flavored coffee I have had in a long long time!!!
I love this flavor!  This is a real perk me up type of coffee--good aroma, good taste. Just what this coffee lover enjoys any time of the day or night.

I love Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee for Keurig K-cups. It really has the taste of butter toffee and is not bitter. I just wish they made it in decaf. I also like that it is being shipped in one large box instead of two smaller ones--less waste and fewer boxes to recycle.
The aroma is pronounced but the coffee flavor is just okay.  I would buy it again.
Aroma is super, but flavor is lacking.  This is better when creamer and sweetener are added to bring out the flavor which tends to wash out.

column9: Lover of Gloria's Butter Toffee Coffee
column10: I love this coffee, it you like the taste of butter toffee this is for you!

The Butter Toffee smells real good but when I set the brew size at 7.25 ozs. It was a little light on flavor. The coffee taste was good overall but, I like a stronger flavor when I choose a flavored coffee.
I really enjoy these and the prices was much better than a lot of the others.  A very good light coffee.

I've ordered this coffee a few times. The last batch I got had changed for the worse. It had no butter toffee flavor that the privious batches had, and it had a bad bitterness to it. I would chalk it up to "just a bad batch", however Gloria Jean's has been unresponsive to my multiple customer service request. When you call, they put you through to a voicemail line that ask you to leave a detailed message. I've done this three times with no response. I wouldn't pay for this product again.

column9: One of the better flavored coffees
column10: Not my cup of tea (or coffee); but my wife enjoys flavored coffees and this is her favorite.I do admit to enjoying the aroma, but give me regular flavored coffee anytime.Also, the price per cup can't be beat.
I bought this flavor coffee after reading the postive reviews...so maybe it is just me but this flavor had a distinct unpleasant after taste.  Couldn't really taste the butter toffee flavor either.

column9: Smells great but tastes like water - no flavor
column10: This stuff smells great but it tastes like water.  I will not order it again, and I do not reccommend it.  I remembered it being better in the sample that came with my coffee maker.

column9: Gloria Jean's Toffee Coffee from Amazon
column10: This is one of our favorite kcups. We typically like our coffee a little stronger, but putting it on the medium water setting strengthens the flavor of the coffee. We order this on the Subscribe and Save, so this makes the price even more reasonable.

The coffee was what I wanted. I was not happy about the packaging. All the k-cups were loose in a packing box. It made me wonder where they all came from. There was no manufactured packages and of course there was not any expiration dates. Not sure if I would order from this place again.

I've had a Keuring brewer in one form or another for a few years now, and besides the sample packs, I must say these are the most disappointing K-kups yet.  Mabye I just like my coffee to taste like coffee, but this particular flavor has a very chemical taste to it, and leaves a pretty bad after taste. 1 star for working in my keurig, and one star for being cheap on Amazon.com!
I had a subscription for 1 price and then without notifying me, the price almost doubled. Very displeased with Amazon.com

This coffee doesn't smell like butter toffee, it just smells like "flavored coffee" which to me all smells very similar no matter what it's supposed to smell like--pecan praline, blueberry cream, amaretto, even "Norseman Grog" which is a combination of vanilla, rum and caramel.  They all smell pretty much the same to me, even different brands.  I was hoping this one would be different because of the high reviews, but it isn't.  I gave it two stars because the coffee itself is good and not bitter like some.

This is a great flavor!  First, my husband likes lots of cream & lots of sugar in his coffees.  One day I saw this in the store & bought it because the name made it sound promising - my husband LOVED it.  He barely puts any cream in his coffee because he says it tastes so smooth.My neighbor also has a Keurig & we swap flavors to get more of a variety.  I gave her some of this, and she was sold!  This is all she drinks now, too!Because this stuff is so great, we obviously buy in big quantities.  This packaging is great!  Just one box w/ a bunch of Kcups thrown in.  We don't have to mess w/ the plastic over the two boxes, etc. etc.
Not only the taste is GREAT! My Son and I love how the aroma fills the house.
A good blend with the flavor of butter toffee - nice switch from hazelnut and vanilla. Served with whole milk or cream, a rich tasting brew that's smooth as "budda"

I never buy flavored coffee.  I'm a cream, sugar and drizzle of caramel sauce type of coffee drinker.  When I read the reviews about this toffee flavored coffee I decided to try it with high hopes.As the coffee was brewing into the mug, I smelled a slight toffee scent.  It, and the coffee smelled good.  My hubs wanted a cup, just black.  I brought him his and after he drank some, while I was brewing mine, I asked him how he liked the flavor.  "What flavor?" he asked.  "It tastes like coffee to me" he said.  More questions to him and he said all he tasted was coffee, no flavor and the coffee was ok.Now for my cup.  I used about 1 inch of milk, one spoon of sugar and the Keurig on medium brewing setting.  The same faint scent of toffee was there along with the coffee.  I took my first sip and hardly tasted any toffee flavor.  I looked at the k-cup and it said 'toffee' on it so it was the correct k-cups that were sent.  It is such a mild, almost non-existent flavor that I wouldn't hesitate to serve this to those who don't like flavored coffee, I'm sure they would like it.  I'm disappointed in the weak flavor of toffee but the coffee itself is good tasting so it's not a waste.  I'm used to extra-bold, dark/french roasts so this is a much lighter roast for me.  All in all I like it.
The Gloria Jean Butter Toffee K-cups satisfy several senses all at once from brewing to drinking to relaxing.  An enjojable cup of coffee.

Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee K-Cups are the best flavor of all the K-Cups that I've tried.  I tried Emeril's, Paul Newman's, and several other brands, but Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee flavor is absolutely my favorite.  It's not too strong nor too weak and while it's brewing, it makes the whole house smell good.
One of my favorites! Not bold, smooth with a touch of toffee taste, light and just delish with a bit if cream!

column9: Great flavor, best price I have found
column10: I recently started drinking flavored coffees, since I preferred regular to hazelnut and french vanilla.  This coffee changed that. This coffee has a rich flavor and tastes great.  I have started keeping a supply on hand, and have had black coffee drinkers try this, and so far they have all said this is the only flavored coffee that they thought tasted good.  Try it you won't be disappointed.
My boyfriend loves this coffee. He drinks it black without cream and sugar. It has just enough flavor without being bitter. It's also great with creamer for me.

My wife loves these Butter Toffee's every Sat & Sun morning, she calls it her taste of Heaven. Which takes her out of this world.  It has a buttery flavor which she enjoys and its a medium blend not to robust, and you can taste the hint of toffee as well.

I purchased this coffee with high hopes for a sweet light roast.  It is ok but has a strong coffee taste I did not expect. I recommend Gloria Jeans Macadamia Cookie for anyone who want a sweet light coffee.

column9: Really don't get the rave reviews. Tastes like stale butterscotches.
column10: I made the mistake of buying a 50 pack of these k cups when they were on sale. The first few were decent, but the more I drank them, the more I started to dislike the flavor. At this point, I'm pretty much forcing myself to get through them since I don't want to waste them. The best way I can describe the flavor is a mixture of watered down coffee and old, stale butterscotch candy. Ugh.

I got hooked on Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee when we purchased a variety pack and this flavor was included.  It is such a rich, creamy, medium roast coffee.  I enjoy it in the morning, but love a cup in the evening as I settle in for the night.  I have just placed a reorder for  more.  If you enjoy flavored coffees, you must try this flavor.
Buying coffee this way saves money . Everyone in the family likes this coffee. It is a medium blend with excellent flavor

We really enjoyed this coffee. Love buying in the bulk package. cut the top off the box and stow it away. Reach in and get a handful to put in our rack on the cabinet. The Butter Toffee flavor is so smooth. We have always enjoyed hazelnut but this is a step up in flavor. Just find a quiet corner and enjoy a cup to relax.

I love this coffee BUT the last box I got was some good some very bitter. I love this and have been buying for a long time but the last box was not as good.One day i make a cup and it is so good smells wonderful next day I get a cup that is bitter with very little of the smell I love
Most of the Gloria Jean's flavors I am not a big fan of, but this one would be the exception. I really enjoyed the flavor and it was a nice change from my normal routine. Plus the price is very nice.

column9: It was my second choice and will now be my first!
column10: I like the 50-cup packs of coffee and I ordered Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee coffee because my first coffee choice could not ship for 2-4 weeks.  I was a bit worried because the GJ Mudslide was a slight disappointment.Butter Toffee is smooth with just the right amount of sweetness  The butter toffee flavor was distinct and at the perfect depth of flavor.This might be my new first choice in coffee!  I would recommend this to others.
One of my favorite flavored coffees available in K-cups.  Good for a Sunday morning cup of joe and a good read!
This order arrived in Afghanistan very quickly and the K-Cups didn't last long at all!! Great Buy!! I would recommend this product and purchase method to anyone!

This butter toffee has become my favorite k-cup flavor. Though I usually prefer unflavored coffee in the morning, this is an exception. It has just a hint of flavor and makes getting up a bit more tolerable. My daughter-in-law introduced me to it and, when my gift box was gone, i was glad to be able to replace it at a reasonable price at Amazon.

I have tried MANY different coffee flavors since purchasing my Keuriq two years ago. Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee remains my favorite. It smells SO GOOD brewing and tastes even better! I buy it in bulk through Amazon and don't want to be without it!!! In fact, I think I'll purchase another box now!

There is something about this particular flavor that keeps me coming back for more.  I am not sure if it is the aroma, while it is brewing or the flavor, but of all of the different flavors that I have tried, this is my favorite.  I have it coming on the subscribe and save plan, so I know I will never be without it.
This variety is one of my daughter & my favorites & I try to keep it on hand at all times.

This is one of my favorite cups of coffee. I will definitely be purchasing more of this.  The flavor is a little weak on the biggest cup setting on my Keurig but the middle setting is perfect and you can really taste the Butter Toffee.  I love it!!  Try it on the smallest setting for a really sweet treat.

Overall I prefer a stronger coffee than Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee, but I tried this coffee when in an accountants office and really liked the flavor.  It is not a K-Cup that I drink every day, but it is definitely good for a change of pace.  If it were a little stronger I would rate it five stars.

My wife absolutely loves this version of k-cup coffee after trying 50+ different types.  It has a pleasant aroma and a subtle flavor.  We were pleased to find this on Amazon but are hoping that it is popular enough to end up in the "Subscribe and Save" program as we would sign up immediately for the convenience factor (and the extra savings)!
Coffee made it quickly and well packed-I did have a couple of cups crushed, but other than that, wonderful as always!
This coffee has such good flavor, i love it! It does not even need creamer! I will absolutely buy it again!
I love this flavor of coffee, and amazon makes it very easy to get large amounts cheaper.  Shipment was shorter then expected. I love amazon!

I love Gloria Jean's coffee's. But this is by far one of the best coffee's out there.  It tastes really good and not overpowering. It's the second time I'm purchasing this flavor and bought the 50 pack because everyone in the house is drinking my coffee. I highly recommend this flavored coffee.  Enjoy!!

The convenience and speed with the shipping of these k-cups makes you hardly notice you ever ran out. The cups are free from damage and easy to open and get to when received. Finally, for my taste the butter toffee is one of the most enjoyable flavors of coffee available from this product line.
I have ordered coffee many times and it was always great. this time, it is butter toffee, and it tastes like watered down junk. how do I exchange it?
I have ordered the coffees i enjoy most in packs of 50, the cost and taste of the Gloria Jean is my favorites so far.. They are a real bargain at a great price!!!
Don't brew on high setting if you drink breafast blends usually, you will find the flavor kind of weak other than that ok.
I expected it little bit different than it tasted. Stronger than I like my coffee to be. I would not recommend this to people who does not like strong coffee

I tend to drink flavored coffees, and use this one in the morning.  I add some creamer and artificial sweetener to mine.  The coffee is not too sweet and it's smooth on the palate.  All in all, I'd say this is a good coffee any time of day.
This is one of my favorite k-cup flavored coffees.  Not too light, it has this sweet, delicious aroma. Everytime I brew a cup someone will complement that coffee smells really good! :)

I didn't realize the fuss-free packaging meant that there would not be any smaller boxes inside the big box keeping the k-cups organized. That's a little irritating because now I have NO idea where I'm going to put them all! The coffee itself is quite lovely. My entire kitchen smells like butter toffee and I am not complaining! It's a wonderful flavour and something I am going to buy again and again.

column9: wish for Gloria Jean's flavored decaf coffee
column10: i love this coffee, it's my favorite however it doesn't come in decaf and i can only drink so much caffine without the side effects. please come out with decaf, we love coffee too.

I really like the Gloria Jeans Butter Toffee Coffee for my Keurig it is one of my favorites.  I have bought this from Amazon several times and I always get a good price and great service.  Most certainly will order again.  Keep up the good work and service.

column9: Great Aroma but flavor Just Okay
column10: I tried this based on the great customer reviews.  I use the Keurig at work (we have one that everyone shares - you just need to bring in your own K-Cups).  The aroma is fantastic, but the actual flavor is just okay. We typically run it through twice using the small cup setting, so it gives us a full large cup.  Maybe this is better if you just run it through one time and make a short cup.  I thought maybe it was just me, so I gave it to a friend who also loves flavored coffee.  He tried it and was not very excited either.  It is certainly a personal preference with regard to flavor.

Butter toffee is my second favorite coffee flavor (second to hazelnut).  As we go through a lot of coffee, we purchase our K-Cups in bulk so we're always looking for the best price per K-Cup.  We've tried other flavors from Gloria Jean's Coffees, and we have been satisfied with all of them so far.  We keep our K-Cups on the Keurig 5060 K-Cup Carousel, Chrome so we're okay that the K-Cups ship in this box.  Highly recommended!

I'm thoroughly enjoying my Butter Toffee coffee in K-Cup form from Gloria Jean's. The coffee tastes great, and the package arrived perfectly - no damage at all. Often one or two K-Cups burst or crack during shipment, but this did not happen. I will order again.
Received quickly and was as advertised. Recommend this product to everyone that enjoys different coffee blend and use Keurig K-cups.
Gloia Jeans Butter Toffee is one of my favorite k-cups, and I've tried almost all of them, has a sweet flavor to them.
This coffee is a treat with dessert and nice on those cold winter days. There is something warm and comforting about this coffee.

We've had this flavor on subscribe and save for a couple of years now, and despite trying many other K-cups, this one remains my wife's favorite.I find it has a pleasant flavor, on the milder side, and while I prefer my coffee a little more feisty, I've never minded drinking this one when it was the only flavor we had left in the pantry.

I have tried many of Gloria Jean's coffees. I experiment with many different flavored creamers, whip cream and caramel. The butter toffee coffee mixes well with every experiment I've tried. Mine is better than Starbucks now LOL.

I don't like strong or bitter coffee, nor do I like to put all different kinds of stuff in it to make it more palatable. This is such a nice and smooth coffee.  It doesn't need a thing added to it, so I can drink it black, just the way I like it.

column9: this one was a disappointment  for me
column10: Sorry but after so many rave reviews I just can't make myself "like" this one.I have ordered countless assorted flavored coffee at the Keurig website andhave not experienced such flavorless coffee.  Can't recall if I have everytried any "Gloria Jean" products....and I'm not knocking the brand...I haveenjoyed that brand served at the mall.Unfortunately I have 50!  (FIFTY) k-cups to use!This is my personal observation of this particular flavor of this one brand.Just so flavorless for me.  sorryWondering if there is any recourse for $30.00 worth of worthless k-cups?  Believe meI am not a "complainer", check out any of my other reviews.  Just a heads up that maybeif you are sitting on the fence on this flavor, IMHO stay away .... sorry Gloria Jean.

column9: Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee K-Cups Coffee
column10: Always delicious and satisfying....Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee K-Cups Coffee is great.  Nioce way to start morning or end day....warmiong and comforting treat.
I'll keep this short and simple. These are the best K-cups I've had, and I've had a lot of them. Also makes the kitchen/office smell awesome. Well worth at least trying.

I love this flavored coffee.  I do not like strong coffee, I was glad this is NOT a strong coffee.  I put cream in my coffee and this smells great while it is brewing and you are not disappointed in the flavor.  I had gotten a sample of this and was so glad to find it at such a great price!! I will be ordering this again!!!

column9: Try it with Caramel Macchiato cream!
column10: To ensure that I don't waste your time, I want to begin this review by letting you know just what kind of coffee drinker I am. I drink coffee every day, sometimes up to 4 cups a day, depending on my mood. When I have coffee I use just a little sugar but a good bit of cream, usually flavored. International Delight French Vanilla has always been my old faithful, go-to creamer.I recently received a Keurig Cup Coffee Brewer and drank the Dark Magic K-Cups that were gifted with it. I found the Dark Magic to be very rich, a little over-roasted, but very drinkable. After running through the 24 pack I was looking for something different.I decided on the Butter Toffee K-Cup by Gloria Jean and was pleasantly surprised by the full, rich flavor delivered without any bitter aftertaste. The Butter Toffee is a medium roast blend with a very nice toffee flavor.Now on to my little recommendation. I was in Wally World the other day and was going to pick up some more French Vanilla cream when something different caught my eye. Coffeehouse Inspirations - Caramel Macchiato by International Delight. (Just so you know, this was the dairy based version, not the non-dairy shelf-stable individual portions.) I was rather impatient during the drive home to say the least. Let me describe the experience with a formula.Butter Toffee K-Cup + International Delight Caramel Macchiato = An amazing cup of coffee.While I'm not going to say that I've never had a cup of coffee this good, I cannot recall one off the top of my head. Try it!
Gloria Jean's Coffees,Butter Toffee K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers (Pack of 50)Love love love this coffee!! Definitely a winner.  I'm a coffee junkie and highly recommend this flavor~
Great coffee, great price and it arrived on schedule. I am a returning customer and I will be ordering more soon.

I took out a subscription of this tuna on July 5, 2012, and I can say Ambrosia is quality - tasting & looking tuna all the way! It has nice big flakes of fish in the can and you can make it taste OH SO GOOD!But there is a but, and its a fairly big BUT.If only the soaring price increases on this product could be better contained AND if Amazon would kindly abide by the customer's delivery subscription date for  payment processing and product delivery -then- a subscription of this tuna would be a great pleasure.Frankly, if I begin a 30-day subscription (and billing) on the 5th of the month, I expect Amazon to bill me for further shipments on the 5th of the month, not days before the 5th nor on haphazard dates from month-to-month.Or lets say, I elect to receive subscription deliveries on the 12th of the month, I do not expect to receive those deliveries before the 12th of the month - PERIOD. Isn't the purpose of the subscription date setup provision to know what to adhere to meet the customer's satisfaction?Beyond these few quirks, I can commend the Amazon family for the great work that it does 24/7 ...... and yes, I absolutely love AMBROSIA TUNA! But how 'bout more affordable, Amz?

This isn't the tuna you used as a CHEAP source of protein... you know those Tuna Noodle Casserole meals, economical and healthy!I would not buy this again. It's like paying more than $2.00 per 6 ounce can. I don't know what the hell I was thinking, I FEEL RIPPED OFF. You do waaaay better catching tuna on sale at your local grocery store.

we were disappointed with how quickly the flowers ended up dying despite our following the care directions.  Yet the flowers received were awesome!  I'd go for the 12 month package if I felt confident they would last more than two weeks.

Cooks Illustrated always rate this as the best extra virgin for the price and it's absolutely true.So damn good - it elevates any dish you're using it on (to finish - don't bother cooking with it and messing up the characteristics of the oil).
I enjoyed this sampler of decade coffees. It gave me an opportunity to try many brands and flavors that I would not have purchased otherwise. I would definitely purchaseit again.

To be fair, this variety sampler pack is NOT ready for gifting. HOWEVER, this is the finest selection of decaf blends available. In searching for variety - there is no better source. To me the entire point of the Keurig is variety for my guests and myself. This seller is the only one that gets the concept of VARIETY!!!!! Will certainly continue to buy this sampler.

I agree the cardboard box isn't ready for gift giving.  However, the coffee selection is wonderful.  I'm learning which brands I prefer so I can narrow down future sample packs.  It's a great decaf introduction to the world of coffee for new Keurig owners.  If you're looking for presentation, buy a carousel and put the K-cups on display before wrapping, perhaps with some tape to hold them in while transporting.  The leftover K-cups that don't fit can then be transfered into any pretty box you desire.  The important thing is the coffee selection can't be beat, and the price is very reasonable.

My Decaf K-cups arrived today and I am very upset. Some of the dates on the K-cups expire next week! Some are unmarked with an expiration date and none are good beyond 4 months from now. They are packed in an unmarked box with a toilet paper roll inside. Don't buy this and certainly don't give it as a gift. I hope to get fresh coffee or my money back!

I was glad to see a variety of flavors as well as brands in the assortment. The only thing I didn't like was the packaging - all 35 pieces thrown in a plain white box. I had to take them out of the box and sort them to see what was there. Overall a very good product and I would buy it again.

Very disappointed is an understatement. I purchased this as a Christmas gift but under the circumstances doubt it will be given unless I can repackage it more attractively. Imagine the shock when the shipping box was opened to find not the expected gift pack pictured as the product but the individual cups thrown in haphazardly on top of a small cardboard tube containing the print. Only to be superceded by the awe that I was stupid enough to buy this in the first place. I certainly will not be buying from Crazy Cups again.

This Crazy Cups Decaf Sampler (pack of 35) contained 13 different varieties of decaf coffee.  There were 3 k-cups of most varieties, 4 k-cups of one variety, and 1 or 2 k-cups of a few varieties. The k-cups arrived in great condition loose in one cardboard box. This was my first k-cup purchase for my brand new Keurig.  I thought it would be nice to try a variety of coffees to see which I liked best, but I think I will continue to purchase this sampler because I liked them all!
I enjoy the convenience of using keurig cups and of being able to get decaffenated more easily by ordering on-line and receiving them by mail.

A nice variety of decaf coffee's.  Good opportunity to sample different producers products for future purchases.  Will definitely purchase Donut House and some of the others again.  Could not find samplers like this in local stores.  Strongly urge new subscribers to try this from Amazon first, to get a good variety.

Presentation was jut thrown in a box, so that was disappointing. Assortment didn't fully reflect what was pictured and only a handful of "flavors", also disappointed. It did provide me with a few decaf flavors that I like and can try to locate. I am happy to have more decaf available. The ones Ive tried are very tasty (Hazelnut and Fr Vanilla) so thats a plus. If you don't care about how it looks, and the number of flavored cups, buy it. It will give you an idea of the decafs out there...

I was disappointed with this sampler pack because I thought it would have a lot more flavored decaf ups than it does.  I thought when I ordered it, it did, so, when I received it and opened the box, I was very disappointed.  If you want a lot of dark roasted decaf cups than this is the pack to get.  If, however you're like me and wanting to try out flavored k-ups, then you'll be sadly disappointed.

I was expecting a variety of flavors, not just boldness'.  I was hoping to give a good friend some flavors of coffee and only Hazelnut was in the box.  The rest were just different makers and boldness types.

column9: lots of variety and fun flavors
column10: I have been getting lucky in ordering this package twice and received a wide variety of flavors.  will keep ordering.
This was a very good variety of coffee brands and flavors. All flavors were very tasty.  I will definitely buy this again in the future.

I think decaf coffee gets a bad rap.  People think it has no flavor and has no umph because it has no caffeine.  The selection to be reviewed has a great variety of flavors and strengths and gives great taste to this coffee lover
I love this Decaf Sampler. There are so many choices and they all taste different. The variety is excellent for this decaf drinker! Definitely going to purchase again.

If you're a k-cup coffee drinker, and you need a decaf every now and then, then:a) you are locked into one variety and buy that in bulk, orb) buy a couple different varieties in bulk and still don't get to try new blends very oftenNow, there's a third option.  This sampler pack, though being slightly more expensive on a unit cost basis (cost per k-cup), provides 2-5 k-cups of each variety of decaf there is.  We have ordered this twice, from the same seller, and each has come with a different mix, to our delight!If variety if the spice of life to you, and you are a decaf k-cup drinker ... you owe it to yourself to get this sampler.  You won't regret it.Jon & Taylor
These were great . I loved the varity. This is the second time I have ordered these. I will order them again.

column9: Bummed about the selection I received

column9: nice variety for a great price

column9: A good assortment of decaf k-cups

It turns out that they liked the sample better than picking one!  The product came with a good selection of coffee types.  I was happy I ordered it.
Gives me a good variety of coffee to try new brands.  It also keeps me from being bored with the same old cup of coffee.

I bought a Keurig for my mother at Christmas. She only wanted decaf coffees. This sampler allowed her to narrow down the brands she liked best without having to buy quantities of the ones she didn't like. She found three she now buys. Definitely the way to go for new users, whether you like decaf or regular.

What a good way to determine the best decaf prior to purchasing the product.  I've been rating the K-cup brands as I drink them.  I'm so glad I didn't purchase one particular brand.  I think it's a little pricier than I'd like, (hence, the 4 stars) but it's a good way to narrow down the brands you like and eliminate those you don't. I have been ordering crazy cups via amazon warehouse for a couple of months now and have not yet to be disappointed.  I drnk both regular coffee and decaf and these taste terrific.
If you like a variety of deaf choices this is a good package to consider. Loved it. Guests liked it too.
A good way to find the coffee you love withoutbuying whole boxdes of one flavor.A nice selectionof brands is included.
I enjoyed trying the different flavors in this sampler.  The donut shop coffee was my favorite.  I will probably not buy this sampler again because the flavor selection is a little weak.

This package has a wonderful variety of decaf coffees! I even received a couple flavored coffee K-Cups, which is fun. This is a great way to try some of the many options available for your Keurig before committing to a full box of a single brand.
Great-tasting coffee and a great variety.  Decaf can be boring sometimes, so this option is awesome!!!  I would definitely buy this again.

column9: so many different choices in one pack

I received a Keurig K Cup coffee maker a few months ago and have been hunting for some decaf K Cups to use with it. I've been keeping a log of the ones that I want to buy more of and again I'll be looking on Amazon.com for my favorites.  Thanks!

column9: Keurig me one cup at a time

I truly enjoyed having the surprise of a different coffee each day. There were a couple that I did not like because they were too bold and I tend to like more medium type coffees. But other than that, I really enjoyed this sampler pack. Great value!

This is an awesome selection of decaf coffees!  I can't wait to try them all.  If you are looking for variety or a way to try the many different flavors of k cups, this is for you.  Will definitely purchase again.

This was a good assortment of decaf k-cups at a good price.  Makes it easy to find one you really like rather than getting stuck with a lot you don't really like.  Shipped fast and as always, well-packaged.

This is a great assortment and great coffee.  We just love our new machine by Keurig and now we can have any kind of coffee that we want.  Nice mix and tastes great.  UNFORTUNATELY, the coffees in this box were not decaf as represented.

column9: Not as good as the Grape/Strawberry

column9: Did not send the brand advertised
column10: After ordering these for 3 years for my dog, they sent a different brand distributed by Radio Systems Corp, Made in China.  Granted, when I look at what's remaining of my last package of Premier Busy Buddy Gnawhide Refil Ring (as advertised), it also was made in China.  It just annoys me that they have changed their distributor/manufacturer.......and haven't changed what they advertise they are selling. I will return these and find another company to order from.  Perhaps Premier Busy Buddy Gnawhide rings no longer exist and I'll have to find another favorite treat for my beloved dog.  Buyer Beware
My dog must love them She goes to town on them. They are kind of expensive for what they are but She loves them. I only gave it for stars because of value for your money.

We like their products and they are good for our big baby, keeps him out of trouble and prevents him from chewing other things for short periods of time. We have two busy buddy bones which use the rawhide crackers. Please not the large size was not easy to find.

My dog is blind and there are very few toys that interest him--okay, the ONLY toys that interest him involve food.  He is about 25 pounds and I got him the medium size Bouncy Bone and the Bristle Bone.  He packs them around the house.  The only reason I gave the gnawhide refills 4 stars instead of five is because they're kind of expensive.

My dandie dinmont terriers absolutely love these. Give each of them one, they are kept busy for a good amount of time and I can get chores done!  These should be sold in multipacs.I would be nice if they could be chicken flavored and without any cornstarch. I try to only feed select foods and snacks, so this has become their one allowed "Junk Food" item and they absolutely love it.You should see, we bring 4 of these out-one for each dog- they sit and wait patiently while we get them ready and then they go off to their own special spots with them. No messy clean up after and everyone is happy.

These are great but don't last very long at all :-(The gnawhide rings that came with the original toy seemed harder and lasted longer, but these refills were very soft an pliable making them go away fast! So, very expensive 5 minute experience. Hopefully next time they will last longer if come from a different lot or something because my doxie loves them on his busy bone!

column9: Lasts longer than the rawhide rings
column10: My dogs love the Busy Buddy bones.  They get the rawhide rings off first, pretty quick.  I am happy to be able to get all cornstarch now, lasts longer.  For dogs that aren't so food motivated, the easier rawhide rings are better as the dogs get frustrated with the cornstarch and give up.

They are really great treats for our puppy.  She loves these and with the toy itself, these fit really well and keep her busy for hours.  As long as a dog does not have a weak stomach or any bad experiences with rawhide, they are fantastic!Premier Busy Buddy Bouncy Bone, Medium

My only complaint is that the refills are too expensive.  My puppy loves this rawhide and putting it in the bristle bone prevents her from snarfing it down too fast.  The two small discs don't seem to upset her stomach and I am not worried about big chunks of rawhide being ingested, as can happen with rawhide bones.  Once a day I can depend on having about 10-15 minuets of free time when I give my puppy this rawhide toy.  I would love to be able to give it to her more often but the cost, and the fact that I don't want her to ingest too much rawhide, prohibits me from doing so.  Tragically, she is learning to extract the rawhide much more quickly, but it still keeps her satisfied longer than most toys.  Premier Busy Buddy Gnawhide Refill Ring Dog Treats for Bristle and/or Bouncy Bones, Rawhide, Medium

we had been looking everywhere but could not find them. Low and behold we found them and our dog is happily spoiled again

I'm kind of concerned that it might be bad for her to swallow these.  They smell like they're just plastic so I'm not sure how easily they digest.. anyone have thoughts on that?

Well, he chews through it in a couple of minutes, and pretty much once he gets a tear in it, the entire thing comes off and he chews and swallows nearly the whole thing at once.  Needless to say, after a cost of 75cents or so per treat, it really wasn't worth 2 minutes of distraction, plus I wasn't happy with how he could swallow it nearly whole.  This would probably be better for smaller dogs or ones that aren't so food motivated!
The Busy Buddy Rawhide is my English Setters favorite treat.  The treat is a refill for the Busy Buddy Bouncy Bone.
I have an 8 month old that likes to chew. I bought the busy buddy but found it difficult to find the refills. Fast delivery on amazon and my dog loves these.

My choc lab Dane just loves these treats!! He has learned when I ask him to get "treat toy" to go and find it and bring it to me. He watches me add the treat to the toy and will actually howl with excitement!! The only problem is that he has it mastered and the treats are gone within min's. But reguardless, he loves them and I will continue to give them to him! Also, the service from this seller is A++++++++++++!!!
"BUFFY" LOOKS FORWARD TO HER "TOY" EVERY AFTERNOON.  MY BIGGEST FEAR IS RUNNING OUT OF REFILLS BEFORE I CAN ORDER AND RECEIVE MORE.
I buy these rawhides that fit into a busy bone and my dog just loves to yank and pull on the rawhide.  It keeps him busy while I am out and he enjoys it.
I have two dogs and they love these!  I just wish they weren't so daggone expensive! I also wish they sold them in larger amounts. My two dogs will eat these up within a week!
Why wouldn't a dog like these? They are rawhides. Dogs go crazy for that stuff. These fit perfectly with the bristle bone, and can even be chewed on if you don't have a bristle bone.
Amazon.com sold me this product at a cheaper price than Target or Pet Smart. Its the exact same product for less and the shipping was free!

I purchased these to put on my dog's Premier Busy Buddy Bouncy Bone, Medium My dog is a lab mix and as soon as I put these on her bone...they're gone!  She loves the taste of them and they're pretty soft for a hard treat, so they just break right off, she chews a couple times and..."Gulp."  they're gone.  So, in general,  if you are purchasing these for a large breed, the bouncy bone itself is a great idea and very very durable (as are ALL of the Premier pet toys,) however I do not recommend the gnawhide rawhide rings for anything larger than a medium terrier breed.  Otherwise you'll be spending wayyyy too much on these refill packs.Note:  If you have a large breed (as I do) these rings work great on the bouncy bone as a big treat/reward for good behavior!

My dog loves these!  I first purchased them for Gus who would bring me his bone to get more.  He absolutely loved them--as does Scout, my current dog.  She gets so excited when she sees me get them out for her!

I've been trying to find something for my puppy (a weimeraner)to chew.  Regular rawhides are too tough for her just yet, but everything else seems too soft.  Thought that these might do the trick. Unfortunately, she just goes through them too quickly.  It takes her less than 20 minutes to finish one off, and these are the "large" ones.

These are refills for the Busy Bone and Bristle Bone.  It is the best possible option for dogs who like to chew:  They love the challenge of the busy bone and bristle bone, yet the rawhide intake is very limited--both on the positive side.  When paired with the cornstarch/rawhide refill rings, it is a special treat.
