column9: refill rings for busy buddy bone
column10: My girls love these but they are a little expensive especially for 6 dogs 4 of my own and 2 fosters right now, but it keeps them all busy and happy for a while for sure...
For whatever reason, my dog isn't very interested in the round gnawhide. She loves the Busy Buddy rectangular strips, so I don't think it's a flavor issue. I won't be buying these again.

I have always been pleased with Premier dog products.  This is no exception to the rule-My dog spends a signifcant amount of time alone and when I come home, I find the chews have been gnawed at until they are almost gone.  She must be lovin' it.
My Danes love these rawhide rings. The nylon bone it goes into is their favorite.Large size is hard to find locally. Glad Amazon carries them.
The greatest chewie that my dog loves best!  They keep her happier and a little more busy than the usual dog treat!
Our dogs go crazy just watching us load the toy it goes on.They play with their toy for hours.Even plan to purchase more

column9: Premier Busy Buddy Treats really do keep puppies busy!
column10: Dog trainer recommended the bouncy bones with gnawhide rings to keep my three cavalier king charles puppies occupied enough so that they wouldn't chew items that they shouldn't.  It worked.  I give each puppy the treat every other day and they like the rawhide better than the cornstarch rings.  Pleased with the choice.
This is a wonderful idea, my dog loves to eat them out of the package but will not use them in the intended bone. I was disappointed because I wanted this to work so her teeth would stay cleaner.
We love the Busy Buddy Bristle Bone and the refills. Our dog really works to get to the treats, and the bristles keep her teeth nice and clean.
These are a must for the buddy bones. My dogs love these and I will be ordering more.
I thought this package would have 2 types of rings (smooth and rough), but most only had the rough type. Other than that sameness, my dog likes the product.

FYI- There are two flavors of rawhide in each package.  My puppy only likes one of them so the other half of the package is useless.  I wish these rings came in other flavors like chicken, liver, salmon etc.

column9: The perfect gift for a ketchup lover.
column10: I had a weirdo friend who puts ketchup on everything. So this seemed to be the perfect gift. She carried it around in her purse all the time. It's so much easier to use than the normal packets. I wish the other fast food places would join chick-fila so I could get these for free but for now it might be an okay alternative to pay a little extra for it. You might want to wait until these things are eligible for free shipping/amazon prime.

I'm on a gluten free diet, who knew there was gluten in most Vanilla? So, this is what I use. I stumbled across a bottle in a scratch/dent/overstock store, now I'm sold on this brand, and know that $5 for an 8 oz bottle was quite the bargain =D
Exactly as listed--bottles look the same, same size, etc.  Smells good out of the bottle (unlike the weird artificial vanillas).  Price is great for what you are getting: real vanilla.
This gives a nice flavor to recipes that require vanilla extract. All vanilla extract is the same and does bring different properties and flavor to food.

Be VERY careful when ordering from OZBO. I was shipped outdated inedible Riesen and passed them out to friends and cohorts without knowing their condition. When people got back to me with information regarding the product white discoloration, sticking to the inside foil and hardness of the candies, OZBO refused to replace the product because I couldn't collect all from whom I had given the candy. I guess OZBO would have me open each separate Riesen candy and inspect, then rewrap them and package back up in the bag. GET REAL OZBO. I hope this review is helpful.
These arrived melted together and out of date - totally unsuitable for gift giving. Don't waste your money. They also were packed tightly together, which I'm sure didn't help.
I purchased these because I wanted to have some smaller marshmallows - not miniature, but somewhere in between.  these are the perfect size for children!

It is a slim packet with mostly tuna meat and not much water.  Make sure you bring a small spoon to get every bits out.  It was a little hard to use my fingers to eat.I bought it primarily for backpacking and hiking.  It is light weight, healthy, and fulfilling as a part of my lunch.  The calorie count is good (80 per packet) and the taste is not bad when the body screams for fuel.  I can also see it being added into rehydrated TVP, rehydrated instant refried beans, and canned soup, etc..I also put a few packets in my cubicle in case i get hungry.  it's a super healthy snack (if u prefer savory snack).Overall I am very happy to have it in my pantry so that I can grab it whenever i need one or two.

column9: So far my favorite canned/pouched tuna
column10: This is a very healthy option. I like to mix it with cooked quinoa or brown rice and added beans for a healthy lunch. Low sodium of 300 mg (13% RDA), so I can have 2-3 pouches a day if I want. The taste is rather bland by itself, which is a good thing if you're adding it to other foods. I was able to buy in bulk with a subscription and the occasional discount from Chicken of the Sea making my per piece price about 78 cents.
I love this product because it's not only nutritious and delicious but it's also very convenient.  Just open and place on bread!  A great lunch if you're dieting.

I am on a low carb diet and this is very convenient to purchase.  Amazon is very easy to use and take to work or eat at home for dinner.  The delivery was quick and I would purchase this again.  Also, this package is a smaller size so honestly you can put this in a salad or eat alone.  It is not the larger size pack which is good for one person meals.

column9: Chicken of the Sea Tuna Health Select Chunk Light , 2.5 Ounce Pouch (Pack of 12)
column10: I am on subscribe and save as this tuna is healthy and good.  I used to purchase another brand, more expensive, and to me this tastes better.  Great to take with you and no mess.  Highly recommended product.

I have these on subscribe & save so they are a staple in my pantry.  I don't eat red meat anymore, so these tuna packs are very handy to have on hand. The portion size is just right to add protein to a salad, to make a quick sandwich, or to add to a pasta dish. I've even stirred it into certain soups when I needed a protein. They always arrive on time and if I need them sooner, or need to delay an order, it is very easy to do with subscribe & save.

column4: Lisa Fowler "Long daily work commute allows f...
column10: This a very good light tuna with a mild tuna flavor.  It's moist and mixes into food well like tuna and noodles or tuna salad.  There isn't an unpleasant fishy smell and it's nice that you don't need to drain it like you do with canned tuna.  I recommend it.

I have been buying the unsweetened carob chips from a local high end supermarket.  I decided to try these since they cost less.  What a mistake!  These taste like cardboard!  I was very disappointed after having bought 5 lbs. thinking they would be the same.  These are awful!  I had to throw them out and go back to buying the other ones at the supermarket.  Sometimes it doesn't pay to try and save money, in this case it didn't.  Also, when they arrived, 2 packages were melted, so they were not packaged well.

column4: Laura Newton "It's a car wash ladies and gent...
column10: These chips contain Partially Hydrogenated oils.  If you are looking to eat these for health benefits, you're better off with chocolate.  Otherwise, find a brand with no hydro.
I love carob and especially since it is unsweetened.  It is really quite delicious.  I can't have chocolate, so this product is perfect for me. I am very happy with the taste and quality.

i love carob chips and the store near me doesn't carry bulk items so i decided to try these. big mistake. i ended up throwing them out they were so dry and yucky. i went back to the store and bought the sunspire brand . so much better and worth the higher price.

I purchased unsweetened carob chips for candy making. They do not melt well and are supper grainy, plus they have a horrible flavor. I called the company and even though they say quality guaranteed these were awful and they would not do anything to make it right and were very rude on the phone. Do not waste your money on these!!!!!!!!!!!

I was so glad I found this product.  I should not eat chocolate for medical reasons.  Carob does not taste exactly like chocolate but it satisfies my cravings and I think it's a great substitute; especially as chips in cookies.  These taste like bittersweet chocolate.  The sweetened ones are good too. I'm so happy I can have cookies and milk again!

column9: Always a great experience with Berry Farm!
column10: Love this company and their products.  I've been ordering from them for over a year now and will continue to do! Great company!

column9: who needs chocolate when you have carob?
column10: i have been using carob for over 12 years, and nobody can tell the difference. at least not right away...but there are no complaints! my brownies and "chocolate" cakes are a hit without the caffeine properties you get with chocolate. it's also a healtyhier choice all around. try it if you want to live and feel better...without the jitter!
I was fairly disapointed with this product. I wanted to make homemade candies but this product does not melt in a creamy fashion. It is all clumpy.

Regarding Barry Farm Foods, I couldn't tell by the description that these carob chips contain soy. They are not returnable. I think it would be helpful to list all ingredients as on the actual label for those of us with lots of diet restrictions.
My 10 month old is usually very picky eater that doesn't want much of anything but this went down in a hurry.

My son loves all the Ella's Kitchen fruit & veggie pouches (along with Plum Organics as well). But this chicken meal... yuck. Not only does it not smell appealing, but it tastes awful. My son is 11 months and eats everything I put in front of him, but this Ella's Kitchen chicken meal (along with the ELLA'S KITCHEN Oh So Creamy Chicken and Corn Mash, 4.5-Ounce (Pack of 7)) is something he refuses to eat. I literally spoon it in his mouth and he sticks out his tongue and pushes it out as quick as he can.The only way I got him to eat this is by mixing it with fruit baby food (with a ratio of 2:1 fruit to chicken). I recommend sticking with homemade chicken. I have not tried other meat-based baby foods but given how Ella's Kitchen tends to be incredibly tasty, I can only imagine how bad other brands' food must be.

I bought this thinking it would be better than all of those other proteins out there marketed to babies. Plus, My son loves the veggie/fruit pouches, but he won't touch any of these (Chicken, Beef, or Bean) with a 10-foot pole!! And we've tried to offer them quite a few times. I say try at your own risk but do not buy more than one or you may be wasting your money. Stick to fresh chicken.

You might ask, why does someone need 12 lbs. of baking soda?  Well, when you think about all the things you do with it around the house, it makes sense.  For starters, a lot of us keep it in the fridge and freezer to absorb odors.  And that's just the beginning.  It occurred to me that it was foolish to keep buying it in the small boxes.  So now I have a large quantity handy for whenever I need it.  The packaging is VERY smart -- you just scissor the top, and it's ready to pour. The handle is a thoughtful addition.

column9: Quantity, but maybe not as good quality
column10: While you can get significantly more product here for the money, I didn't particularly care for these mangoes...  They were rather tough, and tasted somewhat artificial.

Dried Mango doesn't only taste great but they are also rich with vitamins, minerals and anti-oxidants^advertised as a health food...If you're looking for the dried fruit qith the sugar added buy this.If not this is not the place to go.

We bought this product because it celarly stated that is was MADE IN THE USA.  When the product arrived, it was clearly labeled MADE IN CHINA.  This is beyond misleading - it is fraud.  I will not be purchasing Smokehouse products again.

I guess if you want to keep raking in the money you have to fudge and mislead folk.  That's what SmokeHouse has done by adding 'USA' to their name.  I can say this without fear because the packages I have sitting on the kitchen table in front of me clearly say that this is a "Product of China."You know, the China where they feel free to add melamine to products for human babies (2008), and dogs and cats (2007 and 2010) -- all so that the protein levels register higher than they normally would :(I am so disappointed.  Honestly, my little Jack-a-Bee puppy loves their products, but I won't be purchasing the Chicken Chips or Chicken Breast Strips again.  I can't imagine telling my children that the lively little pup they love was made sick (or died!) because of some cheap-*** short-cut.I'd rather pay more money and have it manufactured here in the States.Pam T~mom/blogger/dog lover

I bought these chicken treats after receiving several articles about dogs getting sick from other chicken breast treats that we're made in China.  I bought these specifically because they were made in the USA and I assumed they would be safe.  They were so hard I could barely break them and my dog wasn't chewing them well.  He started choking on a piece while eating it and that was the end of that.  These are terrible and dangerous.  The pieces are so sharp I became concerned about him cutting an intestine or something.  Now I make my own chicken treats.  It's pretty easy and I know exactly what is in them.

column9: Made In America, with a STRING going through them
column10: I bought these because they are made in America and my dogs are worth it.  What I don't like about them is that there is a thick string, or maybe just a thick vain of some kind, going through each piece. A much smaller issues is that these are very hard, even hard to break by hand.  We have been using a pliers to break the pieces up before serving and then a scissors to cut the string part!  A dog could choke to death with these.My biggest problem is that I am looking for an alternative USA raised chicken solution for treats.

Have been buying this product for some time now - saw complaints about made in USA or not so I called the company. I spent about 30 minutes on the phone with a woman there who was weary of this complaint but very nice. I told her we love our pets, have learned to trust almost no one anymore and they were hurting themselves by selling products from China.As she explained,the confusion comes from the following: the "Made in USA" labeled chicken breast strips - what I have been using for my golden retriever puppy (who ABSOLUTELY loves them - really a healthy nutritious chew toy that lasts about 3 minutes - maybe 10 minutes for a little dog - when he sees it, he goes nuts - has never choked on them or had any negative effects I can see) is, as it says on the bag, Made in USA - they are processed in the USA and come from chicken raised in the USA.Smokehouse DOES sell another chicken product that does NOT say made in the USA on the package and this product DOES come from China.Buy whichever one you want.As to the complaints about not being able to cut them up easily - this IS absolutely true - so, if you want tiny bits of treat to use for reward based training, this is definitely NOT the product you want. I use other natural treats for this purpose (Merricks lamb lung is terrific for this use and my dog loves this product just as well - a one pound bag goes a long way - very easy to break up in whatever sizes you want in seconds)Finally, this product (chicken breast strips) has ONE ingredient: chicken. It is made in the USA from chicken grown in the USA. Because it is dried, it lasts forever, does not need refrigeration, makes no mess when fed to your dog, dogs love it - what else do you want for a treat?

My two medium size dogs love these treats and the thickness is great for their teeth.  lt is also very UNTRUE for any review to state this product in not made in the USA. It absolutley states that very clearly on the packaging and I have also verified this with the manufacturer.  No made in China here.

I bought the product because it was made in the USA.  I have 2 small dogs and was used to breaking them up and giving them pieces as the breast strips are too large for their mouths. These are so hard, neither my husband or myself can break them up.  Will not order again.  Amazon verified purchase.

column9: Crap- So hard couldnt cut with a meat clever
column10: I have little yorkies so I generally take products like this and cut into smaller portions.  This stuff was so hard if you tried to snap in half it crumbles away a big portion of the piece.I finally put it on a cutting board and when I tried to cut with a meat clever I got scared the knife was gonna slip sideways.  The pieces still crumbled.  I mean we are talking serious dry.This product is touted as quality and american.  This product is much more expensive yet is the worst I've ever purchased.  It is like it was outdated.Do not buy this product.  It is poor value

We have three dogs and I try to find healthy treats from the USA. Smokehouse also has chicken strips from China that are much cheaper but I'd rather give them less treats from the US than spend less and give them more treats from China. These are pricey but the dogs all love them.

If your dog is the kind with a cast iron gut who chows down on road kill with nary a problem and you have an extremely limited budget, this may not be the treat for your dog. For my own case, I have a Border Collie with a sensitive stomach and my budget for dog treats is modest. These are a great treat made here in the USA as the previous reviewer noted, avoiding the potential problems of Chinese made goods making the news recently. Feeding one of these 2-3 times per week gets that excited, eyes bugging out, reaction one would expect from a treat while providing an all natural, high protein component to your dogs diet, while remaining very affordable. As with any treat, overindulgence can upset the proper balance of your dogs diet, but even 2-3 in one day have not upset my dogs gut. In my opinion, this is almost as good as cooking for your dog yourself.

Just to clarify, Smokehouse makes these in the US and also in China.  The ones made in China will cost less than the ones made in the US. The ones made in the US clearly states it on the front of the bag.  For those of you that got bags from China, you should check to make sure you ordered the right bag and if so, return it for a refund if they mistakenly sent you the wrong bag. These treats are great. All natural, so they're healthy.

column9: Smokehouse delivers great product - not all from USA
column10: We're very happy with the Smokehouse products we've ordered. The quality is top-notch. The Natural Chicken Breast Strips are our dog's favorite. He devours them. He gets a little gassy, sometimes, from them but overall he responds well to the treats.Warning: Not all Smokehouse products are made in the USA. We've found that they are clearly labeled. Generally, if they do not say USA in their main product description you can assume they come from China. We have made the mistake of ordering products made in China, and found that to be our mistake and not the manufacturer's.We have no affiliation with the company.

Very fast delivery, sealed properly keeping chicken very fresh. Not easy finding this product made in USA, scared to buy same product from China heard of many problems, my dog is loving this and I know it's safe

My two papillons get one of these each evening after their walk, and they love them! I'm very vigilant about not buying any food products made in China, and was thrilled when I found these. You can't find the Made In the USA strips in any of the pet stores I've visited, so I regularly order these on line. Great product!

They look just like chicken tenderloins.  I say that because in my heart of hearts I sometimes wonder if our dog treats really come from the animals they say they do?  They call it chicken so that we, the consumers are happy to buy them because we eat chicken too, but what if they said they came from some other kind of avian source?  Anyways, I digress.  My dogs love these, they have no digestion issues from them whatsoever.  I would only feed them, at most, 1 per day.  It is a good value to buy them in the big bag, the smaller bags cost more at my local pet store.

column9: Very happy with "Made in the USA"
column10: I ordered these chicken strips because they were Made in the US. After having  a friend lose two dogs to the contaminated dog food from China I made the decision to not purchase anything for my Shih Tzu that is made in China. She is too precious to give her anything that is made there. The item is a little pricey but well worth it for the health and well being of my pet.

column9: If you want your dog to die.....
column10: These brittle treats ulcerated my Rat Terrier's gastrointestinal tract. The bill for the surgery is over $2100. You've been warned!

column9: Treat caused ulcers in my dog's GI tract
column10: I should have known when I touched these strips.They are rock solid hard.Anyways I gave it to my dog for the first time, and it caused minor tearing and ulcers in her GI tract. I first noticed little blood in her stool, and dog was visibly unwell.I brought her to the vet immediately before they closed for the day, and did xrays, stool test, and all that.Ended up with a $1600 vet bill, but at least a recovering dog that shouldn't have any long term health problems.The treat basically was so hard the sharp edges was causing minor tearing the GI tract. My dog is a chewer too and she never swallows anything whole, and I was watching her as she ate.I had given her bully sticks, raw hide before (about once or twice a week), and she had no problems.It couldn't have been anything else either because she hasn't eaten anything else other than her dog food (Ziwipeak) in the past 3 days. Ziwipeak isn't a kibble diet either. It is jerky like meat which is very soft. No signs of anything else (like plastic or metal toys, etc) on her x-ray either. So yes, it is these Chickenstrips.Anyhow, I took a new one out of the packaging, and attempted to cut it with a pair of scissors.The strip was so hard my scissors wouldn't cut through, especially where the vein/tendon/muscle fiber (or whatever that is) is.I probably will need a penknife or a small saw to do the job.So yea I learned my lesson, and should have listened to what another reviewer said earlier.I took my chances because this product had so many 5 star feedback, and I made my dog go through unnecessary and avoidable pains and hardship. And also landed myself with a $1600 vet bill (sigh...)Definitely wouldn't advice this to anyone. If you have a really big dog like a Mastiff or a Pit Bull, I can see how this is probably OK because the dog itself is big, so this treat is really small compared in size. I have a 10 pound dog, so yea. I still wouldn't recommend anyone risking any chances, well unless you think a few thousand dollars in vet bills is nothing and don't mind your dog going through all that pain.From now on if I am giving any chicken treats, its gonna be freezed dried or I will just boil or steam some boneless chicken myself.Lesson learned. An expensive, painful, and totally avoidable one.I am so regretful for what I have done to my dog -_-

I bought the smokehouse chicken breast strips because they were made in the U.S.A. They are so hard, my dog cannot chew them, and if I break them (which is hard to do), I am afraid she will choke on them. There are not very many "strips", mostly pieces.  It is a wasted $22.99, as I will not give them to her. How can you sell something so dangerous.

column9: My dogs love this MADE IN USA treat!!
column10: Contrary to some reviews, my packages all say made in USA,with USDA inspected chicken.  My dogs love these treats,couldnt get along without them!
Love that its made in the USAFirst bag arrived and chicken was dried and crumbly.Replacement bag arrived and was better but still dried out.

Apparently my yorkie is addicted to these dog treats. She's a very picky little dog. If one of these treats was near she would literally turn her head when offered anything else. If offered again, she would back away and wait until this treat was offered instead. We've worked through that, but she is still controlled by these treats. She will do anything and perform any command as if her life depended on it if she can only have these treats!The positives: She really loves them, above all other treats. They're made in the USA.The negative: I think they're too pricey for dog treats.I'm thinking of using the food dehydrator to whip up some chicken jerky instead. Perhaps she will like that as much. Until then, this is the treat of choice.
I have not met a dog yet that does not love these treats.  I quit buying anything else.

I love ordering from Amazon...my orders arrive fast and well packed.However, the Smokehouse 100% Natural Chicken Breast strips were supposed to be made in the USA.  I paid more for them because I was afraid to buy any more that were made in China.  My dog has been so sick on them.  I even gave him a small piece and everyday he would throw it up.  He never did that with the Milo's Kitchen or Wagon Train which ARE made in China. Also, they are supposed to be lean, but have fat pieces on them that I scrape off.  I don't know what's wrong!!!!

column9: Dog likes them, but they are very DRY and HARD
column10: My Yorkie seems to like these, but they are much harder and drier than other chicken treats that I have purchased. When you go to break them into smaller pieces they crumble.

Our three Shih Tzu dogs love these treats.  If you even rattle the bag they come running from the other room to eat these.  And best of all ..... MADE IN USA.  I DO NOT feed my dogs MADE IN CHINA products.
These are great treats and my schnauzer LOVES them! However, just make sure they are made in the USA and not China!  The extra cost is worth it if you love and care about the health of your animal.

One of my favorite blends made by Twinings.  I don't know what happened to Jacosta's batch, that's not what I get when I make this stuff.  I just ran out and I'm getting a couple more to last me for a while.  4 min brew w/ some milk and a little sugar (< 1 tsp) is the sweet spot for me.

Prince of Wales tea is my Favorite Tea of all time.  It is a blend of China Keemun and just a dash of Lapsang Souchong.  The Keemun is a lovely smooth tasting tea, and the Lapsang Souchong adds just a hint of smoky flavor.  I drink it all the time.  I would recommend Prince of Wales to anyone who enjoys a Good cup of hot tea.The only thing I would change is that I could purchse it in a larger container.

column9: Great Product Regardless of Whatever Party you like
column10: This tea has wonderful blend of Chinese Black Teas which deliver wonderfully pleasant punch to the tastebuds.

column9: Not to my taste, I much prefer the Earl Grey or Irish blend
column10: I ordered this tea while purchasing my usual order of Earl Grey & Irish blend. Because I enjoy the others so much, I thought this may be a great discovery.  For me it was not.  It smells like horse hay & tastes (to me) like I would imagine barn shavings would, were I to collect them & steeped them in a tea ball.  I gave it all away (I bought 6 cans in bulk!!)
We buy this chocolate because doesn't have soy and it's organic. Plus it's vegan, and very tasty! My hubby loves it too. Yay :)

Dark Chocolate with Mint flavor is one of my favorite combinations. This product has a few things on top of that in its favor: organic, and 70% dark.The organic specification is important to me. It's one way we can "vote" with our pocketbook to help reverse the trend towards highly-mechanized, profit-driven food production.70% dark means that this is food, not candy. The sugar is kept to a minimum, so that this can qualify as something that will not harm your health.How is the taste? It's quite good. The dark flavor and mint are balanced well. I'm not sure it's the best mint chocolate I've ever had...I would have preferred a bit stronger mint, but I tend to like strong flavors. All in all I'm very pleased with it and the case-lot price was decent for this class of product. I would buy it again.

I don't know if the order I received was outdated or what but the chocolate was extremely bland and low quality. The slight mint taste of the chocolate resembled toothpaste so that was not appetizing either. I do not recommend this product at all.

Since I found out I am diabetic or at least pre-diabetic I have gone very low carb.  I have become much more conscientious about not eating things that might be bad for my health.  I like it that this chocolate does not contain soy, since I'm trying to stay off of it knowing it negatively  affects my mood in larger amounts.  It's hard to avoid soy, since it's in so many foods.  I haven't found another chocolate bar that doesn't contain soy.  Since this is dark chocolate it has little enough sugar that I can savor it in small amounts.  It is heavenly!  I didn't used to care for dark chocolate that much, but I think part of the reason I like this chocolate so much is that the hint of mint offsets any bitterness.  It seems to make it taste a little sweeter than it actually is.  I like to support fair trade and agricultural practices that work with, instead of against the environment.
This is a delicious dark chocolate mint bar.  It's well balanced, not too sweet, and powerfully chocolatey.
I bought this from the local health food shoppe, but the mint flavoring tasted kind of chemical like so I threw it out. :(

My little West Highland is such a princess. With this attitude comes one finicky eater.  She refuses to eat most kibble, and I have tried many, many brands.  But, since I've discovered Etta's Liver Sprinkles, my pup has become a champion of almost anything that's in her bowl.  With only a few shakes of the bottle, what was once so unappealing to my dog, Bugee, is now by all appearances, YUMMY. I use just three (3) shakes of the liver sprinkles on top of her kibble, and I have one happy pup who can't wait to get to her food.Paula Honey Meisner

column9: Kibbles n Bits is the only food our 4 dogs will eat.
column10: We have 4 dogs, 2 Bichon Frise(Peanut and Curley aka "The Boys") and we rescued 2 Yorkshire Terrier's (Cha-cha and Haley aka "The Girls").  We have tried other dog foods and always end up coming back to Kibbles n Bits.  We purchase the mini bites because the Girls have such small mouth it is difficult for them to eat large pieces.  We are getting it through the Subscribe and Save.
This is one of the worst products I have ever tasted. Wish I could get my money back. Don't waste your money on this.

I was a bit disappointed when I pulled the energizer out of the packaging and some of the on bottle instructions were covered with UPC labels that were added pre-shipping. Besides that, works great, but you will need to find detail usage instructions online.

column9: best beans for the buck you will find
column10: Very happy with this coffee. mellow, and rich, organic and fair trade, what more can you ask for? Oh yeah, what a great deal! THanks

I purchased this product on the off chance that zero reviews but first page listing on the "bestselling" decaf whole bean page meant that it was decent coffee.  I was wrong.First, the bag looked like it had been on a shelf for several years.  The plastic was severely scuffed and the label was very worn, as if it had been shifted around in a bin for a very long amount of time.  There was no roasting date or expiration date, so it's impossible to ascertain how old the beans really are.  Isn't that illegal these days?Secondly, the beans have almost no smell and are not even slightly oily.  Compared to a really good bean, such as the Java Trading Company's Espresso Jet City, these are an utter failure.  Even when finely ground, these Organic Camano Island Peru Decaf. have almost no aroma, and what little they do have is not appealing.  It literally smells like caked dirt, not like coffee should smell.  Sure, it's dark roasted, but even the inside of the bag is suspiciously missing even a hint of the oils prevalent on top quality beans.Lastly, when brewed in either a pump espresso maker, a French press, or a drip coffee machine, the brew's complete lack of crema, body, or aroma is the final nail in the coffin.  Starbucks is better than this stuff.  This Camano Islands Peru Decaf isn't just slightly bad; it isn't even worthy of being placed in a Folger's can.Please look elsewhere for a good decaf organic bean, and don't make the same mistake I did.

I tried it for the first time Saturday at my local Sams. They had tons of the stuff for under $5, I'm going back tonight and load up on this stuff . It seems that Sams is the only place that sell this stuff.

Originally I stumbled across this product at Sam's Club it was on closeout and I decided to try it because the price was right.  I had it for while before I decided to taste it. I am a big fan of the drink fuzzy navels, however I do not drink alcohol anymore.  Well let me tell you, if you take Orchard Peach and just add a little to orange juice over ice it is better then any fuzzy navel I have ever had and it is so delicious.After searching and searching for this product I finally found it and it is still a wonderful product.  Without a doubt I will be ordering lots more of the Orchard Peach.  Please do not blame me when you pour it over orange juice and you become hooked too.

I tried this at Sam's Club today and it was amazing. Very refreshing and all you have to do is blend it with ice! We bought it for about $15 and I feel that it is well worth it. Can't wait to try the other flavors!
I to brought at Sam Club for 4.98. You think a fuzzy navel is good use frozen fruit you dont need ice it thick but smooth, Just try it you  will love it.

I buy this same product (same size) at Sam's Club for $4.98/bottle.  I pour just a small amount (1/2 oz?) into the bottom of my 16-oz. tea glass then fill it up with brewed plain unsweetened tea from the pitcher in the refrigerator.  It's GREAT!  And keeps you from having to add sugar to the tea (of course, this syrup has plenty of sugar).  Also good with iced water to make a cool peach drink, and I'm going to try the virgin fuzzy navel someone else mentioned by adding it to my fresh-squeezed orange juice tomorrow morning.  I guess if you don't have a Sam's Club the $11 price here isn't awful since a few 32 oz. bottles would be a pretty bulky shipment, and you're getting free shipping.

This is the best smoothie mix I have ever tried.  We use our plain ole blender  and sometimes add a little fresh fruit with ice.  The children love this  as a refresher when they are outside playing.  Some adults have suggested that it can be made into a delicious alcoholic drink.  I have not tried that. You purchase this and you will not be disappointed.

I was trying to figure out where I may have purchased this smoothie mix and just cannot remember.  So I decided to go to the trusty Amazon.com.  You can find most anything here.The Smoothie mix itself is phenomenal.  Very good taste for peach lovers.  Just add ice, pour, blend, and enjoy.  That's IT!  Zero effort required.  It can be sweet if you add too much mixture, so follow the directions and all should be well.  The only gripe that I have is I'm SURE 100% SURE that I did not pay $18.00 for this mix as this seller is advertising it.  So if you can find it in your local supermarket, purchase it there.  This is just too expensive. ENJOY!

column9: great product,  but this is too expensive!
column10: I love these, great for travel.My son loves them. Target has these for $0.89 each! Buy them there instead.

column9: Delicious and most versatile snack ever!
column10: When I first saw this product, I thought "yeah right, my daughter would never go for this". I thought the texture would be funny and I thought that the spinach taste would probably be overpowering. Boy was I wrong! My 2 year old song inhaled it. My daughter wasn't too sure about the texture at first but then it grew on her. I tried it myself and it was delicious! I also love that you can just grab it and go. I have some in my trunk's "emergency kit", in case the kids get hungry and don't have a snack. I just throw one in my daughter's lunchbox and I'm done as far as her recess snack. Here's what I love most about it though, you can use this puree as a dipping sauce for pancakes or waffles. You can add it to the egg coating for french toast, you can use it instead of jelly in their pb&j sandwiches, you can add it to chocolate milk and blend it. I've even made chocolate frozen pops by combining this with chocolate milk and freezing it. So any product that will make my children eat spinach, is good in my book. It is AWESOME!!!!! I recommend it to all my mom friends.

My daughter loves these, and I love that she views these as a treat... she begs for them! With protein, vitamin C, and 10% of her daily calcium, you just can't beat it as a snack, treat, or whatever! But seriously... this price is off the charts!!! Please for the love of humanity, buy these elsewhere!

column9: Great tasting and healthy for baby!
column10: I started feeding this to my 9-month-old son and he LOVED it. Happy to know this is healthy AND organic, too!
I love the Salba and hidden veggie.  It is easy to eat and a much better flavor than the other pouches that are on the market.  HappyBaby pouches are by far the best out there

I love these Happy Baby/Tot foods for a couple reasons. 1) the diversity of foods they offer (Spinach/mango/pear - where else will you find that?) 2) the convenience of the pouch and 3) My baby gulps these down - he loves them. Only drawback is that at this time the pouch is not recyclable. Oh and they can be a bit pricey.
These are great for the car. I have to admit it took several tries for my son to eat it, but now he loves them. I think it's getting a kid used the not too sweet taste of fruits AND veggies.
I returned this because it doesn't really have any flavor.  Only a hint of butterscotch.  I keep pouring more and more in my coffee and still couldn't take butterscotch.

I used to live in Atlanta and one of my favorite places to visit was the Dekalb Farmers Market.  I would get this rice there.  I know you can get it other places, but I now live in a small, rural town and the internet is my salvation in terms of still being able to get products I like that aren't available here.  Love this rice.
Although a little pricey, this stuff was worth it, because ut's delicious!!! Even my 16 year old son, who wouldn't eat brown rice before, is sold!

This rice tastes great. The price is right, and you get a good taste with great texture. We ate it all in just a few months (we're voracious rice eaters, I guess!) and I'll be ordering some more once I get through some other rice I have.TIPS:- Although it fills my house with a delicious smell or cooking rice, it doesn't have a jasmine fragrance or taste. No biggie if you're looking for a regular brown rice, but might not be your best bet if you're hoping for a strong jasmine taste. This could have been just my bag, so I'd be curious to see others' experiences.- Make sure to rinse and drain your rice. This removes some starch, especially on brown rices, and may slightly reduce cook times.- I cook my rice in a Zojorushi rice maker, and always cook brown rice with less water than the markings on the machine. I use the same rule for this brown rice as for other browns - I pour in the drained rice first, then fill it up to just below the fill line for white rice.
I accept that 'natural' product may vary from can to can, but these swung madly. Went through a few pricy cases, then moved on.

Have ordered this a couple of times now from Amazon.  Order comes quickly, is packaged well, and the food is the best made.  I feed my all of my cats Felidae, and the 15 and 16 year old cats get the canned Felidae Platinum.  They love it and stay healthy on it.  I can't recommend it enough.

Wow! I cant beleive this find. Whole wheat gnocchi with sweat potato.  what a great combination. Cooks fast, can add white sauce, red sauce or plain with a spinkle of vegan parmasean cheese.  The price is great for a case.  Free shipping cant beat that.

column9: Very Tasty, But Not What I Expected
column10: This product is very good, but my wife and I agreed that it was impossible to tell you were eating sweet potatoes, rather than regular potatoes.  I expected the flavor to be distinguishable.  Oh well.  The only other caution is to not overcook this product.  It will start to get mushy.  That may be characteristic of any gnochhi, but I thought I would include this point as well.

column9: easy great gnocchi, just needs sauce!
column10: Makes for a quick, easy meal.  Wasn't sure what sauce to use so I grabbed sage and tomatoes from the garden and made a butter/sage sauce with cherry tomatoes.  Took other's advice and didn't overcook the gnocchi and it turned out quite tasty, all in under 5 minutes.  My husband licked the bowl and we'd both recommend it for an easy entree.  Definitely cannot tell the sweet potato is there though, so if you are looking for sweet potato flavor, look elsewhere.

column9: You cannot go wrong with these delicious gnocchi!
column10: Just arrived and tried with one of my favorite pasta sauce recipes (vodka sauce) last night: a delight! I heartily recommend these and while I am not the greatest cook, I lived in Italy for almost 5 years and know the good stuff. This is great!

I bought these at a retail store because I try to eat as healthy as I can.  The combination of whole wheat and sweet potato sounded irresistible.  I cooked about half of the pack and I did not like them much when I first ate them.  I could detect no sweet potato taste and they were a bit mushy...I guess I overcooked them.  They are quite flavorless too.  So, I added a littled salt to the water when I cooked the rest of them and cooked them a little less...added some spaghetti sauce and parmesan cheese.  Delicious!  When these are cooked properly and doctored up with some extras they are absolutely scrumptious little dumplings.  If you plan to eat them plain, prepare to be disappointed.

These are some of the best.  They cook quickly and I love that they use whole grain.  This is a staple in my kitchen.  I think it is healthier than regular pasta because of the sweet potatoes.  It works with tomato sauce, pesto, or even just olive oil and herbs.  Good food!

Usually I reserve my reviews for books and the like but I feel compelled to share my love of these delicious gnocchi! I cannot say enough good things about them so I will say one bad-there are not enough of them in the package! Ha ha! I often make them for a quick and delicious dinner for the two of us. They take on many sauce types well and cook in 2-3 minutes. My fave sauces are red pureed kuri squash (from Dreena Burton) and olive oil with garlic and peas and variations therefrom depending on what is on hand. What more could one want? Except more of those luscious sweet potato and whole wheat lovelies???

Packaged gnocchi, including this one, are great, but only if you prepare them correctly.Use a large skilled. Arrange the gnocchi in a single layer in the pan.  Add just enough water to cover.  Heat on medium until water boils; immediately reduce to simmer; test for tenderness with the tip of a knife after 2 to 3 min.  Gnocchi will absorb water and increase in size.  As soon as they are tender, remove from heat and drain in collander.  Return to pan and add sauce, seasonings, and grated cheese if desired.  Just heat through, then serve.

For those who aren't familiar with gnocchi, as I wasn't, don't expect a sweet potato taste.  This is pretty disappointing, but I'm giving the product three stars because there was no problem with freshness or air-tightness, as some negative comments indicate, and I plan to follow up this tentative review when I figure out the best way to prepare this product.  I like the health benefits of a sweet-potato/whole-wheat combination, and now that I have six packages of these things, I can experiment with different recipes.  The consistency is like a dumpling, but the taste is pretty bland.  Of course, the taste of any pasta without sauce is going to be bland, so the problem is to figure out the best combination of sauce, spices, vegetables, whatever, to add.  I anticipate chopping the gnocchi into smaller pieces to garnish a dish with a different main ingredient. (?) Any suggestions out there from real chefs?Addendum:  It looks like most of the internet recipes for recommended gnocchi sauce are pretty traditional pasta sauces:  tomato, cheese, etc.  My instinct is that some of the hardier sauces, for instance those that include meat or sausage in particular, might be the best bet.  My own thinking is that stews or thick soups might benefit from adding gnocchi.  I don't think, preliminarily, I'm going to develop a taste for gnocchi if it's too naked.  I also wonder how much tastier they would be if I simply made them myself.  I'll report back if I find anything that works (at least for me)!

I've recently discovered a recipe for crispy gnocchi with pesto and tomatoes. Oh my it is good! The gnocchi is $3-4 at the store, and Amazon can beat that price, especially with Subscribe and Save. And they carry my favorite - sweet potato! As long as Amazon's prices are cheaper, I'll do my grocery shopping from home in my pj's.

We love these Gnocchi's. I always try to purchase whole wheat pasta's or brown rice. When I found these I was elated. After tasting them... if one could be happier... I was. They cook in no time at all... three minutes. The sauce needs to have some zing as they do not have much flavor on their own. I make a spicy sauce with cayenne, hot pepper seeds, tomato sauce, and creamy goat cheese. Dinner can be prepared and ready to be eaten in 10-15 minutes. The best "fast food" that you are going to find.
Kinda hooked on 'em.  I don't boil but simmer in Olive Oil, add seasonings to taste also a bit of chicken stock.  Will be reordering.

This only cooks for 2-3 minutes, so it comes in handy for a quick meal. But we do have to keep it stored in the refrigerator. It goes well with all kinds of sauces. I'm glad that it's on subscribe & save at last.
These cook so fast and are perfect everytime.  They taste great and their texture is just what it should be.
After having tried unsuccessfully to make my own gnocchi, I bit the bullet and bought these. I am so glad I did- the taste is wonderful and the storage is great as well.

We have purchased Gia Russa Whole Wheat Gnocchi in many variations. The sweet potato pack has a slight taste of sweet potatoes. They're a healthy way to get your carbs for the day and cook in minutes.

Two of the six packages were beginning to mold, but not even close to the expiration date.  One other package was visibly torn.  I was curious to see if any of the packs were still sealed air-tight, so I placed them in water. Five of the packs were exposed to air with small opening around the seal.  I imagine that they burst somewhere in their travels from changes in altitude/pressure.  I cannot vouch for the actually taste of the product as I did not eat them.  The silver lining: Amazon has GREAT customer service.

These gnocchi are yummy and they have 3 or 4 grams of each protein and fiber.  Sometimes I can taste the "wheatiness" a bit, but it doesn't really bother me that much.  I boil mine, then douse them in olive oil, garlic, red pepper flakes, S&P, and parmesan.  Very quick, easy, and fairly healthy meal.

I bought this on a whim because we are trying to eat a more balanced healthy diet and it far surpassed my expectations. Make sure not to overcook it, 2 minutes in boiling water should do the trick. I made a sauce in the food processor with spinach, toasted pecans, one garlic clove and olive oil and tossed it with the gnocchi. My husband who hates whole wheat pasta gobbled it up!
My family loves this product.  I make it many different ways both as entree or side dish.  Buying six pack is helpful as I always have it on hand for quick meal.

I love this gnocchi.  I'm not a big fan of sweet potatoes, but I'm trying to eat healthier.  I figured I would try it and I thought it was delicious. I added a little marinara and it was perfect. I will definitely buy this on a regular basis. I agree with some of the other comments that it does not have a strong sweet potato flavor, but that's probably why I liked it so much.

I really liked these gnocchi, they were delicious Though it's true what the other reviews said about not a strong sweet potato flavor. So I microwaved a sweet potato and addded it to the gnocchi. It made a nice meal. I gave a couple of packages to friends and they liked the taste as well. You just have to not overcook. I bought the Gia Russo whole wheat spaghetti and liked that as well. I am now going to order Gia Russo mini gnocchi.

I was very excited to find this product...and very disappointed when I ate it! I didn't taste any sweet potato at all. The whole wheat flour taste (which I am very familiar with & use almost exclusively) came through in a very strong way.
This item was both delicious and good for your health.  Easy to prepare and serve at a moments notice. The sweet potato filling is great.
This was really good. I had it with just parmesan and butter and it was great! Just make sure you cook it the proper time or it will be gummy.

column9: Wow!  Whole wheat that tastes better than the original!
column10: This stuff is amazing.  It's my new favorite gnocchi.  I usually just serve it with a touch of pesto.
I absolutely love this gnocci.  I find the texture and flavor to be better than regular gnocci.  I will definitely be purchasing this again!
Save your money. Even with a sauce I thought I was eating a dough ball. Zero Stars, Zero Flavor.

More than 1 month in time and have never received this order despite having shipped supposedly on 12/28/2009. No update on tracking provided. For the second time in the last two months, I will have to follow up on an Amazon order. Not worth the trouble in the future.
I have a family secret homade mustard recipe.  The price of this mustard compared to the store saved me lots of money and I can make many gifts for the families.

Growing up in England I have always used Coleman's powder but now the price has skyrocketed so I gave this McCormick a try.  It isn't quite as good but certainly nice and hot with a good bite. We use a lot so I am well pleased with my purchase.

We use this vanilla bean paste in a graham cracker recipe and we couldn't be happier. I love the fact that you can see the seeds; it adds a very "natural" look.The product stores very well and I like the fact that you use it the same way you would regular vanilla.

I have never used vanilla bean paste so I wasn't sure what to expect.  This was an excellent purchase! I have made some very delicious cupcakes and am very glad I have this in my baking pantry for future use!
My son is a chef in the making and this will be a great addition to his ingredients list.  He will enjoy this.
Got this biscuit mix and it is really good.  My family thinks it's much better than other box mixes we have tried.  I highly recommend.

I've been making my homemade gelato for years and I seek out their purees for most of my flavors, they are rich, smooth, and the fruits are picked at the very best ripeness point.  I highly recommend.

I'm a bit of a coffee snob and I have to agree with a leading consumer magazine about this coffee. It's good fresh tasting coffee without any faults and without the slightly burned flavor of the leading latte shops. You can pay a lot more but in my opinion you won't find anything better for the price. You really can't go wrong with it.

I've tried many brands of coffee over the years and I have found this to be one of my favorites. It tastes better than many of the expensive brands I've tried. Whenever I serve this to guests they always love it and ask what kind of coffee I use. I prefer buying the whole bean variety because I like to grind my own coffee beans right before I brew a pot. I get a more flavorful cup of coffee that way.

I have been drinking this coffee for more than 20 years.  It is a consistently roasted and good quality Columbian coffee. The value is excellent as it tastes rich but not bitter, slightly acidic - but a typical arabica Columbian coffee. I prefer Seattle's Best balanced blends but they are more expensive and harder to find. 8 o'clock coffee is available, less expensive, and always a pleasant taste & finish. Generally, I grind whole beans and brew in a french press. Drip brewers and 8 o'clock coffees work fine too. Most of the other 8 o'clock blends are good quality and consistent. They are a better choice than the canned brands, in my opinion.

These Colombian coffee beans used to be a good everyday/nothing fancy coffee.  I've bought them 2 times in the last 6 months (& many times in the past years); they are not as good as they used to be.  They claim the beans are the same even though the packaging changed but I don't believe it.  The beans are now more bitter & have less flavor.  I also found more quakers (underdeveloped coffee beans that make coffee taste awful - they stick out because they do not roast/darken properly).  That's a good test of coffee beans:  empty the bag on a cookie sheet & see how many quakers you find.  A few is "acceptable" but more than 10 is pretty bad in my opinion.  My most recent bag had 9.I've stopped buying this coffee.  Having a good cup of coffee in the morning is one of life's little pleasures for me & so it's worth paying more for good coffee.  So far, I've bought these 3 coffees from Amazon & they are excellent:Kicking Horse Coffee Kick Ass Dark, Whole Bean Coffee, 2.2-Pound PouchWeaver's Coffee and Tea, French Roast Organic Whole Bean Coffee, 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 2)Cameron's Organic French Roast Whole Bean Coffee, 32-Ounce Bag

column9: unbeatable price, quality of product OK
column10: I bought this item at the grocery store a week before I bought this package deal expecting the exact same product, but at lower price.  The seal for these packs of coffee was melted open so they were not air tight.  It could of happened in transport but the beans were much drier than the coffee I bought from the grocery store.The beans from the grocery were much darker and shiny.  These are dry and lighter because of the broken seal.  I payed about 6 dollars at the store which would of made this deal 24 dollars total instead of 19.Against my better judgement, I've been drinking this coffee for the past week.  The coffee is fine and it's hard to tell the difference but I swear it is less flavorful than the product from the grocery store.

When I opened the package I realised that the coffee was a bit stale, and did not have alot of aroma. After I brewed my coffee it was ok tasting. Better than any off the shelf cheap coffee but nothing too exciting. In this case it's a good deal for the price, but I would rather pay more for aroma and great tasting coffee.

I was looking for a weekday bean so I could drink something decent while on-the-go and differentiate from my high quality weekend coffee. This option was less expensive and had great reviews on Amazon but this coffee is gross and not good, people! Honestly, Folgers is better tasting and less bitter. I grind my beans for each pot so I worked a little with each pot and zero change, still bitter/acidic and with a slightly bad aftertaste--this IS better than Dunkin Donuts brand take home beans. So, my hunt goes on for an inexpensive weekday coffee. Until I find something, I'll stick with my Alakef brand weekend brew all week long!Good: Price, free home delivery with PrimeBad: aftertaste

I am no coffee expert I must confess.  I have never had Blue Mtn Coffee or Hawaiian coffee, but I love this coffee.  I grind and make espresso and my wife and I drink it every morning.  I think that is the only reason she keeps me around.  Give it a try, its cheap and you can get it anywhere.  The packing looks old school (like it was designed by A&P in the 50's which it was), but the inside is good.

column9: Good Coffee.  Excellent Price.  But French Roast if Far Better
column10: While the Eight O'Clock Coffee Columbian Roast produced a decent brew, it is not nearly as good as the Eight O'Clock Coffee French Roast.  I was actually surprised by this because most of the Eight O'Clock Roasts are REALLY good.  This one happened to be standard - and a little disappointing.  I tried it because the price of the French Roast has gone sky high on Amazon over the last month or so.I do very much like the 11-ounce bags delivered in a package of four - as this keeps the coffee beans fresher in a vacuum sealed package for a longer period of time.  One disappointment though is that these coffee beans seem drier than they should be.  I like to open the bag to a fresh-smelling and looking roasted bean.  That was not the case with these beans.On the whole, the coffee was really good for excellent price, but definitely not what I expect from the Eight O'Clock label as I've experienced it with other roasts in the past.  I may have to switch back the French Roast (hopefully the price will go down again), or find another brand next time.

This coffee (in the bean format) has become hard to find at my local (Dallas area) supermarkets. Don't know why? Consumers Report had a "taste-off" some time ago and this was the winner - and I concur. I do grind my beans and like a 100% Columbian variety so this was ideal - until it started to disappear from store shelves. I've complained to no avail, so I've resorted to buying on the Internet. It stores well in a cool, dark place so it's unlikely that there will be any negative effect from buying four bags at a time. Anyway, for my tastes, this is the best that I've tried and believe me, I've tried a bunch when this coffee became difficult (and later impossible) to find.

This coffee was recommended by a leading consumer magazine.Based upon that I decidedto try it.I have not been disapointed.This coffee is really delicious;especially the unground beans.I'm a regular user now.
Have found this coffee just as good as the more expensive brands I had been buying

column9: Too Mild and a bit acid coffee
column10: I  hate acid coffee. So this coffee is not my favorite with it's a bit sour.The price is good.

column9: the foundation upon which to build the perfect cup of morning brew
column10: Ever since reading about Consumer Reports selection of 8 O'Clock Columbian (not their other offerings), me and my extended family have been delighted with this affordable performer. It is utterly mellow and caramelly. I'm a firm believer in grinding my beans right before use, using fresh, filtered not-quite-boiling water, stirring that beautiful mixture up in a stainless steel French press (better than constantly replacing broken glass decanters!), waiting about 3 minutes to steep, and then pressing and pouring that frothy love into a waiting mug. It's surely the only way to make it through this crazy days--starting off with a perfect, fortifying cup of 8 O'Clock Columbian. Sometimes, if I'm feeling the need for a little extra smokiness, I'll add just a tablespoon of French Roast beans to the mix (I prefer Peet's and their glistening, almost fishy-smelling charcoal-colored beans). But make no mistake, it's the 8 O'Clock Columbian that makes it work.

I lived in Sweden for about a year and became accustomed to their various high quality coffees as well as the concentration of their coffees.  Having thoroughly enjoyed the likes of Zoegas, Gevalia, Arvid Nordquist and so on; I have high standards.I came back to the US with 9 packages of coffee in hand knowing that they would soon run out.. and they did.  I tried many many brands but found nothing that I liked.  In Sweden the "scoop to water" ratio is much higher than in the US.  Unfortunately most coffee brands in the US taste even worse when you scale them to Swedish standards.This brand and flavor I have found does the best job in my opinion.  It's still a far stretch from the likes of Zoegas but it's far better than Starbucks etc..
I was really hoping that this would be decent, after reading the reviews.  It was not.  I will give my remaining bags of coffee away to someone who does not care.  It just lacked ...... flavor.
I decided to try this coffee after reading a review in Consumer Reports. I love this coffee. It has very intense flavour, without bitterness. I've subscribed to it to get it cheaper. It's great!
Have looked for a long time for great tasting coffee - finally found it.  Great balance. Great taste. Fresh!

I'm a dedicated fan of Eight O'Clock 100% Columbian coffee; I always have it in my pantry and enjoy it black. This is the coffee rated #1 by a major consumer product review organization and I can see why! It has a rich aroma, great taste and a smoothness which leaves no bitter after taste.The whole bean requires you to have access to a grinder which most of us probably have in some shape or variety. Those who are the real purists usually feel the whole bean is the best way to ensure freshness.Especially if you drink your coffee black, this is a fantastic choice that I have found to be totally satisfying; I encourage you to try it for yourself!

column9: Heavenly flavor if you put the right amount
column10: I bought this a month ago and I got to say ,I'm not an expert on coffee but this is one of the best I've had,but you really need to put the right amount of beans to achieve the greatest flavor ,the smell of this coffee is incredible,the taste stays with you throught the day and it really makes a difference in your day...I highly recommend this coffee to anyone who appreciates good coffee,and I really have to say I'm never going back to instant coffee,this is all I ever want.
I've been using Eight O'clock coffee for years. I think it's a great value coffee. This is the first time I've ordered it. And I am very Happy

We've been using Eight O'Clock 100% Colombian for decades. Occasionally we try another brand but we always come back to this one. We buy the whole bean because, control freaks that we are, we want the grind exactly to our own specifications. For a litle more than half the price of Starbucks, etc., we get a consistent, mellow brew with a wonderful after-taste and a positively yummy aroma.We buy ours at [...] (sorry, Amazon!) because they charge significantly less than the grocery stores do.

I've been drinking this coffee for almost a year, and it sure gets the job done.I'm not sure you could find coffee beans anywhere for this cheep, but if you are looking for a great full flavor I would spend a little more money.This 4-pack is the cheapest way to buy coffee beans that I have found, and the smaller packages mean that the beans stay fresh longer.

column9: whole beans without a hole in your wallet
column10: The bottom line on any coffee is your personal taste. I'm thankful that I enjoy the taste of these Eight O'Clock whole Colombian beans. To satisfy coffee lovers, as a whole, is akin to trying to get an answer from a group of economist. I like the flavor and aroma of these Colombian beans and that's the bottom line at any price.

Although I have been drinking coffee for years, I am a newbie at grinding my own coffee. Based on some better than average reviews and readings, I opted for Eight O'Clock coffee for my first coffee bean purchase. I ordered the 4-pack of 11 oz coffee and upon opening the box I noticed that one appeared to be vacuum packed and the other bags were not. Also, one of the bags was not sealed. So quality control appears to be an issue here. Now for the good stuff. When opening the first bag to use for my morning coffee, the wonderful aroma from the beans was very pleasant and inviting to the senses. The beans ground very well to my liking and my first cup was very balanced and smooth. So far I have used two bags of this coffee and have not been disappointed. I do think, however, that after reading more of the negative reviews I will experiment with other coffees for comparison purposes to find that "perfect" cup. Not that this coffee was lacking in taste because I did give it four stars, but being a newbie I realize there are many brands and varieties to choose from and I plan to sample many more.
Perfect way to get your coffee delivered!!! Fresh and my doorstep!!!! LOVE MY EOC whole bean botColombian and Italian Roast

column9: The King is Dead; Long Live the King
column10: We've been drinking coffee for some time - it's a demanded morning ritual, now.  My wife is an excellent cook with very discerning taste buds.  I use a highly rated Rancilio Silva coffee maker and Rancilio Rocky bean grinder to make the coffee.  And after much trial and error, I've learned how to make a great cup of coffee.Several years ago, we learned about the EIGHT O'CLOCK 100% Columbian Bean coffee and loved it!But, in the last year, it has changed from outstanding to "also ran" - the King is dead!Then, after much exploration, we've settled on GREEN MOUNTIAN COFFEE Mocha Java that cost about the same as the late, great 100% Columbian Bean - Long Live the King.

column9: I am an adult with GERD
column10: I recently ended up with GERD and a really bad bleeding ulcer, due to stress and grief.  I have problems keeping food down and went on a baby food diet for the sake of thriving. This also has a pleasant taste.  Some of the baby food is just bland and boring,  but this one is alright.  Not the best but still alright. Please be weary if you're having gastrointestinal problems.  Babyfood is such a great idea if you're having problems keeping things in,  and need to retrain your stomach and intestines.  Just be careful,  some are more acidic than others.By the way,  this doesn't have all the nutrients you would need to survive.  As a adult you'd need about 12-16 small jars a day and you'd need to make sure you get enough protein.  So be careful,  this is only a temporary fix for people with ulcers and GERD.

This sauce brings you right back to Thailand. I had gotten a case after my first jar and shared it with my friends. Everyone loves it. I'm a fan forever.
This sauce is so delicous! I was recently at a party, and they served this sauce as a dipping sauce with eggrolls. It was so tasty and the ingredients are all very high quality! I'm a big fan!

This sauce is incredible! I ordered both of the different sauces (peanut and satay) because of its all natural healthy ingredients. My boyfriend, (who happens to be thai) was hesitant to try it at first because he says he can never find a sauce that met his standards, UNTIL THIS!! One day I came home from work excited to have it over some fried tofu and vegetables, to find that HE HAD EATEN THE ENTIRE THING!! We are both truly loyal customers now - we absolutely love this sauce, it is great on salads, with meats, vegetables or tofu - it really adds an addictive flavor to any dish. Also, the shipping is fast and reliable, and I have found that the price is well worth-it compared to what else is out there (especially with the free shipping that is offered). I'm what you would call a coffee snob.  I do not like starbucks and I don't like store bought coffee also.  I prefer a good columbian, or kona.  This half calf from green mountain is a good all around coffee.  Not real strong, not too weak, has a nice smooth taste and no after taste.  Try it, you will be pleasantly surprised.
Compares to "Folgers", this is my husband's absolute favorite! Great when you don't want a flavored coffee or a strong blend...very rich but mild flavor.

I like the product, but at nearly [...] bucks per 24 pack it is way overpriced. I would buy it again if it was priced at about 40% less.  I do like it for an afternoon boost, but in the mornings I need full strength rocket fuel.
This makes an excellent cup of coffee.  My family really enjoys it.  Both of us are typically sensitive to caffeine, yet this brew is wonderful without the caffeine effects.

This coffee was very pleasant tasting and I would order it again.Has a good taste and if you have to watch your caffine like me, you would like this coffee.I will be ordering more and like the taste very much and would recommend this to anyone.
This is for someone who wants all the flavor without all the caffeine.  I thought it was great!  Would definitely recommend.

So, I now can save shipping, handling, tax and can always find them on sale.  :)

Out of all the Keurig coffees, the Half-Calf is our favorite from Green Mountain.  Ordering it online through Amazon.Com is fast and efficient.  I have it delivered within a week and the price is right!!
Good product with an excellent taste. Why so expensive over all the other brands and types available?
I recently tried the Half-Caff and loved it. Even within hours before bedtime, I have no problem falling a sleep. Coffee has a really great taste too as I am not a fan of decaff coffees.

I was born and raised in Philadelphia. I have tasted only one version of Snapper soup that was better. That was a frozen version produced by Campbell Soups during the 1960s. Having said that, Bookbinders' Snapper Soup is the best-tasting Snapper now available. The label instructs you to cut the contents with one-half can of water; I prefer to open two cans and warm the contents straight. The result is rich and thick with a flavourable base, filled with turtle meat, cooked egg white, and just the right mix of seasonings. Probably the best snapper soup on the market.

I am writing this after having eaten this soup for lunch.  Something has gone terribly wrong here.  I have enjoyed this soup quite frequently in the past.  Until fairly recently, this soup has been consistently good.  The taste was correct, just the right amount of sherry, and enough turtle to  satisfy my normally generous standards.  This last serving has prompted me to search the Internet for the source of the problem; no turtle and far too much tomato.  As I have alluded to earlier, this is not consistent with the past history of this product.  Something has gone very terribly wrong here...

column9: There is no turtle. None. What on earth happened?
column10: There's something funny going on when your main soup ingredient is listed almost dead last on the list, right before caramel color. Three lumps of textured vegetable protein, no bigger than a fly... they're saying this is turtle? Are they using the water from a snapper's territory to make the broth? Looks like the supply of turtle meat has dried up.This soup is for all intents and purposes vegetarian, but with almost no protein. It's still somewhat tasty but without meat you're just having a bowl of gravy for lunch.

I just had a bowl of this stuff.  It tasted all tomato with no meat of any kind.  In fact, the soup itself is pretty much like brown gravy with tomato paste or tomato sauce added.  There is no meat at all.  You could eat a bowl of it with a sturdy straw.  It was gross.  I will not even have it again.
i was disappointed with this soup. it wasn't like brennans in neworleans  i added tomatoes, celery and onions to the soup which made it much better.

one star is too generous for this soup, or should I say broth.  The soup label is just a myth. There was hardly anything in this soup other than liquid. I still have 8 cans left and cannot give it away. I do not recommend this soup to anyone.

I'm so glad that I was able to purchase it from Amazon and hope that they will continue to be able to stock it--as it is the only place for me to buy this soup now. The soup is thick, good, and tastes like I just ordered it at the restaurant.

column9: Used to be the Best...Now a Rip-Off
column10: Just had a can.  What a Rip-Off.  How dare they market this as "Bookbinder's" Snapper Soup.  Should be marketed as "the cheap knock-off of Bookbinder's Snapper Soup sold at the same Premium Price."No meat...all I could taste was corn starch.  Well yes...there was a hint of the original spicing....a hint.This is not the same soup that I used to buy with the same labled soup can.The worst part is that I can no longer get true Bookbinder's Snapper Soup.  Thanks a lot for nothing.The lable also shows a very "chunky" soup.  There are no chunks of anything.  Maybe?...some specs of some vegies.
This company has ripped off the consumer by not making it condensed like it used to so you get less soup for a can of it.  PLUS NO MEAT IN IT WHATSOEVER.  They SHOULD be ashamed of themselves!
Just horrible.  I found almost no meat in the soup.  I used to eat this every Christmas, but this year it was terrible.  I will never buy this brand again.

I used to buy this stuff by the case since I lived in Georgia and it was hard to find. Have not had any on a few years, but this current version is absolutely HORRIBLE! Do not waste your money for you will be very disappointed by this sham of a "snapper soup". Bookbinder's (or whoever owns the rights to the name) ought to be ashamed of what they did to what used to be a very good product.

column10: This Bookbinder's Snapper Soup is almost impossible to find anyplace else. They have other chowders, but not the snapper turtle. Just a little water and this makes a great compliment to any meal. Try it and don't be put off by the fact it's made with snapper turtle. Tastes like chicken! Just kidding.
I have long been a fan of Bookbinder's Snapper Soup.  It is very good with a little sherry.
My father was not happy with the soup. He could not eat it or my brother. I am sending it back and I don't fell that I have to pay for the shipping. It was a Birthday Gift for my Fathers 89th
Great price for the product. This is the best Snapper soup ever.Used with a dash of sherry really perks it up.
This is the best soup anywhere, and only Bookbinder's cans it. Yes it is Pennsylvania Snapper Turtle Soup, best garnished with sherry.
I'm a Philly Boy. It's a have to have!!Add a little wine, makes it better!
I enjoy a good snapper soup and found Bookbinder's very tasty when adding a little Harvey's Bristol Cream. If you can't get to a restaurant that serves good snapper soup, I recommend Bookbinder's.
